jobs.title: Director: International Trade Promotions
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS).
jobs.summary: Director position in the Department of Agriculture managing international trade promotions, economic research and policy briefs in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Successful completion of Pre-entry Certificate for SMS as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). Bachelor’s Degree / Advance Diploma (NQF 7) in Agricultural Economics / Trade / Development Economics. 5 years’ experience at middle/senior managerial level in Agricultural economics / Agricultural trade / International trade. Job Related Knowledge: Applicants must have sound knowledge and understanding of the following: Knowledge and understanding of all relevant legislation and regulations that govern the Public Service including the Public Financial Management Act and Treasury Regulations, the Public Service Act, the Labour Relations Act etc. Knowledge of the Government policies and priorities in terms of Agriculture. Understanding of the Government’s international relations policy framework. Understanding of Government’s vision in terms of international forum and the Intergovernmental Relations framework. Knowledge and understanding of the Agricultural sector, Public Administration, various structures and programmes (SADC, NEPAD, AU, UN). Understanding of relevant regional conventions and protocols. Understanding of diplomatic protocol. Knowledge and understanding of the white paper on the transformation of the public service (Batho Pele). Job Related Skills: Financial management. Strategic Capability and Leadership. Programme and Project Management. Knowledge management. Service Delivery Innovation. Problem Solving and Analysis. People management and Empowerment. Client Orientation and Customer Focus. Communication. Honesty and Integrity. Change management. Extended working hours. Travel (Including international travel).
jobs.duties: Manage economic research and provide regular policy briefs to management. Conduct research on economic issues and disseminate research findings through technical reports and briefing documents. Compile, analyse, and report data to explain economic phenomena and forecast market trends. Formulate recommendations, policies or plans to guide DoA interventions. Monitor international trends on agricultural commodity markets and provide briefs to management. Manage the development of international relations and trade (bilateral and multilateral) policies related to agriculture. Manage the analysis and development of policies and advice bilateral trade. Manage the analysis and development of policies and advice multilateral trade. Provide inputs with regards to the signing of trade agreements. Provide the necessary documentation for stakeholder consultations. Manage the implementation of international trade (bilateral and multilateral) policies and agreements related to structure. Implement obligations in terms of trade agreements. Monitor the implementation of trade agreements by the Department. Facilitate, co-ordinate and support the implementation of international trade agreements and policies. Monitor the implementation of trade policy and trade obligations by other trading partners. Facilitate, coordinate and guide the support of international relations with governments, organisations and forums in the Americas, Australasia, Europe and Middle East. Facilitate, co-ordinate and guide the sector participation in multilateral forums and Rome based agencies. Manage, undertake and support trade negotiations, in order to improve international access and contribute towards fair trade rules. Manage the preparations of policy discussion documents to inform South Africa’s international trade in agriculture (including cross cutting e.g non-tariff barriers). Manage the preparation of negotiating positions for the relevant bilateral and multilateral trade negotiations. Co-ordinate and manage research that forms the basis for negotiation of treaties. Undertake, manage and support trade negotiations regarding agriculture. Represent the Department in international trade fora. Undertake and manage support negotiation of bilateral agreements. Manage the provision of trade intelligence to the agriculture sector. Provide input with regards to the development of export and import policies and regulations. Manage the preparation of and collaborate with the DTI in compiling economic impact assessments of international trade policies on procedures, exporters and consumers. Co-ordinated and manage research into foreign trade policies and best practice. Provide advice and recommendations on research outcomes. Manage, co-ordinated and guide international and multilateral relations with governments, organisations and forums in the UN Americas, Australasia, Europe and Middle East. Manage, negotiate and implement the bilateral Agreements with South-South and North-South regions. Manage, negotiate and implement Multilateral agreements relating to agriculture. Support the participation of the department in at the World Trade Organisation and Official Development Assistance Programme, as well as implementation of global norms and standards by International Organisations.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email DITPrecruit58@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Internasionale Handelaanmoediging
af.summary: Direkteurspos in die Department of Agriculture wat internasionale handelbevordering, ekonomiese navorsing en beleidsopsommings in Pretoria bestuur.
af.requirements: Suksesvolle voltooiing van Pre-entry Certificate for SMS soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government (NSG). Bachelor's Degree / Advance Diploma (NQF 7) in Agricultural Economics / Trade / Development Economics. 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in Agricultural economics / Agricultural trade / International trade. Werksverwante kennis: Aansoekers moet oor deeglike kennis en begrip van die volgende beskik: Kennis en begrip van alle tersaaklike wetgewing en regulasies wat die Public Service regeer, insluitend die Public Financial Management Act en Treasury Regulations, die Public Service Act, die Labour Relations Act, ens. Kennis van die regering se beleide en prioriteite ten opsigte van Landbou. Begrip van die regering se beleidsraamwerk vir internasionale betrekkinge. Begrip van die regering se visie ten opsigte van internasionale forums en die Intergovernmental Relations framework. Kennis en begrip van die landbousektor, Public Administration, verskeie strukture en programme (SADC, NEPAD, AU, UN). Begrip van tersaaklike streekskonvensies en protokolle. Begrip van diplomatieke protokol. Kennis en begrip van die witboek oor die transformasie van die Public Service (Batho Pele). Werksverwante vaardighede: Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Program- en projekbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Diensleweringinnovasie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Kommunikasie. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Veranderingsbestuur. Uitgebreide werksure. Reis (Insluitend internasionale reis).
af.duties: Bestuur ekonomiese navorsing en verskaf gereelde beleidsopsommings aan bestuur. Voer navorsing oor ekonomiese kwessies uit en versprei navorsingsbevindings deur middel van tegniese verslae en opsommingdokumente. Stel data saam, ontleed en rapporteer dit om ekonomiese verskynsels te verduidelik en markneigings te voorspel. Formuleer aanbevelings, beleide of planne om DoA-ingrypings te lei. Monitor internasionale neigings op landbou-kommoditeitsmarkte en verskaf opsommings aan bestuur. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van internasionale betrekkinge- en handelbeleid (bilateraal en multilateraal) wat verband hou met landbou. Bestuur die ontleding en ontwikkeling van beleide en advies oor bilaterale handel. Bestuur die ontleding en ontwikkeling van beleide en advies oor multilaterale handel. Verskaf insette met betrekking tot die ondertekening van handelooreenkomste. Verskaf die nodige dokumentasie vir raadpleging van belanghebbendes. Bestuur die implementering van internasionale handelbeleid (bilateraal en multilateraal) en ooreenkomste wat verband hou met struktuur. Implementeer verpligtinge ingevolge handelooreenkomste. Monitor die implementering van handelooreenkomste deur die Department. Fasiliteer, koördineer en ondersteun die implementering van internasionale handelooreenkomste en beleide. Monitor die implementering van handelbeleid en handelverpligtinge deur ander handelsvennote. Fasiliteer, koördineer en lei die ondersteuning van internasionale betrekkinge met regerings, organisasies en forums in die Americas, Australasia, Europe en Middle East. Fasiliteer, koördineer en lei sektordeelname in multilaterale forums en Rome based agencies. Bestuur, onderneem en ondersteun handelonderhandelings om internasionale toegang te verbeter en by te dra tot billike handelsreëls. Bestuur die voorbereiding van beleidsbesprekingsdokumente om South Africa se internasionale handel in landbou in te lig (insluitend kruisverknygende kwessies bv. nie-tariefversperrings). Bestuur die voorbereiding van onderhandelingsposisies vir die tersaaklike bilaterale en multilaterale handelonderhandelings. Koördineer en bestuur navorsing wat die basis vorm vir die onderhandeling van verdrae. Onderneem, bestuur en ondersteun handelonderhandelings rakende landbou. Verteenwoordig die Department in internasionale handelforums. Onderneem en bestuur die ondersteuning van onderhandeling van bilaterale ooreenkomste. Bestuur die verskaffing van handelinligting aan die landbousektor. Verskaf insette met betrekking tot die ontwikkeling van uitvoer- en invoerbeleide en -regulasies. Bestuur die voorbereiding van en werk saam met die DTI in die samestelling van ekonomiese impakassesserings van internasionale handelbeleide op prosedures, uitvoerders en verbruikers. Koördineer en bestuur navorsing oor buitelandse handelbeleide en beste praktyke. Verskaf advies en aanbevelings oor navorsingsuitkomste. Bestuur, koördineer en lei internasionale en multilaterale betrekkinge met regerings, organisasies en forums in die UN Americas, Australasia, Europe en Middle East. Bestuur, onderhandel en implementeer bilaterale ooreenkomste met South-South en North-South streke. Bestuur, onderhandel en implementeer multilaterale ooreenkomste rakende landbou. Ondersteun die deelname van die departement by die World Trade Organisation en Official Development Assistance Programme, asook die implementering van globale norme en standaarde deur International Organisations.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukukhuthaza Ukuhweba Kwamazwe Ngaphandle
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongameli kuDepartment of Agriculture sokuphathwa kokukhuthaza ukuhweba kwamazwe ngaphandle, ucwaningo lobuhlakani bezezimali nemibhalu yokuqonda izinqobo e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kwePre-entry Certificate for SMS njengoba kunconyiwe iNational School of Government (NSG). I-Bachelor's Degree / Advance Diploma (NQF 7) kwi-Agricultural Economics / Trade / Development Economics. Unyaka wokuqashwa eminyakeni engu-5 ezingeni eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokuqashwa kwi-Agricultural economics / Agricultural trade / International trade. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe nolwazi olujulile nokuqonda okulandelayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda yonke imithetho nemithethelwana ephathelene nokulawula izinsizakalo zomphakathi okuhlanganisa nePublic Financial Management Act neTreasury Regulations, i-Public Service Act, i-Labour Relations Act njll. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zikahulumeni nezinhloso mayelana nezolimo. Ukuqonda isakhiwo sezinqobo zahulumeni mayelana nobuhlobo lwamazwe ngaphandle. Ukuqonda isibono sikahulumeni mayelana nendawo yamazwe ngaphandle nesakhiwo sobuhlobo phakathi kwezinhlanga zahulumeni. Ulwazi nokuqonda ingxenye yolimo, ukuqashwa komphakathi, izakhiwo ezahlukahlukene nezinhlela (SADC, NEPAD, AU, UN). Ukuqonda izivumelwano namaphrotokholi wesifundazwe ahlobene nalokhu. Ukuqonda iphrotokholi yobudiplomatic. Ulwazi nokuqonda iphepha elimhlophe mayelana nokushintsha izinsizakalo zomphakathi (Batho Pele). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ikhono lokubhekana phambili nokuholwa. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlela namaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Intuthuko yokuqashwa kwezinsizakalo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kabantu nokuqiniswa amandla. Ukuqondiswa kubathinti nokuqagela ikhasimodi. Ukuxhumana. Ukuqothoza nokuqashwa kwesibopho. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Amahora okusebenza okukhishiwe. Ukuhamba (okuhlanganisa nokuhamba kwamazwe ngaphandle).
zu.duties: Phatha ucwaningo lobuhlakani bezezimali futhi unikeze imibhalu yokuqonda izinqobo njalo kubaphathi. Yenza ucwaningo ngemibuzo yezezimali futhi usakaze iziphumo zocwaningo ngokusebenzisa imibhalo yobuchwepheshe nemibhalu yesinqibo. Hlanganisa, hlaziya, futhi uthule imininingwane ukuze uchaze izimo kwezezimali futhi ubike amathuba emakethe. Yakha izinkomba, izinqobo noma amaphulani ukuze uholele izinkomba ze-DoA. Londa amathuba ezwe ngaphandle emakethe yezimuli zolimo futhi unikeze imibhalu yokuqonda izinqobo kubaphathi. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqobo zobuhlobo lwamazwe ngaphandle nokuhweba (bilateral nangokumultilateral) ezingemva kolimo. Phatha ukuhlaziwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezinqobo futhi uphakamise ngokuhweba ngokubili. Phatha ukuhlaziwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezinqobo futhi uphakamise ngokuhweba ngokumultilateral. Nikeza okungenayo ngokuphathelene nokusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokuhweba. Nikeza imibhalo edingekayo yokuqondiswa kubathinti. Phatha ukusebenziswa kwezinqobo zokuhweba kwamazwe ngaphandle (okubili nakumultilateral) nezivumelwano ezingemva kwezakhiwo. Sebenzisa izibopho mayelana nezivumelwano zokuhweba. Londa ukusebenziswa kwezivumelwano zokuhweba umnyango. Sikhundaza, hlela futhi usekela ukusebenziswa kwezivumelwano nezinqobo zokuhweba kwamazwe ngaphandle. Londa ukusebenziswa kwezinqobo zokuhweba nemiqondo yokuhoweba abanye abahweba. Sikhundaza, hlela futhi holela ukusekelwa kobuhlobo namahulumeni, izinhlangano nezinkundla kwi-Americas, Australasia, Europe neMiddle East. Sikhundaza, hlela futhi holela ukuthi ingxenye ithathe inxaxhebe ezinkundleni zamultilateral kubashaywe base-Rome. Phatha, yenza futhi usekele izinkulumo zokuqondana zokuhothweba, ukuze kube khona ukufinyelela emazweni futhi unikeze imizuzu eqoqo kumthetho owotho bakhona wobuhlobo. Phatha ukulungiswa kwemibhalo yokuqondana ngeqiniso mayelana nokuhweba kwamazwe ngaphandle kolimo eNingizimu Afrika (okuhlanganisa okuthumphayo njengoba okungalawuleki amabhari angenamtheshu). Phatha ukulungiswa kwezikhundla zokuxoxa ngokusayinwa okuhlobene nezinkulumo ngokusayinwa kokuhweba kokubili namultilateral. Hlela futhi uphathe ucwaningo olwakha isisekelo sokuxoxa izinkulumo zezivumelwano. Yenza, phatha futhi usekele izinkulumo zokuqondana zokuhothweba kwezolimo. Mele umnyango ezinkundleni zokuhothweba kwamazwe ngaphandle. Yenza futhi uphathe ukuxoxa inkulumo ngokusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokubili. Phatha ukunikwa kwezinkomba zokuhothweba kulowo ongumuntu osebenza ngezolimo. Nikeza okungenayo ngokuphathelene nokwakhiwa kwezinqobo nemithetho yokungenisa nokuthumela kwemfutho. Phatha ukulungiswa futhi usebenzisane ne-DTI ekuqoqweni kokuqashwa kwamaphuzu ukhwizeni izinqobo ezingemva kokuhweba emazweni aphandle ngokumayelana nokuqhutsulwa kwezinqobo, abathumela futhi abathengi. Hlela futhi uphathe ucwaningo kulezobuciko bezezimali ngaphandle namhlaniseho. Nikeza izinkomba futhi izinkombela ngeziphumo zocwaningo. Phatha, hlela futhi holela amasiko abunzulu kanye namultilateral namahulumeni, izinhlangano, nezinkundla kwi-UN Americas, Australasia, Europe kanye neMiddle East. Phatha, xoxa futhi usebenzise Izivumelwano ngokubili namahholi amaningi South-South kanye North-South. Phatha, xoxa futhi usebenzise izivumelwano ezingokumultilateral ezingemva kolimo. Sekela ukuba nokuba ithathe inxaxhebe i-World Trade Organisation kanye ne-Official Development Assistance Programme, njengoba nokusebenziswa kwezindinganiso namahholo amazwe ngaphandle ngokwamanye amazwe.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ukuthuthwa kwezorhwebo kwamanye amazwe
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli kwiSebe leZolimo elilawula ukuthuthwa kwezorhwebo kwamanye amazwe, uphando lwezoqoqosho namacebiso amabali kwezopolitiko ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Ukuphumelela ukugqiba iSatifikhepho yangaphambili yokuNgenela i-SMS njengoko kuqinisekiswe yiNkundla yeLizwe kaRhulumente (NSG). IDigri yeBachelors / iDiploma ePhakamileyo (NQF 7) kwiQoqosho leZolimo / uRhwebo / uPhuhliso lweQoqosho. 5 iminyaka yamava kunqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu lolawulo kwiQoqosho lezolimo / uRhwebo lolimo / uRhwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe. ulwazi oluxhonywe kumsebenzi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nolwazi oluzileyo nokuqonda oku kulandelayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda kwawo onke amathetho namacebo alo aphatha iNkonzo kaRhulumente kuquka noMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente nemiQathango yeSikolo nguNxwaled experienced, uMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho weMibhalo yokuSebenza njll. Ulwazi lwezokucwangcisa kwerhulumente nezinto ezibalulekileyo mayelana neZolimo. Ukuqonda isakhelo senkqubo yamabali kaRhulumente malungana neendibaniselwano zamazwe ngamazwe. Ukuqonda umbono kaRhulumente malungana nendeni lamazwe ngamazwe nesakhelo seendibaniselwano phakathi kwamahlikweni karhulumente. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwicandela leZolimo, uLawulo lukaRhulumente, iindidi ezahlukeneyo zeenkqubo (SADC, NEPAD, AU, UN). Ukuqonda iinkqubo namacebiso ahambelanayo abe melwandle. Ukuqonda umthetho wokuziphatha kwabamelwandle. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwaphepha elimhlophe malungana noguqulo lwenkonzo karhulumente (Batho Pele). Amandla axhonywe kumsebenzi: uLawulo lweMali. Ikhono leNkululeko yoQoqosho nokuBekisa iNqanaba. uLawulo lweNkqubo namaPhojekthi. uLawulo loLwazi. iNnovation ekuNikezela iNkonzo. ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuChonga. uLawulo bantu nokuBakhululwa. uMkhondo wokuQwalasela umXhasi nokugqithisa kwabo. uNxibelelwano. uQine nokuzithembisa. uLawulo lokuTshintsha. Iiyure zokusebenza ezikhulileyo. ukuHamba (kuquka nokuhamba kwamanye amazwe).
xh.duties: Lawula uphando lwezoqoqosho unikeze amacebiso amabali aqhelekileyo ngokwentsiso kolawulo. Yenza uphando ngeziba zoqoqosho uze uwabalule iziphumo zophando ngamagqabantshintshi eembono nobumbeko lwamagama. Qokelela, hlaluya, unike ingxelo ngeenkcukacha ukuze uchaze izinto zoqoqosho ize achaze amathuba emarike. Yama amacebiso, iinkqubo okanye iicwangciso ukuze axhasa imiddedation yeDoA. Qwalasa imigama kwamanye amazwe kwimarike zokuqoqosho zezolimo unike amacebiso kulawulo. Lawula uphuhliso lweendibaniselwano lwamazwe ngamazwe neenkqubo zorhwebo (ezibini nangaphezulu kwamabini) ezihambelana nezolimo. Lawula uhlaluyiselo nophuhliso lweenkqubo uncedo lwerhwebo elibini. Lawula uhlaluyiselo nophuhliso lweenkqubo uncedo lwerhwebo elingaphezulu kwamabini. Nikeza izinto ezithintela isayini yeesivumelwano zorhwebo. Nikeza uBumba bokuqinisekiswa kolwazi malungana nengxoxo nabathabathelayo. Lawula ukuSetyenziswa kweenkqubo zothutho lwerhwebo (elibini nangaphezulu kwamabini) neesivumelwano ezihambelana nobumbeko. Setyenzisa iinkqubo ngesivumelwano sothutho lwerhwebo. Qwalasa ukusetyenziswa kweesivumelwano zothutho lwerhwebo yiSebe. Qwebisa, qhobosho unceda ukusetyenziswa kweesivumelwano neenkqubo zothutho lwerhwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe. Qwalasa ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zothutho neenkqubo ngabanye bahlali bethutho. Qwebisa, qhobosho ize ulawule inkxaso yendibaniselwano namazwe ngamazwe namahlikweni, iindalo nendeni kumZantsi-Amerikha, Australasia, yurophu naseMpuma eKhatshu. Qwebisa, qhobosho ize ulawule ungeno lwecandela kundeni elingaphezulu kwamabini naseenkonzeni eziseRoma. Lawula, qhube uncedise iingxoxo zothutho lwerhwebo, ukuze kuphuhliswe ungeno lwamazwe ngamazwe nakuqhothwa iinkqubo zobuzwe bokuthutha. Lawula uLungiselelo lweesicatshulwa sesicwangciso sothungo ukuze axele iSewula Afrika ukuthutha kwamazwe ngamazwe kwezolimo (kuquka nokuhlasela kokuhlaneleka umda njengakuvimba abangangenayo). Lawula uLungiselelo lwezikhundla zengxoxo kwingxoxo elibalulekileyo yothutho elibini nangaphezulu kwamabini. Qhobosho lawula uphando oluxhomekeka kuwo iNgxoxo yeemvumelwano. Qhube, lawula uncedise iingxoxo zothutho malungana nezolimo. Mela iSebe kwindeni lothutho lwerhwebo. Qhube lawule inkxaso yengxoxo yeesivumelwano ezibini. Lawula ukunikwa kwezazisi zothutho kwicandela lezolimo. Nikeza izigqibo malungana nophuhliso lweenkqubo namagunya esithuthi esithumwayo nesisamelayo. Lawula uLungiselelo lweenkqubo uze usebenzisane ne-DTI kuhlahlelwaniso lweqoqosho elithinta iinkqubo zothutho kwamanye amazwe kumishini, abathuthi nogxathwa. Qhobosho lawula uphando lweenkqubo zothutho lwamanye amazwe namancedo angcono. Nikeza amacebiso namagqagqatha ngemiphumela yophando. Lawula, qhobosho ize ulawule indibaniselwano namazwe ngamazwe nengaphezulu kwamabini namahlikweni, iindalo nendeni kwi-UN eMerikha yaseMzantsi, Australasia, yurophu naseMpuma eKhatshu. Lawula, xoxa uze usebenzise iSivumelwano esibini namaphondo aseMzantsi-Mzantsi naseMantla-Mzantsi. Lawula, xoxa uze usebenzise iSivumelwano esingaphezulu kwamabini esihambelana nezolimo. Xhasa ungeno lukaRhulumente eWorld Trade Organisation kwaneliNkqubo yoNxibelelwano oluQinisekileyo lwezeNhlabathi, kunye nokuSebenzisa amagqabantshintshi amazwe ngamazwe nolwandlalo ngamabumba laMazwe ngamazwe.

jobs.title: Scientific Technician Grade A-C
jobs.salary_text: R407 337 – R610 131 per annum, (OSD), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with OSD)
jobs.summary: The Department of Agriculture seeks a Scientific Technician in Buffelspoort to develop methodologies and perform technical scientific functions requiring a National Diploma and SACNASP registration.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Biological Sciences or relevant qualification. Compulsory registration with South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as a Certificated Natural Scientist. A minimum of 3 years post qualification technical (Scientific) experience. Job Related Knowledge: Programme and Project management. Scientific methodologies. Research and development. Computer-aided scientific applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high performance culture. Professional judgement. Data analysis. Mentoring. Job Related Skills: Creativity. Self-management. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Computer literacy. Networking. People management. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Change management. Problem solving and analysis. Extended working hours. Handling of hazardous chemicals.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement methodologies, policies, systems and procedures. Perform technical scientific functions and tasks that require interpretation in the presence of an established framework. Apply operational standards and consolidate methodologies, policies, systems and procedures. Identify gaps and develop appropriate interventions. Prepare for and participation in research activities. Data collection through field surveys. Maintenance, calibration and operation of scientific equipment. Provide technical support and advice. Develop working relations with client base. Promote public awareness of scientific activities. Provide technical/scientific data, information and advice. Perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Preparation of data and routine interpretation. Database and data management. Analysis of technical scientific data. Dissemination of information. Apply the appropriate scientific and technical procedures/skills to generate information and knowledge. Formulate proposals and compile reports. Develop and customize operational procedures. Research and Development. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Conceptualise and development of scientific equipment. Equipment review. Research/literature studies to improve expertise. Publish and present technical reports and research findings. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on technology-related matters. Human Capital and Development. Mentor, train and develop candidate research technicians and others to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound scientific principles and code of practice. Supervise technical support and processes. Manage the performance management and development of staff.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email STGrecruit59@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: African, Coloured, Indian Males and Coloured, White Females and persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Wetenskaplike Tegnikus Graad A-C
af.summary: Die Department of Agriculture soek 'n Wetenskaplike Tegnikus in Buffelspoort om metodologieë te ontwikkel en tegnies-wetenskaplike funksies uit te voer waarvoor 'n Nasionale Diploma en SACNASP-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Biologiese Wetenskappe of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie hê. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as 'n Gesertifiseerde Natuurwetenskaplike. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar na-kwalifikasie tegniese (Wetenskaplike) ervaring. Werkverwante Kennis: Program- en projekbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodologieë. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Kennis van regsvoorskrifnakoming. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Data-ontleding. Bemontoring. Werkverwante Vaardighede: Kreatiwiteit. Selfbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Netwerking. Mensebestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Uitgebreide werksure. Hantering van gevaarlike chemikalië.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer metodologieë, beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Voer tegnies-wetenskaplike funksies en take uit wat interpretasie benodig in die teenwoordigheid van 'n gevestige raamwerk. Pas operasionele standaarde toe en konsolideer metodologieë, beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer gapings en ontwikkel geskikte ingrypings. Voorbereiding op en deelname aan navorsingsaktiwiteite. Dataversameling deur veldopnames. Onderhoud, kalibrering en bedryf van wetenskaplike toerusting. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies. Bou werksverhoudings met kliëntebasis. Bevorder openbare bewustheid van wetenskaplike aktiwiteite. Verskaf tegniese/wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies. Voer wetenskaplike ontleding en regulatoriese funksies uit. Voorbereiding van data en roetine-interpretasie. Databasis- en databestuur. Ontleding van tegnies-wetenskaplike data. Verspreiding van inligting. Pas die toepaslike wetenskaplike en tegniese prosedures/vaardighede toe om inligting en kennis te genereer. Formuleer voorstelle en stel verslae op. Ontwikkel en pas operasionele prosedures aan. Navorsing en Ontwikkeling. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Konseptualiseer en ontwikkel wetenskaplike toerusting. Toerustingsherwaardering. Navorsing/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter. Publiseer en bied tegniese verslae en navorsingsbevindings aan. Skakel met tersaaklike liggame/rade oor tegnologieverwante aangeleenthede. Menslike Kapitaal en Ontwikkeling. Bemontor, lei en ontwikkel kandidaat-navorsingstegnici en andere om oordrag van vaardighede/kennis en nakoming van gesonde wetenskaplike beginsels en praktykskode te bevorder. Oorsien tegniese ondersteuning en prosesse. Bestuur prestasiebestuur en ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Umuntu WezezobuChwepheshe Ezenzululwazi Isigaba A-C
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezolimo ufunwa umuntu WezezobuChwepheshe Ezenzululwazi eBuffelspoort ukuba athuthukise izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi futhi enze imisebeni yezobuchwepheshe ezenzululwazi edinga i-Diploma Yezwe kanye nokubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-Sitifiketi Se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe Kwezolimo Eziyisayensi noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqelele kuSouth African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengomuntu Wezesayensi Yasendaweni Onezitifiketi. Isikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-3 seminye yeziqu iziphalo zezobuchwepheshe (Ezenzululwazi). Ulwazi Oluhambisana Nomsebenzi: Ulawulwe ohlelweni namaprojekthi. Izindlela zezesayensi zokwenza umsebenzi..ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa. Izinhlelo zekhompyutha ezisetshenziswa ezesayensi. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Ukudala inkambiso yentengo ephezulu. Ukuhluleka okuhlonishwayo. Ukuhlaziya idatha. Ukumengela. Amakhono Ahambisana Nomsebenzi: Ukudalwa. Ukuziphathisa. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Ukuxhumana. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuxhuma nabantu. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukuphathwa kwezingxabano. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqamba. Amahola amide. Ukuphatha amakhemikhali anobungozi.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi, izinqubomgomo, izimiso nemigudu. Yenza imisebeni nemicimbe yezobuchwepheshe ezenzululwazi edinga incazelo ekubukameni kohlelo olusekelwe. Sebenziza izinga ezokusebenza futhi uhlanganise izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi, izinqubomgomo, izimiso nemigudu. Hlukanisa izikhala futhi uthuthukise ukungenelela okufanele. Lungiselela futhi uthathe inxaxhe ekucwaningeni. Qoqa idatha ngokwenza isibhekezo esiveldi. Ukugcina, ukulinganisa ngokococo nokusebenza kwemishini yezesayensi. Nikeza ukusekelwa kwezobuchwepheshe neluleko. Thuthukise ubudlelwano bokusebenza nesisisekelo samathengi. Khuthaza ukwazi komphakathi ngemisebenzi yezesayensi. Nikeza idatha/ulwazi yezobuchwepheshe/ezesayensi, ulwazi neluleko. Yenza isilinganiso sezesayensi nomsebenzi okhulumisana nomthetho. Ulungiselelo kwedatha nokucazula ngokujwayelekile. Ukuphatha idethibheysi kanye ne-data. Ukuhlaziya idethibheysi yezobuchwepheshe. Ukusabalalisa ulwazi. Sebenzisa izindlela/amakhono ezobuchwepheshe ezifanele ezesayensi ukukhiqiza ulwazi nolwazi. Hlela iziphakamiso futhi uqoqe imibhalo. Thuthukisa futhi ulungiselele imigudu yezokusebenza. ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo obunjingalwazi ukuze ugcine ukuthi uthintana namateknoloji namagama amasha. Cabangisa futhi uthuthukise imishini yezesayensi. Ukubuyeza imishini. Ucwaningo / izifundo zolwazi ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono. Kushicilele futhi kuphakamise imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe kanye neziphumo zocwaningo. Xhumana namabhunga / amakhono ahambisana nodunyulwazi mayelana nezindaba zobuchwepheshe. Ukuqashwa kolwazi nokuthuthukiswa. Mengela, hlelela futhi uthuthukise abathuli bocwaningo bezobuchwepheshe kanye nabanye ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kwamakhono/ulwazi kanye nokuhambisana nemigomo yesayensi esemthethweni noshintsho lomsebenzi. Qapha ukusekelwa kwezobuchwepheshe nemigudu. Phatha ukuphathwa kokusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Scientific Technician Grade A-C
xh.summary: Isebe leAgriculture lifuna iScientific Technician eBuffelspoort ukuze aphuhlise iindlela aze enze imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe yenzululwazi efunayo iNational Diploma kunye nogunyaziso lweSACNASP.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethdi seQela lama-12 kwaye beNdiploma yezwe kwiZenzululwazi Zebhayoloji okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo. Ukuqatshelwa ngokuyimfuneko kwiSouth African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengosenzululwazi oqinisekisiweyo weZalo. Ubuncinane i-3 iminyaka yamava obuchwepheshe (ebungcali) emva kwezidanga. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Lawulo lenkqubo neprojekthi. Iindlela zenzululwazi. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Izicelo zenzululwazi ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuzithoba ngokomthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukudalwa kwesiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Isigqibo esibungcali. Uhlalutyo lweenkcukacha. Ukuyala. Amandla ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukudala. Ukuzilawula. Lawulo leezezimali. Ukujongana nabathengi nokusabela. Unxibelelwano. Ukusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha. Ukuzingisa. Lawulo labantu. Ukuqamba ohlelwe. Lawulo loxinzelelo. Lawulo lenguqu. Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Iiyure ezongezelelweyo zokusebenza. Ukuphatha iikhemikhali ezingozelileyo.
xh.duties: Phuhlaza uvze futhi usebenzise iindlela, iinkqubomgama, iinkqubo neendlela zokwenza izinto. Zenza imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe yenzululwazi nemisebenzi efunwa inkoliso phantsi kwesiseko esisekiweyo. Sebenzisa iinqobo zokusebenza udibanise iindlela, iinkqubomgama, iinkqubo neendlela zokwenza izinto. Phawula izikhewu udale ungeniso olufaneleyo. Lungiselela athabathe inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yophando. Qokelela iingcombolo ngemibuzo yasemhlabeni. Ukugcina, ukulinganisa nokusebenzisa izixhobo zenzululwazi. Yiba nencopho yobuchwepheshe icebiso. Phuhliza ubudlelwano bokusebenza nabathengi. Khuthaza ukuqonda koluntu ngemisebenzi yenzululwazi. Zisa iingcombolo/inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe, ulwazi nolucebiso. Zenza uhlalutyo lwezenzululwazi nemisebenzi elawulayo. Ulungiselelo lweenkcukacha nentetho eqhelekileyo. Ukulawulwa kweqhosha leengcombolo neengcombolo. Uhlalutyo lweenkcukacha zenzululwazi zobuchwepheshe. Ukusasazwa kolwazi. Sebenzisa iindlela nobuchwepheshe obufanelekileyo bokwenza izinto ukuvelisa ulwazi nolwazi. Pampha iindwebo udwe iingxelo. Phuhliza ucwangcise iinkqubo zokusebenza. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Ukuphuhliswa kobuchwepheshe okungapheliyo ukuze ugqamise noluntsha lweemveliso iindlela ezintsha. Cenga uphuhlise izixhobo zenzululwazi. Ukuhlola izixhobo. Uphononongo/ucando lwemibhalo ukuze kuphuculwe ubuchwepheshe. Shicilela uzive iingxelo zobuchwepheshe neziphumo zophando. Thetha namagunya/amabhunga afanelekileyo ngeendaba zoluntsha. Uluntu nophuhliso. Yalele, qeqeshe uphuhlise oogqabi bophononongo bobuchwepheshe nabanye ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kolwazi nolwazi nokulandelwa kweengcamango zenzululwazi ezilungileyo nomgaqo-nkqubo wokuziphatha. Lawula inkxaso yobuchwepheshe neenkqubo. Lawula ukulawulwa kokusebenza nophuhliso basebenzi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk (SUPERVISOR)
jobs.summary: Supervise administration of imported and exported liquor products, manage Wine Online documentation, and prepare statistical reports for the Department of Agriculture in Stellenbosch.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. A Certificate in wine will be an added advantage. Job Related Work Experience: Three (03) years administration experience in Wine Online certification system and user support. Job Related Knowledge: Departmental policies and prescripts. Relevant regulations of the Liquor Production Act, 1989 (Act No 60 of 1989). Knowledge of wine cultivars and different types of liquor as defined in the Liquor Products Act. Knowledge of export and import procedures, compositional and labelling requirements of the Liquor Products Act. Procurement procedures. Quality assurance practices. Cultural diversity. Job Related Skills: Ability to communicate well and interact with people at different levels. Integrity and discretion. Filing of documentation. Issuing of invoices. Wine Online help desk support and client liaison. Registration, processing and issuing of export and import documentation. Knowledge of wine cultivars and different types of liquor. Ability to interpret the Act and regulations. Data capturing and typing skills. Planning and execution. Management and Organising. Interpersonal skills. Problem solving skills. Analytical skills. Listening Kills. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s licence and the ability to drive. Training of Wine Online users. Acceptance of responsibilities. Quality of work. Self-discipline. Communication. Teamwork. Attitude. Computer literacy. Report writing. A valid driver’s license. Extended working hours.
jobs.duties: Maintain control of exported and imported liquor products. Registration, data capturing and processing of import/export documentation on Wine Online. Issuing documentation. Maintain records on Wine Online. Problem solving in Wine Online. Invoicing. Preparing statistical reports. Handling enquiries. Capturing and linking consignees/branches. Correcting LIMS interface errors. Registering exporters/importers. Maintaining registration information. Overseeing sample registration, discarding samples and vinotheque records. Resolving sample registration issues. Issuing compliance letters. Stakeholder Liaison. Providing advisory services to clients, external and Internal stakeholders. Training personnel and clients. Maintaining Wine Online helpdesk. Answering and resolving queries. Validating export certificates. Interpreting import/export procedures. Identifying and resolving blacklisted clients on WOL to ensure adherence to legislative prescripts. Registration/cancellation of A and B codes for liquor products in terms of Regulation 40 of the Act. Verifying and oversee invoicing processes. Supervise and provide financial and supply chain administration and technical line admin support services in the component. Provide information required for shifting into the correct item codes on the budget. Assist with financial management of budget / 25% expenditure per quarter. Budget assistance. Ensuring proper allocation of expenditure and monitor expenditure targets. Verifying invoices. Overseeing procurement processes. Maintaining financial records and asset registers. Assist with monthly and quarterly import and export reports. Oversee adherence to waste management and health and safety requirements. Ensure effectively filed documentation. Supervise human resources/staff. Allocating work. Check, verify and update documentation/registers (leave forms, EPMDS, overtime). Updating work plans and performance standards. Performance assessment. Staff development. Manage export admin office to ensure effecting Wine Online support services.

af.title: Administrasieklerk (SUPERVISOR)
af.summary: Outoesig hou oor administrasie van ingevoerde en uitgevoerde drankprodukte, bestuur Wine Online-dokumentasie, en berei statistiese verslae voor vir die Department of Agriculture in Stellenbosch.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Sertifikaat in wyn sal 'n voordeel wees. Werkverwante werkservaring: Drie (03) jaar administratiewe ervaring in Wine Online-sertifiseringsisteem en gebruikersteun. Werkverwante kennis: Departementbeleide en voorskrifte. Toepaslike regulasies van die Liquor Production Act, 1989 (Act No 60 of 1989). Kennis van wynekultivars en verskillende tipe drank soos omskryf in die Liquor Products Act. Kennis van uitvoer- en invoerprosedures, samestellings- en etiketteringsvereistes van die Liquor Products Act. Verkrygingsprosedures. Kwaliteitsversekeringspraktyke. Kulturele diversiteit. Werkverwante vaardighede: Vermoë om goed te kommunikeer en met mense op verskillende vlakke te skakel. Integriteit en diskresie. Argief van dokumentasie. Uitreik van fakture. Wine Online-hulplynsteun en kliëntskakeling. Registrasie, verwerking en uitreik van uitvoer- en invoerdokumentasie. Kennis van wynekultivars en verskillende tipe drank. Vermoë om die Wet en regulasies te interpreteer. Datavaslegging en tikvaardighede. Beplanning en uitvoering. Bestuur en organisasie. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Luistervaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie en die vermoë om te bestuur. Opleiding van Wine Online-gebruikers. Aanvaarding van verantwoordelikhede. Kwaliteit van werk. Selfdissipline. Kommunikasie. Spanwerk. Houding. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagskrywing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Uitgebreide werksure.
af.duties: Handhaaf beheer oor uitgevoerde en ingevoerde drankprodukte. Registrasie, datavaslegging en verwerking van invoer/uitvoer-dokumentasie op Wine Online. Uitreik van dokumentasie. Rekords op Wine Online hou. Probleemoplossing in Wine Online. Fakturering. Voorberei van statistiese verslae. Hanteer van navrae. Vaslegging en koppeling van ontvangers/takke. Regstelling van LIMS-koppelvlakfoute. Registrasie van uitvoerders/invoerders. Onderhou van registrasie-inligting. Toesig hou oor monsterregistrasie, wegdoen van monsters en vinotheek-rekords. Oplos van monsterregistrasieprobleme. Uitreik van nakomingbriewe. Belanghebbende-skakeling. Voorsien van voorligtingsdienste aan kliënte, eksterne en interne belanghebbendes. Opleiding van personeel en kliënte. Onderhou van Wine Online-hulplyn. Beantwoording en oplos van navrae. Validering van uitvoersertifikate. Interpretering van invoer/uitvoer-prosedures. Identifisering en oplos van swartlys-kliënte op WOL om te verseker dat daar aan wetgewende voorskrifte voldoen word. Registrasie/kansellasie van A- en B-kodes vir drankprodukte ooreenkomstig Regulasie 40 van die Wet. Verifiëring en toesig oor faktureringprosesse. Outoesig hou en voorsien van finansiële en voorsieningsketen-administrasie en tegniese lyn-administrasiesteundienste in die komponent. Verskaf inligting wat nodig is vir skuif na die korrekte itemkodes op die begroting. Bystand verleen met finansiële bestuur van begroting / 25% besteding per kwartaal. Begrotingsbystand. Verseker behoorlike toekenning van besteding en monitor bestedingsdoelwitte. Verifiëring van fakture. Toesig oor verkrygingsprosesse. Onderhou van finansiële rekords en bateregisters. Bystand verleen met maandelikse en kwartaalikse invoer- en uitvoerverslae. Toesig hou oor nakoming van afvalbestuur en gesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes. jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Assistant
jobs.summary: Senior Laboratory Assistant needed in Stellenbosch to prepare samples and perform routine chemical analysis of agricultural and liquor products, requiring Grade 12 and three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate. Job Related Work Experience: Three (03) years appropriate experience. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Public Service and Departmental prescripts/ policies. Agricultural Product Standards Act, Act 119 of 1990. Liquor Products Act, Act 60 of 1989. Job related skills: Knowledge and application of the laboratory quality system. Knowledge of work-related policies and procedures. Laboratory techniques and safety. Problem solving techniques. Effective communication. Provisioning Administrative system (chemicals, equipment etc.). Data processing. Applicable relevant analytical techniques. Effective managing of stores and ordering of miscellaneous stores. Use of relevant laboratory and office equipment. Manual dexterity. Communication capabilities. Insight capabilities in the application of quality assurance documentation. Accuracy, thoroughness and timeousness. Computer skills, application/usage of computer software. Code 08 Drivers license. Alert and troubleshooting skills. Administrative and organisational skills. Language capabilities with regard to the understating of quality system documentation. Planning skills. Self-developmental inclined, Ability to work in a team. Training skills/give guidance. Willingness to work extended hours. Handling of hazardous chemicals.
jobs.duties: Prepare samples and perform routine analysis for the determination of chemical residues / liquor products composition components (quality control): Labelling of samples. Collecting/taking samples for preparation (fruits, vegetables and or other agricultural products). Preparations of sample material by weighing, drying, cutting etc. Preparation of stains, buffets and reagents. Visual inspection and collection of infected material if possible. Perform extractions and basic analyses of samples. Record analyses results. Storage of samples. Packing and / or transport samples. Assist in decontamination and disposal of used samples. Removal of waste. Perform basic maintenance on selected equipment and instrumentation. Report all faulty equipment and instrumentation. Perform verification and calibration on selected equipment and instrumentation. Maintain tidiness of laboratories, clean/sterilize glassware and equipment. Clean laboratory facilities. Clean glassware and laboratory equipment. Perform administrative and related functions. Inventory control of equipment and consumables of equipment. Record keeping and updating of identified registers (registration book, samples referral, samples received, records of results, inventory of standards, reagents, chemicals, waste removal). Assist with invoicing of analyses. Comply with health and safety regulations, Mentoring of Laboratory Assistants.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email SLArecruit61@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Males and Females and Persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Laboratoriumassistent
af.summary: Senior Laboratoriumassistent word in Stellenbosch benodig om monsters voor te berei en roetine chemiese ontleding van landbou- en drankprodukte uit te voer, met 'n vereiste van Graad 12 en drie jaar se relevante ervaring.

Waaksaam en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Administratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede. Taalvermoëns met betrekking tot die begrip van kwaliteitstelseldokumentasie. Beplanningsvaardighede. Selfontwikkelingsgesindheid. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Opleidingsvaardighede/leiding gee. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk. Hantering van gevaarlike chemikalieë.
af.duties: Berei monsters voor en voer roetine-ontleding uit vir die bepaling van chemiese residu / drankprodukte se samestellingskomponente (kwaliteitsbeheer): Etikettering van monsters. Voorbereiding van kleurstowwe, buffervloeistowwe en reagense. Visuele ondersoek en versameling van besmette materiaal indien moontlik. Voer onttrekkings en basiese ontledings van monsters uit. Registreer ontledingsresultate. Berging van monsters. Verpakking en/of vervoer van monsters. Bystand met dekontaminasie en wegdoening van gebruikte monsters. Verwydering van afval. Voer basiese onderhoud aan geselekteerde toerusting en instrumente uit. Rapporteer alle foutiewe toerusting en instrumente. Voer verifikasie en kalibrering aan geselekteerde toerusting en instrumente uit. Onderhou netheid van laboratoria, maak glasware en toerusting skoon/steriliseer dit. Maak laboratoriumfasiliteite skoon. Maak glasware en laboratoriumtoerusting skoon. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Voorraadbeheer van toerusting en verbruiksmateriaal van toerusting. Hou rekords en werk geïdentifiseerde register by (registrasieboek, monsterverwysings, monsters ontvang, resultaatrekords, voorraad van standaarde, reagense, chemikalieë, afvalverwydering). Bystand met fakturering van ontledings. Voldoen aan gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies. Mentorskap van Laboratoriumassistente.

Bied hulp by die verifikasie van bate-verslae vir die verskeie afdelings vir die kwartaallikse bate-verslag. Bied hulp by die koördinering van verliese vir die kwartaallikse verliesverslag Verskaf personeeladministrasie-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Prosesseer en registreer aansoeke om verlof en onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Stel en onderhou bywoningsregister van die komponent op. Hanteer navrae, bv. verlof, beëindiging, aanstellings, PMDS, Prestasieooreenkoms, ens. Verskaf advies en leiding aan amptenare ten opsigte van menslike hulpbron-aangeleenthede. Dien opleidingsdokumentasie in en onderhou opleidingsrekords. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste. Bied hulp met die begroting deur inligting te verskaf, uitgawes vir die komponent vas te lê en by te werk. Fasiliteer betaling vir goedere en dienste. Administreer, kontroleer en verifieer S&T-eise en vooruitbetaling, werk die S&T-eis- en Vooruitbetalingbeheerregister en personeelrekord by. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en kleinkontantgeld vir die komponent. Kontroleer en verifieer selfoon- en 5G-aansoeke en onderhoud van die databasis en selfoonregister. Kontroleer en verifieer oortyd-eise en werk die oortydregister by. Genereer fakturering en weeklikse faktuurregisters en maandelikse faktuurversoenings. Maandelikse betaling en versoening van die koerierrekening. Verskaf fakture en ander rekenverwante inligting aan belanghebbendes. Lewer vervoeradministratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Koördineer die benutting van regeringsvoertuie. Reis werksopdragte en stallingtoepassings uit aan amptenare, bestuur en beheer die uitreiking van voertuie en petrolkaarte. Voer inspeksies van voertuie uit. Verifieer bestuurderslisensies van amptenare voor uitreiking van departementele voertuie. Verseker dat voertuie bedien en / of onderhou word volgens die vereistes. Rapporteer skade aan voertuie. Koördineer die herstel van voertuie (as gevolg van ongelukke, onderbrekings, ens). hou rekord van logblaaie, reisgemagtigings, verifieer Wes Bank-transaksieverslae, ens. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Voltooi 'n ongelukverslag, verliesverslae en ander vervoerverwante verslae.

zu.title: Umlobi wezokuphathwa
zu.summary: Kudingwa umcebisi wokuphathwa kwezinto eBloemfontein ukuba anikeze inkxaso yomcebisi, abambe idatha futhi aphathe imibhalo, kudingeka ibe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12.
zu.requirements: Um fumuzi kufanele abe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12. Akukho mfundo efunwayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomcebisi, izindlela kanye n ikhono lokubamba idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuqoqa izibalo. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda umthetho ohlela Izikhundla Zikahulumeni. Ulwazi ngezindlela zokusebenza ngokwesimo sasekhaya. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono wolimi, amakhono okuxhumana ahle (oluhlomo nolubhaliwe), Amakhono wokuhlela nokuhlela, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuxhumana kwabantu, Ukuguquguquka n ikhono lokusebenza eqoqweni.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi ejwayelekile yomcebisi wenhlangano. Qophela, hlela, gigima, bathaze ulwazi bese uphinda ulifunde (umsebenzi ohlobene). Qophisa ulwazi ngemikhondo kanye ngesandla / Buyekeza irejista nokubalwa kwabalulekile. Nikela ngesikhungo sokwamukela / seyithi bese uphatha imibuzo evamile. Yenza izikhwama zokukopisha bese uwamukela noma uwathumele amafeksi. Nikeza abahlanganyeli izifundo zenyanga zonke zesikhombi-sikhasi futhi uloge ukulungiswa. Nikeza izaziso zenyanga zonke zokuwamukela kwesikhombi-sikhasi. Bika izindaba zokuphathwa kwezakhiwo / indawo yokuhlala. Phatha iposi eyingenayo nasephumayo kanye namaphakethe kubahlanganyeli abahlukene njengoba kudingekile. Gcina futhi ulondoloze isistimu yokugcina amafayela yeqoqo. Nikeza insiza yesikhulumi esikhundleni somlobi weajenda, qamba amaminithi, hlela imihlangano, izindawo nokuhlala kanye nezinhlelo zokuhamba. Bhala izincwadi kanye nalunye ulwazi lwezincwadi uma kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yamadokhumenti ayingenayo naphumayo yeqoqo. Buyekeza futhi ulondoloze izinhlaka ezihlobene zemininingwane. Hlela bese uthumela imibiko ephathelene, imemo kanye nezindululo njengoba kudingeka. Gcina futhi ulondoloze Ireyjista Yokulawula Ufathe. Nikela ngemisebenzi yomcebisi wokuhamba kwesitokwe kuleli qoqo. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle maqondana nokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsiza. Thola izikhalo, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izimpahla zohhovu futhi uqashe izinkontileka. Lawula isitokwe sezimpahla zohhovu, iza ngokuhlanzeka, amafomu abalulekile, impahla kanye nemisoco bese ukhiqiza idatha. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yempahla yeqoqo. Phatha ukunyakaza kanye nokulahla impahla yeqoqo. Qamba imibiko yempahla nokulawula ukulahleka uma kunesidingo. Siza ekuhlolweni kwemibiko yempahla kumabhange ahlukene ngohlelo lwamakota. Siza ekulungeni ukulahlekelwa ohlelweni lwamakota. Nikeza ngemisebenzi yomcebisi wolawulo babasebenzi kuleli qoqo. Lelela futhi uqophe izicelo zeholide bese ulondoloza irejista yeholide yeqoqo. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abasebenzi eqoqweni. Hlela futhi ulondoloze irejista yokubakhona eqoqweni. Phatha imibuzo, njengaleholide, ukuphuma, ukuqashwa, i-PMDS, Isivumelwano Sezesibalo, njll. Nikeza ngeluleko nokuqondisa abasebenzi ngezenkolo zabantu. Thumela amadokhumentiokuqeqesha bese ulondoloza amarekhodiokuqeqeshwa. Nikeza ngemisebenzi yezimali wolawulo eqoqweni. Insiza yezimali yolawulo. Siza ngejikijana ngokunikela ngolwazi, ukubhala futhi ubuyekeze ukuchithwa kwezimali eqoqweni. Sebukela ngenxa yokukhokha izimpahla nezinsiza. Phatha, hlola futhi uqinisekise izimangalo kwe-S&T nemali ethunyelwe phambili, buyekeza irejista yokulawula kwesimangalo semali yeholide nemali ethunyelwe phambili kanye namarekhodi abasebenzi. Phatha ama-akhawunti ocingo kanye nemali encane yeqoqo. Hlola futhi uqinisekise izicelo zefoni yezandla zamakota no-5G futhi ulondoloze idatha yezinga lemininingwane kanye nerejista yefoni yezandla. Hlola futhi uqinisekise izimangalo zesikhathi esikhulu futhi ubuyekeze irejista yesikhathi esikhulu. Khiqiza izikweletu bese uthumela kanye nerejista yamasonto onke yamavesi bese uhlela futhi ubuyekeza ngokuthunyelwa kwamavesi enhlanganini. Enza futhi uhlele ukukhokhelwa kule minyaka yonke kwezimali zokuqashwa kwenkontileka. Siza abahlanganyeli ngolwazi lwezimali nezinye izindaba. Nikeza ngemisebenzi yolawulo lokuhamba. Hlela ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto kahulumeni. Nikeza izimvume zokuhamba kanye nezicelo zokubeka esikhwameni, lawula futhi uqinisekise ukutholakala kwezimoto namakhadi kagesi. Hlolisisa izimoto. Qinisekisa amalayisensi abashayeli ngaphambi kokuba banikezwe izimoto zomnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zibhekwa futhi / noma zilondolozwe ngokwesidingo. Bika ukulimele kwezimoto. Hlela ukulungiswa kwezimoto (okubangelwa yiziongqo, ukuphahleka, njll). Gcina irekhodi lamashidi okuqamba, izimvume zokuhamba, uqinisekise imibiko yamathuluzi akawuthinti ewesibhange, njll. Hlela ukuhamba kanye nokuhlala. Qedela imibiko yezimoto, imibiko yokulahleka kanye nezinye izindaba eziyohamba.

xh.title: Onobhalo woLawulo
xh.summary: Kufunekiwo oNobhalo wokuLawula eBloemfontein ukuyinika inkxaso yomsebenzi wohlolo, ukuyifaka idatha nakulawula unxibelelwano, kwaye kufuneka abe nesatifikethi seGrade 12.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umfundi abe nesatifikethi seGrade 12. Akukho mfundo yamava edityaniswe nalo msebenzi. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yohlolo, iindlela zokuyenza kunye nokuqonda ukwenza ulwazi lweenkcukacha ngokwakhompyutha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela i-statistics. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwendlela elawulwa ngumthetho yoLawulo Lomsekbenzi kaRhulumente. Ulwazi lweendlela zokusebenza ngokwendalo yendawo yokusebenza. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Amakhono eelwimi, amakhono amabaligqibi mntu wonke alungileyo (okuthethwayo nokubhalwayo), Amakhono okucwangcisa nokulungelelanisa izinto, Ukubhaliswa kwekhompyutha, Ubudlelwane phakathi komntu nomntu, Ukuguquguquka nokuQonda ukusebenza kwelinye iqela.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo ezidibana nexesha ezincedisa kumsebenzi wohlolo. Qamba, hlela, gcina, faka kwaye uphinde ufumane unxibelelwano nedata (umsebenzi woluhlu). Faka idatha ngokwe-elektroniki nangokwasandla / Hlaziya amarejista namastatistikh. Nika inkonzo yamagumbi okwamkelo / weswithibhodi kwaye uphathe imibuzo ejolise kumsebenzi wonyaka. Yenza iikopi ezifanekiswayo kwaye wamkele okanye uthume iifeksi. Nikeza abathathi-nxaxheba iifoti-ikopi ezifundwa nyanga nganye kwaye ubhale izithuba zokulungisa. Nikeza isaziso sokuqinisekisa ukwamkelwa kweefoti-ikopi nyanga nganye. Xela iindaba ezimalunga nokuhlalwa nokulungiswa kwakho. Phatha imeyile ezingena naphuma kunye namaphakheji kwabanxaxheba abahlukeneyo njengoko kufunekayo. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze inkqubo yokugcina amafayile elunga. Nika inkonzo yonobhalo wokuqamba ihlelo lemihlangano kwaye uthathe imizuzu, ulungiselele imihlangano, iindawo zokuhlala nohambelo. Thayipha iileta kwaye / okanye enye unxibelelwano xa kufuneka. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze irejista yamadokhumba angena naphuma elunga Hlaziya kwaye ulondoloze idatabase ezithintekayo. Qamba kwaye unikeze iiripoti, iimemo nokunikelwa njengoko kufuneka. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze iKey Control Register. Nika iinkonzo ezincedisa kumsebenzi wohlolo wenkqubo yokuqokelela iibesi elungeni. Thintana nabanxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuba nipathele ukuthengwa kwezinto neenkonzo. Fumana iikota, gcwalisa iifomu zokuthenga izinto zofise nakumagqabaniso. Lawula isitori samaphakethe zofise, izinto zokucoca, iifomu, iiasethi kunye neempahla kwaye uzinikeze njengomthwalo wezinto. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze irejista yeasethi elungeni. Phatha ukuhamba nokulahlwa kwezasethi elungeni. Qamba iiripoti zeasethi nolawulo lokulahleka njengoko kufuneka. Nceda kuqinisekiso lweeripoti zeasethi kumacandelo amahlukeneyo ukuze kubekho iripoti yeasethi yenyanga yamathathu. Nceda nokulungelelanisa iintshatsheli zeripoti yokulahleka yenyanga yamathathu Nika iinkonzo ezincedisa kumsebenzi wohlolo wolawulo lwabasebenzi elungeni. Sicela kwaye uqambe iifomu zokushiya umsebenzi kwaye ulondoloze irejista yokushiya umsebenzi elungeni. Gcina kwaye ulondoloze amarekhodi abasebenzi elungeni. Qamba kwaye ulondoloze irejista yobukho elungeni. Phatha imibuzo, umzekelo, ukushiya umsebenzi, ukugqiba konke, iinkqubo, iNkqubo yoMvuzo, isivumelwano seMfuyo, njl. Nikeza ingcebiso nokukhokela abasebenzi malunga neendaba zomntu wonke. Nikeza amadokhumba oqeqesho kwaye ulondoloze amarekhodi oqeqesho. Nika iinkonzo zolawulo lweemali elungeni. Iinkonzo zolawulo lweemali. Nceda ngebajeti ngokunikela inkcazelo, ukuyifaka kwaye uhlaziye ukutshixa kwemali elungeni. Yenza kuqhamuke intlawulo yezinto neenkonzo. Lawula, hlola kwaye uqinisekise iinkhalazo ze-S&T kunye neentlawulo, kwaye uhlaziye irejista yokulawula iinkhalazo ze-S&T kunye namarekhodi abasebenzi. Phatha i-akhawunti zefowuni kwaye uncinyane nemali elungeni. Hlola kwaye uqinisekise iifomu zefowuni yaselula kunye ne-5G kwaye ulondoloze idatabase kunye nerejista yefowuni yaselula. Hlola kwaye uqinisekise iinkhalazo zenyanga ebidlulileyo kwaye uhlaziye irejista yenyanga ebidlulileyo. Yenza iinvaysi kunye nerejista yeenvaysi yaveki kunye nokuqinisekisa iinvaysi nyanga nganye. Intlawulo yenyanga kunye nokubuyisana kwesitatu sekhathi phakathi kwamaxhwele. Nikeza abanxaxheba iinvaysi nolunye ulwazi olumayelana ne-akhawunti. Nika iinkonzo zolawulo lokuhamba. Lungelelanisa ukusetyenziswa kwezithuthi zorhulumente. Nikeza iinkqubo zokuvunywa ukuhamba kunye nezicelo zokugcina izithuthi abasebenzini, kwaye ulawule ukunika izithuthi namakhadi epetrol. Qhuba iinpelo kwezithuthi. Qinisekisa amalayisensi abaqhubi abasebenzi ngaphambi kokunikwa izithuthi zebe. Qiniseka ukuba izithuthi zikhonza kwaye / okanye zilungiwe njengoko kufuneka. Xela ukonakala kwezithuthi. Lungelelanisa ukulungiswa kwezithuthi (okubangelwa yingozi, ukuphuka, njl). gcina irekhodi lamakhasi okuloga, iinkqubo zokuvunywa ukuhamba, qinisekisa iiripoti zentshiselwano zeWes Bank, njl. Lungiselela uhambo nendawo yokuhlala. Ukuqwalasela iripoti yengozi, iiripoti zokulahlekelwa nakwezinye iiripoti ezimalunga nezithuthi.

jobs.title: Director: State-owned Entities Governance
jobs.department: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (the all-inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Pension Fund, a medical fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules).
jobs.summary: Direct state-owned entity governance oversight, managing shareholder compacts and governance frameworks for the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF level 7/ degree in Auditing / Law / Accounting / Corporate Governance or relevant equivalent qualification as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority. Five (5) years’ experience at Middle/ Senior Management level in Enterprise /SOEs corporate governance oversight services of organisations/public entities. Postgraduate qualifications in Corporate Governance will serve as an added advantage. Skills / Competencies and Knowledge: Core competencies: At an advanced level in Strategic Capability and Leadership; Government Administrative Processes; People Management and Empowerment; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management, Service Delivery Innovation, Problem solving and analysis, Client Orientation, Customer-focused Communication. Technical knowledge and competencies: Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of the Companies Act 2008, Knowledge of King IV Report on Corporate Governance in South Africa, Review and analysis of governance documents / frameworks / processes / submissions, Interpretation of Governance Legislation and Policy Frameworks, Review and Assessment of Compliance with Policies, Laws, Basic Research, Analytical Thinking, Report Writing.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will manage and drive the development, review and implementation of the Departmental shareholder governance framework. Manage and monitor shareholder governance instruments applicable to assigned entities, including shareholder compacts, governance agreements and Memoranda of Incorporation. Manage assessments of governance performance and compliance of SOEs with shareholder compacts/governance agreements and other governance instruments. Manage the assessment of board governance, board, committee and executive evaluations, and implementation of approved governance improvement plans. Manage the Board appointment and remuneration process and analyse executive appointment submissions from assigned entities, including preparing recommendations for Ministerial consideration. Manage the coordination and facilitation of the Minister’s participation in SOE-related governance structures (annual general meetings and Minister-Board quarterly forum meetings), analysis of SOE annual reports and other reports submitted for the meetings and tabling of SOE annual reports. Manage oversight of interventions arising from audit findings within assigned entities, including assessing audit implications and recommending corrective actions. Manage preliminary assessments of allegations of misconduct across the SOE portfolio, oversight of formal investigations conducted by external service providers, and monitoring of implementation of investigation recommendations and corrective governance measures. Contributing to key result areas such as strategic functional leadership, managing human resources, managing financial resources, driving change and operational excellence, and managing and ensuring compliance.
jobs.enquiries: Mr M Cilo Tel No: (012) 12 427 8514, Ms N Khosa Tel No: (012) 427 8260, Ms N Sekele Tel No: (012) 427 8599

Each post advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialed and signed by the applicant. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity.
