af.title: Direkteur: Bestuur van Staatsbeheerde Entiteite
af.summary: Bestuur staatsbeheerde entiteite se bestuursblootstelling, bestuur aandeelhouerskompakte en bestuursraamwerke vir die Department of Communications and Digital Technologies in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF-vlak 7/ graad in Oudit / Regte / Rekenkunde / Korporatiewe Bestuur of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op Bestuurs-/ Senior bestuursvlak in Korporatiewe bestuursblootstellingsdienste van ondernemings/SOE's van organisasies/publieke entiteite. Nagraadse kwalifikasies in Korporatiewe Bestuur sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Vaardighede / Bevoegdhede en Kennis: Kernbevoegdhede: Op 'n gevorderde vlak in Strategiese Vermoë en Leierskap; Regerings Administratiewe Prosesse; Menslikehulpbronbestuur en Bemagtiging; Programme- en Projektbestuur; Finansiële Bestuur, Diensleweringinnovasie, Probleemoplossing en analise, Kliëntoriëntasie, Kliëntgefokusde Kommunikasie. Tegniese kennis en bevoegdhede: Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die Companies Act 2008, Kennis van King IV Report on Corporate Governance in South Africa, Hersiening en analise van bestuursdokumente / raamwerke / prosesse / voorleggings, Interpretasie van Bestuurswetgewing en Beleidsraamwerke, Hersiening en assessering van nakoming van beleide, wette, basiese navorsing, analitiese denke, verslagskrywing.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van die departementele aandeelhouerbestuursraamwerk bestuur en dryf. Bestuur en monitor aandeelhouerbestuursinstrumente wat van toepassing is op toegewysde entiteite, insluitend aandeelhouerskompakte, bestuursooreenkomste en Memoranda of Incorporation. Bestuur assesserings van bestuursprestasie en nakoming van SOE's met aandeelhouerskompakte/bestuursooreenkomste en ander bestuursinstrumente. Bestuur die assessering van raadbestuur, raad-, komitee- en uitvoerende evaluerings, en implementering van goedgekeurde bestuursverbeteringsplanne. Bestuur die raadsbenoemings- en vergoedingsproses en analiseer uitvoerende benoemingsvoorleggings van toegewysde entiteite, insluitend die voorbereiding van aanbevelings vir oorweging deur die Minister. Bestuur die koördinering en fasilitering van die Minister se deelname aan SOE-verwante bestuursstrukture (jaarlike algemene vergaderings en Minister-Raad kwartaalforum vergaderings), analise van SOE-jaarverslae en ander verslae vir die vergaderings en voorlegging van SOE-jaarverslae. Bestuur toesig oor ingryping wat voortspruit uit ouditbevindings binne toegewysde entiteite, insluitend die assessering van ouditimplikasies en die aanbeveling van regstellende maatreëls. Bestuur voorlopige assesserings van beweringe van wangedrag oor die SOE-portefeulje, toesig oor formele ondersoeke wat deur eksterne diensverskaffers uitgevoer word, en monitering van die implementering van ondersoekaanbevelings en regstellende bestuursmaatreëls. Bydra tot sleutelresultaatgebiede soos strategiese funksionele leierskap, bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne, dryf van verandering en operasionele uitmuntendheid, en bestuur en verseker van nakoming.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukubuswa Kwamashidi Ahlangene Nabumnyama
zu.summary: Qonda ukulawula ukubuswa kwezinhlangano ezinika amandla umbuso, ngokuphatha izivumelwano zabasabalalisi kanye nezinhlelo zokubusa zikamnyango we-Communications and Digital Technologies e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezibekiwe kuma-NQF level 7/ degree ku-Auditing / Law / Accounting / Corporate Governance noma iziqu ezifanayo ezihambisana nalezo njengoba zithathwa njengamazwe ngamazwe ngumnyango we-South African Qualifications Authority. Ube neminyaka emihlanu (5) ohlebeni ezingeni eliphakathi / eliphezulu lobunikazi bemisebenzi ohlelweni lokugadlela inkampani / SOEs kumashidi ahlangene wezinhlangano / izikhungo zomphakathi. Iziqu eziphezulu kwi-Corporate Governance zibe yithamsanqa. Amakhono / Izikhondo nokwazi: Izikhondo eziyisiseko: Kuyizinga eliphezulu ekubeni namandla okubumba ihlelo kanye noBunikazi; Izinqubo zokuphatha kahulumeni; Abantu banikela amandla futhi bakhuliswe; Uhlelo nokuphatha imibhalo; Ukuphatha izimali; Ukubumba izinsiza ezingamuhla; Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda izinto; Ukuqashelwa kwegama losito; Ukwazisa ngokuhambisana nomthengi. Ulwazi ngezobuchwepheshe namandla okwenza izinto: Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Companies Act 2008, Ulwazi ngembiko i-King IV Report on Corporate Governance in South Africa, ukubuyekeza kanye nokuqonda imibhalo / izinhlelo / izinqubo / izincomo zokubusa, ukuhumusha umthetho wobunikazi kanye nezinhlelo zomthetho, ukubuyekeza kanye nokuqashelwa kokulandelwa kwemithetho, kwamapholisi, izinto ezisisiseko zophenyu, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Umuntu othole isikhundla uzophatha futhi aqonde ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa kanye nokuphunywa kwemisoco egxile ekubuseni komnikazi wamasheya komnyango. Uphathe futhi ulawule izinto ezisetshenziswa ekubuseni komnikazi wamasheya ezibekelwe izinhlangano ezabelwe, okuhlanganisa isivumelwano somnikazi wamasheya, izivumelwano zokubusa kanye namamemorandamu wokubhalisa. Uphathe ukuhlola ukusebenza nokulandelwa kwemithetho yalawulo masheya kumashidi ahlangene nezivumelwano zomnikazi wamasheya / izivumelwano zokubusa kanye nezinye izinto zokubusa. Uphathe ukuhlolwa kobuso bebhodi, ibhodi, amakomidi kanye nokuqashelwa kwabaphathi, kanye nokuphunywa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukubusa ezamukelekile. Uphathe inqubo yokubekwa kanye nokukhokhelwa kwebhodi futhi ahlaziye izincomo ezithunyelwe ngabaphathi kusukela kuzinhlangano ezabelwe, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela izincomo eziza kucatshangelwa yiNgqongqoshe. Uphathe ukuhlanganisa nokwesekwa ukubamba kwabaNgqongqoshe ezakhiwo zokubusa ezihlobene namashidi ahlangene (izinkomfa ezivela ngamnye kanye nezinkomfa zikahle kwikota phakathi kweNgqongqoshe neBhodi), ukuhlaziywa kwemibiko yonyaka kanye neminye imibiko ethunyelwe kuleyo nkomba futhi ibe kwinkomba yaleyo nkomba. Uphathe ukugadlela izinyathelo ezithuthwa ngenxa yezinto ezitholwe ekuhloleni ngaphakathi kwezinhlangano ezabelwe, okuhlanganisa nokuqashela imiphumela yokuhlolwa nokunikela ngeminikelo yezinyathelo zokulungisa. Uphathe ukuqashelwa okwenziwa okokuqala ngamacala abhekwa abantu abenza amasoka kunoma yikuphi kulesi simo sabashidi bahlangene, ukugadlela uphenyo olusemthethweni olwenziwa abanikezeli bezinsiza abangaphandle, kanye nokuqapha ukuphunywa kwezincomo zophenyu kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa ukubusa. Ukufaka isandla ezindaweni eziyisiphetho ezibalulekile njengokuba uhola ngokusebenza ngobuchule, ukuphatha abasebenzi, ukuphatha izinsiza zezimali, ukuguqula izinto kanye nokuba ngcono ekusebenzeni, nokuphatha futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwemithetho.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ulawulo loMntla we Ndlela ze Nzuzo
xh.summary: Lawula ukukhangela ulawulo lweentitim zaburhulumente, ulawula iinkcubzana zabanini-zabelo nendlela zolawulo kwiSebe lezoNxibelelwano kunye neeNkqubo zeDigital ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo sika NQF level 7/ degree kwi-Auditing / Law / Accounting / Corporate Governance okanye isifundo esilinganayo esinjalo njengoko sivunywa yi-South African Qualifications Authority. Iminyaka yamava emihlanu (5) kumqondo ongaphakathi kweNdulu / aphezulu yolawulo kwi-Enterprise /SOEs ulawulo lokukhangela iinkonzo kweentitim zaburhulumente / kwiziko. Isifundo sesidanga esiphezulu kwi-Corporate Governance siza kuba lusizo olongezelelekileyo. Amakhono / Amandlaokusebenza nokuQonda: Amandla am abhalisiweyo: Kwisidanga esiphezulu kwi-Strategic Capability and Leadership; Government Administrative Processes; People Management and Empowerment; Programme and Project Management; Financial Management, Service Delivery Innovation, Problem solving and analysis, Client Orientation, Customer-focused Communication. Ukuqonda ngokweemfanelo kunye namandla okusebenza: Ukuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act kunye nee-Treasury Regulations. Ukuqonda i-Companies Act 2008, ukuqonda i-King IV Report on Corporate Governance eMzantsi Afrika, ukuqhuba uluvo nokuqwalasela amaxwebhu olawulo / iinkqubo zeendlebe / iinkqubo / izibhalo ezenziwayo, ukutolika iMthetho yolawulo neendleba zeenkqubo zomthetho, ukuqhuba uvavo nokukhangela ukuzalathiswa ngokomthetho kwemithetho, amathetho, uphando olusisiseko, ukuqamba ngengqondo, ukuBhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Umfundi ophumeleleyo uza kulawula nokushukumisa uphuhliso, ukuqwalasela nokusebenzisa inkqubo yolawulo yabanini-abelo boSebe. Ulawula kwaye ajonge nzulu iinkqubo ezilawula abanini-zabelo kwii-entitim ezabelwe kuzo, kuquka iinkcubzana zabanini-zabelo, iingqinisekiso zolawulo kunye nee-Memoranda of Incorporation. Ulawula ukuqwalasela ukusebenza ngokomthetho kolawulo neenkqubo zolawulo kumthetho wee-SOE ngokwela nkcubzana zabanini-zabelo / iingqinisekiso zolawulo nantoni na enye indleba yolawulo. Ulawula ukuqwalasela ngokoburhulumente bolawulo beBhodi, uvavayo lwebhodi, lweekomiti kunye nabaphathi, kwaye uqwalasele ukusebenziswa kweenkqubo zophuculo lolawulo ezamkelekileyo. Ulawula inkqubo yokuqokwa kwaye nethutyana labambe iqhaza kwi-Bhodi, kwaye atyhila amaxwebhu okuqokwa abaphathi kwii-entitim ezabelwe kuzo, kuquda nokulungiselela izindululo eziza kuqwalaselwa nguNgangekhontha. Ulawula ulungelelaniso nokuqukuqela umanyano lwaNgangekhontha kwiindimi ezilawula ii-SOE (iintlanganiso zakho ngonyaka ezijikelezayo zangabaphathi bezinkampani kunye neNkarha yamashumi amane iintlanganiso ze-Bhodi kwindlu yamabandla) nakwinguqulo yeminyaka yonke yamaxwebhu kwaye kwamaxwebhu amanye aziqhelwe kwiintlanganiso nakwelentyaniso yamaxwebhu yeminyaka yonke ye-SOE. Ulawula ulawulo olubangela kumaxwebhu e-othedit nakwii-entitim ezabelwe kuzo, kuquka ukukhangela imiphumela ye-othedit nokunikela ngolungiso olululo. Ulawula ukukhangela ngokwendlela ekuqaleni iingxelo zemfitsho ngokwenza okungalunganga kwizikhululo kwi-SOE, ukukhangela ngokujulileyo uphando lolungiselelo loluqhutywa ziinkonzo zabantu bangaphandle nokujongisisa ukusebenziswa kolululo lolungiselelo kwaye nokuzalathiswa ngokomthetho kolawulo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Broadcasting Technologies and Services
jobs.department: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum (Level 12), (this all-inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Pension Fund, a medical fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules)
jobs.summary: Manage and coordinate the design and implementation of broadcasting technologies programmes and strategies within the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering/ Communication and Media studies or equivalent relevant field, as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering relevant environment at Assistant Director level / middle management. Skills / Competencies and Knowledge: Core competencies: Understanding of digital broadcasting; Understanding of signal distribution; Understanding of Broadcasting Engineering Principles; Acceptance of Responsibility; Communication; Initiatives; Job Knowledge; Planning and Execution; Quality of work; Reliability; Teamwork. Technical competencies: Broadcasting Infrastructure Development; Broadcasting Engineering; Digital Migration Expertise; Stakeholder Management and Collaboration; Monitoring and Evaluation.
jobs.duties: To manage and coordinate the design and implementation of Broadcasting Technologies programmes and strategies to support the achievement of the DCDT strategic objectives. The successful candidate will: Contribute technical insights to the development of Broadcasting Technologies programmes, strategies and plans. Coordinate the planning and implementation of national broadcasting infrastructure projects. Coordinate the implementation of South Africa’s digital migration strategy from analogue to digital broadcasting and manage the efficient use of broadcasting spectrum to enhance service quality and expand access. Provide support on the development and review of policies, regulations, and technical standards that govern broadcasting services and technologies, ensuring alignment with national and international broadcasting frameworks. Support initiatives for the adoption and integration of emerging broadcasting technologies, such as IPTV, OTT (Over-the-Top) services, and 5G broadcasting, to drive innovation and modernisation in the sector. Collaborate with industry stakeholders, including public and private broadcasters, content creators, regulatory bodies (ICASA), and international broadcasting organisations, to foster partnerships and drive broadcasting infrastructure development. Conduct oversight monitoring on the implementation of projects and programmes within the broadcasting infrastructure directorate. In addition to the above, the key result areas also require: Project management, managing financial resources, driving change and operational excellence and managing compliance.
jobs.enquiries: Mr M Cilo Tel No: (012) 427 8514, Ms N Khosa Tel No: (012) 427 8260, Ms N Sekele Tel No: (012) 427 8599
jobs.applications: Link: CLICK HERE
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted with two (2) attachments: 1. A Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from the DPSA website (Z83 editable) and 2. A recently updated comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. If either or all of these two attachments are not submitted, the applicant’s application will be disqualified. Each post advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialed and signed by the applicant. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Uitsaaitegnologieë en -dienste
af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer die ontwerp en implementering van uitsaaitegnologie-programme en -strategieë binne die Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering/ Communication and Media studies of 'n gelykwaardige tersaaklike veld, soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in 'n Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering tersaaklike omgewing op Assistant Director-vlak / middelbestuur. Vaardighede / Bevoegdhede en Kennis: Kernbevoegdhede: Begrip van digitale uitsending; Begrip van seinverspreiding; Begrip van uitsaingenieurswese-beginsels; Aanvaarding van verantwoordelikheid; Kommunikasie; Inisiatiewe; Werkkennis; Beplanning en uitvoering; Kwaliteit van werk; Betroubaarheid; Spanwerk. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Ontwikkeling van uitsaai-infrastruktuur; Uitsaai-ingenieurswese; Digitale migrasiekundigheid; Belanghebbende-bestuur en samewerking; Monitering en evaluering.
af.duties: Om die ontwerp en implementering van uitsaaitegnologie-programme en -strategieë te bestuur en te koördineer ter ondersteuning van die bereiking van die DCDT se strategiese doelwitte. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal: Tegniese insigte lewer tot die ontwikkeling van uitsaaitegnologie-programme, -strategieë en -planne. Die beplanning en implementering van nasionale uitsaai-infrastruktuurprojekte koördineer. Die implementering van Suid-Afrika se digitale migrasiestrategie van analoog na digitale uitsending koördineer en die doeltreffende gebruik van uitsaaispektrum bestuur om diensgehalte te verbeter en toegang te vergroot. Ondersteuning bied met die ontwikkeling en hersiening van beleid, regulasies en tegniese standaarde wat uitsaaidienste en -tegnologieë regeer, om sodoende belyning met nasionale en internasionale uitsairaamwerke te verseker. Inisiatiewe ondersteun vir die aanvaarding en integrasie van nuwe uitsaaitegnologieë, soos IPTV, OTT (Over-the-Top)-dienste en 5G-uitsending, om innovasie en modernisering in die sektor te dryf. Saamwerk met bedryfsk belanghebbendes, waaronder openbare en privaat uitsenders, inhoudskeppers, regulerende liggame (ICASA) en internasionale uitsaaigroepe, om vennootskappe te bevorder en uitsaai-infrastruktuurontwikkeling te dryf. Toezighoudende monitering uitvoer op die implementering van projekte en programme binne die direktoraat uitsaai-infrastruktuur. Benewens bogenoemde, vereis die kernresultaatgebiede ook: Projekbestuur, bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne, dryf van verandering en operasionele uitnemendheid, en bestuur van nakoming.

zu.title: Ophathi ongumsekeli: Broadcasting Technologies and Services
zu.summary: Phatha futhi hloboza ukuklanywa nokuphunywa kwemisebenzi nezindlela zamabhungu wezobuchwepheshe ezingaphakathi kwi-Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwezinga le-NQF level 7 kubuchwepheshe be-Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering/ Communication and Media studies noma enye indawo ehambisanayo, njengoba kuqashwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority. Okuncane iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhlala kwesikhathi esinde kubuchwepheshe be-Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering endaweni ehambisanayo ezingeni lika-Assistant Director / ephakathi kwabaphathi. Amandla / Ulwazi nangamakhono: Amandla ayisisekelo: Ukuqonda ukusakaza kwedijithali; Ukuqonda ukusabalalisa isignali; Ukuqonda Izinto Eziyisisekelo Zobuchwepheshe Bokusakaza; Ukuziphendulela; Ukuxhumana; Izinhlelo; Ulwazi Ngomsebenzi; Ukucubungula Nokuphunywa; Izinga Lomsebenzi; Ukuthembeka; Ukusebenza Njengoweqembu. Amandla obuchwepheshe: Intuthuko Yezakhiwo Ezibalulekile Zokusakaza; Ubuchwepheshe Bokusakaza; Ulwazi Ngokufuduka Kwedijithali; Ukuphatha Abahilelekile Nokusebenzisana Nabo; Ukugqamisa Nokubuka.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha futhi uhloboze ukuklanywa nokuphunywa kwemisebenzi nezinhlelo zamabhungu wezobuchwepheshe be-Broadcasting Technologies kanye nezindlela ukuze kusekelwe ukufeza izinhloso eziyisisekelo ze-DCDT. Umuntu oyophumelela uzoba: Nika imibono yobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi, izindlela neziqubulo zamabhungu we-Broadcasting Technologies. Hloboza ukucubungula nokuphunywa kwamaphrojekthi wesizwe ezingxenyeni ezibalulekile ze-broadcasting infrastructure. Hloboza ukuphunywa kwenhlelo yokufuduka kwedijithali yase-South Africa ukusuka ku-analogue kuye kudijithali yomsakazo futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwe-broadcasting spectrum ukuze kwandise izinga lenkonzo futhi kwandiswe ukufinyelela. Nikeza usizo ekuthuthukisweni nakubukeni izindlela eziyisisekelo, imithetho, nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe eziphatha izinsiza zamabhungu nobuchwepheshe, uqinisekise ukuthi zihambisana nezinhlelo zezizwe nakwamanye amazwe ezingxenyeni ezibalulekile zamabhungu. Sekela izinhlelo zokumukwa nokuhlanganiswa kobuchwepheshe obusha bamabhungu, njenge-IPTV, izinsiza ze-OTT (Over-the-Top), kanye ne-5G broadcasting, ukuze kudluliselwe intuthuko nokwandaswa kwesimo sesikhathi samanje esibukhaya. Sebenzisana nalabo abahilelekile emkhakheni, okuhlanganisa abasakazi blikahulumeni nabayingcosana, abadali bokuqukethwe, amasiko aphatha imithetho (ICASA), kanye nezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe ezingxenyeni ezibalulekile zamabhungu, ukuze kukhuliswe ubudlelwano futhi kudluliselwe intuthuko yezakhiwo ezibalulekile zomsakazo. Yenza ukugqamisa ukulawula ukuphunywa kwamaphrojekthi nemisebenzi kumnyango wezinsiza ezibalulekile zomsakazo. Ngaphezu kwalokhu okuvezwe ngenhla, izindawo eziyisiphetho eziyisisekelo zifuna futhi: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuphatha izinsiza zezimali, ukudlulisa inguquko nokuhamba kahle kwezomsebenzi, kanye nokuphatha ukuzinza nemithetho.

xh.title: Omvuli weNqanaba eliphezulu: Iteknoloji nobuLuleko kwiNgcobelelwano kwakhona
xh.summary: Lawula kwaye ulungiselele ukuyila nokuphumeza iinkqubo ze teknoloji yasingelelwano kunye namacebo ngaphakathi kwi Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) kwi Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering/ Communication and Media studies okwenye indawo efanayo enomsebenzi, njengokujongwa yi South African Qualifications Authority. Isipho esingaphantsi kweminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwi Broadcasting / Telecommunications/ ICT/ Engineering endaweni enomsebenzi kwiqela elinganqamleziswa kwindawo yomlawuli ongumncedisi / abaphathi bakwanqanaba. Aakhawunti khono kwaye ulwazi: Iinkqabaza ezingundoqo: Ukuqonda ingcolelelwano yamandangalelo; Ukuqonda ukusasazwa komsigno; Ukuqonda iimfuno zoBunjiniyeli bokuNgcobelwa; Ukuzithathela umrhumo; Ixoxo; Iinkqubela; Ulwazi ngomsebenzi; Uqethu nokuphumeza; Isingeniso somsebenzi; Ukuzithembisa; Umsebenzi weqela. Iinkqabaza zobugcisa: Upuhliso lweziseko zokoNgcobelwa; uBunjiniyeli bokuNgcobelelwano; iNgcagco yokusuka kwindangalelo iye kwamandangalelo ezigqibo; uLawulo lweemvisiswano; Uqondaniso nabathinteliyo; Ulolongo lomiselo lwamava.
xh.duties: Ukulawula kwaye ulungelelanisa ukuyila nokuphumeza iinkqubo kunye namacebo e Broadcasting Technologies ukuze axhase ukufezekiswa kwabakhuselayo abangundoqo be DCDT. Umntu ophumelelayo uya: Kuzigalela ngembono yobugcisa ekuphuhlisweni kweekhongqubo, amacebo neendlenla ze Broadcasting Technologies. Ulungelelanisa uqethu nokuphumeza iiprojekthi zeziseko zokuNgcobelwa ezingangwenxa. Ulungelelanisa ukuphumeza isicwangciso senkqubo yodliwano-ndlebe kwi South Africa kwivelu kweluchungechunge ukusuka kwidigital ixelwa kundangalelo ukuya kwingcolelelwano yedigitali, nakulawula ukusetyenziswa ngemigaqo yomsigno wokungcobelwa ukwandisa isingeniso somsebenzi nokwanda ufikelelo. Ukuzekelela ngokuphuhliswa nokuphononongwa kwamacebo, iimigaqo, namazinga obugcisa aloyela iinkonzo kwaye iindqwagqwa zokubumba, kuqinisekiswe ukumisela nemiqathango yengcobelwa yengwenxa nakumazwe ngamanye. Ukuxhasa iinkqubela ngokwamkekelwa nokudidiywa kweendaba ezitsha zokungcobelwa, njenge IPTV, iinkonzo ze OTT (Over-the-Top), nakungcobelwa kwi-5G, ukuze kutsaleliswe iingcaza-nkcubeko nokuze kunqutywe isimodemaniso kweli qela. Ukusebenzisana nabathinteliyo behambo, kuquka abagcisa bakuNgcobelwa ngonxaxha nabucala, abadali bomxholo, amaziko ezoMiso (ICASA), kwaye namanani okungcobelwa amazwe ngamanye, ukuze kuqhutywe iintsebenziswano nakugqithwa phambili uphuhliso lweziseko zokungcobelwa. Lawula ngokumiselayo kwaye ulale ilolongwe ngokuphumeza iiprojekthi ngenkqubo kwindawo yabaphathiweyo yeziseko zokungcobelwa. Ngaphezu kwale minxaxheba ingentsebazo, amagumbi aphangelyo afuna nayo: uLawulo lweeprojekthi, ukulawula imithombo yemali, ukuqhuba utshintsho nokugqithela phambili kumsebenzi, nakulawula ukuzinikela.

Applications must be submitted on the prescribed form Z83 (obtainable from any Public Service Department office i.e effective 01 January 2021 or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/. 'n Geldige motorvoertuigbestuurderslisensie. zu.title: OHS Inspector: Electrical Engineering
zu.summary: Qhuba izinspection zezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthikela emthethweni ohlobene e-Durban Labour Centre.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate kanye nesifundo esithathu unyaka esamukelwe esisingathini se-NQF 6/7 enkundleni ephathelene nalokho, okungukuthi i-Electrical Engineering. I-Driver's licence esevisayo. Ukubhalisa nomphakathi wezinsiza ochwepheshe ohlobene naye futhi ovunyiwe ngumvuzo kodwa akuyona isidingo. Akukho msizamo odingekayo. Ulwazi: Izinqubo kanye namapholisi e-Department, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, njengoba iguquliwe, ama-Regulations (21), i-South African National Standards (Codes) – ama-Codes ahlanganisiwe abe ngama-regulations, i-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, i-Unemployment Insurance Act. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Amakhono okuxhumana, Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, Amakhono okuquumba, Amakhono abantu, Amakhono okuphathwa kwezinkulumo ezingahambi kahle, Amakhono okuxoxisana, Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, Amakhono okubuzana, Amakhono okubonisa, Amakhono okusungula izinto ezingasha, Amakhono okuhlaziya, Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela futhi uqedele izinspections ngokuzimele ngenhloso yokuvikela ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Act 85 ka-1993, ama-Regulations kanye nama-Standards ahlanganisiwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhalisa ngaphansi kwe-Unemployment Insurance Act kanye ne-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act. Hlela, phenya futhi uqedele ngokuzimele izehlakalo nezikhalazo ezibikiwe ezihlobene noMthetho we-OHS kanye namaregulations ahlobene nawo, futhi wenze ukuphoqelela lapho kudingeka khona, avele enkantolo njengofakazi bentando yombuso, hlela futhi uqhube izinspections ezenziwayo ezabelwe njengohlelo ukuze ulawule ukuhambisana nomthetho wezabasebenzi ohlobene kuhlanganise nokubhalisa futhi kuhlanganisiwe imibiko evela kulezo zinspections, Hlela futhi uqhube amakhasimphi wokusesekela wonke umthetho wezabasebenzi ngokuzimele, hlaziya umthelela wawo, uhlanganise futhi ubhale umbiko. Nikeza ngemikhakha ephakeme ekubheneni, ukubhaliseni futhi ekugcineni amapulani emisebenzi yohlelo lwendawo namabhiko kuhlanganise, ukwenza ukuhlaziya kanye nokuhlanganisa imibiko yezibalo mayelana namacala ohlelo lwendawo nawayabelwe.

xh.title: Mhloli we-OHS: Inzululwazi yakuMzobo
xh.summary: Qhuba ukhangelo lolungelelwaniso lwezempilo nokuqinisekiswa ukuba kuhambelana nemithetho echaza inqaku e-Durban Labour Centre.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi senqanaba lesiNganga phezulu kwaye nethuba kwangonyaka wamathathu efunwa sisazinda esikumanqanaba we-6/7 we-NQF kwindawo ephathelwe nakho, ngokomzekelo Inzululwazi yakuMzobo. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ubulungela kumgama ophathelwe naye, oqaphelekayo bomzimba wabasebenzi lisentsiswelo kodwa aliyimfuneko. Akukho nyaniso efunwayo. Ulwazi: Iindlela zengqondo nezithethisi zesebe, uMthetho woNgelelwaniso weMpi loZempilo noQinisekiso lomZimba, njengoko ulungisiwe, iziNgqangqulu (21), iindawo ezingangeemfuneko ezizweni eNingiMzantsi Afrika (iindlela ezikumthetho) – iindlela ezidityanisiweyo ziba ziNgqangqulu, uMthetho weNjinjana kwiNkonzo nasekuQhotsolozweni kumZimba ngexesha loMsebenzi, noMthetho woQinisekiso lokuGqabhuka. Amandla: Ukuqhubelela phambili nokuBumba imicimbi, amandla oThungelwano, ukwazi ukusetyenziswa kweKhompyutha, amandlaokuQhuba iingqungquthela, amandla okuHlangeneyo nabantu, amandla oKulawula iingxabano, amandla oKuxoxisana, amandla oKusombulula iingxaki, amandla oKuphendula iingxoxo, amandla oKubonisa, amandla oKufumanisa izinto ezitsha, amandla oKuhlola ngokubanzi, amandla oKuthetha nokubhala.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa uze uqhube ukhangelo ngokuzimela injongo ukuqinisekisa ukuhambelana koMthetho woNgelelwaniso weMpi loZempilo noQinisekiso lomZimba, uMthetho wonyaka ka-1993, iNgqangqulu 85 neZindlela ezidityanisiweyo. Qinisekisa ubhaliso ngokuMthetho woQinisekiso lokuGqabhuka kumZimba ngexesha loMsebenzi nokuMthetho woNgelelwaniso weMpi loZempilo. Cwangcisa, uphenye uze ugqibe ngokuzimela iimeko ezibikelwayo neengxaki ezibikweyo ezihambelana noMthetho we-OHS nesiNgqangqulu esihambelana nazo, uze ulawule njengoko kuyimfuneko, uze ubonakale enkundla njengosunguli wesizwe, cwangcisa uze uqhube ukhangelo obekelwe olwangaphambili njengohlelo ukugcina ulawulo ukuhambelana noMthetho weMpi olusemgangathweni oquka nokubhala nokudibanisa iingxelo ezisuka kumkhangelo wakho, Cwangcisa uze uqhube iinkathazo zoluntu ngamawonke onke amMthetho weMpi ngokuzimela, hlola umphumo wawo, dibanisa uze ubhale ingxelo. Nikela ngaphezulu ekuCwangciseni, ekuBhaleni nokusiNcedeni iindlela zokuHlola kwengingqi nemiQulu ngokubandakanya, ukuZalisekisa lokuBala nokuyidibanisa iingxelo ngesibalo ngokubanzi kwemeko zengingqi nalongo ababelwe.

Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures, Occupational Health and Safety Act soos gewysig, Regulations (21), South African National Standards (Codes) – geïnkorporeerde Kodes word regulasies, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, Unemployment Insurance Act. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering, Kommunikasievaardighede, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Fasiliteringsvaardighede, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Konflikhanteringsvaardighede, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Onderhoudvoeringsvaardighede, Aanbiedingsvaardighede, Innoveervaardighede, Analitiese vaardighede, Mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Om beplande en onafhanklike inspeksies uit te voer met die doel om nakoming van die Occupational Health and Safety Act, Act 85 of 1993, Regulasies en geïnkorporeerde Standaarde te verseker. Om registrasie kragtens die Unemployment Insurance Act en die Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act te bevestig. Beplan, ondersoek en finaliseer onafhanklik voorvalle en klagtes wat aangemeld is rakende die OHS Act en die relevante regulasies en dwing af waar en wanneer nodig, tree in die hof op as staatsgetuie, beplan en voer toegewysde proaktiewe inspeksies volgens skedule uit om nakoming van die relevante arbeidswetgewing te monitor, insluitend die opstel en konsolideer van verslae wat uit sodanige inspeksies voortspruit. Beplan en voer onafhanklik voorspraakveldtogte oor alle arbeidswetgewing uit, ontleed die impak daarvan, konsolideer en stel verslag op. Dra op 'n hoër vlak by tot beplanning, opstel en instandhouding van streeksinspeksieplanne en verslae, insluitend die uitvoering van ontleding en opstel van gekonsolideerde statistiese verslae oor streeks- en toegewysde sake.

zu.title: Isihloli se-OHS: Civil Engineering
zu.summary: Kudingeka isihloli se-OHS Kokstad ukuphoqa ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act ngokubuyekezwa okuhleliwe, kudinga iziqu ze-Civil Engineering kanye nesilayisense sokushayela.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuvunyiwe okuyiminyaka emithathu ezingeni le-NQF 6/7 enkundleni ephathelene nalokho, okungukuthi i-Civil Engineering. I-Driver's licence esebenzayo. Ukubhaliswa ehlanganini lezisebenzi elivunyiwe lolwazi kuyisikhuthazo kodwa akuyona inkomba. Akukho njongo efunwayo. Ulwazi: Izinhlelo zeminyango kanye nokuqhuba, umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, njengoba ulungisiwe, imithetho elandelwayo (21), izifundo ze-South African National Standards (Amakhowhodi) – amakhowhodi afakiwe aba yimithetho, umthetho we-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, umthetho we-Unemployment Insurance Act. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokuqamba, amakhono okuxhumana, ulwazi lwekhompyutha, amakhono okuhlola, amakhono abantu, amakhono okuphatha ingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuphendula imibuzo, amakhono okubonisa, amakhono okuqamba, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela futhi udone ngokuzimele ukubuyekezwa ngenhloso yokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kuhambisana nomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Act 85 ka-1993, imithetho elandelwayo nezifundo ezifakiwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhaliswa ngaphansi kwe-Unemployment Insurance Act kanye ne-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, Hlela, phenya futhi uqedele ngokuzimele izehlakalo nezikhalazo ezibikiwe eziphathelene nomthetho we-OHS kanye nemithetho elandelwayo ehlobene nawo futhi uphoqe lapho kudingeka khona, ukubonakala enkantolo njengofakazi baka umbuso, hlela futhi udone ukubuyekezwa okuhleliwe okunikeziwe njengohlelo lwesikhathi ukuze ulawule ukuhambisana nemithetho yabasebenzi ehlobene kuhlanganise nokubhala futhi uqucocise imibiko evela kulelo kubekezwa. Hlela futhi udone amakhampushi okukhuthaza ngawo wonke umthetho wabasebenzi ngokuzimele, hlaziya umphumela wawo, qucocisa futhi ubhale umbiko. Nikela ngcongo ezingeni eliphezulu ekubheneni, ukubhaleni kanye nokugcineni amapulani nokubuyekezwa kwesifunda kuhlanganise nemibiko, ukuqaliswa kokuqondisisa kanye nokubhalwa kwemibiko yezibaluli equkociwe ngezenzakalo zesifunda kanye nalezo ezinikeziwe.

xh.title: UmKhangelo-OHS: iNjineli yoBucwempetshe beNzululwazi
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNjengalOHS eKokstad ukuze iqinisekise ukuthathwa kwamanyathelo okuthobela uMthetho wezaMafa nokuKhuseleka koBomi baseBenzini ngokwendwendwe zokukhangela ezicwangiweyo, oko kufuna isidanga seNjineli yoBucwempetshe beNzululwazi kunye nelayisensi yoQhubi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSekondari kananjalo nesidanga esithathu samenyaka esamkelwe kwinqanaba le-NQF 6/7 kwicala elichanekileyo, oko kukuthi iNjineli yoBucwempetshe beNzululwazi. Ilayisensi yoQhubi esemthethweni. Ukubhaliswa kumbutho wababenzi bamagigaba oProfessional othintelekayo, owamkelwayo luluntu kube luluhlahiso kodwa alinyanzelisi. Akukho mfundo yamava ifunekayo. ULwazi: Iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi eSebe, uMthetho wezaMafa nokuKhuseleka koBomi baseBenzini, njengoko ulungisiwe, iMigaqo (21), amaStandardi weSizwe eNingizimu Afrika (Iikhowudi) – iikhowudi ezithathiweyo ziba ngamagqabantshintshi, uMthetho weeNzuzo ngeeNzala ezenzeka kumsebenzi, uMthetho weNgeniso yoMsebenzi ongenangomsebenzi. Amandla: ukuQamba iplani nokuBumba, amandla okuNxibelelanisa, ukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha, amandla okuKhokelb'a b'eentlanga, amandla oNxibelelwano phakathi kwabantu, amandla okuLawula iingxabano, amandla oku Nxibelelanisa ngokuxoxwa, amandla okuSombulula iingxaki, amandla oBuza iimbuzo, amandla okubonisa ngokubanzi, amandla okuvakalisa iimbono ezitsha, amandla oHlalutyo, amandla oNxibelelwano ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba iplani nokwenza ngokuzimeleyo iindwendwe zokukhangela ngenjongo yokufezesa ukuthobela uMthetho wezaMafa nokuKhuseleka koBomi baseBenzini, uMthetho wonomobo wama-85 ka-1993, iMigaqo namagqabantshintshi eziMigaqo eziBekiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhaliswa ngaphantsi koMthetho weNgeniso loMsebenzi ongangeMfuno nokoMthetho weeNzuzo ngeenzala ezenzeka kumsebenzi, Qamba iplani, phandoze yaye ugqibe ngokuzimeleyo iiganeko neengxaki ezibikiweyo ezingqamana noMthetho wezaMafa nokuKhuseleka koBomi baseBenzini namagqabantshintshi afanelekileyo yaye uze uyisebenzise njengoko kufuneka, uze kuve esithilweni somthetho njengomfaki bango wobulungisa, qamba iplani yaye wenze iindwendwe zokukhangela ezingeniswayo ezabelwe ngokwejadule ukuze ulawule ukuthobela umthetho ohilela umsebenzi ochanekileyo kuquka nokubhala nokudibanisa iingxelo eziphuma kwezo ndwendwe zokukhangela. Qamba iplani yaye wenze amaphulo phantse kuwo onke amagqabantshintshi omthetho ohilela umsebenzi ngokuzimeleyo, hlalutya imiphumela yawo, dibanisa yaye ubhale ingxelo. Zenzele ngenqanaba eliphezulu ekwenzeni iplani, ekubhaleni nasekugcinweni kweeplani zokukhangela iindwendwe nengxelo zesithili kuquka nokuze kwenziwe uhlalutyo nokuqokelelwa kweengxelo ezididiwayo zezibalo ngeendwendwe zokukhangela ezingxangathwa kwizithili nakuwo amacala abelwe wona.

zu.title: Isiphathi se-OHS: Injiniyela yezobunjiniyela
zu.summary: Isiphathi se-OHS kubunjiniyela bezemishini e-Pinetown Labour Centre, sidinga isiqu se-NQF 6/7 nephasimoti esebenzayo.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate kanye nesiqu esiqashelwayo seminyaka emithathu esebenzisa i-NQF 6/7 enkundleni ehambisanayo, okungukuthi Injiniyela yezobunjiniyela. Iphasiyoti esebenzayo. Ukubhalisa komzimba wemisebenzi wekheli okuhlobene naye futhi oqashelwayo kuyinzuzo kodwa akuyikhonjalo. Akukho mhlamulo odingekayo. Ulwazi: Izindlela nemithetho yomnyango, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, njengoba ilungisiwe, Imithetho (21), i-South African National Standards (Codes) – Othikodi ohlanganisiwe ube ngumthetho, i-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, i-Unemployment Insurance Act. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa, Amakhono okuxhumana, Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, Amakhono okukhuthaza, Amakhano abantu, Amakhono okuphatha ingxabano, Amakhono okuxoxisana, Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, Amakhono okuxoxa abantu abafakwa ocansini, Amakhono okubumba inhlangano, Amakhono okuba nokuhlakanipha okusha, Amakhono okuhlaziya, Amakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela futhi wenze ukugcwesheka okuzimele ngenjongo yokugcina ukuthobela i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Act 85 ka-1993, Imithetho nokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezihlanganisiwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhaliswa ngaphansi kwe-Unemployment Insurance Act kanye ne-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act. Hlela, phenya futhi ucife izehlakalo neziphikiso ezibikwe eziphathelene noMthetho we-OHS kanye nemithetho ehambisanayo bese uphoqa lapho kudingeka khona, uve esinkundleni njengofakazi bukaBUMNYAMA, hlela bese enza ukugcwesheka okuguqulayo okwabeliwe njengohlelo lokulandelela ukuthobela nomthetho wezabasebenzi ohambisanayo okuhlanganisa nokubhala nokuhlanganisa imibiko evela kulezo zgcecwesheko. Hlela futhi uthume amaphjengi wokweseka nawo wonke umthetho wezabasebenzi uzimele, uhlaziye umthelela wawo, uhlanganise bese ubhala umbiko. Nazi emazingeni aphezulu ekuhleleni, ukubhaleni nokugcinweni kwezinhlelo zokugcwesheka zemikhakha kanye nemibiko okuhlanganisa, ukuqaliswa kokuhlaziya nokubhalwa kwemibiko yezibalo ehlanganisiwe emkhakheni nasezimeni ezenzelwe zona.

xh.title: Umhloli we-OHS: Injiniyering yezimoto
xh.summary: Umhloli we-OHS kwiNjiniyering yezimoto eLabour Centre ye-Pinetown, efuna isifundo se-NQF 6/7 nephasi yokuqeshisa efanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Senior Certificate negqibelesho lesifundo sezinyanga ezintathu esemthethweni esikumqobo we-NQF 6/7 kwicala elichanekileyo, oko kukuthi i-Mechanical Engineering. Phasi yokuqeshisa efanelekileyo. Ukungenisa igama kubungakanani bamabanga aphezulu obuchwepheshe abelulekiyo luyonceda kodwa alinyanzeliswa. Akukho nqamlezo efunwayo. Ulwazi: Iimboniso ngeendlela zolawulo zesebe, uMthetho wezempilo nokhuseleko kwakhona, iimthetho (21), iSouth African National Standards (Codes) – iikhodi ezifakwe ngaphakathi ziba ngumthetho, uMthetho woMvuzo weeNtimba zomsebenzi namaQhathathi, noMthetho weSixhomo sokungasebenzi. Amandla: Ukucazulula nokuhlela, amandla oxhumo-nxaxheba, ulwazi lokusebenzela iikhompyutha, amandla okunceda, amandla okusebenza nabantu, amandla okupatha iingxabano, amandla okuxoxisana, amandla okusombulula iingxaki, amandla okubuzisa, amandla okubonisa, amandla okuyila iinto ezintsha, amandla okuhlola ngokweenkcukacha, namandla okuthetha nokuwabhala amaxwebhu okuqukuqela kunye.
xh.duties: Ukucazulula nokwenza ngokuzodwa iindwendwendwenzo ngenjongo yokwenza kuqatshelwe ukuzinikela kuMthetho wezempilo nokhuseleko, uMthetho wona wama-85 ka-1993, iimthetho namaStandard afakwe ngaphakathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqeshiswa ngokoMthetho weSixhomo sokungasebenzi noMthetho woMvuzo weeNtimba zomsebenzi namaQhathathi. Ukucazulula, uphando kugqitywe ngokuzodwa iinkathazo nezinto ezikrwadileyo ezixinxiwe ezithetha ngoMthetho we-OHS nangeemthetho ezichanekileyo kwaye uziphathe njanioko nini na kufuneka, abone enkundleni yamatyala njengesigqidi sesizwe, acazulule aze acuthe iindwendwendwenzo ezenziwayo ezibekelwe ngaphambili njengoko kucwangciswe ukuyihlola ukuzinikela kwemithetho yabasebenzi echanekileyo kuquka nokuqamba nokudibanisa iingxelo eziphuma kwezo ndwendwendwenzo. Ukucazulula aze acuthe iinkampana zokuvakalayo ngezimithetho yonke yabasebenzi ngokuzodwa, ahlolothe imiphumo yawo, adibanise aze aqambe ingxelo. Uncedo ngowona mgangatho ophezulu ekucazululeni, ekuqambeni nasekugcineni iindlela neengxelo zophando lwesithili kuquka nasekuqeqeshweni kolwundo nasekuqambeni iingxelo ezibekiweyo ngenani malungana neemeko zesithili nabanikiweyo.

Registration with the relevant, recognised professional body is an advantage but not compulsory. Knowledge: Departmental policies and procedures, Occupational Health and Safety Act, as amended, Regulations (21), South African National Standards (Codes)- incorporated Codes become regulations, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, Unemployment Insurance Act. SKILLS: Planning and Organizing, Communication skills, Computer Literacy, Facilitation skills, Interpersonal skills, Conflict handling skills, Negotiation skills, Problem solving skills, Interviewing skills, Presentation skills, Innovation skills, Analytical skills, Verbal and written communication skills.

To confirm registration of with the Unemployment Insurance Act and the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act. Plan, investigate and finalise independently incidents and complaints reported pertaining to the OHS Act and the relevant regulations and enforce as and when necessary, appear in Court as a State witness. Plan and conduct allocated proactive inspections as per schedule to monitor compliance with the relevant labour legislation including compiling and consolidating reports emanating from such inspections. Plan and conduct advocacy campaigns on all labour legislations independently, analyse impact thereof, consolidate and compile report. Contribute at a higher level to planning, drafting and maintenance of regional inspection plans and reports including execution of analysis and compilation of consolidated statistical reports on regional and allocated cases.

zu.title: OHS: Onozinci: Inzululwazi Yemishini Ye-Jikelele
zu.summary: Kudingeka isihloko sokuphenya se-OHS semishini yohlelo lwezobuciko obusebenza ngamakhono emishini esikhungweni sama-Jane Furse Labour Centre ukuze kugcinwe ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho wezempilo nokuphepha ezikhundleni zomsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samabanga aphezulu kanye nokuqeqeshwa okungeminyaka eyisithupha (3) okuvunyiwe enkundleni ehlobene, okungukuthi, i-Mechanical Engineering. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukubhalisa emzimweni wemisebenzi ochwepheshe ofanele ovunyiwe kuyinzuzo kodwa akuyona ephoqelelwe. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango, umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety, njengoba ushintshiwe, izimiso (21), ama-South African National Standards (Amakhodi)- amakhodi afakiwe abe yimithetho, umthetho we-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, umthetho we-Unemployment Insurance Act. AMAPHILI: Ukubekisisa nokuhlela, amakhono okuxhumana, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okukhuthaza, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuphatha ingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okubuzisa, amakhono okubonisa, amakhono okweqamba, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela futhi uqedele ukuphenya ngokuzimele ngenjongo yokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kuhambisana nomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Act 85 of 1993, izimiso ezithathwe kanye ne-Standard efuckeziwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhalisa ngaphansi kwe-Unemployment Insurance Act kanye ne-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act. Hlela, phenya futhi uqedele ngokuzimele izehlakalo nezikhalazo ezibikiwe ezithintka noMthetho we-OHS kanye nemithetho ehlobene nawo, futhi uphoqe ukusetshenziswa kwawo lapho kudingeka, ubonakale eNkundlini njengofakazi bembuso. Hlela futhi wenze ukuphenya okuhlelekile okwabeliwe njengohlelo ukuze ulawule ukuhambisana nomthetho wezabasebenzi ohlobene, okuhlanganisa nokuqamba futhi uqoqe imibalo ephuma kulezo zivivinyo. Hlela futhi wenze amakhampeni okusesha ngazwi emthethweni wonke wezabasebenzi ngokuzimele, hlaziya umphumela wawo, qoqa bese uqamba umbiko. Nikela ngomnikelo ezingeni eliphezulu ekubhokodezini, ekubhaleni nasekugcinweni kwezinhlelo zemibiko yokuqhenya yendawo kanye nemibuko, okuhlanganisa nokwenza isilinganiso nokubhala kwemibiko ebandakanyayo yezibalo yamacala endawo nalawo abekiwe.

xh.title: OHS: Isiphatho: iNzululwazi
xh.summary: Kufuneki igosa elibambe iqhaza kwezoMntu kwindawo eMekeni oKusebenza nokuKhuseleka ukunika amandla ukubambelela kumthetho woMpilo woKusebenza nokuKhuseleka kwindawo kaJane Furse yokugcina abasebenzi baseMekeni.
xh.requirements: Isetifiketi samabanga aphakamileyo ngayinye ngelinye (1) elibambe iqhaza kwisikhundi sesithathu (3) samabanga eDyunivesithi kwindawo efanelekileyo, oko kukuthi, iNzululwazi. Ilayisenisi yokushweshtha esemthethweni. Ukubhalisa ngenkqubo esemthethweni nengamkelekileyo yamagosa afanelekileyo kukhuthazwa nangonakungabi yimfuno. Ulwazi: Iinkqubo namagosa ehlabathi, umThetho woMpilo woKusebenza nokuKhuseleka, njengoko lutshintschiwe, iRhentyula (21), iZiko lesiZwe esiNdingathwa (iikhowudi)- iikhowudi ezidityanisiweyo ziba yirhentyula, umThetho woBulawa ngoMsebenzi nasiGulo, umThetho weSikhokelo seVimba yoMsebenzi. AMABALO: Iplani nokuQamba, Amabalo oThintathu, ukufunda ngekhompyutha, amabalo eNkqubo, amabalo obuBomi, amabalo oKuphathisana ngamaxhoba, amabalo oKucinga, amabalo oKusombulula iingxaki, amabalo oKubuzwa bubomi, amabalo eNkcazelo, amabalo oQamba, amabalo oHluzo, amabalo othetha nabhalwa.
xh.duties: Iplani kwaye ndenze iphondo lokutshayela okuzimeleyo ngokuzimela ngakumbi ukunika amandla ukubambelela kumthetho woMpilo woKusebenza nokuKhuseleka, umThetho woKusebenza nokuKhuseleka, uMthetho woKusebenza nokuKhuseleka, umThetho we-85 ka-1993, iRhentyula kwaye ndityikitye isigqibo. Ukuba ndityikitye ukubhalisa nakuMthetho weSikhokelo seVimba yoMsebenzi nakuMthetho woBulawa ngoMsebenzi nasiGulo. Iplani, ndize ndiphinde ndigqibe ngokuzimela iinkathazo nemiya yabantu abavela kumthetho woKusebenza nokuKhuseleka nakumthetho osetyenziswa kwaye ndize ndinike amandla njengoko kufunekayo, ndibonwe eNkundleni njengongaphezu kukaGqirha. Iplani kwaye ndenze iphondo lokutshayela okuzimeleyo njengesicelo sokulawula ukubambelela kumthetho woKusebenza nokuKhuseleka kwaye ndiqokele iingxelo ezingena kwindawo yokugqiba. Iplani kwaye ndenze iphondo lokutshayela okuzimeleyo kwindawo yokugqiba ukulawula ukubambelela kwimithetho yoKusebenza ehambelana nabantu, kuqokelelwa iingxelo ezahlukeneyo ezisuka kuloo ntshukumo. Iplani kwaye ndenze iphondo lokutshayela okuzimeleyo, ndahlule nakanjani na imiphumo yayo, ndiqokele kwaye ndityikitye ingxelo. Ndinike isandla ngaphezulu kwesithili kwiplani, ukutyala kwaye ndigcine iplani yoKusebenza nokuKhuseleka yoMmandla, iingxelo kunye neenkalo ezahlukeneyo ezibekiweyo.

af.title: Administrasiebeampte
af.summary: Administrasiebeampte by die Department of Employment and Labour Hoofkantoor in Pretoria, wat begrotingsbeplanning, HR en verkryging vir die Inspection and Enforcement Services-tak ondersteun.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6)/Voorgraadse Bachelorsgraad (NQF 7) in Kantoorbestuur/ Finansiële Bestuur/ Openbare Administrasie/ Besigheidsadministrasie/ Besigheidsbestuur. Minimum van een (1) jaar funksionele ervaring in kantoorbestuur of inspeksies en handhawingsdienste. Kennis: Departementbeleide en prosedures. Public Finance Management Act, minimum termyn bestedingsbegrotingsprosesse, finansiële administrasieprosesse en stelsels, rekenaargeletterdheid (MS-pakkette, Excel, Word, PowerPoint en vermoë om e-pos te gebruik). Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Interpersoonlik, Probleemoplossing, Kommunikasie (Mondelings en Skriftelik).
af.duties: Voer begrotingsbeplanning uit vir die Inspection and Enforcement Services-tak. Voer Menslike Hulpbronne-funksies uit vir die Inspection and Enforcement Services-tak. Voer die funksies van verkryging van goedere en dienste uit vir die Inspection and Enforcement Services-tak. Koördineer inligting oor klagtes wat ontvang is. Konsolidering van Prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Isikhulu Sokuphathwa Kwezindaba
zu.summary: Isikhulu Sokuphathwa Kwezindaba eHhovisi Elikhulu le-Department of Employment and Labour ePretoria, sisekela ukuhlelwa kwebhajethi, izinsiza zabantu kanye nokuthuthukisa izingudla lehhovisi leso esibheke futhi siphoyisa izinsiza zokugcina uthuli lehhovisi elibheke futhi ligunyaze izinsiza zokugcina uthuli lehhovisi elibheke futhi ligunyaze izinsiza zokugcina uthuli lehhovisi elibheke futhi ligunyaze izinsiza zokugcina uthuli lehhovisi.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe eminyaka mithathu (3) (NQF 6)/Iziqu ze-Undergraduate Bachelor Degree (NQF7) kokuPhathwa KweHhovisi/kuPhathwa Kwezimali/kuPhathwa Kwendawo Yomphakathi/kuPhathwa Kwezabhizinisi/kuPhathwa Kwezabhizinisi. Isiphephelo somz esingaphansi kwesisodwa (1) unyaka isipilingo samandla kubuphathi behhovisi noma emsebenzini wokuphenya futhi wonikeza izinsiza ezimbalwa noma emsebenzini wokugcina uthuli lehhovisi. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango. I-Public Finance Management Act, inqubo yokubeka imali exhala isikhathi esincane, izinqubo zokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nezinhlelo, ukwazi kwekhompyutha (MS Packages, excel, word, PowerPoint kanye nokuthi ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-email). Amakhono: Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela kabusha, ukwazi kwekhompyutha, ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ukuthumela imiyalezo (Ngomlomo kanye Ngesibhalo).
zu.duties: Yenza ukuhlelwa kwebhajethi lehhovisi leso esibheke futhi siphoyisa izinsiza zokugcina uthuli lehhovisi. Yenza imisebenzi ye-Human Resources yehhovisi leso esibheke futhi siphoyisa izinsiza zokugcina uthuli lehhovisi. Yenza imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa izingudla lezimpahla kanye nosebenziso yehhovisi leso esibheke futhi siphoyisa izinsiza zokugcina uthuli lehhovisi. Hlanganisa ulwazi mayelana nezinkinga ezitholwe. Ukuhlanganisa ulwazi ngemisebenzi edluliwe.

xh.title: Isikhulu Solelo eNtengiselwano
xh.summary: Isikhulu Solelo eNtengiselwano kwindlu enkulu yesebe i-Department of Employment and Labour Head Office ePretoria, sinceda uqokelelo-lwabiwo-mali, i-HR nokuthenga izinto ngenxa yesebe le-Inspection and Enforcement Services.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF 6) yeminyaka elithathu (3)/Undergraduate Bachelor Degree(NQF7) kwi-Office Management/ Financial Management/ Public Administration/ Business Administration/ Business Management. Okungenani amava eminyaka elinye (1) ekwenzeni umsebenzi wokulawula ihovisi okanye imisebenzi yokutsha kwaye kugcinwe ukumiselwa kwemithetho. Ulwazi: Iindlela nemigaqo yesebe. Umthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, iinkqubo zoxa ezincinane zokuqokelela inkcitho yemali, iinkqubo nezixhobo zolawulo lweemali, nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iiphakheji ze-MS, excel, word, PowerPoint nakhono ukusebenzisa i-imeyile). Amakhono: Ukuqumba nokuqulunqa, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuba nabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki, Unxibelelwano (ngemilomo nangokubhalwayo).
xh.duties: Yenza uqokelelo-lwabiwo-mali lwesebe le-Inspection and Enforcement Services. Zenza imisebenzi yoLawulo lwabantu kwisebe le-Inspection and Enforcement Services. Zenza imisebenzi yokuthenga izinto neenkonzo kwesebe le-Inspection and Enforcement Services. Linganisa ulwazi malunga neengxaki ezifunyenweyo. Ukuqokelelwa kolwazi ngemigaqo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1-3: Medical Adjudication
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 - R397 392 per annum, (OSD) Grade 2: R411 978 – R485 289 per annum, (OSD) Grade 3: R495 423 - R635 088 per annum, (OSD)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse needed for medical adjudication of occupational injury claims at the Department of Employment and Labour in Modimolle, with OSD salary grading across three experience levels.
jobs.requirements: Four (4) years’ degree (NQF7)/ three (3) years’ Diploma in Nursing (NQF6). Post Graduate Diploma (NQF8) in Occupational Health / Theatre Technique / Critical Care will be an advantage. Grade 1: 2-9 Years’ experience gained after registration, Grade 2: 10-19 Years’ experience gained after registration. Grade 3: 20 Year’s and above experience gained after registration. Experience in trauma/emergency/internal medicine/general surgery/orthopaedics/theatre at the regional public hospital level or private hospital. Experience in medical claims processing/insurance environment will be an added advantage. Registration with the South African Nursing Council. Knowledge: Medical related Legislation, Medicines and related Substances Act, Medical aid knowledge (case management), Occupation Health knowledge, Regulatory Knowledge & Implementation, Del and Compensation Fund objectives and business functions, Nursing legislations and related legal as well ethical nursing practices, Compensation Fund policies, procedures and processes, Stakeholders and customers, Customer Service (Batho Pele Principles), Fund Values, Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS), COIDA Act, Regulations and Policies, COIDA tariffs, Technical Knowledge, PFMA and National Treasury Regulations, General knowledge of the Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, Health Professions Act, Health Act. Skills: Post claims management and settlement, Claims handling, Claims settlement management, Medical Policy Management, Clinical Excellence and Advisory, Project Management and Planning, Information Analysis and Interpretation, Digital Acumen/Medical Systems (IT Systems Control Designs), Clinical Coding, Quality Assurance and Improvement, Research and Benchmarking.
jobs.duties: Provide advice and recommendation in the acceptance of liability. Recommend the approval for medical accounts. Provide medical advice on the processing of occupational injury claims. Determine PD (Permanent Disability) and TTD (Total Temporary Disability). Assess medical accounts on occupational injury claims and OD medical accounts.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1-3: Mediese Adjudikasie
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige benodig vir mediese adjudikasie van beroepsbeserings-eise by die Department of Employment and Labour in Modimolle, met OSD-salarisgradering oor drie ervaringvlakke.
af.requirements: Vier (4) jarige graad (NQF7)/ drie (3) jarige Diploma in Verpleegkunde (NQF6). Nagraadse Diploma (NQF8) in Beroepsgesondheid / Teatertegniek / Kritiese Sorg sal 'n voordeel wees. Graad 1: 2-9 Jaar se ondervinding opgedaan na registrasie, Graad 2: 10-19 Jaar se ondervinding opgedaan na registrasie. Graad 3: 20 Jaar en meer se ondervinding opgedaan na registrasie. Ondervinding in trauma/noodgevalle/interne geneeskunde/algemene chirurgie/ortopedie/teater op streeksopenbare hospitaalvlak of private hospitaal. Ondervinding in mediese eisverwerking/versekeringsomgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Registrasie by die South African Nursing Council. Kennis: Mediesverwante wetgewing, Medicines and related Substances Act, Mediese hulpkennis (gevalbestuur), Beroepsgesondheidskennis, Regulerende kennis en implementering, Del en Compensation Fund doelwitte en besigheidsfunksies, Verpleegwetswetgewing en verwante regs- sowel as etiese verpleegpraktyke, Compensation Fund beleide, prosedures en prosesse, Belanghebbendes en kliënte, Kliëntediens (Batho Pele Beginsels), Fondswaardes, Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS), COIDA Act, Regulasies en Beleide, COIDA tariewe, Tegniese kennis, PFMA en National Treasury Regulasies, Algemene kennis van die Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, Health Professions Act, Health Act. Vaardighede: Pos-eisbestuur en skikking, Eishantering, Eisskikkingsbestuur, Mediese beleidbestuur, Kliniese uitnemendheid en advies, Projekbestuur en beplanning, Inligtingsanalise en -interpretasie, Digitale vaardigheid/Mediese stelsels (IT-stelselsbeheerontwerpe), Kliniese kodering, Kwaliteitsversekering en -verbetering, Navorsing en benchmarking.
af.duties: Verskaf advies en aanbeveling by die aanvaarding van aanspreeklikheid. Beveel die goedkeuring van mediese rekeninge aan. Verskaf mediese advies oor die verwerking van beroepsbeserings-eise. Bepaal PD (Permanente Gestremdheid) en TTD (Totale Tydelike Gestremdheid). Assesseer mediese rekeninge op beroepsbeserings-eise en OD-mediese rekeninge.

zu.title: Ummeli Wezempilo Ezinga 1-3: Ukwehlulelwa Kwezokwelapha
zu.summary: Ummeli wezempilo odingekayo ukwehlulelwa izinkokhelo zezomzimba ezimalunga nomsebenzi ekuMnyangweni Wezokuqashwa Nolusebenza eModimolle, nokulinganiswa kweholo le-OSD kuzo zonke izinga ezintathu zesiphephelo.
zu.requirements: IDigri yeminyaka emine (4) (NQF7)/ IDiploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) Ekuqashweni Kwezempilo (NQF6). I-Post Graduate Diploma (NQF8) Ezenzele Impilo Yomsebenzi / Izindlela Zesidlali / Ukunakekelwa Okubalulekile kuzoba ngusizo. Izinga 1: Isiphephelo seminyaka engu-2-9 esitholakele emva kokubhalisa, Izinga 2: Isiphephelo seminyakaengu-10-19 esitholakele emva kokubhalisa. Izinga 3: Isiphephelo seminyakaengu-20 nangaphezulu esitholakele emva kokubhalisa. Isiphephelo kumthunywa/ezesikhashana/izenzo zangaphakathi/ukuhlinzwa okujwayelekile/izinpunu/esidlalini ezingeni lesibhedlela sikahulumeni seningingizi noma esibhedlela sangasese. Isiphephelo ekucubunguleni izinkokhelo zezokwelapha/izinkambiso zensimbi kuzongeyusizo engeziwe. Ukuqashwa kwiSouth African Nursing Council. Ulwazi: Izimiso ezithintwe izinto ezingomthetho wezempilo, Umthetho Wezamakhemikhiki Nezinto Eziyisihlanganise, Ulwazi ngesikhwama sezempilo (ulawulwe izimo), Ulwazi Ngempilo Nomsebenzi, Ulwazi Nemitsetho Nokuphathwa Kwawo, IminYango Wezokuqashwa Nolusebenza; Isikhwama Sokuhlinzeka nezinkambiso zokwenza umsebenzi, izimiso zezokwelapha kanye nenkambiso yomthetho nenzondo yezokwelapha, izinqubo nezinhlelo zeSikhathi Sokuhlinzela, Bahlali kanye namakhasimende, Inkondlo Yabathengi (Izimiso ZakaBatho Pele), Amaxabiso Esikhwama, Umthetho Wezokuphepha Nokunakekelwa Ngempilo Nomsebenzi (OHS), Umthetho We-COIDA, Izimiso Nezinqubo, Amakhodi E-COIDA, Ulwazi Lwobuchwepheshe, I-PFMA Kanye Nezimiso Ze- National Treasury, Ulwazi Olujwayelekile Ngemithetho YePublic Service, Umthetho We- Public Service, Umthetho We- Health Professions Act, Umthetho We- Health Act. Amakhono: Ukuphathwa Kwamangcwethu Nokuvunyelwa, Ukuphathwa Kwamangcwethu, Ukuphatha Ukuvunywa Kwamangcwethu, Ukuphathwa Kwemithetho Yezokwelapha, Ukuhlinzeka Ngolwazi Ngemfundo Nobunqwamile, Ukuphathwa Nokuqamba Amaphrojekthi, Ukuhlaziya Nokuhumusha Ulwazi, Ulwazi Olwezikhompuyutha/Amasistimu Ezokwelapha (Izinhlobo Zokulawula Amasistimu E-IT), Ukupeyikhodi Ngokwelapha, Ukutholwa Kwesigqoki Nokuphucula Ikhwalithi, Ukuqophela Nokuqonda Izinto ezinhle kakhulu.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngeluleko nentshutelo ekuvunyweni kwebango lokumosha. Celu ekuvunyweni kwezinkokhelo zokwelapha. Nikeza ngeluleko ngokwelapha ekucubungulweni izinkokhelo zomonakalo wonakele osemsebenzini. Huntushula i-PD (Permanent Disability) nethi-TTD (Total Temporary Disability). Hlela izinkokhelo zokwelapha ngokusimila komonakalo wonakele osemsebenzini kanye nani azinkokhelo zokwelapha ze-OD.

xh.title: Umqeshi weProfeshonale weGumbi leGazi leRhyme 1-3: Ukugunyazisa kweZokwakho
xh.summary: Kufuneka umqeshi weprofeshonale wokuqinisekiswa kwezexesho lwezonzulwa kwiSebe loMsebenzi nokuSebenzela eModimolle, ngonika imali ngokwezintsimo ze-OSD kwabo obeka yaye iinqanaba ezintathu.
xh.requirements: Izinga leNQF7 lobuchwephetha beNQF7 (iNursi) (isikhathi esifunda kwiminyaka emine (4) iminyaka) isikhathi seNQF8 kwesibini seNursi (iNursi) (NQF6). Izinga leNQF8 (Post Graduate Diploma) kwiZokunyuka kweZempilo / iNkundla yokuGqitha / iZinto eziBalulekileyo zokuQhatha. Iqondo 1: 2-9 iminyaka yokuqonda emva kokubhaliswa, Iqondo 2: 10-19 iminyaka yokuqonda emva kokubhaliswa. Iqondo 3: 20 iminyaka nangaphezulu yamava afunyanwe emva kokubhaliswa. Amafutha ekugqwesa kwiNdlela yokuSebenzela / iNdawo yokuNgenisa iNgingqi / iNdingo yangaphakathi / iSurgejari yonke / iNgqondo / iSurgejari kwizinga lesibhengeko lesigungqwela saseburhulumentehi okanye esibhengeko sangasese. Amafutha ekugqwesa ekugqithwa kwezifundo ezisemthethweni / iNdawo yokubonelela iNgingqi. Ukubhaliswa kwiRhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika wezoBunurse. Ulwazi: iMithetho engeyanto yokuSebenzela, iMtshato wokuSebenzela nokuSebenzisa iZinto ezinxulumene nokuQhelwa, ulwazi ngeNkxaso yeMpilo (iqhalan elinguLuhlazo), ulwazi lokuQhelwa ngokuSebenzela, iNkqubo yoLawulo nokuSebenzisa, iinjongo neentshaxo zeNgeniso yoLawulo neentshaxo zeSebe, iMithetho yokuNurse nemithetho ethetha ngayo nokuQhatha kwangoku, iNkqubo nokuSebenzisa kweNgeniso yoLawulo, iindidi nokuSetyenziswa kweNgeniso, abathathi nxaxheba nabo bafuna iNgeniso, inkxaso yokuKhutshwa (iNkqubo kaBatho Pele), iNkqubo yoLawulo, iMithetho yeMpilo yoGqoziyo, iMithetho yeCOIDA nokuQhelwa, iNkqubo yeCOIDA, iNkqubo zokuQondisa, iNkqubo ze-COIDA, ulwazi lokuQhatha, i-PFMA neNkqubo zeNginxiwo yeSizwe, ulwazi ngokubanzi lweNkqubo yoGqoziyo wokuSebenzela, iMthetho yoGqoziyo wokuSebenzela, iMthetho yoBuchwephetha beMpilo, iMthetho weMpilo. Amandla: uLawulo nokuQhela iNkqubo zokuGqibela, uLawulo lokuSetyenziswa kweNkqubo zokuGqibela, uLawulo lokuSetyenziswa kweNkqubo, uLawulo lweNkqubo yeMpilo, iNkqubo yokuPonta nokuNika iNgcebiso, uLawulo neNkqubo yoQhagamshelwano, uHlalutyo nokuLonda iNkcazelo, uQhakamshelwano lwamakhompyutha nokuSebenzisa iNkqubo zeMpilo (iNkqubo ze-IT Control Designs), iNkqubo yokuQhatha, uQiniseko lweNkqubo yokuQhatha, uPhando nokuQhatha iNkqubo yokuHamba phambili.
xh.duties: Nikeza ingcebiso nokuCamkelwa komava. Camkela ukuvunywa kweekhawunti zempilo. Nikeza ingcebiso yempilo ngokugqibela iinkqubo zonzakalo. Qamba ukuba PD (iNkqubo yokuSebenzela) kunye ne-TTD (iNkqubo yokuQhatha). Hlola iikhawunti zokugqibela iinkqubo zonzakalo kunye ne-OD iikhawunti zokugqibela iinkqubo zokugqiba izinto.

af.title: Human Resource Management Klerk
af.summary: 'n Human Resource Management Klerk word benodig by die KwaZulu-Natal provinsiale kantoor om HR-administrasie, diensvoorwaardes en prestasiebestuursfunksies te hanteer.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. Kennis: PERSAL, HR-inligtingsbestuurstelsel, kennis van registerpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf. zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesiqu se-undergraduate kwi-Corporate Governance/ Business Management/ Administration/ Auditing/ Law ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mkhulu wamava odingekayo. Kungaze kwaze kwabamba inqubo yomaqhubayo eysikhombisa ( kokubili komphakathi nasesimweni sangasese). Ulwazi: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Public Service Regulations (PSR). Public Service Act (PSA). Unemployment Insurance Act and Regulations (UIAR). Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act (UICA). Amakhono: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kumakhompyutha. Okubukhoma bethu. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukwenza isilinganiso sekhono. Ukuxhumana ( Kokubili okulotshiwe nasezinkulumweni ). Isikhathi sokuba nethonya. Ukuhlakanipha ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ukwabhala imibiko. Ukulawula isikhathi. Ukubala inani.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yozibuse emphakathini wokuphumelelisa amakhadi omthetho woBukhosi Bezinkampani amakomidi e-Fund. Sekela ucwaningo ngendlela ezinhle zokubusa kwemikhakha yezinkampani. Siza ekugcineni ukusebenza kahle kwezakhiwo zokubusa kwezinkampani kwi-Fund. Nikeza inkxaso ekuvumelaneni nemithetho nasekuhlanganiseni inqubo yokuhlola.

jobs.title: Senior Human Resource Practitioner: Recruitment and
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Coordinate recruitment, shortlisting and interviewing for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in HR and two years' experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF 6) in Human Resource Management or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ proven experience in the field of Human Resources Management, with a specific focus on Recruitment, Selection and Appointments. Candidates must be in possession of PERSAL introduction Certificate. Knowledge of the recruitment and selection processes. Ability to interpret policies and directives on HR matters. Skills in formulating and writing reports. Ability to plan and organise the activities of the division. Good understanding and functional knowledge of the Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, OSD Framework, Basic Conditions of Employment Act and Employment Equity Act. Experience in the use of PERSAL System. Supervisory skills. Good communication (verbal and written), stakeholder liaison, organising and planning skills. Good analytical thinking, innovation, and creative skills. Good computer literacy and use of standard packages. Ability to work long hours and under pressure. Ability to work independently and in a team.
jobs.duties: Provide support, coordinate, and facilitate effective recruitment, shortlisting and interviewing of competent human resources and ensure compliance with all the relevant legislation and policy framework. Compile and draft adverts in line with Job Description and in accordance with the relevant legislative framework. Advertise vacant posts in the relevant media. Ensure proper management of applications. Verify captured applications and do quality control. Serve as technical advisor during shortlisting and interviewing process. Support effective Personnel Suitability Checks and placement of employees on PERSAL. Provide advice on all HR related matters. Provide support in the development and implementation of the Department recruitment policies. Develop, refine and maintain databases, reports on Recruitment, Selection and Placement. Provide overall supervision and guidance to staff.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical passement for all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. OTHER POSTS
