Goeie begrip en funksionele kennis van die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, OSD Framework, Basic Conditions of Employment Act en Employment Equity Act. Ervaring in die gebruik van die PERSAL-stelsel. Toesighoudende vaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), belanghebbende-skakeling, organiseer- en beplanningsvaardighede. Goeie analitiese denke, innovasie en kreatiewe vaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid en gebruik van standaardpakette. Vermoë om lang ure en onder druk te werk. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bied ondersteuning, koördineer en fasiliteer effektiewe werwing, keuring en onderhoude van bekwame menslike hulpbronne en verseker nakoming van alle relevante wetgewing en beleidsraamwerk. Stel en opstel advertensies in ooreenstemming met die posbeskrywing en in ooreenstemming met die relevante wetgewende raamwerk. Adverteer vakante poste in die relevante media. Verseker behoorlike bestuur van aansoeke. Verifieer vasgelegde aansoeke en doen gehaltebeheer. Tree as tegniese adviseur op tydens die keurings- en onderhoudproses. Ondersteun effektiewe Persoonlike Geskiktheidskontroles en plasing van werknemers op PERSAL. Bied advies oor alle MH-verwante aangeleenthede. Bied ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling en implementering van die departement se werwingsbeleide. Ontwikkel, verfyn en onderhou databasisse, verslae oor Werwing, Keuring en Plasing. Bied algehele toesig en leiding aan personeel.

zu.title: Umphathi Ophakemei Wemisebenzi Yabantu: Ukubumba Nokuqasha
zu.summary: Koordinate ukubumba abasebenzi, ukwenza uhlu lwabafanelekile kanye nokuxoxisana ngephimisondo ku Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria, kudingeka i-National Diploma kwi-HR kanye neminyaka emibili yemfundo.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) ku-Human Resource Management noma iziqu ezihambisana nomkhakha ohlobene njengoba kubonakaliswa yi-SAQA. Ukube ngokungaphansi kweminyaka emibili (2) yemfundo eyaziwayo enkundleni yoLawulo Wemisebenzi Yabantu, ngokuqala okukhethekile ekubumbeni, ukukhetha kokuqashwa. Oqeqeshiwe kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-PERSAL introduction. Ulwazi ngezenzo zokubumba nokukhetha. Ukukwazi ukuhumusha izinqumo nokuqondisa ngemiba ye-HR. Amakhono ekuqamba nokubhala imibiko. Ukukwazi ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela imisebenzi yomnyango. Ukuqonda kahle futhi ulwazi olusebenzayo ngo-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-OSD Framework, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act kanye ne-Employment Equity Act. Ulwazi ekusebenziseni i-PERSAL System. Amakhono okuba ngumphathi. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okushoyo nokuqoshiwe), ukuxhumana nabalulekile, ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukucabanga ngokuhlola kahle, ukudala okusha, namakhono okuqamba. Ukusebenzisa kahle ikhompuyutha kanye namaphakheji azejwayelekile. Ukukwazi ukusebenza amahora amade nangapansi koxhaxha. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngabanye nangaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso, yoordinate, futhi ukuthuthukisa ukubumba, ukwenza uhlu lwabafanelekile nokuxoxisana ngokusebenza kahle kwemisebenzi yabantu eqinisekisiwe futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho wonke ohlukile nokuqondiswa kwenqumoshe. Hlela futhi uthathe izikhalazo ezihlobene ne-Job Description futhi ngokuhambisana nenqumoshe yomthetho. Qasha izikhundla ezize ezikwabezindaba ezihlukene. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okuhle kwezicelo. Qinisekisa izicelo ezibambiwe futhi wenze ukulawula kwekhwalithi. Phathwa njengomsizi ochwepheshe ngexesha lenqubo yokwenza uhlu lwabafanelekile nokuxoxisana. Nika inkxaso ekuqinisekisweni okuhle kokulunga komuntu kokuqashwa kwaye ubenze uhlu kwi-PERSAL. Nikela ngeluleko kuzo zonke izinto ezihlobene ne-HR. Nika inkxaso ekwakheni nokuqaliswa kwezinqumo zokubumba komnyango. Yila, cula futhi ugcine izindlu zemininingwane, imibiko yokubumba, ukukhetha nokubeka. Nika oqobo ukulawula kanye nokuqondisa abasebenzi.

xh.title: Senior Human Resource Practitioner: Recruitment and
xh.summary: Lungelelanisa ukuqesha, ukulungisa uludwe lwabafaki isicelo nokubuza abafaki isicelo kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria, kufuneka i-National Diploma kwi-HR kunye namava emyaka emibini.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) kwiHuman Resource Management okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo kwikhondo elinxulumene nalo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Isiqinisekiso sokuba n-amava amabini (2) eminyaka obonakalisiweyo kwikhondo leHuman Resources Management, ngqondweni ekubeni ijongene nokuBumba abasebenzi, uKhetho kunyeokuMisela. Kufunke abafaki isicelo babe nePERSAL introduction Certificate. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokubumba abasebenzi nokuKhetha. Amandla okuchaza amanqamle kunye neelayisense ezimalunga ne-HR. Amandla okulunga nokubhala iingxelo. Amandla okucwangcisa nokulungelelanisa imisebenzi yesiqhagamsheli. Ukuqonda kakuhle nolwazi olusebenzayo lwe-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-OSD Framework, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act kunye ne-Employment Equity Act. Amandla okusebenzisa inkqubo ye-PERSAL. Amandla okulawula. Amandla amabalé ez ukunxibelelwana (ngelizwi nangokubhaliweyo), ukunxibelelana nabathintekayo, ukulungelelanisa nokucwangcisa. Amandla amahle okucinga ngokutahluliswa, inkqubela, nokudala. Amandla amahle okusebenzisa ikhompyutha nakusetyenziswa iinkqubo eziqhelekileyo. Amandla okusebenza iiyure ezinde kunye nangxwaxha. Amandla okusebenza yedwa nakwisiqu.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso, ulungelelanise, kwaye ulawule ukuba kokusebenza ngokusebenzayo, ukulungisa uludwe lwabafaki isicelo kwaye uxoxe ngeengxoxo nabagqatswa abanamandla kubasebenzi kwaye uqinisekise ukuthobela yonke imithetho nakwisakhelo senkqubo efanelekileyo. Hlenga kwaye ubhale iinkqubo zokushicilela izikhundla ngokwemiselweyo kunye nokulandela isakhelo semithetho esifanelekileyo. Shicilela izikhundla ezizele kumajelo afanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lwesicelo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwesicelo esingenisiweyo kwaye wenze ulawulo lolwazi. Zive njengomceli-mangaliswano ochumileyo ngexesha lokulungisa uludwe lwabafaki isicelo nakwingxoxo nabagqatswa. Nika inkxaso ekusingathweni kolwavo lokufaneleka kwabasebenzi kwaye ubeka abasebenzi kwi-PERSAL. Nikela ngengcebiso kuzo zonke izinto ezimalunga ne-HR. Nika inkxaso ekuthuthweni nakuphoYWenweni kweenkqubo zokubumba abasebenzi ze-Sebe. Phuhlisa, ucace kwaye ulondoloze iideshtha, iingxelo zoLungelelwaniso, lUdweLwabafakisisicelo kunye nokubekwa. Nikela ngolawulo lonke kunye nenkqubo yokulungelelanisa abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Human Resource Officer: Recruitment and Selection
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Human Resource Officer supporting recruitment, selection and appointments within the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF4) as recognized by SAQA. Post-matric qualification and experience in Recruitment, Selection and Appointments will be an added advantage. knowledge of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act and Employment Equity Act. Good communication (verbal and written), interpersonal, organising and planning skills. Good analytical thinking, innovation, and creative skills. Good computer literacy. Ability to work independently and in a team. Ability to interpret policies and directives on HR matters. Ability to plan and organise the activities of the division. Ability to work long hours and under pressure.
jobs.duties: Render recruitment, selection, and appointments support. Administer job applications. Provide support with the coordination and processing of appointment documents. Serve as technical advisor during shortlisting and interviewing process. Support effective Personnel Suitability Checks and administer and process placement of employees on PERSAL. Provide advice on all HR related matters.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical passement for all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Menslike Hulpbronbeampte: Werwing en Keuring
af.summary: Menslike Hulpbronbeampte wat werwing, keuring en aanstellings binne die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria ondersteun.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (NQF4) soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Post-matriekkwalifikasie en ervaring in Werwing, Keuring en Aanstellings sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act en Employment Equity Act. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), interpersoonlike, organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede. Goeie analitiese denke, innovasie en kreatiewe vaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om beleide en riglyne oor HR-aangeleenthede te interpreteer. Vermoë om die aktiwiteite van die afdeling te beplan en te organiseer. Vermoë om lang ure en onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning ten opsigte van werwing, keuring en aanstellings. Administreer werkansoeke. Verskaf ondersteuning met die koördinering en verwerking van aanstellingsdokumente. Tree as tegniese adviseur op tydens die kortlyssamestelling en onderhoudvoeringsproses. Ondersteun doeltreffende Personeelgeskiktheidskontroles en administereer en verwerk die plasing van werknemers op PERSAL. Verskaf advies oor alle HR-verwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Inkulu Yamaphoyisa Abantu: Ukubumba Abasebenzi Nokukhetha
zu.summary: Inkulu Yamaphoyisa Abantu enikela usizo ekubumbeni abasebenzi, ekukhetheni nasekunikezeni izikhundla ngaphakathi kwamaphoyisa abantu e-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (NQF4) njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu ze-post-matric namava ekubumbeni abasebenzi, ekukhetheni nakunikezeni izikhundla kuzoba usizo. Ulwazi ngoPublic Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act kanye ne-Employment Equity Act. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okukhuluma nokubhala), abantu, ukuhlela nokubeka izinhlelo. Amakhono amahle okucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukwakha okusha, nokudala. Ukulunga okuhle ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha. Ikono ukusebenza eyedwa nasenhlanganweni. Ikono lokuhumusha izinqobo nezinqavobela kanye nezinkomba kumaphoyisa abantu. Ikono lokubeka izinhlelo nokuhlela imisebenzi yesigaba. Ikono lokusebenza amawela amahora nangaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Nikela usizo ekubumbeni abasebenzi, ekukhetheni nakunikezeni izikhundla. Phatha izicelo zemisebenzi. Nikela usizo ekuhambiseni nasekuthatheni iziqubulo zamaphoyisa abantu. Yiba ngumeluleki wezobuchwepheshe ngesikhathi kuncishiswa uhla futhi kubuzwa imibuzo. Sekela ukubuywa kwemibiko yokulingana kwezempahla zabasebenzi futhi uphathe futhi uthathe isiqubulo sokubeka abasebenzi ku-PERSAL. Nikeza izeluleko kuyo yonke imicabango ehlobene namaphoyisa abantu.

xh.title: Ofisi yoLawulo loBuntu: Ukuza kubakho Abantu noKhetho
xh.summary: Ofisi yoLawulo loBuntu enika inkxaso ekuzoseni abantu, ekukhetheni nasekuqeshweni ngaphakathi kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e-Pretoria.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 (NQF4) njengoko ivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Isidanga esingaphezu kwe-matric namava ekuzoseni abantu, ekukhetheni nakuqeshweni kuya kuba yinyaniso ekongezelelwayo. Ulwazi lomthetho wePublic Service Act, wePublic Service Regulations, weLabour Relations Act, weBasic Conditions of Employment Act nowoEmployment Equity Act. Amakhono amabalawuli icala (athethwayo nawabhalwayo), abantu,okuququzelela nokulungiselela. Amakhono amabalawuli ingqondo, iingcamango, nodidi lwenkqubo yemfihlakalo. Amakhono amabalawuli ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kodwa nangaphandle kwaye nakulo qela. Ukuba nakho ukuvezwa iinkqabo nezikhokelo ezimalunga noLawulo loBuntu. Ukuba nakho ukulungiselela nokulawula imisebenzi yesigaba. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza iiyure ezinde kwaye ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekuzoseni abantu, ekukhetheni, nakwiinkcukacha zokuqeshwa. Lawula izicelo zemisebenzi. Nika inkxaso ekulawuleni nasekuqhubeni iinkcukacha zokuqeshwa. Zoba ngumcebisi ongcali ngexesha lenkqubo yokubhalisa abantu abafanelekileyo nasekubuzeni imibuzo ephathelene nokuqeshwa. Nika inkxaso ekwenzeni iimpimo ezifanelekileyo zabasebenzi kwaye ulawule ukuqwalaselwa nokubekwa kwabasebenzi kwi-PERSAL. Nikeza izigqibo kuzo zonke izinto ezidibana noLawulo loBuntu.

jobs.title: Director: Development Cooperation
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% of total package, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion]. The flexible portion of the package can be structured according to the Senior Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Director of Development Cooperation providing strategic leadership for South Africa's international health agenda and managing bilateral, trilateral and multilateral partnerships.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and NQF 7 qualification in International Relations Diplomacy / Social Sciences / Public Health and/or Health Sciences. NQF 8 qualification of the above will be an advantage. At least five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior management level in international negotiations and partnership management, resource mobilization and donor coordination. Knowledge of Public Service policies, regulations and procedures, international relations and foreign policy frameworks. Knowledge of global health diplomacy and international health systems as well as development cooperation and ODA management. Global health trends and multilateral systems. Good communication (verbal and written), strategic leadership and policy development, programme and project management, financial, change and knowledge management, service delivery innovation, people management and empowerment, high-level of negotiation and diplomacy, stakeholder engagement and partnership management and decision-making skills. A valid driver’s license. SMS pre-entry Certificate is required for appointment finalization.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and development cooperation. Develop and implement strategies to promote South Africa’s international health development agenda. Establish and strengthen bilateral, trilateral and multilateral partnerships with international stakeholders. Manage and mobilise official development assistance (ODA) resource for health sector in South Africa. Lead the development of funding proposals, agreements, and partnership frameworks. Coordinate the implementation of donor-funded programme at national and provincial levels. Ensure effective, monitoring and reporting of donor funds in line with regulatory requirements. Coordinate, evaluate and monitor development cooperation framework and project. Ensure alignment and integration across national, provincial and regional health programmes. Compile strategic and operational reports for executive management and stakeholders. Manage resources and financial. Provide leadership, mentorship and performance management to staff. Ensure sound financial management and accountability of allocated budget. Develop and implement risk management plans within the directorate. Respond to audit findings and implement corrective measures. Strengthen governance systems and internal controls.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T Mnisi Tel No: (012) 395 8830 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria. 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Ontwikkelingsamewerking
af.summary: Direkteur van Ontwikkelingsamewerking wat strategiese leierskap verskaf vir Suid-Afrika se internasionale gesondheidsagenda en bilaterale, trilaterale en multilaterale vennootskappe bestuur.
af.requirements: Grade 12-sertifikaat en NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Internationale Betrekkinge en Diplomasie / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Volksgezondheid en/of Gesondheidswetenskappe. 'n NQF 8-kwalifikasie in bogenoemde sal 'n voordeel wees. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in internasionale onderhandelinge en vennootskapsbestuur, hulpbronmobilisering en skenkerkoördinering. Kennis van Openbare Diens-beleide, regulasies en prosedures, internasionale betrekkinge en buitelandse beleidsraamwerke. Kennis van globale gesondheidsdiplomatie en internasionale gesondheidstelsels asook ontwikkelingsamewerking en ODA-bestuur. Globale gesondheidstendense en multilaterale stelsels. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), strategiese leierskap en beleidsontwikkeling, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële, verandering- en kennisbestuur, diensleweringsinnovasie, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, hoë vlak van onderhandeling en diplomatie, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en vennootskapsbestuur en besluitnemingsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. 'n SMS-toelatingsertifikaat word vir die finalisering van die aanstelling vereis.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en ontwikkelingsamewerking. Ontwikkel en implementeer strategieë om Suid-Afrika se internasionale gesondheidsontwikkelingsagenda te bevorder. Vestig en versterk bilaterale, trilaterale en multilaterale vennootskappe met internasionale belanghebbendes. Bestuur en mobiliseer amptelike ontwikkelingsbystand (ODA)-hulpbronne vir die gesondheidssektor in Suid-Afrika. Lei die ontwikkeling van befondsingsvoorstelle, ooreenkomste en vennootskapsraamwerke. Koördineer die implementering van deur skenkers befondsde programme op nasionale en provinsiale vlak. Verseker doeltreffende monitering en verslagdoening van skenkingsfondse in ooreenstemming met regulatoriese vereistes. Koördineer, evalueer en monitor die ontwikkelingsamewerkingsraamwerk en projekte. Verseker belyning en integrasie tussen nasionale, provinsiale en streeksgesondheidsprogramme. Stel strategiese en operasionele verslae vir uitvoerende bestuur en belanghebbendes op. Bestuur hulpbronne en finansies. Verskaf leierskap, mentorskap en prestasiebestuur aan personeel. Verseker deeglike finansiële bestuur en verantwoording van die toegekende begroting. Ontwikkel en implementeer risikobestuursplanne binne die direktoraat. Reageer op ouditbevindings en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls. Versterk bestuurstelsels en interne kontroles.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukubambisana Kokuthuthukisa
zu.summary: Umphathi Wokubambisana Kokuthuthukisa ohlinzeka ngobuholi obuhle mayelana nesenzo sezempilo saseNingizimu Afrika futhi ephatha ubudlelwano bobulwelwane, obungethathu kanye nombambisana wemidlalo eminingi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 kanye neziqu ze-NQF 7 kwi-International Relations Diplomacy / Social Sciences / Public Health futhi/noma Health Sciences. Iziqu ze-NQF 8 ezinjengezindlu zokuhambisa izinto ezengeziwe zizoba nenzuzo. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ezingeni eliphakathi/phezulu lolawula ekuxoxiseleni kwamazwe ngaphandle nakuphathweni kwebungu, ekwenzeni amakhulu amatholwa kanye nokuhlanganisa abanikazi zabelo. Ulwazi ngemithetho, imithethonqobo kanye nezinqubo zesevisi yomphakathi, izinsimboni zokubambisana kwamazwe ngaphandle kanye nezesicoco sawo wonke amazwe. Ulwazi ngokusungula izinga lezwe emazweni mayelana nezempilo kanye namasistimu ezempilo emazweni ngaphandle kanye nokubambisana kokuthuthukisa nokuphathwa kwe-ODA. Amathrendi ezempilo emazweni ngaphandle namasistimu wokubambisana wemidlalo eminingi. Amakhono okuxoxa kahle (olwimi olushashalazini nolwolunye), ubuholi obuhle futhi usungule umthetho, ukuphathwa kohlaka namaphrojekthi, izimali, ukushintsha kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi, ukwakusa ukuletha izinsizakalo, ukuphatha abantu futhi babakhuphulele izinga, ukuxoxisana nokuqonda ezinye izwe eziseduzane, ukubandakanya izigxobo kanye nokuphathwa kwebungu namakhono okwenza izinqumo. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehloniphekile. Isitifikedi sokuqala se-SMS sidingwa ukuqedwa kokubekwa esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngobuholi obuhle futhi uzinikele ekubambisweni kokuthuthukisa. Sungula futhi usebenzise izuva ukuthuthukisa isu sezempilo saseNingizimu Afrika emazweni ngaphandle. Sungula futhi uqinise ubudlelwano bobulwelwane, obungethathu nombambisana wemidlalo eminingi nezigxobo zamazwe ngaphandle. Phatha futhi uqoqe usizo olusemthethweni lwezokuthuthukisa (ODA) lwesabelo sezempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Hola ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokucela imali, izivumelwano, kanye nezinkomba zokuqinisa ubudlelwane. Hlanganisa ukusebenza kohlaka obuxhaswa ngemali abantu abazinikelayo ezinkundleni zesifunda nesifunda. Qinisekisa ukubukeka okuhle, ukulawula nokubika ngemali etholwe kubantu abazinikelayo ngokuhambisana nemithethonqobo. Hlanganisa, hlola futhi ulawule izinkomba zokubambisana kokuthuthukisa kanye nephrojekthi. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuhlanganisa kohlaka bezempilo ezinkundleni zesifunda, esifunda esifanayo. Qamba imibiko ehlakaniphile futhi yezokusebenza kwabaphathi bezenza umsebenzi kanye nezigxobo. Lawula izinsiza nezimali. Hlinzeka ngobuholi, ukuba ngumuntu ohola abanye kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthula kohlaka kubasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali okuhle kanye nobhekezelelwa kwebhajethi ekiwe. Sungula futhi usebenzise izinkomba zokubhekezelela ingozi kulezi zinkomba. Phendula imibiko yokuhlola futhi usebenzise izindlela zokulungisa. Qinisa amasistimu okubusa kanye nokulawula okwangaphakathi.

xh.title: Ingqwalasela: Ukusebenzisana Ngokwakha Uluntu
xh.summary: Ulawulo lokusebenzisana ngendalo, kubakho ubuqhawe obuzela ngokwamandla ekubeni kubekho isikhokelo ngokwamandla ekwaziseni amazwe ngamazwe, nokulawula ubudlelwane namanye amazwe.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seKhredi yakhelo yi-12, nefom yeNQF 7 kwimiba ethinta iindlela zobudiplomata ezahlukeneyo kwihlabathi ngokubanzi / iindawo ezithinta imiba yomphakathi, okanye iziphumo ezingagungqiyo kwimiba yempilo yonke. Ifom yeNQF 8 ngaphezulu kwezi ndawo zitshiwo apha ngasentla iya kuba yinzuzo. Kufuneka ubenolwazi olugqithisayo lweminyaka emihlanu (5) kulawulo kwinqanaba eliphakathi nelongentloko kwimiba yokuhlangabezana namanye amazwe ngokwerhafu, nokulawula imali ethotywa ngaphandle, nokuhambelana nabani na onikayo. Ulwazi ngamathongo eMphakathi woLuntu, nangemigaqo-nkqubo yokwenza izinto, kunye nendlela yokusebenza ngokwerhafu kwihlabathi ngokubanzi. Ulwazi ngokuhamba-hamba kwezempilo kunye namanye amazwe, nokwaziswa kwindlela ezisebenza ngayo izempilo kwihlabathi ngokubanzi. Ulwazi ngamatrend ezempilo kwihlabathi nge ndlela ezisebenzayo. Ulwazi loluntu ngokubanzi. Unako ukuziphatha kakuhle ngokwemilomo nangokubhalwa, ukulawula ngobuchule, ukulawula iNkqubo yoMthetho-nkqubo weSizwe nakulo lonke iqela labantu, ukulawula imiba ehambelanayo nemali, nokuziphatha kwindalo entsha, ukuqonda kakuhle imigaqo-nkqubo, ukubeka ngasentla kwaye ukhokela iinkqubo namaphulo, ukuqonda kakuhle indlela yokwenza izinto ngokwerhafu, nokuziphatha kakuhle.
xh.duties: Nika ubuqhawe obuzela, ngenoxa, ngobuchule phezu kokusebenzisana ngendalo, nokuyiphuhlisa. Pharisa ubuchule bokuqhuba phambili, busewe ngomthetho, itekisi, kwaye uphuhlise iindlela ezintsha zokuzimisela nokuyiphuhlisa. Misela uqhagamshelwano, ngakumbi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo, kwiindaba ezahlukeneyo namazwe aphesheya. Sebenzisa neziko elawulayo lokuze lenze isixhobo esikwi sikwazi ukuyicela ngokuchanekileyo neengcali ngamanye amazwe aphesheya; oku ngokulandela izigqibo zamazwe ngamazwe. Qonda ngakumbi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzayo ezikwimpilo, ngokulandela imigqabo yamazwe ngamazwe ecacisa iimfuno. Qonda ngakumbi ngezizathu ezahlukeneyo ezingadala ukuba kubeluncedo ekulawuleni imali yamanye amazwe nokuyicima. Yazi ngezizathu ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzayo kwimpilo ngokwakhe kunye nendlela yokuziphatha kwihlabathi liphela. Yazi iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwenza isigqibo esinzulu sokulawula imali yamanye amazwe nokuyiphuhlisa. Qonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzayo kwimpilo ngokwakhe kunye nendlela yokuziphatha kwihlabathi liphela. Nika inkqubo yokuziphatha ekhokelayo, eqinisekisa, ecacisa, eqinisekisa ngakumbi, ngokubhalwa, nokuba nolwazi oluzo ukuba luncedo ekubeni kuqondwe kakuhle kwaye kukhokelwe kakuhle. Qonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza ngendalo nokuyiphuhlisa. Qonda ngakumbi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza kwimpilo ngokwakhe kunye nendlela yokuziphatha kwihlabathi liphela. Qonda ngakumbi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzayo kwimpilo ngokwakhe kunye nendlela yokuziphatha kwihlabathi liphela. Qonda ngakumbi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzayo ekulawuleni imali yamanye amazwe nokuyiphuhlisa. Qonda ngakumbi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzayo ekulawuleni imali yamanye amazwe nokuyiphuhlisa. Yiba nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ifuna isatifikethi sokungena phambi kwesikhathi esibhalwe ngaphambi kokuba kugqitywe ukumiswa.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Health Promotion
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Health Promotion in Pretoria responsible for developing national healthy lifestyle guidelines, frameworks and strategies within the Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate and NQF 7 undergraduate qualification in Health Sciences / Social Sciences / Health Promotion and/or Nursing qualification as recognized by SAQA. At least three (3) years’ experience as an Assistant Director in health promotion / disease prevention / healthy lifestyle promotion / communicable diseases / non-communicable diseases / public health and/or related programmes. Knowledge of relevant Acts, regulations and policies within the Department of Health related to health promotion and disease prevention. Understanding of health promotion principles, behaviour change approaches and social, economic, environmental and commercial determinants of health. Knowledge of South Africa’s health system structure and public health service delivery models. Understanding of interventions related to healthy eating, physical activity, tobacco control, reduction of harmful alcohol use, mental wellbeing promotion, communicable disease prevention and other public health priorities. Knowledge of public health programme planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation systems, as well as policy, strategy, guideline and training material development and review processes. Principles of management and people management. Good technical and analytical thinking, communication (verbal and written), presentation, facilitation, organisational, planning, conflict resolution, project management and computer (MS package) skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Develop National guidelines, framework, strategies and tools for the implementation of HLS programme. Coordinate and provide technical guidance for the development and review of healthy lifestyle policies, norms and standards, strategies and guidelines. Facilitate alignment with WHO recommendations, national health priorities and relevant legislative frameworks. Manage stakeholder consultation processes to validate technical documents and interventions. Provide technical support to provinces for implementation of healthy lifestyle interventions and programmes. Coordinate and support the development and dissemination of implementation tools, communication materials and training packages. Conduct support visits to monitor and evaluate implementation of healthy lifestyle programmes and compliance with national guidelines and standards. Coordinate implementation, monitoring and reporting of national healthy lifestyle interventions and programmes. Monitor programme performance, implementation progress and utilisation of resources to ensure achievement of programme targets. Identify implementation challenges, risks and gaps, and facilitate corrective actions and continuous programme improvement. Compile reports on programme performance and implementation outcomes to inform planning and decision making. Provide technical support to internal and external stakeholders for the implementation of HLS programme. Facilitate establishment and strengthening of intersectoral collaboration mechanisms to support implementation of healthy lifestyle interventions. Represent the department in relevant technical forums and committees. Manage resources and audit risks. Manage human and operational resources. Sign performance agreements of ASDs and PDPs as well as conduct mid-year and annual performance reviews. Respond to audit queries.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria. 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Gesondheidsbevordering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Gesondheidsbevordering in Pretoria verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling van nasionale gesonde leefstylriglyne, raamwerke en strategieë binne die Departement van Gesondheid.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n NQF 7 voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Gesondheidswetenskappe / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Gesondheidsbevordering en/of 'n Verpleegkwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring as 'n Assistentdirekteur in gesondheidsbevordering / siektevoorkoming / gesonde leefstylbevordering / oordraagbare siektes / nie-oordraagbare siektes / openbare gesondheid en/of verwante programme. Kennis van relevante Wette, regulasies en beleide binne die Departement van Gesondheid wat verband hou met gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkoming. Begrip van gesondheidsbevorderingsbeginsels, gedragsverandering-benaderings en sosiale, ekonomiese, omgewings- en kommersiële determinante van gesondheid. Kennis van Suid-Afrika se gesondheidstelselstruktuur en openbare gesondheidsdiensleweringsmodelle. Begrip van ingrypings wat verband hou met gesonde eet, fisiese aktiwiteit, tabakbeheer, vermindering van skadelike alkoholgebruik, bevordering van geestelike welsyn, voorkoming van oordraagbare siektes en ander openbare gesondheidsprioriteite. Kennis van openbare gesondheidsprogrambeplanning, implementering, monitering en evalueringsisteme, asook beleid-, strategie-, riglyn- en opleidingsmateriaalontwikkeling en -hersieningsprosesse. Beginsels van bestuur en personeelbestuur. Goeie tegniese en analitiese denke, kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), aanbieding, fasilitering, organisatoriese, beplannings-, konflikoplossings-, projekbestuurs- en rekenaarvaardighede (MS-pakket). Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel nasionale riglyne, raamwerke, strategieë en hulpmiddels vir die implementering van die HLS-program. Koördineer en verskaf tegniese leiding vir die ontwikkeling en hersiening van gesonde leefstylbeleid, norme en standaarde, strategieë en riglyne. Fasiliteer belyning met WHO-aanbevelings, nasionale gesondheidsprioriteite en relevante wetgewende raamwerke. Bestuursbelanghebbende-konsultasieprosesse om tegniese dokumente en ingrypings te valideer. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan provinsies vir die implementering van gesonde leefstylingrypings en -programme. Koördineer en ondersteun die ontwikkeling en verspreiding van implementeringshulpmiddels, kommunikasiemateriaal en opleidingspakkette. Voer ondersteuningsbesoeke uit om implementering van gesonde leefstylprogramme en nakoming van nasionale riglyne en standaarde te moniteer en te evalueer. Koördineer implementering, monitering en verslagdoening van nasionale gesonde leefstylingrypings en -programme. Moniteer programprestasie, implementeringsvordering en gebruik van hulpbronne om bereiking van programteikens te verseker. Identifiseer implementeringsuitdagings, risiko's en gapings, en fasiliteer korrektiewe maatreëls en deurlopende programverbetering. Stel verslae op oor programprestasie en implementeringsuitkomste om beplanning en besluitneming te inlig. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes vir die implementering van die HLS-program. Fasiliteer die vestiging en versterking van intersektoriële samewerkingsmeganismes om implementering van gesonde leefstylingrypings te ondersteun. Verteenwoordig die departement in relevante tegniese forums en komitees. Bestuur hulpbronne en ouditrisiko's. Bestuur menslike en operasionele hulpbronne. Teken prestasieooreenkomste van ASD's en PDP's asook voer midjaar- en jaarlikse prestasie-evaluerings uit. Reageer op ouditnavrae.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Ohamba Neyele: Ukukhuthaza Impilo
zu.summary: Onjiniyela Ohamba Neyele wokuKhuthaza Impilo ePretoria ongemüthimeli ngokuthuthukisa iziqondiso, izakhiwo nezindlela zesiquzondvelwe mayelana nokuphila ngendlela enempilo ezweni lonke, ngaphakathi kweDepartment of Health.
zu.requirements: Isitifikathi seGrade 12 kanye nesidanga se-NQF 7 sezifundo ezingaphansi kwesiqu samakhosi we-HNS / Social Sciences / Health Promotion noma isidanga soNursi esigunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ube nobuhlolwanga obungangaphezu kweminyaka emithathu (3) njengoAssistant Director ekuqokwenza impilo / ekuthintelweni izifo / ekukhuthazeni ukuphila ngendlela enempilo / ezifweni ezeluliswayo / ezifweni ezingazeluliswayo / empilweni yakomphakathi noma ezinhlelweni ezihlobene. Ukwazi ngemithetho, izimiso kanye nemigomo ehlobene ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Health mayelana nokukhuthaza impilo nokuthintela izifo. Ukuqonda imigomo yokuKhuthaza Impilo, izindlela zokushintsha ukuziphatha kanye nezinto ezenza impilo ngokomphakathi, kwezomnotho, zokondlela, zendawo nezentengiso. Ukwazi isakhiwo samaphilisi weSouth Africa namamodeli ayo okuletha izinkonzo zempilo komphakathi. Ukuqonda ukungenelela okuhlobene nokudla okunempilo, ukuzivocavoca umzimba, ukulawula ubhontsi, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwebhiya okulimazayo, ukukhuthaza ukuphila ngokomoya okunempilo, ukuthintela izifo ezeluliswayo kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile empilweni yakomphakathi. Ukuqonda ukwenza izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo komphakathi, ukuqoka ukusetshenziswa kwazo, ukuqamba ukubuka kanye nezokuhlatshulwa kwezinhlelo, kanye nentuthuko nokubuyekeza kwezinkambiso, izindlela, iziqondiso kanye nezinto zokuqeqesha. Imigomo yabaphathi kanye nokuphatha abantu. Ukuphikisana ngobuchwepheshe nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangobhalwe), ukubukela, ukwazi ukuthuthukisa amandla, ukuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi namakhono ekhompyutha (MS package). Ukuba namandla okusebenza eyedwa nangaphakathi kwethimba. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa iziqondiso, izakhiwo, izindlela namathuluzi ezingeni lesizwe ukusetshenziswa kweproghram ye-HLS. Hlela futhi unike inxusa yobuchwephesha ekuthuthukiseni nasekubuyekiseni izinkambiso zokuphila ngendlela enempilo, amagunya kanye nemiqathango, izindlela neziqondiso. Yenza kube lula ukuqondanisa ngokubhaliwe yi-WHO, okubalulekile empilweni yesizwe kanye namakhovo emithetho. Phatha inqubo yokuxoxa nabantu abathintekayo ukuze aqiniseke amadokhumenti obuchwephesha kanye nokungenelela. Nikeza inkhasela yobuchwephesha ezifundazweni ekusetshenziseni ukungenelela nokuphila ngendelela enempilo namaphroghram. Hlela futhi usekele ukuthuthukiswa nokusabalalisa kwamathuluzi okusetshenziswa, izinto zokuxhumana namaphakheji okuqeqesha. Yenza ukuvakashela ukusekela ukuze ubuke futhi uhlole ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphila ngendlela enempilo kanye nokuhambisana neziqondiso namagunya ezingeni lesizwe. Hlela ukusebenzisa, ukubuka nokubika ngokungenelela nokuphila ngendlela enempilo ezweni lonke namaphroghram. Buka imiphumela yephroghram, inqubo yokusetshenziswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo ukuze kuqiniseke ukufinyelela okuhlosiwe kumphumela wephroghram. Hlola ubunzima bokusebenzisa, ubungozi kanye nezikhala futhi usize ukulungisa okubiwe nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwephroghram. Qamba imibiko ngeziphumana nesiphumakamu sephroghram ukuze kusize ekuhlelweni nasekwenzeni izinqumo. Nikeza inkhasela yobuchwephesha abathintekayo banganangaphandle nangaphakathi ekusetshenziseni iphrogharam ye-HLS. Yenza kube lula ukusungula nokugcizelela izinkambiso zokusebenza ndawonye phakathi kwamasimangamusimi ukuze kusekele ukusetshenziswa kwokungenelela ekuphileni ngendlela enempilo. Mela umnyango kumafomela namakomidi ahlobene nobuchwepheshe. Phatha izinsiza futhi uhlolisise ubungoza bokuphathwa kwezimali. Phatha abantu nezinsiza zokusebenza. Sayina izivumelwano zokusebenza ze-ASD nama-PDP kanye nokwenza ukubuyekeza okukhalf-way kunoma nonyaka. Phendula imibuzo yohlelo lokulawula izimali.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuthuthuzela Kwezempilo
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli wokuKhuthaza iziNgqiqo ezisempilweni ePretori, oxakekile ekuthuthuzeleni iziqondiso, iinkqubo nezicwangciso zesiqhelo esempilweni esezweni ngaphakathi kwisebe lezeMpilo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethda senqanaba le-12 nendikimba yemfundo esingaphantsi kwe-NQF 7 kwiZiZeNzulu / ezeNzululwazi ezeNtu / ukuKhuthaza ukuSebenza kweziMpilo nokuba ngumongameli weziNgqina njengoko kuyaziwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane iintsuku ezingamithathu (3) zeminyaka yamava ngumncedisi weNkululeko kokuKhuthaza isempilo / ukuthintela iigama / ukukhuthaza isiQhelo esempilweni / iigama ezingangenwa ntsholongwane / iigama ezingangenwa ntsholongwane ezingelona ngokubakho / iziGqibo zezempilo zabantu nokuba zinkqubo ezinxulumene naleyo. Ulwazi ngomthetho, iingqinisiso namacebo ngaphakathi kwisebe lezeMpilo nxulumene nokukhuthaza izempilo nokuthintela iigama. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokukhuthaza izempilo, iindlela zokutshintsha indlela yokuziphatha kwaye kubangelwa zentlalo, ezentlalo, ezemvelo, nenzuzo ngezempilo. Ulwazi ngokuqulunqwa kwendlela inkqubo yamagigaba eMzantsi Afrika iKwelakhaya namakhowa abonelelo amagigaba asentlalweni. Ukuqonda ukungenelela okunxulumene nokutya okuPhilayo, ukuzilolonga umzimba, ukulawula i-Tabakhulu, ukunciphisa ukusetyenziswa kobusi ngendlela eYingozi, ukukhuthaza impilo yengqondo, ukuthintela iigama ezingangenwa ntsholongwane nezinye iindidi eziphambili kwiZiGqibo zezempilo zabantu. Ulwazi ngokucwangcisa, ukuphumeza, ukuqokelela nokubuyisela amava inkqubo yeZiGqibo zezempilo zabantu, kuqala nokuQamba iNqamlezelo, iNgqiqo, isiQondiso nokuQeqesha okuBalulekileyo nokuQwalasela iNkqubo. Amagama oBulawa nokuLawula abaQeshiweyo. Ukucinga ngokweNzululwazi, nokuqonda ulwimi (ngomLomo nokuBhalwe), iNkcazelo, ukwenza iNkqubo iSebenze, ukuLungelelanisa, ukuCwangcisa, ukuzisa isiSombululo kwingxabano, ukuLawula iNkqubo namakhompyutha (i-MS package). Isakhono sokusebenza wedwa nakuQembu. Ilayisense yokushayela.
xh.duties: Qamba isiQondiso seSizwe, iNkqubo, isiCwangciso nezixhobo zokuSebenzisa iNkqubo ye-HLS. Lungiselela kwaye unike iNkqazo yeNzululwazi ekwakhiweni nakuQwalaselweni kweziQendu zokuQhuba phambili iNgqina eziQhelekileyo, ukuQwalasela iNgqina, iNqamlezelo, isiQondiso neNkqubo. Yenza kube mnandi ukuvumelanisa nezigqibo ze-WHO, iindidi eziphambili kwezeMpilo zeSizwe neNkqubo eZalathwa nguMthetho. Lawula iNkqubo yokucinga ngemiBuzo nabantu abanomdla wokuQinisekisa amanqaku eNzululwazi kwaye ungenise isigqibo. Unike iNkaziso yeNzululwazi kwiiPhondo ukuze kuQhutywe iNkqubo yokuQhuba phambili iNgqina eziQhelekileyo. Qamba kwaye uzixhasa ngeNkqubo zokuSebenzisa iziXhobo, iziNqaku ezikwimi nokuQeqesha iziXhobo eziBalulekileyo. Yenza ukwendela kunxibelelwano nokuQonda ukuba kuQaliswe njani kwaye kubekho ulwazi ekwakhiweni nakuQwalaselweni kweNkqubo yokuQhuba phambili iNgqina eziQhelekileyo neNkqubo. Lungiselela, qokelela nokubika ngokuQhutywa iNkqubo yokuQhuba phambili iNgqina eziQhelekileyo kwizwe. Qokelela iNkqubo yokubika ngokuQhutywa, ukuQhuba phambili kweNkqubo nokuSebenzisa iZibonelelo kuQinisekiswe ukufeza okukhankanyiweyo. Qamba iNkqubo yokuzidla ngemiBuzo, ukuba khona kengozi nokuQonda kwaye ulungiselele ukulungisa iNkqubo yokwenzeka kobubi nokwazi ukuyilungisa iNkqubo ngokokuQhuba phambili. Qamba iNkcazelo ngokuQhutywa iNkqubo neziphumo ezivela kuNkqubo yokwenza isiQondiso. Unike iNkaziso yeNzululwazi kubantu abangaphakathi nabanje ngaphandle ukwenzela iNkqubo yokuSebenzisa i-HLS. Qhube phambili ekwakhiweni nokuQinisekisa iNkqubo yokusebenzisana phakathi kweeSebe kwaye uxhase ukuQhutywa iNkqubo yokuQhubele phambili iNgqina eziQhelekileyo. Mela iSebe kwindawo ephilayo yamagigaba neNkqubo yokuLawula. Lawula izibonelelo kwaye uqwalasele iNkqubo yengozi. Lawula abantu nokuSebenza izibonelelo. Sayina iNkqubo yokubonisana ngoMsebenzi wee-ASDs nee-PDPs kwaye uqhube ukuQwalasela iNkqubo yokuQhuba phambili embindini kwakunyaka nakuQwalaselwa ngokwakunyaka. Phendula iimbuzo.

af.title: Adjunk-direkteur: Gesondheid Internasionaal Strategies
af.summary: Adjunk-direkteur benodig om internasionale gesondheidsprogramme te koördineer en strategiese voorligting te verskaf oor SADC- en Nasionale Aktieplan vir Gesondheidsveiligheid-inisiatiewe.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Gesondheid / Sosiale Wetenskappe. 'n Nagraadse NQF 8 in dieselfde velde sal 'n voordeel wees. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring op 'n Assistent-direkteur of gelykwaardige vlak in 'n strategie- en beplanningsomgewing. Ervaring moet werk met internasionale organisasies en of vennote by die implementering van gesondheidsprogramme insluit. Kennis van die Openbare Diens-wetgewing, insluitend maar nie beperk tot die Health Act nie. Kennis en begrip van die National Health Act en die Suid-Afrikaanse gesondheidstelsel, asook regeringsbeplanning- en beleidontwikkelingspraktyke/prosesse en metodologieë. Navorsingsbestuur, insluitend projek- en befondsingsvoorstelskryf. Kennis van die skryf van terme van voorkeur en konsepdokumente asook data- en inligtingsontleding. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), analitiese, projek- en navorsingsbestuur, netwerk- en belanghebbendebestuur, strategiese en operasionele beplanning, voorligting en aanbieding, probleemoplossing en besluitneming, finansiële bestuur en rekenaar (MS-pakket) vaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer menslike hulpbron-intervensies en fasiliteer tegniese insette oor internasionale gesondheidsprogramme soos die implementering van die SADC HRH-strategie en die Nasionale Aktieplan vir Gesondheidsveiligheid (NAPHS) vir nakoming van die Internasionale Gesondheidsregulasies. Verskaf bondige voorligting oor belangrike strategiese kwessies op die gebied van die gesondheidsarbeidsmag om internasionale gesondheidsbesprekings en -intervensies te inlig. Ontwikkel en formuleer substantiewe projekvoorstelle vir kapasiteitsbou in die gesondheids- menslike hulpbronsektor. Ontwikkeling, monitering en evaluering van die implementering van die HRH (Human Resource for Health)-strategie en -plan op alle vlakke van die gesondheidstelsel. Identifiseer, ontleed en fasiliteer langtermyn modellering van die sektor se vaardigheidsvereistes, met inagneming van tendense in regulasies, tegnologie, demografie, ens., om strategiese sektor- en organisatoriese doelwitte te bereik. Koördineer en ondersteun beplanning van die gesondheidsarbeidsmag dwarsoor provinsies. Betrek provinsies by die Nasionale HRH-strategie ter ondersteuning van die implementering of ontwikkeling daarvan. Koördineer en fasiliteer vergaderings, werkswinkels en aanbiedings aan belanghebbendes. Versterk die beplanningskapasiteit van die HRH-arbeidsmag op alle vlakke van die gesondheidstelsel. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van 'n spilpunt van kundigheid en hulpbronne vir die beplanning van die gesondheidsarbeidsmag vir die gesondheidstelsel. Bestuur projekte wat gemik is op die versekering van HRH-gereedheid en -beskikbaarheid vir noodgevalgereedheid. Hou toesig oor die implementering van die ramp-/noodgeval HRH-gereedheidsplan, insluitend die versekering van kapasiteit en meganismes vir die implementering van besigheidskontinuiteitsmaatreëls. Bestuur van die sub-direktoraat. Bestuur hulpbronne (finansiële en menslike) wat aan die sub-direktoraat toegewys is, insluitend die onderneem van finansiële en menslike hulpbronbeplanning. Berei verskillende tipes verslae, voorligtingsdokumente, terme van verwysing, ens. voor soos en wanneer vereis oor die werk van die sub-direktoraat.

zu.title: Onobhala-Jikelele: Ezenkwenkwezeli EzoHlelo Lwezempilo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onobhala-Jikelele ozoqondisa izinhlelo zezempilo ezingamazwe nabakubeke ukunikeza izinkulumo ezimfushane ngezinqumo mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izempilo ze-SADC kanye ne-National Action Plan for Health Security.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesidanga se-NQF 7 kwezempilo noma kwezeSayensi Zezentlalo. Isidanga se-NQF 8 sokuqeqesha okuphezulu esifanayo sibe kuncedo. Ukwaba nokuhlangenwe nakho okungaphezu kweminyaka emithathu (3) esikhundleni sokuba nguAssistant Director noma esilinganayo kwendawo yokuqamba izinhlelo nokuhlela. Kufanele kube nokuhlangenwe nakho kokusebenza nalezinhlangano ezingamazwe nabashayingi ekuphothulweni kwezinhlelo zezempilo. Ukuqonda uMthetho Wasezikhungweni Zomphakathi okufaka phakathi kodlula kuze kuMthetho Wezempilo. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho Wezempilo Womphakathi kanye neNhlelo Yezempilo yase-South Africa, kanye nezindlela/zinqubo nokwakheka kokuqamba izinhlelo kanye nenqubomgomo kahulumeni. Ukuphatha ucwaningo okufaka phakathi nokubhala amaphrojekthi kanye namapropo wemali. Ulwazi lokubhala amagama okuthandwayo namadokhumenti ezigaba kanye nokuhlaziya idatha kolwazi. Amakhono okuxhumana (athethwayo nabhalwayo), ukuhlaziya, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi nocwaningo, ukuxhumanisa nokuphatha abashayingi, ukuhlela ngokoqobo nangomsebenzi, ukumela kaluleko kanye nokunikeza izinkulumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo, ukuphatha imali kanye namakhono ekhompyutha (i-MS package). Ikhono lokusebenza ngabanye nangaphakathi kwethimba. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa Ukungenelela Kwamabhide Abantu kanye nokweseka okutheknikhali kwezinhlelo Zempilo Ezingamazwe njengokuphothulwa kweSADC HRH Strategy, i-National Action Plan for Health Security (NAPHS) ukuze kuhambisane nemithetho Yezempilo Yezwe. Niketha izinkulumo ezimfushane ngezindaba ezibalulekile zoqobo kwindawo yamandla emisebenzi yezempilo ukunikela ulwazi ngemibuzo nokungenelela kwezempilo kwamazwe. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukwakha amapropo wezinhlelo amaningi okwakha ikhono emkhakheni wobunyusi bezempilo abantu. Ukuthuthukiswa, ukulawula nokuhlola ukusetshenziswa kweSADC HRH kanye nohlelo kuzo zonke izinga zenhlelo yezempilo. Ukuthola, ukuhlaziya futhi ukweseka ukumodela okude kwesikhathi izidingo zamakhono emkhakha, ngokubhekwa kwethuba emthethweni, theknoloji, imibhalo yabantu, njll. ukuze kuhlangabezwe izinjongo zoqobo zomkhakha nezinhlaka. Ukuqondisa futhi ukweseka ukuhlelwa kwamabhide emisebenzi emiphakathi nakwonke amaphurovhinsi. Ukuxhumana namaphurovhinsi ngeNational HRH Strategy ngokweseka ukuphothulwa kwayo noma ukuthuthukiswa kwayo. Ukuqondisa futhi ukweseka izinkumbulo, amawokshophu nezinkulumo kwabashayingi. Ukugcina amandu okuhlela amabhide eSADC HRH nakuzo zonke izinga zenhlelo yezempilo. Ukuthuthukisa indawo yolwazi lokuhlela amabhide eSADC HRH kanye nezinsiza zenhlelo yezempilo. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi ahlose ukuqinisekisa ukulungele nokutholakala kweSADC HRH ngokulungelelwa izimosi eziphuthumayo. Ukubuka ukusetshenziswa kwohlelo lweSADC HRH lokulungelelwa iziphazamulo/izimo eziphuthumayo okufaka ukuchuma kwamandla nezendlela zokusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokuqhubeka nomsebenzi. Ukuphatha isikhundla esingaphansi. Ukuphatha izinsiza (imali nabantu) ezinikezwe isikhundla esingaphansi, okufaka ukuhlela imali nokuqamba abantu. Ukulungisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zamabhuku emibiko, amadokhumenti ezinkulumo, amagama okuthandwayo njll njengoba kudingeka ngomsebenzi wesikhundla esingaphansi.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 kunye nefomali yeNQF 7 kwiMpilo / izeNzululwazi zezeNtlalo. Ifomali yamamaster eNQF 8 kwelinye icala iya kuba luncedo. Kennis van primêre gesondheidsorg en landelike diensbestuur, gemeenskapsgesondheidswerkerprogram, opleidings- en ontwikkelingsregulasies en gesondheidsbevorderingsstrategieë. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) en inligtingsbestuur, leierskap en bestuur, projekbestuur, probleemoplossing en besluitneming, beplanning, organisasie, interpersoonlike, analitiese, skakeling en koördinasie, aanbieding en fasilitering en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindezi, ngokuzimeleyo nakuba kuhlanganiswa imisebenzi namalungu eqembu kanye nokuthanda ukuhamba nokusebenza amahora angajwayelekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Kwenze futhi kuqinisiswe ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokuziqeqesha abasebenzi bezempilo emtshini. Siza ekwakheni, ekusetshenziseni, nasekuqapeleni izinhlelo zezempilo zomphakatha ezigxile ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yezempilo yomphakatha. Yenza amapholisi, hlaziya futhi ubuyekeze amapholisi namasiko okusebenza abasebenzi bezempilo emtshini adayo ngokuhambisana nomodeli yokwakhiwa kabusha kwezempilo yesisekelo. Sisa izifundazwe ngamaphulani ebhizinisi nezokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezempilo zomphakatha zihambisana namapholisi namasu wezempilo avela emphakathini wonke. Ngokuvamile hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi bezempilo emtshini, unikeze imibono futhi uthole izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwamapholisi namasiko we-HRH ahlose ekwenzeni kube lula ukufaka izigaba ezintsha zabasebenzi bezempilo ohlelweni lwezempilo. Saka futhi ugcine ubuhlobo nalabo abahlotshaniswe nabo ohlelweni, okuhlanganisa nokusaka isistimu yokuphatha ulwazi ngeqeqesho labasebenzi bezempilo emtshini. Ukuqapha nokuhlola imininingwane yezinhlelo zezempilo ngaphansi kwesikhungo esincane, kuhlola umphumela wazo emphakathini futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo kanye nenhloso izufeza.

xh.title: Umphathi oncedisayo: Abasebenzi beMpilo yomphakathi
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMongameli oncedisayo sokulawula iinkqubo zokuzimisela nabasebenzi bempilo yomphakathi nemimiselo kwiSebe leMpilo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Garde 12 nesanemba se-NQF 7 kwiSayense yeMpilo njengoko sivotiwe yi-SAQA. Isanemba sokuzimisela okanye ekuphuhliseni kuya kuba ngummiselo. Ubuncinane iiminyaka elishumi (10) yamava afanelekileyo kwimpilo yamaphandle njengoMphathi oncedisayo okanye inqanaba elinganayo. Ulwazi lolawulo lweempilo zamaphandle nesevisi yasezandeni, iinkqubo zemisebenzi yempilo yomphakathi, ukuzimisela nemimiselo yomthetho ekuphuhliseni, kunye namaqhinga okuquumba impilo. Ulwazi lokuziphatha (ngokuthetha nokubhalwayo) nolawulo lolwazi, ukulawula nokuhanjiswa, ulawulo lweprojekthi, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqamba iigqibo, iplani, uqhoqhoqho, ubomi bomntu, luhlaluhlu noqoqosho, nabalinganiswa nabambisana noyilo lwe-computer (i-MS Office package). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngcinezicinsi ngokutsha, uzibuse uqakatheke kwaye udibanise imisebenzi abanye abantu, kwaye ufuna ukusasaza kwaye usebenze kumawela alingananga.
xh.duties: Qhubeza kwaye uqinise ukuba kukho intshukumo nokuqikelelwa kohlelo lokuzimisela kwe basebenzi bempilo yomphakathi. Nceda ekwakheni, ekusebenziseni, nakumhalathazeni iinkqubo zempilo yomphakathi ezibhekise k ukuphucula iimpembelelo zempilo yomphakathi. Phezulu iimphatho, hlaluya kwaye uhlolis iimphatho nezikhokelo ezikhoyo zemisebenzi yempilo yomphakathi ngokwesixeko sangaphambi kobudlelwane phantsi kommandwe wokusingatha iinkqubo ezikwisiseko. Nceda iiphondo ngezicwangciso zeshishini nezokusetyenziswa. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zempilo yomphakathi zidibana nemimiselo kunye namacebiso oluntu iwezona. Ngokukhawuleza hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi bempilo yomphakathi, unike isilumkiso kwaye uchaze iindawo ezingaphuculwa. Lawula ukusebenza nokuqikelelwa kwemimiselo nezikhokelo ze-HRH ezijoliswe ekwenzeni lula ngokungeniswa kweeseti ezintsha zemisebenzi yempilo kwinkqubo yempilo. Misela kwaye ulondoloze ubudlelwane namalungu abathathi-nxaxheba, kuquka nemiselo yokulawula ulwazi ngokuzimisela kwabasebenzi bempilo yomphakathi. Qhapha kwaye uhlole iidata yeenkqubo zempilo ngaphantsi komqondo ongezantsi, ehlole imvela kumphakathi kwaye aqinisekise ukuba iinjongo neengqinisekiso zipunyelelwe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Administration
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Administration providing administrative support to a Chief Directorate within the Department of Health in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF 4) certificate and NQF 6 qualification in Management / Office Administration / Office Management/ Public Management / Public Administration / Business Management or Business Administration as recognized by SAQA. At least three (3) years’ experience in office administration and financial management at supervisory level. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act. Sound understanding of financial policies as guided by Treasury Regulations. Good communication (verbal and written), planning, organizing, interpersonal, problem solving and decision making, liaison and coordination, analytical, project management and computer skills (MS Office package). Ability to work independently and under pressure. Ability to co-ordinate with other units of the Department. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide administrative support to the Chief Directorate. Plan, organise and control administrative activities pertaining to the Chief Directorate. Manage the flow of documents within the Chief Directorate. Ensure efficient flow of information between the Chief Directorate and the entire department. Administer the finances of the Chief Directorate. Co-ordinate procurement activities and assist with MTEF submissions. Provide secretariat support to the Chief Directorate and National Human Resource Committee (NHRC). Ensure proper co-ordination of meetings and ensure timeous submission of minutes and agenda. Management of human and physical resources. Ensure proper control of leave records, asset register, procurement of assets/equipment etc.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria. 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Administrasie
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Administrasie wat administratiewe steun aan 'n Hoofdirektoraat binne die Department of Health in Pretoria verskaf.
af.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF 4)-sertifikaat en NQF 6-kwalifikasie in Management / Office Administration / Office Management/ Public Management / Public Administration / Business Management of Business Administration soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring in kantooradministrasie en finansiële bestuur op toesighoudende vlak. Kennis van die Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act. Deeglike begrip van finansiële beleide soos gelei deur Treasury Regulations. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), beplanning, organisering, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossing en besluitneming, skakeling en koördinasie, analitiese, projekbestuur en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Vermoë om met ander eenhede van die departement te koördineer. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe steun aan die Hoofdirektoraat. Beplan, organiseer en beheer administratiewe aktiwiteite met betrekking tot die Hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur die vloei van dokumente binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker doeltreffende vloei van inligting tussen die Hoofdirektoraat en die hele departement. Administreer die finansies van die Hoofdirektoraat. Koördineer verkrygingsaktiwiteite en help met MTEF-voorleggings. Verskaf sekretariële steun aan die Hoofdirektoraat en die National Human Resource Committee (NHRC). Verseker behoorlike koördinasie van vergaderings en verseer tydige voorlegging van notules en agenda. Bestuur van menslike en fisiese hulpbronne. Verseker behoorlike beheer van verlofrekords, bate-register, verkryging van bates/toerusting ens.

Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (3) yokuhlola emkhwabeni wokuphathwa kwe-ofisi kanye nokuphathwa kwemali kwenqanaba lokuphatha. Ulwazi ngeHlelo LoMthetho Wezinsiza Zomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wezinsiza Zomphakathi. Ukuqonda kahle ngemithetho yemali njengokuqondiswa yiHlelo LoMthetho Lesidlavela. Ukuxhumana kahle (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe), ukweluleka, ukuhlela, ubudlelwano nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuthatha izinqumo, ukuxhumana nokubambisana, ukuhlaziya, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye namakhono ekhompyutha (iphakheji le-MS Office). Ukukwazi ukusebenza kodwa futhi ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ukukwazi ukubambisana namanye amayunithi oMnyango. Ileyisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yokuphathwa kwiNgqalaselentaba Eyinhloko. Cwangcisa, hlela futhi ulawule imisebenzi yokuphathwa ehlobene neNgqalaselentaba Eyinhloko. Lawula ukugeleza kwamadokhumenti ngaphakathi kweNgqalaselentaba Eyinhloko. Qinisekisa ukugeleza okusebenza kahle kolwazile phakathi kweNgqalaselentaba Eyinhloko nayo yonke iminyango. Lawula imali yeNgqalaselentaba Eyinhloko. Hlela imisebenzi yokuthenga futhi usize ngokuhlawuliswa kweMTEF. Nikeza inkxaso yesikhungo sobhalisi kwiNgqalaselentaba Eyinhloko kanye neKomidi Lezinsiza Zabantu Ezingeni Lizwe (NHRC). Qinisekisa ukubambisana okulungile kwemihlangano futhi qinisekise ukuthunyelwa ngasikhathi saminethi nencwajana nhlebelele. Ukuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu nezinto ezingokomzimba. Qinisekisa ukulawula okulungile kwerekhodi lokuhamba, irekhodi lezimpahla, ukuthengwa kwezimpahla/izinto njll.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedo: uLawulo
xh.summary: Oncedo loLawulo: Umphathi oncedo lolawulo onikeza inkxaso yolawulo kuSikhokelo esiPhakamileyo ngaphakathi kwiSebe lezeMpilo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethda seGrade 12 (NQF 4) nengqeqesho yeNQF 6 kwiManagement / Office Administration / Office Management/ Public Management / Public Administration / Business Management okanye Business Administration njengoko kusamkelwe yiSAQA. Ubuncinane iiminyaka emithathu (3) yamavalolwazi kulawulo leofisi nolawulo lwezimali kwinqanaba labaphathi. Ulwazi ngeziMiso zeNkonzo zoLuntu noMthetho weNkonzo zoLuntu. Ukuqonda kakuhle iinkqubo zezimali njengoko kukhokelelwa ziMiso zeTreasury. Unxibelelwano olululo (oluthethwayo nolubhalwayo), ukucwangcisa, ukulungiselela, ubuni bomntu, ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo, unxibelelwano nokuqhagamshelwa, ukuhlalutya, ulawulo lweeprojekthi namakhono ekhompyutha (MS Office package). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza yedwa nangxweme. Ukuba nakho ukuqhagamshelana namanye amaqela esebe. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kuBaphathiswa baPhakamileyo. Cwangcisa, lungisa ulawulo kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yolawulo ehlobene noBaphathiswa baPhakamileyo. Lawula ukuhamba kwamaxwebhu ngaphakathi koBaphathiswa baPhakamileyo. Qinisekisa ukusasela kolwazi okusebenzayo phakathi koBaphathiswa baPhakamileyo nesebe lonke. Lawula iimali zeBaphathiswa baPhakamileyo. Qhoboshela imisebenzi yokuthenga kwaye uncede ngemiselwe yabucala iMTEF. Nika inkxaso yomlambo kuBaphathiswa baPhakamileyo neKomiti yeZabasebenzi ezingqukuva yeSizwe (NHRC). Qinisekisa uqhagamshelwano olululo lwemiqungu kwaye uqinisekise ukungeniswa kwexesha lemizuzu nemiba. Ulawulo lwemithombo yabantu nezinto ezibonwayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olululu lemivalo yokuphumla, irekhodi yezinto ezithengiweyo, ukuthengwa kwezinto/empahla njl.

af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat (NQF4) en Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Kantooradministrasie, Publieke Administrasie of Besigheidsadministrasie / Administrasie / Kantoorbestuur, Publieke Bestuur of Besigheidsbestuur. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak in die veld van Administrasie. Kennis van departementele prosedures met betrekking tot finansies en begroting. Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van tersaaklike voorskrifte en toepassing van menslike hulpbronne asook begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van die Wet op Openbare Finansies en Tesourie-regulasies, LOGIS- en PERSAL-stelsels. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), probleemoplossing, analitiese, beplanning, organisasie en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Beheer van dokumentasie binne die Direktoraat. Bestuur die posregister, ontvang, registreer en versprei dokumente aan die tersaaklike persone. Verseker die verwerking van telefoonnavrae. Administreer menslikehulpbronbestuursfunksies. Berei voorleggings voor oor vakante poste en die aanstelling van personeel. Reël onderhoudsessies. Onderhou verlofregister en verseker dat alle verlof geneem aangeteken en nagegaan word, en dat verlofaansoekvorms by Menslike Hulpbronne ingedien word vir vaslegging op PERSAL. Liasseer alle eenheiddokumente, verseker die veilige bewaring van inligting en dokumentasie. Verseker die reël van vergaderings, werkswinkels, funksies en akkommodasie en reis vir amptenare. Plas bestellings en administreer betalings vir werkswinkels, etes, konferensies en departementele vermaak. Liasseer met reisagentskappe vir navrae. zu.title: Senior Administrative Officer
zu.summary: Kudingeka inkokheli ephakeme yolawulo ePretoria ukulawula amadokhumenti, okubhaliswe kwi-mail registers, imibuzo yocingo, nemisebenzi yabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Health.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 (NQF4) kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF 6) kwi-Office Administration, Public Administration noma Business Administration / Administration / Office Management, Public Management noma Business Management. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhluhlela ezingeni lomphathi esikhundleni sokulawula enkundleni ye-Administration. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zomnyango ngemali kanye nokwenza ibhajethi. Ulwazi olujulile noluphathelene nemithetho ebalulekile kanye nokusetshenziswa kwabantu kanye nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho olawula inkonzo kahulumeni. Ulwazi lwe-Public finance Management Act kanye ne-Treasury Regulations, izimiso ze-LOGIS kanye ne-PERSAL. Izindlela ezinhle zokuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukuhlela umsebenzi kanye nezikhungo zekhompyutha (MS Office package). Isikhathi sokusebenza nosuku kanye namageza amakhulu elungile ukusebenza nosuku. Isitifikedi sokushayela esivunyiwe.
zu.duties: Ukulawula ukuthunyela kwamafa ethniki ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate. Uphatha irejista yeposi, ukuthola, ukubhalisa kanye nokusabalalisa amadokhumenti kubantu abafanele. Qinisekisa ukucutshungulwa kwemibuzo yocingo. Phatha imisebenzi yokulawula abasebenzi. Lungela izinhlelo ezithunywe ngamakhono avele nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi. Hlela izikhathi zezingxoxo. Gcina irejista yokuhlala ikhaya futhi qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaholide athathiwe abhalisiwe, ahlolwe, futhi amafomu okuhlala ekhaya ethunyelwe kwabasebenzi abantu ukuthi abhalise kwi-PERSAL. Phatha ibhajethi ye-Cluster. Hlela imibiko yokuqeda imali. Siza ekwabeleni ibhajethi imisebenzi ohlelweni lokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwenhlelo yokuqoqa amafayela. Faka wonke amadokhumenti eyunithi, qinisekisa ukuphephiswa kolwazi ncamashi namadokhumenti. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kwemihlangano, amakilasi, imisebenzi, indawo yokuhlala kanye nohambo lwemisebenzi. Ukubeka ama-odra futhi uphathe ukukhokhelwa kwamakilasi, ukuphatha ukudla, izinkhungo kanye nokuzidela komnyango. Xhumana namagensi ohamba ucelo ngemibuzo. Qinisekisa futhi uhlinze ngenkxaso yezimiso zokuqhuba i-Directorate. Qinisekisa ukubonezelwa okwanele kwezinto zokubhala ofisini ye-Chief Directorate. Hlela ukuthenga izinto zokubhala nezinto ezidayiswa ezenzululwazi zekhompyutha.

xh.title: Unonothile woMlawulo oPhakamileyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka uNonothile woMlawulo oPhakamileyo ePretoria ukulawula uxwebhu, amagazini eposti yefowuni, imibuzo yefowuni nemisebenzi yezabasebenzi kwisebe lezeMpilo.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi yeGrade 12 (NQF4) neDiploma yesiQonga (NQF 6) kuLawulo loBuchwephesha, kuLawulo likawonke-wonke okanye kuLawulo loShishino / uLawulo / uLawulo lweZiko, uLawulo likawonke-wonke okanye uLawulo loShishino. Ubuncinane eminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwinqanaba lobaphathi kwinkundla yoLawulo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yesebe ngeemali nejengethu. Ulwazi oluzolileyo nolujulileyo ngemigaqo ephathelene nayo nokusetyenziswa kwabasebenzi kanjalo nokuqonda inguquko yomthetho elawula inkonzo yawonke-wonke. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMfutshane yawonke-wonke nemiQatho yeTreasure, iinkqubo zeLOGIS nePERSAL. Amakhono amabalawulo (olwahlulo nolubhaliweyo), okusombulula iingxaki, okuhlola, okucwangcisa, okuqamba izinto nakomthombo wekhompyutha (isixhobo seMS Office). Ulawulo lokusebenza wedwa nakwindyikimba. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eseza kusebenza.
xh.duties: Ulawulo uxwebhu ngaphakathi kuDirekte. Ulawula igazini leposi, ukwamkela, ukubhalisa nokusasaza uxwebhu kubantu abahambelanayo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwemibuzo yefowuni. Lawula imisebenzi yabasebenzi. Lungiselela iingxelo ezithunyelwe kwizithuba ezize nokuqesha abasebenzi. Cwangcisa iinqanaba zemibuzo yabafaki-vakalashi. Phatha igazini elimala nelungeniselelo lokuba lonke icele lithathwa libhalisiwe, lihlolwe nakuba amafomu okuthatha icele athunyelwe kubasebenzi ukubhaliswa kwiPERSAL. Lawula ijengethu leQoqo. Hlenga iingxelo zoku-tyala. Nceda kwabelo ngejengethu kwimisebenzi kwicwangciso yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwendlela yokulondoloza iifayile. Faka zonke iifayile zeqoqo, qinisekisa ukhuseleko lwolwazi naxwebhu. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo lweeminyamiselwa, iinkalo zomsebenzi, imisebenzi, indawo yokuhlola nakuhamba ngokusesikweni. Beka iiodolo ulawule nentlawulo yeenkalo zomsebenzi, ukutya, iinkonzo zamabanga kagcisa nakuhlelo kwisebe. Thethathetha neenekampani zokuhamba ngeemibuzo. Qinisekisa unikezela ngenkxaso yemisebenzi kuDirekte. Qinisekisa ukunikwa okwaneleyo kwezixhobo zokubhala kwisebe leNjengele ophakamileyo. Qhoboshisa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zokubhala nezinto ezisetyenziswa kwikhompyutha.
