Ulwazi olusesikweni nangabanzima ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo nokusetyenziswa kwemisebenzi yabantu kanjalo nokuqonda inguquko yomthetho elawula iNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lweMalini kaRhulumente nokuLawulwa kwezezimali kweli qonga lomthetho njengoko kulindelekile kuwo. Iimfihlo ezisesikweni ngokudibana nazo, izisombululo ezinzima ezisesikweni ezisesikweni ezibalulekileyo kwinkonzo ebalulekileyo, ngamava, amandla okuhlawulela, inkxaso-mali enkulu, inkqubo yokusingathwa komsebenzi wakho, amandla okubhala izitshixo-magama kwelakho nalawo, njengoko nokufumanisa iinkqubo ezingaphantsi kobunkqubo ubhekise kubakho ulungelelwaniso olukhulu.

Igunya eligunyazisiweyo lokuguqula iNkqubo nguMthetho-siseko weRhulumente. Isiko, ixabiso leMali eNxwemeneyo, ingxelo-mali, kwaye ukulandela umthetho-siseko ovela kwiNkqubo yeBhanki iza kuvumela ukuba uqonde ukuba umsebenzi wakho xa kuthethwa ngoMthetho kaWonke-wonke wokuLawula iMalini wakho.
xh.duties: Ukulawula amaxwebhu ngaphakathi kweNyaniso eziNgunya. Ulungelele iinkqubo zomzila wamagumbi abaphathi abaphezulu eNyanisweni eziNgunya. Uyayilawula irejista yeposi, ukwamkela, ukubhalisa nokusasaza amaxwebhu kubantu abahambelana nawo. Qinisekisa ukuqhubwa kwemibuzo yefowuni. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo yemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Lungiselela izimiso ezimalunga neesithuba ezizezelweyo nokuqeswa kwabasebenzi. Cwangcisa iinkqubo zemibuzo yabafuna-basebenzi. Gcina irejista yamalungu ezikhundla ukuze zonke iintsuku ezithathiweyo zibhalwe, zihlolwe, ukuze iifomu zesicelo samalungu ezikhundla zithunyelwe kubasebenzi bokuzezelwa ukuba zibhalwe kwi-PERSAL. Lawula umthamo wemali weNyuso. Hlenga iingxelo zentswelu-buxhaxha. Nceda kwicala lokwaba umthamo wemali kumisebenzi kwindlela yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwendlela yokulondolozo iifayile. Faka onke amaxwebhu eqela, qinisekisa ukhuseleko lolwazi namaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso lweenkqubo, amawele, imisebenzi nendawo yokuhlala nohambo ngokusesikweni. Bekisa oodolo ulawule imihlawulo yeenkqubo, ukunikezela ukutya, iinkqubo zokuququzelela nokuhamba kunye nokuzonwabisa kwesebe. Xhumana nama-ejensi ahambo ngemibuzo. Qinisekisa kanjalo uncedo lwezomathuthu kuNyuso. Qinisekisa ukunikela kwane ngaphezulu ngesixhobo sokubhala kwindlu yophando eziNgunya. Hlanganisa ukuthenga izixhobo zokubhala nezinto ezisebenziswa khompyutha.

jobs.title: Physical Control Security Officer
jobs.summary: Physical Control Security Officer in Pretoria at the Department of Health, requiring Grade 12, a National Diploma in Security Management, PSIRA Grade A, and three years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate (NQF4) and National Diploma (NQF 6) qualification in Security Management/ Policing or Security Risk Management as recognized by SAQA. Grade A PSIRA certificates. At least three (3) years’ experience in security services. Supervisory experience will be an advantage. Knowledge of Minimum Information Security Standard and other departmental policies/guidelines and procedural. Knowledge of Financial Management for Managers and departmental computerized ordering system (LOGIS and Doctrack System). Knowledge of general investigation functions and security policy. Knowledge of contingency plan with regards to emergency. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993, Criminal Procedure Act and government legislation. Good communication (verbal and written), planning, organization, decision making, people management, investigation, presentation, interpersonal relations, conflict management and computer skills (MS Office package). Ability to work independently and under pressure, as well as in a team. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Conduct preliminary investigation before registering a file/case docket. Gather, verify, and coordinate information and documentation required for security investigations. Coordinate and liaise with internal and external stakeholders. Liaise with internal stakeholders on criminal cases, security breaches, losses, fraud, corruption, and misconduct within the Department. Coordinate and monitor operational and physical security. Maintain and safeguard confidential security files, reports, and case dockets in accordance with approved security protocols. Supervise the implementation of key control measures and ensure compliance with departmental key control procedures. Manage resources and audit queries. Creating of security registers for operational and physical security for access control measures. Administration of human resources matters and other tasks assigned by supervisor. Coordinate leave management processes and maintain leave plans for security personnel.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria. 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba

The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). af.title: Fisiese Beheer Sekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Fisiese Beheer Sekuriteitsbeampte in Pretoria by die Department of Health, wat Graad 12, 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sekuriteitsbestuur, PSIRA Graad A, en drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat (NQF4) en 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6)-kwalifikasie in Sekuriteitsbestuur/Polisiëring of Sekuriteitsrisikobestuur soos deur SAQA erken. Graad A PSIRA-sertifikate. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring in sekuriteitsdienste. Toesigervaring sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van Minimum Information Security Standard en ander departementele beleide/riglyne en prosedures. Kennis van Financial Management for Managers en die departementele rekenaargesteunde bestelsisteem (LOGIS en Doctrack System). Kennis van algemene ondersoekfunksies en sekuriteitsbeleid. Kennis van noodplan met betrekking tot noodgevalle. Kennis van Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993, Criminal Procedure Act en regeringswetgewing. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), beplanning, organisasie, besluitneming, mensebestuur, ondersoek, voorlegging, interpersoonlike verhoudings, konflikbestuur en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk, asook in 'n span. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Voer 'n voorlopige ondersoek uit voordat 'n lêer/saakdossier geregistreer word. Versamel, verifieer en koordineer inligting en dokumentasie wat vir sekuriteitsondersoeke benodig word. Koordineer en skakel met interne en externe belanghebbendes. Skakel met interne belanghebbendes oor kriminele sake, sekuriteitskending, verliese, bedrog, korrupsie en wangedrag binne die departement. Koordineer en monitor operasionele en fisiese sekuriteit. Onderhou en bewaar vertroulike sekuriteitslêers, verslae en saakdossiers in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde sekuriteitsprotokolle. Hou toesig oor die implementering van sleutelbeheermaatreëls en verseker nakoming van departementele sleutelbeheerprosedures. Bestuur hulpbronne en ouditvrae. Skep sekuriteitsregisters vir operasionele en fisiese sekuriteit vir toegangsbeheermaatreëls. Administrasie van menslike hulpbronne aangeleenthede en ander take wat deur die toesighouer toegewys word. Koordineer verlofbestuursprosesse en onderhou verlofplanne vir sekuriteitspersoneel.

zu.title: Inkokheli Yezokuphepha Eziphothile
zu.summary: Inkokheli Yezokuphepha Eziphothile ePretoria kumnyango wezempilo, idinga ibhodi lesibili, idiploma yezwe ezifundeni ezibalulekile ezokuphepha, isitifiketi se-PSIRA izinga A, kanye namayihloko amathathu wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nale ndima.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 (NQF4) kanye nediploma yezwe (NQF 6) ezifundeni eziyinhloko eziphothile ezokuphepha/ukuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho noma ukulawula ingozi yokuphepha njengoba evunyiwe yi-SAQA. Izitifiketi ze-PSIRA izinga A. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhlangenwe nakho kwesevisi yokuphepha. Olunye ukuqeqeshwa njengenkosikazi kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukwazi kwe-Minimum Information Security Standard kwezinye izinqubomgomo/iziqondiso zomnyango kanye nezinqubo. Ukwazi ngokuqasha izimali zabalulekile ezingaba ngamaphoyisa kwezinhlelo zomnyango ezibhalwa ngesikhathi esithile ngesiqu (i-LOGIS kanye nenhlelo ye-Doctrack). Ukwazi ngeqembu leminyuzo yemiyalelo yezokuphepha kwezinye izinqubomgomo ezifundwayo ezingaba ngamaphoyisa. Ukwazi ngomkhankaso wokubuyela emuva ngokuqinisekiswa kokuthi kutholakale isimo esibi ngesikhathi eside. Ukwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993, Criminal Procedure Act kanye nomthetho kahulumeni. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okwenziwayo nokubhaliwayo), ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa, ukwenza izinqumo, ukulawula abantu, ukuphenya, ukubonisa, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, ukupatha izinkinga kakhona namakhono wemfundiso yezezimali (i-MS Office package). Ukuthola umsebenzi ozenzakalelayo nakuba ngaphansi koxanduva, kanye nokusebenza kwindlu elibanzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Hlela isimo sokwamukela isikhathi eside nangaphambi kokubhala incwadi yesikhashana sokubhaliswa/ukubhaliswa. Hlola, qinisekisa, futhi uhlanganise ukwaziswa kanye namawebhusayithi adingekayo emibuzweni ekhoyo. Hlanganisa futhi uxhume abantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle. Xhumana nabantu abangaphakathi ngamacala obugebengu, ukushaywa kwezokuphepha, ukulahlekelwa, ukukhwabanisa, ukukhwabanisa, nokwenza okungalungile kumnyango. Hlanganisa futhi ulawule izokuphepha ezisebenzayo futhi eziphothile. Gcina kwaye uvikele amafayela ephiwayo ezokuphepha, imibiko, kanye namacala ngezenzo ezivunyiwe zezokuphepha. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinsimbi zokulawula ukuthintwa nokungathintwa futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwemithetho yomnyango ngokusetshe lzinsimbi. Lawula abantu kwaye uphenye imibuzo engangoyesikhashana. Dala amabhuku wokuphepha okusebenzayo kakhona futhi eziphothile ezokwenza izinsimbi zokulawula ukungena. Lawula izindaba zabantu kakhona kwezinye izikhathi ezibekiwe enkosi. Hlanganisa inqubo yokubuyela emuva kokuthi kubhalwe kakhona kwaye ugcine amapulani okubuyela emuva kubantu abazodwa.

xh.title: Umseci Wokhuseleko Wolawulo Lomzimba
xh.summary: Umseci Wokhuseleko Wolawulo Lomzimba ePretoria kwiSebe lezeMpi lo, ofuna ibhedi yeGraji 12, iDiploma yeSizwe kukuLawulwa koKhuseleko, i-PSIRA Graji A, namarhanimiswa eminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGraji 12 (NQF4) nengeni yediploma yesizwe (NQF 6) ekulawulwa kokhuseleko/ukupholisa okanye ekulawulwa ingozi yokhuseleko njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Iisatifikethi zeGraji A PSIRA. Ubuncinane bamava eminyaka emithathu (3) kwinkonzo yokhuseleko. Amava okulawula abanye kuya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi lweSimo esiPhantsi Esihleliweyololwazi kunye namanyathelo amaninzi emigaqo/inqibo nengqiqo yesebe. Ulwazi lokulawula imali yabaphathi kunye nendlela yoku-oda ngekhompyutha yesebe (i-LOGIS neDoctrack System). Ulwazi lomsebenzi jikelele wophando kunye nomgaqo wokhuseleko. Ulwazi lwendlela ezibekelwe iingxaki ngexa lezigqitho. Ulwazi loMthetho wezeMisebenzi noKhuseleko loLonwabo umthetho ka-85 ka-1993, uMthetho woNgeniso lweziPhengo nomthetho welawulo lwurhulumente. Amakhono amahle (okuthetha nokuwuthabatha), okucwangcisa, okulungiselela, okwenza izigqibo, okulawula abantu, wophando, lwethulo, lobudlelwane bomntu nomntu, lokulawula iingxabano namakhono ekhompyutha (i-MS Office package). Ulawulo lokusebenza kodwa nokuchanabuswa kwingcinezelo, nakwindlela yomntu nomntu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando lokuqala phambi kokuqulatha ifayili/ifayili yecalulo. Qokelela, qinisekisa, ulungelelanise ulwazi nemiqulu efunekayo kuphando lokhuseleko. Ulungelelanise uze uxhumane nabanikabelo bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Xhumana nabanikabelo bangaphakathi kwiimeko zobugebenga, iingohlazo zokhuseleko, iintsolo, ukukhohlakala, ukonakaliswa, nokuziphatha kabi ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Ulungelelanise uze ulawule ukhuseleko olusebenzayo nolomzimba. Zigcine uze zikhuselwe iifayili zoximotho zokhuseleko, iiripoti, neefayili ezicalulileyo ngokwemigaqo evunyiweyo yokhuseleko. Lawula ukuqalisezwa kwendlela zolawulo lokuqhaqha izitshixo uze uqinisekise ukuzithobela iinkqubo zolawulo lokuqhaqha izitshixo zesebe. Lawula abantu basebenzayo namaxesha okulawulwa ngabanye abantu. Yenza iirejista ezintsha zokhuseleko olusebenzayo nolomzimba ukuze kulawulwe indlela yokungena. Lawula izinto zabantu basebenza kule sebenziso yamagunya amanye anikelwe ngumlawuli welungiselelo lokuqaliswa, nokulungiselelwa kolawulo lokuqhaqha uluhlu lwemisebenzi ezisakuba ixesha elide uze ugcinwe uluhlu lwesikhathi sabantu basebenzela ukuqinisekisa ukuba balandela imithetho yolawulo lokuqhaqha izitshixo zesebe. Lawula iinkcukacha nempilo yabantu basebenzayo kule ngxoxo abanye abantu abanikezelwa ngumlawuli welungiselelo lwesikhathi sokuphumla abasebenzayo nabasebenzisa indlela yokungenela abantu balawula iinkonzo zokhuseleko ezahlukileyo.

af.title: Sekretaresse
af.summary: Sekretaresse wat ontvangs- en klerklike ondersteuning aan 'n bestuurder in die Department of Health, Pretoria, verskaf, waarvoor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat met tik- en kantooradministrasie-ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 (NQF 4) met tik as 'n vak of enige ander opleidingskursus/kwalifikasie wat die persoon in staat sal stel om die werk bevredigend te verrig. NQF 5 in Kantoorbestuur/Administrasie / Bestuursassistent en/of 'n Sekretariële Diploma sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis en ervaring in algemene kantoor- en voorsieningsadministrasie. Kennis en ervaring in Microsoft Office en kennis van departementele prosedures rakende finansies en begroting. Goeie telefoonetiket, rekenaarvaardigheid, organisatoriese en beplanning, basiese finansiële administrasie, 'n hoë vlak van betroubaarheid en goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling) vaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële/ontvangsteondersteuningsdiens aan die bestuurder: Neem telefoonoproepe aan en verwys oproepe na die regte rolspelers as dit nie vir die betrokke bestuurder bedoel is nie. Verskaf 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die bestuurder. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reëlreëlings te tref en kontroleer reëlings wanneer die betrokke dokumente ontvang word. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte/beleide en prosedures wat op sy/haar werkterrein van toepassing is. Bestudeer die betrokke openbare diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Unobhala ohlinzeka ngensekelo yomamukeli nemisebenzi yokubhala kumphathi Kumnoango Wezempilo, ePretoria, ofuna isitifikedi se-Grade 12 esinobungazi bokuthayipha nobugcwe bokuphatha ihhovisi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 (NQF 4) esinobukhayipha njengesifundo noma noma yiphi iphulasidi yokuhlolwa/izifundo ezokwenza umuntu akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwanelisayo. I-NQF 5 kokuPhatha Ihhovisi/Imbhalo / Ongezansi omphathi kwezokuphatha kanye nekhadi lesifundo se-Secretarial kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi loluhlu lwemisebenzi ejwayelekilekahhovisi nokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ulwazi lolwazi kokusebenza i-Microsoft office kanye nolwazi lwezinqubo zomnyango mayelana nezimali nokuhlela amabhajethi. Izenzo ezinhle zocingo ezingokomthetho, ukwazi ukusebenza ngosizo lwekhompyutha, ukuhlelwa nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwemali okuyisisekelo, izinga eliphezulu lokwethemba kanye nobugcwe obuhle bokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa).
zu.duties: Uhlinzeka ngensekelo yobhala/ yomamukeli kumphathi wesevisi: Wamukela izingcingo azithumelele abadlalwe-buhlobo abafanele uma kungeyona engenhlelwe kumphathi othintekayo. Uhlinzeka ngensekelo yokubhala kumphathi. Xhumana namawebhusayithi okuhamba ukulungiselela izinhlela zokuhamba futhi ahlole izinhlelo lapho itholakala imibhalo ephathelene nokuhamba. Agcine ukwazi ngemithetho/ izinqobo kanye nezinqobo ezibhekene nomsebenzi wakhe. Afunde imithetho yesevisi yomphakathi kanye nemithetho/ izinqobo zomnyango kanye namanye amabhali ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wayo uqondwe ngokufanele.

xh.title: Umsebenzi webhokhede
xh.summary: Umsebenzi webhokhede onika inkonzo yokwamkela nabantu nokwenza imisebenzi yofiko kwimenja kwisebe lezempilo, ePretoria, efuna iGrade 12 ngesatifikethi namava ekuthayipheni nakulawulo leofisi.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 (NQF 4) ekuthayiphini njengesihloko noma nawuphi na omnye ukhoso lwamava/ikwalifikheyshin equka ubomi emntwini ukuba akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwaneliseyo. I-NQF 5 kwilawulo leofisi/nakulawulo / ngenkonzana yabancedisi bemenja kwaye/okanye i-Secretarial Diploma iya kuba luncedvo. Ulwazi namava kulo lonke uofisi nakulawulo lokuqedelelwa koluhlu. Ulwazi namava kwiMicrosoft office nolwazi ngemigaqo yesebe ngemali nakwingqikitho yemali. Iimpawu ezilungileyo zocingo, ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha, ukuqamba nokuqamba, ulawulo olusuka kwisingaphambili semali, inqanaba eliphezulu lokuqinisekisa nobugcisa obulungileyo bokunxibelelana (elibhalwayo noluthethwayo).
xh.duties: Unikeza inkonzo yomsebenzi webhokhide/ yokwamkela abantu kumenja: Wamkela iicingo ezibizayo kwaye azidlulele kubantu abafanelekileyo ukuba azingenanga kumenja othintele. Unikeza inkonzo yofiko kumenja. Unxibelelane ne-agensi zohambo ukwenza ulungelelwaniso lohambo kwaye aqhubeke ulungelelwaniso xa amaxwebhu afunekayo efikelwe. Uhlala egqibe kakhulu ngeentsingiselo/ iingqikhitha nemigaqo esetyenziswa kwimizila yakhe/ yayo. Ufunda iintsingiselo/ iingqikhitha zendawo yoloncedo nesebe namaxwebhu amanye ukuqinisekisa ukuba isetyenziso sawo siqondwe kakuhle.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk (PRODUCTION)
jobs.summary: Supply Chain Clerk sought by the Department of Health in Pretoria to manage invoice payments, verify documents and load them onto ITS and LOGIS systems.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate (NQF4). National Diploma (NQF 6) qualification in Supply Chain Management/Logistics or Finance will be an advantage. Experience of at least one (1) year in working with payment of invoices will be an added advantage. Knowledge of governments supplier payment processes. Good communication (verbal and written) and computer skills (MS Office package). Able to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Preparation of documents for payment and loading them on ITS. Receive invoices from the Supervisor, date stamp date received, verify correctness and validity then load on ITS. Printing of approved invoices from ITS and ensuring that the invoices are captured on LOGIS. Immediately respond to any notifications that Line Functionaries confirmed delivery of goods or services relating to payments allocated. Capture payments on LOGIS. Verify the correctness of invoices approved against approvals and orders as well as bank details. Handle payment enquiries. Provide timely feedback to suppliers and or officials relating to the status of payments.
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria. 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise for SMS posts, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk (PRODUKSIE)
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Pretoria soek 'n voorsieningskettingklerk om fakturenbetalings te bestuur, dokumente te verifieer en op die ITS- en LOGIS-stelsels te laai.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat (NQF4). 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6)-kwalifikasie in Voorsieningskettingbestuur/Logistiek of Finansies sal 'n voordeel wees. Ervaring van ten minste een (1) jaar in die werk met betaling van fakture sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van regeringsverskaffers se betalingsprosesse. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) en rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office-pakket). In staat om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Voorbereiding van dokumente vir betaling en laai daarvan op ITS. Ontvang fakture van die toesighouer, datumstempel die ontvangsdatum, verifieer korrektheid en geldigheid en laai dan op ITS. Druk van goedgekeurde fakture vanaf ITS en verseker dat die fakture op LOGIS vasgelê word. Reageer onmiddellik op enige kennisgewings wat lynfunksionarisse bevestig dat gelewerde goedere of dienste in verband met toegewysde betalings ontvang is. Vang betalings op LOGIS vas. Verifieer die korrektheid van goedgekeurde fakture teen goedkeurings en bestellings asook bankbesonderhede. Hanteer betalingsnavrae. Versk tydelike terugvoer aan verskaffers en/of amptenare oor die status van betalings.

zu.title: Supply Chain Clerk (PRODUCTION)
zu.summary: I-Supply Chain Clerk iyifunwa uMnyango Wezempilo ePretoria ukuphatha ukukhokhelwa kwezifaki, ukuqinisekisa imibhalo bese kuyifaka kumasistemu e-ITS ne-LOGIS.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 (NQF4). I-National Diploma (NQF 6) kwi-Supply Chain Management/Logistics noma i-Finance izoba yinto ekusize. Ukuba namava okungenani unyaka owodwa (1) ekusebenzeni nokukhokha izifaki kuzoba yinto ekusize. Ukwazi izinqubo zokuhlinzela abahlinzeki zikahulumeni. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (elidlidlile neliyibhaliwe) namakhono ekhompyutha (i-MS Office package). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegcina.
zu.duties: Ukulungiselela imibhalo yokukhokhelwa kwayo ifakwe kwi-ITS. Ukuyamukula izifaki evela kwoMphathi, kufakwe usuku olubhalwe ngalo, kuqinisekiswe ukuzwakala nokusemthethweni bese kufakwa kwi-ITS. Ukuphrinta izifaki ezamukelekile eziye zavela kwi-ITS bese kuqinisekiswa ukuthi izifaki zifakiwe kwi-LOGIS. Ukuphendula ngokushesha noma yiziphi izaziso mayelana nokuthi oMphathi Bayiqinisekisile ukulethwa kwempahla noma izinsiza mayelana nokukhokhelwa okwabiwe. Ukufaka ukukhokhelwa kwi-LOGIS. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzwakala kwezifaki ezamukelekile kuma-approval nama-odayo kanye nemininingwane yebhange. Ukuphathwa kwemibuzo yokukhokhelwa. Ukunikeza umbiko oyesikhathi kubahlinzeki noma kubasebenzi mayelana nesimo sokukhokhelwa.

xh.title: Isiphathaedini se-Supply Chain (PRODUCTION)
xh.summary: Isebe loPhondo loLungiselelo lweMfundo eNgezantsi ePretoria lifuna uMlawuli we-Nqanaba lokuFana ne-6 kwi-Supply Chain Management/Logistics okanye eziMali ukuze alawule inkxaso-mali yee-invoisi, aqinisekise amaxwebhu alayishe kwi-ITS nephawu eLuxineneyo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi se-Grade 12 (NQF4). Isidanga seBanga leNqanaba (NQF 6) kwi-Supply Chain Management/Logistics okanye eziMali kuya kuba lusizi olukhulu. Amava afikelela kwelinye (1) umnyaka ekusebenzeni nentlawulo yamavesi esiya kuba lusizi olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zentlawulo yabahlinzeki kurhulumente. Amakhono amabaliselelisa (ngomlomo nangokubhalisa) nangamakhondo ekhompyutha (MS Office package). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Ulungelelanishwa kwamaxwebhu entlawulo nalayisha kwi-ITS. Ukufumana i-invoisi kumLawuli, ukuqhwesha umhla wokuwufumana, ukuqinisekisa ukuchanekileyo nokuqeleliswa ke ngoko ulayishe kwi-ITS. Ukushicilela i-invoisi ezivunyiweyo ezivela kwi-ITS kwaye uqinisekise ukuba i-invoisi zifakwe kwi-LOGIS. Ukuphendula ngoko nangoko naziphi na izaziso ezithi oMisebenzi beNqanaba baye bagqibezile ukufikelela kweempahla okanye iinkonzo eziquka iintlawulo ezabeliweyo. Ukufaka iintlawulo kwi-LOGIS. Ukuqinisekisa ukuchanekileyo kwee-invoisi ezivunyiweyo ngokumelene neemvume nalamanyathelo akwakhona iinkcukacha ze-bhanki. Ukupatha imibuzo yentlawulo. Ukunika iingxelo ngexesha elifanelekileyo abahlinzeki nabasebenzi ngeemo zentlawulo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Accounting
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Service
jobs.summary: Oversee financial reporting and accounting functions for a college in Malmesbury, requiring a degree in Financial Management and supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric / Grade 12 plus a recognised 4-years Degree (NQF Level 7) in Financial Management. Minimum of three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in Financial Management environment of which 3 years’ must be supervisory experience. A valid driver’s licence compulsory. Proficient in Microsoft Office. Completed articles will be advantageous. Knowledge and understanding of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); CET Act; Treasury Regulations; Public Service Regulations; Public Service Act and the National Student financial Aid Scheme and related legislation. Knowledge of Financial Management Systems. Strategic project management skills. Extensive knowledge of government decision-making and delegation of powers processes. Excellent computer software skills. Budget forecasting and management skills. Problem-solving and decision-making skills. Analytical thinking and report writing skills. Time management skills; Verbal and written communication skills. Presentation skills; Administration skills, decision-making skills, problem-solving. Ability to operate under pressure, highly motivated. Interpersonal skills. Supervisory skills.
jobs.duties: Coordinate, review, analyse and quality assure the financial information for planning purposes. Oversee financial reporting for the college and support the Deputy Principal: Finance with regards to the compilation of Annual Financial Statements and Monthly Reports. Review monthly reconciliations and perform financial reporting duties to internal and external parties. Support the Deputy Principal: Finance with the compilation of quarterly reports to Council. Monitor the internal controls in the Finance Division and ensure adherence to controls throughout the college. Liaise with internal and external auditors and provide access to documentation. Support the Deputy Principal: Finance in the management of the units within the Finance Department. Assist the Deputy Principal: Finance in ensuring self-sustainability, proper accounting records and daily accounting discipline among staff. Ensure effective supervision of staff for efficient financial accounting services. Develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning.
jobs.applications: Please log on to www.westcoastcollege.co.za register and apply online
jobs.notes: Please click on the vacancies tab, fully complete the online Z83 application form, and attach a recently updated detailed CV with (years of experience, the start and the end date, the duties and three contactable references with email addresses for the previous and current employers). Failure to sign, date and not fully complete the Z83 form will result in your application not being considered. Applicants must submit Z83 and CV only, all other documents / proof will be submitted by shortlisted candidates. A separate application must be submitted for each post for which you are applying. Late applications (received after the closing date and time) will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other relevant documents to College Human Resources Management Administration Unit on or before the day of the interview. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The employer is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender, and disability) in the Department through the filling of the post(s) with a candidate whose appointment will promote representatively in line with the numerical targets as contained in our Employment Equity Plan. The Employer reserves the right not to make an appointment, to withdraw, and / or amend the adverts for the post(s) and retains the right not to fill the posts as determined by the Director - General or the delegated authority. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills test. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates. All short- listed candidates will be subjected to a qualifications and citizen verification; criminal record and financial/asset record checks. Applicants who have not been invited for an interview within 60 days of the closing date should consider their application unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde
af.summary: Oorsien finansiële verslagdoening en rekeningkundige funksies vir 'n kollege in Malmesbury, wat 'n graad in Finansiële Bestuur en toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek / Graad 12 plus 'n erkende 4-jarige Graad (NQF Level 7) in Finansiële Bestuur. Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in 'n Finansiële Bestuursomgewing waarvan 3 jaar toesigervaring moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie is verpligtend. Bevoeg in Microsoft Office. Voltooide artikels sal voordelig wees. Kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); CET Act; Treasury Regulations; Public Service Regulations; Public Service Act en die National Student financial Aid Scheme en verwante wetgewing. Kennis van Finansiële Bestuurstelsels. Strategiese projekbestuursvaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van regeringsbesluitneming en magtigingsprosesse. Uitstekende rekenaarprogramvaardighede. Begrotingsvoorspellings- en bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Analitiese denkwyses en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Tydbestuursvaardighede; mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Voorleggingsvaardighede; administratiewe vaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede, probleemoplossing. Vermoe om onder druk te funksioneer, hoogs gemotiveerd. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Toesigervaardighede.
af.duties: Koördineer, hersien, analiseer en verseker die gehalte van die finansiële inligting vir beplanningsdoeleindes. Oorsien finansiële verslagdoening vir die kollege en ondersteun die Adjunkhoof: Finansies met betrekking tot die opstel van Jaarlikse Finansiële State en Maandelikse Verslae. Hersien maandelikse afstemmings en voer finansiële verslagdoeningspligte uit aan interne en eksterne partye. Ondersteun die Adjunkhoof: Finansies met die opstel van kwartaalverslae aan die Raad. Monitor die interne kontroles in die Finansiesafdeling en verseker nakoming van kontroles regdeur die kollege. Skakel met interne en eksterne ouditeure en verskaf toegang tot dokumentasie. Ondersteun die Adjunkhoof: Finansies met die bestuur van die eenhede binne die Finansies-departement. Bystand verleen aan die Adjunkhoof: Finansies om selfvolhoubaarheid, behoorlike rekeningkundige rekords en daaglikse rekeningkundige dissipline onder personeel te verseker. Verseker effektiewe toesig oor personeel vir doeltreffende finansiële rekeningkundige dienste. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werksisteme en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker.

zu.title: Onozane wePhini: Izinkamelo zeZimali
zu.summary: Qapha ukubika ngezimali kanye nemisebenzi yezinkamelo kuleso sikhungo eMalmesbury, sidinga idigri ekuPhathweni kweZimali namava okugada.
zu.requirements: Ikhuledi lesi-12 kanye ne-Digri yeminyaka emine (4) evunyiwe (NQF Level 7) ekuPhathweni kweZimali. Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (3) kuya kwayisihlanu (5) yamava ekuPhathweni kweZimali lapho iminyaka emithathu (3) kumele ibe ngamava okugada. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe iyaphothula. Ukusebenzisana kakhulu ku-Microsoft Office. Ukugcina izinkamelo kuyoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); umthetho we-CET Act; imithetho ye-Treasury Regulations; imithetho ye-Public Service Regulations; umthetho we-Public Service Act kanye ne-National Student financial Aid Scheme kanye nomthetho ohlobene nawo. Ulwazi ngamaphethini okuphatha izimali. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekhi asendleleni eqhubekayo. Ulwazi olwandisiwe ngokuqondisa kwezinqumo zahulumedu nokuqhuba amandla. Amakhono ohlelo lokusebenza ngesiqaikundo. Amakhono okubikeka kanye nokuqondisa kwezimali. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuqondisa izinqumo. Amakhono okucabanga ngesimo sangempela kanye nokubhala amabiko. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi; Amakhono okuxoxa nokuqamba. Amakhono okuyalela; Amakhono okuphatha, amakhono okwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono elikhulu lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxulu, ukuzimisela kakhulu. Amakhono okusebenzisana nabantu. Amakhono okugada abantu.
zu.duties: Hlela, hlola, hlaziya futhi qinisekisa izinga lolwazi lwezimali ngenjongo yokuhlela. Qapha ukubika okusezimali kwesikole futhi useke oMveledeli wePhini: Izimali ngokuphathelene nokulungiselela izinkulumo zeZimali Zonyaka namabiko Aanyangazonke. Hlola ukuvumelana kanyangazonke futhi wenze imisebenzi yokuvela amabiko ezimali kwabangaphakathi nangaphandle. Useke oMveledeli wePhinyi: Izimali ekulungiseleleni amabiko akoNyaka nezinyanga ezintathu ezeNdvuna yePhiko. Qapha izilawuli zangaphakathi ePhakameni lezeZimali futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kwesilawuli kuyo yonke indawo yesikole. Xhumana nabahloli bangaphakathi nangaphandle futhi unikeze ukufinyelela kumadokhumenti. Useke oMveledeli wePhinyi: Izimali ekuphatweni kwamayunithi aphakathi kwabasebenzi bezeZimali. Siza oMveledeli wePhinyi: Izimali ekuqinisekiseni ukuzimela, ukugcinwa kwezinkamelo ezifanele zezimali nokuqinisekiswa kokuzithiba kwezimali ngokwansuku zonke phakathi kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okusebenzayo kwabasebenzi ukuze kunikezwe izinsiza ezisebenzayo zezimali. Linganisa, yenza futhi ulawule imithetho yomsebenzi futhi uhlole izinqubo ukuze kutholwe ukusebenza okulungile nezinzuzo.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: I-Financial Accounting
xh.summary: Qhoboshela iinkqubo zokwenza ingxelo ngeemali kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yohlelo lokubala kule kholishi eMalmesbury, kufuneka ube negunya kwi-Financial Management nabanq能力i bokulawula abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-Matric / Grade 12 negunya eliqapheliweyo le-Degree yeminyaka esi-4 (NQF Level 7) kwi-Financial Management. Amava angaphezulu kweyimini ithathu (3) ukuya kwihlanu (5) nonyaka kwindawo ye-Financial Management apho iminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe ngamava okulawula abantu. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba eloqinisiweyo yinyanzeliso. Ukuba buhle kwi-Microsoft Office. Ukuqeda i-articles kuya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); i-CET Act; i-Treasury Regulations; i-Public Service Regulations; i-Public Service Act nase-National Student financial Aid Scheme nolunye ulwango-mthetho. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwe-Financial Management Systems. Amakhono abakho-mthetho obuqu. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeenqobo-zenzo zokwenza izigqibo kolawulo kangangobukhosi bukaRhulumente. Amakhono amninzi okusebenzisa isoftware yekhompyutha. Amakhono okubika ngemali kwaye ukuqikelela. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Amakhono okucinga ngokuthe ngqo nokubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okulawula ixesha; amakhono okuthetha nokubhala. Amakhono okubonisa; amakhono bokulawula, amakhono okwenza izigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengxaki, ukuzithembisa ngakumbi. Amakhono abantu. Amakhono okulawula abasebenzi.
xh.duties: Lungisa, phinda uhlole, uhlalutye uze uqinisekise umgangatho walula ulwazi ngeemali ngenjongo zokuca. Qhoboshela ukwenza iingxelo ngeemali zale kholishi ze uncedise i-Deputy Principal: Finance ngakumbi ngokulungiselela i-Ngonyaka i-Financial Statements ne-Zinyanga iingxelo. Phinda uhllole izibitzekwiso zenyangaj ngokwayo uzenze imisebenzi yokwenza iingxelo ngeemali kubantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ndiza uncedise i-Deputy Principal: Finance ngokusungula iinkcazelo zenye ngenyanga ngqo kwi-Council. Qhoboshela iindawo zolawulo ngaphakathi kwe-Finance Division kuze uqinisekise ukuthobela iindawo zolawulo kulo onke amakhalishi. Thetha nabakhipha-ngxelo bangaphakathi nangaphandle unikele inzela kumaxwebhu. Ndiza uncedise i-Deputy Principal: Finance ngokulawula amacandlo angaphakathi kwe-Finance Department. Ncedisa i-Deputy Principal: Finance ekuqinisekiseni ukuzigcinela nokuzincedisa, ukubhala iirekhodi zentsimbi zomhlaba ngamhla ngamhla kubasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukulawula abasebenzi abaqinileyo ekuze kube khona iinkonzo zokubala ngeemali. Phezulu, seta uze ulawule iinkqubo zendawo yokusebenza ukuya qinisekisa isebenza ngokukhawuleza ngokukhawuleza nokuze.

jobs.title: Human Resources Management and Development
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Service
jobs.summary: Oversee human resource management and administration services at the central office in Malmesbury, including conditions of service, recruitment, and selection processes.
jobs.requirements: Matric /Grade 12 plus a recognised 3- years’ National Diploma in Human Resources Management or a 4 - years’ Degree. A minimum of 5 years in Human Resource Management environment of which three (03) years should be management experience. A Post Degree qualification will be an added advantage. PERSAL Certificates. Proof of computer literacy & qualifications in MS Software applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook. Proof of current and previous work experience endorsed by Human Resource (Not certificate of service). Valid Driver’s license. Knowledge of Public Services legislations and policies related to Human Resource Management. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/ CET Administration. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. Knowledge of PERSAL and Job Evaluation. In-depth knowledge of BCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, employee wellness and benefits. Excellent understanding of HR Risk and Compliance Knowledge of CCMA/Labour Court/Bargaining processes.
jobs.duties: Oversee Human Resource Management and Administration services - Render conditions of services (Leave, Housing, Medical, Injury on duty, Long service recognition, overtime, relocation, pensions, transfers, allowances etc.); Oversee the recruitment and selection processes as per departmental delegation (advert, shortlisting, interviews, security vetting, competency test, reference check, verification of qualifications) are coordinated within the stipulated timelines); Management of HR Personnel records. Oversee Human Resource Development services - Render Bursaries administration; Render Internship and Work Integrated Learning (WIL); Conduct Induction; Coordinate and facilitate the Training interventions. Develop and implement Workplace Skills Plan (WSP); Administration of Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) and Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Coordinate and facilitate Organizational Development, services - Coordinate the design, review and implementation of the college organizational structure; Facilitate the development of Job Descriptions; Coordinate the Job Evaluation of posts/jobs and submit to Head Office; Conduct work-study and business process re-engineering; Facilitate change management and organizational transformation services. Coordinate and facilitate Human Resource Planning (HRP) and Employment Equity (EE) services - Coordinate, develop, review, implement and monitor the college HR plan; Submit college HR plan to Regional and Head Office for integration of the departmental plan; Coordinate, develop, review, implement and monitor the college EE plan; Submit college EE plan to Regional and Head Office for integration of the departmental plan; Employment Equity (EE) data for submission to Regional and Head Office; Ensure the implementation of HR and EE Plan. Provide Employee Health and Wellness (EHW) services - Implement wellness programmes and service for the college; Coordinate and manage HIV, AIDS, STI and TB services; Coordinate and manage health productivity programmes; Implement health and safety working environment programmes; Promotion of sport activities to encourage physical fitness and healthy lifestyle. Develop and implement Human Resource policies and manuals. Management of all Human, Financial, and other resources of the unit. Advanced skill: Administrative; Planning and organising; Financial management; Report writing, Communication and interpersonal; Problem solving; Computer literacy; Analytical; Client oriented; Project management; Team leadership; People management. Labour Relations Management - Provide advisory services on all employee relations policies, procedures, strategies, agreements, and legislation. Conduct daily employee relations operations specifically in the areas of disciplinary hearing, grievances, absenteeism, performance improvement and collective bargaining; Partner with management in driving fair labour relations within the business Represent the company in dispute resolution process including mediation, arbitration and negotiation; Partner with management in driving fair labour relations within the business Values/ attributes - Client service focus; Integrity; Committed; Proactive and loyal.

af.title: Bestuur en Ontwikkeling van Menslike Hulpbronne
af.summary: Oorsig oor menslikehulpbronbestuur en -administrasiedienste by die sentrale kantoor in Malmesbury, insluitend diensvoorwaardes, werwing en keuringsprosesse.
af.requirements: Matric /Graad 12 plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n 4-jaar Graad. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing waarvan drie (03) jaar bestuurservaring moet wees. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. PERSAL-sertifikate. Bewys van rekenaargeletterdheid en kwalifikasies in MS-sagtewaretoepassings soos Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook. Bewys van huidige en vorige werkervaring wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne bekragtig is (nie dienssertifikaat nie). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van openbare dienste-wetgewing en beleide wat verband hou met Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie. Kennis en begrip van die hoër-onderwyssektor. Kennis van PERSAL en Werk Evaluering. Diepgaande kennis van BCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, werknemerwelstand en voordele. Uitstekende begrip van HR-risiko en -nakoming. Kennis van CCMA/Arbeidshof/onderhandelingsprosesse.
af.duties: Oorsig oor Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en -administrasiedienste - Lewer diensvoorwaardes (Verlof, Behuising, Medies, Besering op diens, Langdienserkenning, oortyd, hervestiging, pensioene, oorplasings, toelaes, ens.); Oorsig oor die werwing en keuringsprosesse volgens departementele delegasie (advertensie, kortlyssaking, onderhoude, veiligheidskontrole, bevoegdheidstoets, verwysingsnavorsing, verifikasie van kwalifikasies word binne die voorgeskryfde tydlyne gekoördineer); Bestuur van HR-personeelrekords. Oorsig oor Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsdienste - Lewer Beursadministrasie; Lewer Internskap en Werk Geïntegreerde Leer (WGL); Voer induksie uit; Koördineer en fasiliteer die opleidingsintervensies. Ontwikkel en implementeer Werkplekvaardigheidsplan (WVP); Administrasie van Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsels (PBOTS) en Geïntegreerde Kwaliteitsbestuurstelsel (GKBS). Koördineer en fasiliteer Organisasie-ontwikkelingsdienste - Koördineer die ontwerp, hersiening en implementering van die kollege se organisasiestruktuur; Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van Werksbeskrywings; Koördineer die Werk Evaluering van poste/werk en dien in by Hoofkantoor; Voer werkstudie en besigheidsproses-herontwerp uit; Fasiliteer veranderingbestuur en organisasietransformasiedienste. Koördineer en fasiliteer Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning (MHB) en Indiensnemegelykheid (IE) -dienste - Koördineer, ontwikkel, hersien, implementeer en monitor die kollege se HR-plan; Dien die kollege se HR-plan by Streeks- en Hoofkantoor in vir integrasie van die departementele plan; Koördineer, ontwikkel, hersien, implementeer en monitor die kollege se IE-plan; Dien die kollege se IE-plan by Streeks- en Hoofkantoor in vir integrasie van die departementele plan; Indiensnemegelykheid (IE) -data vir voorlegging aan Streeks- en Hoofkantoor; Verseker die implementering van die HR- en IE-plan. Verskaf Werknemergezondheid en -welstand (EHW) -dienste - Implementeer welstandsprogramme en -dienste vir die kollege; Koördineer en bestuur MIV-, VIGS-, SOI en TB-dienste; Koördineer en bestuur gesondheidsproduktiwiteitsprogramme; Implementeer gesondheids- en veiligheidsprogramme vir die werksomgewing; Bevorder sportaktiwiteite om fisiese fiksheid en 'n gesonde lewenstyl aan te moedig. Ontwikkel en implementeer Menslike Hulpbronbeleide en -handleidings. Bestuur van alle Menslike, Finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid. Gevorderde vaardigheid: Administratief; Beplanning en organisering; Finansiële bestuur; Verslagskrywing, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik; Probleemoplossing; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Analities; Kliëntgerig; Projebestuur; Spanleierskap; Mensebestuur. Arbeidsverhoudingsbestuur - Verskaf adviesdienste oor alle werknemerverhoudingsbeleid, prosedures, strategieë, ooreenkomste en wetgewing. Voer daaglikse werknemerverhoudingsbedrywighede uit spesifiek in die areas van disiplinêre verhore, griewe, afwesigheid, prestasieverbetering en kollektiewe onderhandeling; Werk saam met bestuur om billike arbeidsverhoudings binne die besigheid te bevorder. Verteenwoordig die maatskappy in geskilleoplossingsprosesse insluitend bemiddeling, arbitrasie en onderhandeling; Werk saam met bestuur om billike arbeidsverhoudings binne die besigheid te bevorder. Waardes/kenmerke - Kliëntediensfokus; Integriteit; Toegewyd; Proaktief en lojaal.

zu.title: Iqondo Lesephulelo Lezinsizakalo
zu.summary: Lawula ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu nobuholo besikhungo esikhulu eMalmesbury, kuhlanganise izimo zesevisi, ukuqasha, namaqapho okukhethwa.
zu.requirements: Ithesis yabafundi /Iqatha lesi-12 in enye idiploma yezwe leminyaka emi-3 kuLawulo Lezinsizakalo zabaNtu noma idigri yeminyaka emi-4. Umkhulu weminyaka engu-5 esiLabathini eLawulo Lezinsizakalo zabaNtu okumaphakathi kwayo eminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe ngokuhola. Ikwazi ukuba ngamva kokuqwalaselwa nengeni kwidigri iya kuba ngumsizi. Amagama okuqinisekisa i-PERSAL. Iqinisekiso lokwazi isiphath sakhiwa somsakazo kwiinkqubo zohlelo lwe-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Iqinisekiso lobomi bakho ngokuqhuba isakhono kwiishishini ezizeleko eRhuman Resources esisiseko (Akuyona isatifikhe yesevisi). Ifayili yokushaywa ibhaso etlolwe igama lemishini yephondo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinhlu esisebenza ngayo eposi yezinsizakalo zabantu. Ukuzwisiswa kwabakho empuzi edibeneyo yase-TVET/CET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngesiphitha sesiya seMfundo ePhakamileyo. Ulwazi nge-PERSAL noQwalaselo lomSebenzi. Ulwazi olujulileyo nge-BCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, impilo yabasebenzi nemisuzi. Ukuqonda nge- HR Risk kwiNkqubo zeSiseko yonke kwaye ulwazi ngendlela i-CCMA/inkundla yezibaso/iBargaining iokuziphatha.
zu.duties: Lawula iziCandelo zokuLawula iziNsiza zabaNtu nemisebenzi ngokubanzi - Hlinzeka ngemiTha yesiVisi (iHolo, amagumbi obomi, iziko lezempilo, ekuhalalelweni esibangweni, indlela yokuqashwa kovu olude, inkqubo yokuziphilisa, ukutshintshela, iPension, kokuNika izinhlaka, namagama esimilo okunye); Lawula iinkqubo ezokwaziwa nokukhethwa ngokomthetho wezabe lephondo (nokuthumela amagama, nokuqokelela amagama, nokubekwa kwamagama, nokuvakatshwa ngokwemfihlo, nokuhlolwa kwesiCazela, nekheshelo yamagama evisi, nokuqinisekiswa kwesiNgqishelo) akhiwa kwisithuba esihleliweyo esithathiweyo; Lawulwa kwezixa zoxhathu lwabaNtu. Lawula iinkonzo zokuNika imiTha yemfundo - Hlinzeka ngomlawulo wezibhalo ezinkonza ngokufunda; Lawula iinkonzo ze-Internship nomfundo oNxibelelanayo noBunyazi (WIL); Qhutywa kokungeniswa koluse; Lungelelanisa nokhokela amanyathelo oLolunye. Bhala alandele inYukhumentu yoBunyazi bokusebenza eLizwini (WSP); Umlawulo wokuSebenza ngokulingene noMqulu waWokutwa noNtsimbi (PMDS) noMqulu oNtsimbi weQhinga elilodwa leSizima (IQMS). Lungelelanisa nokhokela iziCandelo ezilwandle ezikude kwisiSebe, iziCandelo - Lungelelanisa inyaniyento, ukulungiswa, ukusebenzisa nokusika kwesakhiwo esingamagqeba sasekolishi; Yenza iNkqubo yeNyathelo lokutholakala ngokulunga kolunye; Lungelelanisa uQwalaselo lokuQhutywa ngokwamalungu ngokuThathwa kwesiGqeba esileKolishi uze udlulise eNtla naKwisebe leMveliso eliyisiQhobo soMnyango; Yenza imiswe nokuQwalasela imiswe yohlahlo lwemisebenzi emini; Lungelelanisa uQwalaselo lokuQhutywa ngokwamalungu abantu; Lungelelanisa, bhala, qwalasela, sebenzisa ulawule inqaku ye-HR yekolishi; Nikela ngenqaku ye-HR yekolishi esifundazimeni nakwiOfisi eNtla ukuze kuhlanganiswe inqaku yomnyango; Lungelelanisa, bhala, qwalasela, sebenzisa ulawule inqaku ye-EE yekolishi; Nikela ngenqaku ye-EE yekolishi esifundazimeni nakwiOfisi eNtla ukuze kuhlanganiswe inqaku yomnyango; Ulwazi lwe-Employment Equity (EE) lokunika esifundazimeni nakwiOfisi eNtla; Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwenqaku ye-HR ne-EE. Nikeza ngezenzo eziphila ngokuphila (EHW) - Hlela amaqaphelo obuNene bokuPhephela nokuba Nempilo nakolishi; Lungelelanisa ulawule iziCandelo ze-HIV, i-AIDS, i-STI ne-TB; Lungelelanisa ulawule iinkqubo zokuSebenza ngokuPhepha; Hlela amaqaphelo okuPhepha nokuphepha kwendlela yokusebenzisa ngaphandle; Phakamisa imigcisto yemitambo ukukhuthaza ukuPhepha ngokuthi nempilo emnandi. Bhala alandela iNkqubo iNchambelo yeziCandelo zabaNtu. UkuLawulwa kolunye uBunyazi, iziXhobo, nokuqwalaselwa kwezinye iziNsiza zesiqendo. Amakhono aphezulu: EzaNtlalo; uHlelo nokuHlelanga; uLawulo lweziNxukenkxabo; uBhalo lweNkqubo, uNxibelelwano noNxibelelanano nabantu; uKuQondiswa kolunye; uKwazi isihlathi sesiKhadi lokuNcwadi; uQhakqo olucuthwa ngokulingene; uKuKhuthazwa ngoMthengi; uLawulo lweProje; uKulawula iqhikixha laphakade; uLawulo bantu. UkuLawulwa kolunye uQhikixha oBomvu - Nikeza ngamacebiso kuzo zonke iNqaku, inqubo, isikhalo, isivumelwano, nokuQondiswa kolunye. Hlela iNkqubo yamalungu yonke imihla ngokukodwa kwindawo yeNqumbo nokuZaliswa kolunye, iNkcazelo ekuKhutshwa okungalunganga, ukungabikho, ukuQondiswa kolunye nokuxova ngokuhlohlo; Dibanisa nokuLawula ngokusizika kolunye olubafuyiweyo phakathi kolunye okufunwa, qamba eqhikixha ibe ngumalathisa olubhukha ngokungalunganga ngokubakho kwamalungu eqhikixha ekuBhaliseni ngokomthetho; Seta izinketho ngokusetyenziswa komkhosi wokuSombulula imikrokro nokubukana, ukubukana nokuxoxa nokukhupha inkinga; Dibanisa nokuLawula ngokusizika kolunye olubafuyiweyo phakathi kolunye okufunwa, qamba eqhikixha ibe ngumalathisa olubhukha ngokungalunganga ngokubakho kwamalungu eqhikixha ekuBhaliseni ngokomthetho - uKulandela kolunye; ukuzinza; ukuQhathanisa; ukusebenza ngaphandle kwamathandabuzo.

xh.title: Ukulawula nokuPhuhlisa iZabasebenzi
xh.summary: Ukuqonda iziseko ezikulawuleni abasebenzi nesebe lokulawula kwindlu yamagunya eMalmesbury, kuquka iimeko zokusebenza, inkqubo yokuba ngabasebenzi, kunye nokukhetha abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-Matric/Grade 12 ngediploma yezwe eqaqobelekileyo yeminyaka emi-3 kwi-Human Resources Management okanye idigra yeminyaka emi-4. Amava angu-5 ubuncinane kwindawo yokulawula abasebenzi, apho kweminyaka mithathu (03) kufuneka ibe ngamava okulawula. Iqwalaselo ye-Post Degree kuya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Iifom ze-PERSAL. Ibesedwa yokukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nangabaguquli kumacandelo e-MS Software anje nge-Word, Excel, PowerPoint no-Outlook. Ibesedwa yamava aziko kunye nawangaphambili okusebenza egunyazwe ngabasebenzi (Hayi isatifikethi somsebenzi). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemithetho kunye namagqabantshintshi ezeNkonzo yaZwezelisayo ahlobene noLawulo lwabaBasebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuyilwa kwe-TVET/CET. Ulwazi nokuqonda le candelo leMfundo ePhakamileyo. Ulwazi nge-PERSAL nokuQwalasela uMsebenzi. Ulwazi olunzulu nge-BCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, impilo yabasebenzi nezibonelelo. Ukuqonda kakuhle ngeengozi ze-HR nokuhambelana nemithetho. Ulwazi ngenkqubo ye-CCMA/Nkundla yaseBasebenzi/Isazimgqabarho.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zoLawulo nokuLawulwa kabaBasebenzi - Yenza iinkonzo ngokuwenzakalo kwemeko yokusebenza (Ixesha lokuphumla, izindlu, iMedical, Iinkwelomoya ngokusesweni umsebenzi, ukuzinza okude, ukugqitha ixesha, ukutshintsha indawo, iipenshini, ukudluliselwa, izibonelelo, njl.); Qonda iinkqubo zokubangumsebenzi nokukhetha ngokwagqithiswa kwamagunya esebe (isazelifundo, ukwenza uluhlu olufutshane, iintervyu, ukuvavanya usindululi, ukuvavanywa kobuchule, ukuqwalasela isalathiso, ukuqinisekiswa kweqwalaselo) zihlelwe ngaphakathi kwamaxesha alingisiweyo); Ulawulo lwegqabi labasebenzi be-HR. Lawula iinkonzo zoPhuhliso lwabaBasebenzi - Hlawula abasebenzi ngezibonelelo; Yenza inkqubo yokuziphatha nabafundi nabasebenzi (WIL); Qhuba inkqubo yokwaziswa; Hlela nokuqhuba iinkqubo zoqeqesho. Phuhlisa nokuzeke iNkqubo yeNkhetho zeNdawo yoQeqesho (WSP); Ulawulo lweeNkqubo zoLawulo nokuPhuhlisa uQwalaselo (PMDS) neNkqubo yoLawulo loQwalaselo oluDityaniswe (IQMS). Hlela nokuqhuba uPhuhliso lweNkundla, iinkonzo - Hlela ukuyilwa, ukuqwalasela nokuzekeka kwenkqubo yekholishi; Qhuba ukuphuhlisa iincazelo zomsebenzi; Hlela ukuQwalaselwa komsebenzi kwezithuba/njalo nizezele kwindlu enkulu; Qhuba isifundo somsebenzi nokuqamba kwendlela entsha yokwenza imisebenzi; Qhuba ukutshintshwa kolawulo nokuqalwa kwesimo esitsha sendkundla. Hlela nokuqhuba uQeqesho ngokulungiselela abasebenzi (HRP) kunye nezinkonzo zoQwalaselo lwesini (EE) - Hlela, phuhlisa, qwalasela, zeke nokuqwalasela inkqubo ye-HR yekholishi; Thumela inkqubo ye-HR yekholishi kwiiZiko nakuNdlu eNkulu ukuze idityaniswe nendlela yesebe; Hlela, phuhlisa, qwalasela, zeke nokuqwalasela inkqubo ye-EE yekholishi; Thumela inkqubo ye-EE yekholishi kwiiZiko nakuNdlu eNkulu ukuze idityaniswe nendlela yesebe; Iinkcukacha ze-Employment Equity (EE) ezithunyelwa kwiiZiko nakuNdlu eNkulu; Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo ye-HR kunye ne-EE. Bonezela iinkonzo zeMpilo noKuzinza kabaBasebenzi (EHW) - Zeke iinkqubo ngenkonzo yeempilo yekholishi; Hlela nokuzelela iinkonzo ze-HIV, i-AIDS, i-STI ne-TB; Hlela nokuzelela iinkqubo zemveliso yempilo; Zeke iinkqubo zokhuseleko nempilo kwindawo yokusebenza; Ukukhuthaza imidlalo ukukhuthaza impilo yolunyu nendlela ephila kakuhle. Phuhlisa nokuzeke amagqabantshintshi nencwadi ezingumkhwa kumalungu abasebenzi. Ulawulo lwe-Candelo lonke loLawulo, leMali, nezinye iinkcukacha zelundo. Amandla okuziphatha: OLawulweni; Ukuqamba nokuqwalasela; Ulawulo lweMali; UKubhala iingxelo, Unxibelelwano nokuqonda abanye; Ukusombulula iingxaki; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ukwenza isahluko; Ukuqwalasela umthengi; Ulawulo lomsebenzi; Ukulawula iqela; Ulawuloabantu. Ulawulo lweNxulumano zeBasebenzi - Nikeza iinkonzo zokumisela ngokwamagqabantshintshi woluntu lwabasebenzi, iinkqubo, iindlela, iingqwalasela, kunye nemi-thetho. Yenza iimisebenzi yamhlanje-ngamhlanze ngokunxulumene neendaba zokuzwa amava kunye nokumiswa kwexesha lokuzwa amava, iingxaki, ukungabikho emsebenzini, ukuphucula iNkqubo yokusebenza nokuqamba ngokusesweni; Dibana nabaphathi ekukhuthazeni iindlela ezilungileyo zoluntu lwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenkundla. Mela inkampani kwinkqubo yokusombulula iingxabano ekuquka ukuzwelana, ukuziphatha ngokwemithetho nokuqamba iindlela; Dibana nabaphathi ekukhuthazeni iindlela ezilungileyo zoluntu lwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenkundla. Iinkqabelo/izimilo - Ukumisela indlela yokukhathalela umthengi; Ukuqina; Ukuqina ngokuzimisela; Ukwenza ngaphambili nokuthembeka.

jobs.title: Local Office Manager
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 - R1 297 476 per annum (Level 12), (A basic salary)
jobs.summary: Manage overall operations and service delivery performance of the Department of Home Affairs Local Office in Bloemfontein, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and three years junior management experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Public Management, Public Administration, Operations, Business Management, Management, Administration, Law or Social Science within these specified fields of study at NQF level 6 as recognized by SAQA. 3 Years’ experience at a Junior Management / Assistant Director level in Operations in a client or customer services environment. Experience in Civic or Immigration Operations will be an added advantage. Knowledge of South African Constitution. Knowledge and understanding of all relevant public service and Departmental Legislative Frameworks, as well as Government Structures. Excellent abilities and experience in project management, project optimization and use of online systems. Knowledge of National Treasury Regulations and Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge of Human Resources Regulatory Framework and Occupational Health and Safety Act. Knowledge of South African Constitution. Knowledge of workflow and capacity planning. Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Knowledge of Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA) and Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). A valid drivers’ license. Willingness to travel and work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: Strong Management and Leadership capability. Service delivery innovation, client orientation and customer focus. People management and empowerment. Financial Management. Program and project management. Change management. Ability to instil appropriate processes and systems, as well as enabling technology, to support the Department in efficiently and effectively managing the required work. Support digital transformation. Excellent verbal and written communication, as well as report writing and presentation skills. Problem-solving and analysis. Policy interpretation. Risk Management. Influencing, networking, conflict management and negotiation skills. Knowledge and Information Management. Decision making and initiating action. Planning, organising and time management. Computer literacy. Patriotism, Honesty and Integrity.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Manage the overall operations and performance of the Office against agreed service delivery standards. Provide advice and guidance on operations of the Department at a Local Office level. Manage the provision of safe and secure enabling documents as it relates to citizenship, births, marriages, death, travel documents and passports. Ensure delivery against the mandates derived from the Government’s Programme of Action (POA). Ensure effective management and oversight of the Local Office’s Immigration Inspectorate activities. Foster effective partnerships with all stakeholders and represent the Office at various forums. Ensure the effective implementation of strategic objectives and innovation (digital transformation and case management solutions) in the Local Office. Coordinate and monitor delivery of the Local Office’s operational plan against agreed timeframes and objectives. Implement governance processes, frameworks, policies, procedures and manage risks. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Local Office. Coach and guide staff on compliance with all regulatory requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Free State: Ms V Molefe Tel No: (051) 430 0378
jobs.applications: Applications compliant with the “Directions to Applicants” above, must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za or sent to the correct address specified as follows: Free State: Physical Address: 41 Charlotte Maxeke Street, Bloemfontein, 9301.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za sent to the correct address specified at the bottom of the posts, on or before the closing date, accompanied by a fully completed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021), obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za, citing the correct post number and job title, and a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date dd/mm/yy), job title, duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of at least two contactable employment references (as recent as possible), regardless of online or manual submission. Where a valid Driver's License and a Professional Driving Permit (PDP) is a requirement, this must be indicated on the CV. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Shortlisted candidates will also be required to submit a copy of their ID document, a valid driver’s license (if specified as a job requirement), relevant educational qualifications / RPL certificates / Academic Transcripts of completed qualifications, and Acting letters as directed. Furthermore, applicants who possess (a) foreign qualification(s), are required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications, as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity, will be subjected to an interview, various relevant tests and assessments, and employment suitability checks (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, and employment references including verification of exit reasons, and conducting business with State). Once appointed, serving of a prescribed probation period, and obtaining of a security clearance appropriate to the post, will be required. Correspondence between the Department and candidates will be limited to shortlisted candidates, ONLY. The DHA is a merit-based, equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In line with its commitment to promoting representivity, in the filling of entry-level positions preference may be given to locally based candidates on grounds of affordability as well as to (unemployed) youth and the DHA’s interns and learners who have successfully completed their respective skills development programmes. In the filling of all posts, preference may be afforded to persons with disabilities, and in respect of SMS-level posts, to women. Persons falling in these categories and who meet the post requirements are preferred. The DHA complies with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act No. 4 of 2013). Applicants’ personal information will be used for recruitment purposes, retained where required for audit, and safeguarded against unauthorised disclosure, except where legally required. af.title: plaaslike kantoorbestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur die algehele bedrywighede en diensleweringprestasie van die Department of Home Affairs plaaslike kantoor in Bloemfontein, waarvoor 'n NQF vlak 6 kwalifikasie en drie jaar junior bestuurservaring vereis word.

Ervaring in Civic of Immigration Operations sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Kennis en begrip van alle relevante openbare diens en departementale wetgewende raamwerke, sowel as regeringsstrukture. Kennis van die Menslike Hulpbronne Regulerende Raamwerk en Occupational Health and Safety Act. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Kennis van werkvloei en kapasiteitsbeplanning. Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Kennis van Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA) en Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en verlengde ure te werk. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Sterk bestuurs- en leierskapsvermoë. Diensleweringinnoviasie, kliëntoriëntasie en klieëntefokus. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Finansiële bestuur. Program- en projeksbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Vermoë om gepaste prosesse en stelsels, sowel as ondersteunende tegnologie, te implementeer om die Departement te help om die vereiste werk doeltreffend en effektief te bestuur. Ondersteun digitale transformasie. Voortreflike mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie, sowel as verslagdoenings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise. Beleidinterpretasie. Risikobestuur. Invloedryke, netwerk-, konflikbestuurs- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Kennis- en inligtingsbestuur. Besluitneming en inisiëring van aksie. Beplanning, organisering en tydbestuur. Versewer die effektiewe implementering van strategiese doelwitte en innovasie (digitale transformasie en saakbestuursoplossings) in die plaaslike Kantoor. Koördineer en monitor lewering van die plaaslike Kantoor se bedryfsplan teen ooreengekome tydlyne en doelwitte. Implementeer bestuursprosesse, raamwerke, beleide, prosedures en bestuur risiko's. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die plaaslike Kantoor. Mentorskap en leiding aan personeel oor nakoming van alle regulatoriese vereistes.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezikhungo Zasendaweni
zu.summary: Phatha izindlela zokusebenza ngokuphelele kanye nezenzo eziphathelene nokuhanjiswa kwezinsiza kweNyuvesi yasekhaya yomnyango kuBloemfontein, kudinga iziqu ze-NQF level 6 kanye neminyaka emithathu yesiphephelo sabaphathi abancane.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu eziphakeme ekuqashweni kwabasebenzi basezikhungweni ezakhela, ekuqashweni kwabasebenzi bazakhamuzi, ezokuphathwa kwezindaba, ekuqashweni kwebhizinisi, ekuqashweni kwezindaba, ngaphansi kwalawa mikhakha etholakala ngamazinga e-NQF level 6 njengobaqashwa yi-SAQA. 3 Years’ experience at a Junior Management / Assistant Director level in Operations in a client or customer services environment. Isiphephelo esikhulu ngokuqashwa kwabasebenzi ngomthetho wesizwe noma ngokuhamba kwabantu kuzobe kuyinzuzo. Ukwazi umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi futhi ukuqonda yonke imigangatho yabasebenzi basezikhungweni nezomthetho zomnyango ngokwesikhathi, kanye namakomidi kahulumeni. Isiphephelo esikhulu kanye nokuba khona ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo, ukulungiswa kwezinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezingaxhunyiwe esimeni. Ukwazi imigangatho ye-National Treasury Regulations ne-Public Finance Management Act. Ukwazi imigangatho yomthetho wobuhlakani bokuphathwa kwabantu kanye no-Mthetho wezempilo nokuphepha abasebenzi. Ukwazi umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi ukuphathwa komsebenzi kanye nokuqasha isikhathi. Ukwazi imigangatho ye-Batho Pele Principles. Ukwazi i-Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), i-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA) kanye ne-Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kanye nokusebenza amahora amaningi. Amakhono kanye namandla okusebenza: Isiphephelo esikhulu sokuphathwa kanye nokuba gumqondo weqhaza. Ukuba yisibonakaliso ekuletha ezinsizakalo, ukuqonda abathengi kanye nokugxila kubathengi. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubakhulisa. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukuphatha izinhlelo kanye nezinhlela zokusebenza. Ukuphatha izinguquko. Isiphephelo sokufaka izinqubo ezifanele kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nobuchwepheshe obuncike kocingo bokweseka umnyango ekuphathweni komsebenzi odingekayo ngokusebenza kahle nangokuphumelela. Ukusekela ukuguquka kwezobuchwepheshe. Ukusebenzisana okuhle ngokukhuluma nokubhala, kanye nokubhala imibiko nokwethula. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqhathanisa. Ukuhumusha imigangatho. Ukuphatha izingozi. Ukuthinta, ukuxhumanisa, ukuphatha izinkinga kanye nokuxoxa. Ukuphatha ulwazi kanye nolwazi. Ukwenza izinqumo nokwethula isenzo. Ukucwangcisa, ukulungisa kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uthando lwesizwe, ukuqinisile kanye nembhalo eqotho.
zu.duties: Umphathi obe uhambile uzobekwa isibopho sokwenza, phakathi kwabanye, le misebenzi elandelayo: Ukuphatha ngokuphelele izindlela zokusebenza kanye nezenzo zofisi ngokumelana nemigangatho yokuletha izinsiza. Nikeza izeluleko kanye nesiqondiso ekuphathweni komnyango ezingeni lezikhungo zasendawo. Phatha ukuletha izinhlamvu eziphephile ezivikelwe ezithinta izakhamuzi, izaluzzi, imishado, ukufa, izinhlamvu zokuhamba kanye namaphasipoti. Qinisekisa ukuletha ngokumelana nemiyalo evela kuhulumeni ohlelela izindlela zokusebenza (POA). Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kanye nokuqapha izenzo zokuqashwa kwabantu bezikhungo zasendawo. Sakhisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo kubo bonke abanegalelo futhi ime isikhungo emihlandleni emihlukene. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo kwezinhloso ezinhle kanye nokungajwayelekile (ukuguquka kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqashwa kwezindlela) esikhungweni. Hlanganisa futhi uqaphe ukuletha kohlelo lokusebenza lwezikhungo zasendawo ngokumelana nesikhathi esithunywe kanye nezinhlloso. Qeda izinqubo zokuqashwa kwezomthetho, imigangatho, izinqubo kanye nokuphatha izingozi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kokugcwala kwabantu, izinsiza ezibonakalayo kanye nezimali esikhungweni. Fundisa kanye nokuhola abasebenzi ngokuzelelana ngazo zonke izidingo ezomthethweni.

xh.title: Umphathi We-ofisi Yasedolo

Experience in Civic or Immigration Operations will be an added advantage. Knowledge of South African Constitution. Knowledge and understanding of all relevant public service and Departmental Legislative Frameworks, as well as Government Structures. Excellent abilities and experience in project management, project optimization and use of online systems. Knowledge of National Treasury Regulations and Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge of Human Resources Regulatory Framework and Occupational Health and Safety Act. Knowledge of South African Constitution. Knowledge of workflow and capacity planning. Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Knowledge of Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS), Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA) and Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). jobs.title: Assistant Director: Photo Capturing
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 - R713 535 per annum (Level 10), (a basic salary)
jobs.summary: Manage daily operations of the photo capturing unit at the Department of Home Affairs Head Office in Tshwane, coordinating fingerprint capturing and application processing.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Operations Management, Public Management, Administration, Business Management, Administration or Social Science within these specified of study at an NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA. 3 years’ supervisory experience. Experience in Civic and Immigration Services. Experience in coordination of information gathering citizenship processes. Knowledge of Workflow planning and capacity planning. Knowledge of all Civic Services Regulations. Basic knowledge of the Immigration Act and Refugee Act. Extensive knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury regulations. Knowledge of the South African Constitution. Understanding of departmental legislation and Human Resources legislation and prescripts. Knowledge of the South African Constitution Knowledge of the Public Service Regulations Act. Willingness to work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: Capability and Leadership. People management and empowerment. Expenditure Management. Project Management. Time Management. Accountability. Business Continuity. Decision Making. Business Analysis. Strong Communication. Interpersonal Skills. Conceptual Thinking Ability. Strong Analytical Skills. Client orientation and customer focus. Research skills. Strong problem solving. Proficiency in business process modelling. Presentation skills. Problem solving and analysis. Business report writing. Influencing and networking. Planning and organizing. Interpersonal skills. Technical Skills: Commercial Skills. Negotiation Skills. Document management skills. Computer and digital literacy skills. Decision Making skills. Patriotic, Honesty, Integrity and Accountability.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Manage daily operation of the photo capturing Unit. Coordinate the fingerprint capturing and processing of applications. Conduct on incoming and finalised work of senior fingerprint officers and fingerprint officers. Manage the processing of photographs, fingerprints and special functions in accordance with DHA guidelines and requirements. Manage effective activities within Preparations, HANIS and Special Tasks Sections. Monitor daily performance and take corrective action or escalate in accordance with DHA guidelines. Prepare monthly reports on the status and progress of various projects within the Section. Testify in a court of law on special cases regarding fingerprint and identification matters. Ensure that adequate training is provided to all fingerprint personnel. Ensure that all exceptional cases are investigated and resolved timeously. Commission the prepared Section 212 declarations for court cases. Participate in the process of developing training manuals for the fingerprint occupational class. Conduct feasibility study on best practices on improvement of services with regard to fingerprint related activities. Build and maintain relationship with various stakeholders (Internal and External). Participate in the formulation of policies concerning the pre-processing of Identity Documents. Implement effective risk and compliance in line with the relevant practices. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.

Furthermore, applicants who possess (a) foreign qualification(s), are required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications, as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. In line with its commitment to promoting representivity, in the filling of entry-level positions preference may be given to locally based candidates on grounds of affordability as well as to (unemployed) youth and the DHA’s interns and learners who have successfully completed their respective skills development programmes. In the filling of all posts, preference may be afforded to persons with disabilities, and in respect of SMS-level posts, to women. Persons falling in these categories and who meet the post requirements are preferred. The DHA complies with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act No. 4 of 2013). Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die Eenheid. Afrig en begelei personeel oor beste praktyke en nakoming van regulatoriese vereistes.
