jobs.title: Control Immigration Officer: Inspectorate
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 - R486 501 per annum (Level 08), (a basic salary package)
jobs.summary: Supervise immigration law enforcement and investigate illegal foreigners at the Ethekwini office, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and two years' law enforcement experience.
jobs.requirements: A qualification in Law, Public Management, Public Administration, Policing, Criminology, Forensics or Criminal Justice at NQF level 6 as recognized by SAQA. 2 Years’ experience in a law enforcement environment. Knowledge of the Immigration Act, Refugees Act, Criminal Procedure Act, and relevant Regulations. Knowledge of International treaties. Knowledge and understanding of all relevant public service and Departmental Legislative Frameworks, as well as Government Structures. A valid drivers’ license (Code C1) or C (Code 10). Valid Public Driver Permit (PDP). Willingness to travel including outside of the borders of South Africa. Work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: Service delivery innovation. Client orientation and customer focus. Excellent interpersonal skills. Problem solving and conflict management. Analytical skills. Planning, organising and time management. Good written and verbal communication skills. Report writing. Computer literacy. Patriotic, Honesty and Integrity.
jobs.duties: The successful candidates will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Provide effective law enforcement, and monitoring of the investigation of illegal foreigners according to the Immigration Act No 13 of 2002. Supervise, administrate and enforce the detection, tracing, arrest and detention of illegal foreigners within the Country. Ensure effective investigation of cases involving smuggling of migrants, human trafficking and illegal mass production of enabling documents such as birth certificates, travel documents, permits, Visas, Identity documents and theft of face value documents. Assist in dealing with illegal migration facilitated by corruption and other high-profile cases. Appear and testify in court proceedings (both criminal and civil), as well as disciplinary enquiries on behalf of the Department. Monitor the process of the deportation of illegal foreigners out of the Country to their country of origin. Administrate and implement inspections in loco. Assist in the promotion of a climate in the Country that discourages illegal migration and ensures that illegal foreigners depart the Country either through deportation or voluntarily, in line with applicable Acts and Regulations. Monitor the influx of foreigners residing in the Country and ensure that they have legal documentation. Timeously liaise with all law enforcement agencies and other relevant institutions on the verification of the identity of foreigners who contravene the provisions of applicable Legislation. Administrate the arrest and deportation of illegal foreigners who are unwilling to leave the Country voluntarily, in a lawful manner. Assist in crime combatting operations with other law enforcement agencies. Participate in security cluster forums and case flow management meetings. Prepare reports and statistics as directed. Operate, maintain and safeguard the assigned heavy-duty vehicle as well as designated tools of trade, in accordance with relevant Departmental policy frameworks. Ensure the implementation of Departmental policies and procedures. Maintain relationships with various stakeholders (Internal and External). Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on compliance with all regulatory requirements.

af.title: Beheer-Immigrasiebeampte: Inspektoraat
af.summary: Supervedeer wetstoepassing op immigrasiewetgewing en ondersoek onwettige buitelanders by die Ethekwini-kantoor, wat 'n NQF level 6-kwalifikasie en twee jaar se wetstoepassingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie in Regte, Openbare Bestuur, Openbare Administrasie, Polisiëring, Kriminologie, Forensiese Wetenskap of Strafreg op NQF level 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 2 Years' ervaring in 'n wetstoepassingsomgewing. Kennis van die Immigration Act, Refugees Act, Criminal Procedure Act, en toepaslike Regulasies. Kennis van Internasionale verdrae. Kennis en begrip van alle toepaslike staatsdiens- en Departementele Wetgewende Raamwerke, asook Regeringsstrukture. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (Code C1) of C (Code 10). Geldige Public Driver Permit (PDP). Bereidwilligheid om te reis insluitend buite die grense van South Africa. Werk verlengde ure. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Dienslewering-inovasie. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Uitstekende interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossing en konflikbestuur. Analitiese vaardighede. Beplanning, organisering en tydbestuur. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagdoening. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Vaderlandsliefde, eerlikheid en integriteit.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidate sal onder andere vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: Verskaf doeltreffende wetstoepassing en monitering van die ondersoek na onwettige buitelanders ooreenkomstig die Immigration Act No 13 of 2002. Supervedeer, administreer en handhaaf die opsporing, naspeuring, aanhouding en aanhouding van onwettige buitelanders binne die land. Verseker doeltreffende ondersoek van sake wat betrekking het op smokkeling van migrants, menseshandel en onwettige massaproduksie van bemagtigende dokumente soos geboortesertifikate, reisdokumente, permitte, Visas, identiteitsdokumente en diefstal van sigwaarde-dokumente. Bystand verleen in die hantering van onwettige migrasie wat deur korrupsie gefasiliteer word en ander hoëprofielsake. Verskyn en getuig in hofverrigtinge (sowel strafregtelik as siviel), asook dissiplinêre navrae namens die Departement. Moniteer die proses van die uitsetting van onwettige buitelanders uit die land na hul land van herkoms. Administreer en implementeer ondersoeke in loco. Bystand verleen in die bevordering van 'n klimaat in die land wat onwettige migrasie ontmoedig en verseker dat onwettige buitelanders die land verlaat hetsy deur uitsetting of vrywillig, in ooreenstemming met toepaslike Wette en Regulasies. Moniteer die toestroming van buitelanders wat in die land woon en verseker dat hulle wettige dokumentasie het. Tydig skakel met alle wetstoepassingsagentskappe en ander relevante instellings rakende die verifikasie van die identiteit van buitelanders wat die bepalings van toepaslike Wetgewing oortree. Administreer die aanhouding en uitsetting van onwettige buitelanders wat nie gewillig is om die land vrywillig te verlaat nie, op 'n wettige wyse. Bystand verleen in misdaadbestrydingsoperasies met ander wetstoepassingsagentskappe. Deelneem aan sekuriteitsklusterforums en saakvloei-bestuursvergaderings. Verslae en statistieke voorberei soos aangewys. Bedryf, onderhou en beskerm die toegewysde swaardiensvoertuig asook aangewysde handelswerktuie, in ooreenstemming met relevante Departementele beleidsraamwerke. Verseker die implementering van Departementele beleide en prosedures. Onderhou verhoudings met verskeie belanghebbendes (Intern en Ekstern). Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die Eenheid. Stuur en begelei personeel oor nakoming van alle regulatoriese vereistes.

zu.title: Umphathi We-Immigration Officer: Inspectorate
zu.summary: Ukubuka ukuphoqelela kwemithetho yokungena kwabanye bangaphakandi kanye nokuphenya abanye bangaphakandi abangekho emthethweni ehhovisi le-Ethekwini, kudinga isiqu se-NQF izinga 6 kanye neminyaka emibili yemfundo ekuqinisekisweni kokusebenza kwemithetho.
zu.requirements: Isiqu ezifundweni eziyizi-Mthetho, izi-Management kazwelonke, izi-Administration kazwelonke, izi-Policing, izi-Criminology, i-Forensics noma i-Criminal Justice ezingeni le-NQF 6 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Unyaka o-2 wemfundo ekuqinisekisweni kokusebenza kwemithetho. Ulwazi nge-Immigration Act, Refugees Act, Criminal Procedure Act, nemithetho ehlobene nalokho. Ulwazi ngezivumelwano zezwe lonke. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda yonke imithetho yesevisi yomphakathi nakaMnyango, kanye nezakhiwo zoHulumeni. I-License yokushayela evunyiwe (Code C1) noma C (Code 10). I-Public Driver Permit (PDP) evunyiwe. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kubandakanya kanye nangaphandle kwezinkambu zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukusebenza amahora amade. Amandla kanye namakhono adingekayo: Intuthuko yesevisi yokuletha. Ukugxila kukhasimende. Amandla mahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphatha izinkoxo. Amandla ahlukanisa. Ukulungisa, ukuhlela kanye nokulawula isikhathi. Amandla mahle okubhala nokuKhuluma. Ukubhala imibiko. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuzithoba, ukuqotho kanye nokuzinza.
zu.duties: Abantu abaphumelelayo bazibophezele kokunye okulandelayo: Ukunikeza ukuphoqelela kwemithetho okusebenzayo, kanye nokulawula uphenyo lwabanye bangaphakathi abangekho emthethweni ngokomthetho we-Immigration Act No 13 ka-2002. Ukubuka, ukuphatha nokuphoqelela ukutholwa, ukulandelwa, ukuboshwa kanye nokubekwa ebulungeni kwabanye bangaphakathi abangekho emthethweni ongaphakathi kwelinye. Ukuqinisekisa uphenyo olusebenzayo lwamacala ahlobene nokuthutha ngaphandle kwemithetho abantu, ukuthengiswa kwabantu kanye nokuqamba ngokungalungile amaphepha okuvumela ukungena njengezatifikethi zokuzalwa, amaphepha okuhamba, izivumelwano, i-Visa, amakhadi obunikazi kanye nokweba amaphepha anenani. Ukusiza ekuphatheni ukungena kwabanye bangaphakandi ngaphandle kwemithetho okubekwa phambili ukholo kanye namanye amacala abalulekile. Ukubonakala kanye nokufakaza enkantolo (kobugebengu nangesivumelwano), kanye nakulezo zincoko ezibhekene nokuhlakanipha egameni loMnyango. Ukulawula inqubo yokuxothwa kwabanye bangaphakathi abangekho emthethweni baseNingizimu Afrika baye elweni labo baphuma kulo. Ukuphatha nokusebenzisa ukuhlola endaweni. Ukusiza ekukhuthazeni isimo ezweni lokuqeda ukungena kwabanye bangaphakandi ngaphandle kwemithetho kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bangaphakathi abangekho emthethweni baphume ezweni nangokuxoshwa noma ngokuzithandela, ngokuhambisana nemithetho ephathelene nalokho. Ukulawula ukungena kwabanye bangaphakathi abahlala ezweni futhi baqinisekise ukuthi banamaphepha okusemthethweni. Ukuxhumana ngokushesha nazo yonke izinhlelo ezibheke ukuphoqelela kwemithetho kanye nezinye izikhungo ezibalulekile ekubukeni ukuzinza kobunikazi bazo ongaphakandi abaphula imithetho. Ukuphatha ukuboshwa kanye nokuxoshwa kwabo ongaphakandi abangekho emthethweni abangathandi ukuhamba ngokuzithandela, ngendlela evumelana nomthetho. Ukusiza emisebenzini yokulwa nobugebengu kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezibheke ukuphoqelela kwemithetho. Ukubambe iqhaza emikhakheni yokuvikela kanye nemitshinana yokuphatha amacala. Ukulungiselela imibiko kanye nezibalo njengoba kushiwo. Ukusebenzisa, ukugcina futhi uvikele isithuthi esibukhulu esinikiwe kanye nemithiyo yokusebenza, ngokuhambisana nemithetho kaMnyango mayelana nalokho. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho kaMnyango. Ukugcina ubuhlobo bezinhlobonhlobo zezinhlaka (ngaphakathi kanye nangaphandle). Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokusebenzayo kwezinsizakalo zabantu, ezingokoqobo nasezimali. Ukufundisa kanye nokuhola abasebenzi ekuzweleni yonke imithetho.

xh.title: I-Controller yoMphathi wezoNtshato: I-Inspectorate
xh.summary: Qonda ukusebenza kolawulo-lwemithetho yokuhamba kwabantu kwaye uphenye abantu bangaphandle abangamnyangeyo kwindlu yomsebenzi yase-Ethekwini, efunwa ngamandla emfundo ezingqongqo level 6 kunye neminyaka emi-2 yamava olawulo-lwemithetho.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso semfundo kumMthetho, uLawulo loLuntu, uLawulo loLuntu loQotho, iNgqeqesho yoMmyalezo, i-Criminology, i-Forensics okanye iNyaniso eTyhilwe ngecala ezingqongqo level 6 njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emi-2 yamava kwendawo yolawulo-lwemithetho. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woKuhamba kwabantu, uMthetho weSicwangciso esithile sokuhamba, uMthetho wenkqubo yecalâ, kunye noLawulo oluhambelana nawo. Ulwazi ngesivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda konke olunxulumene noluntu lolwazi-kawonke-wesebe neNkqubo eMthethweni yesebe, nakuqonda iNgqina eZiko. Unxibelelwano nokuxhasa oonqwena-matshini abalawulayo ngenkqubo ekuziswa iMithetho ye-Highway 13 ye-2002. Isiqinisekiso esikhoyo semvume yokushuka unxweme (Ikhodi C1) okanye C (Ikhodi 10). Isiqinisekiso sokuvunyelwa ukushuka unxweme (PDP). Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kuquka namaphandle kwemida ye-Afrika seMzantsi. Ukusebenza iiyure ezinde. Amakhono kwaye nako konke okulindelekile: inkqubo entsha yokuphatha abantu. Uqwalaselo kumxhasi kwaye ukhathalele ukwazi kumthengi. Amakhono amaninzi okuxabana nabantu. Iingxaki ezinzima nokulawula inkcaso. Amakhono okuhlola. Ukulungiselela, ukuqamba nokulawula ixesha. Ulwazi ngokubhala kwaye uthethe ulwimi ngokubhalweyo nangokuthethwayo. Ukubhala ingxelo. Ulwazi ngakakhompyutha. Uthando leNlizwe, inyaniso nokuzinikela.
xh.duties: Omele abakhetwayo baya kuxatyiswa ngokwabanjalo, ngokukodwa koku kulandelayo: ukuphana ngokusebenza kolawulo-lwemithetho, nokulawula uphando lwabantu bangaphandle abangamnyangeyo ngokweMithetho yoKuhamba kwabantu inamba 13 ka-2002. Qonda, ulawule kwaye uphokezele ukubonwa, ukulandelelana, ukubethwa nokuvalwa kwabantu bangaphandle abangamnyangeyo ngaphakathi kweli Lizwe. Qinisekisa uphando olusebenzayo lwezicala eziquka ukuthutha ngamayendesha, ukuthengiswa kwabantu nokwenziwa ngamandla amakhulu amaxwebhu okuvumela ukungena afana namaxwebhu okuzalwa, amaxwebhu okuhamba, izivume, i-Visa, amaxwebhu okuzaziwa nokutshatwa kwamaxwebhu anexabiso elibonakalayo. Nceda ekuphatheni ukungena okungamnyangeyo kwenziwe ngungqwalaselo nakwezinye iicala ezibaluleke kakhulu. Bonakala kwaye uqinisekise inkqubo yecalâ (kwezona ngcalâ nakwezobugcisa), nakwizicwangciso zokuphatha iingxeki ngokwesebe. Qaphela inkqubo yokukhutshwa kwabantu bangaphandle abangamnyangeyo kule Lizwe baya kwelizwe labo. Lawule kwaye ufake ukuphononwa kwandawonye. Nceda ekukhuthazeni imozulu kule Lizwe ezingathandi ukungena okungamnyangeyo kwaye qinisekisa ukuba abantu bangaphandle abangamnyangeyo bahambe le Lizwe nokuba ngokukhutshwa okanye ngokuzimisela, ngokweMithetho nakwezinye iziCwangciso ezichaziweyo. Qaphela ukungenela kwabantu bangaphandle abahlala kule Lizwe kwaye uqinisekise ukuba banamaxwebhu okusemthethweni. Thetha ngesixa kunye nawo onke amaqela olawulo-lwemithetho nakwezinye iindawo ezibalulekileyo ekugqinisekiseni isazwi sabantu bangaphandle abaphula izicwangciso zoMthetho ochaziweyo. Lawula ukubethwa nokukhutshwa kwabantu bangaphandle abangamnyangeyo abangazimiseli ukuhamba le Lizwe ngokuzimisela, ngendlela esemthethweni. Nceda kwiinkqubo zokulwa nobugebenga nakwezinye amaqela olawulo-lwemithetho. Thatha inxaxheba kwiindawo zokuxoxwa ngokhuseleko nakwindlu yokuphatha iinkqubo zeemeko. Lungiselela iingxelo namarhelo njengakushiwo. Sebenzisa, zigcine kwaye uzikhusela iimoto ezinkulu ezinikwe iinkqubo kwaye nako konke okunikiweyo ukusebenza, ngokweNkqubo eMthethweni yesebe. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweNkqubo eMthethweni nemiqathango yesebe. Zama ubudlelwane obuhle namaqela abantu abaninzi (ngaphakathi nakangaphandle). Qinisekisa ukuphatha ngokusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo amandla, izinto nakwezimali ngaphakathi kweNyanga. Fundisa kwaye kalatha abasebenzi ngokuzithobela konke okulindelekileyo ngeNkqubo eMthethweni.

jobs.salary_text: R413 001 - R486 501 per annum (Level 08), (a basic salary)
jobs.summary: Provide senior administrative support including travel, correspondence and office budget administration at the Department of Home Affairs provincial office in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Office Management and Technology, Business Management, Administration Management or a related field at NQF Level 6 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 2 years’ experience as an Administrative Officer/ Chief Administration Clerk is required. Experience in the administration of office budgets is required. Knowledge of National Treasury Regulations. Extensive knowledge of various filing systems. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Knowledge and Understanding of departmental Legislations and Prescripts. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management processes and procedures. Knowledge of the Human Resource Regulatory Framework. A valid drivers’ license. Willingness to travel and work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: Problem Solving. Planning and organising. Planning and organising. Financial Administration. Analytical thinking. Verbal and Written Communication. Interpersonal. Customer Focus. Attention to Detail. Clerical and Administration. Multi-Tasking. Results and Achievement focus. Teamwork. Time Management. Computer literacy. Patriotic, Honesty, Integrity and Accountability.

Perform general administrative activities in support of the unit (travel, venues and accommodation arrangements). Ensure the administration of office correspondence, documents and reports (Compile letters, memorandums, submissions, reports and minutes for the unit). Ensure the maintenance of filling system for the unit. Compile financial and administration reports and documents. Ensure compilation of budget and cash flow projections. Convene and attend meetings and act as secretary during meetings. Ensure accurate Completion of subsistence claims. Keep track of all incoming work and ensure that all deadlines are met. Liaise with all stakeholders relevant to the unit. Ensure the flow of information and documents in the unit. Ensure that forms and documents related to claims, payments, invoices and consultant fees relevant to the unit are processed. Provide office administration services in the functional unit. Ensure innovation and service delivery within the Unit. Ensure the implementation of effective risk and compliance management practices. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Verskaf senior administratiewe ondersteuning insluitend reis, korrespondensie en kantoorbegrotingsadministrasie by die Department of Home Affairs provinsiale kantoor in Pietermaritzburg.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Office Management and Technology, Business Management, Administration Management of 'n verwante veld op NQF Level 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring as 'n Administratiewe Beampte/ Hoof Administratiewe Klerk word vereis. Ervaring in die administrasie van kantoorbegrotings word vereis. Kennis van National Treasury Regulations. Uitgebreide kennis van verskeie lêerstelsels. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Kennis en begrip van departementele wetgewing en skrifte. Kennis van die Public Service Regulatory Framework. Kennis van Supply Chain Management prosesse en prosedures. Kennis van die Human Resource Regulatory Framework. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en buitengewone ure te werk. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Probleemoplossing. Beplanning en organisering. Beplanning en organisering. Finansiële Administrasie. Analitiese denke. Mondelingse en Skriftelike Kommunikasie. Tussenmenslik. Kliëntfokus. Aandag aan Detail. Klerklik en Administrasie. Multitaakverrigting. Resultate en prestasiefokus. Spanwerk. Tydbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vaderlandsliewend, Eerlikheid, Integriteit en Verantwoordelikheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir, onder andere, die volgende spesifieke take: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning in die eenheid. Voer algemene administratiewe aktiwiteite uit ter ondersteuning van die eenheid (reis, plekke en akkommodasie-reëlings). Verseker die administrasie van kantoorkorrespondensie, dokumente en verslae (stel briewe, memos, voorleggings, verslae en notule vir die eenheid op). Verseker die instandhouding van die lêerstelsel vir die eenheid. Stel finansiële en administratiewe verslae en dokumente op. Verseker die opstel van begroting en kontantvloeiproeksies. Reël en woon byeenkomste by en tree as sekretaris op tydens byeenkomste. Verseker die akkurate voltooiing van bestaanskeise. Hou tred met alle inkomende werk en verseker dat alle sperdatums nagekom word. Skakel met alle belanghebbendes wat relevant is tot die eenheid. Verseker die vloei van inligting en dokumente in die eenheid. Verseker dat vorms en dokumente wat verband hou met eise, betalings, fakture en konsultantgelde wat relevant is tot die eenheid verwerk word. Verskaf kantooradministrasiedienste in die funksionele eenheid. Verseker innovasie en dienslewering binne die eenheid. Verseker die implementering van effektiewe risiko- en nakomingsbestuurspraktyke. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die eenheid. Afrig en begelei personeel oor beste praktyke en nakoming van regulatoriese vereistes.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wokuphathwa Kwezindaba
zu.summary: Nikela ngokusekela okuphakeme kokuphathwa kwezindaba okubandakanya ukuhamba, inhlangano yezincwadi nokuphathwa kwezimali zehhovisi ehhovisi lesifundazwe le Department of Home Affairs e Pietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesiqu esingaphansi kwalesi esiphezulu ekuPhathweni Kohlelo Nobuchwepheshe, ekuPhathweni Kwamabhizinisi, ekuPhathweni Kwezindaba noma enye indawo ehlobene nayo ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka uneminyaka engu-2 okungenani uyishintshwe ulunya ngokuba nguMphathi Wezindaba/Zilawuli Elikhulu Lezindaba. Kudingeka ube namava ekuPhathweni kwezabelo zehhovisi. Ukwazi Izimiso Zeqhazwakula LesiZwe. ULwazi olubanzi ngezinhlelo ezahlukahlukene zokugcina amafayela. Ukwazi i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). ULwazi nokuqonda kokuMthetho kanye Nemiyalo Yomnyango. Ukwazi i-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ukwazi inqubo namagugu e-Supply Chain Management. Ukwazi i-Human Resource Regulatory Framework. Ilayisense yokushayela esevumelekile. Ukuhlakanipha okwukuholo futhi usebenze amahora amide. Amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. UkuPhathwa Kwezimali. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxoxa nokuBhala ngokubhaliwe. Okuhlobene nabantu. Ukuqala kwesithakazelo. Ukuqasha izinhlangothi. Ukuphathwa kwezindaba namapheshana. Ukwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ukuqinisekisa iziphumelele nemigomo. Ukusebenza njengosotho. UkuPhathwa Kwesikhathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ubuso bezwe, Ukuqaphela, Ukuqiniseka nokuba Nebhalansi.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethiwe uzobe unomthwalo wezinkinga, phakathi kokunye, emsebenzini olandelayo othize: Nikela ngokusekela kokuphathwa kwezindaba kwingqikithi. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezindaba evamile esekela ingqikithi (ukuhamba, izikhungo nendawo yokuhlala). Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezincwadi zehhovisi, amadokhumenti nemibiko (Hlela amagama, okukhunjulwa, okuhunyushiwe, imibiko kanye neminithi yengqikithi). Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kohlelo lokufaka amafayela kwingqikithi. Hlela imibiko nokuqashwa kwemali namadokhumenti. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kwezabelo kanye nokuqagula kwokusakaza kwemali. Bizana futhi ubuye emihlanganweni futhi ube ngumlobi ngesikhathi somhlangano. Qinisekisa ukuqedwa ngokunembile kwemikhuze yokuphila. Qaphela wonke umsebenzi ongenayo futhi qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaphethu ahambiswe. Xhumana nalabo bonke abahlobene nengqikithi. Qinisekisa ukusakaza kolwazi namadokhumenti kwingqikithi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafomu namadokhumenti ahlobene nemikhuze, izinkokhela, izikweletu nezimali zalabo bahloli ahucwengiwe. Nikela ngezinkonzo zokuphathwa kwehhozisi kwingqikithi esebenzayo. Qinisekisa izinhlelo ezintsha nokuhanjiswa kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kolwazi oluthile nokuqashwa kwemithetho ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Qinisekisa ukuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu, ezomzimba nezesimali ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Fundisa futhi uhola abasebenzi ngezinhlelo ezinhle nokuhambisana nezidingo zemithetho.

xh.title: Isikhokelo Sokulawula Esiphakamileyo
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo okhokelayo kuhambo, ukubhalelana, kunye nolawulo lwemali yofisi kwisebe leDepartment of Home Affairs kofisi yephondo ePietermaritzburg.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka wenze inkqubo yenqanaba lesithandathu kwilixesha elifutshane lakho, ukulawuleka ngokweshishini lakho, ukulawuleka ngokwemisebenzi okanye indawo entsha kwilixesha elifutshane njengakuqaphela iSAQA. Uya kudityaniswa neemfuno zokuba nenqanaba elingaphezu kweminyaka emibini njengomsebenzi wolawulo/Unobhala wolawulo. Kufuneka uqalise usetyenziso kwilixesha elifutshane kulawulo lwemali. Kufuneka ulwazi kwimigaqo yeqhina likarhulumente. Ulwazi olubanzi lweendlela ezahlukeneyo zokugcina amaxwebhu. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yesebe kunye nezikhokelo. Ulwazi ngendlela elawula inkonzo yomrhulumente. Ulwazi ngakunye nokuqonda ngenkqubo yoLawulo lweMali. Ulwazi ngokuqhagamshelana noluntu nakwendlela yokubeka imisebenzi. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zoLawulo lweMali. Ilayisensi yokushuka. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba nakusebenza ngeyure ezongezelelweyo. Ikhompyutha kufuneka ihlale ibikho: Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukulawula imali. Ukucinga ngokulula. Intetho ebuzwayo nengabuzwayo. Ukuzimisela ekubeni nomsebenzi. Ukuqhagamshelana ngezinto. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Ukushiywa kwendawo nokulawulwa. Ukwenza imisebenzi emininzi. Ukuzimisela ekubeni nokuphumelela. Ukubamba iqela. Ukuhlela ixesha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuzithanda, ukuqinisekisa, ukuqinisekisa, nokuhambelana nemigaqo.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi ongummiselo kule ngxulumana, nomgca wokuba ngowakho ndini nawe, kukulandela izinto ezenziwa kwilixesha elifutshane ekubeni kum: Yonakalisa inkxaso-mali, inkxaso-ntetho, ngenkxaso-ntetho yakho ngokwakho. Quka inkxaso-ntetho ekulawuleni iinkxaso-mali, iinkxaso-ntetho kunye nothungelwano lweekhomishani. Qinisekisa ukuba zishiywe zidlulise iindaba, amaxwebhu, kunye neemvume-mvimba zesiphakamiso, ngokubhalisa iileta, iimemo, iingxelo, kunye neemfanelo ezithunyelwa kwilixesha elifutshane. Qinisekisa ulondolazo lwendlela yokugcina amaxwebhu kwindawo yakho. Hlala uxela ngeendaba zomsebenzi ekulawuleni inkxaso-mali. Qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa inkqubo yemali kunye nokumisela inkqubo yemali. Biza kwaye uhlele iindaba, ukuba ngumamkela-wemiyalezo kwindawo ekuyo. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo oluqinisekileyo lweeklaimi zokutya. Gcina ulwazi ngalo lonke usebenziso olungenayo, uqinisekisa ukuba yonke imigiba iyafezwa. Qhagamshelana nabo bonke abanomdla kum. Qinisekisa ukusasazwa kolwazi namaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuba iifomu namaxwebhu axela ngeendaba ezimali, izixelo zotyalo-mali, kunye neemvuzo zabakhi akuba sentsomini. Yonakalisa inkxaso-ntetho yolawulo kwilixesha elifutshane. Qinisekisa izimvo ezintsha kunye nokunikela inkonzo kwilixesha elifutshane. Qinisekisa ukusetenziswa kweenkqubo zokulawula iingozi nokuhambelana nemigaqo. Qinisekisa ukulawula kakuhle abantu, izixhobo, kunye nemali kwilixesha elifutshane. Fundisa abasebenzi ngakunye nabalandeli ngendlela ekulungileyo yokwenza imisebenzi nokuhambelana nemigaqo yomsebenzi.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Finance
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 - R486 501 per annum (Level 08), (a basic salary)
jobs.summary: Manage budgets, administrative matters and expenditure compliance at a Department of Home Affairs office in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Financial Administration or related field at NQF Level 6 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 2 years’ experience in Administrative Officer/ Chief Administration Clerk is required. Experience in administration of office budget is required. Knowledge of National Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Extensive knowledge of various filing systems. Knowledge and Understanding of departmental Legislations and Prescripts. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management process and procedures. Knowledge of Human Resource Regulatory Framework. A valid drivers’ license. Willingness to travel and work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: Planning and organizing. Analytical thinking. Problem Solving. Financial Administration. Verbal and Written Communication. Planning and Skills. Interpersonal. Customer Focus. Attention to Detail. Clerical and Administration. Multi Tasking. Results and Achievement focus. Teamwork. Time Management. Computer literacy. Patriotic, Honesty, Integrity and Accountability.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Coordinate and monitor the budget and administrative matters. Ensure compliance to policies and procedures for Budget management and control. Monitor implementation of expenditure and commitments against voted funds. Identify, recover and reporting all unauthorized, irregular and fruitless and wasteful expenditure. Coordinate and submit provincial inputs on Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Administer provincial adjustment Estimates including submissions regarding roll over funds, as well as other correspondence. Participate in budget planning as well as preparation of budget. Participate in the compilation of the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework and projections in the province. Maintain the Department Chart of Accounts at province. Monitor expenditure trends and reconciliation thereof against the budget and cash flow projections. Co-ordinate projections of anticipated expenditure & revenue. Facilitate the year end processes regarding budgetary management. Monitor revenue management processes. Monitor asset management in the Province. Ensure the implementation of effective risk and compliance management practices. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.
jobs.enquiries: KwaZulu-Natal: Ms N Ngema Tel No: (033) 845 5003
jobs.applications: Applications compliant with the “Directions to Applicants” above, must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za KwaZulu-Natal: Physical address: 181 Church Street, Pietermaritzburg, 3209.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za sent to the correct address specified at the bottom of the posts, on or before the closing date, accompanied by a fully completed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021), obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za, citing the correct post number and job title, and a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date dd/mm/yy), job title, duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of at least two contactable employment references (as recent as possible), regardless of online or manual submission. Where a valid Driver's License and a Professional Driving Permit (PDP) is a requirement, this must be indicated on the CV. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Shortlisted candidates will also be required to submit a copy of their ID document, a valid driver’s license (if specified as a job requirement), relevant educational qualifications / RPL certificates / Academic Transcripts of completed qualifications, and Acting letters as directed. Furthermore, applicants who possess (a) foreign qualification(s), are required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications, as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity, will be subjected to an interview, various relevant tests and assessments, and employment suitability checks (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, and employment references including verification of exit reasons, and conducting business with State). Once appointed, serving of a prescribed probation period, and obtaining of a security clearance appropriate to the post, will be required. Correspondence between the Department and candidates will be limited to shortlisted candidates, ONLY. The DHA is a merit-based, equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In line with its commitment to promoting representivity, in the filling of entry-level positions preference may be given to locally based candidates on grounds of affordability as well as to (unemployed) youth and the DHA’s interns and learners who have successfully completed their respective skills development programmes. In the filling of all posts, preference may be afforded to persons with disabilities, and in respect of SMS-level posts, to women. Persons falling in these categories and who meet the post requirements are preferred. The DHA complies with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act No. 4 of 2013). Applicants’ personal information will be used for recruitment purposes, retained where required for audit, and safeguarded against unauthorised disclosure, except where legally required. Submission of an application constitutes consent to such processing. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Finansies
af.summary: Bestuur begrotings, administratiewe sake en besteding-nakoming by 'n Departement van Binnelandse Sake-kantoor in KwaZulu-Natal.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Finansiële Administrasie of 'n verwante veld op NQF Vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 2 jaar se ondervinding as Administratiewe Beampte/ Hoofadministratiewe Klerk word vereis. Ondervinding in die administrasie van 'n kantoorbegroting word vereis. Kennis van Nasionale Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis van die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet (PFMA). Uitgebreide kennis van verskeie lêerstelsels. Kennis en begrip van departementele Wetgewing en Voorskrifte. Kennis van die Reguleringsraamwerk vir die Openbare Diens. Kennis van die voorsieningskettingbestuursproses en -prosedures. Kennis van die Menslike Hulpbronne Reguleringsraamwerk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en verlengde ure te werk. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Beplanning en organisering. Analitiese denke. Probleemoplossing. Finansiële Administrasie. Verbale en Skriftelike Kommunikasie. Beplanning en Vaardighede. Interpersoonlik. Kliëntefokus. Aandag aan detail. Klerik en Administrasie. Multitaak. Resultate en prestasiefokus. Spanwerk. Tydbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Patriotisme, Eerlikheid, Integriteit en Verantwoordelikheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: Koördineer en monitor die begroting en administratiewe sake. Verseker nakoming van beleide en prosedures vir begrotingsbestuur en -beheer. Monitor implementering van besteding en verbintenisse teenoor gestemde fondse. Identifiseer, herstel en rapporteer alle ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige en nuttelose en vermorsende besteding. Koördineer en dien provinsiale insette oor Skattings van Nasionale Besteding (ENE) in. Administreer provinsiale aanpassingskattings insluitend voorleggings met betrekking tot oorpligtingsfondse, asook ander korrespondensie. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning asook voorbereiding van begroting. Neem deel aan die samestelling van die Mediumtermynbestedingsraamwerk en projeksies in die provinsie. Handhaaf die Departement se Rekeningkundige Plan in die provinsie. Monitor bestedingstendense en die versoenings daarvan teenoor die begroting en kontantvloei-projeksies. Koördineer projeksies van verwagte besteding en inkomste. Fasiliteer die jaareindeprosesse met betrekking tot begrotingsbestuur. Monitor inkomste-bestuursprosesse. Monitor batesbestuur in die Provinsie. Verseker die implementering van doeltreffende risiko- en nakomingsbestuurspraktyke. Verseker doeltreffende en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die Eenheid. Afrig en lei personeel oor beste praktyke en nakoming van reguleringsvereistes.

xh.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wolawulo: izimali
xh.summary: Lawula amabhajeti, izinto ezithintelwe lolawulo nokuzaliseka kweendleko ezisemthethweni kwiofisi ye Department of Home Affairs e KwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Isexwayiso esingaphantsi kwesidanga seNQF Level 6 kwiFinancial Administration okanye kundzima ephathelene nayo njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Kufuneka kube khona owona mdlalo ubuncinane unyaka wama-2 wamava njengoba kunjalo kwisikhundla seAdministrative Officer/ Chief Administration Clerk. Kufuneka kube namava kulawulo lebhejethi yofisi. Ulwazi ngeNational Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi ngePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi olubanzi ngezinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokugcina iifayile. Ulwazi nokuqonda iMithetho nemimiselo yesebe. Ulwazi ngePublic Service Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo neenqambo zoLawulo loHambelo lweziQithi. Ulwazi ngeHuman Resource Regulatory Framework. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethembekileyo. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezinde ngesiqu. Iikhompetensi nezakhono efunekayo: Ulungiselelo nokuqamba. Ukucinga ngokuhlaziya. Isonjululwa ziinkinga. Ulawulo lwezimali. Unonxibelelwano ngemlomo nangokubhalwayo. Ulungiselelo nezakhono. Unxibelelwano nabantu. Ukuqwalasela iimfuno zabathengi. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Ulawulo lweekalamba nolawulo. Ukwenza izinto ezininxiwana ngexesha elinye. Ukuqwalasela iziphumeleko neziphumo. Ukusebenza njengesigqiza. Ulawulo lwexesha. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uthando lwezwe, inyaniso, intlonelo nokupeakisa.
xh.duties: Omele ophumelelayo uzakubenako ukuphatha, phakathi kwezinye, ezi msebenzi ethile: Ukuqamba kunye nokuqwalasela ibhajethi nezinto ezithintelwe lolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kweenkqubo neenqambo ngolawulo nolawulo lwebhajethi. Qwalasela ukuphunyezwa kweendleko neziyalekiso ngokuchasene nemali evotelwe. Qamba, fumana ngenene ugqibo nokuvelisa yonke imali engasebenziswanga ngokungalunganga, engahambanga kolunye uhlobo netyala elinganxebiswanga. Qamba uthathe iimveliso zephondo malunga neEstimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Lawula iEstimates zokulungiselela izabelo zephondo kuquka nezipho njengazo zonke izipho ezimalunga nento yokugqibelela kunye nezinye iindlela zokuthumela. Thatha inxaxheba kulungiselelo nokuqamba lwebhajethi kwakunye nokuqamba lwebhajethi. Thatha inxaxheba ekudityaneni kweMedium-Term Expenditure Framework nakuqamba iiprojekthi kwiphondo. Gcina iChart of Accounts yesebe kwiphondo. Qwalasela iindlela zokuchithwa kwemali nokudityaniswa kwayo ngokuchasene nebhejethi neeprojekthi zomkhondo wemali. Qamba iiprojekthi zokuchithwa kwemali kunye nemali ethi ingenayo. Yenza izinkqubo zonyaka wokugqibela ngokumayelana nolawulo lwebhajethi. Qwalasela iinkqubo zolawulo lwemali engenayo. Qwalasela ulawulo lweempahla kwiphondo. Qinisekisa ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ezisebenzayo zolawuloengooyoyo nekompliance. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusebenza ngokukhawuleza kwemali abantu, eziyinzima nezimali ngaphakathi kweQhiqimba. Fundisa kwaye ulonge abasebenzi ngaphezu kweenkqubo ezona zilungileyo nangokuzaliseka kweenkqubo ezisemthethweni ezifunekayo.

zu.title: Unozigodi Phakathi Ophethe Izindaba: Izimali
zu.summary: Phatha amabhajethi, izindaba zokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza kanye nokuhambisana nokusebenziswa kwemali esikhungweni se-Department of Home Affairs e-KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: Isiqu semfundo esingenaphansi ekusebenziseni izimali noma inkombo ehlobene nalo ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka ubenoSizo oluncane lweminyaka engu-2 ohlwini lwenzo njengoMphathi Wezinsizakusebenza/ NjengenaKlaki Khulu Ephethe Izindaba. Kudingeka kube nokuba nohlwayo ekuphatheni ibhajethi yenhlangano. Ukwazi ngemithetho ye-National Treasury Regulations. Ukwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ukwazi kakhulu ngamaphethini ahluhlukene okulondoloza amafayela. Ukwazi ukuqonda imithetho nezincwadi ezilawula umnyango. Ukwazi i-Public Service Regulatory Framework. Ukwazi inqubo namanyathelo ye-Supply Chain Management. Ukwazi i-Human Resource Regulatory Framework. Ilayisense yokushayela. Ukubekezela ekuzulazuleni nokusebenza amahora amanengi. Amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala. Ukucubungula amakhono. Ukuhlobana nabantu. Ukuqonda izidingo zabathengi. Ukuqesha ukuqonda imininingwane. Ukusebenza ngamaphephandabo nokuphathwa kwezindaba. Ukwenza izindima eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ukuqonda ukufeza imigomo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Uthando wezwe, Ukuqotho, Ukuzinza, kanye noBubele.
zu.duties: Umfundi opumelelayo uzobe negunya lokuphatha phakathi kweminye imisebenzi elandelayo ehluke khona: Uhlele futhi ulawule ibhajethi kanye nezindaba zokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho namanyathelo ekuphathweni kwe bhajethi nasekulawuleni. Lawula ukuqashwa komsebenzi wokusebenziswa kwemali kanye nezibopho uma kubhekwana namafondi avunyelwe. Qaphela, buyisa bese ubika ngemali ehlukunywe ngaphandle kwemithetho, engahambisana nenyanga noma eholela ekulahlekelweni kanye namabi. Hlela bese uthumela imininingwane yesifunda mayelana ne-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Phatha izilinganiso zesikhathi sonyaka zesifunda okuhlanganisa nokuthunywa imininingwane mayelana namafondi ahanjiswe phambili, kanye namanye amawadi. Bamba iqhaza ekuhlelweni kwe bhajethi kanye nokulungiselelwa kwayo. Bamba iqhaza ekwakheni i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework kanye nemibono yesikhathi esizayo esifundeni. Gcina umkhondo we-Department Chart of Accounts esifundeni. Lawula izinkambiso ezimalini ezisebenziswa bese ulinganisa ne bhajethi kanye nemibono yokuqhubelela kwemali. Hlela imibono yemali ebelwe ukuthi izosebenziswa kanye nemali engenayo. Siza inqubo yesikhathi sokuqedwa konyaka ekuphathweni kwe bhajethi. Lawula imikhondo ekuphathweni kwemali engenayo. Lawula ukuphathwa kwezimpahla Esifundeni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemikhuba engcono yokuqashwa kwengozi nokuhambisana. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kahle kwemali yabantu, yezinto nezimali ngaphakathi kweqembu. Qeqesha bese uhola izisebenzi ngamanye amakhono amahle kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo ezimiswe umthetho.

jobs.title: Immigration Officer: Inspectorate

jobs.salary_text: R280 278 - R330 162 per annum (Level 06), (a basic salary)
jobs.summary: Immigration officers are sought across multiple KwaZulu-Natal offices to enforce immigration legislation, detect and detain illegal foreigners, and process deportations.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Law, Public Management, Public Administration, Policing Criminology, Forensics or Criminal Justice at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA is required. Basic understanding of the Refugees Act and Immigration Act. Basic understanding of South African Constitution. Basic understanding the Immigration Act. Basic understanding Public Service Regulatory Framework. A valid driver’s license (Code B/C1/C/ EC1). Valid Public Driver Permit (PDP). Willingness to travel outside the borders and work extended hours Required skills and competencies: Liaison and interpersonal skills. Problem Solving Skills. Customer orientation. Planning and Organising. Strong Analytical Skills. Computer Literacy. Written and verbal communication. Diplomacy. Patriotic, Honesty and Integrity.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Effective enforcement of the Immigration Act 13 of 2002 as amended and other Legislation. Detect, trace, detain and prosecute illegal foreigners within the country. Process the deportation of illegal foreigners out of the country to their country of origin. Provide support on law enforcement investigations and anti-corruption cases. Conduct inspections in loco with or without warrant as allowed by law. Conduct investigations on any transgressions of the Immigration Act, 2002, the Refugee Act, 1998 or other departmental legislation. Enable prosecutions of transgressions of departmental legislation and the Criminal Procedure Act. Issue notices to appear in front of the Director–General to transgressors. Process and present evidence in court and Departmental cases. Issue admission of guilt to fines to transgressors. Conduct interviews and investigation of foreigners who are suspected to be illegal in the transgressors. Process the application and the extensions of detention warrants. Monitor the records of all cases. Monitor the influx of foreigners residing in the country with no legal documentation. Implement incidental matters ensure that the identity of illegal foreigner who are arrested, detained or convicted. Conduct arrests and deporting of illegal foreigners who are unwilling to leave the country voluntarily. Participate in training session that will enable advanced knowledge and understanding in detecting illegal foreigners in line with Immigration Act.No13 of 2002 as amended and enforcing departmental legislation. Ensure compliance with the terms and conditions of permits. Participate in the processing of illegal foreigners for deportation to their country of origin. Participate in law enforcement operations with other security cluster agencies. Provide expert evidence and statement to support law enforcement and crime combatting investigation efforts that require departmental evidence. Participate in regular training and personal development to be able to undertake the tasks as an effective law enforcement peace office. Conduct deportation processes and keep records of foreigners (legal and illegal) in the country. Safe keep, maintain and manage state properties and assets. Implement policies and procedures in line with the approved Framework. Monitor individual resources (Physical).

Once appointed, serving of a prescribed probation period, and obtaining of a security clearance appropriate to the post, will be required. Correspondence between the Department and candidates will be limited to shortlisted candidates, ONLY. The DHA is a merit-based, equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In line with its commitment to promoting representivity, in the filling of entry-level positions preference may be given to locally based candidates on grounds of affordability as well as to (unemployed) youth and the DHA’s interns and learners who have successfully completed their respective skills development programmes. af.title: Immigrasiebeampte: Inspektoraat
af.summary: Daar word in verskeie KwaZulu-Natal kantore na immigrasiebeamptes gesoek om immigrasiewetgewing toe te pas, onwettige buitelanders op te spoor en aan te hou, en uitsettings te verwerk.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Regte, Openbare Bestuur, Openbare Administrasie, Polisie Kriminologie, Forensies of Strafregreg by NQF level 6 soos deur SAQA erken, word vereis. Basiese begrip van die Refugees Act en Immigration Act. Basiese begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Basiese begrip van die Immigration Act. Basiese begrip van die Openbare Dienst Regulerende Raamwerk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Code B/C1/C/ EC1). Geldige Public Driver Permit (PDP). Bereidwilligheid om buite die grense te reis en verlengde ure te werk Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Skakeling en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Klïentegerigtheid. Beplanning en Organisering. Sterk Analitiese Vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Skriftelike en verbale kommunikasie. Diplomasie. Vaderlandsliewend, Eerlikheid en Integriteit.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: Doeltreffende toepassing van die Immigration Act 13 of 2002 soos gewysig en ander wetgewing. Opsporing, opsporing, aanhouding en vervolging van onwettige buitelanders binne die land. Verwerk die uitsetting van onwettige buitelanders uit die land na hul land van herkoms. Verskaf ondersteuning by wetstoepassingsondersoeke en korrupsiebestrydingsake. Voer inspeksies in loco met of sonder 'n lasbrief soos deur die wet toegelaat. Voer ondersoeke uit na enige oortredings van die Immigration Act, 2002, die Refugee Act, 1998 of ander departementele wetgewing. Moontlik maak die vervolging van oortredings van departementele wetgewing en die Criminal Procedure Act. Reeis kennisgewings om voor die Director–General te verskyn aan oortreders. Verwerk en lê getuienis voor in die hof en departementele sake. Reeis skuldige bevindings en boetes aan oortreders. Voer onderhoude en ondersoeke uit na buitelanders wat vermoedelik onwettig in die land is by die oortreders. Verwerk die aansoek en die verlenging van aanhoudingslasbriewe. Monitor die rekords van alle sake. Monitor die toestroming van buitelanders wat sonder wettige dokumentasie in die land woon. Implementeer toevallige sake en verseker die identiteit van onwettige buitelanders wat gearresteer, aangehou of skuldig bevind is. Voer arrestasies en uitsettings uit van onwettige buitelanders wat nie gewillig is om die land vrywillig te verlaat nie. Neem deel aan oefensessies wat gevorderde kennis en begrip in die opsporing van onwettige buitelanders in ooreenstemming met die Immigration Act.No13 of 2002 soos gewysig en die toepassing van departementele wetgewing sal moontlik maak. Verseker nakoming van die bepalings en voorwaardes van permitte. Neem deel aan die verwerking van onwettige buitelanders vir uitsetting na hul land van herkoms. Neem deel aan wetstoepassingsoperasies met ander veiligheidsklusteragentskappe. Verskaf kundige getuienis en verklarings om wetstoepassings- en misdaadbestrydingsondersoekpogings te ondersteun wat departementele getuienis vereis. Neem deel aan gereelde opleiding en persoonlike ontwikkeling om die take as 'n doeltreffende wetstoepassingsvreedsame beampte te kan uitvoer. Voer uitsettingsprosesse uit en hou rekords van buitelanders (wettig en onwettig) in die land. Bewaar, onderhou en bestuur staats eiendomme en bates. Implementeer beleide en prosedures in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde raamwerk. Monitor individuele hulpbronne (Fisies).

zu.title: Inkholojininathi yokuZula: Isikhulu sokuhlola
zu.summary: Izikhulu zokuHamba kwezwe zifunwa kumahhovisi amaningi eKwaZulu-Natal ukuze ziqinise imithetho yokuhamba kwezwe, zithole futhi zibambe abanye bangaphandle abangashiedile, futhi zihlele ukudluliselwa kwabo baphindele ezweni labo.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibe naloluhlobo lwemfundo ephakeme yebanga lokuqala enqabeni elibekwe kuNQF level 6 njengoba kuvunyiwe i-SAQA kwezomthetho, eziphathwe kahle, eziphathwe kahle ezikahulumeni, ephathwe kwezokubeka inqubo, e-forensics noma komthetho webugebengu. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomthetho wezRefugiyesi nangomthetho wokuHamba kwezwe. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomthetho wokuHamba kwezwe. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngesivumelwano sesekelo lasezikhungweni kahulumeni. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (Ikhodi B/C1/C/EC1). Isivumelwano sokushayela sasezikhungweni kahulumeni (PDP) esevumelekile. ukuzithoba ukuhamba ngaphandle kwemingcele nokusebenza amahora amude izikhonzi namakhono abadingekayo namakhono okubambisana: Amakhono okuxhumana nokwazana. Amakhono okuxazwa izinkinga. Ukuba nombhalo oqonde kumthengi. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Amakhono okuhlonza izinto ngesibonakaliso obunamandla. Ukuba nesisekelo sezikhathi. Ukuba nesisekelo sokukhuluma nokubhala ngomlomo. Ukuphatha izindaba ngobuwula. Ubumuzi, ukuqotho nokuziphatha ngokuqotho.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumelele uzobe unamanye amalungu abekelwe abo abalandelayo. Ukuqinisekiswa komthetho wokuHamba kwezwe uMthetho no-13 ka-2002 njengokuqinisekiswa kwelunga elithile kwabanye bese kunjalo nokwenziwa kwezinye izindleko ezibekelwe umthetho. Ukuthola, ukulandelana, ukubamba nokushushiswa abantu abangaphandle abangafuni kusuke kudlula amakhasimende abo ngokungashiedileyo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokudluliselwa abantu abangaphandle abangashiedileyo abangaphandle kwesive seNyakatho abayilawulayo baphinde ezweni abayiyo. Ukunika isizo ekuphenyeni amacala ezomthetho nezinye izindaba ezimalunga nokuqiniswa komthetho nokulwa nobuqili. Ukuqinisekisa amalungiselelo okuvela kuleminyaka ebanzi kuye nawe yize angavunyelwa ngomthetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphenya noma iyiphi na imisitha ngomthetho wokuHamba kwezwe ka-2002, uMthetho wokuBekwa kanye nezinye iMithetho yesiFunda. Ukuqinisekiswa kokushushiswa kokungenwa emthethweni wesiFunda noMthetho weNqubo yeMithetho eqotho. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlinzeka abambe ngesazisa ngokubakhuluma kwiNkundla yaseNyakatho ngokushushiswa kwabo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlinzeka ngemvume yokuzuza kuvalwe abantu abangenwe yizimo ezibi kubahle bathole amacebo okugcina ukuthi baphele emthethweni. Ukuqinisekiswa nokubakhuluma ngesazisa esikhathini abakwenzayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlinzeka kwezinsiza nezinkomba ezazikwazi ukuhlinzeka abantu abangenwe ngokomthetho abangaphandle abangakwazi ukuhlala emthethweni. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezingezona ezomthetho ezakha amacebo okugcina amalungelo abo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuthola nokuphenya ngomthetho wokuhamba kwezwe kwabanzi abangangaphandle abangenzekiyo ngokungenwa kwabo okungenwa ngokomthetho. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuqamba nokuhlinzeka amacebo okugcina kubambe ngokuthi baphendule ngemizuzu yabo ukuze babekwe phansi komthetho.

xh.title: Iofisa woHamba-hamba: INkokeli yeMisebenzi yokuhlola
xh.summary: Kufunwa boHamba-hamba kumaziko amaninzi eKwaZulu-Natal ukuze bagcine umthetho wohamba-hamba, bafumne balibambe abantu bengamazwe abangekho mthethweni, balungise ukudlubula kwabo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka kubekho isidanga se-Certificate ukuya kwesi-4 kwelenguqu iNQF level 6 njengoko kubalulekile yi-SAQA. Ukuqonda okusesisekelu kwi-Refugees Act ne-Immigration Act. Ukuqonda okusesisekelu koMgaqo-siseko waseMzantsi Afrika. Ukuqonda okusesisekelu i-Immigration Act. Ukuqonda okusesisekelu iNkqubo yoLawulo lweZiko le-Service. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba elisebenzayo (i-Code B/C1/C/ EC1). I-Permit yokuQhuba iNtsika (PDP) esebenzayo. Ukuzithanda ukuhamba ngaphandle kumda wezilawuli nokusebenza iiyure eziza kongezwa. Ikhono neenkalo ezifuneka yile ndlela: Ikhono lokunxibelelana nountu. Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki. Ikhokelwe ngumthengi. Uyilo nokuhlela. Ikhono elinamandla lokuhlola. Ukuqonda ngakumbi ngemisebenzi ye-Computer. Ukunxibelelana ngokubhala nangokuthetha. Ikhono elinobugcisa bokuziphatha. Uthanda ilizwe, unyanisekile kwaye unobungathembeki.
xh.duties: Umntu ophumeleleyo uza kuxhamla kwezinye izinto, kumsebenzi olandelayo: Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwomthetho we-Immigration Act 13 of 2002 njengoko ulungisiwe nangolunye uMthetho. Ukuqaphela, ukufumana, ukubamba nokugxotha abantu abangekho mthethweni kwelilizwe. Ukuqhuba inkqubo yokudlubula abantu abangekho mthethweni baye elizweni labo bokuvela. Unika inkxaso kwiindaba zokuphenya ngomthetho nangemikrwa yokuziphanga. Ukuqhuba iindaba zokuhola eendaweni nangaphandle kwesaziso njengoko umthetho uvumela. Ukuqhuba iindaba zokuphenya ngokwahlukana komthetho we-Immigration Act, 2002, i-Refugee Act, 1998 okanye omnye umthetho weNdlu. Ukuqinisekisa ukwenza umthetho weNdlu kwaye ugxininise uMthetho weNdlu nokwenza iNkqubo yokuqala kwindlu yomthetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo iza kwenza umthetho kwindlu yomthetho.

jobs.title: Director-general
jobs.department: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
jobs.salary_text: R2 446 749 – R2 756 241 per annum (Level 16), (an all-inclusive remuneration package), plus 10% non-pensionable allowance payable to Head of Departments (HoDs) for a five (5) year term.
jobs.summary: Lead the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development as Director-General, providing strategic executive oversight of justice administration and legislative reform for a five-year term.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 8 qualification recognized by SAQA in Law, Public Administration, Public Management, Business Administration or a related field. Admission as an Attorney or Advocate will be an added advantage. A minimum of ten (10) years' experience at senior managerial level, of which a substantial portion must have been gained at executive leadership level within a large, complex organization. Proven experience in organizational transformation, strategic planning, institutional performance, governance, financial management, policy development and stakeholder management is essential. Executive leadership experience within the Public Service will serve as a distinct advantage. Extensive knowledge of constitutional and administrative law; criminal law; labour law; international law; legislative drafting; justice administration; litigation and State legal services; constitutional democracy; human rights; public administration; organizational development; information and communication technology; public sector governance; the Public Service Act; Public Service Regulations; Public Finance Management Act; Treasury Regulations; Government planning frameworks; and financial management within the Public Service. Skills and Competencies: Exceptional strategic leadership and executive management capability, with the ability to provide strategic direction and translate Government priorities into measurable organizational outcomes. Demonstrated capability in programme and project management, financial management, organizational transformation and change management, knowledge management, service delivery innovation, governance and organizational performance. Strong analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving capability. Excellent people management, communication, stakeholder management and customer service orientation. Ability to build strategic partnerships, lead multidisciplinary executive teams, manage organizational risk and drive organizational performance. High levels of professionalism, ethical leadership, innovation, accountability and commitment to public service values.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and overall management of the Department to ensure the effective administration of justice and implementation of its constitutional and legislative mandate. Oversee the development, reform and implementation of legislation, legal services and policies that promote constitutional democracy, human rights and the rule of law. Provide strategic oversight of court administration services, including lower court administration, the Integrated Criminal Justice System and programmes supporting vulnerable groups. Oversee the administration of Master's Services and Family Law Services, including deceased estates, trusts, insolvencies, guardianship administration and family advocate services. Direct the provision of State legal advisory and litigation services on behalf of Government and organs of State. Ensure effective financial management, strategic planning, governance, enterprise risk management, internal audit, organizational performance and transformation and regulatory compliance. Strengthen intergovernmental relations, cluster coordination, entity oversight and strategic partnerships, and oversee programmes that advance constitutional values and social justice. Serve as principal adviser to the Executive Authority on matters relating to the Department's mandate and strategic direction.
jobs.applications: Quoting the relevant reference number, direct your application to: https://forms.office.com/r/X2XaVPasWu OR Postal address: The Human Resources: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, Private Bag X81, Pretoria, 0001 OR Physical address: Application Box, First Floor Reception, East Tower, Momentum Building, 329 Pretorius Street, Pretoria.

Applicants who possess foreign qualification(s), are furthermore required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA).All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. These assessments are aimed at assessing candidate’s professional and technical competency against the job requirements and duties, general job fit, integrity and digital literacy). All shortlisted candidates for SMS positions will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural, emotional intelligence and integrity. All suitable candidates will be subjected to mandatory pre-employment screening/ suitability checks/ verification (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, employment pending disciplinary action and professional registration. Suitable candidates for Senior Management Service positions will also be required to successfully complete the online Nyukela Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services course, which can be accessed via: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.
