af.title: Direkteur-generaal
af.summary: Lei die Department of Justice and Constitutional Development as Direkteur-generaal en bied strategiese uitvoerende toesig oor regsadministrasie en wetgewende hervorming vir 'n termyn van vyf jaar.
af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 8-kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word in Regte, Publieke Administrasie, Publieke Bestuur, Besigheidsadministrasie of 'n verwante veld. Toelating as 'n Prokureur of Advokaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak, waarvan 'n aansienlike deel op uitvoerende leierskapsvlak binne 'n groot, komplekse organisasie opgedoen moes gewees het. Bewese ervaring in organisatoriese transformasie, strategiese beplanning, institusionele prestasie, bestuur, finansiële bestuur, beleidsontwikkeling en belanghebbende-bestuur is essensieel. Uitvoerende leierskapservaring binne die Openbare Diens sal as 'n duidelike voordeel dien. Uitgebreide kennis van grondwetlike en administratiewe regte; strafreg; arbeidsreg; internasionale reg; wetgewende opstel; regsadministrasie; litigasie en Staatsregsdienste; grondwetlike demokrasie; menseregte; publieke administrasie; organisatoriese ontwikkeling; inligting en kommunikasietegnologie; openbare-sektorbestuur; die Public Service Act; Public Service Regulations; Public Finance Management Act; Treasury Regulations; Regeringsbeplanningsraamwerke; en finansiële bestuur binne die Openbare Diens. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitsonderlike strategiese leierskap en uitvoerende bestuursvermoë, met die vermoë om strategiese rigting te bied en Regeringsprioriteite in meetbare organisatoriese uitkomste te vertaal. Bewese vermoë in program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, organisatoriese transformasie en veranderingbestuur, kennisbestuur, diensleweringinnovering, bestuur en organisatoriese prestasie. Sterke analitiese, strategiese dink- en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Uitstekende mensebestuur, kommunikasie, belanghebbende-bestuur en kliëntediensgerigtheid. Vermoë om strategiese vennootskappe te bou, multidissiplinêre uitvoerende spanne te lei, organisatoriese risiko te bestuur en organisatoriese prestasie te dryf. Hoë vlakke van professionaliteit, etiese leierskap, innovasie, aanspreeklikheid en toewyding aan openbare dienswaardes.
af.duties: Bied strategiese leierskap en algehele bestuur van die Departement om die effektiewe administrasie van reg te verseker en die implementering van sy grondwetlike en wetgewende mandaat. Oorsien die ontwikkeling, hervorming en implementering van wetgewing, regsdienste en beleide wat grondwetlike demokrasie, menseregte en die regsstaat bevorder. Bied strategiese toesig oor hofadministrasiedienste, insluitend laerhofadministrasie, die Geïntegreerde Strafregstelsel en programme wat kwesbare groepe ondersteun. Oorsien die administrasie van Meester se Dienste en Familieregdienste, insluitend oorlede boedels, truste, insolvensies, voogdyadministrasie en familie-advokaatsdienste. Rig die voorsiening van Staatsregsadvies- en litigasiedienste namens die Regering en Staatsorgane. Verseker effektiewe finansiële bestuur, strategiese beplanning, bestuur, ondernemingsrisikobestuur, interne oudit, organisatoriese prestasie en transformasie en regulatoriese nakoming. Versterk interregeringsverhoudinge, klusterkoördinasie, entiteits toesig en strategiese vennootskappe, en oorsien programme wat grondwetlike waardes en sosiale reg bevorder. Dien as hoofadviseur van die Uitvoerende Gesag oor aangeleenthede rakende die Departement se mandaat en strategiese rigting.

zu.title: Umongameli-jikelele
zu.summary: Hola umnyango we-Department of Justice and Constitutional Development njengoMongameli-Jikelele, unikeze olunye ukuqondisa okuyisigaba esiphezulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwezobulungiswa nenkululeko yomthetho isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF Level 8 ezivunywe yi-SAQA kuMthetho, ukuqashelwa kwezomphakathi, ukuqashelwa kwebhizinisi, ukuqashelwa kwezamabhizinisi noma inkambu ephathelene nayo. Ukungamiswa njengommeli noma i-Advocate kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ukuhleleka okungenani kweminyaka eyishumi (10) kwesipiliyoni samabanquli, lapho kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi kuqoqiwe kulesigaba sabaphathi abaphezulu ngaphakathi kwenhlangano enkulu eyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuhlolwa okushiwo ngokuguqulwa kwenhlangano, ukuhlelelwa okuhlelekile, ukusebenza kwenhlangano, ukuphathwa, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo nokuphathwa kwezimoto kubalulekile. Isipiliyoni sobuholi besigaba esiphezulu ngaphakathi koMphakathi we-Zenzele sizonikeza inzuzo ehlukile. Ukuqonda okusuka kakhulu ngomthethosisekelo nomthetho wokuphathwa; umthetho webhekaya; umthetho wabasebenzi; umthetho wamazwe ngamazwe; ukubhalwa komthetho; ukuphathwa kwezobulungiswa; izinkantolo nezinkonzo zomthetho zesiZwe; intando yeningi yomthethosisekelo; izinkululeko zomuntu; ukuphathwa kwezomphakathi; ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlangano; ulwazi nobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana; ukuphathwa kwezomphakathi ngokusemthethweni; umthetho we-Public Service Act; imithesho ye-Public Service Regulations; umthetho we-Public Finance Management Act; imithesho ye-Treasury Regulations; izakhiwo zokuqamba kahle zikahulumathi; nokuphathwa kwezimali ngaphakathi koMphakathi we-Zenzele. Amakhono namandla: Ikakhulukazi amandla okuqamba kabi nobuphathi besigaba esiphezulu, ngenhlonipho yokunikeza isiqondiso esihlelekile futhi uguqule izinhloso zikahulumathi zibe yiphumelo elingeniswa yenhlangano. Ukuboniswa kwamandla ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo nemikhiqizo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuguqulwa kwenhlangano nokuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuthuthukiswa kwensizakalo, ukuphathwa nokusebenza kwenhlangano. Amandla aqinile okuhlaziya, okucabanga okuhlelekile nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwezihloko okuhle, ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwezimoto nokujwayeleka kwesevisi yamakhasimende. Amandla okwakha ubudlelwano obuhle,okuqamba ngaphandle kokuhweba, ukuphatha amaqembu ahlukene kanye nokuqondisa ukusebenza kwenhlangano. Izinga eliphezulu le-sitjhaba, ukuphathwa ngokuzethemba, amandla amakhulu, ukuziphendulela kanye nesibopho samagugu oMphakathi we-Zenzele.
zu.duties: Nikeza ubuholi esihlelekile kanye nokuphatha ngokuphelele umnyango ngokugcine ukuphathwa kwezobulungiswa nokuphathwa kwebango lalo lomthethosisekelo lomthetho. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa, ukuguqulwa nokuphathwa komthetho, izinkonzo zomthetho namagugu okuthuthukisa intando yeningi yomthethosisekelo, izinkululeko zomuntu nomthetho. Nikeza ukuqondisa okuhle kwiinkonzo zokuphathwa kwezinkantolo, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezinkantolo ezingezansi, i-Integrated Criminal Justice System namabhulogi asekela amaqembu abathathwa kakhulu. Qaphela ukuphathwa kwe-Master's Services kanye ne-Family Law Services, okuhlanganisa amafa abashonile, i-trusts, i-insolvencies, ukuphathwa kwezokuqaphela kanye nezinkonzo ze-family advocate. Qondisa ukunikelwa kwezomthetho zeluleko noma izinkantolo ngokwesizwe kusiZwe nezithiyo zesiZwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuhlelwa okuhlelekile, ukuphathwa, ukuphathwa kokungcwatshiwa kokuba ngengozi, ukuhlolwa kwangaphakathi, ukusebenza kwenhlangano nokushintsha kanye nokuziphendulela ngokomthetho. Qinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kohulumathi, ukuqondanisa kweqembu, ukuqaphela izinhlelo kanye nobudlelwano, futhi uqaphele izinhlelo eziqhubela phambili amagagu esizwe nobulungiswa bahle. Phekula njengeluleki elikhulu kuGunyazi ngamaphuzu ahlobene neSibopho somnyango nesiqondiso esihlelekile.

xh.title: Umntu ongusihlalo weNkundla
xh.summary: Yiba ngumlawuli-jikelele kwiSebe loBulungisa nentuthuko yoMgaqo-siseko, unikezela nengqondo ephakamileyo ekulawulweni kokusingathwa kolweso ngokusesigqakeni kunye nokulungiselelwa kolweso-mthetho kwelixesha leminyaka elihlu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi seNqanaba le-8 le-NQF esamkelwe yi-SAQA kwiMthetho, uLawulo loLuntu, uLawulo nokuLawulwa koluntu, uLawulo lweShishini okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Ukungena njengogqethi okanye ngummeli kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Amava okuqeqeshwa abayi-10 (10) kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo, apho inxalenye enkulu kufuneka ithathwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lembuso ngaphakathi kwishishini elikhulu, elibucukubedwane. Amava aboniswe kuguqulo loluntu ngokusesigqakeni, ulungiselelwa ngokusesigqakeni, ukusebenza kwehlabathi ngokusesigqakeni, uLawulo, uLawulo lweMal, uphuhliso lweenkqubo nolawulo lwabathengi baluleke kakhulu. Amava okulawula ngokusesigqakeni ngaphakathi kuSebenzo loLuntu lukaRhulumente kuya kuba lusizo olukhulu. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nomthetho womgaqo-siseko nolawulo loluntu; umthetho wobugqi; umthetho basebenzi; umthetho wamazwe ngamazwe; ukubhalwa kolweso-mthetho; ukusingathwa kolweso; izigwebo kunye neenkonzo zomthetho zoRhulumente; intsinzo yomthetho-siseko; amalungelo oluntu; ulawulo loluntu; uphuhliso loluntu; ulwazi nolonwabo lwesixhobo; uLawulo loLuntu ngokusesigqakeni; umthetho wokuSebenza koluntu; Iimigaqo yokuSebenza koluntu; umthetho woLawulo loVuzo woRhulumente; Iimigaqo yoVuzo; iinkqubo zolungiselelo zoRhulumente; nolawulo lweMal ngaphakathi kuSebenzo loLuntu lukaRhulumente. Amakhono namakhono: Ikhono elikhulu lokulawula ngokusesigqakeni nokuLawulwa ngokusesigqakeni, elinamandla okunika isalathiso ngokusesigqakeni nokuqamba iinkqaba zoRhulamente zibe ngemiphumela ekubakalwe ngayo ukusebenza koluntu. Ikhono elibonisiweyo ekulawulweni kweenkqubo namaphulo, ekulawulweni kweMal, ekuguqulweni koluntu nakulawulweni lokuTshintsha, ekulawulweni kolwazi, ekwaziseni iinkonzo ezintsha, kuLawulweni nakusebenzeni koluntu ngokusesigqakeni. Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlola ngokusesigqakeni, nokuqamba ngokusesigqakeni nokusombulula iingxaki. Ukulawula abantu, ukunxibelelana, ukulawula abathengi nokunaka iinkonzo zabathengi. Ikhono lokwakha ubudlelwane ngokusesigqakeni, ukulawula amaqela angabamelana abukhali nabalawuli basebenza, ukulawula iingozi koluntu nokukhuthaza ukusebenza koluntu ngokusesigqakeni. Ikhondo eliphezulu lokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe, ukulawula ngokuziphatha kakuhle, ukuyila iinto ezintsha, ukuziphathisa nokuqinisekisa amagunya nokuqinisekisa iindlela zokusebenza koluntu.
xh.duties: Nika isalathiso ngokusesigqakeni nokuLawulwa ngokubanzi kwiSebe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusingathwa kolweso ngokuchanekileyo nokusebenza kolweso-mthetho nokuQinisekiswa kolweso-mthetho. Lawula uphuhliso, ulungiso nokusebenza kolweso-mthetho, iinkonzo zomthetho neenkqabo ezikhuthaza intsinzo yomthetho-siseko, amalungelo oluntu nomthetho olawula. Nika isalathiso ngokusesigqakeni sokulawulwa kweenkonzo zeNkundla, kuquka ukulawulwa kweenkundla ezingozantsi, iNkqubo yoBulungisa ngokuBandakanya iYure nokuqinisekisa iinkqabo ezixhasa amaqela abaswelayo. Lawula ukusingathwa kweenkonzo ze-Sika namasebe oLwulo, kuquka izifa ezibekwe phantsi koLawulo, iitholakhi ezithenjiwe, iinkqubo ezingenamvuzo, ulawulo lwegadi kunye neenkonzo zomphakathi wolwulo. Qonda ukunika iinkonzo zomthetho nezigwebo zelizwe ngokusesigqakeni nangomzobo weRhulamente namaphandla oRhulamente. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokuchanekileyo kweMal, ukulungiselela ngokusesigqakeni, uLawulo, uLawulo lweengozi ngokusesigqakeni, ukuhlola ngaphakathi, ukusebenza koluntu ngokusesigqakeni nokuGuqula nokuziphatha ngokomthetho. Qinisekisa ubudlelwane phakathi koRhulumente namasebe oRhulamente, ukulawulwa kwamaqela, ukulawulwa koluntu nokuLawulwa ngokusesigqakeni, kwaye ulawule iinkqabo ezikhuthaza amagunya womthetho-siseko nolweso ngokwemiba yoluntu. Yiba ngumcebisi ophambili kulawuli loBukhosi kumagunya anxulumene namagunya eSebe nokuqonda ngokusesigqakeni.

jobs.title: Solicitor-general
jobs.department: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
jobs.salary_text: R2 446 749 – R2 756 241 per annum (Level 16), (an all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Lead national litigation strategy and oversee civil litigation across all State Attorney Offices as Solicitor-general within the Department of Justice.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 8 in Law or as recognised by SAQA. Admission as An Advocate or Attorney with right of appearance in the High Court of South Africa is essential. A minimum of ten (10) years' experience at senior managerial level. Extensive experience in Litigation and previous experience of litigating high- profile cases will be an added advantage. Comprehensive knowledge of the State Attorney Act, the State Attorney Amendment Act, the State Liability Act, the Public Finance Management Act, the Public Service Act and Regulations, applicable Treasury Regulations and Departmental prescripts. Extensive knowledge of litigation management, State legal services, organisational and government strategy, financial management, governance, organisational change, public administration and public sector regulatory frameworks. Sound understanding of Government priorities, strategic planning, organisational leadership and digital litigation management systems. Skills and Competencies: Exceptional strategic capability and leadership with the ability to develop and implement organisational strategies, provide strategic direction and inspire high performance. Demonstrated capability in programme and project management, financial management, governance, organisational transformation and change management. Strong knowledge management, service delivery innovation, analytical thinking and problem-solving capability. Excellent people management, stakeholder engagement, client orientation and communication skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate and build strategic partnerships across government and the legal profession. Demonstrated honesty, integrity, professionalism and commitment to ethical leadership and sound public administration. High levels of professionalism, ethical leadership, innovation, accountability and commitment to public service values.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership, governance oversight and national coordination of litigation involving the State. Oversee and coordinate civil litigation across all State Attorney Offices and establish national litigation strategies, governance frameworks, norms and standards to ensure consistent and effective legal representation of the State. Oversee the management of contingent liabilities and financial risks in accordance with the State Liability Act through the implementation of litigation risk management systems, expenditure control measures and strategies to reduce litigation costs. Monitor compliance with court orders and the execution of judgments by organs of State, establish mechanisms to monitor implementation, and escalate systemic non-compliance where necessary. Lead the development of national litigation policies, norms, directives and legal reform initiatives, provide strategic oversight on constitutional and precedent-setting litigation, and support legal research and international legal cooperation. Promote sound governance, ethical conduct, transparency and consequence management through compliance monitoring, investigation of litigation failures and implementation of corrective measures. Drive the transformation and professionalization of litigation services by promoting equitable briefing patterns, strengthening the capacity of State Attorney Offices, supporting the development of emerging legal practitioners and implementing professional standards and quality assurance systems. Department's Strategic Plan, ensuring sound financial and human resource management, implementing knowledge management and digital litigation systems, and monitoring organizational performance.
jobs.applications: Quoting the relevant reference number, direct your application to: https://forms.office.com/r/X2XaVPasWu OR Postal address: The Human Resources: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, Private Bag X81, Pretoria, 0001 OR Physical address: Application Box, First Floor Reception, East Tower, Momentum Building, 329 Pretorius Street, Pretoria.
jobs.notes: Applicants are invited to submit applications, quoting the relevant reference number to the link and or address indicated in each specific advertisement. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021, obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za), citing the correct post number and job title; a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date (dd/mm/yy), job title, detailed duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of three contactable employment references and copies of educational qualifications. Applicants who possess foreign qualification(s), are furthermore required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA).All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. These assessments are aimed at assessing candidate’s professional and technical competency against the job requirements and duties, general job fit, integrity and digital literacy). All shortlisted candidates for SMS positions will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural, emotional intelligence and integrity. All suitable candidates will be subjected to mandatory pre-employment screening/ suitability checks/ verification (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, employment pending disciplinary action and professional registration. Suitable candidates for Senior Management Service positions will also be required to successfully complete the online Nyukela Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services course, which can be accessed via: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates wishing to be considered for appointment, are encouraged to enrol for the course as soon as possible. Due to high volumes anticipated, communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (DOJ&CD) seeks to appoint exceptional, ethical and visionary leaders to join its executive leadership team in advancing constitutional democracy. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Department is committed to providing equal opportunities and affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Solicitor-general
af.summary: Lei nasionale litigasiestrategie en hou toesig oor siviele litigasie oor alle Staatsprokureurskantore as Solicitor-general binne die Department of Justice.
af.requirements: An NQF Level 8 in Law or as recognised by SAQA. Toelating as 'n Advokaat of Prokureur met verskyningreg in die Hooggeregshof van Suid-Afrika is essensieel. 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak. Uitgebreide ervaring in Litigasie en vorige ervaring van litigasie in hoëprofielsake sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Omvattende kennis van die State Attorney Act, die State Attorney Amendment Act, die State Liability Act, die Public Finance Management Act, die Public Service Act and Regulations, toepaslike Treasury Regulations en departementele voorskrifte. Uitgebreide kennis van litigasiebestuur, staatsregsdienste, organisatoriese en regeringsstrategie, finansiële bestuur, bestuur, organisatoriese verandering, openbare administrasie en openbaresektor regulerende raamwerke. Deeglike begrip van regeringsprioriteite, strategiese beplanning, organisatoriese leierskap en digitale litigasiebestuurstelsels. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitsonderlike strategiese vermoë en leierskap met die vermoë om organisatoriese strategieë te ontwikkel en te implementeer, strategiese rigting te gee en hoë prestasie te inspireer. Agetoonde vermoë in program- en projektebestuur, finansiële bestuur, bestuur, organisatoriese transformasie en veranderingsbestuur. Sterk kennisbestuur, dienslewering innovasie, analitiese denke en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Uitstekende menslikebestuur, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, kliëntoriëntasie en kommunikasievaardighede, met die vermoë om te beïnvloed, te onderhandel en strategiese vennootskappe oor regering en die regsberoep te bou. Agetoonde eerlikheid, integriteit, professionaliteit en toewyding aan etiese leierskap en goeie openbare administrasie. Hoë vlakke van professionaliteit, etiese leierskap, innovasie, aanspreeklikheid en toewyding aan openbare dienswaardes.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap, bestuursoor sig en nasionale koördinering van litigasie wat die Staat betref. Hou toesig oor en koördineer siviele litigasie oor alle Staatsprokureurskantore en stel nasionale litigasiestrategieë, bestuursraamwerke, norms en standaarde vas om konsekwente en doeltreffende regsverteenwoordiging van die Staat te verseker. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van voorwaardelike aanspreeklikhede en finansiële risiko's in ooreenstemming met die State Liability Act deur die implementering van litigasierisikobestuurstelsels, bestuursmaatreëls vir uitgawes en strategieë om litigasiekostes te verlaag. Monitor nakoming van hofbevele en die tenuitvoerlegging van vonnisse deur staatsorgane, stel meganismes op om implementering te monitor, en eskaleer stelselmatige nie-nakoming waar nodig. Neem die leiding met die ontwikkeling van nasionale litigasiebeleid, norms, richtlyne en regsvernuwing inisiatiewe, verskaf strategiese toesig oor grondwetlike en presedensskeppende litigasie, en ondersteun regsnavorsing en internasionale regsamewerking. Bevorder goeie bestuur, etiese gedrag, deursigtigheid en gevolgbestuur deur nakomingsmonitering, ondersoek van litigasiefaal en die implementering van regstellende maatreëls. Dryf die transformasie en professionalisering van litigasiedienste aan deur billike opdragpatrone te bevorder, die kapasiteit van Staatsprokureurskantore te versterk, die ontwikkeling van opkomende regspraktisyns te ondersteun en professionele standaarde en gehalteversekeringsstelsels te implementeer. Departement se Strategiese Plan, verseker goeie finansiële en menslikehulpbronbestuur, implementeer kennisbestuur en digitale litigasiestelsels, en monitor organisatoriese prestasie.

zu.title: Umeli jikelele
zu.summary: Hola inqubomgomo yokumelana nomango ezweni lonke bese uphele ukumelana nomango okuzwelayo kuwo wonke amahhovisi e-State Attorney njengoSolicitor-general ngaphakathi kwi-Department of Justice.
zu.requirements: I-NQF Level 8 eMthethweni noma njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ukwamukelwa njengo-Advocate noma i-Attorney elungelo lokubonakala e-High Court of South Africa kuyadingeka. Okuncane isipiliyoni seminyaka eyishumi (10) ezingeni labaphathi abaphezulu. Isipiliyoni esibanzi ekumelweni nomango kanye nesipiliyoni sokumelana nomango izinkolelo eziphawulekako kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuqonda okubanzi komthetho we-State Attorney Act, i-State Attorney Amendment Act, i-State Liability Act, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Public Service Act and Regulations, imithetho yeTreasury efanelekileyo kanye nemiyalo kaMnyango. Ulwazi olubanzi lokuphathwa kokumelana nomango, izinsizakalo zomthetho zeZwe, inqubomgomo yentuthuko nomaenhlelweni, ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa, ukushintsha kwentuthuko, ukuphathwa kwezonzimbe zikahulumeni kanye namakhaphethi okulawula emkhakheni kahulumeni. Ukuqonda okuhle ngabaluleki kahulumeni, ukuhlela okuyisigaba, ubuholo bezinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo zomango ezithunqiwe. Amandla namaKkhono: Amandla mahle kakhulu okucabanga ngokusigaba nobuholo bokuba ukwazi ukuthuthuka futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo zenhlelo, ukunika isiqondiso ngesigaba kanye nokukhuthaza ukwenza kahle kakhulu. Ukukhombisa ikhono ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo zomsebenzi, ekuphathweni kwemali, ekulawuleni, ekuqhenyulweni kwenhlehle kanye nokuphathwa koshintsho. Ulwazi oluhle lokuphathwa kolwazi, ukwakha okusha ekulethweni kwenkonzo, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, nokuba nesandla ekuqondeni izinkinga. Amandla amahle ekuphathweni kwabantu, ukuhlanganyela nabahola, ukuqondiswa kwezivakashi namakhono okuxhumana, elandelwa kukhono lokuqinisekisa, ukuxoxa ngokuhlangana nezinhlelo phakathi kwahulumeni namabalana nomthetho. Ukubonisa ukuqotho, ukuziphatha okuhle, ubungcweti nokuzinikela ekuholeni okungadangi kanye nokuphathwa okuhle kahulumeni. Amazinga aphezulu obuchwepheshe, ubuholo obungenamdida, ukwakha okusha, ukunikela ngezipho kanye nokuzinikela kwezentengo zenhlelo zezepulo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngobuholo obuyisigaba, ukulawula ukuphathwa kwezindaba, kanye nokuqondanisa ezweni lonke izinkolelo eziphathelene nokumelana nomango okuhilela Izwe. Qapha futhi uqondanise ukumelana nomango okuzwelayo kuwo wonke amahhovisi e-State Attorney bese usungula izindlela zokumelana nomango ezisabalela ezweni lonke, izakhiwo zokuphathwa kwezindaba, imigomo namazinga ukuze kuqiniseke ukumelana nomango okungaguquki futhi okusebenza kahle kwezwe. Qapha ukuphathwa kwezikweletu ezingase zenzekale kanye nezingozizezimali ngokusho kwe-State Liability Act ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokulawula ingozi yomango, izinyathelo zokulawula ukuchithwa kwemali, kanye nezindlela zokunciphisa izindleko zokumelana nomango. Qapha ukuthobela izimiso zezinkantolo kanye nokuphumeza izinqumo ngezithunywa zeZwe, sungula izinhlelo zokuqapha ukuphumeza, bese ukhuphula izindaba zokungathobeli uma kunesidingo. Buka ukuthuthuka kwemigomo yokumelana nomango ezweni lonke, imigomo, imiyalo, kanye nokuqala kokuqinisa umthetho, nikela ngokuqapha okuyisigaba mayelana nokumelana nomango okuxhumaniswa nomthethosisekelo noma okubeka isibonelo, kanye nokusekela ucwaningo lomthetho nokusebenzisana ngomthetho emazweni avelene. Khuthaza ukuphathwa okuhle kwezindaba, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukuguquguquka, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinyathelo zomphumela ngokuqapha ukuthobela imigomo, uphenye ukusilele kokumelana nomango, bese usebenzisa izinyathelo zokulungisa. Khokhela ukuguqulwa nokwenza ukumelana komango kusebenza ngobungcweti ngokukhuthaza izindlela zokwaba imisebenzi ngokulingana, uqinise amandla amahhovisi e-State Attorney, usekele ukuthuthuka kwabaphathi bomthetho abasakula, bese usebenzisa amazinga obuchwepheshe kanye nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Hlela i-Strategic Plan kaMnyango, qiniseka ukuphathwa okuhle kwemali kanye nabantu, usebenzise izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi kanye nezinhlelo zomango ezithunqiwe, bese uqapha ukusebenza kwentuthuko.

xh.title: Umthethi-jikelele
xh.summary: Yiba ngummandwa weqela lezixhobo kunye nokulawula amaxatso ombuso kuzo zonke Iiofisi zoMgcini weSizwe njengoko kunjalo kwisebe leMthetho.
xh.requirements: Isixa se-NQF Level 8 kumthetho noma njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhaliswa njengomngunyathi noma ugqirha womthetho onelayisense lokubonakala eNkundleni eNkulu yaseMzantsi Afrika sibathathwa njengesibini. Uqhaqho olungentla kweminyaka elishumi (10) kunyaka ngowasebenza kwinqanaba eliphezulu lokulawula. Uqhaqho olubanzi kumaxatso kunye noqhaqho olwangaphambili ekuxhaseni amaxatso ezindaba ezibaluleke kakhulu kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi olubanzi lokulawula iinkqubo, amaxatso ombuso, amandawo kabuhlungu kunye noshishino, ulawulo lwezimali, ukuhlelwa koluntu, ukuguquguquka koluntu, ukulawulwa koluntu kunye neendlela ezilawulwa ngurhulumente. Ukuqonda okubanzi kumagunya karhulumente, ukuhlelwa ngeendlela, amandawo kabuhlungu kunye neendlela zolwazi zolwimi lokusebenza ngamabomvu. Amabali kunye namandawo: Imandawo yokulawula ngeendlela eziphezulu kunye nokulawula abantu bokukwazi ukuqhutywa kwaye kusetyenziswe amandawo yoluntu, ukunikela izimvo ezahlukeneyo uze ukhuthaze ukusebenza ngamandla amakhulu. Ubunjiniyelwa obubonakalayo ekulawuleni inkqubo nephulo, ekulawuleni imali, ekulawuleni isigqeba, ekuguquleni uluntu nasekulawuleni ushintsho. Ulwazi olunamandla lokulawula inkqubo, ubuchwepheshe bokunikela iinkonzo, ukucinga ngokuhlola kunye namandawo okusombulula iingxaki. Amandawo amakhulu ekulawuleni abantu, ekuzibandakanyeni nabo babambe iqhaza, ekuzungeveni abathengi kunye nolwimi lokuchaza, kunye namandlawo okukwazi ukuchukumisa, ukucinga kunye nokuqamba iindlela ezahlukeneyo kurhulumente nakwishishini lomthetho. Ubufundiswa obubonakalayo, yinyani, ubugcisa bokusebenza kunye noqoqosho lokulawula iinkqubo ezilunge noluntu olusebenzayo. Iinkalo ezilunge zobugcisa bokusebenza, ukulawula iinkqubo ezilunge, amandawo amakhulu, iindaba ezibalulekileyo kunye noqoqosho kwimigiqabo yabantu bonke.
xh.duties: Nika imbalasela eqondisayo, ulawulo lokulawula ukuhlelwa koluntu nokulungelelanisa kwelizwe konke nxaxheba kwamaxatso ombuso. Qwalasela futhi ulungelelanise amaxatso obuzwe kuzo zonke Iiofisi zoMgcini weSizwe uze miswe iindlela zokuxhasa amaxatso ezilwini, iinkqubo zolawulo, iingcamango namagunya ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukumelwa kwangokomthetho okuhambelana nokusebenza kakuhle koMbuso. Qwalasela ukulawulwa kwezibophelelo ezibuthathaka neengozi ezimalini ngokuvumelana neSihlabelelo seNtengiso yoMbuso ngokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokulawula iingozi kumaxatso, iindlela zokulawula inkxaso amaxatso kunye neendlela zokunciphisa iindleko zamaxatso. Qwalasela ukuzinikela kwemimiselo yenkundla kwaye iqale ukusetyenziswa kwezigwebo ziithixo zoMbuso, misa iindlela zokuqwalasela ukusetyenziswa, uze uphakamise ukungazinikeli kolwimi nakwimiba apho kufuneka khona. Suka ubambe iqondo ekuyileni iindlela zombuso namagunya olwimo, iindlela zokubeka iindawo zokuxhasa amaxatso, unike imbalasela eqondisayo kwimiba yolwimi loMthethosiseko nezimiso ezibeka umzekelo, uze uxhase uphando lomthetho nokusebenzisana ngokomthetho kwamanye amazwe. Khuthaza ulawulo olulunge, imoralithi, ukuguquguquka nokulawula iziphumo ngokulawula ukuzinikela, uqwalasele ukusilela kwamaxatso uze usebenzise iindlela zokulungisa. Khuthaza uguquko-lwazi nokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe ekuxhaseni amaxatso ngokukhuthaza ukubakwa kweekomiti ezilinganayo, ukuqinisa amandawo Iiofisi zoMgcini weSizwe, ukuxhasa uphuhliso lwoogqirha bomthetho abatsha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zobugcisa bokusebenza nokuhambelana nobungakanani bolwazi. Iplani yeSebe leSizwe, ukuqinisekisa ulawulo oluhle lwemali kunye noluntu, ukusebenzisa inkqubo yolwazi namaxatso obuchwepheshe, kunye noqwalaselo lwemveliso yoluntu.

jobs.title: Chief State LAW Adviser
jobs.department: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 – R2 124 237 per annum (Level 15), (an all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Lead the certification and drafting of Bills at the Department of Justice National Office in Pretoria, providing strategic legal advisory support across the parliamentary legislative process.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 8 in Law or as recognised by SAQA. Admission as an Advocate or Attorney in the High Court of South Africa is essential. Extensive knowledge of Bills and legislation, legislative drafting and certification processes, legal advisory services, public and international law, public administration, government decision-making processes, and the statutory and regulatory framework governing the Public Service, including the Public Service Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations and related prescripts. Sound understanding of Government priorities, organizational governance, strategic planning and professional legal ethics. Skills and Competencies: Exceptional strategic capability and leadership with the ability to provide strategic direction, develop legal policy and lead a specialized legal advisory environment. Demonstrated capability in programme and project management, financial management, organizational transformation, change management, knowledge management and service delivery innovation. Strong analytical, planning and problem-solving capability, with excellent people management, stakeholder engagement, communication and client orientation skills. Proven ability to build strategic partnerships, manage complex legal matters, influence decision-making and lead multidisciplinary professional teams. High levels of professionalism, ethical leadership, accountability and commitment to the values and principles of the Public Service.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the certification and drafting of Bills, including the provision of preliminary legal opinions, certification of legislation and legal advisory support throughout the parliamentary process. Oversee the scrutiny, drafting and certification of subordinate legislation and provide authoritative legal opinions and advisory services to Government departments and other organs of state. Direct the scrutiny of international agreements to ensure consistency with the Constitution and domestic law and oversee the provision of legal advice relating to international legal obligations. Lead the strategic management and governance of the Office of the Chief State Law Adviser through effective strategic planning, operational performance monitoring, risk management, audit compliance, financial management and resource utilization. Oversee the translation and editing of legislation and other legal documents into the official languages to support legislative accessibility and constitutional compliance. Provide strategic legal opinions on contracts, legal documents, settlements and disputes referred by Government departments and organs of state. Ensure sound governance, people management, financial stewardship, asset management, organizational performance and compliance with all statutory and regulatory prescripts within the Office of the Chief State Law Adviser.

af.title: Hoofstaatsregadviseur
af.summary: Lei die sertifisering en opstel van Wetsontwerpe by die Department of Justice Nasionale Kantoor in Pretoria, en verskaf strategiese regkundige adviesondersteuning dwarsdeur die parlementaire wetgewingsproses.
af.requirements: NQF Level 8 in Regte of soos deur SAQA erken. Toelating as 'n Advokaat of Prokureur in die High Court of South Africa is noodsaaklik. Uitgebreide kennis van Wetsontwerpe en wetgewing, wetgewingsopstel- en sertifiseringsprosesse, regkundige adviesdienste, publieke en internasionale reg, openbare administrasie, regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse, en die statutêre en regulatoriese raamwerk wat die Public Service beheer, insluitend die Public Service Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations en verwante voorskrifte. Deeglike begrip van regeringsprioriteite, organisatoriese beheer, strategiese beplanning en professionele regsetiek. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitsonderlike strategiese vermoë en leierskap met die vermoë om strategiese rigting te bied, regbeleid te ontwikkel en 'n gespesialiseerde regadvies-omgewing te lei. Agetoonde vermoë in program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, organisatoriese transformasie, veranderingbestuur, kennisbestuur en diensleweringsinnovatie. Sterke analitiese, beplannings- en probleemoplossingsvermoë, met uitstekende mensebestuur-, belanghebbende-betrokkenheids-, kommunikasie- en kliëntoriëntasievaardighede. Bewese vermoë om strategiese vennootskappe te bou, komplekse regsaangeleenthede te bestuur, besluitneming te beïnvloed en multidissiplinêre professionele spanne te lei. Hoë vlakke van professionaliteit, etiese leierskap, aanspreeklikheid en toewyding aan die waardes en beginsels van die Public Service.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en toesig oor die sertifisering en opstel van Wetsontwerpe, insluitend die verskaffing van voorlopige regsmenings, sertifisering van wetgewing en regkundige adviesondersteuning dwarsdeur die parlementêre proses. Hou toesig oor die ondersoek, opstel en sertifisering van ondergeskikte wetgewing en verskaf gesaghebbende regsmenings en adviesdienste aan regeringsdepartemente en ander staatsorgane. Stuur die ondersoek van internasionale ooreenkomste om ooreenstemming met die Grondwet en binnelandse reg te verseker en hou toesig oor die verskaffing van regadvies rakende internasionale regverpligtinge. Lei die strategiese bestuur en beheer van die Kantoor van die Hoofstaatsregadviseur deur effektiewe strategiese beplanning, operasionele prestasiemonitering, risikobestuur, oudit-nakoming, finansiële bestuur en hulpbronbenutting. Hou toesig oor die vertaling en redigering van wetgewing en ander regsdokumente in die amptelike tale om wetgewingstoeganklikheid en grondwetlike nakoming te ondersteun. Verskaf strategiese regsmenings oor kontrakte, regsdokumente, skikkinge en geskille wat deur regeringsdepartemente en staatsorgane verwys word. Verseker deeglike beheer, mensebestuur, finansiële bewind, batebestuur, organisatoriese prestasie en nakoming van alle statutêre en regulatoriese voorskrifte binne die Kantoor van die Hoofstaatsregadviseur.

zu.title: Chief State LAW Adviser
zu.summary: Hola ukugunyazwa nokubhala kwemithethosivivinywa eDepartment of Justice National Office ePretoria, ngenikezo lokwesekwa ngomthetho ngokuhola amasu kuwo wonke amaqondo epharliamenti okwenza umthetho.
zu.requirements: I-NQF Level 8 kuMthetho noma njengoba kuqashwe i-SAQA. Ukungena njengoMmeli noma uMmeli eNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika kubaluleke kakhulu. Ulwazi olubanzi ngemithethosivivinywa nomthetho, ukubhala nokugunyazwa komthetho, izinkonzo zokweluleka ngomthetho, umthetho kazwelonke nowezwe, ukuphathwa kabezindawo, amaqondo okwenza izinqumo kahulumeni, kanye nesakhiwo somthetho nemitshwana esibusa Inkonzo Yomphakathi, okuhlanganisa uMthetho weNkonzo Yomphakathi, uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumeni, Imithetho yeNqola kanye nemibhalo ehlobene nayo. Ukuqonda okuhle ngamaphothuphuthi kahulumeni, ubulungisa beqembu, ukuletha izinhlelo eziphathwayo kanye nokuqonda okuhle komthetho. Amandla kanye nokwaziswa: Amandla aphezulu okuletha amasu kanye nobuholo bokwazi ukuletha iqondo lezinhlelo, ukwakha umthetho kahulumeni kanye nokuhola indawo ekhethekile yokweluleka ngomthetho. Ukukwaziswa okubonisiwe ekuphathweni kwezinhlela nezinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuguqulwa kweqembu, ukuphathwa izinguquko, ukuphathwa kwolwazi kanye nentuthuko yokuletha izinkonzo. Amandla aqinile okuhlaziya, ukuletha izinhlelo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga, ngekhono elihle lokuphatha abantu, ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli, ukuxhumana kanye namakhono omtshina wezivakashi. Ikhono elibonisiwe lokwakha ubudlelwano eziphathwayo, ukuphatha izindaba ezibucayi zomthetho, ukuthinta izinqumo kanye nokuhola amaqembu abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Izinga eliphezulu lobungcali, ubuholo obungokomthetho, ukubeka ubuso kanye nokuqhashisa ngamagugu nemithetho yaseNkonzo Yomphakathi.
zu.duties: Nika inhlokodolobha ephathwayo kanye nokuqapha ukugunyazwa nokubhala koMthethosivivinywa, okuhlanganisa nokunikezwa kwezibono zomthetho ezingaphambilini, ukugunyazwa komthetho kanye nokwesekwa ngomthetho kulo lonke iqondo lepharliamenti. Qapha ukuhlola, ukubhala nokugunyazwa komthetho ongaphansi kanye nokunikezwa kwezibono zomthetho ezivunyiwe nezinkonzo zokweluleka ngomthetho emaphaketheni kahulumeni kanye nezinye izikhungo zombuso. Hola ukuhlola kwemivumelwano yamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana nomthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho wasekhaya, futhi uqaphele ukunikezwa kwezeluleko zomthetho ngemitheshwana yomthetho yamazwe ngamazwe. Hola ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nobulungisa beOfisi yoMphathimthetho Ohloliweyo Inhlokodolobha ngezikhashana eziphathwayo zokuqamba amasu, ukulandelela ukusebenza okusebenzayo, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ukuthobela izikhwama zokuqasha, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo. Qapha ukuhumusha nokuhlela komthetho kanye namanye amadokhumenti omthetho abhalwe ngolimi olusemthethweni ukuze useke ukufinyeleleka komthetho kanye nokuthobela umthethosisekelo. Nikeza izibono zomthetho eziphathwayo ngomthetho wokuqashwa kwentela, amadokhumenti omthetho, izinxephezono kanye nezinkinga ezithunyelwe emaphaketheni kahulumeni kanye nezikhungo zombuso. Qinisekisa ubulungisi obuhle, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwempahla, ukusebenza kweqembu kanye nokuthobela konke okumayelana nomthetho nemitshwana yomthetho ngaphakathi kweOfisi yoMphathimthetho Ohloliweyo Inhlokodolobha.

xh.title: Gqwetha loMthetho loRhulumente oPhakamileyo
xh.summary: Yiya phambili ekugqiniseni nasekulungiseni iBhili kwiSaziso soMthetho, kwisiHlalo sasePretoria, esinika inkxaso yengcebiso yomthetho ejoliswe ekubakho kwengqondo-kamva kwinkqubo yomthetho yepalamente.
xh.requirements: I-NQF Level 8 kwiSaziso somthetho okanye njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Ukungena njengesigqatsha okanye njengommeli kwiNkundla eNkulu yoMzantsi Afrika kubalulekile. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeBhili nakumthetho wezakuwo, iinkqubo zokulunga nokugqinisa umthetho, iinkonzo zengcebiso yomthetho, umthetho kawonke-wonke nowamazwe ngamazwe, ulawulo lukaRhulumente, iinkqubo zokuthatha izigqibo karhulumente, nendlela yomthetho nokulawulwa komthetho ekulawulweni koMphumi wentlalo, kuquka uMthetho woMphumi wentlala, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente, Imimiselo yeQhosha kunye namagunya amanqanaba. Ukuqonda kakuhle ngokubaluleka kwemigangatho kaRhulumente, ulawulo oluhle lwentlalo-ntle, uqikelelo olubonisa ikhondo kunye nendlela ebekwe ngayo imigaqo yomthetho. Amakhono kunye nobuchule: Ubuchule obukhulu ekuboniseni ikhondo nasekulawuleni, nako kukwazi ukubonisa ikhondo elihamba phambili, ukwakha umthetho-wezopolitiko nokulawula indawo ebalulekileyo yengcebiso yomthetho. Ubuchule obubonisiweyo ekulawuleni iinkqubo kunye neeprojekthi, ekulawulweni kwemali, ekuguqulweni kwenkcumama, ekulawuleni iinguquko, ekulawuleni ulwazi nakukuphuculweni kwenkqubo yokuqhutywa kwemisebenzi. Amakhono amakhulu obuntu bomcu, wokuqamba amacebo, nosombululo lweengxaki, nako kukwazi ukuqonda izithukuthezi, ulawulo lwabantu, ukuzibandakanya nabalawuli, nokuqonda abathengi. Isakhono esibonisiweyo sokwakha ubudlelwane obubonisa ikhondo, ukulawula iingxaki zomthetho ezinzima, nokulawula iinkqubo zokuthatha izigqibo kunye nokulawula amaqela abantu abavela kumasebe amaninzi. Ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo ekubeni ngumntu onamaphupha, ukulawula ngokungatshoyi nto, ukuba nawo amanyathelo okuzithoba, nokuzimisela ngokwemigaqo nendlela kaMphumi wentlala.
xh.duties: Yela inkululeko ephakamileyo nolawulo oluvela phezulu ekugqiniseni nasekulungiseni amabhili, kuquka ukunikela iimvo zomthetho eziphelo kwesikhashana, ukugqinisa umthetho-wezakuwo n inkxaso yengcebiso yomthetho kuwo wonke umgangatho wenkqubo yepalamente. Lawula ukuqwalaselwa, ukulungiswa nokugqinisa komthetho ongaphantsi, kwaye unike iimvo zomthetho ezinezithethe kunye nezinkonzo zengcebiso kumasebe karhulumente nakwezinye iindlu karhulumente. Qondisa ukuqwalaselwa kwezivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana noMgaqo-siseko nomthetho wengingqi, kwaye ulawule ukunikwa kweengcebiso ngemithetho malunga nezibophelelo zamazwe ngamazwe. Meme ukulawula okuvela phezulu nolawulo lweziko leGqwetha loMthetho loRhulumente weSizwe ngokusebenzisa uqikelelo oluzingelwe, ukuqwalaselwa kokusebenza kwezinto ezisenziwayo, ulawulo lomngcipheko, ukuthobela ukwangwa-langwa, ulawulo lweemali, nendlela yokusebenzisa iinsuku. Lawula ukuqwalaselwa kolungiso lwamagama omthetho nakwezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezisemthethweni zolwimi ukuze kuxhaswe ukufikeleleka komthetho nokuthobela uMgaqo-siseko. Nikela iimvo zomthetho ezibuzu-phambili kwizivumelwano, amaxwebhu omthetho, izixhobo zokuphela ngokutshalwa kunye neengxabano ezithunyelwa ngamasebe karhulumente nangezinye iindlu karhulumente. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluhle, ulawulo labantu, ulondolozo lweemali, ulawulo lwempahla, ukusebenza koluntu, nokuthobela zonke iinkqubo ezithile nomthetho ngaphakathi kweZiko leGqwetha loMthetho loRhulumente weSizwe.
