af.summary: Hoofmeester by die Department of Justice and Constitutional Development in Pretoria, wat strategiese regulatoriese toesig oor Meesterskantore op SMS Level 15 verskaf.
af.requirements: An NQF Level 8-kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word in Finansiële Bestuur, Besigheidsbestuurreg of 'n verwante veld, wat deur SAQA erken word. Toelating as 'n Geleerde Rekenmeester sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ervaring op seniorbestuursvlak, met uitgebreide kundigheid in die bestuur van boedels van oorledenes, insolvensie, truste of regulatoriese bestuur. Uitgebreide ervaring in die bestuur van grootskaalse fondse sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Uitgebreide kennis van Suid-Afrikaanse privaat- en grondwetlike reg, wetgewing wat Meestersdienste regeer, fidusiêre regulering, boedeladministrasie, familiereg, internasionale kinderontvoeringsraamwerke, openbare-sektor bestuur, die Openbare Finansiële Bestuurswet, Tesourie-regulasies, en die statutêre raamwerk wat die administrasie van boedels van oorledenes, truste, voogdyskap en verwante regsprosesse regeer. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitsonderlike strategiese vermoë en leierskap met die vermoë om nasionale strategiese rigting te verskaf, organisatoriese prestasie te dryf en komplekse regulatoriese omgewings te lei. Agetoonde vermoë in program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, organisatoriese transformasie, veranderingbestuur, kennisbestuur en dienslewering-innovasie. Sterk analitiese, beplannings- en probleemoplossingsvermoë, met uitstekende belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, kommunikasie, kliëntgerigtheid en verhoudingsbestuursvaardighede. Bewese vermoë om multidissiplinêre spanne te lei, strategiese vennootskappe te bou en goeie bestuur, aanspreeklikheid en etiese leierskap te bevorder. Hoë vlakke van professionaliteit, etiese leierskap, innovasie, aanspreeklikheid en toewyding tot openbare dienswaardes.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese nasionale regulasieregstoorligting van alle Meesterskantore om die wettige, doeltreffende en eenvormige administrasie van statutêre funksies regoor die Republiek te verseker. Lei die regulasieregstoorligting van die administrasie van boedels van oorledenes, insolvente boedels, trustregistrasie en -toesig, administrasie van die Voogdyfonds, kuratorskappe en verwante fidusiêre dienste, insluitend die ontwikkeling van nasionale standaarde, riglyne, nakomingsraamwerke en regulatoriese ingrypings. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor bestuur, beleggingsbestuur en statutêre nakoming met betrekking tot die Voogdyfonds om die belange van begunstigdes te beskerm. Lei beleidsontwikkeling, regsnavorsing en wetgewende hervorming om bestuur te versterk en Meestersdienste te moderniseer. Hou toesig oor die administrasie van Familieregspreekdienste en die implementering van Suid-Afrika se verpligtinge met betrekking tot internasionale kinderontvoering en verwante familieregsdienste. Bou en handhaaf strategiese vennootskappe met die Uitvoerende Gesag, Regbank, regsprofessie, finansiële instellings en ander belanghebbendes om bestuur te versterk, dienslewering te verbeter en openbare vertroue te verhoog. Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir die Tak deur doeltreffende finansiële bestuur, organisatoriese prestasie, menslikehulpbronbestuur, kennisbestuur, digitale bemagtiging, bestuur, risikobestuur en nakoming ter ondersteuning van die Departement se grondwetlike mandaat.

zu.title: I-Master Eyinhloko
zu.summary: I-Master Eyinhloko e-Department of Justice and Constitutional Development e-Pretoria, ehlinzeka ngenakekelho olushaqekile nolubhekiswe emthethweni kwezikhungo zabaMasters ngazinga le-SMS Level 15.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esingu-NQF Level 8 esivunyelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Financial Management, i-Business Management Law noma endaweni ehlobene, esivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Ukubhalisa njengo-Chartered Accountant kuzoba ukunzuzo engeziwe. Ubude obungafani bokwenziwa beminyaka eyisishiyagalombali (8) njengenoma ubuphi isikhundla esiphezulu sokuphatha, nobuhlakaniphu obunjalo ekuphathweni kwezindawo zabafafile, ukusileleka kwezimali, izinkambu noma ukuphathwa komthetho. Ukuqonda okujulile ekuphathweni komthetho wangasese nomthethosisekelo wase-South Africa, umthetho ohlela Izinsizakusebenzi zabaMasters, ukulawulwa kwebhasidi, ukuphathwa kwezindlu zalfa, umthetho wobuhlobo, izikhungo zokugetha izingane emazweni, ukuphathwa komphakathi, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, nesakhiwo somthetho esibeka ukuphathwa kwezindawo zabafafile, izinkambu, ukugada kanye nokuqhuba izinqubo zomthetho eziyimfanelo. Amakhono nobudlelwano: Ikhono elikhulu lokubeka uhlelo kanye nobuholi bokukwazi ukunikeza isiqondiso sezwe, ukushukumisa ukusebenza kwent organisational kanye nokuba ngumholi kwezindawo ezinobuningi bomthetho. Ukubonakalisa ikhono ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuqhuba ibhalansi ent organisational, ukuphatha inguqulo, ukulawulwa kolwazi kanye nokuqamba izindlela zokulethwa kwezinsizakusebenza. Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziya, ukubeka izinhlelo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga, nobukhulu bokwenza ubudlelwano nabantu, ukuxhumana, ukuzinisekela kumthengi nokuphatha ubudlelwane. Ukukwazi ukubonakalisa ikhono lokuba ngumholi kumacandelo ahlukene, ukwakha ubuhlobo obusiqondile kanye nokugqugquzela ukuphathwa okuhle, ukubekelana izibalo kanye nobuholi obuqotho. Izinga elikhulu lokuba ngumuntu othembekile, ngokuphathwa komthetho, ubuholi obuqotho, ukuqamba izinto ezintsha, ukubekelana izibalo kanye nokuzinikezela kwamagugu asebenza emphakathini.
zu.duties: Kunikeza inakekelo olubhekiswe emthethweni kabanzi elwedlule zonke izikhungo zabaMasters ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokusemthethweni, ngokusebenza kahle kanye ngokuvundlile kwezinkalo zomthetho kulo lonke i-Republic. Hola ukunakekelwa okubhekiswe emthethweni kokuphathwa kwezindlu zabafafile, ukuphathwa kwezindlu zabafafile abasilelekile, ukubhaliswa kwezinkambu nokulawulwa kwazo, ukuphathwa kwe-Guardian's Fund, ukuba ngumcurator kanye nezinsizakusebenze eziyimfanelo, okubandakanya ukuthuthukiswa kwezindinganiso zezwe, iziyalezo, izimiso zokuqinisekisa kanye nezenzo ezibhekiswe emthethweni. Kunikeza inakekelo olusiqondile kokuphathwa komthetho, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho okubhekiswe kwi-Guardian's Fund ukuqinisekisa izinkolelo zabaLwazi. Hola ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, uphenyo lomthetho kanye nolushintsho lomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle kanye nokwenza ngokwamanje izinsizakusebenze zabaMasters. Buka ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenze ze-Family Advocate Services kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezibopho ze-South Africa ezingokugetha izingane emazweni kanye nezinsizakusebenze zobuhlobo. Luba kanye nokugcina ubuhlobo obusiqondile ne-Executive, i-Judiciary, yomthetho, izikhungo zezimali kanye nabanye ukuzinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle, ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakusebenze nokukhulisa ukuthembeka kumphakathi. Kunikeza ubuholi obusiqondile phakathi kwe-Branch ngokuphathwa kwezimali okusebenzayo, ukusebenza kwent organisational, ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi, ukulawulwa kolwazi, ukwenza izinto ngokwedijithali, ukuphathwa, ukuphathwa kokuzingela kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho ukusekela umthethosisekelo ka-Department.

xh.title: I-Nkulumbuso eNkulu
xh.summary: INkulumbuso eNkulu kwisebe lezoLunga loMthetho nentlalo eziko iPretoria, inika ulawulo oluluhlwanzi lomthetho kumaziko eNkulumbuso ngelinqanaba i-SMS Level 15.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingu-NQF Level 8 esamkelwe yi-SAQA kwizifundo zoLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweShishini yoMthetho okanye elinye ibala elinxulumene nalo, esamkelwe yi-SAQA. Ukwamkelwa njengoChartered Accountant kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Amava amabalwe (8) iminyaka kwinqanaba lolawulo oluphezulu, enobugcisa obukhulu ekulawuleni amafa abafafileyo, izigwebo zokungahlawuli, iithrusthi okanye ugunyaziso ngomthetho. Amava amaninzi ekulawuleni imali elinganiselwe makhulu kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi oluninzi ngomthetho wangasese nowomthethosiseko waseNingizimu Afrika, urhelo lomthetho olulawula iinkonzo zeNkulumbuso, ugunyaziso bethrusthi, ulawulo lwamafa, umthetho wesapho, amakadisi okubamba abantwana ngokudluliselwa kwamanye amazwe, ulawulo lwelizwe langasese, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yokuRhangqa ngokomthetho, iZiqendu zeTreasury, kunye nommandla womthetho osetyenziswa ekulawuleni amafa abafafileyo, iithrusthi, ulawulo lokhuseleko namanye amagqabantshintshi omthetho. Amakhono namava: Ukuba namandla amakhulu ekuqamba iindyanthetho nokuqaqumba abantu ngokukhokela ukuba banako ukunika isalathiso senhlalo, kwakhona ukukhuthaza ukusebenza koluntu nokukhokela iindawo ezinobungakanani obungalula ngomthetho. Ukuboniswa kwamandla ekulawulienkqubo namanqongoza, ukulawula imali, ukutshintsha uluntu, ukulawula iinguqu, ukulawula ulwazi nokuqamba iindlela entsha zokwenza izinto. Ikhono elinamandla lokuhlola, ukuqamba iindyanthetho nokusombulula iingxaki, elinamandla amakhulu ekuchazana nabantu, ekunxibelelwani, ekuzinikela kumaxwebhu nakulawulo lobudlelwane. Ukuba namandla aqinisekisiweyo ekukhuliseni amaqela angazibambi ndawonye, wokwakha ubuhlobo obuluhlwanzi nasekugqakeni ngomthetho, ekupekuleni iziphithiphithi nakulawulo lokulunga. Ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo kwinkonzo yalontlo, ukukhokela ngokulunga, ukuqamba okutsha, ukuziphendulela nokuzinikela kwamaxabiso enkonzonkulumbuso yalontlo.
xh.duties: Kunika ulawulo oluluhlwanzi ngokomthetho kumaziko eNkulumbuso yonke iNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba imisebenzi ngokomthetho yenziwa ngokusesikweni, ngokukhawuleza nangokulinganayo. Ukukhokela ulawulo ngokomthetho lolawulo lwamafa abafafileyo, ulawulo lwamafa abantu abangahlawulanga, ukubhalisa nokulawula iithrusthi, ukulawula i-Guardian's Fund, abalawuli bamafa namanye amakhonzo ethrusthi, kuquka nesiphithiphithi sokuqamba iizinga zangonke, iindlela ezahlukeneyo, iindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho nemisebenzi yokungena phantsi komthetho. Kunika ulawulo oluluhlwanzi ekulawuleni ngokomthetho, ekulawuleni iimali ezidityaniswayo nakuhlonelwa umthetho malunga ne-Guardian's Fund ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ncamekile abazuzi. Ukukhokela ukuqwaqwa komthetho, uphando lomthetho nokuguqulwa koluhlu lomthetho ukuze kuqiniswe ulawulo lugqatso lusetyenziswe iinkonzo zeNkulumbuso. Ukulawula iinkonzo ze-Family Advocate nokuphumeza izibophelelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezinxulumene nokubamba abantwana abadluliselwa kumanye amazwe nezinye iinkonzo zomthetho wesapho. Ukwakha ulwalamano oluluhlwanzi nabaphathi benkqubo yelizwe, abagwebi, amagosa omthetho, amaziko ezimali nabanye abantu ababambe iqhaga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo, ukuphuculwa kwezinkonzo nokwandiswa koloyiko lontlo. Kunika ulawulo oluluhlwanzi kuleBranch ngokulawula imali, ukusebenza koluntu, ukulawula abantu, ukulawula ulwazi, ukusebenzisa iindlela ze-digital, ukulawula ngokomthetho, ukuyiqonda ingxaki nokuzithoba kuxanduva lomthetho ngenjongo yokuxhasa umthethosiseko we-sebe.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Institutional Development and
jobs.department: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 – R2 124 237 per annum (Level 15), (an all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Lead institutional development and justice policy coordination as Deputy Director-General at the Department of Justice in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 8 qualification as recognised by SAQA, in Public Administration, Public Management, Administration, Law, Governance, Social Sciences or a related field. 8 years' experience at Senior Management level in public administration within a large, complex organisation. Extensive knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act, the Public Service legislative and governance framework, organisational performance management, strategic planning, institutional governance, human resource management and public administration. Sound understanding of Government priorities, organisational development, policy coordination, justice sector governance and executive management within the Public Service. Skills and Competencies: Exceptional strategic capability and leadership with the ability to provide organisational direction, develop and implement strategies and inspire high performance. Demonstrated capability in programme and project management, financial management, organisational transformation and change management, knowledge management, service delivery innovation and organisational performance improvement. Strong analytical, planning and problem-solving capability. Excellent people management, stakeholder engagement, communication and client orientation skills, with the ability to build collaborative partnerships and influence strategic outcomes. High levels of professionalism, ethical leadership, innovation, accountability and commitment to public service values.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership for justice policy coordination, entity oversight and Justice Cluster governance to strengthen institutional governance, integrated decision-making and the implementation of departmental strategic priorities. Lead justice education, professional development, research, innovation and knowledge management programmes to strengthen institutional capability and organisational performance. Direct strategic planning, organisational performance management, service delivery improvement, operational intelligence and integrated performance monitoring systems to support evidence-based planning, accountability and continuous organisational improvement. Lead public education, strategic communication, media relations, stakeholder engagement and reputation management initiatives to promote public confidence, improve access to justice and strengthen the Department's public profile. Provide strategic leadership for legal services, legal advisory services, litigation management, contract management, statutory legal processes and legal governance to mitigate legal risks and safeguard the Department's interests. Ensure sound strategic, financial, human resource, asset and performance management, promote compliance with legislative and regulatory prescripts, and build a capable, ethical and high- performing Branch that supports the Department's constitutional mandate.
jobs.applications: Quoting the relevant reference number, direct your application to: https://forms.office.com/r/X2XaVPasWu OR Postal address: The Human Resources: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, Private Bag X81, Pretoria, 0001 OR Physical address: Application Box, First Floor Reception, East Tower, Momentum Building, 329 Pretorius Street, Pretoria.
jobs.notes: Applicants are invited to submit applications, quoting the relevant reference number to the link and or address indicated in each specific advertisement. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021, obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za), citing the correct post number and job title; a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date (dd/mm/yy), job title, detailed duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of three contactable employment references and copies of educational qualifications. Applicants who possess foreign qualification(s), are furthermore required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA).All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. These assessments are aimed at assessing candidate’s professional and technical competency against the job requirements and duties, general job fit, integrity and digital literacy). All shortlisted candidates for SMS positions will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural, emotional intelligence and integrity. All suitable candidates will be subjected to mandatory pre-employment screening/ suitability checks/ verification (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, employment pending disciplinary action and professional registration. Suitable candidates for Senior Management Service positions will also be required to successfully complete the online Nyukela Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services course, which can be accessed via: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates wishing to be considered for appointment, are encouraged to enrol for the course as soon as possible. Due to high volumes anticipated, communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (DOJ&CD) seeks to appoint exceptional, ethical and visionary leaders to join its executive leadership team in advancing constitutional democracy. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Department is committed to providing equal opportunities and affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur-generaal: Instituionele Ontwikkeling en
af.summary: Lood instituionele ontwikkeling en justisiebeleid-koördinering as Onderdirekteur-generaal by die Departement van Justisie in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 8-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, in Openbare Administrasie, Openbare Bestuur, Administrasie, Regte, Bestuur, Sosiale Wetenskappe of 'n verwante veld. 8 jaar se ervaring op Seniorbestuurvlak in openbare administrasie binne 'n groot, komplekse organisasie. Uitgebreide kennis van die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur, die wetgewende en bestuursraamwerk van die Openbare Diens, organisatoriese prestasiebestuur, strategiese beplanning, instituionele bestuur, menslikehulpbronbestuur en openbare administrasie. Goeie begrip van Regeringsprioriteite, organisatoriese ontwikkeling, beleidkoördinering, justisiesektorbestuur en uitvoerende bestuur binne die Openbare Diens. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitsonderlike strategiese vermoë en leierskap met die vermoë om organisatoriese rigting te bied, strategieë te ontwikkel en te implementeer en hoë prestasie te inspireer. Bewese vermoë in program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, organisatoriese transformasie en veranderingbestuur, kennisonderhoud, diensleweringsinnovasie en organisatoriese prestasieverbetering. Sterke analitiese, beplannings- en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Uitstekende menslikehulpbronbestuur, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, kommunikasie en kliëntgerigtheidvaardighede, met die vermoë om samewerkende vennootskappe te bou en strategiese uitkomste te beïnvloed. Hoë vlakke van professionaliteit, etiese leierskap, innovasie, aanspreeklikheid en toewyding aan openbare dienswaardes.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir justisiebeleidkoördinering, entiteitsierraad en Justisieklusterbestuur om instituionele bestuur, geïntegreerde besluitneming en die implementering van departementele strategiese prioriteite te versterk. Lei justisie-opvoeding, professionele ontwikkeling, navorsing, innovasie en kennisonderhoudprogramme om instituionele vermoë en organisatoriese prestasie te versterk. Stuur strategiese beplanning, organisatoriese prestasiebestuur, diensleweringverbetering, operasionele intelligensie en geïntegreerde prestasiemonitoringstelsels om bewysgebaseerde beplanning, aanspreeklikheid en deurlopende organisatoriese verbetering te ondersteun. Lei openbare opvoeding, strategiese kommunikasie, mediaverhoudinge, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en reputasiebestuursinisiatiewe om openbare vertroue te bevorder, toegang tot justisie te verbeter en die openbare profiel van die Departement te versterk. Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir regsdiens, regsadviesdienste, litigasiebestuur, kontrakbestuur, statutêre reg prosesse en regsbestuur om regsrisiko's te verminder en die belange van die Departement te beskerm. Verseker deeglike strategiese, finansiële, menslikehulpbron-, bates- en prestasiebestuur, bevold navolging van wetgewende en regulatiewe voorskrifte, en bou 'n bekwame, etiese en hoëpresterende Tak wat die grondwetlike mandaat van die Departement ondersteun.

zu.title: Umongameli ohola esikhundleni sobaledi: Ukuthuthukiswa Komnyango kanye No
zu.summary: Hola ukuthuthukiswa komnyango kanye nokuqondanisa inqubomgomo yobulungiswa njengoba ungumongameli ohola esikhundleni sobaledi e-Department of Justice e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF Level 8 njengoba kuvunywa i-SAQA, kwi-Public Administration, Public Management, Administration, Law, Governance, Social Sciences noma indawo ehlobene nalesi. Uhambo lweminyaka engu-8 ngesikhathi esithile kubaphathi abaphakeme kwi-public administration ngaphakathi kwenhlangano enkulu, eyinkimbinkimbi. Ulwazi olubanzi nge-Public Finance Management Act, uhlelo lomthetho nobukhosi be-Public Service, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komnyango, ukwenza izinkundla zesibili, ubukhosi bomnyango, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza kanye ne-public administration. Ukuqonda kahle izinkundla eziyisihloko kahulumeni, ukuthuthukiswa komnyango, ukuhlanganiswa kwezinqubo, ubukhosi bobungcweti be-justice kanye nokuphathwa ngobukhulu ngaphakathi kwe-Public Service. Amakhono kanye namandla okwenza izinto: Ikhono elivelele nokuqonda okuyisibusiso kanye nobuholi bokukwazi ukunika isiqondiso somnyango, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuphoqa izinhlelo kanye nokukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle. Ikhono elibonisiwe ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukushintshwa komnyango kanye nokuphathwa oshintshweni, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuthuthukiswa ekuletheni amasevisi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza komnyango. Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinkundla kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okuphatha abantu, ukubamba iqhaza kwezinkundla, unxibelelwano kanye nobunjiniyela bamakhasimende, ngekhono lokwakha ubudlelwano obuhlanganyisiwe futhi namandla okushintsha iziphetho eziyisibusiso. Izinga eliphezulu lobungcweti, ubukhosi obuhle, izinto ezintsha, iblexess kanye nokuzinikezela emagugu abasebenzi bemphakathi.
zu.duties: Nika abukhosi bukhulu mayelana nokuhlanganisa inqubomgomo yobulungiswa, ukuqaphela izinhlelo, kanye nobukhosi be-Justice Cluster ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubukhosi basemthethweni, ukuthatha izinqumo ngokuhlanganisiwe kanye nokuphoqelela izinto eziyisihloko eziyisibusiso somnyango. Bahola imfundo yobulungiswa, ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi yobungcweti, ucwaningo, izinto ezintsha nokuphathwa kolwazi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ikhono lomnyango nemikhuba yawo. Qondisa ukucubungula izinhlelo, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komnyango, ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwamasevisi, ulwazi mayelana nokusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokuqapha ukusebenza ngokuhlanganisiwe ukuxhasa ukucubungula okusekelwe ezibonweni, iblexess kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo komnyango. Bahola imfundo yomphakathi, unxibelelwano oluyisibusiso, ubudlelwano namaphathwa, ukubandakanya izinkundla kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwegama ukuze kuthuthukiswe ithemba lomphakathi, kulungiswe indlela yokufinyelela ebulungisini kanye nokuqinisa isithombe somnyango emphakathini. Nikeza ubukhosi obuyisibusiso kumasevisi omthetho, amacebo omthetho, ukuphathwa kwezinkomba zomthetho, ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka, izinqubo zomthetho ezisetshenziswa umthetho kanye nobukhosi bomthetho ukuze kuncishwe ubungozi bomthetho futhi kuvikelwe izinkomishini somnyango. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle kwezobusakwethu, kwezimali, kwabantu, kwempahla nokuqapha ukusebenza, wenze ukuthi kuhlonishwe izimiso zomthetho kanye nezokuqondisa, futhi akhe isiqu esimqoka, esingamasiko futhi esisebenza kahle esixhasa ibandla eliyimithetho-ntando yomnyango.

xh.title: Isekela-ngqonda: EzoPhuhliso zeNhlangano kunye noLawulo lweNkqubo yokuZinza
xh.summary: Qhatha ekuqhutyweni koPhuhliso lweNhlangano nolawulo lweenkqubo zocalulo njengeSekela-ngqonda kwiSebe lezoBulungisa ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF Level 8 njengokubalwa yi-SAQA, kwiNtengiso yoLawulo lukaRhamentye, uLawulo lukaRhamentye, uLawulo, iZomthetho, uLawulo lweNkqubo yokuZinza, ezoLuntu nakuCandulo lwamabali okanye indawo edibene nayo. Iminyaka eyi-8 yamava kwinqanaba loLawulo lwaphezulu kulawulo lukaRhamentye ngaphakathi kwentengiso enkulu, ebenzima. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga noMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhamentye, iNkqubo yomthetho nolawulo lweNkonzo yoRhamentye, ulawulo lwenkqubo yokuqonda ukusebenza kwenhlangano, uqwalaselo olucwangcisiweyo, uLawulo lweNkqubo yokuZinza yenhlangano, ulawulo lwemithombo yabantu nolawulo lukaRhamentye. Ukuqonda kakuhle iingqwelomva zoRhamentye, uPhuhliso lweNhlangano, ulawulo lweenkqubo zocalulo, uLawulo lweNkqubo yokuZinza kwicala lobulungisa nolawulo oluphezulu ngaphakathi kwiNkonzo yoRhamentye. Amandla nobuchule: Amandla aphakamileyo bokuqonda ngokwamaqhinga nokuqhatha kunye nakhona ukunikela isalathiso kumbono wenhlangano, ukuqamba nokusebenzisa iinqamleze kunye nokakhuthaza ukusebenza ngamandla. Ubufakazi bokuba unako ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo, ulawulo lwemali, utshintsho lwenhlangano nolawulo lotshintsho, ulawulo lolwazi, izinto ezintsha kwindalo yonke kunye nentuthuko yezinto ezithileyo. Amandla aqinileyo bokuqwalasela, ukucwangcisa nokusombulula iingxaki. Amandla aphakamileyo bokulawula abantu, ukubamba iqhaza nabanomdla, ukunxibelelana nokubakho kwabathengi, kunye nakhona ukwakha ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nokuqinisekisa iziphumo eziphakamileyo. Izinga eliphezulu lobungcali, kuqhatha ngokungazenzisiyo, izinto ezintsha, ukuzibophelela nokuqinisekisa amaxabiso enkonzo yoRhamentye.
xh.duties: Nikeza isiqhuma soqhatha esiphakamileyo kulawulo lweenkqubo zocalulo, ulawulo lweziko kunye noLawulo lweNkqubo yokuZinza yeNhlangano yobuBulungisa ukugqithisa amandla kolawulo lwenkqubo yokuZinza, ukuthathwa kwezigqibo ezidityanisiweyo nokuqhubwa kweengqwelomva eziphakamileyo zesebe. Qhatha ekuqhubeni iinkqubo zemfundo yobulungisa, intshukumo yobuchule bomsebenzi, uphando, izinto ezintsha nolawulo lolwazi ukugqithisa amandla olawulo lwenkqubo yokuZinza nokuqonda ukusebenza kwenhlangano. Qondisa uqwalaselo olucwangcisiweyo, ulawulo lwenkqubo yokuqonda ukusebenza kwenhlangano, intshukumo yokuphucula iinkonzo, ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuhamba kolawulo lweenkqubo ezidityanisiweyo zokuqonda ukusebenza ukuxhasa uqwalaselo olusekelwe kwimiqobo, ukuzibophelela nentshukumo yokuphucula inhlangano. Qhatha kumaphulo emfundo yorhamentye, ukunxibelelana okucwangcisiweyo, ubudlelwane nezindaba, ukubamba iqhaza nabanomdla nolawulo lobungcali bokugcina ithamsanqa lilungile ukukhuthaza ithemba lorhamentye, ukuphucula ufikelelo kobulungisa nokuqinisekisa isithombe-iRhamentye seSebe. Nikeza isiqhuma soqhatha esiphakamileyo kulawulo lweenkonzo zomthetho, iinkonzo zengcebiso zomthetho, ulawulo lweempixama, ulawulo lweendlela ezivunyelweyo, iinkqubo zomthetho ezisemthethweni nolawulo lomthetho ukunciphisa iingozi zomthetho nokhusela iimfuno zeSebe. Qinisekisa ulawulo olululo, lwemali, lwemithombo yabantu, lwempahla nolawulo lwenkqubo yokuqonda ukusebenza, khuthaza ukuthobela imithetho nemiqathango yomthetho, yakhe isebe elinako, elingenamdla nokusebenza ngamandla elixhasa igunya lomthetho sikaRhamentye seSebe.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Information Communication
jobs.department: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 – R2 124 237 per annum (Level 15), (an all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director-General for ICT at the Department of Justice in Pretoria, requiring an NQF Level 8 qualification and eight years of senior management ICT experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF Level 8 qualification recognised by SAQA in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Informatics, Engineering, Business Information Systems or a related ICT field. A minimum of eight (8) years' experience at Senior Management level in an ICT environment. Extensive knowledge of information and communication technology governance, ICT strategy development, enterprise architecture, information security, digital transformation, ICT operations, applications development, infrastructure management, systems integration, ICT service management, project and programme management, business continuity, financial management, public sector governance, the Public Finance Management Act, the Public Service legislative framework and Government ICT policies and standards. Skills and Competencies: Exceptional strategic capability and leadership with the ability to develop and implement enterprise ICT strategies that support organisational priorities. Demonstrated capability in programme and project management, financial management, organisational transformation, change management, knowledge management and service delivery innovation. Strong analytical, planning and problem-solving capability, with excellent people management, stakeholder engagement, communication and client orientation skills. Proven ability to lead large-scale ICT modernisation initiatives, manage multidisciplinary technical teams, establish strategic partnerships and drive continuous organisational improvement. High levels of professionalism, ethical leadership, innovation, accountability and commitment to public service values.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership for the development and implementation of the Department's ICT strategy and digital transformation programme to support organisational objectives and service delivery. Lead ICT governance, enterprise architecture and ICT planning to ensure alignment between business requirements and technology solutions. Oversee ICT operations, infrastructure, networks, applications, information management and customer support services to ensure secure, reliable and efficient ICT service delivery. Direct the development, acquisition, implementation and maintenance of ICT systems and digital platforms that improve organisational performance and enhance access to justice services. Provide strategic leadership for information security, cybersecurity, ICT risk management, business continuity and disaster recovery to safeguard the Department's information assets and digital environment. Establish effective ICT governance, project management, procurement and contract management frameworks to ensure compliance with legislative and regulatory requirements. Ensure sound financial management, performance management, governance, human resource development and the effective utilisation of resources within the Branch
jobs.applications: Quoting the relevant reference number, direct your application to: https://forms.office.com/r/X2XaVPasWu OR Postal address: The Human Resources: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, Private Bag X81, Pretoria, 0001 OR Physical address: Application Box, First Floor Reception, East Tower, Momentum Building, 329 Pretorius Street, Pretoria.
jobs.notes: Applicants are invited to submit applications, quoting the relevant reference number to the link and or address indicated in each specific advertisement. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021, obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za), citing the correct post number and job title; a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date (dd/mm/yy), job title, detailed duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of three contactable employment references and copies of educational qualifications. Applicants who possess foreign qualification(s), are furthermore required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA).All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. These assessments are aimed at assessing candidate’s professional and technical competency against the job requirements and duties, general job fit, integrity and digital literacy). All shortlisted candidates for SMS positions will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural, emotional intelligence and integrity. All suitable candidates will be subjected to mandatory pre-employment screening/ suitability checks/ verification (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, employment pending disciplinary action and professional registration. Suitable candidates for Senior Management Service positions will also be required to successfully complete the online Nyukela Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services course, which can be accessed via: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates wishing to be considered for appointment, are encouraged to enrol for the course as soon as possible. Due to high volumes anticipated, communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (DOJ&CD) seeks to appoint exceptional, ethical and visionary leaders to join its executive leadership team in advancing constitutional democracy. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Department is committed to providing equal opportunities and affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunk-Direkteur-generaal: Inligtingkommunikasie
af.summary: Adjunk-Direkteur-generaal vir IKV by die Department of Justice in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF Level 8-kwalifikasie en agt jaar se senior bestuurs-IKV-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n NQF Level 8-kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word in Inligtingstegnologie, Rekenaarwetenskap, Inligtingstelsels, Informatika, Ingenieurswese, Besigheidsinligtingstelsels of 'n verwante IKV-veld. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ervaring op Senior Management-vlak in 'n IKV-omgewing. Uitgebreide kennis van inligting- en kommunikasietegnologie-bestuur, IKV-strategieontwikkeling, ondernemingsargitektuur, inligtingsekuriteit, digitale transformasie, IKV-bedrywighede, toepassingsontwikkeling, infrastruktuurbestuur, stelselintegrasie, IKV-diensbestuur, projek- en programbestuur, besigheidskontinuïteit, finansiële bestuur, openbare-sektor-bestuur, die Public Finance Management Act, die wetgewende raamwerk vir die openbare diens en Regering se IKV-beleide en -standaarde. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Uitsonderlike strategiese vermoë en leierskap met die vermoë om ondernemings-IKV-strategieë te ontwikkel en te implementeer wat organisatoriese prioriteite ondersteun. Bewese vermoë in program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, organisatoriese transformasie, veranderingbestuur, kennisoordrag en diensleweringsinnovasie. Sterke analitiese, beplannings- en probleemoplossingsvermoë, met uitstekende mensebestuurs-, belanghebbende-betrokkenheids-, kommunikasie- en kliëntgerigtheidsvaardighede. Bewese vermoë om grootskaalse IKV-moderniseringsinisiatiewe te lei, multidissiplinêre tegniese spanne te bestuur, strategiese vennootskappe te vestig en deurlopende organisatoriese verbetering te bevorder. Hoë vlakke van professionaliteit, etiese leierskap, innovasie, aanspreeklikheid en toewyding aan openbare dienswaardes.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Departement se IKV-strategie en digitale transformasieprogram om organisatoriese doelwitte en dienslewering te ondersteun. Lei IKV-bestuur, ondernemingsargitektuur en IKV-beplanning om belyning tussen besigheidsvereistes en tegnologie-oplossings te verseker. Hou toesig oor IKV-bedrywighede, infrastruktuur, netwerke, toepassings, inligtingsbestuur en klantondersteuningsdienste om veilige, betroubare en doeltreffende IKV-dienslewering te verseker. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, verkryging, implementering en instandhouding van IKV-stelsels en digitale platforms wat organisatoriese prestasie verbeter en toegang tot regsdienste verhoog. Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir inligtingsekuriteit, kuberveiligheid, IKV-risikobestuur, besigheidskontinuïteit en rampherstel om die Departement se inligtingsbates en digitale omgewing te beskerm. Stel doeltreffende IKV-bestuurs-, projekbestuurs-, verkrygings- en kontrakbestuursraamwerke in werking om nakoming van wetlike en regulasionele vereistes te verseker. Verseker deeglike finansiële bestuur, prestasiebestuur, bestuur, menslike hulpbronontwikkeling en die doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne binne die Tak

zu.title: Omweli wokuzwakalisa kahle: Information Communication
zu.summary: Thesebunjabhala we-ICT ongumqondiswa e-Information Communication e-Department of Justice e-Pretoria, edinga iziqu ze-NQF Level 8 kanye namashumi eyisikhombisa (8) eminyaka yamava ekuphathweni ngenhlonipa kwe-ICT.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF Level 8 ezivunyelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Informatics, Engineering, Business Information Systems noma indlela ehlobene nesebe le-ICT. Okungenani isipho somzuba weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (8) ngaphezulu kweminyaka ephansi ngaphezu kwabaphathi abakhulu emkhakheni we-ICT. Ukwazi okubaluleke kakhulu ngokuphathwa kobuchwepheshe bokwaziswa nokuxhumana, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ze-ICT, i-architecture yebhizinisi, ukuze kuphathwe ngokuphepha ulwazi, ukuguqulwa kwedijithali, imisebenzi ye-ICT, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kohluzo olubi, ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo, ukuphathwa kophelo lwe-ICT, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi nanqubo, ukuqhubeka kobhizinisi, ukuphathwa kwezimali, okugunya kwesikhungo sabantu, uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi, uhlelo lomthetho lomnyango weSezinsiza Zomphakathi namapholisi nezinga kahulumathi we-ICT. Amakhono namandla okwenza izinto: Ikhono elivelele lokubona ngokuya phambili nokuholiwa ngenkumbi yokuthuthukisa nokuphatha amaqhinga e-ICT asekelwa inhloso leNhlanganonyama. Ikhono elibonisiwe ekuphathweni kwephrojekthi nanqubo, ekuphathweni kwezimali, ekuguqulweni kweNhlanganonyama, ekuphathweni koshintsho, ekuphathweni kolwazi nasekubunqumeni kokulethwa kwesevisi. Ikhono elikhulu lokuqonda, kokuhlela nokuxazulula izinkinga, elikhulu ngokuphathwa kwezimbangulu, ekuhlongweni kwabashukumisana nomphakathi, ekuxhumana nokuqonda abathengi. Ikhono elibonisiwe lokuholiza izinhlelo ezinkulu zokuqubula kabusha i-ICT, ukuphatha iqembu lezinhlangano eziphathwa ndawonye ezibonisa ubuchwepheshe emkhakheni nokuqinisekisa amakhono amaningi ezemfundo kanye nokuqinisa ubuhlobo ngokuya phambili lobuchwepheshe, nokushukumisela ukuthi inhlanganonyama igcine isikhathi eside ihamba phambili ngokwemfundo nezenzo ezenza sengathi konke kulungile. Izinga eliphakeme ngokuba ngumuntu ovelele ngokuziphatha, ekwenzeni izinto ezingiwe, ekuphathweni kwento eyodwa ngomdlandla, ekubeni nolwazi nangokuzinika ngenhliziyo ngamasiko wobuntu ngokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu.
zu.duties: Nika abaqondiswa bobuchwepheshe bokwaziswa nokuxhumana iholiso elinjongo yokuthuthukisa futhi losa inqubo yokusebenza kwe-ICT kanye nenqubo yokuguqulwa kwedijithali kumnyango ukuze kusekelwe amaganga leNhlanganweni nokuhanjiswa kwemisebenzi. Hola igunya le-ICT, i-architecture yamabhizinisi nokuhlela kwe-ICT ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelanisa phakathi kwemfuneko yebhizinisi nezixazululi zobuchwepheshe. Qapha imisebenzi ye-ICT, insimbi yezinto eziyingqayizivele, amanethiwekhi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kolwazi nesevisi yokweseka abathengi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwemisebenzi ye-ICT ekuphephile, ethembekile lesebenzayo. Nika abaqondiswa bobuchwepheshe bokwaziswa nokuxhumana iholiso ekuthuthukiseni, ekutholeni, ekulosweni nasekulondolozweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-ICT namasayithi wedijithala okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kweNhlanganonyama futhi kwandise ukufinyelela ezinkonzini zokuphathwa kwobulungiswa. Nika iholiso elinjongo ekuphathweni kolwazi ngokuphepha, ukuqinisekiswa kwe-ICT, ekuphathweni kwezingozi ze-ICT, ekuqhubekeleni kobhizinisi nakumlindweni wokubuyela emuva ukuze kuvikelwe impahla yolwazi nomkhakha wedijithala womnyango. Misela izimiso ezisebenzayo zogunya le-ICT, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, ukuthenga nokuphathwa kwezinkontileka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho nezimiso. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali okuhle, ukuphathwa kokusebenza, igunya, ukuthuthukiswa kwemithombo yabasebenzi nokusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwemithobo ngaphakathi kweSikhungo

xh.title: Sekela iNkulumba i-General: Ulwazi kunye nonxibelelwano
xh.summary: Sekela iNkulumba i-ICT kwisebe lika-Department of Justice ePretoria kwaye ifuna i-NQF Level 8 qualification kunye namashumi asibhozo (8) amashumi wobuchule ekulawuleni i-ICT.
xh.requirements: Nqanaba le-NQF Level 8 lemfuno elivunyelwe yi-SAQA kwilifa le-Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Informatics, Engineering, Business Information Systems okanye indawo engcolileyo kwi-ICT. Oku kungeniswe emva kwamashumi alutshanu (8) amashumi obuchule kwi-Nqanaba i-Senior Management kwindawo ye-ICT. Ukwaziswa okubanzi malunga no lawulo lothuthuzishe, i-ICT strategy development, ulwakhiwo igqiza, ukhuseleko Lwazi, ukutshintshwa kwangexesha, imisebenzi ye-ICT, ukuba kwakhiwa kweenkqubo, ukulawulwa kwesiseko sezinto, ukudityaniswa kweenkqubo, ukulawulwa kwenkonzo ye-ICT, ulawulo lomsebenzi kwaye no lawulo lomxholo wemisebenzi, ukuqhubekeka koshishino, i-financial management, ulawulo lwangaphakathi kogqithimbe, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Public Service legislative framework kunye namagqabantshintshi e-ICT kwi-Government nemiqathango. Amakhono namaphakathi: Ukukwazi amandla okubonelela ngamandla obulumko ngokungathathi hlangothi kwaye anamandla obukhosi bokuba nakho ukwakha kwaye asebenzise i-strategies ze-ICT ezixhasa izinto eziphambili zegqiza. Amandla obukhosi abonakalisiweyo kulawulo I-programme kunye no lawulo lomsebenzi, i-financial management, ukuguqulwa koluntu, ulawulo lweziganeko, ulawulo lwazolwazi kunye nophuhliso lwenkonzo. Ukudidiyela amandla, ukucwangcisa kwaye ukusombulula iingxaki, namakhono amakhulu ekulawuleni abantu, isithintatho sabaphulaphuli, unxibelelwano kunye ne-client orientation. Amandla abonisiweyo ukuba nakho ukuzisa isikhokeli i-modernisation initiatives ze-ICT ezinkulu, ukulawula amaqela obuchwepheshe amaninzi, useka ubudlelwane ngokulawula kunye nokuzisa iingqibo zegqiza ezenza ushintsheqo olukhawulezileyo. I-Nqanaba elithe chatha ngokuziphatha okusesikhweni, ukukhokela ngoBom Lokuziphatha, okungathathi hlangothi, ukuziphendula nokuzinikela kubemi baseburhulini.
xh.duties: Nika isikhokeli esinamagqabantshintshi ekubeni kwakhiwe kwaye setyenziswe iNqanaba le-ICT nakwingqungelaalathuli yamathuba obuchwephesha kwisebe ukuze axhasa iinjongo zegqiza kwanemisebenzi yayo. Yiba ngumaneli wolawulo i-ICT, isakhiwo segqiza i-ICT kunye nokucwangcisa i-ICT ukuze kuqinisekiswe uluhlu oluhambelana phakathi kweemfuno zoshishino nezisombululo zobuchwepheshe. Qhuba imisebenzi ye-ICT, esiseko sezinto, iinethiwekhi, iinkqubo, ulawulo lwolwazi nencekedo yamathengi ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukuba kutyhilwa ngokhuselekileyo, ngokwethembekileyo nangempumelelo iinkonzo ze-ICT. Qondisa ekwakhiweni, ekuqojweni, ekusetynzisweni nakulondolozweni kweenkqubo ze-ICT kunye namaphaphu abathubi amathuba obuchwephesha axela imveliso yegqiza kwaye akhulisa ifikelo kule nkonzio ka-Themba. Nika isikhokeli esinamagqabantshintshi ekhuselekeni kolwazi, ekhuselekeni koluntu I-ICT, ekulawuleni iingxaki ze-ICT, ekusuka kuqhubekayo phakathi kokutshintsha koluntu kwanasemva kokubuyela ngemva kwethamsanqa lokuqinisekisa ukuba kugcinwa izityalo zolwazi nangengingqi ekwazulu kwisebe. Seka ngempumelelo ulawulo I-ICT, ulawulo lomsebenzi onjaniweyo, I-procurement nakulawulo I-contract framework ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukuthelewana nezidingo eziso Shanxaxa. Qamba ngokusisiseko ulawulo I-financial, ulawulo I-performance, ulawulo I-financial, ulawulo I-financial, ukunaka kakhulu ngokusetyenziswa okusebenzayo kwezibizo phakathi kwezi Brande.

af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Regte / LLB soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak; Toelating as 'n prokureur; Administratiewe ervaring. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling); Rekenaargeletterdheid; Tegniese kundigheid; Strategiese leierskapsvermoë; Analitiese denke, probleemoplossing en besluitneming; Entrepreneurs- en besigheidsvermoë; Projekbestuur; Kliëntediensgerigtheid; Menslike ontwikkeling en bemagtiging; Deelnemende leierskap en spanwerk; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Navorsings- en ontwikkelingskundigheid; Strategiese veranderingsbestuur; Eerlikheid en integriteit; Interpersoonlike verhoudings en konflikbestuur.

jobs.department: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
jobs.centre: Master of The High Court, Pretoria Ref No: 2026/61/GP (X1 Post) :   Master of The High Court, Bloemfontein Ref No: 25/19/FS (X1 Post) Master of The High Court, Johannesburg Ref No: 2026/19/GP (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 – R1 551 807 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Senior manager to oversee Guardian's Fund, deceased estates, curatorships, trusts and insolvencies at the Master of the High Court, requiring an LLB and five years' managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Law / LLB or any legal equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior managerial level; Admittance as an Advocate / Attorney with right of appearance at the High Court; Knowledge of the Foundations of South African law, Administration of Estates Act, Mental Health Act, Insolvency Act, Companies Act, Close Corporations Act, Trust Property Control Act and other relevant legislations; South African family law, constitutional law, intellectual property, evidence and African Customary Law. Skills and Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership; Project and programme management; Financial Management; Change management; Knowledge management; Service Delivery Innovation (SDI); Diversity management; Client Orientation and Customer Focus; Good communication skills (verbal and written); Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Manage and monitor the implementation of Guardian’s Fund; Manage and monitor the implementation of Deceased Estate; Manage the administration of Curatorship and registration of Trust; Manage the administration of Insolvencies; Monitor and manage service points operations; Manage human, financial and other resources.
jobs.enquiries: Free State: Ms N Dywili at (073) 775 0709 Gauteng: Ms T Maphoto Tel No: (011) 332 9000 or Ms P Raadt Tel No: (011) 332 9000
jobs.applications: Quoting the relevant reference number, direct your application to: https://forms.office.com/r/X2XaVPasWu OR Postal address: The Human Resources: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development, Private Bag X81, Pretoria, 0001 OR Physical address: Application Box, First Floor Reception, East Tower.
jobs.notes: A separate application must be submitted for each position quoting the relevant reference number. OTHER POSTS Applicants are invited to submit applications, quoting the relevant reference number to the link and or address indicated in each specific advertisement. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021, obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za), citing the correct post number and job title; a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date (dd/mm/yy), job title, detailed duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of three contactable employment references and copies of educational qualifications. Applicants who possess foreign qualification(s), are furthermore required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA).All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. These assessments are aimed at assessing candidate’s professional and technical competency against the job requirements and duties, general job fit, integrity and digital literacy). All shortlisted candidates for SMS positions will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural, emotional intelligence and integrity. All suitable candidates will be subjected to mandatory pre-employment screening/ suitability checks/ verification (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, employment pending disciplinary action and professional registration. Suitable candidates for Senior Management Service positions will also be required to successfully complete the online Nyukela Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services course, which can be accessed via: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates wishing to be considered for appointment, are encouraged to enrol for the course as soon as possible. Due to high volumes anticipated, communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (DOJ&CD) seeks to appoint exceptional, ethical and visionary leaders to join its executive leadership team in advancing constitutional democracy. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Department is committed to providing equal opportunities and affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

xh.duties: Lawulisa nilawule ukusebenza kwethemba loMzi wokuqinisekisa iinwele, imali yabantu abangasekhoyo, abalawuli bubemi bathembu kunye neenkontileka ezingazange zihlawuliswe kwindlu yombuso ephonononga iindaba zamafa eza kubanjwa yindlu yombuso enemvuzo webhungqa kummandla othile owodwa ojikelezileyo kuqinisekiso lombuzo wokuqala elikhoyo, iphumo leminikela isigqibo esithi zonke iindawo zokukhethwa ngqo kwelungu elilodwa nelinye kwindlu yombuso ebezwe kwaye ibambe ngendlela echanekileyo.

jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS).
jobs.summary: Chief Director position overseeing monitoring and evaluation systems for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor’s Degree or Advanced Diploma in Development Studies / Social Sciences / Public Administration (NQF Level 7) or related equivalent qualification and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum of 5 years’ experience at senior managerial level in monitoring and evaluation. Experience in monitoring for verification of the projects. Experience in integrated planning for multisector engagement for improved rural development outcomes. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of monitoring and evaluation frameworks including the Government wide monitoring and evaluation system. Knowledge of the legislation that is applicable to the Department and the sector. Job related skills: Interpersonal relations and presentation. Communication (verbal and written). Negotiation and advocacy. Interpretation ability. Project management. Strategic capacity and leadership ability. Computer literacy. Diplomatic. Report writing ability. Ability to conduct investigation.
jobs.duties: Oversee the development and maintenance of an integrated monitoring and evaluation system. Develop / review the Department’s framework for monitoring and evaluating the performance of the Department and relevant State-Owned Entities (SOEs) the framework may include policy, strategy, processes, tools etc. Oversee the development/review of the Department’s systems for managing data and information as well as reporting. Oversee the development of a framework for assessing the effectiveness and efficiency of the monitoring and evaluation system. Oversee the conducting of periodic assessments to determine the effectiveness and efficiency of the monitoring and evaluation system. Oversee the development/review of the Department’s systems for managing data and information as well as reporting. Monitor and report on the performance of the Department in line with strategic plans, annual performance plans and operational plans. Drive operational excellence and governance of the Department. Develop and maintain performance monitoring tools and frameworks. Coordinate and compile institutional performance and strategic reports. Compile and consolidate inputs into the departmental annual report. Conduct evaluation assessments related to the programmes of the Department. Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks. Perform evaluation of strategic projects and programmes according to the departmental evaluation plan. Analyse and interpret evaluation data. Facilitate development of sectoral evaluation plan. Manage monitoring and evaluation functions and provide technical support to public entities. Oversee the processes of monitoring and reporting between DLRRD and public entities. Facilitate and coordinate capacity building on monitoring and evaluation matters. Facilitate the development and support implementation of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and guidelines for public entities. Facilitate and coordinate planning, monitoring and evaluation working groups. Provide strategic guidance and support on the development and review of performance indicators. Facilitate and coordinate monitoring of strategic projects performance and results. Create capacity to monitor and evaluate performance. Facilitate the provision of training with regards to monitoring and evaluation. Formulate and manage strategic partnerships to enhance the capacity of the Department to monitor and evaluate its performance. Establish and lead forums / structures aimed at enhancing monitoring and evaluation practises within the Department. Participate in national, regional and international forums and structures aimed at enhancing monitoring and evaluation practices.
