Vermoë om ondersoeke uit te voer.
af.duties: Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van 'n geïntegreerde moniterings- en evalueringsstelsel. Ontwikkel / hersien die departement se raamwerk vir die monitering en evaluerings van die prestasie van die departement en tersaaklike Staatsbeheerde Entiteite (SOEs); die raamwerk kan beleid, strategie, prosesse, instrumente ens. insluit. Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling/hersiening van die departement se stelsels vir die bestuur van data en inligting asook verslagdoening. Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling van 'n raamwerk vir die assessering van die doeltreffendheid en doelmatigheid van die moniterings- en evalueringsstelsel. Hou toezig op die uitvoer van periodieke assesserings om die doeltreffendheid en doelmatigheid van die moniterings- en evalueringsstelsel te bepaal. Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling/hersiening van die departement se stelsels vir die bestuur van data en inligting asook verslagdoening. Monitor en rapporteer oor die prestasie van die departement in ooreenstemming met strategiese planne, jaarlike prestasieplanne en operasionele planne. Dryf operasionele uitnemendheid en bestuur van die departement aan. Ontwikkel en onderhou prestasie-moniteringsinstrumente en -raamwerke. Koördineer en stel institusionele prestasie- en strategiese verslae op. Stel en konsolideer insetsels vir die departementele jaarverslag. Voer evalueringsassesserings uit wat verband hou met die programme van die departement. Ontwikkel en onderhou evalueringsraamwerke. Voer evaluering van strategiese projekte en programme uit volgens die departementele evalueringsplan. Analiseer en interpreteer evalueringsdata. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van 'n sektorale evalueringsplan. Bestuur moniterings- en evalueringsfunksies en verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan openbare entiteite. Hou toezig oor die prosesse van monitering en verslagdoening tussen DLRRD en openbare entiteite. Fasiliteer en koördineer kapasiteitsbou oor moniterings- en evalueringsake. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en ondersteun die implementering van moniterings- en evalueringsraamwerke en -riglyne vir openbare entiteite. Fasiliteer en koördineer beplannings-, moniterings- en evalueringswerkgroepe. Verskaf strategiese leiding en ondersteuning rakende die ontwikkeling en hersiening van prestasie-aanwysers. Fasiliteer en koördineer monitering van strategiese projekte se prestasie en resultate. Skep kapasiteit om prestasie te monitor en te evalueer. Fasiliteer die verskaffing van opleiding met betrekking tot monitering en evaluering. Formuleer en bestuur strategiese vennootskappe om die kapasiteit van die departement te versterk om sy prestasie te monitor en te evalueer. Stig en lei forums / strukture wat gemik is op die verbetering van moniterings- en evalueringspraktyke binne die departement. Neem deel aan nasionale, regionale en internasionale forums en strukture wat gemik is op die verbetering van moniterings- en evalueringspraktyke.

zu.title: Mfundi oyinhloko: Ukuqapha nokuhlola
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokubusa sokuqaphela kwezinsiza zokubuka nokwahlulela isiso kwi-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavunyelwa ngaphansi kwazo: Abafaki bamacala kumele babe nokutholwa kwe-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree noma i-Advanced Diploma kwi-Development Studies / i-Social Sciences / i-Public Administration (NQF Level 7) noma iziqu ezilinganayo kanye nesitifiketi se-Nyukela (isitifiketi sangaphambi kokungena ku-SMS) esinikezwa ngaphambi kokwamukelwa. Ukuze ube wusomabhizinisi onguthisha kodwa kumele ube neminyaka eyi-5 yeminyaka yokubuka nokuhola kumkhakha webhizinisi namkhuva. Ukuba nolwazi ekubukeni izinhlelo ngokuqinisekisa ngokuboneka kwepulani. Ulwazi ekubukeni nokuqondwa ngokohlelo nokuqhuba imimongo eqoqa imikhakha ukukhuthaza izifundo zasemakhaya. I-licence yokushayela egunyaziwe. Ulwazi olwengeziwe: Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokuqaphela nokuqaphela kubandakanya isistimu kahulumuzi yokuqaphela. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambisana noMnyango nokuleyo ewo yomkhakha. Amasu okusebenza ohlelweni: Ukubekezela nokuxhumana nabanye. Ukudlulisela inkulumo (lolu limi nolubhaliwe). Ukubukisisa nokuqondakaliswa. Ukuphatha amaphulani. Amandla wokuqapha kanye nendlela yokubekezela. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngomshini. Ukudlula izizinda ngezinkathazo. Ulwazi lokuqapha nokuqhagamishelwa ngaleyo ndlela. Ukulunga okunamandla okubuzwa izindinganiso.
zu.duties: Qapha intlupheko kanye nolondolozo lwesistimu elondolozwayo. Bumba / phinda ubuke isakhiwo somnyango sokubheka nokuhlola ukusebenza komnyango kanye nemicimbe ehlobene nayo yabasingathi bomphakathi (SOEs) isakhiwo singabandakanya inqubomgomo, isu, izinqubo, amathuluzi njs. Qapha ukuthuthwa/phindwa kwezinhlelo zomnyango zokuphatha idatha nolwazi kanye nokubika. Qapha ukuthuthwa kwesakhiwo sokuhlola ukusebenza nokusebenza kahle kwezistimu yokubuka nokuqaphela. Qapha ukwenziwa kokuhlola okwenziwa njalo ukuze kuthiwe kusebenza yini futhi kusebenza kahle yini le nxulumene yokubuka nokuqaphela. Qapha ukuthuthwa/phindwa kwezinhlelo zomnyango zokuphatha idatha nolwazi kanye nokubika. Qaphela futhi ubike ngomsebenzi womnyango ngokwezinhlelo ezibalulekile, izinhlelo zomsebenzi zonyaka kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Qhuba ukugqama ekusebenzeni nokubusa komnyango. Bumba futhi ugcine amathuluzi nezakhiwo zokuqaphela ukusebenza. Hlela futhi uhlanganise imibiko yokusebenza kweziko kanye nezinhlelo eziyisigaba. Hlela futhi uhlanganise okungenayo emishweni yomnyango yonyaka. Yenza izipqoqo zokuqaphela ezihlobene nezinhlelo zomnyango. Bumba futhi ugcine izakhiwo zokuqaphela. Yenza ukuqaphela kwezinhlelo ezingamaphrojekthi namapulani njengengxenye yesigaba sokubuka komnyango. Hlaziya futhi uchaze imininingwane yokubuka. Lwazi ukuthuthwa kohlaka lokubuka nokuqaphela. Phatha imisebenzi yokubuka nokuqaphela futhi unike usizo lwobuchwepheshe kumabanga omphakathi. Qaphela izinqubo zokuqaphela nokuqaphela phakathi kuka-DLRRD kanye namabanga omphakathi. Lwazi futhi uhleze ukulungiselela nokwakha amandla ezindabeni zokuqaphela. Lwazi ukuthuthwa nokwesekwa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuqaphela nokuqaphela namagqabrabo emikhakha ka wona umphakathi. Hlela futhi ulunge izinkampani ezimisele kubuka, ukubuka nokuqaphela. Nikeza iselulelo esibalulekile kanye naleso ekuqondweni kokuthuthwa nokuphindwa kwezinkomba zokusebenza. Hleza futhi ulunge ukubuka kokusebenza kwezinhlelo amaphrojekthi namaphuzu. Yiza izindlu ezithuthukisa amandla okubuka nokuqaphela. Yenza nokufundisa ngaphakathi kwalokhu mayelana nokubuka nokuqaphela. Hlela futhi ulawula ubudlelwano obuqotho ukukhulisa amandla esikhundla. Hleza futhi uhlela amaforamu / izakhiwo ngokusizakala ukubuka nokuqaphela endaweni ka DLRRD. Thatha inhlangothi ohlangothini lwesifunda nekhaya okukhuthuza ukubuka nokuqaphelwa kwezinto ezenzwayo.

xh.title: Umlawuli Omkhulu: Ulawulo lokuqwalasela nokuqhawula
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli omkhulu ophethe iziphithi zolawulo lokuqwalasela nokuqhawula kwisebe leLand Reform and Rural Development, esekwa ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neGrade 12 Certificate kunye neBachelor’s Degree okanye iAdvanced Diploma kwiDevelopment Studies / Social Sciences / Public Administration (NQF Level 7) okanye nesiqinisekiso esilinganayo, njengoko kunye necertificate yeNyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) ekuza kunikwa ngaphambi kokwamkelwa. Kufuneka abe namava eminyaka engu-5 kwinqanaba lolawulo oluphezulu ekubuyiselweni kolwazi ngokuqwalasela nokuqhawula. Kufuneka abe namava ekubuyiselweni kolwazi ngenjongo yokwenza isiqinisekiso kumaphrojekthi. Kufuneka abe namava ekulungiseni izicwangciso ezibambekayo eziza kuvumela ukusebenzisana kumacandelo amaninzi ukuphucula iziphumo zentshukumo yasemaphandleni. Kufuneka ane-driver’s licence esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngezikongo zokuqwalasela nokuqhawula kuquka nesisiphithi sokubuyiselwa kolwazi kolawulo esiya kuto lonke iRhulumente. Ulwazi ngemithetho eqhotsywe kwisebe nasecandelo. Ikhono elihambelana nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisana nabantu nokubonelela ipezentethi. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Iinkcinezelo nokukhusela izinto. Ikhono lokutolika. Ulawulo lwamaphrojekthi. Ikhono lokulawula nokuqonda iindlela ezikhethekileyo. Ukusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha. Ukuba nesimo sokhethwe. Ikhono lokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokwenza uphando.
xh.duties: Ukugcina ixhoba kwephuhliso nolondolozo kwesisiphithi esibambekayo sokuqwalasela nokuqhawula. Ukuphuhlisa / ukuphonononga isikongo sesebe sokuqwalasela nokuqhawula ngokusebenza kwesebe kunye neentitshu zebuso ezinxulumene (SOEs) isikongo singaquka inkqubo, isicwangciso, iinkqubo, izixhobo njl. Ukugcina ixhoba kwephuhliso / ukuphonononga kwezisiphithi zesebe zokulawula idatha nolwazi kunye nokwenza iingxelo. Ukugcina ixhoba kwephuhliso lesikongo sokuqwalasela ukusebenza nokuqhawula ukubakho nokuqhuba komsoco weqondo kokuphindaphinda kolawulo lookuqwalasela nokuqhawula. Ukugcina ixhoba ekwenzeni ukuphonononga ngokuphindaphinda kwisiphithi sokubakho nokuqhuba kweqondo kolawulo lokuqwalasela nokuqhawula. Ukugcina ixhoba kwephuhliso / ukuphonononga kwezisiphithi zesebe zokulawula idatha nolwazi kunye nokwenza iingxelo. Ukubuyela ngenxelo ngokusebenza kwesebe ngokwesicwangciso esiqondo phambili, iisicwangciso zobukho bezonyaka nezikw imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla. Ukukhuthaza ukuphuculwa kwemisebenzi nolawulo lwesebe. Ukuphuhlisa nolondolozwa kwezixhobo zokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwentla nozikongo. Ukulungelelanisa nokubumba iingxelo eziqond phambili ngokusebenza kwentlalo nesi zikongo. Ukubumba nokudibanisa izigqibo kwinguvo yonyaka yesebe. Ukwenza ukuphonononga ngokulinganisa okuquka iinkqubo zesebe. Ukuphuhlisa nolondolozo kwezikhongo zokuqhawula. Ukwenza ukuqhawula kwamaphrojekthi aqondo phambili n inkqubo ngokwesicwangciso sokuqhawula sesebe. Ukuphonononga nokutolika idatha yokunxulumana nesiphithi sokuqhawula. Ukukhuthaza iphuhliso lesicwangciso sokuqhawula kumacandelo. Ukulawula imisebenzi yokuqwalasela nokuqhawula noku nikela inkxaso ngezobuchwepheshe kwiintitshu zikawonke-wonke. Ukugcina ixhoba kwiinkqubo zokuqwalasela nokubika phakathi kwedLRRD nentitshu zikawonke-wonke. Ukukhuthaza nokulungelelanisa ukwakhiwa kwamandla kumabanga alo na kolawulo lokuqwalasela nokuqhawula. Ukukhuthaza iphuhliso nokuxhasa ukusebenza kwezikhongo neenkkamiso zokuqwalasela nokuqhawula kwiintitshu zikawonke-wonke. Ukukhuthaza nokulungelelanisa izikongo zokucwangcisa, ukuqwalasela nokuqhawula. Ukunikela ngolu tshogo oluphandlayo nokuxhasa ekuphuhlisweni nasekuphononongeni iimpawu zokuqala. Ukukhuthaza nokulungelelanisa ukuguqula iziphumo zokuqwalasela nokuqhawula kwamaphrojekthi. Ukuyila amandla okuqwalasela nokukhawula inkqubo. Ukukhuthaza ukuqatshelwa kolwazi mayela nokuqwalasela nokuqhawula. Ukuqamba nolawula ukuhlangana okuqondo phambili ngokwenza isiphithi esi khululeyeko ukunika amandla kwisebe. Ukumiswa kokulatha amafawuni / iinkqubo zokuqwalasela nokukhawula ngaphakathi kwisebe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwamaza, iindawo namazwe aphesheya nakuzo naziphi na iindawo ezikujoliswe kuzo ukuphucula inkqubo yokuqwalasela nokuqhawula.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Human Resource Administration
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 929 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in Polokwane managing human resource administration services, including PERSAL appointments, allowances, leave and benefits, at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Human Resources Management / Human Resource Development / Labour Relations (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience at junior management in a human resource management environment. PERSAL Personnel Certificate, PERSAL Leave Administration certificate. Knowledge and experience in pension administration. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC) resolutions. Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Public Finance Management Act. Job related skills: Analytical thinking. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Report writing ability. Problem solving ability.
jobs.duties: Manage and monitor human resource management services. Oversee and manage the capturing of appointments on PERSAL. Oversee and manage the administration of allowances. Oversee and manage compensation of service benefits and conditions. Oversee and manage the administration of leave. Oversee and monitor the processing of employee mobility (e.g. translation in rank, secondments, re-assignments, counter-offers). Manage termination of service. Provide advise on human resource management services. Manage employee relations. Monitor the grievances submitted to National Office. Monitor disciplinary cases submitted to National Office. Manage the implementation of progressive discipline, grievance and misconduct cases outcomes. Manage the capturing of labour relations events. Manage employee performance management, training and development system. Oversee and manage the submission of performance agreements. Oversee and manage the mid-term review assessments. Oversee and manage the annual assessment process. Coordinate and facilitate the assessments of staff including senior management members. Provide statistics on compliance. Oversee and manage the capturing of Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) documents on PERSAL. Oversee and manage the capturing the of performance incentives. Ensure submission of inputs on the workplace skills plan. Manage the activities of the training and development committee. Manage and oversee the submission of training memorandums to National Office. Oversee and monitor the provisioning training and development in the province. Manage and oversee the orientation of employees. Monitor the placement approval of the in-service requests. Manage the appointment of interns within the province. Coordinate compilation of training reports and provide statistics with regards to training courses attended. Provide advise on training and EPMDS matters Manage recruitment and selection. Oversee and manage recruitment and selection processes. Monitor the updating of Employment Equity targets. Monitor security clearances for selected candidates. Oversee and manage submissions for appointment. Provide statistics with regards to filling of posts. Manage and oversee the activities of Employment Equity Forums. Ensure provision of statistics with regard to recruitment and selection. Manage employee health and wellness programmes. Oversee and manage the implementation of employee health and wellness programmes. Ensure provision reports with regards to employee health and wellness programmes and referral to wellness service providers. Manage and oversee the activities of Employee Health and Wellness Forum. Ensure provision of advice on EHWP matters.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 61 Biccard street, Polokwane, 0700 or by email to Post180@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. ERRATUM: The position of Deputy Director: Strategic Land Acquisition ref 3/1/1/1/2026/150 for the Directorate: Strategic Land Acquisition: Limpopo (Polokwane) that was advertised in Public Service Vacancy Circular 24 dated 10 July 2026 has reference. The position has been withdrawn. The Department apologies for any inconvenience caused. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos in Polokwane wat menslike-hulpbronadministrasiedienste bestuur, insluitend PERSAL-benoemings, toelaes, verlof en voordele, by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling / Arbeidsverhoudinge (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante ekwivalent kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak in 'n menslike-hulpbronbestuursomgewing. PERSAL Personeelsertifikaat, PERSAL Leave Administration-sertifikaat. Kennis en ervaring van pensioenadministrasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC) resolutions. Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Public Finance Management Act. Werksverwante vaardighede: Analitiese denke. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagdoeningsvermoë. Probleemoplossingsvermoë.
af.duties: Bestuur en monitor menslike-hulpbronbestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die vaslegging van benoemings op PERSAL. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die administrasie van toelaes. Hou toesig oor en bestuur vergoeding van diensvoordele en -voorwaardes. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die administrasie van verlof. Hou toesig oor en monitor die verwerking van werknemermobiliteit (bv. vertaling in rang, ontheffings, heraansoeke, teenaanbiedinge). Bestuur beëindiging van diens. Verskaf advies oor menslike-hulpbronbestuursdienste. Bestuur werknemerverhoudinge. Monitor klagtes by die National Office ingedien. Monitor dissiplinêre sake by die National Office ingedien. Bestuur die implementering van progressiewe dissipline, klagte- en wangedrag-sake se uitkomste. Bestuur die vaslegging van arbeidsverhoudingsgebeure. Bestuur werknemerprestasiebestuur, opleidings- en ontwikkelingstelsel. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die indiening van prestasieooreenkomste. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die midtermyn-hersieningsassesserings. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die jaarlikse assesseringsproses. Koördineer en fasiliteer die assesserings van personeel insluitend senior bestuurslede. Verskaf statistieke oor nakoming. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die vaslegging van Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS)-dokumente op PERSAL. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die vaslegging van prestasie-aansporings. Verseker indiening van insette oor die werkplekvaardigheidsplan. Bestuur die aktiwiteite van die opleidings- en ontwikkelingskomitee. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die indiening van opleidingsmemorandums by die National Office. Hou toesig oor en monitor die voorsiening van opleiding en ontwikkeling in die provinsie. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die oriëntasie van werknemers. Monitor die plasinggoedkeuring van die in-diens-versoeke. Bestuur die benoeming van internasione in die provinsie. Koördineer samestelling van opleidingsverslae en verskaf statistieke met betrekking tot opleidingskursusse bygewoon. Verskaf advies oor opleidings- en EPMDS-aangeleenthede Bestuur werwery en seleksie. Hou toesig oor en bestuur werwerings- en seleksieprosesse. Monitor die bywerking van Employment Equity-teikens. Monitor veiligheidsklarings vir geselekteerde kandidate. Hou toesig oor en bestuur voorleggings vir benoeming. Verskaf statistieke met betrekking tot die vul van poste. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die aktiwiteite van Employment Equity Forums. Verseker voorsiening van statistieke met betrekking tot werwering en seleksie. Bestuur werknemergezondheids- en welstandsprogramme. Hou toesig oor en bestuur die implementering van werknemergezondheids- en welstandsprogramme. Verseker voorsiening van verslae met betrekking tot werknemergezondheids- en welstandsprogramme en verwysing na welstandsdiensverskaffers. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die aktiwiteite van die Employee Health and Wellness Forum. Verseker voorsiening van advies oor EHWP-aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Isikhundla somongameli ohambelayo: Ukuphatwa kwezenzi zabantu
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongameli ohambelayo ePolokwane sokuphatha izinkonzo zokuphathwa kwezenzi zabantu, okuhlanganisa ukumiswa kwabasebenzi kwiPERSAL, izibonezelo, ukushiya kanye nezinzuzo, eNyuvesi yoLushintsho lweZwe nokuPhuhliswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavunyelwe ngaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma yezwe kuPhathwa kwezenzi zabantu / ukuPhuhliswa kwezenzi zabantu / ubudlelwano bemisebenzi (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezihlobene nazo. Isiphephelo seminyaka eyi-3 sokuhamba phambili esikweni esiphansi sokuphatha kwindawo yokuphathwa kwezenzi zabantu. Isitifiketi sabasebenzi sePERSAL, isitifiketi sokuphatha ukushiya sePERSAL. Ulwazi kanye namava ekuphathweni kwezipenzela. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: iEmployment Equity Act. iPublic Service Regulations. iBasic Conditions of Employment Act. iPublic Service Act. iSkills Development Act. iLabour Relations Act. izinqumo zePublic Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC). iPromotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). iPromotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). iPublic Finance Management Act. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulawule izinkonzo zokuphathwa kwezenzi zabantu. Qaphela futhi uphathe ukungena kwabasebenzi abashwe kwiPERSAL. Qaphela futhi uphathe ukuphathwa kwezibonezelo. Qaphela futhi uphathe inkokhelo yezinzuzo zesevisi kanye nezimo. Qaphela futhi uphathe ukuphathwa kokushiya. Qaphela futhi uholele ukugqitshwa kwezinhjazuba zabasebenzi (isb. ukuhumusha esikhundleni, ukuthunyelwa, ukubekwa kabusha, iziphakamiso eziphikisanayo). Phatha ukuphela kwenkonzo. Nikeza izeluleko ngezinkonzo zokuphathwa kwezenzi zabantu. Phatha ubudlelwano babasebenzi. Qaphela izinto ezingemukeleko ezithunyelwe eNyuvesi. Qaphela izimoto ezingumthetho zezehlazo ezithunyelwe eNyuvesi. Phatha ukuqedwa kwebuqotho obuqhubekayo, izinto ezingemukeleko kanye neziphumo zemikhuba yenukubhadleli. Phatha ukungena kwezehla zemibhalo yezehlazo ezenzakalayo. Phatha inkqubo yokuphathwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi, ukuqeqesha nokuqhakambisa. Qaphela futhi uphathe ukuthunyelwa kwezivumelwano zokusebenza. Qaphela futhi uphatle izilinganiselo zokuhlola ezenza ngaphakathi ngesikhathi. Qaphela futhi uphathe inqubo yokuqatshwa kwamaviki onke. Hlanganisa futhi wenze izilinganiselo zabahlanganyela bezigaba esiphezulu sokuphatha. Nikeza izibalo ngenqubo. Qaphela futhi uphathe ukungena kwamafayela eEmployee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) kwiPERSAL. Qaphela futhi uphathe ukungena kwezikhuthazo zokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwezifakelo ngohlelo lwamakhono asebenzayo. Phatha imisebenzi yabandla lokuqeqesha nokuqhakambisa. Phatha futhi qaphela ukuthunyelwa kwezaziso zokuqeqesha eNyuvesi. Qaphela futhi uholele ukuqeqesha nokuqhakambisa esifundeni. Phatha futhi qaphela isiqondiso sabasebenzi abasha. Qaphela ukuvunywa kokubekwa abasebenzi kumaNorth Afrika. Phatha ukumiswa kwesigaxa sabasebenzi esifundeni. Hlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemibiko yokuqeqesha futhi nikeza izibalo ngamakilasi okuqeqeshwa abaye babakona. Nikeza izeluleko ngokuqeqesha kanye nemikhuba ye-EPMDS. Phatha ukubanjwa abasebenzi nokukhethwa. Qaphela futhi uphathe inqubo yokubanjwa kwabasebenzi nokukhethwa. Qaphela ukuvuselelwa kwezinto ezingaguquki zezenqubu. Qaphela izinkambu zosungulo zabantu abakhethiwe. Qaphela futhi uphathe izinto ezithunyelwe ukuze kubekwe abantu. Nikeza izibalo ngokugcwalisa izikhundla. Phatha futhi qaphela imisebenzi yama-employment equity forums. Qinisekisa ukubonezela izibalo ngokubanjwa kwabasebenzi nokukhethwa. Phatha amahlelo ezempilo namahlelo okuphila kahle abasebenzi. Qaphela futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa kwamahlelo ezempilo namahlelo okuphila kahle abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukubonezela imibiko ngamahlelo ezempilo namahlelo okuphila kahle kanye nokuqondiswa kwababenzi ikhono le-employee health and wellness service providers. Phatha futhi qaphela imisebenzi yase-Employee Health and Wellness Forum. Qinisekisa ukubonezela izeluleko ngezinto ze-EHWP.

xh.title: Isekela-Mongameli: Ukulawula IzeNkonzo zabasebenzi
xh.summary: Indima yesekela-mongameli ePolokwane yokulawula iinkonzo zolawulo lwezenkonzo zabasebenzi, kuquka iintonjio ePERSAL, ii-allowances, i-leave nezibonelelo, kuSebe loLwazi-lwamabhulumlu nokuPhuhliswa kwamaphondo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno esisiseko: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Garde 12 kwaye babe neDiploma yezwelonke kwiNkululo lweZenkonzo zabasebenzi / eZinto zoPhuhliso lweZenkonzo zabasebenzi / uBudlelwane boMsebenzi (iNqanaba leNQF 6) okanye isifaniso esinxulumeneyo. Iminyaka elishumi elithandathu yamava ehlonipho kwindawo ekuyinkqubo yokulawula iinkonzo zabasebenzi. Isatifikethi soBuntu bePERSAL, isatifikethi soLawulo lwe-Sick-Leave ePERSAL. Ulwazi namava kwindawo yokulawula iipenshini. Ilayiseni yomqhubi egunyaziweyo. Ulwazi oluxhwebwe kumsebenzi: uMthetho woMlinganiselo wokuQashwa. Iindlela zoMthetho wokuLwa ngamaphulo. Umthetho wokuLwisa kwamagama okulungelelanisa amaxwebhu eNkonzo yeXesha elide kakhulu. Uqeqesho ngakumbi lweNkonzo zikaRhulumente. Umthetho wokuQalwa ngakumbi kwiNkonzo zikaRhulumente. Iindlela zoMthetho weSaziso seNkonzo zaRhulumente (i-PSCBC). Ukuqaliswa kolwazi ngokubanzi (i-PAIA). Ukuqaliswa kolwazi olubhekisa kwiNkonzo zoRhulumente mayela nokuSetyenziswa kolwazi. Umthetho woLawulo loMntu. Ukuzinza kolwazi. Ukulawula kwamagama amanyathelo oqeqesho. Iimfuno mayela namava: ukuba ukhulelwe ukuphuhliswa kolwazi ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwaye ukwazi ukuqamba amaxwebhu eMsebenzi kaRhulumente.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaye ulandele iinkonzo zolawulo lwezenkonzo zabasebenzi. Qinisekisa kwaye ulawule ukugcina iintonjio kwiPERSAL. Qinisekisa kwaye ulawule iindlela zokulawula ii-allowances. Qinisekisa kwaye ulawule izibonelelo eziyimpefumlo kunye nemigaqo yolawulo. Qinisekisa kwaye ulawule iindlela zokulawula i-leave. Qinisekisa kwaye ulandele inkqubo yokuhanjiswa koluntu. Lawula iinkqubo zokuphela kwemisebenzi. Nikela ingcebiso ngolawulo lwezenkonzo zabasebenzi. Lawula izindaba ezithinta abasebenzi. Landela izikhalazo ezithunyelwa kwiNkundla yezwelonke. Landela izigaba ezithunyelwa kwiNkundla yezwelonke. Lawula ukusebenza kweendlela ezahlukeneyo ezibekwa ngokomthetho. Qinisekisa kwaye ulandele indlela yokulawula inkqubo yokubonakaliswa koluntu. Qinisekisa kwaye ulandele indlela ezingowolawulo lwezindaba ezahlukeneyo. Lawula inkqubo yokubonelela ngolwazi kubasebenzi. Lawula indlela yokubonelela ngolwazi oluxhwebwe kumsebenzi.

jobs.title: Professional Construction Project Manager (GRADE A-C)
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 – R1 376 199 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with the OSD requirements)
jobs.summary: Oversee and coordinate built environment construction projects for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mmabatho.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Higher Diploma (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years and 6 months certified experience. BTech (Built Environment field) with a minimum of 4 years’ certified managerial experience. Honors Degree in any Built Environment field with a minimum of 3 years’ experience. Compulsory registration with the South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP) as Professional Construction Project manager on appointment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Programme and project management. Project principles and methodologies. Engineering design and analysis. Knowledge research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Knowledge of legal compliance and technical report writing. Creating high performance culture. Professional judgement and networking. Job related skills: Decision making. Team leadership. Analytical thinking and creativity. Self-management. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Problem solving and analysis. People management.
jobs.duties: Manage and co-ordinate all aspects of projects. Guide the project planning, implementation, monitoring, reporting and evaluation in line with project management methodology. Create and execute project work plans and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements. Identify resources needed and assign individual responsibilities. Manage day-to-day operational aspects of a project and scope. Apply methodology effectively and enforce projects standards to minimise risk on projects. Provide project accounting and financial management services. Report project progress to Chief Construction Project Manager. Manage project budget and resources. Manage office administration tasks and budget planning. Provide inputs to other professionals with tender administration. Liaise and interact with service providers, client and management. Contribute to the human resources and related activities. Maintain the record management system and the architectural library and utilise resources allocated effectively. Conduct research and development. Keep up abreast with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature on new developments on project management methodologies. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on project management.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Cnr James Moroka and Sekame Drive, West Gallery, Megacity, Mmabatho, 2735 or by email to Post181@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. ERRATUM: The position of Deputy Director: Strategic Land Acquisition ref 3/1/1/1/2026/150 for the Directorate: Strategic Land Acquisition: Limpopo (Polokwane) that was advertised in Public Service Vacancy Circular 24 dated 10 July 2026 has reference. The position has been withdrawn. The Department apologies for any inconvenience caused. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder (GRADE A-C)
af.summary: Oorsien en koördineer konstruksieprojekte in die beboude omgewing vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mmabatho.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Hoër Diploma (Beboude Omgewing-gebied) met 'n minimum van 4 jaar en 6 maande gesertifiseerde ervaring. BTech (Beboude Omgewing-gebied) met 'n minimum van 4 jaar se gesertifiseerde bestuurservaring. Honneursgraad in enige Beboude Omgewing-gebied met 'n minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring. Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP) as Professionele Konstruksieprojekbestuurder by aanstelling. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Program- en projekbestuur. Projektebeginsels en -metodologieë. Ingenieursontwerp en -analise. Kennisnavorsing en -ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Kennis van regsvereistes en tegniese verslagdoening. Skep van 'n hoë prestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel en netwerk bou. Werksverwante vaardighede: Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Analitiese denke en kreatiwiteit. Selfbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Probleemoplossing en -analise. Menslikehulpbronbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer alle aspekte van projekte. Lei die beplanning, implementering, monitering, verslagdoening en evaluering van projekte in ooreenstemming met projekbestuurmetodologie. Skep en voer projekte werkplanne uit en hersien dit soos nodig om aan veranderende behoeftes en vereistes te voldoen. Identifiseer benodigde hulpbronne en ken individuele verantwoordelikhede toe. Bestuur daaglikse operasionele aspekte van 'n projek en omvang. Pas metodologie doeltreffend toe en handhaaf projekstandaarde om risiko op projekte te minimaliseer. Verskaf projektekening en finansiële bestuursdienste. Rapporteer projekvordering aan Hoofkonstruksieprojekbestuurder. Bestuur projektebegroting en hulpbronne. Bestuur kantooradministrasietake en begrotingsbeplanning. Verskaf insette aan ander professionele persone met tenderadministrasie. Skakel en tree in interaksie met diensverskaffers, kliënte en bestuur. Dra by tot menslike hulpbronne en verwante aktiwiteite. Onderhou die rekordbestuurstelsel en die argitektuurbiblioteek en gebruik toegekende hulpbronne doeltreffend. Doen navorsing en ontwikkeling. Bly op hoogte van nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Doen navorsing/literatuurstudie oor nuwe ontwikkelinge in projekbestuurmetodologieë. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor projekbestuur.

zu.title: Professional Construction Project Manager (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Qapha futhi uhlanganise amaphrojekthi okwakha kwendawo asakhiwe i-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e-Mmabatho.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eyingqayizivele: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-National Higher Diploma (kumkhakha we-Built Environment) okanye unyakeni ongungenwa ngaphansi kwama-4 kanye nenyanga ezingu-6 weminyaka yokuqinisekisiwe yokuqinisekisiwe. I-BTech (kumkhakha we-Built Environment) okangetho ongafingqi eminyakeni engu-4 yokuqinisekiswa kweminyaka yokuqinisekisiwe yobaphathi. I-Honors Degree kunoma yisiphi isifundo se-Built Environment okangetho ongafingqi eminyakeni engu-3 yokusebenza. Ukubhaliswa okuphoqelele ku-South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP) njengoba uMphathi wePhrojekthi yoKwakha oGunyaziwe esikhathini sokwethweswa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela kanye nokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Izimiso zamaphrojekthi nendlela zokwenza. Ukuklama nokuhlaziya isimiso. Ulwazi locwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokuklanywa kwezinsiza. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho kanye nokubhala imibiko yezobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko elenza abantu basebenze ngamandla. Ukubuka okungqongqoshe nokuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuqondisa iqembu. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya nokudala okusha. Ukuqapha nokuzilawula. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuqondiswa kubathengi nokuvezwa. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphatha izingxabano. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqondisisa. Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlanganise zonke izinhlobo zephrojekthi. Hola ukwelulekwa kwephrojekthi, ukuqalisa, ukulandela, ukubika kanye nokuhlola ngokuhambisana nendlela yokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Dala futhi usebenzise amaphulani okusebenza aphrojekthi uwakhiwe kabusha njengoba kufanele ukuze uhambelane nezidingo ezishintshayo. Hlakanipha izinsiza ezingadingekayo futhi wabelane izibopho zabantu ngabanye. Phatha izinto zansuku zonke eziphathelene nokusebenza kwephrojekthi nomkhawulo walo. Sebenzisa ngokufanele indlela yokusebenza futhi phoqe izitandarda zamaphrojekthi ukuze kuncishwe ingozi kumaphrojekthi. Nikeza ngeminikelo yephrojekthi kanye nosebenzo lokuphatha izimali. Bika inqubo yephrojekthi kwaMphathi WezokuHakwa kwaPhrojekthi Oyinhloko. Phatha ithemba lemali lamaphrojekthi kanye nezinsiza. Phatha imisebenzi yolawulo kohhovisi kanye nokuhlela ithemba lemali. Nikeza iminikelo kwezinye izazi eziphathelene nokulawula izitende. Xhumana nobanikazi bamasevisi, abaklayenti kanye nolawulo. Yifa umnikelo ezindabeni zamabalengise kwezinhlobonhlobo ezihlobene nazo. Gcina isistimu yokulawula amarekhodi nolayibrari yezakhiwo futhi usebenzise izinsiza ezabelwe ngokusebenza kahle. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Gcina ukwaziswa kwakamuva ngetheknoloji namasu amasha. Funda/incwadi ngetuthuko ezintsha kwindlela yokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Xhumana nabalingani/ amakhabhoni aphathelene nokuphatha amaphrojekthi.

xh.title: UMphathi Oqobo woQongozo lokuWakha (GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Khangela kwaye usebenze ngokubambisana nalamazwi emizi yezakhiwo zoluntu eDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development Mmabatho.
xh.requirements: Umzekelo: Kufuneka abafaki zicelo babe namasthili e-12 kwaye bekwesi uqobo lwe-matrik kwaye basebenze iminyaka engama-4 kwaye kweyure ezingama-6 inegazethiyo esemthethweni kuba ngokwakho imimiselo yegazi elilodwa. I-PHD kwisebe lemizekelo yoluntu eshumi kubakho iminyaka engama-3 kuphela. Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP) njengomphathi webakala weqongozo ngexesha lokwenzeka kokuba nguMphathi weqongozo ngexesha lenkqubo. Isitudiyo esemthethweni sokulawula isithuthi. Ulwazi oluhambelanayo nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lwenkqubo nolkonyo nolusebenziso lwenkqubo. Iimpawulo zokulinganisa iindlela zokuqokelela ulwazi. Ukuxilongo nokuvakalisa ulwazi lomzobo wolwazi. Ulwazi lophando nentluko. Isiseko sezicelo zophando kumakhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokumisela komthetho kwaye kubhale iintekhnikhali ngokweenkqubo zenkqubo. Ukudala inkqubo yokwenza umsebenzi ngokugqithisileyo. Ukugqiba ngokubakho inethiwekhi ekuwohloko. Amakhono ahambelanayo nomsebenzi: Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula iqela. Ukucinga ngenkcukacha nokudala. Ukuzilawula. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (olubhalweyo noluthethwayo). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ukucwangcisa nokuhlelwa. Ulawulo lweengxabano. Ukusombulula iingxaki kwaye uhlaziye ngokweenkcukacha. Ulawulo abantu abakho.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha nokusebenza kwakho nako bonke babalinganisi beziqongozo. Ukukhokela uqulunqo lweqongozo, ukuqalwa, ukuqatshulwa, ukubika nokuhlola ngokuhambelana nendlela yophatlho lweziqongozo. Ukudala futhesebenzisa iinkqubo zomsebenzi weqongozo kwaye uzilungise njengoko kufunekayo ukwanelisa iimfuno eziguqukayo. Ukuchonga imithombo efunekayo kwaye wabelane ngemisebenzi yabantu bomanye. Uphathe iindlela zokusetyenziswa kwemihla nemihla yomsebenzi weqongozo kwaye usetyenziswe ngobukhulu obuhambelanayo. Usebenzise ngempumelelo iindlela zokusetyenziswa kwaye ulawule izindinganiso kwindlela yokuseta amaxhoba kwiziqongozo ukuba singezanga kakhulu emaxhobeni. Qinisekisa izixhobo zemali nokuphatha iimali zeqongozo. Kwaye uxele inkqondo yeqongozo kunye nophathi webakala weqongozo woqobo wokuqala. Uphathe iholide nemithobo yeqongozo. Uphathe imisebenzi yolawulo kofiso kwaye ulungiselele ipulo lemali. Nikezela ngolwazi kubaphi abanye abasebenzi ngomsebenzi wokulungelelanisa amaqhinga. Unxibelelane nokusebenza nabaniki bensebenzo, umthengi nolawulo. Yoluvo lokwenza umsebenzi woluntu kunye nemisebenzi ehambelanayo. Rhintelela isixokelelwano sofiso noluhlu lwemiqathango nasekusinge izikalo ezinikezwe kakuhle; Hlola ulwimi olutsha kwaye uvule iindlela ezintsha. Phatha ulwazi malunga namava amsha nendlela entsha ekuphathweni kweqongozo.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: A Senior Supply Chain Practitioner is needed at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Nelspruit to manage procurement, conduct market analysis, and coordinate demand planning.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Logistics Management / Public Management / Purchasing Management / Supply Chain Management / Management (Logistics / Supply Chain Management). Minimum of 2 years of experience in procurement administration/acquisition management/provisioning administration. Job-related knowledge: The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations. Treasury Supply Chain and Management guidelines and practice notes. Knowledge of supply chain management with emphasis on procurement administration and Government and CIBD procurement policies. Knowledge of Transversal contracts and the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and relevant prescripts. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Communication (verbal and written). Interpersonal relations. Analytical thinking. Teamwork. Working under pressure and meeting deadlines.
jobs.duties: Facilitate demand management services. Conduct and analyse the market per commodity. Coordinate and review the procurement and demand management plan. Receive and check compliance of all procurement request from clients. Provide support in drafting specifications. Compile and update procurement and demand plan progress report. Implement the quotation process. Manage sourcing of quotations amounting to R1 000 000.00 using the electronic departmental database (CSD). Check compliance of all procurement documents and processes. Ensure the sourcing of goods and services from updated registered service providers on the National Treasury supplier database. Arrange and facilitate BID specifications where and when applicable. Conduct and facilitate briefing sessions where and when applicable. Coordinate compilation minutes of the briefing session outcome. Arrange and facilitate Bid Evaluation Committee procedures where and when applicable. Coordinate and check minutes. Coordinate comparative schedules for request above R30 000.00. Coordinate documentation for approval. Coordinate appointment letters and update registers. Implement the Bidding process. jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and receptionist support to senior management in the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Secretarial / Office Administration / Management or relevant equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in rendering a support service to senior management. Computer literacy (Microsoft Office). Good interpersonal relations. High level of reliability. Communication (verbal and written). Language and ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds. Ability to do research and analyse documents and situations. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Self- management and motivation. Willingness to work extended hours. Classified Secrets Security Clearance.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretarial / receptionist support service to the manager. Receives telephone calls in an environment where, in addition to the calls for the senior manager, discretion is required to decide to whom the call should be forwarded. In the process the job incumbent should finalise some enquiries. Performs advanced typing work. Operates and ensures that office equipment, e.g. printers and photocopies are in good working order. Record the engagements of the senior manager. Utilises discretion to decide whether to accept/decline or refer to other employees’ requests for meetings, based on the assessed importance and urgency of the matter. Coordinates with and sensitises/advises the manager regarding engagements. Compiles realistic schedules for appointments. Render administrative support service. Ensures the effective flow of information and documents to and from the office of the manager. Ensures the safe keeping of all documentation in the office of the manager in line with relevant legislation and policies. Obtains inputs, collates and compiles reports, e.g.: Progress reports, Monthly reports and management reports. Scrutinises routine submissions/reports and make notes and/or recommendations for the manager. Respond to enquiries received from internal and external stakeholders. Drafts documents as required. Does filling of documents for the manager and the unit where required. Collects, analyses and collates information requested by the manager. Clarifies instructions and notes on behalf of the manager. Ensures that travel arrangements are well coordinated. Prioritises issues in the office of the manager. Manages the leave register and telephone accounts for the unit. Handles procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. for the activities of the manager and the unit. Obtains the necessary signatures on documents like procurement advice and monthly salary reports. Provides support to manager regarding meetings. Scrutinises documents to determine actions/information / other documents required for meetings. Collects and compiles all necessary documents for the manager to inform him / her on the contents. Records minutes/decisions and communicates to relevant role-players, follow-up on progress made. Prepares briefing notes for the manager as required. Coordinates logistical arrangements for meetings when required. Supports the manager with the administration for the manager’s budget. Collects and coordinates all the documents that relate to the manager’s budget. Assists manager in determining funding requirements for purposes of Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) submissions. Keeps records for expenditure commitments, monitors expenditure and alerts manager of possible over and under spending. Checks and correlates Basic Accounting System (BAS) reports to ensure that expenditure is allocated correctly. Identifies the need to move funds between items, consults with the manager and compiles draft memos for this purpose. Compares the MTEF allocation with the requested budget and informs the manager of changes. Studies the relevant public service and departmental prescripts/policies and other documents and ensure that the application thereof is understood properly. Remains up to date with regard to the prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to his / her work terrain to ensure efficient and effective support to the manager. Remains abreast with the procedures and processes that apply in the office of the manager.

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en ontvangsondersteuning aan senior bestuur in die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, gesetel in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sekretariële / Kantooradministrasie / Bestuur of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in die lewer van 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan senior bestuur. Werksverwante kennis: Relevante wetgewing/beleid/voorskrifte en prosedures, telefoonetiket, basiese kennis van finansiële administrasie. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie organisatoriese vermoë. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Office). Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Taal en vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer. Vermoë om navorsing te doen en dokumente en situasies te ontleed. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Selfbestuur en motivering. Bereidwilligheid om lang ure te werk. Klassifiseerde geheime veiligheidsklaring.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële / ontvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die bestuurder. Neem telefoonoproepe aan in 'n omgewing waar, benewens die oproepe vir die senior bestuurder, diskresie vereis word om te beslis aan wie die oproep aangestuur moet word. In die proses behoort die posbekleuer sommige navrae af te handel. Voer gevorderde tikwerk uit. Bedryf en verseker dat kantoortoerusting, bv. drukkers en fotostate, in 'n goeie werkende toestand is. Teken die afsprake van die senior bestuurder aan. Gebruik diskresie om te beslis of om versoeke vir vergaderings van ander werknemers te aanvaar/af te wys of te verwys, gebaseer op die beoordeelde belangrikheid en dringendheid van die saak. Koördineer met en sensibiliseer/adviseer die bestuurder aangaande afsprake. Stel realistiese skedules vir afsprake op. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdiens. Verseker die doeltreffende vloei van inligting en dokumente na en van die kantoor van die bestuurder. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in die kantoor van die bestuurder in ooreenstemming met relevante wetgewing en beleid. Verkry insette, sorteer en stel verslae op, bv.: Vorderingsverslae, maandelikse verslae en bestuursverslae. Ondersoek roetine-voorleggings/verslae en maak notas en/of aanbevelings vir die bestuurder. Reageer op navrae ontvang van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Stel dokumente op soos vereis. Doen die lê van dokumente vir die bestuurder en die eenheid waar nodig. Versamel, ontleed en sorteer inligting wat deur die bestuurder versoek word. Verduidelik instruksies en notas namens die bestuurder. Verseker dat reëlings vir reis goed geköördineer is. Prioritiseer sake in die kantoor van die bestuurder. Bestuur die verlofregister en telefoonrekenings vir die eenheid. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verkwikkings ens. vir die aktiwiteite van die bestuurder en die eenheid. Verkry die nodige handtekeninge op dokumente soos verkrygingsadvies en maandelikse salarisverslae. Bied ondersteuning aan die bestuurder aangaande vergaderings. Ondersoek dokumente om vas te stel watter aksies/inligting/ander dokumente vir vergaderings vereis word. Versamel en stel alle nodige dokumente vir die bestuurder op om hom/haar in te lig oor die inhoud. Teken notules/besluite aan en kommunikeer dit na relevante rolspelers, volg vordering op. Stel voorligtingnotas vir die bestuurder op soos vereis. Koördineer logistiese reëlings vir vergaderings wanneer nodig. Ondersteun die bestuurder met die administrasie van die bestuurder se begroting. Versamel en koördineer alle dokumente wat verband hou met die bestuurder se begroting. Bied hulp aan die bestuurder om befondsingsvereistes te bepaal vir doeleindes van Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF)-voorleggings. Hou rekords van bestedingsverbintenis, hou besteding dop en stel die bestuurder in kennis van moontlike oor- en onderbesteding. Kontroleer en korreleer Basic Accounting System (BAS)-verslae om te verseker dat besteding korrek toegewys word. Identifiseer die behoefte om fondse tussen items te skuif, konsulteer met die bestuurder en stel konsepnotas hiervoor op. Vergelyk die MTEF-toekenning met die versoekte begroting en stel die bestuurder in kennis van veranderinge. Bestudeer die relevante openbare diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleid en ander dokumente en verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Bly op hoogte aangaande die voorskrifte/beleid en prosedures wat van toepassing is op sy/haar werksterrein om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die bestuurder te verseker. Bly op hoogte van die prosedures en prosesse wat van toepassing is in die kantoor van die bestuurder.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Womuntu Siqu Oyisikhulu
zu.summary: Nika inkxaso yobuhlakani bomlomo kanye nokwamukela abantu kubaphathi abaphezulu e-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, esikhundleni esise Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma kwi-Secretarial / Office Administration / Management noma iziqu ezingulinganiselayo ezihlobene nalokho. Okuncane unyaka wama-3 wamava ekunikeni inkxaso ebalulekile kubaphathi abaphezulu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Imithetho / izinqondiso / izinqubo ezihlobene nomsebenzi, Indlela yokusebenzisa ifoni, Ulwazi olusisekelo ngabalawuli bemali. Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikakhulukazi ikhono lokuhlela. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhaya lakho (Microsoft Office). Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Izinga eliphezulu lokwesabela. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ulwimi kanye nakhona lokuxhumana kahle nabantu abakumaqoqo ahlukene abavela kwindawo ezingafani. Ikhono lokucinga nokuhlaziya amadokhumenti kanye nezimo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngobuhlakani kakhulu. Ukuzilawula nokuzikhuthaza. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ihora elininingi. Isitifiketi Sokuphepha Sakhesihlalo.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso ebalulekile yokusingathwa kubaphathi abaphezulu. Yamukela kholi ezingeni elingaphakathi kwalo owenza izinqumo ngokuba ufuna ukuthumela kubani inkinga. Kule ndlela kufanele aphele imibuzo ethile. Yenza umsebenzi wokuthayipha onzima. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zofisi njengamaphrinta kanye namakhophi zisezimeni ezihle. Bhalisa izinkomba zomphathi. Yenza izinqumo ukuthi wamukele / wenze ngani noma wethumele kubasebenzi abanye izicelo zokuhlangana, kuncike ekubalulekeni kwenkinga kakhulu. Xhumanisa kanye nomphathi mayelana nezinkomba zakhe. Hlela isikhathi esifanele sezinhlelo zokuhlangana. Nikela inkxaso yomsebenzi kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi kanye namadokhumenti ahamba kahle kofisi lomphathi. Qinisekisa ukubekwa okuphepha kwawo wonke amadokhumenti ofisini lomphathi ngokwezomthetho nezinqondiso ezithile. Thola izimvo, qoqa futhi uhlele amabhiko ezinto ezithile. Buka okuthunywayo okuyisicebi / amabhiko wenze izinkomba nezindulumiso / izindulumiso ezibalulekile. Phendula imibuzo ethunyelwe abantu abangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle. Hlola amadokhumenti njengoba kudingeka. Yenza ukugcwalisa kwamadokhumenti omphathi kanye necandelo lapho kudingeka khona. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uhlele ulwazi oluceliwe umphathi. Chaza imiyalo kanye nezinkomba ngokwakhe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuhamba zihleleke kahle. Beka izinto ezibalulekile ofisini lomphathi. Phatha irejista yokuhambele nabantu bacela ukushiywa kanye nama-akhawunti wefoni. Phatha izinto ezifana nadi, amafayini kanye nezinye izinhlela ezihlobene nomphathi kanye necandelo. Thola izinkomba eziyisidingo kumadokhumenti afana nesiphakamiso sokuthenga kanye namabhiko oholo nyanga zonke. Nikeza inkxaso ngokuhlobene nezinkomba. Hlola amadokhumenti ukuthola ukuthi kudingeka yini imiyalo / ulwazi / eminye imiyalo. Qoqa kanye nokuhlela wonke amadokhumenti okuwusizo kakhulu. Bhalisa amaminithi / izinqumo kanye nokuxhumana ngendlela ethile, alandele inqubo ekhona. Lungiselela amanotsi okuhlaziya umphathi njengoba kudingeka. Hlela izinto ezibalulekile ezinkomba mayelana nezinsuku. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezihlobene nezimali ziyahlelekwa. Phatha irehjista yokuhambele nabantu kanye namakhophi kahle.

xh.title: Personal Assistant
xh.summary: Nika inkonzo yesiphithiphithi nokuwamkela kwindawo yolawulo kwi-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, esekwe e-Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezibalulekileyo: Abafake isicelo kufuneka babe nesiqinisekiso seNqanaba le-12 kwaye be neDiploma yaseLwizwe kumsebenzi wokusebenza ngokwendawo yofiso / Ulawulo lofiso / ulawulo okanye isifundo esifanayo ngokwento. Ubuncinane i-3 yeminyaka yamava ekunikeni inkonzo yokuxhasa kulawulo oluphakamileyo. Ulwazi oluthe nkqo emsebenzini: Imigqathango / amacebo / amagama abhalwe ngaphambili nengqubo, Ukuziphatha kocingo, Ulwazi olusentloko yolwazi lweemali. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ikhono lokuhlela. Ulwazi lweekhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Unxibelelwano oluhle nabantu. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Unxibelelwano (ngelivi nangokubhaliweyo). Ulwimi nakhono lokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abakumanqanaba ahlukeneyo abavela kummandla ahlukeneyo. Ikhono lokwenza uphando nokwahlulela imiqathango ne meko. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobubeke nangokuyigqibelela. Ukuzilawula nokuzikhuthaza. Ukuthanda ukusebenza iiyure ezandisiweyo. Isiqinisekiso sokugcinwa kwemfihlo ekuyingxwaleko.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yokweseka ngokwendawo yomsebenzi wesiphithiphithi / yokwamkeela kumngr. Yamkela iinkqubo zocingo kwimeko apho, ngaphezu kweenkqubo ezingela umlawuli ophakamileyo, kufuneka kuzicwangcisiswe ngokucacileyo ukuba inkqubo idluliselwa nakuphi. Kuloo nqubo lowo usebenzayo kufuneka aphelise ezinye imibuzo. Wenza umsebenzi onzulu wokuthayipha. Usebenzisa uqinisekise ukuba izixhobo zofiso, umz. iiprinta kunye neefotothayiphi zisebenza kakuhle. Ugcina irekhodi le nkqubo zomlawuli ophakamileyo. Usebenzisa isigqibo sokuziphatha ukugqiba nokuba wamkele / walale okanye udululse kubasebenzi abanye iimfuno zokubakhangelana, ngokwesisigqibo malunga nabaluleke nokubaluleka kwenkxwaleko. Uqhagamshelana nomlawuli umenze axhamile / umxelele ngenkqubo zakhe. Uqamba iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zemiqesho. Yenza inkonzo yokeseko yolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuhamba kolwazi nemiqathango kwaye kuyofika kwaye kuye kwindawo yolawulo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwakho konke ukubhalisa kwemiqathango windawo yolawulo ngokwemigqathango namacebo ahambisayo. Zama iingcombolo, zibekelwe ndawonye nikwazi ukuqamba iingxelo, umz.: Iingxelo zenteko, Iingxelo zenyanga ncingxelo zolawulo. Iqwalasela iingxelo ezizezinto ezinqamlezileyo yenze iintshukumo kunye / okanye iingcebiso kumlawuli. Phendula imibuzo evela kumaphandle nakwindawo yangaphakathi. Uqamba imiqathango njengoko kufuneka. Yenza ukuqhutywa kolwazi kwemiqathango kumlawuli nendawo apho kufuneka khona. Qokelela, yahlulela yize ndawonye ulwazi oluceliwe ngumlawuli. Chaza imiyalelo neentshukumo ixrabebo lika lawuli. Qinisekisa ukuba ukujolise kolwazi kuhle ngokwento. Kubeka kwindawo ephambili iziganeko windawo ka mLawuli. Lawula irragista yesikhululo nii-akhawunti zecingo kwiziko. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezijezileyo njengesikrthuru, isixa sokuphuzua kumz. kuloo nkqubo zomlawuli nendawo. Zama izigqibo ezifunekayo kumqathango njengengcebiso yokuthenga ncingxelo zenyanga yomvuzo. Nikela ngokuxhasa umlawuli malunga nonqamlezano. Qwalasela imqathango ukugqiba ekuyeni / ulwazi / eminye imiqathango efuneka kunkqamlezano. Qokelela yize ndawonye onke imiqathango efunwa ngumlawuli ukuze amxelele ngolwazi oluceliweyo. Igqiba iingxelo zeengqungquthela / isigqibo kwaye azidululise kuloo bantu abafunekayo, alandelwe inkqulo yophuhliso. Lungelelanisa iingxelo eziyimfuziselo kumlawuli njengoko kufuneka. Qhagamshela iziphethulo zohambo Iwngqungquthela xa kufuneka. Xhasa umlawuli ngolawulongexa ye bajeti yakhe. Qokelela yize ndawonye onke imiqathango enxulumene ne bajeti ka mlawuli. Mnika usizo umlawulu ekugqumeni ukuba ngakanani na imfuno yemali ukujolise kwiinkqubo ze-MTEF. Zigcina iirekhodi zeertziko lemali, ilawule ukusetyenziswa kolwazi yexa kumlweli xa kunokubakho ukuqitha okanye ukuchithwa kolwazi. Pjonga yize qambe iingxelo ze-BAS (Bastic Accounting System) ukuqinisekisa ukuba i ndlela yokusetyenziswa kolwazi isetyenziswe kakuhle. Qaphela iimfuno zokujolisa iimali phakathi kwemizekelo, uqhagamshelane noMlawuli yize udle iimemo zesiphithiphithi ngenjongo. Qhathanisa isabelo se-MTEF nombuzo webajeti yize umxelele umlawuli ngeenguqu. Funda imiqathango yolwazi wkonze yeentla lomanyano yisebe namanye amaqatshu yiqinisekisa ukuba uyenziswa kakuhle. Gcina ulwazi lwasemva kumqathango / amacebo nangenkqubo ezisebenza kumkhakha wakhe ukuguqula inkxaso efezekileyo kumlawuli. Gcina ulwazi olutsha ngenkqubo neenkqubo ezenzeka kwindawo komlawuli.

jobs.title: Secretary
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and receptionist support to the Director, including managing calls, diary appointments and document typing, in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Job related skills: Good telephone etiquette. Sound organisational ability. Good people skills. Computer literacy. Ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds (both written and verbal). Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretariat / receptionist support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refer the calls to the correct role players if not meant for the relevant senior manager. Record appointments and events in the diary. Type documents for the senior manager and other staff within the unit. Operate office equipment e.g. computers and photocopiers. Provide a clerical support service to the Senior Manager. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Check arrangements when relevant documents are received. Arrange meetings and events for the senior manager and the staff in the unit. Identifies venues, invite role players, organise refreshments and sets up schedules for meeting and events. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the senior manager. Records basic minutes of meetings of the senior manager where required. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Do filing of documents for the senior manager and the unit where necessary. Administer matters like leave registers and telephonic accounts. Receive, records and distributes all incoming and outgoing documents. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. Collects all relevant documents to enable the Director to prepare for meetings. Remains up to date with regard to prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to her / his work environment to ensure efficient and effective support to the senior manager. Study the relevant public service and the departmental prescripts / policies and other documents to ensure that the application thereof is understood properly. Keep abreast with the procedures and process that apply in the office of the senior manager.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 1st Floor, 270 Jabu Ndlovu Street (formerly known as Loop Street), Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or by email to Post183@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination.
