Hoëghof- of litigasie-ervaring en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal 'n voor-toelatings praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die assesseringsmetode om die geskiktheid van die kandidaat te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van elektroniese inligtingsbronne en aanlyn ontsluiting (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Jutastat SAFLLI en Sabinet) Praktykhandleiding van die Hof, deeglike begrip van Suid-Afrikaanse reg en regstelsel, Interpretasie en toepassing van die reg, Batho Pele-beginsels, Kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik), probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede, uitstekende navorsings-en analitiese vaardighede, verslagskryf- en redigeervaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid. Kommunikasie en inligtingsbestuur, akkuraatheid en aandag tot besonderhede. Diversiteitsbestuur, hantering van interpersoonlike konflik, projektbestuur, vermoë om onder druk te werk en tydbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning aan regsnavorsingsfunksies vir die regters en ander hofamptenare: Verskaf ondersteuning met regsnavorsing oor verskeie regskwessies, statutte, reëls, regulasies en regspraak, ontleed en pas komplekse regsbeginsels toe en verskaf opsommings aan die regters, verskaf navorsingsondersteuning aan regters by die voorbereiding van verhore en probeerslae, voer navorsing uit en ontsluit alle materiaal uit alle bronne in beide hardekopie en elektroniese formaat oor regskwessies, soos deur 'n regter versoek, verskaf ontleding deur die bestudering van alle tersaaklike materiaal, bestudeer alle tersaaklike materiaal en verskaf 'n deeglike ontleding daarvan. Berei en stel regsmenings op: Verskaf ondersteuning aan die regters met ontleding van regsargumente wat deur litigante ingedien is, evalueer meriete van elke argument, ondersoek ondersteunende en teenoorgestelde regspraak (presedent) en verskaf aanbevelings aan die regters, hersien regskwessies, argumente en tersaaklike regspraak in die vorm van regsmemos, berei 'n omvattende memorandum voor oor die uitkoms van die regsnavorsing. Verskaf ondersteuning met die opstel van duidelike, konsekwente en omvattende uitsprake: Verskaf ondersteuning aan regters by die hersiening en proeflees van konsepuitsprake om duidelikheid en akkuraatheid te verseker, proeflees alle uitsprake, artikels, toesprake en konferensiepapake ten opsigte van spelling en grammatika, gehalteverseker alle verwysings, volledige aanhaling van uitsprake en voetnote in alle konsepuitsprake en regsartikels teen die oorspronklike teks om korrektheid en akkuraatheid te verseker, korrigeer foute (tikfoute) met behulp van 'track changes' sodat regters enige voorgestelde veranderinge kan aanvaar of van die hand wys. Verseker dat regters op hoogte is van onlangse ontwikkelinge in regspraak, praktykriglyne en wetgewing: Gehalteverseker die handhawing van kennis van onlangse regsontwikkelings, nuwe wetgewing en tersaaklike regspraak, verskaf ondersteuning aan die monitering van regstydskrifte, verseker dat regters toegang het tot die jongste regsinligting, hou treding met onlangse ontwikkelinge in tersaaklike regsgebiede, soos wetgewingsveranderinge, nuwe presedente en ontluikende regstendense.

zu.title: UMCWANINGI WEZOMTHETHO
zu.summary: Nikela ngokusekela ucwaningo ngomthetho kubajaji nakubasebenzi benkantolo esikhungweni se-Eastern Cape Division of the High Court e-Makhanda, kudingwa ibanga le-LLB kanye neminyaka emithathu yenkulo yocwaningo ngomthetho.
zu.requirements: Kumele abafaki isicelo babe noma inqubo eqiniswe yisikhathi esingaphezu kwezine noma ngaphansi kwe-LLB Degree, njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. U kube nenani elingaphansi kwezingu-3 (3) zeminyaka yokwenza ucwaningo ngomthetho. Ulwazi noma ukuqeqeshwa kwezinkantolo eziphezulu, isipiliyoni sokubandakanya ecaleni, kanye nelayisense evumelekile yokushayela kuzoba usizo olwengeziwe. Bonke abafaki isicelo ababe kwindlu ethole ukuthunywa kuzodlula isivivinyo sokuvivinya okungenwa ngaphambili njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlonza ukuze kwahlatshiwe ukulingana komuntu ohlonga isikhundla ngokususela ekuqondeni nakuqukethweni okudingwa isikhundla. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwezinsiza zenziwa ngogesi bese kuthathwa kusuka emoyeni (i-Westlaw, i-LexisNexis, i-Jutastat SAFLLI nase-Sabinet) kusetshenziswa isiqubulo zenkantolo, ukuqonda okuphelele ngomthetho waseNingizimu Afrika nendlela yokusebenza kwezinkantolo, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa umthetho, izimiso zika-Batho Pele, amakhono okukhuluma (ngomlomo nangokubhala), amakhono okuxazula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo, amakhono okucwaninga nokuhlaziya aphezulu, amakhono okubhala izibali nokuhlela, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okubakhuluma emaphambili, amakhono okuhlela futhi ukuqamba konke, ulwazi lwekhompiyutha. ukuxhumana nokuphathwa kolwazi, ukuba sicebile nokunakisisa kokuqonda. ukuphathwa kwezihluahlukene, ukuphatha impikiswano phakathi kwabantu, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, amandla okusebenza ngokucindezelayo kanye namakhono okuphatha isikhathi.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokusekela imisebenzi yokucwaninga ngokomthetho kumaJaji nabanye abasebenzi beNkantolo: Nikela ngokusekela ucwaningo ngemithetho mayelana nezindaba ezahlukahlukene zomthetho, izixaxha ezimbambisayo, izindinganiso, izinqubo, kanye nesimo somthetho esiseduzane, hlaziya futhi usebenzise izimiso ezinkomishayo zomthetho bese unikeza abajadi imfushaniselo, nikeza abajadi ukusekela ocwaningweni ekulungiseleleni izinkundla zokuzwa icala kanye nezigijimi, yenza ucwaningo bese ulanda konke okokulingisa kuzo zonke izinto eziyingxenye kokubhaliwe nakwezinye izindlela zomsakazo mayelana nezindaba zomthetho, njengoba kuceliwe nguMajaji, nikeza ukuhlaziya ngokufunda konke okokulingisa okuhlobene, funde konke okokulingisa okuhlobene bese unikeza ukuhlaziya okuphelele. Lungiselela futhi uhlanganise izincomo ngomthetho: Nikela ngokusekela abajadi ngokuhlaziya impikiswano ngomthetho ethunyelwe abanikeli bamacala, hlola ukuhamba kahle kwempihlisano ngamunye, cwaninga isimo somthetho esiseduzane esisekelayo nesiphikisayo bese unikeza abajadi izincomo, buya izindaba zomthetho, imiphikiswano, nesimo somthetho esiseduzane kusetshenziswa imemorandam yomthetho, lungiselela imemorandam eqotho mayelana nomphumela wocwaningo ngomthetho. Nikela ngokusekela ukubhala izinqumo ezicacile, ezihambisana, futhi eziplethile: Nikela ngokusekela abajadi ekubuyeni nasekuhlolisweni kokubhaliwe kwesinqumo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba sicebile nokwenza right, hlola zonke izinqumo, izihloko, izikhulumo namaphepha omhlangano mayelana nopelowegama nakuqondiswa komagama, qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkomba, indlela yokubala okuqondile kwezinqumo, namaphuzu ogezantsi kuzo zonke izinqumo okubhaliwe nakwezinye izihloko zomthetho ziqondile zibe sicebile ukuba ngokweqiniso nokuqondile, kulungise iziphosepheshi (amaphutha okubhala) ngosizo lwezinguquko ezibonakalayo ukuze abajadi bakwazi ukwamukela noma ukwenqaba noma iyiphi inguquko ephakanyisiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaJaji bakageshe kwakusha ekuthuthukisweni kwesimo somthetho esiseduzane, izinkomba zokusebenza, kumthetho osanda kwenziwa: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kolwazi ngokuthuthuka okusha ngomthetho, umthetho osanda kwenziwa, nesesimo somthetho esihlobene, nikeza ngokusekela okubukwa emagazini omthetho, qinisekisa ukuthi abajadi bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi olusha lomthetho, hlala ushaya kageshe ngokuthuthuka okusha kuleyo ndawo yomthetho, njengokushintshwa kwesixaxha ezimbambisayo, okusha kwezinye izimo eziseduzane zomthetho, kanye nezindlela ezisha ezihlobene nomthetho.

xh.title: Umphandi weMITHETHO
xh.summary: Kunikela inkxaso yophando lomthetho kuwo amajaji namaphakathi jikelele enkantolo kwindawo ye-Eastern Cape Division ye-High Court e-Makhanda, efuna igqiba le-LLB kunye neminyaka elithathu yamava okuphanda komthetho.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe negqiba le-LLB okanye ngqekthi yeminyaka emithathu yomthetho evunyiwe njengoko ivunywa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka emithathu (3) yamava okuphanda komthetho kwindawo echwebenyo. Amava enkantolo ephakamileyo okanye ulwazi lwezwebookumedo kunye negunya lokushayela elisebenzayo kuya kuba lusisongezo. Onke amagqabi ahlu kwi-ndlela yosuku banokuthi bagqibe umthambo wokungenisa ogqithiswayo njengenxalenye yendlela yokuqikelela ukuzenza kwelakhe ngakumbi ngeemfuno zobuchwephesha neziquonzima zendawo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngeZixhobo Zolwazi Ezentlalo nokuzizisa (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Jutastat, SAFLLI, naseSabinet), incwadana yokuSebenza yenkantolo, ukuqonda okubonakalileyo ngomthetho waseMzantsi Afrika nolwawulo lokwebhodi lamajaji, inqanaba lezicwangciso nobuqu ezisebenzisekayo njengoko lisigqibo, iziNcedo ezisisigqibo somthetho, nokuqonda okucacileyo ngolawulo lomthetho, iNkqubo ye-Batho Pele, amandla okuzethula (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo), nakhona lokusombulula iingxaki nokuqhuba izigqibo, amandla aphezulu okuphanda nokuqonda isisindiso seli, amandla okugqiba iNgxelo nokuqoka amagama, amandla okucoca, ukusombulula iingxaki, amandla okugqiba iNgxelo ngokugqithiswayo, amandla okuyalela nokusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Kunikela inkxaso kumisebenzi yokuphanda kumthetho kuwo amajaji namaphakathi amaninzi enkantolo: Kupha inkxaso ngokuphanda kumthetho ngeendawo ezininzi zomthetho, izitathu, iimithetho, iimiso, namaxabiso acacileyo ezomthetho obugunya nezilawulo ezincwadi zomthetho ezalathiswa nguMthetho. Kunikela inkxaso kuwo amajaji kulungiselelwa lokuva iingxelo ezijoliswe kwiNkundla nee trial, kuphanda kwakho nasekubuyiseni zonke iingxelo ngenyaniso ezenziweyo, gqitha kwelifomath yoshicilelo esemthethweni nasekugqibeni iNgxelo ngenkqubo ukusombulula iingxaki ezizezona. Kusekela amajazi ukwakha iinkqubo zokulawula, kubhalwe okuqondileyo neziNkqubo ezahlukeneyo: Kugqinisekisa ukuba amajazi anolwazi olutsha ngeNdawo ezintsha zomthetho, izalathiso ezahlukeneyo, kunye noMthetho omtsha, kunyanzelekiswa ukuqwalaselwa kweNkqubo yokuqwalaselwa kolwazi, iNkxaso ekulawulweni kwamaphepha eNkantolo, kwaye kugqinisekiswe ukuba amajaji afikelela kolwazi olutsha ngokuchanekileyo, kunokuba nolwazi olupheleleyo ngeendawo ezahlukeneyo zomthetho, kugqinisekiswa amajaji ngolwazi lwakho ukuqwalaselwa kolwazi olukwiNkqubo yokuqwalaselwa kwaye kubuye kwenzelwe amajaji okutshekisha iindawo ezingama-citation ngeencwadi ngokuchanekileyo nezazisonjululwa kuyo iNgxelo yomthetho. Kusekela amajaji ekubuyiseni iNkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuba amajaji anolwazi olunceduze kwaye ukwazi ukuqwalasela ulwazi olutsha ngomthetho, iiNkcukacha ezahlukeneyo zomthetho, kunye noluqonda kolwazi olutsha, nangendlela ezokuvula ngayo umthetho okunyuka phaya.

jobs.title: Senior Court Interpreter
jobs.centre: Eastern Cape Division of The High Court: Bhisho
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 - R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: The Office of the Chief Justice seeks a Senior Court Interpreter at the Bhisho High Court to provide interpreting services across various legal proceedings.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Legal Interpreting or equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of one (1) year’ experience as a Court Interpreter, or Grade twelve (12) certificate with at least ten (10) years practical experience in Court Interpreting. Proficiency in English and isiXhosa. Proficiency in any other indigenous languages i.e. isiZulu, Afrikaans, Sesotho or Setswana and a valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of relevant acts and regulations, knowledge of culture, knowledge of subject area, knowledge on how to translate and be able to keep to time frame, computer literacy (MS Office), effective communication skills (written and verbal), time management, good interpersonal relations skills, listening skills, customer service skills, problem solving skills, planning and organising skills, decision-making skills. analytical thinking, excellent English language, flexible, motivational, able to work under pressure, meticulous, self-driven and people-centric.
jobs.duties: Render interpreting services: Interpret in Children’s Act matters, criminal proceedings, Civil proceedings, Domestic Violence Act matters, Older Persons Act matters, Family, Protection from Harassment Act matters, Labour, Maintenance Act matters, Child Justice matters, Inquests, and quasi-judicial matters, interpret in small claims Courts, interpret in disciplinary hearing, interpret in Conciliation and Arbitration, interpret in confession. Interpret in pre- trial proceedings and consultations, liaise with the supervisor for foreign language interpreters, interpret from source to target language during Court proceedings, pre-trial, consultation, quasi, judicial. interpret non-verbal gestures, dramatization and confessions, engage with the judiciary to confer on the readiness and/or performance of a particular interpreter in Court, render legal and quasi-judicial and language service: Render audible and clear interpreting from source to target language without embellishment or omissions while preserving the language, convey the correct language in accordance with language usage of the speaker, control the speaker and ensure that the citations are interpreted correctly, interpret non-verbal gestures dramatization and confessions, translate legal documents and exhibits: Study and analyse the source document, conduct the necessary research and consult with the relevant parties, ensure accurate cite translation documents, check, edit and revise the translated document, translate mechanically recorded audio material. Develop terminology and provide support in the reconstruction of records: Accumulate terminology and develop database, populate the terms and respective meaning in the glossary register, gather all trial documents, attend to mechanical recordings, compare notes of the Presiding Officer, State and Defence.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr. L Ceza Tel No: (040) 608 7738 HR Related Enquiries: Ms. Z Sulo at (087) 086 6929
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/84/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Hofvertaler
af.summary: Die Kantoor van die Hoofregsoffisier soek 'n Senior Hofvertaler by die Bhisho Hooggeregshof om vertaaldiensste te verskaf oor verskeie regsprosedures.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regsvertaling of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 6 met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar se ervaring as 'n Hofvertaler, of 'n Graad twaalf (12) sertifikaat met ten minste tien (10) jaar se praktiese ervaring in Hofvertaling. Vaardigheid in Engels en isiXhosa. Vaardigheid in enige ander inheemse tale d.w.s. isiZulu, Afrikaans, Sesotho of Setswana en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle kortlys-kandidate sal 'n voor-toetrede praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die asseseringsmetode om die kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante wette en regulasies, kennis van kultuur, kennis van onderwerpsgebied, kennis oor hoe om te vertaal en in staat wees om tydraamwerk na te kom, rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office), effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling), tydbestuur, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, luistervaardighede, kliëntediensvaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede. Analitiese denke, uitstekende Engelse taal, buigsaam, motiverend, in staat om onder druk te werk, noukeurig, selfgedrewe en mensegerig.
af.duties: Lewer vertaaldiensste: Vertaal in Kinderwet-sake, strafregtelike verrigtinge, siviele verrigtinge, Wet op Huishoudelike Geweld-sake, Wet op Bejaardes-sake, Gesin, Wet op Beskerming teen Teistering-sake, Arbeid, Onderhoudswet-sake, Kinderjustisie-sake, lykskouings, en kwasi-geregtelike sake, vertaal in kleinvorderingshowe, vertaal in dissiplinêre verhore, vertaal in Versoening en Arbitrasie, vertaal in belydenis. Vertaal in verhoorvooraf-verrigtinge en konsultasies, skakel met die toesighouer vir vreemdetaalse vertalers, vertaal van brontaal na doeltaal gedurende Hofverrigtinge, verhoorvooraf, konsultasie, kwasi, geregtelik. Vertaal nie-verbale gebare, dramatisering en belydenisse, raadpleeg die regbank om te beraadslaag oor die gereedheid en/of prestasie van 'n spesifieke vertaler in die Hof, lewer regs- en kwasi-geregtelike en taaldiens: Lewer hoorbare en duidelike vertaling van brontaal na doeltaal sonder versiering of weglatings terwyl die taal behou word, dra die korrekte taal ooreenkomstig die taalgebruik van die spreker oor, beheer die spreker en verseker dat die aanhalings korrek vertaal word, vertaal nie-verbale gebare dramatisering en belydenisse, vertaal regsdokumente en uitstallings: Bestudeer en ontleed die brondokument, voer die nodige navorsing uit en raadpleeg die relevante partye, verseker akkurate aanhalingvertaalde dokumente, kontroleer, redigeer en hersien die vertaalde dokument, vertaal meganies opgeneemde oudiomateriaal. Ontwikkel terminologie en verskaf ondersteuning in die rekonstruksie van rekords: Akkumuleer terminologie en ontwikkel databasis, vul die terme en onderskeie betekenis in die glossariumregister in, versamel alle verhoordokumente, attendeer aan meganiese opnames, vergelyk notas van die Presiderende Beampte, Staat en Verdediging.

zu.title: Umhumushi oPhakamile weNkantolo
zu.summary: Ihhovisi likaNoMmeli Jikelele lifuna uMhumushi Omkhulu weNkantolo eNkantolo ePhakamene ye-Bhisho ukuba aze ahlinze ngokuhumushela ezinkundleni ezahlukahlukene zomthetho.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe neDiploma yezwe kukuHumushela izomthetho noma iziqu ezingaso ezingeni le-NQF level 6 ezinamekhredithi angama-360 njengoba kuthathwa nguhlelo i-SAQA. Isipilingo esingaphansi konye (1) unyaka weminyaka yokuba ngumhumushi weNkantolo, noma isitifikedi seBanga leshumi nambili (12) esinobugcwethe beminyaka eyishumi (10) yeminyaka yomsebenzi ekuHumusheleni enkantolo. Ukuba nolwazi esiNgisini nangesiXhosa. Ukuba nolwazi nangolunye ulimi lwasekhaya njengesiZulu, isiBhunu, isiSuthu noma isiTswana kanye namalayisensi evuthiwe yokuqhuba kuyoba yinzuzo ekwenzeni isicelo. Bonke abagqidwa ababetha ibhodi bazobe benza isivivinyo sokuzama ngaphambi kokungena njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlola ukuze kubonakale ukuthi umuntu ulungele ngokusobala ukulandela imithetho nezidingo zendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho nemiyalo ephathelene nakho, ulwazi ngesiko, ulwazi ngendawo ekushiwo ngayo, ulwazi ngokuthi uhumushe kanjani futhi ukwazi ukuhambisana nesikhathi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomyutha (i-MS Office), amakhono okuxhumana abalulekile (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa), ukulawula isikhathi, amakhono amahle abalinganiswa nabantu, amakhono okulalela, amakhono okukhonza abantu, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba, amakhono okwenza izinqumo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, isiNgisi esihle, ukuguquguquka, ukwethula inkuthazo, ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukukhathalela imininingwane, ukuzibophezela nokuzenzelela nokugxila kubantu.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yokuhumusha: Humusha kumacala eshoMthetho weBantwana, ezinqubweni zezocalo, ezinqubweni zeZomthetho wamalungelo abantu, kumacala oMthetho wokuDlaba ngokwedluliselwa komshoshaphansi noma ngokwedluliselwa kuntu, kumacala oMthetho wokuPhakamisa izulu, kumacala oMthetho wezinyoni ezingakhululeki, emagatsheni amancane, kumacala okugadla ngokusonteka, ezomsebenzi, ecaleni lokugcina, emicimbini yobulungiswa bezingane, ekuphenyweni kokufa, kanye nemicimbini engaphansi komyalo wesigqila, humusha kumaKosi amancane, humusha kumava okuzama, humusha kwizinsimbi zokuqinisekisa nokulawula, humusha nasekuqinisekiseni. Humusha kumava okungaphambi kocalo futhi uxhumane nomphathi wokuhumusha abantu abangabakuleli, humusha ngolimi lokuqala kuya kolimi okuhunjshiwe kuyo ngesikhathi senkantolo, ngaphambi kwecala, ukuxhumana, ngokwesigqila. Humusha izexwayiso ezingasho ngamazwi, ngokubamba kanye neziqinisekiso, xhumana nomnyango wezomthetho ukuze sixoxe ngokulungele noma ngemisebenzi yomhumushi othile enkantolo, hlinzeka ngesevisi yolimi nangokomthetho nesigqila: Hlinzeka ngokuhumusha okuzwakalayo futhi okucacile lusuke kolimi lokuqala kuya kolimi okuhumushiwe kuyo ngaphandle kokuhlotshiswa noma kokushiya okuthile ngelimi, dlulisa ulimi olufanele ngokomthetho wokusebenzisa ulimi komkhulumayo, lawula umkhulumayo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi okushiwo kuhunyushwe ngokufanele, humusha izexwayiso ezingasho ngamazwi ngokubamba kanye neziqinisekiso, humusha amadokhumenti nemibhalo yomthetho: Fundisisa futhi uhlaziye idokhumenti yokuqala, wenze ucwaningo oludingekayo futhi uxhume namaphathi ahlobene, qinisekisa ukuhumushwa okufanele kwamadokhumenti, hlola, hlela kabusha futhi ulungise idokhumenti ehumushiwe, humusha okulalelwa kwisilencinga. Xhasa amagama futhi unikeze inkxaso ekwakheni kabusha amarekhodi: Qoqa amagama futhi wakhe idathabhesi, faka amagama nokuqondene nawo esibukweni, qoqa yonke imibhalo yecalà, zibalase okulalelwe kwisilencinga, qhathanisa amanothi oMlawuli, bobuSulu kanye noMmeli wokuqinisekisa.

xh.title: Isiquphuli-thetho esiphakamileyo seenkundla
xh.summary: I-Office of the Chief Justice iFunwa nguM Comentwe we-Senior Court Interpreter ebhotweni iBhisho High Court, ekuze ngokufika kwamnye nasekuzonxibelelaniseni ukwaziswa njengesinxibelelanisi-mathandabuzo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafakeli babe nesidanga seDiploma yeSizwe kuguqulo-lwimi lemithetho okanye isifundo esithatha indawo yaso kwinqanaba le-6 le-NQF ngeecredithi ezingama-360 njengoko ziqatyiwe yi-SAQA. Kufuneka abe namava abangaphezulu kwonyaka omnye (1) njengesiququli-thetho seenkundla, okanye ifayitilikhethe yebanga lesiKhosi lethoba (12) elineimava ezingaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi (10) yokusebenza ngokubanzi kuguqulo-lwimi nkundla. Ilungilelo lokuzithandela kolwimi isiNgesi nangesiXhosa. Ilungilelo kolunye ulwimi lwasekhaya nangalolu ithethwa kakhulu ngabantu abantu kangangamaxesha amaninzi esiZulu, isiBhulu, isiSuthu okanye isiTswana, kunye nelayisensi yokushayela igqithisayo kuya kuba lusgqeba ngesandla phantsi kwaxa eza kuba lusiba kubomi babo onke iintsuku njengenexhoba lokuncitshiswa kwemigaqo yokulunga. Onke abakhethwe baza kwenza isihluzi ngokubhala-thetha njengenxalenye yeendlela zokuqokelela ezingomahluko ukuze kugqitywe ukulungelelana ngakumbi kobukhosi bobugcisa bobugqiweyo belinga kulo nangakumbi ngakumbi bobugqiweyo imisebenzi eyilwayo nengamaphupha-hlankatho. Ulwazi nakhono ngokukhanya kwesiqu esinamaphupha okubakho kwelinye ilinye: Ulwazi ngemithetho-nqamlezolo nemithetho elandelayo, ulwazi ngamasiko, ulwazi nengcinga ekuyo, ulwazi lokuguqula kwesiNgesi nokuba nakho ukuba nakho ukuba namandla okugcina isithuba, ulwazi ngokusesetyenziswa kwekhompyutha ekuqondweni kwamakhalaza, amandla okunxibelelwana oluvela olubhaliweyo noluthethwayo, ukulawula isithuba, amandla okudibana ngokusombulula iingxaki, amandla okuva, amandla okubakhulule afikelelo kubomi balo mntu wonke, amandla okudibana ngokusombulula iingxaki ngokupela kwamathandabuzo nokubhala-hlomla iingxaki, amandla okwamkela izigqibo. ingcinga, ulwimi oluqhwiyiweyo esiNgesi, olungenanto, iya kwamandla alinganiselwe ukulunga ngokukho lokuqhubeka phambili, lungenamathemba.
xh.duties: Kubela iinkonzo zenguqulo: Guqula ulwimi kumacala omthetho wezeNtsezakuso, kumacala obulelesi, kumacala angomthetho wonke, kumacala omthetho wokuGcinwa kwindlu ngamabom, kumacala omthetho wabaNdala, kwentsapho, kumacala omthetho wokuKhuselwa ekuQhatheni, kumabalo abasebenzi, kumacala omthetho wokuNikela inkxaso-mali, kumacala ezoBulungisa beBantwana, ekuPonyweni, nakumacala esiguquari-sigunyazisiwe, guqula ulwimi kwiNkundla zamabala amancinci, guqula ulwimi kumba wokuva amabala, guqula ulwimi kumanyano nokuQhubela phambili, guqula ulwimi ekuVumeni. Guqula ulwimi kumisidyana phambi kocalo nasekuwelweni, ncedisane nomphathi wegosa elihamba phambili ngokulawula iinguqulo zolwimi lwangaphandle, guqula ulwimi kuvelisela kolwimi oluchaziweyo phakathi kwemiba yenkundla, phambi kocalo, ekuwelweni, kwingxoxo ezingunyathelo lokulungiselela, kwicala elingasemva kunyathelo lokuqala lomthetho. Guqula okubonakalayo ngaphandle kwamagama, emdlalweni oqulunqwe nasekuvumeni, xoxa nabanikazi bomthetho malunga nokulungelelana okanye ukusebenza kwesiququli-thetho ethile enkundleni, yemisebenzi yomthetho nokuqulunqwa kolwimi ezingunyathelo: Zenze iinguqulo ezivelisela ngokucacileyo kulwimi lwangaphambili zize kolwimi oluchaziweyo ngaphandle kokuhombisa nangaphandle kokushiya nantoni na ngelondoloza ulwimi, dlulisa ulwimi oluchanekileyo ngokwemigaqo yokusetyenziswa kolwimi komthethi, lawula umthethi uze uqiniseke ukuba izalathiso ziguqulwe ngokuchanekileyo, guqula iimfono ezingagqitywanga ngamagama ezidlalwe ekuvineni ezisemthethweni nasekuvumeni, guqula amaxwebhu omthetho neemboniso: Phonononga uze uhlohlolisise uxwebhu oluchaziweyo, wenze uphando olufunekayo uze uncede ngokuxoxa namaphakathi achaphazelekayo, qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu aguqulwe ngokuchanekileyo ngokwesalathiso semiba, khangela, uhlele uze ulungise uxwebhu eliguquliweyo, guqula iindlela ezenziwa ngokuhambelana nezixhobo ezirekhotiweko zombhalo. Ekuphuhliseni ulwimi nasekunxumeni inkxaso ekuqulunqweni kwamaxwebhu: Qokeleza iintetho uze uphuhlise isiseko seenkcukacha, gcaza iintetho kunye nomsinga wazo ngokutsho kwelali ezingalathisiweyo zidityanisiweyo, qokeleza onke amaxwebhumacala, yaphula imiba yokuwa kumarekhodo, qhathanisa iingqondo ezibhaliweyo zomlawuli ongumbuki wecala, zikaBala weeNkokeli zengesiyo iRhulumente naseKhuselo leeMeka.

jobs.title: Registrar
jobs.centre: Eastern Cape Division of The High Court: Mthatha
jobs.salary_text: R337 563 - R1 155 777 per annum (MR3-MR5), Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a service certificate/s for determination of their experience. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Registrar position at the Eastern Cape High Court in Mthatha requiring an LLB degree and minimum two years postgraduate legal experience to process default judgments and quasi-judicial functions.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year Legal qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years post graduate legal experience. MR3: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 2 years post graduate legal experience. MR4: LLB Degree or equivalent plus minimum of 8 years post graduate legal experience. MR5: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 14 years post graduate legal experience. Superior Court or litigation experience and a driver’s license will be an added advantage. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of registrar’s duties, Case Flow Management, legislative framework governing the public service, knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, Batho Pele Principles, excellent communication skills (verbal and written), computer literacy, numerical skills, planning and organising skills, problem solving and decision-making skills, interpersonal skills, conflict management skills, time management skills, analytical skills, customer service orientated, conflict management, strong work ethics and professionalism, ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines, results driven, honesty/trustworthy and observance of confidentiality.
jobs.duties: Process default judgments to enhance efficiency of the Court in handling of quasi- judicial functions: Determine whether pleadings/ processes comply with the Court rules, consider applications for default judgment (Rule 31[5]) – by applying Court rules and regulations, case law, discretion and knowledge, capture accurate outcome of discretion applied on the file cover, ensure circulation of the outcome to the relevant litigating party, capture and update accurate Default applications register and data tool registered in the office daily, verify data and submit reporting tool on percentage of default judgments granted by Registrars to the Statistician, execute taxations to enhance efficiency of the Court in handling of quasi-judicial functions, Tax bills of cost - by hearing arguments from the parties and apply discretion and knowledge to the reasonable litigation costs, process and finalise Opposed and Unopposed Taxations in accordance with SOP, deal with and finalise taxation reviews (Rule 48) through the drafting of stated cases, replies, and submission to the Judiciary, capture and update accurate Bills of costs registered and data tools in the office, submit reporting tool on Taxations to the Statistician, manage criminal/civil process to enhance efficiency of the Court: Analyse statistical data to assess trends and devise strategies to address identified risk factors, resolve Presidential Hotline queries and chapter 9 institution enquiries, coordinate and report on the provision of support staff in Court Rooms and Registrars supporting offices, manage the collation of performance information/ data/ Statistics for purpose of reporting as per Reporting Tools, maintain and update manual registers for Audit of reported Performance information, supervise, develop staff and ensure general supervision of employees.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr. M Mhlontlo Tel No: (047) 504 5500 HR Related Enquiries: Ms. Z Sulo at (087) 086 6929
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/85/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrateur
af.summary: Registrateur-pos by die Eastern Cape High Court in Mthatha wat 'n LLB-graad en minimum twee jaar nagraadse regservaring vereis om verstekvonnisse en kwasi-regterlike funksies te verwerk.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n LLB-graad of 'n vier (4) jaar regskwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken besit. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar nagraadse regservaring. MR3: LLB-graad of gelykwaardig plus 'n minimum van 2 jaar nagraadse regservaring. MR4: LLB-graad of gelykwaardig plus 'n minimum van 8 jaar nagraadse regservaring. MR5: LLB-graad of gelykwaardig plus 'n minimum van 14 jaar nagraadse regservaring. Hooggereghof- of litigasie-ervaring en 'n bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal 'n voor-toetreed praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die assesseringsmetode om die kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van registrateur se pligte, Saakvloei-bestuur, wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer, kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing, Batho Pele-beginsels, uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik), rekenaarvaardigheid, numeriese vaardighede, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede, interpersoonlike vaardighede, konflikbestuursvaardighede, tydbestuursvaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, kliëntediens-georiënteerd, konflikbestuur, sterk werksetiek en professionaliteit, vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom, resultaatgedrewe, eerlikheid/betroubaarheid en inagneming van vertroulikheid.
af.duties: Verwerk verstekvonnisse om die doeltreffendheid van die Hof in die hantering van kwasi-regterlike funksies te verbeter: Bepaal of pleitstukke/prosesse met die Hofreëls voldoen, oorweeg aansoeke om verstekvonnis (Reël 31[5]) – deur Hofreëls en regulasies, gevallereg, diskresie en kennis toe te pas, vaslegging van die akkurate uitslag van die diskresie wat op die lêeromslag toegepas is, verseker sirkulasie van die uitslag aan die tersydelike litigerende party, vaslegging en opdatering van akkurate Verstek-aansoeke-register en datawerktuig wat daagliks in die kantoor geregistreer word, verifieer data en dien rapporteringswerktuig oor persentasie verstekvonnisse wat deur Registrateurs toegestaan is by die Statistikus in, voer belasting uit om die doeltreffendheid van die Hof in die hantering van kwasi-regterlike funksies te verbeter, Belasting van koste-rekenings - deur argumente van die partye aan te hoor en diskresie en kennis toe te pas op die redelike litigasiekoste, verwerk en finaliseer Teengesette en Onteengesette Belastings ooreenkomstig SVR, hanteer en finaliseer belastinghersienings (Reël 48) deur die opstel van gestelde gevalle, antwoorde, en voorlegging aan die Regbank, vaslegging en opdatering van akkurate Koste-rekenings wat geregistreer is en datawerktuie in die kantoor, dien rapporteringswerktuig oor Belastings aan die Statistikus in, bestuur kriminele/siviele proses om die doeltreffendheid van die Hof te verbeter: Analiseer statistiese data om tendense te assesseer en strategieë te beraam om geïdentifiseerde risikofaktore aan te spreek, los Presidentshiftlyn-navrae en navrae van hoofstuk 9-instellings op, koördineer en rapporteer oor die voorsiening van ondersteuningspersoneel in Hofkamers en Registrateurs-ondersteuningskantore, bestuur die samestelling van prestasie-inligting/data/Statistiek vir die doel van verslagdoening soos per Rapporteringswerktuie, onderhou en werk handmatige registers by vir Oudit van gerapporteerde prestasie-inligting, toesig hou, personeel ontwikkel en algemene toesig oor werknemers verseker.

zu.title: Umrejistra
zu.summary: Isikhundla somrejistra e-Eastern Cape High Court eMthatha esifuna iziqu ze-LLB nokuhlangenwe nakho okungenani kweminyaka emibili kuwo nomsebenzi wezomthetho emva kweziqu ukuze kucutshungulwe izahlulelo ezingenzwa ngokungabi khona kwezamacala nemisebenzi enosizo ngokomthetho.
zu.requirements: Abafakisiso kufanele babe neziqu ze-LLB Degree noma iziqu ze-Legal zeminyaka emine (4) njengoba ezitholwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani ukuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka emibili (2) komsebenzi wezomthetho emva kweziqu. MR3: Iziqu ze-LLB Degree noma okulingana nokho okungenani nokuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka emibili komsebenzi wezomthetho emva kweziqu. MR4: Iziqu ze-LLB Degree noma okulingana nokho okungenani kokuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili komsebenzi wezomthetho emva kweziqu. MR5: Iziqu ze-LLB Degree noma okulingana nokho okungenani kokuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka eyishuminane komsebenzi wezomthetho emva kweziqu. Ukuhlangenwe nakho enkantolo ephakeme noma emacaleni kanye nelayisensi yokushayela kuzoba yinzuzo. Bonke abantu ababekwe ohlwini bazokwenza isivivinyo sokuzilolonga njengengxenye yenqubo yokuhlolwa ukuze kuhlolwe ukufaneleka komuntu ngokusobekwa kwemisebenzi nangezidingo ezijwayelekile zesikhundla. Ulwazi nobukhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi komrejistra, ukuPhathwa kokuhamba kwamacala, uhlelo lomthetho oluphatha isevisi yomphakathi, ulwazi ngemiyalo yokulondolozwa nokubuyiswa kwemibhalo ngokwesimo somsebenzi, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu (oluhlomo nolubhalwayo), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono ezibalo, amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela umsebenzi, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuqumba izinqumo, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuphatha izinkinga, amakhono okuphatha isikhathi, amakhono okuhlaziya, ukukhathalela ukukhonza abathengi, ukuphatha izinkinga, izimiso zokusebenza ezinzima nongcwatywa, ikakhulukazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezelo nokuhlangabezana namadelu, ukugxila emiphumeleni, ukuqiniseka/ukwethembeka nokugcina imfihlo.
zu.duties: Cutshungula izahlulelo ezingenzwa ngokungabi khona kwezamacala ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwengqondo enkantolo ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi enosizo ngokomthetho: Qinisekisa ukuthi izicelo/izinqubo zivumelana nemithetho yenkantolo, cabangela izicelo sezahlulelo ezingenzwa ngokungabi khona kwezamacala (Rule 31[5]) - ngokusebenzisa imithetho nemicimbi yenkantolo, umthetho wamacala, ukukhetha nokusebenzisa ulwazi, faka umphumela ophelele wokukhetha okwensiwe kwesiqulathi zicelo, qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa komphumela kuleyo ndawo eqashwa isiqulathi, faka ubuvakashela izicelo ezingenzwa ngokungabi khona kwamacala ngenhla ukuze kutholwe izicelo ezibhalwe kule ndlu yomsebenzi nsuku zonke, qinisekisa idatha. Hlaziya idatha futhi unikeze isixhumi esibika ngokwesibamba esinamaphesenti kwezahlulelo ezingenzwa ngokungabi khona kwezamacala ezinikwe abarejistra kusiya ku-Statistician. Yenza izinkokhelo zokuthintwa kwamacala ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwengqondo enkantolo ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi enosizo ngokomthetho. Lalela izikweletu zezinkokhelo - ngokulalela imibhalo yamacala phakathi kweqembu, bese usebenzisa isinketho nokwaziswa ukukhipha izinkokhelo ezingabangela ubunzima bokulwa. Yenza, futhi uphethule, izinkokhelo eziphikiswa nalezo ezingaphikiswa ngokwendlela ebekiwe (SOP). Phatha uphethule futhi ukubuyekezwa kwezinkokhelo ezenziwe ngokuthintwa kwamacala (Rule 48) ngokubhala izimo ezichaziwe, izimpendulo, nokuzithumela kubahlule bezomthetho. Faka futhi ulondoloze izibalo ezingahlelwa zezinkokhelo zeziqulathi namathuluzi idatha ekhasini lesikhundla. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, athule ibhalansi lokuhlelwa ngokususa izinkokhelo ezenziwe esitadini. Hlela izinsizakusebenza zokugcina idatha kanye namathuluzi eminyuziso afakiwe eba ibe khona ngokuhlelelwa kwenhlangano noma imfanelo. Hlola idatha kanye nezinsizakusebenza ekhasini eliphathwa ngenhlokwanjengana yezinsizakusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa ngokulondoloza amanani atholakala emthethweni 5 ukuze kutholakale isibalo sokuthi izinsizakusebenza ziye zabanziwe yini ngokuhlelwa okuhleliweyo. Hlola ngokuthumela isitifikethi sokubona izinsizakusebenza ezinamaphepha okulinganisela kahle. Hlinza, hamba kabili nozakwabo ocishiwe. Faka isikhwama senkabhi emtholothwa yezinhlaka zensizakusebenza ezigxumile ezingakwazimi ukuvela ukusebenzela inqubomgomo yomthetho okubi kakhulwini emthethweni 5. Zibandakanye futhi ziphawule ukudalwa kolwazi olubonwayo / idatha / izibalo ezitholakalayo emsebenzini kanti futhi, ebasweni kwezinhlangano emsebenzini, zibale imiphumela emibhaliwe yezinto ezibalwa ngokomthetho ohleweni lokubika. Gcina futhi uhleze ulondoloze izinkulungwane ezibhalwa ngesandla ngokwe-Audit yolwazi olubikiwe ngomphumela omuhle ngemisebenzi, ziphathe, zithuthukise abasebenzi futhi zigqamise ukulawula okujwayelekile kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi webhankane
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi webhankane kwikhothi Ephakamileyo yaseEastern Cape eMthatha esifuna isidanga seLLB kunye nokuba ndilunya ngaphezulu kweminyaka mibini yamava emthethweni emva kwezidanga ukuze kuphathwe izigwebo ezenziwa ngenxa yokungabikho komthengi nakwimisebenzi enguqalo yomthetho.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesiQondo se-LLB Degree okanye isidanga semithetho seminyaka mine (4) esamkelwe yi-SAQA. Kufuneka babe nolona hlobo lwamava amabini (2) emthethweni emva kwezidanga. MR3: Isidanga se-LLB Degree okanye esilinganayo ngenani yamava ambini emva kwezidanga. MR4: Isidanga se-LLB Degree okanye esilinganayo ngenani yamava asibhozo emva kwezidanga. MR5: Isidanga se-LLB Degree okanye esilinganayo ngenani yamava alishumi elinane emva kwezidanga. Amava kwikhothi Ephakamileyo okanye kumthetho wengxoxo nelayisensi yokushayela kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Onke amagqabantshi asweleke ahlawulwe aya kwenza isicatshulwa esithile sokungenisa phambi kokungena njengenxalenye yenklele yokuqonda ukuba umthengi ulungele ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno ezithile nakwezizezulwini zesithuba. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomphathi webhankane, Ulawulo lokuHamba kweMiba, iinkqubo zomthetho ezilawula inkonzo yakhovwini, ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokugcina nokuveza ulwazi ngokwemimandla yokusebenza, iMigaqo yeBatho Pele, amakhono amangaliswe okunyaniseka kwethintelana (ngomlomo nangobhalo), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okubala, amakhono okucwangcisa nokuqamba, amakhono okuxazula iingxaki nokwenza iigqibo, amakhono abantu bokuzonxibelelana, amakhono okulawula ingxabano, amakhono okulawula ixesha, amakhono okuhlalutya, ukuba noluvo lokukhathalela abathengi, ulawulo lwengxabano, izimilo ezomelezeyo zokusebenza nokuziphatha ngokuchanekileyo, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngocinezelo nokugqiba ngexesha elibalulekileyo, ukuzinikela kumziphumo, inyaniso/ukwathemba kwaye ugcine iyimfihlo.
xh.duties: Phatha izigwebo ezenziwa ngenxa yokungabikho komthengi ukwandisa inkonzo yeKhothi ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi enguqalo yomthetho: Qamba ukuba izibhalo/iinkqubo zihambelana nemigaqo yeKhothi, xelela iimfuno zokwenza isigwebo ngenxa yokungabikho komthengi (Rule 31[5]) – ngokusebenzisa imigaqo nolawulo lweKhothi, umthetho wezimemo, ukuzikhethela ngokubakho kolwazi, qamba neziphumo ezichanekileyo zokuzikhethela ezibhaliwe kwifayile, qinisekisa ukusasaza isiphumo kwindalo efanelekileyo yabahlumeni, qamba uze ugcino iresitha yokungenisa izicelo ezenziwa ngenxa yokungabikho komthengi nesoftware sedatha elibhalwe kwindlu zonxibelelwano yonke imihla, qinisekisa idatha uze unike iresitha yokuqamba ngepesenti yezigwebo ezenziwa ngenxa yokungabikho komthengi ezinikiwe ngabaphathi bebhankane kumTyali-datha, phatha iindleko ze-randi ukwandisa inkonzo yeKhothi ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi enguqalo yomthetho, Iindleko zeBhili zomrhengo - ngokuziva iingxoxo ezivela kumacandelo aze usebenzise ukuzikhethela nolwazi kwindleko ezichanekileyo zomthetho wengxoxo, qamba uze ugqibe iindleko ezichasiweyo nongachasiweyo ngokuvumelana ne-SOP, phatha uze ugqibe iingxelo zokuhlola iindleko (Rule 48) ngokusika amacala, iimpendulo, nangokuzelelanisa kwiZiko lendalo eqamba iingxelo, qamba uze ugcino iresitha yamabhilli okuhlawulwa edatha aze afakwe kwindlu zonxibelelwano, ngenisa isixhobo esikuqamba ukulandelwa kwemiba yendleko kumTyali-datha, phatha iinkqubo zobugweba/zomthetho ukwandisa inkonzo yeKhothi: Nalalisa idatha yokubala ukuze uqonde iimbonakaliso uze uqambe iindlela zokulunga eengozi eziphawulwe kakhulu, phathisa imibuzo yolada yangamagosa namabhalo eziqendu ze-chapter 9, qhuba uze uxele ngokusetyenziswa kwabasebenzi abanika inkxaso kwiKhothi nakwindlu kaBaphathi bebhankane, qhuba ukuqokelelwa kolwazi/Idatha/Izibalo zokwenza ngokwakho ukwenza iingxelo njengakusoftware yokwenza iingxelo, gcina uze ugcine izibalo zesandla zokuqamba ulwazi ngokwenza iingxelo, qeqesha, phatha abantu basebenzayo uze uqinisekise ukugcinwa okubanzi kokwabo bonke obasebenza.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Legal
jobs.centre: Eastern Cape Division of The High Court: Gqeberha
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Administration clerk sought for the Eastern Cape High Court in Gqeberha to conduct legal research, compile statistics, manage case flow and support audit readiness.

A minimum of one (1) year’ experience in a legal environment, LLB Degree qualification and a driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements. Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of Public Services Legislation, Prescripts and Regulations, research skills, communication skills (verbal and written) including presentation skills, minute taking skills and report writing skills, problem solving and decision making and time management skills, good reporting, organising and planning skills, creative and analytical thinking skills and computer literacy (MS Office).
jobs.duties: Conduct legal research for the Regional Court President/Chief Magistrate (as and when required), compilation of statistics (Submission to Monitoring & Evaluation unit, reconcile manual and electronic statistics), audit readiness and data purification, case flow management, assisting Regional Court Registrar and members of the public, provide administrative support in general as requested by the Court Manager and Supervisor.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Ms. P Boya-Nyhiba Tel No: (041) 502 6626 HR Related Enquiries: Ms. Z Sulo at (087) 086 6929

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Regs
af.summary: Administrasieklerk gesoek vir die Eastern Cape Hooggeregshof in Gqeberha om regsnavorsing te doen, statistiek saam te stel, sakevloei te bestuur en ouditgereedheid te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF vlak four (4) soos deur SAQA erken, beskik. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. 'n Minimum van one (1) jaar se ervaring in 'n regsomgewing, 'n LLB-graadkwalifikasie en 'n bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate sal 'n voor-toetredende praktiese oefening as deel van die assesseringsmetode onderneem om die kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal. af.duties: Voer regsnavorsing vir die Regional Court President/Chief Magistrate uit (soos en wanneer vereis), samestelling van statistiek (Indiening by die Monitoring & Evaluation-eenheid, herkontroleer van handmatige en elektroniese statistiek), ouditgereedheid en datasuiwering, sakevloeibestuur, bystand aan Regional Court Registrar en lede van die publiek, verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning in die algemeen soos deur die Court Manager en Supervisor versoek.

xh.summary: Kufunwa iclerki yolulo kwiNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseEastern Cape eGqeberha ukuba yenze uphando olumthetho, idibanise iibalo, ilawule ukuhamba kwamacala kwaye inike inkxaso ekulungeleliseni ukuhlolwa.
xh.requirements: Omgqogi kufuneka abe nesatifikethi seQela le-12 okanye ngenzo elifanayo kwinqanaba le-NQF elinesi (4) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mfundo yamava iyafunwa. Bonke abagqogi abakhethiweyo baya kwenza isixhobo somzobo sokuqala njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinganisa ukuqinisekisa ukufaneleka komgqogi ngokusabela kwiimfuno ezize ngobuchwepheshe nangobubanzi yesithuba. Ulwazi Nobugca: Ulwazi ngeMigaqo, iMiyalelo namaLungiselelo ezeNkonzo za Kawonke-wonke, amandla okuphanda, amandla okunxibelela (ngomlomo nangobhalo) kuquka namandla okubonisa, amandla okuthatha imizuzu nemisebenzi yokubhala iingxelo, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqumba kwaye kubekho namandla okulawula ixesha, amandla amaninzi okubhala iingxelo, ukuqamba nokuhlela, amandla okucinga ngokwakhiwo nokuhlalutya nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office).
xh.duties: Yenza uphando olumthetho loMongameli weNkundla yoMmandla/NoMajistrati oMkhulu (njengoko kuyimfuneko), ukuhlanganiswa kweebalo (Ukuhambisa kuMmandla woKuhlola nokulinganisa, ukumisa ngokuthe ngqo iibalo zangasemva nangobuntlolo), ukulungelelana kolwaza ukuze kuhambe kakuhle nokucofa iinkcukacha zedatha, ulawulo lokuhamba kwamacala, ukuncedisa uMmeli weNkundla yoMmandla nakwabathengi bomphakathi, ukunikeza inkxaso yolulo ngokubanzi njengoko kucelwa nguMphathi weNkundla noMphathi oNgaphezulu.

af.title: Bode Klerk
af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe en hofondersteuning aan regters by die Limpopo Hooggeregshof in Thohoyandou, insluitend die vergesel van banklede en die handhawing van hoforde.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor Graad 10 of ABET level 3 soos deur SAQA erken beskik. Relevante ervaring is vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal 'n voor-toelatings praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die assesseringsmetode om die kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaars te bedryf en statistiek te versamel, kennis van die MS Office-pakket, met ervaring in woordverwerking, Outlook, Power Point en Excel, kennis van Kantooradministrasie, kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer, Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings & skriftelik), probleemoplossingsvaardighede, goeie openbare betrekkinge vaardighede, moniterings- en analitiese vaardighede, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, verslagskrywingsvaardighede en tikvaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies aan die Regters en die Hofkamer, vergesel lede van die bank na en vanaf die Hof en vergesel Regters se kamers met prokureurs, fasiliteer orde in Hofkamers voordat die Regters ingeroep word, organiseer die Hofbemanning en stel hulle in kennis van die aanvangstye in ooreenstemming met die daaglikse Hofrol, handhaaf stilte en orde in die Hofkamers wanneer Regters inkom of uitgaan, kontroleer die korrektheid van motion Hofrolle, genereer kopieë en versprei dit volgens die verspreidingslys, handhaaf Hofkamers se rekords, kontroleer en reël die kriminele en siviele lêers (om na die Hofkamers geneem te word), rapporteer die vermiste lêers aan die Regters, lê argiveer die dokumente, registers, ens, fasiliteer die gladde verloop van die Hofkamers, help met die skedulering van Hof sake (motion opposed), reël die verteenwoordiging van sake, onderhandel die Hofkamers toekenning met Regters in tye van Hof, kamertekorte, versamel en versprei Hof lêers, sorteer en kontroleer die Hof lêers, hou die Hof lêers veilig en sirkuleer Hof rolle volgens die verspreidingslys.
