zu.summary: Nika abajudge e-Limpopo High Court e-Thohoyandou inkxaso yolawulo nangakho ikhothi, okuhlanganisa nokuhamba nabalingisi bebench kanye nogcina ukuthula ekhothi.
zu.requirements: Abafakikelayo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 10 noma i-ABET level 3 njengoba kwamukelwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka abanamava ohamba nobuhlobo nalokhu. I-driver’s license evumelekile izoba yilungelo elingeziwe. Bonke abantu abakhethekile abakufaka ohlwini abazokwenza isenzo sezokuzijwayisa phambi kokungena njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlola ukuze kubonakale ukufaneleka komuntu ofakikelayo kusekelwe ezidingweni zobuciko nobubanzi besikhundla. Amakhono namandla: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yobikliki, izindlela kanye namandla okungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ama-computer nokuthola izibalo, ulwazi lwesiphakamiso se-MS Office, ncamashi nokusebenza ngamagama, i-Outlook, i-Power Point kanye ne-Excel, ulwazi lwe-Office Administration, ulwazi nokuqonda ohlangothini lomthetho oluphethe Public Service, amakhono okuxhumana (okusho lapho nokubhalayo), amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono ohlelo lwabantu oluhle, amakhono okubuka nokuhlaziya, amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba, amakhono okubika nokubhala kanye namakhono okuthayiphiza.
zu.duties: Yinkxaso yolawulo kojuejeli naseKhothi; hamba nabalingisi bebenchiya ekhothi ubuyele futhi uphendulele abajudge kumasamu abo; qinisekisa ukuthula ekhothi phambi kokubiza abajudge; hlela abasebenzi bethimba ekhothi futhi ubatshengise izikhathi zokuqala ngokuhambisana nesikhathi somugqa wemisebenzi yansuku zonke; gcina ukuthula ekhothi lapho abajudge bengena noma bephuma; hlola ukuthi kuyaqondakala yini imigqa yemisebenzi ekhothi yamacala abhaliweyo; ukukhiqiza amakhophi nokuyabelwa ngokohlu lokwabelwa; gcina amarekhodi ekhothi; hlola futhi uhlele amafayela wobugebengu nabezomthetho (okuziswa ekhothi); bgcazele abajudge ngamafayela alahlekile; bhala/nikela amafayela amadokhumente, amarekhodi; qinisekisa ukuthi ekhothi kuhamba kahle; siza ekubekweni kwezinhlelo zemisebenzi yekhothi (amacala alwa nawo); hlela ukumela kwamacala; xoxa ngokwabelwa kweKhothi nojuejeli ngesikhathi sekhothi kuncane izindlu; thola futhi wabelane namafayela ekhothi; hlela futhi uhlole amafayela ekhothi; gcina amafayela ekhothi abe naphephandle futhi uhambise imigqa yemisebenzi yekhothi ngokohlu lokwabelwa.

xh.title: Ushala umnxeba
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo nencwadi yenkantolo kwabambelelayi eLimpopo High Court eThohoyandou, kuquka ukukhokela amalungu ebhentshi nokugcina ukulungelelana kwenkantolo.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufunekube nesiQinisekiso seGrade 10 okanye isiQinisekiso seABET level 3 esamkelwe yiSAQA. Kufunekubenamava ahambelanayo nendima. Ulayisense wokuqhuba ogunyaziweyo uza kubanguvo ongawongezelelayo. Onke amagqabantshintshi abekwe kulu luhluo kuya kwenza isicelo sokuzilolonga ngokwesiphiqo njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinga ukumisela ukufaneleka komfaki ngokwesithuba ngokwemfuno yaso yobuchwepheshe nakumava afanelekileyo. Amakhono namandla okwenza: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yolwazi lweenkqubo, kunye namandla okugcina iingcombolo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthatha iimbali ezisemthethweni ngokubanzi, ulwazi lokusebenzisa i-MS Office, ngamava ukusebenza i-word processing, Outlook, Power Point kunye Excel, ulwazi ngolawulo lwe-Office, ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho ephatha iNkonzo kaRhulumente, amakhono okunxibelelanisa (okuthetha nokubhala), amakhono okusombulula iingxaki, amakhono amahle onxibelelwano nomntu wonke, amakhono okuhlola nokuhlalutya, amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela, amakhono okubhala iingxelo kunye namakhono okuthayipha.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwabaambelelayi nakwigumbi lenkantolo, khokela amalungu ebhentolo ukuza kwaye uphume enkantweni, ukhathalele amagumbi abambelelayo nogwetya, yilawule ukuziphatha ngokuhle kwamagumbi enkantolo phambi kokumema abambelelayo ngaphakathi, hlela iqela lenkantolo uze uwaxelele iixa zokuqalisa ngokuhambisana norhelo lwansuku zonke lenkantolo, gcina ucule nolungelelana kwamagumbi enkantolo xa abambelela bengena okanye baphuma, khangela ukuchaneka kwamagama arhelo enkantolo yentshukumo, dala amakhophi uze uwahlule ngokurhelo lwabelo, gcina iirekhedi zamagumbi enkantolo, khangela uze uhlele iifayili ezilwaphula-mthetho nezangabantu ngabuphela abahlala bachithwa kwamagumbi enkantolo, xela abambelelayo ngeefayili ezihlazekileyo, gcina ukuqinisekiswa okanye zigcine iifayili, iirekhodi, nokunye, qwalasela ukuhamba kakuhle kwamagumbi enkantolo, yenza isexezo lwezinto zenkantolo (entshukumisano eqhathaniswa), hlela ukumela kweyango, thatha isigqibo ngokwaba amagumbi enkantolo kunye nalomntu ongumgwebi kwixa ezingagumbi zankantolo, phatha kwaye zabnisise iifayili zenkantolo, hlela kwaye khangela iifayili zenkantolo, gcina iifayili zenkantolo zikhuselwe kwaye zasule iirhelo zenkantolo ngokuhambisana noluhlu lokwabelwa.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Planning Alignment
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive salary package). The remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within the relevant framework.
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed to manage and coordinate strategic and annual performance plans for national and provincial departments, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 8 years' planning experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF level 7 qualification in any of the following: Public Administration/Management, Business Administration, Social Science, Development Studies. 8 years’ experience in strategic planning/ public sector institutional planning/ operational planning/ public sector development planning/ public sector monitoring & evaluation of which 5 years should be at a senior managerial level. NQF level 8 qualification, or higher, will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s license. A good understanding of political, government planning and governance issues. Good understanding of government across the three spheres and of development partners that work with governments. Knowledge of government prescripts (including National Treasury regulations), policies, administrative processes, practices, and programmes. Knowledge of the National Development Plan (NDP) and the Medium-Term Development Plan and their implementation processes within institutions. Ability to foster and manage effective working arrangements with other centres of government departments and social/development partners to ensure coordinated and integrated actions. Willingness to travel on a regular basis. Competencies & Skills: Management skills including people management and empowerment, and experience in managing multi- disciplinary teams. Ability to provide strategic direction and leadership. The ability/experience to create an environment for high performance culture and staff development. Ability to manage multiple projects. Excellent interpersonal & communication skills (written & verbal). Highly developed negotiation and conflict management skills. Strategic and analytical skills. Research and policy analysis skills. Financial management and project/programme management skills. Good computer literacy skills. Personal Attributes: The incumbent must be assertive and self-driven, innovative and creative, client orientated and customer focused, solution orientated and able to work under stressful situations.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible to: Manage, coordinate and support the development and assessment of Strategic Plans, Annual Performance Plans and Operational Plans with development priorities for national departments, provincial departments and Schedule 3A & 3C public entities with regard to non-financial performance, Manage coordinate and facilitate the quarterly performance reporting, of non-financial performance, of national departments, provincial departments and Schedule 3A & 3C public entities Manage the development, review and implementation of policies, frameworks, circulars and guidelines that support strategic planning, annual performance planning and operational planning processes for national and provincial departments and Schedule 3A & 3C public entities, Manage coordinate and facilitate stakeholder engagements and forums on Strategic Plan and Annual Performance Plan processes and reporting for national, provincial departments and Schedule 3A & 3C public entities ,Provide professional management and leadership in respect of the provision of the core functions and services assigned to the Chief Directorate and support cross-functional work within the department.
jobs.applications: can be sent to Recruitment27@dpme.gov.za
jobs.notes: The relevant reference number must be quoted on all applications. The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement and will be required to undergo a security clearance. Applications must be submitted on a signed Z83 accompanied by a comprehensive CV only specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applicants will be required to meet vetting requirements as prescribed by Minimum Information Security Standards. The DPME is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) Failure to submit the above information will result in the application not being considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Note that correspondence will only be conducted with the short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by DPME. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks will be conducted once they are short-listed and the appointment is also subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. For salary levels 11 to 15, the inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The DPME reserves the right to utilise practical exercises/tests for non-SMS positions during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). The DPME also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details      can   be     sourced        by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates are required to use the new Z83 (Application for employment) that is implemented with effect from 1 January 2021. A copy can be downloaded on the website of the Department of Public Service & Administration (DPSA) at www.dpsa.gov.za MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Beplanningsbelyning
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur benodig om strategiese en jaarlikse prestasieplanne vir nasionale en provinsiale departemente te bestuur en te koördineer, waarvoor 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 8 jaar beplanningservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in enigeen van die volgende: Openbare Administrasie/Bestuur, Besigheidsadministrasie, Maatskaplike Wetenskap, Ontwikkelingstudies. 8 jaar ervaring in strategiese beplanning/openbare sektor instellasionele beplanning/operasionele beplanning/openbare sektor ontwikkelingsbeplanning/openbare sektor monitering en evaluasie waarvan 5 jaar op 'n senior bestuursvlak moet wees. 'n NQF-vlak 8-kwalifikasie, of hoër, sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Goeie begrip van politieke, regeringsbeplannings- en bestuursake. Goeie begrip van regering oor die drie sfere en van ontwikkelingsvennote wat met regerings werk. Kennis van regeringsvoorskrifte (insluitend Nasionale Tesourie-regulasies), beleide, administratiewe prosesse, praktyke en programme. Kennis van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NDP) en die Medium-Term Development Plan en hul implementeringsprosesse binne instellings. Vermoë om doeltreffende werksreëlings met ander sentrums van regeringsdepartemente en sosiale/ontwikkelingsvennote te bevorder en te bestuur om gekoördineerde en geïntegreerde optrede te verseker. Bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis. Bevoegdhede en vaardighede: Bestuursvaardighede insluitend mensebestuur en bemagtiging, en ervaring in die bestuur van multidissiplinêre spanne. Vermoë om strategiese rigting en leierskap te bied. Die vermoë/ervaring om 'n omgewing vir 'n hoëprestasiekultuur en persoonlike ontwikkeling te skep. Vermoë om veelvuldige projekte te bestuur. Uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Hoogs ontwikkelde onderhandelings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Strategiese en analitiese vaardighede. Navorsings- en beleidsanalisevaardighede. Finansiële bestuur- en projek/programbestuursvaardighede. Goeie rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Die ampsdraer moet beslis en selfgedrewe wees, innoverend en kreatief, kliëngerig en klantgefokus, oplossingsgerig en in staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees om: Die ontwikkeling en assessering van Strategiese Planne, Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne en Operasionele Planne met ontwikkelingsprioriteite vir nasionale departemente, provinsiale departemente en Schedule 3A & 3C openbare entiteite ten opsigte van nie-finansiële prestasie te bestuur, te koördineer en te ondersteun. Die kwartaallikse prestasieverslagdoening van nie-finansiële prestasie van nasionale departemente, provinsiale departemente en Schedule 3A & 3C openbare entiteite te bestuur, te koördineer en te fasiliteer. Die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van beleide, raamwerke, sirkulères en riglyne wat strategiese beplanning, jaarlikse prestasiebeplanning en operasionele beplanningsprosesse vir nasionale en provinsiale departemente en Schedule 3A & 3C openbare entiteite ondersteun, te bestuur. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en forums oor Strategiese Plan- en Jaarlikse Prestasieplan-prosesse en verslagdoening vir nasionale, provinsiale departemente en Schedule 3A & 3C openbare entiteite te bestuur, te koördineer en te fasiliteer. Professionele bestuur en leierskap met betrekking tot die voorsiening van die kernfunksies en dienste wat aan die Hoofdirektoraat toegewys is, te verskaf en kruisfunksionele werk binne die departement te ondersteun.

zu.title: Umqondisi Omkhulu: Ukuqondaniswa Kwezinhlelo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi ongumqondisi omkhulu yokuphatha kanye nokuqondisa Izinhlelo eziyisinqamuli nezinhlelo zoMsebenzi Wonka zomnyango wezwe kanye nesifundazwe, okudinga iziqu ze-NQF 7 kanye neprofuve eminyakeni eyi-8 yokuhlela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF level 7 kunoma yisiphi esinye salawa: Public Administration/Management, Business Administration, Social Science, Development Studies. Uhlale iminyaka engu-8 uprofuwe ukuhlela okuyisinqamuli/ ukuhlela izikhungo zomphakathi/ ukuhlela ukusebenza/ ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo komphakathi/ ukubheka nokuhlola izinkinga zomphakathi, okuyilapho okungenani iminyaka engu-5 kufanele ibe singeni losobaphathi abaphezulu. Iziqu ezingeni le-NQF level 8, noma eziseduze, zibe yinjabulo engekho emthethweni. Ifayela yokushayela eliyisikhathi esedlule. Ukwaziswa okuhle ngemibuzo yezombusazwe, ukuhlela kahulumeni kanye nezinkomba zokuphathwa kwezindaba. Ukwaziswa okuhle ngokusebenza kahulumeni kuzo zozigaba ezintathu nakubalingani bokuthuthukiswa abasebenza namahulumeni. Ulwazi mayelana nemiyalo yohulumeni (okuhlanganisa nemithetho ye-National Treasury), izinqubomgomo, izinqubo zokuphatwa kwezindaba, izindlela, kanye nezinhlelo. Ulwazi mayelana ne-National Development Plan (NDP) kanye ne-Medium-Term Development Plan kanye nezinqubo zazo zokusetshenziswa ezikhungweni. Isipho sokukhuthaza kanye nokuphatha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo namanye amakhono ezigaba eminyangweni kahulumeni kanye nabalingani bethuthuko/imiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe izenzo eziqondene nezinye futhi ezihlanganisiwe. Ukuzikhanyela ukwamukela ukuhamba njalo. Amakhono nobukhosi: Amakhono okuphatha okuhlanganisa nokuphatha abantu nokusizakala, kanye noprofuwe yokuphatha amaqembu aphathe imisebenzi ehlukene. Isipho sokubonezela isiqondiso esiyisinqamuli nogogo. Isipho/profuve yekhono lokudala isimo sokusebenza ukuba namasiko aphakeme kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Isipho sokuphatha amaphrojekthi amaningi. Amakhono aphakeme okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuxhumana (okubhalwe nokuvedwa). Amakhono aphakeme okuxoxisana ngokuncintisana kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkinga. Amakhono okuhlakanipha nokuhlonza. Amakhono okuphenya kanye nokuhlola izinqubomgomo. Amakhono okuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi/izinhlelo. Amakhono okusebenza ngobungcweti ngekhompyutha. Izici zomuntu: Umphathi kufanele abe nesibindi futhi aziphathe, abe nomqondo oshukumisayo, abe nobuciko bokuqamba okusha, ajuke ukusebenzela abakhulumayo kanye nokuqwalasela imfuneko yabathengi, aqondiswe kwizixazululo futhi akwazi ukusebenza esimeni esinengcindezi.
zu.duties: Umphathi lothisi wozibuse ekule imisebenzi elandelayo: Abaphathi, balungise futhi basekela ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlola Izinhlelo Eziyisinqamuli, Izinhlelo ZoMsebenzi Wonyaka kanye Nezinhlelo Zokusebenza ngokuhambisana nezinto eziyisidingo sokuthuthuka kwezinsizakalo ezingezona ezemali zezikhungo zikahulumeni ezingezona ezifundwe eminyangweni yezwe nesifundazwe kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi ze-Schedule 3A & 3C, Abaphathi, balungise futhi bathuthukise ukubika ngokusebenza kwesikhathi esiyisikwehla, ngokusebenza okungewona okwezimali, kweminyango yezwe nesifundazwe kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi ze-Schedule 3A & 3C. Baphathe ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlolwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, izakhiwo, amagobongo kanye nezindlela eziyisiqondiso ezisekela izinqubo zokuhlela okuyisinqamuli, ukuhlela ukusebenza kwonyaka kanye nezinqubo zokuhlela ukusebenza kweminyango yezwe nesifundazwe kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi ze-Schedule 3A & 3C. Baphathe, balungise futhi bathuthukise ingxoxo nabahlanganyeli kanye namaphoramu mayelana nezinqubo nokubika kwezinhlelo eziyisinqamuli nezinhlelo zomsebenzi wonyaka ezikhungweni ezingezona ezifundwe kanye nabahlanganyeli bakuthuthukiswe ezigabeni ezinkuluno zomnyango, ukuphathe kwezwe nesifundazwe kanye nabahlanganyeli bezinsizakalo. Sinike umphathi obungcweti kanye nogogo bokuhola mayelana nokubonelela ngemisebenzi eyisiseko kanye nezinsiza enikelwe kwiKhompyutha eYinhloko kanye nokuqhuba imisebenzi engapheli kumnyango ophela wonke.

xh.title: Igqebe leNkulumbuso: Ulungelelwaniso lweCandelo
xh.summary: Kufuneka igqebe leNkulumbuso eliza kulawula nokuqhagamshela iindaba eziphambili kunye neendawo zokusebenza ezingonyaka zeminyaka kumasebe angurhulumente kwangonxweme namaKhaladi, kwaye kufuneka libe nesidanga se-NQF 7 kunye neminyaka eyi-8 yamava wokucwangcisa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekile se-NQF level 7 kwezinye zale ndlela zilandelayo: Public Administration/Management, Business Administration, Social Science, Development Studies. Iminyaka eyi-8 yamava kwicwangciso lenkqubo ephambili/nokucwangciswa kweekhandlema zarhulumente nokuhamba phambili/nokucwangcisa iindlela zokusebenza/nokubakho kwamarhulumente nokusetyenziswa kobuchule/nokuphathwa kweerhululumente nemibono yemisebenzi, apho kwiminyaka eyi-5 kuya kuba kwinqanaba eliphezulu lokulawula. Isidanga se-NQF level 8, okwangaphezulu, siya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuqonda okulungileyo ngemiba yolawulo, iindlela zarhulumente zokucwangcisa nengqondo ekubekwa izinto endleleni. Ukuqonda okulungileyo ngarhulumente kumazwe amathathu nakumahlakani aphuhlisayo abasebenza namanye amarhulumente. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yarhulumente (kuquka nemigaqo ye-National Treasury), iinkqubo, iindlela zokulawula izinto, izinto ezisiqhelekizeni, nemicimbi. Ulwazi malunga ne-National Development Plan (NDP) kunye ne-Medium-Term Development Plan nendlela ezisetshenziswa ngayo kumbutho. Amandla okwakha nokulawula ulungelelwaniso olusebenzayo namanye amaziko kumasebe karhulumente nabahlohli bakho bokuxhasa imiphakama nentsapho ekwenzeni izinto ngokudityanisiweyo nangokusebenzisana. Ilungelelwaniso lokuhamba rhoqo. Amandla nemisebenzi: Amandla okulawula kuquka nokulawula abantu nokubakhusela ukuba bakhule, namava ekulawuleni iqela labantu abavela kumacandelo ahlukeneyo. Amandla okunika isalathiso nokuqhatha ekubekweni iindlela ezibalulekileyo. Amandla/amava okwenza indawo enokubakho kwamasiko aphakamileyo ekusebenzeni nasekuphuhlisweni abasebenzi. Amandla okulawula iiprojekthi ezininzi. Amandla aphezulu okuchazana nabantu nokuqhathanisa amagama (abhalwe nokuqulunqwa). Amandla aphakamileyo okuxoxisana ngemigqaliselo nokulawula iingxabano. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuqonda iindlela ezibalulekileyo. Amandla okuyila iindlela zophando nokwahlula iinkqubo. Amandla okulawula iimali nokulawula iiprojekthi/iinkqubo. Amandla alungileyo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ovalekileyo kufuneka abe nenkqondo yokuzimela aze afune ukwenza izinto, abe nokuba yindaba eyakhila, akholelwe kubathengi aze ajonge iimfuno zabo, akhangela iindlela zokusombulula iingxaki aze akwazi ukusebenza kwiimeko ezinxulumene nengxaki.
xh.duties: Ovalekileyo uza kuba nesibophelelo sokwenza izinto ezilandelayo: Ukulawula, ukuqhagamshela nokuxhasa ukuphuhliswa nokugqitywa kweendawo zokucwangcisa iindlela ezibalulekileyo, iindawo zokusebenza ezingonyaka kunye neendawo zokusebenza ngemigqaliselo yokuphuhliswa kwamasebe angurhulumente kwangonxweme namaKhaladi nabahlakani bango-Schedule 3A & 3C ngokungathathi nxaxheba kwemali. Ukulawula, ukuqhagamshela nokwenza okulula ukubika ngemigqaliselo yethatu yoxesha lwangaphakathi, ngokungathathi nxaxheba kwemali, kwamasebe angurhulumente kwangonxweme namaKhaladi nabahlakani bango-Schedule 3A & 3C. Ukulawula ukuphuhliswa, ukulungiswa nokusebenziswa kweenkqubo, iindlela ezisisiseko, amanye amaxwebhu okulawula iindlela namaxwebhu okuxhasa iinkqubo zokucwangcisa iindlela ezibalulekileyo, ukucwangcisa ukusebenza kwangonyaka nokucwangcisa iindlela zokusebenza kumasebe angurhulumente kwangonxweme namaKhaladi nabahlakani bango-Schedule 3A & 3C. Ukulawula, ukuqhagamshela nokwenza okululu ukubakho kwabantu abachaphazela umsebenzi kunye namaziko kwinkqubo yendawo zokucwangcisa iindlela ezibalulekileyo kunye nezinto ezibhalwayo ngonyaka zamasebe angurhulumente kwangonxweme namaKhaladi nabahlakani bango-Schedule 3A & 3C, Ukunikela ngolawulo olungcalile nokuqhatha ekunikezelweni kwemisebenzi engundoqo kunye namancedo anikelwe kwiNdzamsholo yegqebe nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza phakathi kwesebe.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Public Service
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive salary package). The remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within the relevant framework.
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed to coordinate monitoring of government priority programmes, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 8 years of strategic management experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF level 7 qualification in Public Administration, Social Sciences. A Minimum of 8 years in Strategic and Executive Management experience in Human Settlements, Spatial Planning Frameworks of which 5 years must be at senior managerial level. NQF level 8 will be an added advantage A valid drivers-license. A good understanding of political, planning and governance issues. Good understanding of government across the three spheres and partners for development. Knowledge of government prescripts, policies, administrative processes, practices, and programmes. A good understanding of the National Developmental Planning, National Planning Commission (NPC), National Development Plan (NDP) and its implementation processes. Ability to foster and manage effective working arrangements with other centre of government departments and social/development partners to ensure co-ordinated and integrated actions. Willingness to travel on a regular basis. Competencies & Skills: Management skills including people management and empowerment, and experience in managing multi- disciplinary teams. Ability to provide strategic direction and leadership. The ability/experience to create an environment for high performance culture and staff development. Ability to manage multiple projects. Excellent interpersonal & communication skills (written & verbal). Highly developed negotiation and conflict management skills. Strategic and analytical skills. Research and policy analysis skills. Financial management and project/programme management skills. Good computer literacy skills. Personal Attributes: The incumbent must be assertive and self-driven, innovative and creative, client orientated and customer focused, solution orientated and able to work under stressful situations.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for developing, coordinating, facilitating and providing strategic support for the monitoring of the implementation of Priority 3: Building a Capable, Ethical and Developmental State, in alignment with the Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) and the National Development Plan (NDP). The roles include developing intervention strategies and implementation plans to strengthen government performance, as well as coordinating capacity development programmes to promote the effective application of Planning, Monitoring, and Evaluation (PM&E) policies, frameworks, systems, tools and guidelines across government. Key responsibilities include contributing to planning and evaluation activities related to the implementation of national priorities; monitoring the performance and accountability of sector departments and the implementation of Cabinet decisions and remedial actions arising from Priority 3 progress reports; and analysing Strategic Plans; Annual Performance Plans (APPs), and budget allocations to assess alignment with the MTDP and NDP. The incumbent will provide strategic technical advice and support to political principals, executive management and governance structures on matters relating to planning, monitoring, evaluation and institutional performance. The role further entails developing and enhancing government–wide monitoring, reporting tools, systems and guidelines to strengthen evidence-based planning, performance monitoring and accountability across the public sector. The incumbent will coordinate national and international partnerships to advance PM&E policy, capacity development knowledge-sharing, thereby contributing to the professionalisation of the public service and the strengthening of a capable, ethical and developmental state. The position also requires effective leadership, people management and oversight of managers within the immediate span of control to ensure the achievement of organisational objectives.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Openbare Diens
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur benodig om die monitering van regeringsprioriteitsprogramme te koördineer, met 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 8 jaar se strategiese bestuurservaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie, Sosiale Wetenskappe. 'n Minimum van 8 jaar se strategiese en uitvoerende bestuurservaring in Menslike Nedersettings, Ruimtelike Beplanningsraamwerke waarvan 5 jaar op senior bestuursvlak moet wees. NQF-vlak 8 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Goeie begrip van politieke, beplannings- en bestuursake. Goeie begrip van regering oor die drie sfeer en vennote vir ontwikkeling. Kennis van regeringsvoorskrifte, beleide, administratiewe prosesse, praktyke en programme. 'n Goeie begrip van Nasionale Ontwikkelingsbeplanning, die National Planning Commission (NPC), die National Development Plan (NDP) en die implementeringsprosesse daarvan. Vermoë om effektiewe werkreëlings met ander sentrums van regeringsdepartemente en sosiale/ontwikkelingsvennote te bevorder en te bestuur om gekoördineerde en geïntegreerde optrede te verseker. Bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis. Bevoegdhede en vaardighede: Bestuursvaardighede, insluitend mensebestuur en bemagtiging, en ervaring in die bestuur van multidissiplinêre spanne. Vermoë om strategiese rigting en leierskap te verskaf. Die vermoë/ervaring om 'n omgewing vir 'n hoëprestasiekultuur en personeelontwikkeling te skep. Vermoë om veelvuldige projekte te bestuur. Uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Hoogs ontwikkelde onderhandeling- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Strategiese en analitiese vaardighede. Navorsings- en beleidsanalisevaardighede. Finansiële bestuurs- en projek/programbestuursvaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Die ampsdraer moet beslis en selfgedrewe wees, innoverend en kreatief, kliëntgerig en op die klant gefokus, oplossingsgerig en in staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die ontwikkeling, koördinering, fasilitering en verskaffing van strategiese ondersteuning vir die monitering van die implementering van Prioriteit 3: Building a Capable, Ethical and Developmental State, in ooreenstemming met die Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) en die National Development Plan (NDP). Die rolle sluit in die ontwikkeling van intervensiestrategieë en implementeringsplanne om regeringsprestasie te versterk, asook die koördinering van kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprogramme om die effektiewe toepassing van Planning, Monitoring, and Evaluation (PM&E)-beleide, -raamwerke, -stelsels, -instrumente en -riglyne oor die hele regering te bevorder. Sleutelverantwoordelikhede sluit in bydraes tot beplannings- en evalueringaktiwiteite wat verband hou met die implementering van nasionale prioriteite; die monitering van die prestasie en verantwoordelikheid van sektordepartemente en die implementering van Kabinetsbesluite en remediërende optrede voortspruitend uit Prioriteit 3-voortgangsverslae; en die ontleed van Strategic Plans, Annual Performance Plans (APPs), en begrotingstoekenning om ooreenstemming met die MTDP en NDP te assesseer. Die ampsdraer sal strategiese tegniese advies en ondersteuning aan politieke principe, uitvoerende bestuur en bestuursstrukture verskaf oor sake rakende beplanning, monitering, evaluering en institusionele prestasie. Die rol behels verder die ontwikkeling en verbetering van regeringsbreë monitering, verslagdoeningsinstrumente, stelsels en riglyne om getuienisgebaseerde beplanning, prestasiemonitering en verantwoordelikheid oor die openbare sektor te versterk. Die ampsdraer sal nasionale en internasionale vennootskappe koördineer om PM&E-beleid, kapasiteitsontwikkeling en kennisdeling te bevorder, en sodoende by te dra tot die professionalisering van die openbare diens en die versterking van 'n bekwame, etiese en ontwikkelingsgerigte staat. Die pos benodig ook effektiewe leierskap, mensebestuur en toesig oor bestuurders binne die onmiddellike span van beheer om die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte te verseker.

zu.title: Umqondisi Ohola: I-Public Service
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMqondisi Ohola ozoqondisa ukulandelwa kwemiklamo ebalulekile kahulumeni, okudinga iziqu ze-NQF 7 neminyaka eyi-8 yamava obuphathi bokuhlakanipha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-NQF level 7 ku-Public Administration, Social Sciences. Ubuncwane beminyaka eyi-8 yamava obuqotho bokuphatha nokuba ngabaholi abakhulu ku-Human Settlements, Spatial Planning Frameworks okuyiminyaka eyi-5 kuyo kumele ibe ngazinga lokuphatha abaphakeme. I-NQF level 8 izoba yinzululwazi. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethathwa njengesemthethweni. Ukuqonda kahle izinto ezihlobene nezopolitiki, ukweluleka kanye nobusikhulumi. Ukuqonda kahle kahulumeni kuzona zonke izindawo ezintathu kanye nabalingani bokuthuthukiswa. Ulwazi ngemithetho kahulumeni, izinqubomgomo, inqubo yokuphathwa kwezokwaziswa, izindlela, namaklamo. Ukuqonda kahle i-National Developmental Planning, i-National Planning Commission (NPC), i-National Development Plan (NDP) kanye nenqubo yayo yokuphumeza. Ikono lokwakha nokulawula izinhlela zokusebenza ezisebenzayo nabanye emnyangweni kahulumeni kanye nabalingani bezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe izenzo eziqhutshwa ndawonye. Ukuzethemba ekuhambeni kanjalo njalo. Amandla nobugciko: Amandla okuphatha okuhlanganisa ukuphatha abantu nokubasiza ukuziphakamisa, namava ekuphatheni amaqembu ahlukene. Ikono lokunika isiqondiso sokuhlakanipha nokuqondisa. Ikono/amava wokwakusa isimo sokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ikono lokuphatha imiklamo eminingi. Amandla amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuvezwa ngomlomo). Amandla aphezulu okuxoxisana nokuphatha izinkinga. Amandla okuhlakanipha nokuhlaziya. Amandla lokucwaninga nokuhlaziya izinqubomgomo. Amandla okuphatha imali kanye nokuphatha imiklamo/izinhlelo. Amandla amahle okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izinto zobuqu: Lowo othathwa kulesi sikhundla kumele azime ngqo aze azigqugquzele, abe nomoya wokwakha okusha, aqonde ngokubhekise kubathengi, aze aqonde nangokuxazulula izinkinga akwazi ukusebenza emimeni ebangela ukucindezeleka.
zu.duties: Lowo othathwa kulesi sikhundla uzobe unesibopho sokuthuthukisa, ukuqondisa, ukweseka kanye nokunika inkxaso ebuqotho bokulandela ukuphumezwa kwe-Priority 3: Building a Capable, Ethical and Developmental State, ngokuvumelana ne-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) kanye ne-National Development Plan (NDP). Imisebenzi ihlanganisa ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokungena kanye namapulani wokuphumeza ukuze kwenhke ukusebenza kahulumeni, kanye noqondiso wemiklamo yokuthuthukiswa ikhono ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwamapulani, ukulandela, kanye nokuhlola izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo, amasistimu, amathuluzi kanye nomhlahlandlela kahulumeni wonke. Izibopho eziyisisekelo zihlanganisa ukunikela ngokweluleka nokuhlola imisebenzi ehlobene nokuphumeza izidingo ezingxenyeni; ukulandela ukusebenza kanye nekhono lezinyanga zomnyango kanye nokuphumeza izinqumo ze-Cabinet kanye nezinye izenzo zokulungisa eziphuma emibikweni ye-Priority 3; kanye nokuhlaziya amapulani e-strategic; amapulani okusebenza ngonyaka (APPs), kanye nabelo emali ukuze kuhlolwe ukuvumelana ne-MTDP kanye ne-NDP. Lowo othathwa kulesi sikhundla uzobe unika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ebuqotho kanye nokweseka abaholi abezopolitiki, abaphathi abakhulu kanye nezakhiwo zokubusa ngemayelana nokuqamba, ukulandela, ukuhlola kanye nokusebenza kwezikhungo. Lomsebenzi futhi uhilela ukuthuthukisa kanye nokwenza amathuluzi okulandela, okubika, amasistimu kanye nomhlahlandlela kahulumeni wonke ukuze kwenhke ukweluleka okusekelwe ubufakazi, ukulandela ukusebenza kanye nekhono kulo lonke iqembu lomphakathi. Lowo othathwa kulesi sikhundla uzobe eqondisa ubudlelwano bomkhakha namazwe ngamazwe ukuze kusukumelwe inkxaso ye-PM&E, ukuthuthukiswa kwekhano ngokwabelana kolwazi, ngaleyo ndlela enegalelo ekubeni ngabantu abakhulu ku-Public Service kanye nokuqinisa izwe elinamakhono, elithembekile elithuthukisayo. Lomsebenzi futhi udinga ukuphatha okusebenzayo, ukuphatha abantu kanye nokuqaphela abaphathi abangaphakathi kubandla eliseduze ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza imigomo yenhlangano.

xh.title: Iphini leGqeba: Inkonzo kaRhulumente
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iPhini leGqeba eliya kulungelelanisa ulwazi lweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo kurhulumente, kwaye kufuneka babe nesidanga se-NQF 7 namava eminyaka eli-8 ekulawulen izigqibo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF level 7 kwi-Public Administration, Social Sciences. Iminyaka elingu-8 ubuncinane emave enkululeko ngokwezigqibo nolawulo oluphezulu kwi-Human Settlements, Spatial Planning Frameworks apho iminyaka emi-5 kuyo ibe ngowesimo sokulawula abaphathi abaphezulu. Isidanga se-NQF level 8 siza kuba yoncedo olongezelelweyo; Ifayile yelayisensi yokushaya. Ukuqonda okuhle kwemiba ezopolitiko, ekuqwalaselweni kwendlalo nokulawulwa kwezomphakathikomzi. Ukuqonda okuhle kurhulumente kumacandelo amathathu nabahlobana nawo ukulungelelanisa inkuthazo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo ezichanekileyo, neenkqubo kurhulumente. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokuqwalaselwa kwendlalo yokuveliswa kwezizwe, i-National Planning Commission (NPC), i-National Development Plan (NDP) nendlela ezenzwayo. Ikhono lokuxhasa nokuqamba iindlela zokusebenza ezingagqibekanga kunye namanye amasebe eziko karhulumente kunye nabahlobana nendalo yentlalo/inkqubo yokulungelelanisa izenzo. Ulwelo lokuhamba rhoqo. Iikhompetensi & Amakhono: Amakhono okulawula aquka ukulawula abantu nokuzinika amandla, namava ekulawulebeni amaqela abantu abavela kumacandelo ahlukeneyo. Ikhono lokubonelela ngengqondo ebona ikamva nolawulo. Ikhono/amava okwakha endawo enkqubo yenkqubo yemisebenzi ephezulu nophuhliso lwabasebenzi. Ikhono lokulawula iiprojekthi ezininzi. Amakhono aphuculileyo okuxhumana & athetha (ebhalweyo & ethethwayo). Amakhono aphuculileyo okuxoxisana ngemigudu nokulawula iingxabano. Amakhono okubona ikamva nokuhlalutya. Amakhono okuphanda nokuhlalutya iinkqubo-zomgaqo. Amakhono okulawula iimali nokulawula iiprojekthi/iinkqubo. Amakhono amakhulu ekusebenzisen ikhompyutha. Iimpawu zobuntu: Isikhululi kufuneka sibe sinesibindi sibethe ngqo, sibe namandla okuzidla, sibe nesithembu esitsha esinomdla wokuyila, sibe nomdla nakumaxhaga, sibe nolwazi lokusombulula iingxaki sibe nakho ukusebenza kunye ne meko ezinzima zengqondo.
xh.duties: Isikhululi siza kuba ngumnikeli wophuhliso, ulungelelaniso, lwenkxaso-migaqo yolwazi lweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo ezithi Priority 3: Building a Capable, Ethical and Developmental State, ezihambelana ne-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) ne-National Development Plan (NDP). Iminikelo ibandakanya ukuyiwa kweekharityule ezizama ukuxhasa urhulumente, kunye nokuqamba iinkqubo ezilandela ukuphuhliswa kwamandla okulawula urhulumente ukuze kube khona ukuqgqiba kweenkqubo zokuqwalasela, ulwazi, nokuqwalasela iinkqubo (PM&E) kunye nendlela yokulawula iinkqubo kurhulumente. Iminikelo ephawulekayo ibandakanya inkxaso-migaqo nakwingxoxo ngokuqwalasela nokuguqulela izigqibo kurhulumente; ulwazi ngemisebenzi nobuncinane bamasebe urhulumente nolwazi lwezigqibo ze-Cabinet nendlela ezisombululwa ngayo iingxaki ezivela kwiinkqubo ze-Priority 3; ukuhlalutya iinkqubo zobuso; iinkqubo zoNyaka wokuQwalasela uPhumelelo (APPs), kunye nokwabiwa kweemali ukuze kubonwe ukuba zihambelana njani ne-MTDP ne-NDP. Isikhululi siza kunika ingcebiso yobuchwephetshe ngokwemigaqo ninkxaso kubaphathi bomgaqo, kolawulo oluphezulu nemiqathango kahulumente mayelana nokuqwalasela, ulwazi, ukuhlalutya nokusebenza kolawulo. Umsebenzi ubandakanya ukuyiwa nokuphucula iindlela zolwazi lwesizwe ngokubanzi, iindawo zokubhala iingxelo, iinkqubo neendlela zolawulo ukuze kwandise ukusebenza kolwazi olusetyenziswa ngokwemigaqo nokubuzwa iimbuzo kwindalo yoluntu. Isikhululi siza kwenza ulungelelaniso lwamanxibelelaniso karhulumente nangamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kuphuhliswe iinkqubo-migaqo ze-PM&E, ulwazi malunga nophuhliso lwamandla, ngaloo ndlela luncede ekubeni gqiba ubugcisa benkonzo yoluntu nokuba ngummandla olungelelanisa urhulumente oqinileyo. Esi sikhundla sifuna ukuba kubekho ukulawula okuchanekileyo, ukulawula abantu nokuqwalasela abaphathi abangaphakathi kwesikhundla sokulawula ukuze kuphume izigqibo zoluntu.
