NQF level 8 sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Goed begrip van politieke, beplannings- en bestuursake. 'n Goed begrip van die regering oor die drie sfere en vennote vir ontwikkeling. Kennis van regeringsvoorskrifte, beleide, administratiewe prosesse, praktyke en programme. 'n Goeie begrip van die National Development Plan (NDP) en die implementeringsprosesse daarvan. Vermoë om effektiewe werkreëlings met ander sentrale regeringsdepartemente en sosiale/ontwikkelingsvennote te bevorder en te bestuur om gekoördineerde en geïntegreerde optrede te verseker. Bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis. Bevoegdhede en vaardighede: Bestuursvaardighede, insluitend mensebestuur en bemagtiging, en ervaring in die bestuur van multidissiplinêre spanne. Vermoë om strategiese rigting en leierskap te bied. Die vermoë/ervaring om 'n omgewing vir 'n hoëprestasiekultuur en personeelontwikkeling te skep. Vermoë om veelvuldige projekte te bestuur. Uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Hoogs ontwikkelde onderhandelings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Strategiese en analitiese vaardighede. Navorsings- en beleidsanalisevaardighede. Finansiële bestuurs- en projek/programbestuursvaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Die ampsdraer moet selfversekerd en selfgedrewe wees, innoverend en kreatief, kliëng gerig en kunde gefokus, oplossingsgerig en in staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees om kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprogramme met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes te lei en te koördineer ten einde regeringsbreë Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering (BM&E)-stelsels, instellings-BM&E-stelsels en individuele BM&E-kapasiteit te versterk in ooreenstemming met die Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) en die National Development Plan (NDP). Verskaf strategiese leierskap rakende BM&E-kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprogramme om openbare-sektorinstellings te ondersteun om hul instellingsmonitering te versterk. Verskaf BM&E-tegniese adviseringsteun om regeringsbreë monitering-, evaluerings- en verslagdoeningstelsels te versterk. Koördineer vennootskappe vir BM&E-opleiding en -kapasiteitsontwikkeling om by te dra tot die bou van 'n Bevoegde, Etiese en ontwikkelingsgerigte staat. Bestuur van belanghebbendes/vennootskappe om uiteenlopende vaardighede en kundigheid te benut wat vereis word om BM&E-praktisyne te professionaliseer. Verskaf professionele bestuur en leierskap ten opsigte van die verskaffing van die kernfunksies en -dienste wat aan die pos toegeken is.

zu.title: Ochwepheshe Ophakeme Wokuthuthukisa Ikhono
zu.summary: okuqondisa futhi kucoorde amaphrogramu wokuthuthukisa ikhono ukuze kwandiswa izinhlelo zokuqamba, ukulawula nokuhlola imephu kwawo wonke amahhovimenti eDepartment of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esifanele sika NQF level 7 kwi-Public Administration/Management, Human Resource Development. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-8 yama-experience ekuthuthukiseni, ekusetshenziseni nasekuhloleni i-framework policy ye-Planning Monitoring and Evaluation (PME) kanye nemikhakha ehlobene nokuthuthukisa ikhono okuyi-strategies, lapho eminyakeni eyi-5 kumele ibe ngu-Middle/Senior Managerial Level. I-NQF level 8 izoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuqonda okuhle mayelana nezindaba zezombusazwe, zokuqamba kanye nokuphathwa kwezwe. Ukuqonda okuhle kahhulumeni kuzono zintathu kanye nabalingani bokuthuthukiswa. Ulwazi ngemithetho kahulumeni, izinhlelo-mthetho, inqubo yobuso, izinkalo, kanye namaphrogramu. Ukuqonda okuhle i-National Development Plan (NDP) kanye nokuqondiswa kwayo. Ukukwazi ukukhuthaza futhi ulawule izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo kwezinye izigaba zamahhovimenti kahhulumeni namalingani abathuthukisa/bezenhlalakahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe izenzo ezicoordekiwe ne-hlanganisiwe. Ukuzithoba ukuvakasha njalo. Amakhono kanye ne-Skills: Amakhono okuphatha okuhlanganisa nokuphatha abantu nokunika amandla, kanye noma-experience ekuphatheni amathimu ahlangene kakhulu. Ukukwazi ukunikeza isiqondiso se-strategy kanye ne-leadership. Ukukwazi noma/experience yokudala isimo somphakathi we-high performance kanye nokuqhuba amalungu. Ukukwazi ukuphatha amaphrojekthi amaningi. Amakhono okuxhumana nokuthetha (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa) aphezulu kakhulu. Amakhono okuxoxisana nokuphatha izinkinga aqhutshwa kakhulu. Amakhono e-strategy kanye nokuqagela. Amakhono e-research kanye nokuqagela policies. Amakhono okuphatha imali kanye nokuphatha amaphrojekthi/amaphrogramu. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha ahle kakhulu. Izakhiwo zomuntu: Umphathi kumele abe ukuzimisela ngokwakhe futhi aziphemeshe, abe yisihhoboki nodwebi, ajwayele ukusebenza kwabathengi futhi afune ukwenzela abathengi, afune izixazululo futhi akwazi ukusebenza emazweni anezinkinga.
zu.duties: Umphathi uzobe nesibopho sokuqonda futhi acoorde amaphrogramu wokuthuthukisa ikhano kubalingani abangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisiswe isistimu yokuqamba, ukulawula kanye nokuhlola (PM&E) kahhulumeni wonke, isistimu ye-PM&E yesikhungo kanye nankhono ye-PM&E yomuntu ngamunye ngokuhambisana ne-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) kanye ne-National Development Plan (NDP). Nikeza i-leadership ye-strategy kwamaphrogramu wokuthuthukisa ikhono i-PM&E ukuze uxhase izikhungo zabantu bonke ukuze ziqinise isistimu yawo yokuqaphela nokulawula. Nikeza inkxaso yengcebiso yobuchwepheshe i-PM&E ukuze kuqinisiswe isistimu kahhulumeni yokuqaphela, ukulawula nokubika. Qondisa ubudlelwano bokusebenza kakhanye nokuthuthukisa ikhano i-PM&E ukuze kufake isandla ekuakheni i-capable, ethical and developmental state. Ukuphatha abalingano/bubungani bokusebenza ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhali ezahlukene kanye nolwazi okudingeka ukuba abasebenzi be-PM&E bagxile kwimikhakha yobuchwepheshe. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwezobuchwepheshe ne-leadership maqondana nokunikezwa kwezinkalo ezinhlo kanye nezinsiza ezabelwe isikhundla.

xh.title: Uchwepheshe Ophakamileyo Wophuhliso Lwamakhono
xh.summary: Qhuba uhlele inkqubo yophuhliso lwamakhono kunye nokuyinika isikhokelo ukuze zomeleze iinkqubo zolwezicwangciso, lokwenza isalathiso noluhlaziyo kuyo yonke irhulumente kwi Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF level 7 kwilungelo loPhando loRhulumente/LoLawulo, okanye uPhuhliso Lwamabele Abantu. Uqobo Lolwazi olungungenwa ngaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-8 ekuyileni, ekuqhubeni nasekwenzeni isalathiso koluhlelo lwezicwangciso lokwenza isalathiso noluhlaziyo (PME) nemigaqo eluhambelanayo namanqanaba ophuhliso lwamakhono, apho iminyaka eyi-5 kufuneka ibe ngumqeqeshi ongumphakathi wolawulo ophakathi/ophezulu. Isidanga se-NQF level 8 siza kuba yinxaxheba eongezelelweyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukuqonda okulungileyo ngemiba yezopolitiko, ezicwangcisoni nolawulo. Ukuqonda okulungileyo kurhulumente kuzo zontsi iindawo ezintathu nababalinganiswa ekuphuhliseni. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yerhulumente, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo, iindlela namaprojekthi. Ukuqonda okulungileyo iNational Development Plan (NDP) neenkqubo zokuyiphumeza. Ukuba nakho ukudala ulawulo olusebenzayo kunye nokululawula nabanye kwisebe leziko karhulumente kunye nababalinganiswa bokuhlaziywa komphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinto ezihlelweyo nezinamanqanaba. Ukulungele ukuhamba rhoqo. Amandla nomakhono: Amakhono olawulo aquka ulawulo labantu nokuzinika amandla, nolwazi ekulawuleni iinqwemqam ezinamasiko amaninzi. Ukuba nakho ukunikela isikhokelo ngokobuchwepheshe nokuqonda. Amandla/ulwazi lokwenza indawo enolwazi lokusebenza ngamandla amakhulu nophuhliso abasebenzi. Ukuba nakho ukulawula amaprojekthi amaninzi. Amakhono aphakamileyo okuziqhelanisa nokunxibelelwana (awabhalwayo nawathethwayo). Amakhono aphakamileyo okuxoxisana nokuqonda ukulawula iingxabano. Amakhono obuchule nokuhlaziya. Amakhono okuphanda nokuhlaziya iinkqubo. Amakhono olawulo lemali nolawulo lwaprojekthi/inkqubo. Amakhono amabalwe ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iimpawu zobuntu: Umntu ogcwele le sithuba kufuneka abe nesibindi aze azityhale phambili, abe nomhlwa wokuyila, akhangele iimfuno zabathengi, aze ajonge iindlela ezisombulula iingxaki, akwaze nokuba nakho ukusebenza kwiimeko ezinzima.
xh.duties: Umntu ogcwele le sithuba uza kuba nogunya lokuba ngumlawuli-nxiba-nxaxheba kinkqubo yophuhliso lwamakhono kunye nabalinganiswa bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze zomeleze iinkqubo zolwezicwangciso, lokwenza isalathiso noluhlaziyo (PM&E) kurhulumente wonke, iinkqubo ze-PM&e zeendawo zolawulo namandla e-PM&E omnthu ngamnye ngokwemigaqo yeMedium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) neNational Development Plan (NDP). Nika isikhokelo ngokobuchwepheshe kumaprojekthi ophuhliso lwamakhono be-PM&E ukuze axhase iindawo zorhulumente zoluntu ukuba zomeleze isalathiso lwazo olusendaweni yolawulo. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ye-PM&E ukomeleza iinkqubo zoluntu zokwenza isalathiso, ukuhlaziya nokubika. Langela ubudlelwane bokuya kwisikolo nophuhliso lwamakhono be-PM&E ukuze incede ekwakheni irhulumente enamandla, ethembekileyo nophuhliso. Ulawulo Lobudlelwano/Babalinganiswa ukuze kuthwetshelwe amakhono ahlukeneyo nolwazi olufunekayo ukuba ngabantu abangabachwepheshe be-PM&E. Nikeza ulawulo lobuchwepheshe nokuqonda ngokwemigaqo yemisebenzi nesezibonelelo ezinikiwe kule sithuba.

jobs.title: Head of the Office of the Director-general
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive salary package). The remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within the relevant framework.
jobs.summary: Lead the Office of the Director-General at the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation, coordinating executive and administrative support services in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor's Degree/ Advanced Diploma qualification NQF 7 in Public Administration/ Office Management as recognised by SAQA, with at least five 5 years’ experiences at Middle/Senior Managerial level in rendering administrative and executive office support. Experience in the office of an Executive Manager will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of public Service Regulations, policies and procedures. Working knowledge of the functioning of National, Provincial and Local Government. Financial Management and Financial Directives. Knowledge of Project Management. Knowledge of Administrative Systems and Minute Taking. Competencies and Skills: Strategic capacity and leadership; Programme and Project management; Financial management; Change Management; Knowledge Management; Service Delivery Innovation (SDI); Problem solving and analysis; People management and empowerment; Client orientation and customer focus; Communication skills; Honesty and integrity.
jobs.duties: To manage and coordinate the provisioning of executive and administrative support services to the Director-General and the Department, and sustain good working relationship with all internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective flow of information inside and outside of the Department. This involves conducting research, analyse information and compile complex documents for the DG and scrutinise documents to determine actions/ information/ and/or documents required. Providing an effective and efficient strategic administrative support to the DG, compile the agenda of meetings chaired by the DG and ensure circulation of accompanying memorandum. Co-ordinate and liaise with internal and external strategic alliances and stakeholders between the Office of the DG and other stakeholders to ensure integration of programmes. Provide strategic management and leadership in respect of the core functions and services assigned to the DG’s Office.
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent to Recruitment23@dpme.gov.za OTHER POST
jobs.notes: The relevant reference number must be quoted on all applications. The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement and will be required to undergo a security clearance. Applications must be submitted on a signed Z83 accompanied by a comprehensive CV only specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applicants will be required to meet vetting requirements as prescribed by Minimum Information Security Standards. The DPME is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) Failure to submit the above information will result in the application not being considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Note that correspondence will only be conducted with the short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by DPME. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks will be conducted once they are short-listed and the appointment is also subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. For salary levels 11 to 15, the inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The DPME reserves the right to utilise practical exercises/tests for non-SMS positions during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). The DPME also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details      can   be     sourced        by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates are required to use the new Z83 (Application for employment) that is implemented with effect from 1 January 2021. A copy can be downloaded on the website of the Department of Public Service & Administration (DPSA) at www.dpsa.gov.za MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoof van die Kantoor van die Direkteur-generaal
af.summary: Lei die Kantoor van die Direkteur-generaal by die Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation en koördineer uitvoerende en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad/ Gevorderde Diploma-kwalifikasie NQF 7 in Openbare Administrasie/ Kantoorbestuur soos erken deur SAQA, met ten minste vyf 5 jaar se ervaring op Middle/Senior Managerial-vlak in die lewering van administratiewe en uitvoerende kantoorondersteuning. Ervaring in die kantoor van 'n uitvoerende bestuurder sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Openbare Diensregulasies, beleide en prosedures. Werkskennis van die funksionering van Nasionale, Provinciale en Plaaslike Regering. Finansiële Bestuur en Finansiële Direktiewe. Kennis van Projekbestuur. Kennis van Administratiewe Stelsels en Notule. Bevoegdhede en Vaardighede: Strategiese kapasiteit en leierskap; Program- en projekbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Kennisbestuur; Diensleweringinnovansie (SDI); Probleemoplossing en analise; Mensebestuur en bemagtiging; Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus; Kommunikasievaardighede; Eerlikheid en integriteit.
af.duties: Om die verskaffing van uitvoerende en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die Direkteur-generaal en die departement te bestuur en te koördineer, en goeie werksverhoudings met alle interne en eksterne belanghebbendes te handhaaf om doeltreffende vloei van inligting binne en buite die departement te verseker. Dit behels die uitvoer van navorsing, analise van inligting en samestelling van komplekse dokumente vir die DG, en die ondersoek van dokumente om aksies/ inligting/ en/of dokumente wat vereis word, te bepaal. Verskaffing van doeltreffende en doelmatige strategiese administratiewe ondersteuning aan die DG, samestelling van die agenda van vergaderings wat deur die DG voorgesit word, en sirkulasie van vergeselskapende memorandum verseker. Koördineer en skakel met interne en eksterne strategiese alliansies en belanghebbendes tussen die Kantoor van die DG en ander belanghebbendes om integrasie van programme te verseker. Verskaf strategiese bestuur en leierskap ten opsigte van die kernfunksies en -dienste wat aan die Kantoor van die DG toegewys is.

zu.title: Uhlelo leNhloko leOfisi kaMqondisi-Jikelele
zu.summary: Qondisa iOfisi kaMqondisi-Jikelele e-Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation, uhlele inkusezelasi yesikhulu esiphezulu nesezinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwezomsebenzi e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree/ Advanced Diploma ezifanele e-NQF 7 ku-Public Administration/ Office Management njengoba kunikwa isiqiniseko ngu-SAQA, nomuzwa ongungenwa ongaphansi kwamahlanu 5 eminyakeni emisebenzi ezingeni loMphathi oPhakathi/Phezulu ekunikeleni ngesekelo lezinsizakalo ezomdayisini nezofisi. Ukuqashelwa isipho esingeziwe ukuba nomuzwa emsebenzini wezinsizakalo zokuphathwa eNqandweni yesikhulu esiphezulu. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubo namacebo asebenza kulo Nyango lomphakathi. Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngendlela asebenza ngayo i-National, Provincial kanye ne-Local Government. Ukuphathwa kweMali kanye Neziyalezo zezezimali. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwe-Project Management. Ulwazi ngamaphulatifomu okuphathwa kwezomsebenzi kanye nokubhala amaminithi. Ikhono namakhono: Ikhono lezokususa inkinga nokuhlaziya; Ikhono lokuphathwa kwe-Project nama-Project; Ukuphathwa kweMali; Ukuphathwa okushintshayo; Ukuphathwa kolwazi; Iqhaza elitsha lokulethwa kwensizakalo (SDI); Ikhono lokususa inkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisekiswa; Ukujwayela amakhasimodi nokuqondiswa kumakhasimodi; Ikhono lokuxhumana; Ukwethembeka nokuzithiba.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha kanye nohlela lokunikezwa kwesekelo ezinsizakalo ezinhleko zokuphathwa ezinkulu nezomsebenzi kuMqondisi-Jikelele nakuNyango, futhi zigcine ubuhlobo obuhle bomsebenzi kubo bonke abahlanganyeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqiniseke ukugeleza okuhlakaniphile kolwazi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweNyango. Lokhu kuqukethe ukuhlola, ukuhlaziya ulwazi, ukutholakala kolwazi abaludingako, nokuhlolwa kwamafayela ukuze kutholwe imibhalo/ ulwazi/ noma okunye okudingekayo ukwenza izinqumo. Nikela ngobugeke obuhlakaniphile obusebenzayo bokuphathwa okunamandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo ebalulekile ihlelwa ngokushesha ngemuva kokuhlinzekwa kolwazi oluyinhloso mayelana nokususwa kwezimali ezingekho ezinhle abaganga kubonakaliswa ngokuthi izinkomba zokuqinisekiswa kwezimali abalengezwayo kubhalwe ngokushesha; nokuhlolwa kwamafayela ukuze kutholwe imibhalo/ ulwazi/ kanye noma imibhalo edingekayo. Nikela ngobugeke obuhlakaniphile obusebenzayo bokuphathwa ku-DG, hlela ohlelweni lwezinsizakalo abazitholayo abantu abangamkhokheli futhi uqinisekise ukutholakala kwezindlu ezenziwayo ezingamakhono ezetha ukuxazulula imibhalo abafuna ukuba ize ibhalwe ngokuhlelekile; nokuhlolwa kwemibhalo ukuze kutholwe izenzo/ ulwazi/ futhi noma imibhalo edingekayo. Inikela ngobugeke obuhlakaniphile obusebenzayo obuhlelelekile lokuphathwa ngokomthetho ku-DG, hlela ihlela lomzimba ngokuhleleka komhlela ophethwe yi-DG kanye no-Senior Management Service (SMS) nokunikezwa ngokuhleleka kwezinkomba zemibhalo ekuqinisweni esibekiwe. Hlela kanye noxhumo nabahlanganyeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nohlelo abahlela abakhokhelwa ibhizinisi elihlezi elingeniswa abantu abaningi abahlukene; xhumanisa nabahlanganyeli bangaphandle balawula imigomo futhi uhlele amaphrojekthi aphakathi nendawo enkulu yezomnotho ukuthuthukiswa kwazo ngokushesha kwezokunakekelwa kwabahleli; futhi uhlele izingqinamba nezingxoxo kulo lonke uhlelo. Nikela ngabakho ukuphatha ngokobuhlanela kanye nobukhosi bokuhleleka kwemisebenzi eyinhloko kanye nezinsizakalo abazinikelayo ohlelweni luka-DG.

xh.title: Umphathi weOfisi kaMongameli-Jikelele
xh.summary: Qhubeza iOfisi kaMongameli-Jikelele kwisebe leZolungelelwaniso, lokuQhathanisa nokuLinganisa iziphumo ePretoria, ngokulungelelanisa iinkonzo zolawulo nentshekelo yolawulo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor's Degree/ Advanced Diploma esifanelekileyo NQF 7 kwiNtongo kaRhulumente/ uQhatho lweOfisi njengokwamkelwa yiSAQA, noko ubume obungaphantsi kweyure ezingamashumi amahlanu 5 zeminyaka kwinqanaba loPhathi oPhakathi/ oPhezulu ekuboneleleni ngenkxaso yolawulo nentshekelo yolawulo. Uluvo kwezomthetho kunye namava kwiofisi kaPhathi oLawulayo kuya kubakho nzuzo eongezelekileyo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngeziNgqungqutha zeNkonzo kaRhulumente, iinkqubo kunye neendlela zokwenza izinto. Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngendlela ezisebenza ngayo iRhulumente leSizwe, leSifunda nakoWenginqangi. uQhatho lweMali nokuQhathwa kweMali. Ulwazi loQhatho lweeProjekthi. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zoLawulo nokuThathwa kweMiminithi. Ikhono kunye namava: Isakhono sokuba namandla okulawula nokuqhubeza; uQhatho lweeProjekthi nakwiinkqubo; uQhatho lweMali; uLawulo lokuTshintsha; uQhatho lweLwazi; iNkonzo yoQhayisela entsha (SDI); ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqhathanisa; uLawulo nabantu nokuBakhukulisa; uQhatho kumxhasi nokuqwalasela iindwendwe; izakhulo zokuThetha; uQinisileyo nengqiqo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuqamanisa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zentshekelo yolawulo nentshekelo yolawulo kwaMongameli-Jikelele nakwisebe, zigcinelwe ubudlelwane obulungileyo bokusebenza nabo bonke abathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuya kolwazi okusebenzayo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesebe. Oku kuquka ukwenza uphononongo, ukuhlalutywa kolwazi nokuqokelela amaxwebhu anzima ukwenzela uMongameli-Jikelele kuqwalaselwe amaxwebhu ukuze kumnikwe isigqibo/ ulwazi/ nakho okanye amaxwebhu afunekayo. Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yolawulo olubuzayo obusebenzayo nasebenzayo kwaMongameli-Jikelele, qokelela isihloko sewhethu yemiqulu eqhutywa nguMongameli-Jikelele uze uqinisekise ukusasazwa kwemowudi ehambele phambili. Qamanisa uze uxhume nabaphathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle ababuzayo phakathi kweOfisi kaMongameli-Jikelele nabanye abathathi-nxaxheba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukudityaniswa kweenkqubo. Bonelela ngolawulo olubuzayo nokuqhubeza ngokomsebenzi ongundoqo nengeenkonzo ezinikiweyo kwiOfisi kaMongameli-Jikelele.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Presidential Hotline
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for the Presidential Hotline in Pretoria, requiring a relevant tertiary qualification and three years of experience in monitoring, data analytics, or administration.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (\NQF 6\) in the area of National Diploma / Degree in Public Administration/ Communications, Developmental Studies/ Humanities/ Data Analytics or related fields with at least 3 years’ relevant experience in Experience in the Monitoring and Evaluation, data analytics, project management environment and/or administrative experience and/or Customer care. A good understanding of government policies, M&E and logging of cases. Competencies/Skills: The ideal candidate should possess well developed report writing skills, research methodology and analytical skills, sound knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (including Excel and Power Point) should produce good quality work, be reliable and take initiative. Should have good interpersonal relations and communication skills, should be flexible and have the ability to work with a team Personal attribute: The incumbent must be assertive and self-driven, client orientated, customer focused, solution orientated and able to work under stressful situations and the ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible to support Presidential Hotline Directorate in ensuring good quality logging of cases, effective monitoring and support to departments and provinces and support the research, knowledge management and communications functions. Management of case logging and tracking function. Manage and track complaints referred to national departments and provinces (Stakeholders). Manage research & knowledge management and communications. Project and administration support.
jobs.applications: can be sent to Recruitment30@dpme.gov.za
jobs.notes: The relevant reference number must be quoted on all applications. The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement and will be required to undergo a security clearance. Applications must be submitted on a signed Z83 accompanied by a comprehensive CV only specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applicants will be required to meet vetting requirements as prescribed by Minimum Information Security Standards. The DPME is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) Failure to submit the above information will result in the application not being considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Note that correspondence will only be conducted with the short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by DPME. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks will be conducted once they are short-listed and the appointment is also subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. For salary levels 11 to 15, the inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The DPME reserves the right to utilise practical exercises/tests for non-SMS positions during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). The DPME also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details      can   be     sourced        by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates are required to use the new Z83 (Application for employment) that is implemented with effect from 1 January 2021. A copy can be downloaded on the website of the Department of Public Service & Administration (DPSA) at www.dpsa.gov.za MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Presidentskaplike Hotlyn
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir die Presidentskaplike Hotlyn in Pretoria, wat 'n tersaaklike tersiêre kwalifikasie en drie jaar se ervaring in monitering, data-analise of administrasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (\NQF 6\) in die gebied van Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Publieke Administrasie/ Kommunikasie, Ontwikkelingstudies/ Geesteswetenskappe/ Data-analise of verwante velde met ten minste 3 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in ervaring in die Monitering en Evaluering, data-analise, projekbestuursomgewing en/of administratiewe ervaring en/of kliëntesorg. 'n Goeie begrip van regeringsbeleid, M&E en die aanmelding van sake. Bevoegdhede/Vaardighede: Die ideale kandidaat moet goed ontwikkelde verslagskryfvaardighede, navorsingsmetodologie en analitiese vaardighede besit, deeglike kennis van die Microsoft Office-pakket (insluitend Excel en Power Point) hê, goeie gehalte werk moet lewer, betroubaar wees en inisiatief toon. Moet goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge en kommunikasievaardighede hê, moet buigsaam wees en die vermoë hê om in 'n span te werk. Persoonlike eienskappe: Die ampshouer moet selfversekerd en selfgedrewe wees, kliëntegerig, klantgefokus, oplossingsgerig en in staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk, asook die vermoë hê om hoë vlakke van vertroulikheid te handhaaf.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees om die Presidentskaplike Hotlyn-direktoraat te ondersteun om goeie gehalte aanmelding van sake te verseker, doeltreffende monitering en ondersteuning aan departemente en provinsies te bied, en die navorsings-, kennisbestuurs- en kommunikasiefunksies te ondersteun. Bestuur van die aanmeldings- en naspeurfunksie van sake. Bestuur en naspoor van klagtes wat na nasionale departemente en provinsies verwys is (belanghebbendes). Bestuur van navorsing en kennisbestuur en kommunikasie. Projeks- en administratiewe ondersteuning.

zu.title: Ongusizo Owayejwayele Ekhaya: Isimemo Sakho Ngokusebenza Kwendabuko
zu.summary: Ongusizo Owayejwayele Ekhaya: Isimemo Sakho Ngokusebenza Kwendabuko, okudinga iziqu ezingezesi esikoleni esiphakeme kanye neminyaka emithathu yemisebenzi ekubukeleni, ekubhekeni imininingwane, nasekolawulweni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zesikhathi esingeminyaka emithathu kusikole samabanga aphakeme (\NQF 6\) endaweni yesidiploma sezwe / iziqu eZikhalazini Zomphakathi / Enxulumene, Ezifundweni Ezithuthukisayo / Enzabakhamizi / Ekubhekeni Imininingwane noma kumagatsha ahlobene nokunye okubangelwa iminyaka engu-3 yemisebenzi ekubukeleni nasekuhloleni, ekubhekeni imininingwane, ekulawuleneni amaphrojekthi kanye nasekolawulweni imisebenwe/ nasekuphathweni abathengi. Ukuqonda kahle izinqubomgomo zahulumeni, ukuqonda nokubuka imisebenze kanye nokubhala izindaba ezibandakanya kuhlelo. Izidingo/Ikhono: Umzamo ofanelekile kufanele abe nakhono lokubhala umbiko olungile, indlela yokucwaninga nokuqonda ukuthi kwenzeke ini kanye nokuqonda imininingwane, okuhle ngolwazi lweMicrosoft Office (kuhlanganise i-Excel kanye ne-Power Point), kufanele akhiqize umsebenzi omuhle, abe nesithembile athathe isinyathelo. Kufanele abe nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu kanye nakhono lokukhuluma, kufanele ahlukaniseke kanye nakhono lokusebenza eqenjini Izimfihlo Zomuntu: Lo muntu kufanele abe nesibindi aziphathe ngokwakhe, axhaswe abathengi, axhaswe abathengi, axhaswe ngokuthi ahlole izixazululo kanti futhi akwazi ukusebenza esimweni esibucayi nakho ukugcina izimfihlo eziphakeme.
zu.duties: Umntu ophumeleleyo kuzakufuneka axhase uMnyango Wekhomishani YesiNgosi ngokuqinisekisa ukuba kubhalwe ngokuhamba kwezinto ezingezizi, ukubuka ngokusebenza kwaye axhase iminyango nantlango kanti futhi axhase ucwaningo, ukuphathwa kolwazi kwaye axhase nolunye ulwazi ngokwenza. Ukuphathwa kokubhala nokulandelwa kwezindaba ezingezizi. Ukulawula nokulandela izikhalazo ezithunyelwa kwiminyango yantlango nantlango (Abahola-ndawo). Ukulawula ucwaningo nolwazi ngokusilwa nokuqonda nokwenza ulwazi. Ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi nencwadi yemisebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: iLayini yeFowuni yoMongameli
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli weLayini yeFowuni yoMongameli ePretoria, efuna isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo samabanga aphezulu neminyaka emithathu yamava okuhlola, ukuhlalutya iingcombolo, okanye ulawulo.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo samabanga amathathu aphezulu (\NQF 6\) kwicala leDiploma yaseLizwe / iNqanaba leNqubo kaRhulumente / Unxibelelwano, izifundo zophuhliso / iNgcadini yomntu / ukuHlalutya iingcombolo okanye amacala axhunyeneyo nobunini obungaphelayo beminyaka emithathu yamava afanelekileyo kuMava kukuQwalasela nokuBumba, ukuhlalutya iingcombolo, kwimeko yolawulo lweeprojekthi nokuba nayiphi na imiva yolawulo nokuba nayiphi na imiva yokukhathalela abathengi. Ukuqonda okuhle kweenkqabo zikaRhulumente, ukuQwalasela nokuBumba nokuqamba iicala. Iikhompetensi/Amakhono: Ikhandidethi efanayo kufuneka ibe namakhono obhalo emibiko asulungekileyo, iindlela zophando namakhono ohlalutyo, ulwazi oluhle lweqela leMicrosoft Office (kuquka iExcel nePower Point) kufuneka iveze umsebenzi womgangatho ophezulu, ithembekile yaye ithathe isigqibo. Kufuneka ibe nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu namakhono oxhumano luni, kufuneka iguquguquke yaye ikwazi ukusebenza ngeqela Iimpawu zobuntu: Umsebenzi kufuneka aqinise yena azixhasa, ajolise kumthengi, ajolise ekwaneliseni abathengi, ajolise kwimiziselo yaye akwazi ukusebenza kwiimeko ezinxulumene nengxaki yaye akwazi ukugcina iinqanaba ezithile zokwazisa ngasese.
xh.duties: Ikhandidethi edlulileyo iya kuba yinxaxheba ekuxhaseni uLawulo lweLayini yeFowuni yoMongameli ekuqinisekiseni ukuqamba iicala komgangatho ophezulu, ukuqwalasela okusebenzayo nokuxhasa amasebe nolunye ulwandle kunye nokuxhasa imisebenzi yophando, ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi loluntu. Ulawulo lomsebenzi wokuqamba nokulandela iicala. Lawula ulandele iingxelo ezidityaniswe kumasebe oluntu nolunye ulwandle (Abantu baseMmandla). Ulawulo lophando nolawulo lolwazi nolwazi loluntu. Inkxaso yeprojekthi nolawulo.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor “
jobs.closing_date_text: 07 August 2026 at 16h00. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Senior Internal Auditor position in Pretoria at the Department of Small Business Development, requiring a degree in Auditing or Accounting and at least two years of internal auditing experience.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor’s Degree or BCom Degree (NQF7) in Auditing / Accounting / Information Systems / IT Auditing or equivalent / related as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 2 years’ experience in Internal Auditing/ Auditing financial statements and information systems auditing including IT controls, and data analytics and systems environments. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, and Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) standards and guidelines. Post Graduate qualification in Auditing, Accounting or IT Auditing, Professional certification in Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) and experience in Auditing Financial Systems and IT environments including conducting IT audits would be considered an added advantage. Ms Office packages. Have proven competencies: Communication (verbal and written), Customer / Client Focus, Service Delivery Systems, Analytical Thinking, Research Skills, Presentation Skills, Problem-solving, Planning and organising and Data analysis.
jobs.duties: Plan internal audits inclusive of but not limited to conducting business understanding on the audit subject, risk analysis, identifying risk, considering applicable legislative frameworks on the subject, determining audit scope the focus areas etc. Execute internal audits by conducting control adequacy assessments, sampling procedures, developing audit programme to be signed off by the audit manager, executing audit procedures, communicate exceptions to management etc. Develop a draft audit report, convene exit meeting and present the findings of the draft report. Prepare an audit summary for the various stakeholders, highlight risk areas and track process. Support audit committee processes, maintain audit working papers and records. Coordinate responses to internal and external stakeholders and participate in audit administration activities.
jobs.enquiries: Enquiries for all advertised posts should be directed to the recruitment office Tel No: (012) 394-5286/43097
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by email to the relevant email and by quoting the relevant reference number provided on the subject line. Acceptable formats for submission of documents are limited to MS Word, PDF. The Department of Small Business Development is committed to the pursuit of diversity and redress. Candidates must submit applications to recruitment5@dsbd.gov.za and quote the reference number for the abovementioned position on the subject line (email) when applying, i.e. “REF NO: SIA”
jobs.notes: Applications must quote the relevant reference number and consist of: A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a recent comprehensive CV. Submission of copies of qualifications, Identity document, and any other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All non-SA citizens will be required to submit proof of permanent residence in South Africa when shortlisted. Personnel suitability checks will be done during the selection process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 1 month of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. In the pursuit of diversity and redress, appointments will be made in line with the DSBD EE Plan. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment, as well as complete a financial interest declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. The Department reserves the rights not to fill or withdraw any advertised post. Note: a new application for employment (Z83) form is applicable from 01 January 2021.      The     new     form      can      be     downloaded     online     at http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp OTHER POST

af.title: Senior Interne Ouditeur “
af.summary: Senior Interne Ouditeur pos in Pretoria by die Department of Small Business Development, vereis 'n graad in Ouditing of Rekenkunde en ten minste twee jaar se interne ouditeringservaring.
af.requirements: Baccalaureusgraad of BCom-graad (NQF7) in Ouditing / Rekenkunde / Inligtingstelsels / IT-Ouditing of 'n gelykwaardige / verwante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 2 jaar se ondervinding in interne ouditering / ouditering van finansiële state en inligtingstelsels-ouditering, insluitend IT-kontroles, data-analise en stelselomgewings. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, en Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) standaarde en riglyne. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Ouditing, Rekenkunde of IT-Ouditing, professionele sertifisering in Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) of Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) en ondervinding in die ouditering van finansiële stelsels en IT-omgewings, insluitend die uitvoer van IT-oudite, sal as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word. MS Office-pakette. Het bewese bevoegdhede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), Kliëntfokus, Diensleweringstelsels, Analitiese denke, Navorsingsvaardighede, Voorleggingsvaardighede, Probleemoplossing, Beplanning en organisering, en Data-analise.
af.duties: Beplan interne oudite, insluitend maar nie beperk tot die opdoen van besigheidsbegrip oor die ouditonderwerp, risiko-analise, die identifisering van risiko's, die oorweging van toepaslike wetgewende raamwerke oor die onderwerp, die bepaling van die ouditomvang, die fokusareas, ens. Voer interne oudite uit deur kontrole-toereikendheidsassessering uit te voer, steekproefprosedures, die ontwikkeling van 'n ouditprogram om deur die ouditbestuurder onderteken te word, die uitvoer van ouditprosedures, die kommunikeer van uitsonderings aan bestuur, ens. Ontwikkel 'n konsepsouditverslag, reël 'n afsluitvergadering en lê die bevindings van die konsepverslag voor. Berei 'n ouditsamevatting vir die verschillende belanghebbendes voor, beklemtoon risikoareas en volg die proses op. Ondersteun ouditkomiteeprosesse, hou ouditwerkpapierre en rekords aan. Koördineer reaksies aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes en neem deel aan ouditadministrasie-aktiwiteite.

zu.title: I-Auditor Yamaphakathi Ophethe
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Auditor Yamaphakathi Ophethe ePretoria kuDepartment of Small Business Development, esidinga ibanga eliphezulu kwe-Auditing noma i-Accounting okungenani iminyaka emibili yokuhlolwa ngaphakathi.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor’s Degree noma i-BCom Degree (NQF7) kwe-Auditing / i-Accounting / i-Information Systems / i-IT Auditing noma okulinganayo / ohlobene nakho njengokuthathwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani unyaka ogu-2 wokuthola isipiliyono kwi-Internal Auditing/ ukuhlola izinkulumo-ezimalini kanye nokuhlola amasistimu yolwazi okuhlanganisa izilawulo ze-IT, nanaluhlaziya idatha namasistimu. Ukwazi umthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho ye-Treasury Regulations, kanye nemigomo namalahleso we-Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA). I-Post Graduate qualification kwi-Auditing, i-Accounting noma i-IT Auditing, isitifiketi sabuchwepheshe se-Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) noma se-Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) kanye nesipiliyono sokuhlola Amasistimu Wezimali nezindawo ze-IT okuhlanganisa nokuqasha ukuhlola i-IT kubhekwa njengenzuzo egeziwe. Amaphakheji we-Ms Office. Ufake isibindi ngamakhono obungcweti: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), Ukuqagela abathengi / abaklayenti, Amasistimu Esevisi Ehanjiswa, Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, Amakhono Okucwaninga, Amakhono Okubonisa, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ukuhlela nokuhlela kanye Nokuahlaziya idatha.
zu.duties: Hlela ukuhlola ngaphakathi okuhlanganisa kodwa akukhawulwe ekwenziweni ukuqonda umgwaqo wezentengiselwano ngohlobo lolu hlola, ukuhlaziya ubungozi, ukubona ubungozi, ukubheka izinhlelo zomthetho ezisebenza kohlaka lolu, ukunquma ubukhulu bolu hlolo izindawo ezigxilwe kuzo njll. Phetha ukuhlola ngaphakathi ngokwenza ukuhlola ukwaneleka kwesilawulo, izinqamuleli zokuqamba, ukuthuthukisa uhlela lolu hlolo oluzobhaliswa umphathiohlolo, ukuphetha izinqubo zokuhlola, ukuxhumana ngokwehluleko nomphathi njll. Thuthukisa umbikoohlolo othosiwe, baqoqe isikhathi sokuphuma bese ubonisa imiphumela yombiko othosiwe. Lungiselela isifinyezo solu hlolo sezinxuluma ezahlukene, gqamisa izindawo zengozi bese ulandela inqubo. Sekela izinqubo zikomkhulu wokuhlola, gcina amaphepha okusebenza olu hlolo namarekhodi. Hlanganisa impendulo kwizinxeba zangaphakathi nangaphandle futhi uthathe inxaxheba ezinhlelweni zokuphathwa koku.hlola.

xh.title: Senior Internal Auditor
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaSenior Internal Auditor ePretoria kwiDepartment of Small Business Development, sifuna idigri kwiAuditing okanye iAccounting kunye nonyaka wamava olongezeleleyo emisebenzini yokuNika izikhokelo ngaphakathi.
xh.requirements: IDigri yeBachelor okanye iDigri yeBCom (NQF7) kwisiSebe sokuNika izikhokelo ngeengozi / iNkqubo yeZimali / iNkqubo yolwazi / ukuHlola i-IT okanye esiyinzuncana / ezinxulumene njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Isiseko seenyanga eziyi-2 zeminyaka yamava kwikuHlola ngaphakathi / ukuhlola iinkcukacha zemali kwaye ukuhlola iinkqubo zolwazi kuquka ulawulo lwe-IT, nokuhlolwa kolwazi ngolwazi nendalo yeenkqubo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), i Treasury Regulations, neemigangatho nezikhokelo zeInstitute of Internal Auditors (IIA). Isidanga sePost Graduate kwisiSebe sokuNika izikhokelo ngeengozi, iNkqubo yeZimali okanye ukuHlola i-IT, izatifikethi zobugcisa kwisiTifikethi seCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) okanye iCertified Internal Auditor (CIA) namava kwisiSebe sokuHlola iiNkqubo zeZimali neendalo ze-IT kuquka ukuqhutywa kokuHlola i-IT kuya kubalwa njengenzuzo eyongeziweyo. Iipakethe zeMs Office. Ukuba nokuqina okuqinisiweyo: uThetho (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo), uKuzinikela kwiKhhasi / uKuzinikela kuQhagamshelo, iiNkqubo zoKunikela iNkonzo, uKucinga ngokuhlalutya, uBuchule bokUphando, uBuchule bokubonisa, uKusombulula iingxaki, uKucwangcisa nokuLungelelanisa nokuHlalutya iData.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa ukuhlola kwangaphakathi kuquka kodwa kungangathwaliwa kuphela ukuqonda ishishini ngomxholo wokuhlola, ukuhlalutya iingozi, ukuqaphela iingozi, ukuqwalasela iinkqubo zomthetho ezifanelekayo ngomxholo, ukuqamba umda wokuhlola iindawo ezijoliseyo njalo njalo. Phumeza ukuhlola kwangaphakathi ngokwenza ukuhlola ukwanelela kolawulo, iinkqubo zokucinga, ukuphuhlisa inkqubo yokuhlola efanele ukutyikitywa ngumlawuli wokuhlola, ukuze kusetyenziswe iinkqubo zokuhlola, ukunikelisa ngokungalunganga kubaphathi njalo njalo. Phuhlisa umbiko wokuhlola ongakabhalwa ngokusemthethweni, ribha indibano yokuvala nikeleni neziphumo zombiko ongakabhalwa ngokusemthethweni. Lungiselela isishwankathelo sokuhlola sabo bonke abanomdla, phawula iindawo ezingozi kwaye ulande iinkqubo. Nxiba amanqamlelo eenkqubo zekomiti yokuhlola, gcina amaphepha emisebenzi yokuhlola nerekhodi. Lungelelanisa iimpendulo kubantu abangenaphakathi nabanaphandle abanomdla kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kumisebenzi yolawulo wokuhlola.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Organisational Design and JOB Evaluation
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration salary package), consists of a basic salary, Sate’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of Basic salary) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules Middle Management Services Guidelines
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Organisational Design and Job Evaluation at the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria, offering R932,292 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate/ NQF 4 or equivalent qualification. Minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF Level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Management Services / Organisation and Work Study / Operations Management/Production Management/ Organisational Development/ Industrial Psychology or any relevant Organisational Development qualification. Job Evaluation Certificate and PERSAL Establishment Certificate as additional requirements. 3-5 years relevant experience, at least 3 years at an Assistant Director level in organisational development, job evaluation and or any relevant organisation development environment. Knowledge of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, etc. Knowledge of Job evaluation and job grading processes. Knowledge and understanding of DPSA directives, circulars, PSCBC Resolutions etc. applicable to organisational development/change management environment. Knowledge and understanding of Organisational Design principles and techniques. Understanding of Code of Remuneration (CORE). Knowledge of Computer software (Excel, OrgPlus, Visio, PowerPoint, etc). Knowledge and understanding of Diversity management. Knowledge and understanding of business process management. Good communication and Interpersonal relation. Planning and organising skills. Problem solving skills. Interviewing and analytical thinking skills. Project Management skills. Facilitation and Presentation skills. Computer literate. Attention to detail. Ability to work independently and as a team. Ability to keep classified information.
jobs.duties: To manage and provide organisational development and design services to support organisational effectiveness within the Department. Manage organisational development and structure review process: Lead organisational design and structure review processes. Manage the development, review, and alignment of organisational structures with approved establishment requirements and CoE provisions. Develop organisational structure reports, recommendations, and submissions for management approval. Monitor the implementation of approved organisational structures and related organisational development interventions. Conduct organisational functionality and mandate analysis. Authorise the creation, amendment, and abolishment of posts on PERSAL in line with approved organisational structures. Manage and monitor alignment between approved organisational structures, establishment information, and PERSAL records. Manage and monitor job evaluation processes: Oversee the implementation of job evaluation and job grading processes in accordance with DPSA policies and frameworks. Ensure newly created, revised and existing positions are evaluated and graded in line with approved job evaluation systems. Manage the coordination of job evaluation panel meetings. Oversee the monitor of job evaluation register and implementation of approved grading outcomes. Provide technical advice and guidance on job evaluation and grading matters. Ensure approved job evaluation and grading outcomes are accurately implemented and updated on PERSAL. Manage job description development and review processes: Oversee the development, review, and quality assurance of job descriptions aligned to organisational structures and operational requirements. Ensure all employees have approved and signed job descriptions in the department. Oversee the maintenance of the job description database and related records. Manage Business Process Improvement Initiatives: Oversee the business process mapping, analysis, and improvement initiatives. Oversee the development and review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and business process documentation. Facilitate the identification of process gaps, inefficiencies, and operational improvement opportunities. Monitor the implementation of approved business process improvements. Leveraging AI tools to analyse organisational structures, spans of control and reporting lines. Supporting AI-assisted business process mapping and process optimisation. Developing governance frameworks for the responsible and ethical use of AI within Organisational Design and Development. Develop reports and recommendations on business process improvement within the department. Manage Administrative and Governance Support Services: Coordinate administrative, reporting, and governance processes within the organisational development unit. Prepare reports, submissions, presentations, and memos related to organisational development processes and procedures. Manage the coordination of meetings, workshops, consultations, and stakeholder engagements. Monitor compliance with organisational development policies, procedures, and legislative prescripts.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Organisatoriese Ontwerp en Werk-evaluasie
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Organisatoriese Ontwerp en Werkevaluasie by die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria, wat R932,292 per jaar bied.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat/Matrik Sertifikaat /Graad 12 Sertifikaat/ NQF 4 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum driejarige Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6)/ Graad (NQF vlak 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Bestuursdienste / Organisasie en Werkstudie / Operasionele Bestuur/Produksiebestuur/ Organisatoriese Ontwikkeling/ Bedryfsielkunde of enige relevante Organisatoriese Ontwikkelingskwalifikasie. Werkevaluasiesertifikaat en PERSAL Vestigingsertifikaat as bykomende vereistes. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring, ten minste 3 jaar op 'n Assistent-Direkteur-vlak in organisatoriese ontwikkeling, werkevaluasie en of enige relevante organisatoriese ontwikkelingsomgewing. Kennis van Openbare Dienswet, Openbare Diensregulasies, Openbare Finansiesbestuurwet, ens. Kennis van werkevaluasie- en werkgraderingsprosesse. Kennis en begrip van DPSA-riglyne, sirkulêre, PSCBC-resolusies ens. van toepassing op organisatoriese ontwikkelings-/veranderingsbestuursomgewing. Kennis en begrip van Organisatoriese Ontwerpsbeginsels en -tegnieke. Begrip van Vergoedingskode (CORE). Kennis van rekenaarsagteware (Excel, OrgPlus, Visio, PowerPoint, ens). Kennis en begrip van diversiteitsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van besigheidsprosesbestuur. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Beplannings- en organisingingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Onderhoudende en analitiese denkvaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Fasiliterings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterd. Aandag aan besonderhede. Vermoe om onafhanklik en as 'n span te werk. Vermoe om geklassifiseerde inligting te bewaar.
af.duties: Om organisatoriese ontwikkelings- en ontwerpsdienste te bestuur en te verskaf om organisatoriese doeltreffendheid binne die departement te ondersteun. Bestuur die proses vir organisatoriese ontwikkeling en strukturings hersiening: Lei organisatoriese ontwerp- en strukturingsherzieningsprosesse. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en belyning van organisatoriese strukture met goedgekeurde vakature-vereistes en CoE-bepalings. Ontwikkel organisatoriese strukturingsverslae, aanbevelings en voorleggings vir bestuursgoedkeuring. Monitor die implementering van goedgekeurde organisatoriese strukture en verwante organisatoriese ontwikkelingsintervensies. Voer organisatoriese funksionaliteits- en mandaatanalise uit. Magtig die skepping, wysiging en afskaffing van poste op PERSAL in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde organisatoriese strukture. Bestuur en monitor belyning tussen goedgekeurde organisatoriese strukture, vakature-inligting en PERSAL-rekords. Bestuur en monitor werkevaluasieprosesse: Hou toesig oor die implementering van werkevaluasie- en werkgraderingsprosesse in ooreenstemming met DPSA-beleid en -raamwerke. Verseker dat nuutgeskepte, hersiene en bestaande poste geëvalueer en gegradeer word in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde werkevaluasiestelsels. Bestuur die koördinasie van werkevaluasiepaneelvergaderings. Hou toesig oor die monitering van die werkevaluasieregister en die implementering van goedgekeurde graderingsuitkomste. Verskaf tegniese advies en leiding oor werkevaluasie- en graderingsaangeleenthede. Verseker dat goedgekeurde werkevaluasie- en graderingsuitkomste akkuraat geïmplementeer en op PERSAL opgedateer word. Bestuur prosesse vir die ontwikkeling en hersiening van werksbeskrywings: Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, hersiening en gehalteversekering van werksbeskrywings wat met organisatoriese strukture en operasionele vereistes belyn is. Verseker dat alle werknemers in die departement goedgekeurde en ondertekende werksbeskrywings het. Hou toesig oor die instandhouding van die werksbeskrywingsdatabasis en verwante rekords. Bestuur sakeprosesverbeteringsinisiatiewe: Hou toesig oor sakeproseskartering, analise en verbeteringsinisiatiewe. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en hersiening van Standaard Bedryfsprosedures (SBPs) en sakeprosesdokumentasie. Fasiliteer die identifisering van prosesgaping, ondoeltreffendheid en operasionele verbeteringsgeleenthede. Monitor die implementering van goedgekeurde sakeprosesverbeterings. Benut AI-instrumente om organisatoriese strukture, beheerspanne en verslagdoeningslyne te analiseer. Ondersteun AI-ondersteunde sakeproseskartering en prosesoptimalisering. Ontwikkel bestuursraamwerke vir die verantwoordelike en etiese gebruik van KI binne Organisatoriese Ontwerp en Ontwikkeling. Ontwikkel verslae en aanbevelings oor sakeprosesverbetering binne die departement. Bestuur Administratiewe en Bestuursondersteuningsdienste: Koördineer administratiewe, verslagdoenings- en bestuursprosesse binne die organisatoriese ontwikkelingseenheid. Berei verslae, voorleggings, aanbiedings en memorandum voor wat verband hou met organisatoriese ontwikkelingsprosesse en -prosedures. Bestuur die koördinasie van vergaderings, werkswinkels, samesprekings en belanghebbendesbetrekking. Monitor nakoming van organisatoriese ontwikkelingsbeleid, prosedures en wetgewende voorskrifte.

zu.title: I-Deputy Director: Organisational Design and JOB Evaluation
zu.summary: I-Deputy Director: Organisational Design and Job Evaluation e-Department of Sport, Arts and Culture e-Pretoria, inikeza i-R932,292 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate/ NQF 4 noma izifundo ezifanayo. Isiqu se-Certificate se-National Diploma (NQF level 6) seminyaka emithathu/ Degree (NQF Level 7) njengoba kunikwa isihlabathi ngu-SAQA kwi-Management Services / Organisation and Work Study / Operations Management/Production Management/ Organisational Development/ Industrial Psychology noma noma yisiphi isiqu sokuthuthuka kwezinhlanga. Isiqu sokuhola izikhundla kanye nesiqu se-PERSAL Establishment njengezidingo ezingeziwe. Eminyakeni engu-3-5 yokuhlolela okuhlobene, okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 ezingeni lika-Assistant Director kuthuthukiswa kwezinhlanga, ukuholwa izikhundla noma noma yisiphi isikhundla sokuthuthuka kwezinhlanga. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Service Act, izincazelo ze-Public Service Regulations, umthetho we-Public Finance Management Act, njll. Ulwazi ngokuholwa futhi ngokugredwa izikhundla. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinkomba ze-DPSA, izincwadi zokwazisa, izinqumo ze-PSCBC, njll. ezihambisana nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlanga/oshintshweni. Ulwazi nokuqonda imigomo kanye namasu okwakheka kwezinhlanga. Ukuqonda ngekhodi yokuhola (CORE). Ulwazi lwe-Computer software (Excel, OrgPlus, Visio, PowerPoint, njll). Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kokubanaphilhe. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwenqubo yebhizinisi. Ukukhuluma kahle nokuxhumaneka nabantu. Amasu okuhlela futhi uhle. Amasu okuxazulula izinkinga. Amasu okubuzwa kanye nokuqonda okuhlaziyiwe. Amasu okuphatha iphrojekthi. Amasu okukhuthaza futhi ukwenza izethulo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukugcoba izinsuku. Isikhakha sokusebenza eyedwa futhi njengelungu lenqamu. Isikhakha sokugcina imininingwane ebalulekile.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha futhi unikele izinsizakalo zentuthuko kanye nokwakheka kwezinhlanga ukusekela ukusebenza kahle kwenhlanga ngaphakathi kwe-Department. Uphatha inqubo yokubuyekewa kokwakheka kwenhlanga: Hola izinqubo zokwakheka nokubuyekewa kwakho. Phatha ukuthuthuka, ukubuyekewa, kanye nokuqondanisa izakhiwo zezenhlanga nemithetho evunyiweyo yokuqasha kanye nezinkomba ze-CoE. Hlola amabhulogi ezakhiwo zezenhlanga, okunconyiwe, kanye nezinkumiso zokuvuma i-management. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwesakhiwo esivunyiwe sezinhlanga kanye nezikhundla ezihlobene nentuthuko yezenhlanga.enza ukuhlaziya ukusebenza kwenhlanga kanye nesenzo sayo. Vumela ukudalwa, ukushintshwa, kanye nokususwa kwezikhundla kwi-PERSAL ngokulandelana izakhiwo ezivunyiweyo zezenhlanga. Phatha futhi uqaphele ukuqondana phakathi kwezakhiwo ezivunyiweyo zezenhlanga, ulwazi lokuqasha, kanye namarekhodi e-PERSAL. Phatha futhi uqaphele izinqubo zokuhlola izikhundla: Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zokuhlola futhi zigrede ngepholisi kanye namaphulasidi we-DPSA. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhundla ezidalwe kamuva, ezibuyekeziwe, kanye nezikhona zihlolwe zigredwe ngokuhambisana namasistimu avunyiwe okuholayo. Phatha ukuhlanganisa amabhulogi okuhola. Qaphela ukuqashelwa kwe-register yokuholwa kanye nokuqondiswa kokusetshenziswa kolwazi oluvunyiwe. Nikeza iseluleko nokuqondisa ngemibuzo yokuholwa futhi uthole abahola. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela evunyiwe yokuhola igredwe ichazwe ngokusobeka ithuthelwe kwi-PERSAL. Phatha inqubo yokuthuthukisa nokubuyekeza incazalo yomsebenzi: Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekeza, futhi uqiniseke incazalo yomsebenzi ehambisana nesakhiwo sezenhlanga kanye nezidingo zokusebenza. Qinisekisa bonke abasebenzi banecazelo yomsebenzi evunyiwe futhi esayiniwe kule-Department. Qaphela ukugcinwa kwe-database yencwadi yomsebenzi kanye namarekhodi ahlobene. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa Kwenqubo Yebhizinisi: Qaphela ukumethwa nokuqonda inqubo yebhizinisi, ukuhlaziya, kanye nezinhlobo ezithuthukiswayo. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekeza izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza (SOPs) nokuqamba amakhompyutha wenqubo yebhizinisi. Siza ukubona izikhala zenqubo, ukungasebenzi kahle, kanye namathuba okuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Qapha ukusetshenziswa okuvunyiwe kokuthuthukiswa kwenqubo. Ukusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi e-AI ekuhlaziyeni izakhiwo zezenhlanga, izifanekiselo, kanye nomugqa wokubika. Ukusekela ukumethwa kwenqubo ekelwe ku-AI kanye nokulungiselelwa kwenqubo. Buthaza izakhiwo ezibusayo ngokusethenziswa okunomthelela kanye nokuziphatha kwe-AI ngaphakathi kokwakheka nokuthuthuka kwezenhlanga. Hlola amabhulogi futhi ungene izinkomba ngokuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yebhizinisi ngaphakathi kwale-Department. Phatha izinsizakalo Zokuqondisa Nokwesekwa: Hlanganisa izinqubo zokuphatha, ukubika, futhi useke inqudo ngaphakathi kweyuniti yentuthuko yezenhlanga. Lungiselela amabhulogi, izinkumiso, izethulo, kanye namamemoranda ahlobene nentuthuko yenhlanga nezinqubo. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kwamabhulogi, amakhonsathi, futhi kubambe izikhundla zabanikazi baleziqu. Qaphela ukuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubo, kanye nemithetho yesiShayamthetho.

xh.title: Isekela likaM lawuli: Uyilo lweNgqalasela kunye nokuqwalasela iMisebenzi
xh.summary: Isekela likaMlawuli: Uyilo lweNgqalasela kunye nokuqwalasela iMisebenzi kwiSebe leMzobo, zobuBom kunye nesiNeko ePretoria, linika R932,292 ngeminyaka yonke.
xh.requirements: Izatifikathi ePhakamileyo / IZatifikathi yeMatric / IZatifikathi yeGredi 12 / NQF 4 okwesiqingatha sokufana naso. I-Diploma yesiZwe ubuncinane iiminyaka ezintathu (inqanaba le-NQF 6) / i-Degree (inqanaba le-NQF 7) njengoko kujulwe yi-SAQA kwiZiko leeNkonzo zoLawulo / ku phononongo lweNgqalasela noMsebenzi / kuLawulo lweNdlela ezisezinyeni / kuLawulo lweNzululwazi / eNtshukumo yeNgqalasela / kwiNzululwazi yobuGcisa bendalo okwesina nasiphi na isigaba sokufana nesiqu seNtshukumo yeNgqalasela. IZatifikathi yokuQwalasela iMisebenzi kunye neZatifikathi yeSigqeba se-PERSAL njengemfuno eyongezelelweyo. Ulunyulwano oluqhelekileyo lwe-3-5 kwiminyaka, ubuncinane i-3 kwiminyaka kwinqanaba likaMlawuli ongancedisayo kwintshukumo yeNgqalasela, ukuqwalaselwa kwemisebenzi nasiphi na na esona singqiqibo sendlela yokuphuhlisa iNgqalasela. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weeNkonzo kaRhamentye, ngezMigaqo yeeNkonzo kaRhamentye, ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhamentye, nangamanye. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubeka izigaba semisebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimfuno, iisangqa, izigqibo ze-PSCBC, nokunye okusebenziseka kwindawo yokuphucula iNgqalasela / ulawulo lweshigu. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuyila iNgqalasela. Ukuqonda iKhowudi yoMvuzo (CORE). Ulwazi ngamathuba ekhompyutha (i-Excel, i-OrgPlus, i-Visio, i-PowerPoint, nokunye). Ulwazi nokuqonda ulawulo lweentshaba. Ulwazi nokuqonda ulawulo lweenkqubo zorhwebo. Ikhomunikheyishan elitile kunye namakhuphiswano phakathi kwabantu. Iimfuneko zokucinga nokuqwalomisa. Iimfuneko zokulawula iingxaki. Iimfuneko zokubuza iimbuzo nokuqwalasela ngokutsho kuka-gqogqwana. Iimfuneko zoLawulo lweeProjekthi. Iimfuneko zokwamkela nokuzibonisa. Ukuba lulwazi ngekhompyutha. Inkarada yemiba emininzi. Amandla okusebenza kodwa kunye nentsapho. Amandla okugcina iinkcukacha ezingathunyelwa kwabaninzi.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba nokunika iinkonzo zokuphuhlisa nokuyila iNgqalasela ukuze ixhasa ukusebenza kweNgqalasela ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Ukulawula ukuqwalaswa kokubakwa kweNgqalasela nokuhlohlohlwa kokuqwalaswa: Ukuhola iinkqubo zokuyila nokubumba iNgqalasela. Ukulawula ukuphucula, ukuqwalasela, nokuqondanisa ukubakwa kweNgqalasela neemfuno ezivunyelweyo kwiCoE. Ukuphuhlisa iingxelo zokubumba iNgqalasela, izinto ezithi zwenzeke, kwaye zingeniselelwe kuLawulo ukuvuma. Ukulandelela ukusetenziswa koluntu oluqinisekisiweyo lokubumba iNgqalasela. Ukuqhubelela iingxelo zokusebenza kweNgqalasela nokuqwalasela umthetho-siseko wokubakwa koluntu. Ukuvuma ukudalwa, ukutshintshwa, nokususwa kwezikhundla kwi-PERSAL. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela ukuqondanisela oluvunyelweyo kokubumba iNgqalasela kwirekhodi. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokuqwalasela imisebenzi: Ukugcina amehlo ngokusetenziswa kwezi nkqubo zokuqwalasela zokubeka imisebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindawo ezintsha, ezitshintshweyo kwaye ezikhoyo ziqwalaselwa kwaye zibekeke ngokwezi nkqubo ezivunyelweyo. Ukulawula ukuhlanganiswa kwamagosa okubuza imisebenzi. Ukulandelela ukusetenziswa kwemithelela yokuqwalasela imisebenzi kwi-PERSAL. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izigqibo ezivunyelweyo zifakwa ngokuchanekileyo kwi-PERSAL. Ukulawula iinkqubo zokuphucula iNkqubo yoRhwebo: Ukugcina amehlo ekubukeni nokusika iinkqubo zorhwebo. Ukugcina amehlo ekuphuhliseni nokuqwalaseleni iinkqubo eziqhelekileyo zoRhwebo. Ukunceda ekuboniseni iingxowa ezingekho, iinkqubo ezingenanto, izinto ezinokuphuculwa. Ukulandelela ukusetenziswa kwezi nkqubo ezintsha kwiSebe. Ukusebenzisa i-AI ukusika iNgqalasela, iimeko yolawulo, kunye namazwi okunika iingxelo. Ukuxhasa i-AI ekubumba iinkqubo zorhwebo. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zolawulo lwe-AI. Ukuphuhlisa iingxelo kunye namacebiso okuphucula iinkqubo zorhwebo kwiSebe. Ukulawula iNkonzo zoLawulo lokuLungiselela nokuQwalasela: Ukuhlanganisa iinkqubo zolawulo, iingxelo, kunye nokuqwalasela kwindawo yokuphucula iNgqalasela. Ukulungiselela iingxelo, iingxelo ezithunyelwa, iingxelo ezibonwayo, kunye namagama athunyelwe eNxulumene neNtshukumo yeNgqalasela. Ukulawula ukuhlanganiswa kweminyhadala yamagosa, iklasi, kunye neminyhadala yoluntu. Ukulandelela ukuthobela imigaqo yoluntu yokuphucula iNgqalasela, iinkqubo, kunye nemithetho yepaliyamenti.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration salary package), consists of a basic salary, Sate’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of Basic salary) and a flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules Middle Management Services Guidelines.
jobs.summary: The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture seeks a Deputy Director for Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria to develop performance monitoring frameworks and consolidate quarterly reports.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Matric Certificate / Grade 12 Certificate / NQF 4 or equivalent qualification. Minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Monitoring and Evaluation/ Public Administration / Public Management / Public Governance / Internal Auditing / Statistics / Data Management or any relevant Monitoring and Evaluation qualification. 3-5 years relevant experience and (at least 3 years at an Assistant Director level) in monitoring and evaluation environment. Knowledge of business and management principles. Knowledge of strategic planning, resource allocation and human resources. Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations. Participate in the Quarterly and Departmental performance review session. Finalise the quarterly performance report and facilitate the sign off by the DG or delegated official. Facilitate the submission of reports to Internal audit, DPME and National Treasury. Review draft monthly report on targets that are not achieved. Conduct refresher workshop with programmes on the reporting guidelines. Review and consolidate quarterly performance presentations for Audit and Portfolio Committee. Submit national oversight comments to DPME and provincial department of Sport, Arts and Culture through eQPRS. Compile a draft report on reviewed Departmental Annual Performance Plans and Standard Operating Procedures (inclusive of its technical indicator description): Compiling a draft report on reviewed APP, TIDs and Strategic Plan covering the following; SMART principles of indicators and targets. Proposed verifications sources in the TID. Review the previous FY Standard Operating Procedures and propose changes where necessary. Consolidate and review the development of quarterly operational plan reports: Develop reporting template on operational plan. Circulate the reporting template to all programmes in the Department. Receive and review operational plan reports submitted by programmes. Generate operational plan reports for the department. Review and consolidate quarterly performance presentations for programmes. Facilitate the submission of reports to programmes for noting and improvement.
