af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Matric Certificate / Grade 12 Certificate / NQF 4 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum driejaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF level 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Monitoring and Evaluation/ Public Administration / Public Management / Public Governance / Internal Auditing / Statistics / Data Management of enige relevante Monitering en Evaluering-kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring en (ten minste 3 jaar op 'n Assistentdirekteur-vlak) in 'n moniterings- en evalueringomgewing. Kennis van besigheids- en bestuursbeginsels. Kennis van strategiese beplanning, hulpbrontoewysing en menslike hulpbronne. Kennis van Public Service Act en Regulasies. Kennis van Projektbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede. Goede kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus. Vermoë om met verskillende belanghebbendes oor prestasie-inligtingsake te werk. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Verantwoordelikheid en Etiese Gedrag. Veranderingsbestuur. Spanwerk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Om prestasiemoniterings-, evaluerings- en verslagdoeningsraamwerkstelsels en -prosedures vir die departement te ontwikkel en te handhaaf. Konsolideer en hersien die ontwikkeling van Quarterly Performance Reports: Ontleed en hersien kwartaalinsette wat deur programme ingedien is. Neem deel aan die kwartaal- en departementele prestasieherwinningssessies. Finaliseer die kwartaalprestasieverslag en fasiliteer die ondertekening deur die DG of die gedelegeerde beampte. Fasiliteer die indiening van verslae by Internal audit, DPME en National Treasury. Hersien konsep maandelikse verslag oor teikens wat nie bereik is nie. Hou opfrissingswerkswinkel met programme oor die verslagdoeningsriglyne. Hersien en konsolideer kwartaalprestasie-aanbiedings vir Audit and Portfolio Committee. Hersien en konsolideer insette vir ENE mid-term report. Konsolideer en hersien die ontwikkeling van Annual Performance Report: Hersien konsep jaarlikse prestasieverslag. Hersien die Dashboard report oor verifikasiemene soos uiteengesit in die TID en Standard Operating Procedures. Neem deel aan die kwartaal- en departementele prestasieherwinningssessies. Fasiliteer die indiening van die jaarlikse prestasieherwinningsverslag by AGSA. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van die Service Provider en goedkeuring van die voorblad. Fasiliteer die voorlegging van die Annual Report in Parliament. Hersien en konsolideer jaarlikse prestasie-aanbiedings vir Audit and Portfolio Committee. Verskaf nasionale toesig oor provinsiale kwartaalverslagdoening op die Electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting System of Department of Planning Monitoring and Evaluation: Hersien van die provinsiale verslae op die Electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting system van DPME. Dien nasionale toesigkommentare by DPME en die provinsiale departement van Sport, Arts and Culture in via eQPRS. Stel 'n konsepverslag op oor hersiene Departmental Annual Performance Plans en Standard Operating Procedures (insluitend die tegniese aanwyserbeskrywing daarvan): Stel 'n konsepverslag op oor hersiene APP, TIDs en Strategic Plan wat die volgende dek; SMART-beginsels van aanwysers en teikens. Voorgestelde verifikasiemene in die TID. Hersien die vorige FY se Standard Operating Procedures en stel veranderings voor waar nodig. Konsolideer en hersien die ontwikkeling van kwartaalbedryfsplanverslae: Ontwikkel 'n verslagdoeningsjabloon oor die bedryfsplan. Sirkuleer die verslagdoeningsjabloon aan alle programme in die departement. Ontvang en hersien bedryfsplanverslae wat deur programme ingedien is. Genereer bedryfsplanverslae vir die departement. Hersien en konsolideer kwartaalprestasie-aanbiedings vir programme. Fasiliteer die indiening van verslae by programme ter kennisname en verbetering.

zu.title: Umsunguli Wozela Ukubuka Nokuqagela
zu.summary: Umnyango Wezemidlalo, Inguqulo Kwezamasiko Ubumbe owayeyiNgqalasoratha Wozela Ukubuka Nokuqagela ePretoria ukwakha izindlela zokuqonda ukusebenza kahle kanye nokubaqukatha izinkomba zamasonto.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samatrikulashe / Isitifikedi se-Senior / Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Isitifikedi se-NQF 4 noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Isitifikedi samatrikulashe saminyaka emithathu esemthethweni (NQF 6)/ Isiqu (NQF 7) njengoba samukelwa yi-SAQA ekuqaphelelweni nokuqagela / Ukuphathwa Komphakathi / Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi Bomme / Ukubukela Ukuphathwa Komphakathi / Ukuhlola Ngaphakathi / Izibalo / Ukuphathwa Kwemininingwane noma noma yiziphi iziqu eziphathelene nokubuka nokuqagela. Uzululele iminyaka eyi-3-5 kuleyo ndawo futhi (okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 njengomqondisi osecondelayo) kubulungelo lokubuka nokuqagela. Ulwazi ngezimiso zebhizinisi kanye nokuphathwa. Ulwazi ngokuqunjelwa isu, ukwabiwa kwemithombo kanye nempilo yabantu. Ulwazi ngomthetho kanye nemiyalo yesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngokuqondiswa kwezinhlelo. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokuthumela imiyalezo kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ikhono lokucubungula futhi ukuhlele. Ikhono lokwethula. Ukubhekisisa kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza nabasebenzi abahlukene mayelana nokusebenza komphakathi. Ikhono lokuqondisa kanye nokuba ngumholi. Ukuba nexabiso nokuziphatha ngokungakhulumi. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukusebenza njengomphakathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwezingxubuntshingxube.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa nokugcina izinhlelo zokulawula, ukuhlola nokubika kokusebenza kanye nendlela yokusebenza komnyango. Ukuqukatha nokubuyekeza ukuthuthukiswa kweNkomba Yokuqhuba Njalo Kanye Ngenkathi: Ukuhlola kabusha nokuhlaziya okokuthunyelwe njalo ngamakhomu. Ukubamba iqhaza kumasikhathi sokuqhuba nokubuyekeza ukusebenza komnyango. Ukuqedelela inkomba yokusebenza yamakhomu kanye nokwenza kube lula ukusayina nguDGG noma umuntu othunyiwe. Ukwenza kube lula ukuthunyelwa kwezinkomba ku-Internal audit, DPME kanye ne-National Treasury. Ukubuyekeza inkomba ynyanga ngezinhloso ezingafinyelelwa. Ukuqamba umhlangano wokuqasha kabusha namakhomu ngokuqondisa ngokubika. Ukubuyekeza nokuhlanganisa okuhambisana nokuqhuba kwamakhomu okuyimibhalo ebukwa yi-Audit kanye ne-Portfolio Committee. Ukubuyekeza futhi ukuqukatha okuhambisana nombhalo waphakathi kwaka-ENE. Ukuqukatha nokubuyekeza ukuthuthukiswa kwenkomba yokusebenza kwaminyaka yonke: Ukubuyekeza inkomba yonyaka yonke yokusebenza. Ukubuyekeza inkomba le-Dashboard emithonjeni yokugunyaza njengoba kuchaziwe ku-TID kanye nendlela ezinhle zokusebenza. Ukubamba iqhaza kumasikhathi sokuqhuba nokubuyekeza ukusebenza komnyango. Ukwenza kube lula ukuthunyelwa kwenkomba yokubuyekeza ukusebenza kwaminyaka yonke ku-AGSA. Ukwenza kube lula ukumiswa komNikazi Wesevisi kanye nokugunyazwa kwekhasi lokubuka. Ukwenza kube lula ukulethwa kwenkomba yonyaka wonke kuPhalamende. Ukubuyekeza nokuhlanganisa imibhalo yokusebenza kwaminyaka yonke ebukwa yi-Audit ne-Portfolio Committee. Ukunika ukubukela komphakathi okuzimele ngokubika kwamakhomu njalo ku-Electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting System kaDepartment of Planning Monitoring and Evaluation: Ukubuyekeza izinkomba zeSifundazwe ohlelweni le-Electronic Quarterly Performance Reporting luka-DPME. Ukuthumela iziphakamiso zokubukela ezimele ku-DPME nakuMnyango weSport, Arts and Culture wesifundazwe ngaphandle kwe-eQPRS. Ukuqamba inkomba ehluziwe yokubuyekeza uHlelo Lokuqhuba Lukamnyanga Lwaminyaka Yonke kanye nendlela ezinhle zokusebenza (okuhlanganisa incazelo yezinkomba zocwaningo): Ukwenza inkomba ehluziwe ngokubuyekeza i-APP, i-TIDs kanye noHlelo Lokuqhuba oluhlanganisa okulandelayo; izimiso ze-SMAT yezinkomba nezinhloso. Izinto zokugunyaza eziphakanyisiwe kwi-TID. Ukubuyekeza izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza zangomunyaka wezimali odedele kanye nokuphakamisa izinguquuko lapho kunesidingo. Ukuqukatha nokubuyekeza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba zohlelo lwamakhomu ezithunyelwe njalo ngamakhomu: Ukuthuthukisa inqubo yokubika kohlelo lokusebenza. Ukusabalalisa inqubo yokubika kuyo yonke imikhakha kuMnyango. Ukuthola nokubuyekeza izinkomba zohlelo lokusebenza ezingeniswa yimikhakha. Ukukhiqiza izinkomba zohlelo lokusebenza zomnyango. Ukubuyekeza nokuhlanganisa imibhalo yokusebenza yamakhomu esikhathini esithile. Ukwenza kube lula ukuthunyelwa kwezinkomba kumikhakha ukuze iqaphele futhi ithuthuke.

xh.title: Mlawuli ongunanyekelisi wokuLawula nokuhluza ulwazi
xh.summary: Isebe leSport, Arts and Culture lifuna uMlawuli oNgunanyekelisi wezokuLawula nokuhluza kwiziko lasePretoria ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zokuqhathanisa inkqubo yemisebenzi nokwenza iingxelo zesikhathi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu (Senior Certificate) / Isatifikethi seMatric / Isatifikethi seBanga le-12 / Isatifikethi se-NQF 4 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. I-National Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6) / I-Degree (NQF level 7) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwiliso leMonitoring and Evaluation / Public Administration / Public Management / Public Governance / Internal Auditing / Statistics / Data Management okanye naliphi na igqeba elidingekayo kwiliso leMonitoring and Evaluation. Ukuba neminyaka engama-3-5 yamava ahambelanayo (ubuncinane iminyaka emi-3 kwinqanaba likaMncebedi) kwimo yokulawula nokuhluza ulwazi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yoshishino olusebenzayo kunye namagunya alo. Ulwazi lokuqonda amagunya, ukubekwa koluntu nokuqonda iinkqubo zokwamkela iingxelo zabantu. Isidima sokuziphatha nokuzipatha ngokusesikweni.
xh.duties: Ukuphuhlisa kwaye zigcinile iinkqubo zokulawula, ukuhlola nokubika ngemveliso kunye nendlela ezisetyenziswayo kwisebe. Ukuqokelela kunye nokuhlola uphuhliso lweNgxelo yeNkokeli yaManyathelo eQ1 kunye neQ2: Ukuhlola nokuhlalutya okunikelweyo ngamaphulo. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwiganelo lokuhlola inkqubo kunye nemisebenzi yesebe. Ukuqeda ixesha lokubika kwamanyathelo aQ1 nakwaQ2, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusayina nguDG okanye lowo amiselweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukunikezelwa kweengxelo kwiNkqubo yoLawulo loMbindi, kwi-DPME nakwi-National Treasury. Ukuhlola umthetho wokuvelisa ingxelo yamanyathelo ezingafinyelelwanga ngokwamanyathelo eQ1 nokuba mbi nakwiQ2. Ukuqhuba iinkqubo zokulungiselela abasebenzi kwimigaqo yokubika ngokwamanyathelo eQ1 nakwiQ2. Ukuhlola nokuqokelela iinkqubo zokuvelisa iingxelo kwinkqubo yoLawulo loMbindi nakwiKomiti yeSebe. Ukuhlola iinkqubo zokubika kwamanyathelo eQ1, eQ2, eQ3, eQ4, kunye neQ1. Ukuqokelela nokuqinisekisa ukuzinikela kweengxelo kwinkqubo yamanyathelo eQ1, eQ2, eQ3, eQ4, nakwiQ1.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Support monitoring and evaluation of departmental programmes and coordinate quarterly performance reporting for the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate/ NQF 4 or equivalent qualification. A minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Monitoring and Evaluation/ Public Administration/ Public Management/ Public Governance/ Internal Auditing/ Statistics/ Data Management or any relevant Monitoring and Evaluation qualification. 2-3 years relevant experience and (at least 2 years at a Senior/ Practitioner/ Officer level) in data analysis, data auditing, monitoring, evaluation and reporting environment. Knowledge and understanding of Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, PFMA and relevant legislations. Knowledge and understanding of Monitoring and Evaluation Frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of data collection and data analysis. Knowledge of departmental policies and procedures. Research skills. Facilitation and presentation skills. Problem solving and analytical thinking skills. Planning and organising skills. Good communication and Interpersonal relations. Change management skills. Computer literacy. Ability to work in a Team and independently. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: To provide support for monitoring and evaluating departmental programmes. and projects. Assisting in the coordination of the development and review of the Departmental Quarterly Performance Reports: Coordinate and send out meeting invites for branch review sessions as well as the Departmental review session. Prepare agendas for quarterly review sessions. Prepare quarterly reporting templates for relevant Programmes. Make inputs for TID and targets in the Barnowl system. Review evidence submitted by relevant Programmes. Prepare feedback report to be used as discussion document during quarterly review sessions for relevant Programmes. Capture quarterly report for relevant Programmes. on the DPME EQPR system. Prepare minutes for review session for relevant Programmes and the Departmental review session. Prepare demographic reports for relevant indicators. Respond to audit queries from Internal Audit. Prepare statistical report for women, youth and people with disabilities. Prepare a quarterly deviation register to report progress on targets that were not achieved. Coordinate submission of beneficiary details for projects under relevant programmes. Prepare PMER presentation. Facilitate the development of monitoring and evaluation reports: Prepare the annual report review report template for relevant programmes. Review evidence submitted by the relevant Programmes. Prepare feedback report to be used as discussion document during review sessions for the relevant Programmes. Capture quarterly report for the relevant Programmes on the DPME EQPR system. Respond to audit queries from Internal Audit. Prepare documents/information for submission to AGSA in response to the requests for information. Coordinate SCM processes for appointment of a service provider that will develop the annual report. Develop the task directive for the appointment of a service provider. Develop a workplan for annual report project. Coordinate and review annual report inputs from various units in the Department. Liaise with service provider for the design and layout of the annual report. Review the annual report from the service provider and provide further inputs/ changes/ corrections. Assist in the development of the ENE Mid-Term report: Receive reporting template from the relevant unit. Assist in coordinating inputs for Estimated of National Expenditure (ENE) Mid Term report from the relevant programmes. Consolidate, capture and verify performance information on the template. Submit to the budget unit. Coordinate development and review of standard operating procedures: Assist with the development and updating of the M&E database / systems. Assist in reviewing SOPs for the relevant programmes. Develop SOP report (tracking tool). Review of SOP evidence for the relevant programmes. Coordinate the development of criteria/selection document for the relevant Programmes. Develop APP AND TID assessment report. Verify and validate data captured on the M&E databases and system. Assist in the development of quarterly operational plan reports: Assist with the review of data Management guidelines. Develop quarterly reporting templates for the relevant programmes. Review evidence submitted by the relevant Programmes. Develop operational plan reports for the relevant Programmes. Develop operational plan presentations for the relevant Programmes.

zu.title: Ongezinqindi: Ukuqapha Nokuhlola
zu.summary: Sika ukusekela ukuqapha nokuhlola izinhlela zomnyango futhi uhlolelanise okubikwa ngakhona ngokusebenza kwikota kuDepartment of Sport, Arts and Culture ePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 Certificate/NQF 4 noma izifundo ezingulinganisayo. I-National Diploma (izinga le-NQF 6) eyiminyaka emithathu noma i-Degree (izinga le-NQF 7) evunyelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Monitoring and Evaluation/Public Administration/Public Management/Public Governance/Internal Auditing/Statistics/Data Management noma noma yisiphi isifundo esihambisana no-Monitoring and Evaluation. Ukuze ube neminyaka engu-2-3 yesiphephelo esihambisana nalokhu futhi (okungenani iminyaka engu-2 ezingeni lama-Senior/Practitioner/Officer) kwindawo yokuhlaziya idatha, ukuhlola idatha, ukuqapha, ukuhlola nokubika. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Service Regulations, i-Public Service Act, i-PFMA nemithetho ehambisana nalokho. Ulwazi nokuqonda amasikhululo wo-Monitoring and Evaluation. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuqoqa nokuhlaziya idatha. Ulwazi ngemigomo nangamalungiselelo omnyango. Amakhono okucwaninga. Amakhono okuhola izingxoxo nokubonisa. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda ngokuhlaziya. Amakhono okwelula nokuhlela. Ukuxhumana kahle nabantu. Amakhono okuphatha inguquko. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nodwa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxuzu.
zu.duties: Ukunikela inkxaso yokuqapha nokuhlola izinhlela zomnyango. kanye namaphrojekthi. Ukusiza ekuhlolelweni kokuthuthukiswa nokubuyekezwa kwemibiko yokusebenza kwikota yomnyango: Hlolelanisa uthumele izimemo zomhlangano wamaseshini okubuyekeza igatsha kanye neseseshini yokubuyekeza komnyango. Lungiselela ajenda yamaseshini okubuyekeza kwikota. Lungiselela amathempleythi okubika kwikota ahambisana namaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Faka okufakiwe ama-TID kanye namajoni kusistimu ye-Barnowl. Buza ubufakazi obuthunywe amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Lungiselela umbiko we-feedback ongasetshenziswa njengoxhoxho lwemibuzo ngesikhathi seseshini yokubuyekeza kwikota amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Faka umbiko wekhota yamaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. kusistimu ye-DPME EQPR. Lungiselela amaminethi eseshini yokubuyekeza amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo nesesishini sokubuyekeza komnyango. Lungiselela imibiko yedatha yabantu abachazwe ngobuhlobo namajoni ahambisanayo. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlola evela ku-Internal Audit. Lungiselela umbiko wezibalo ngabesifazane, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile. Lungiselela irejista yokuqhosha kwikota ukubika inqubo kwamajoni angafinyelelwa. Hlolelanisa ukuthunyelwa kwezinkcukacha zabenikeli bamaphrojekthi phansi kwamaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Lungiselela okubonwayo kwe-PMER. Siza ekuthuthukiseni imibiko yokuqapha nokuhlola: Lungiselela ithempleyithi yombiko wokubuyekeza kombiko wonyaka wephrojekthi ahambisanayo. Buza ubufakazi obuthunywe amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Lungiselela umbiko we-feedback ongasetshenziswa njengoxhoxho lwemibuzo ngesikhathi seseshini yokuqapha namaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Faka umbiko wekhota yamaphrojekthi ahambisanayo kusistimu ye-DPME EQPR. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlola evela ku-Internal Audit. Lungiselela amaxhoxho/ulwazi okuthunyelwa ku-AGSA njengempendulo kumasweli olwazi. Hlolelanisa inqubo ye-SCM yokubeka abanikeli besevisi abazothuthukisa umbiko wonyaka. Thuthukisa umyalo wemisebenzi wokubeka umnikeli besevisi. Thuthukisa ipulani yomsebenzi yamaphrojekthi ombiko wonyaka. Hlolelanisa futhi ubuyekeze okufakiwe kombiko wonyaka kumayunithi ahlukene kuMnyango. Xhumana nomnikeli besevisi mayelana nokwakheka kwombiko wonyaka. Buza umbiko wonyaka ovela kumnikeli besevisi futhi unikeze okufakiwe/izinguquko/izilungiso ezeqisayo. Siza ekuthuthukiseni kombiko wakwa-ENE Mid-Term: Yamaza ithempleyithi yokubika kuyunithi ahambisanayo. Siza ekuhlolelweni kokufaka okuhambisana kombiko wakwa-Estimated of National Expenditure (ENE) Mid Term ovela kumaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Qoqa, faka futhi qinisekise ulwazi ngokusebenza kwentemplheyithi. Thumela kuyunithi yebhajethi. Hlolelanisa ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekezwa kwamasistimu aqavile okusebenza: Siza ekuthuthukiseni nangokubuyekeza idathhebhezi/sistimu ye-M&E. Siza ekubuyekezeni ama-SOP amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Thuthukisa umbiko we-SOP (isixhosi sokuqapha). Buza ubufakazi be-SOP bamaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Hlolelanisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemigidingo/umbiko wokukhetha amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Thuthukisa umbiko wokuqikiza i-APP nama-TID. Qinisekisa futhi uqinise umbiko ofakiwe kudathhebhezi namasistimu ye-M&E. Siza ekuthuthukiseni kwemibiko yeplani yokusebenza yekota: Siza ekuhlolisweni kwemiyalelo ephatha idatha. Thuthukisa amathempleyithi wokubika kwikota amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Buza ubufakazi obuthunywe amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Thuthukisa imibiko yeplani yokusebenza amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo. Thuthukisa okubonwayo kweplani yokusebenza amaphrojekthi ahambisanayo.

xh.summary: Nika inkxaso ekulandeleni nasekuqwalaselweni iinkqubo zesebe uze ulungelelanise ingxelo yentshukumo yenyanga ezintathu yeSebe loMzamo, ezobugcisa naseNkcubeko ePretoria.

Ulwazi nokuqqonda ukuthatha kolwazi nokuqhathanisa kolwazi. Ulwazi ngamagqabantshishi nangendlela ezisetyenziswa kwisebe. Amakhono okuphanda. Amakhono okulungelelanisa nokuvelisa. Amakhono oxazululo ziingxaki nokuqwalasela ngokucangcazela. Amakhono olungelelwaniso nokuqwalasela. Unxibelelwano olululo nokuhambelana nabantu. Amakhono olawulo lwenguquko. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza njengesiqinga nokusebenza nodwa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngexesha elinzima.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngokulandela nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zesebe. kunye namaphulo. Unxibelelwano ekuthuthuzweni nasekuhlaziyweni kweNgxelo yesebe yentshukumo yenyanga ezintathu: Lungiselelanisa uthumela izimemo zeminyhadala yokuhlanganiselwa ukuvavanywa kweziqendu kunye nesiqendwana sesebe. Lungiselela i-ajenda yeminyhadala yokuqwalasela yenyanga ezintathu. Lungiselela iitempleyiti zokubika kwexesha ngalinye zeziqendu ezihambelanayo. Nikela ngemvaphulo ye-TID nemiqobo kwindlela ye-Barnowl. Qwalasela ubungqina obunikezelwe ziiqendu ezihambelanayo. Lungiselela ingxelo yemibuyiso eza kusetyenziswa njengoxwebhu locandelo kwiminyhadala yokuqwalasela yenyanga ezintathu. Qamba ingxelo yenyanga ezintathu. kwinkqabo ye-DPME EQPR. Bhala imizuzu yeminyhadala yokuqwalasela. Lungiselela iingxelo ezingabakho kumava ahlukeneyo. Phendula imibuzo yokuvavanya evela kuVavanyo langaphakathi. Lungiselela ingxelo ebalayo ngabasetyhini, intsimi nabantu abakhubazekileyo. Lungiselela irejista yentshukumo yenyanga ezintathu ukubika inkqubo kumgobo ongafunyaniswa. Lawula ulungelelwaniso ngolwazi ngabazuzi kumaphulo. Lungiselela i-PMER. Khokela ukuthuthuzwa kweengxelo zokulandela nokuqwalasela: Lungiselela itempleyiti yokubika kwengxelo yonyaka. Qwalasela ubungqina obunikwe iiqendu ezihambelanayo. Lungiselela ingxelo yemibuyiso eza kusetyenziswa njengoxwebhu. Bhala ingxelo yenyanga ezintathu kwinkqabo ye-DPME EQPR. Phendula imibuzo. Lungiselela amaxwebhu/inzululwazi eziza kuthunyelwa ku-AGSA. Lawula iinkqubo ze-SCM. Yenza umyalelo wokusebenza. Yenza iplen yokusebenza. Lungiselelanisa ukuvavanywa kolwazi olufakwa ngamaphaphu. Thintathinta nomalathiso wesebenziso. Qwalasela ingxelo. Yenza i-APP AND TID. Qinisekisa ukuqwalasela kolwazi. Yenza iingxelo zexesha ngenxaxheba.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Organisational Design and JOB
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role in Pretoria at the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture implementing organisational design and job evaluation support services, paying R487197 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/ Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate/ NQF level 4 or equivalent qualification. Minimum three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF Level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Management Services / Organisation and Work Study / Operations Management / Production Management/ Organisational Development/ Industrial Psychology or any relevant Organisational Development qualification. Job Evaluation Certificate and PERSAL Establishment Certificate are additional requirements. 2-3 years relevant experience (at least 2 years at a Senior/Officer/ Practitioner level) in organisational development, job evaluation and change management or any relevant organisation development environment. Knowledge of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, etc. Knowledge of Job evaluation and job grading processes. Knowledge and understanding of DPSA directives, circulars, PSCBC Resolutions etc. applicable to organisational development/change management environment. Knowledge and understanding of Organisational Design principles and techniques. Understanding of Code of Remuneration (CORE). Knowledge of Computer software (Excel, OrgPlus, Visio, PowerPoint, etc). Knowledge and understanding of Diversity management. Good communication and Interpersonal relation. Planning and organising skills. Problem solving skills. Interviewing and analytical thinking skills. Project Management skills. Facilitation and Presentation skills. Computer literate. Attention to detail. Ability to work independently and as a team. Ability to keep classified information.
jobs.duties: To implement an organisational development design and job evaluation support services. Monitor and coordinate the development and review of job descriptions: Coordinate the development, review, and maintenance of job descriptions as mandated by the DPSA or when necessary. Develop Job descriptions in line with the departmental structure. Identify job profiles to be developed and reviewed. Quality assures job descriptions for advertising. Conduct benchmarking of job descriptions in line with DPSA directives. Provide advisory and technical support to employees. Ensure all newly appointed employees have signed job descriptions. Maintain and update the job descriptions database. Assist with the development and review of job description policy, frameworks and guidelines. Coordinate the review and redesign processes and Change Management interventions: Coordinate organisational design, restructuring, and work study processes. Facilitate organisational functionality assessments. Collect, analyse, and consolidate organisational data to support organisational design and structural alignment processes. Coordinate the implementation of approved organisational structures and related change interventions. Facilitate the creation, abolition, and amendment of posts on PERSAL in line with approved organisational structures. Participate in the development and review of organisational structures, service delivery models, and establishment requirements. Prepare organisational design reports, presentation, recommendations, and submissions for approval. Support the implementation of change management initiatives arising from organisational restructuring and transformation processes. Coordinate and provide secretariat support to awareness session, meeting and forums. Monitor and conduct Job Evaluation process: Coordinate and facilitate the implementation of job evaluation processes within the department. Facilitate and establish the nomination and training of panel members within the department. Analyse, evaluate, and grade posts in a job according to the Public Service Job Evaluation System. Ensure provision of secretariat and administrative services to the job evaluation panel meeting. Identify and prioritise jobs to be evaluated. Maintain and monitor job evaluation register in line with the approved job evaluation outcomes. Conduct benchmarking of job descriptions and grading of levels in line with DPSA directives. Facilitate the implementation of DPSA directives, policies, and frameworks relating to job evaluation and grading. Coordinate the development and review of JE and job grading policy. Facilitate awareness sessions, workshops, and capacity-building initiatives on job evaluation systems, policies, and directives. Conduct and coordinate Organisational functionality assessments within the department. Coordinate organisational functionality and operational efficiency assessments. Gatheranalyse, and consolidate information and reports to support organisational assessment processes. Monitor progress and follow up on organisational improvement actions and recommendations. Participate in steering committee meetings and provide administrative and secretariat support where required. Coordinate meetings, information sessions and provide secretariat support. Compile information on the DPSA organisational assessment and reporting templates. Identify organisational gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities to enhance service delivery. Utilise AI tools to draft organisational reports, Support AI- assisted business process mapping and workflow optimisation initiatives. Evaluate opportunities to automate routine organisational reporting and administrative processes using approved digital technologies. Keep abreast of emerging AI technologies and recommend practical applications that improve organisational effectiveness and service delivery Coordinate the development and implementation of business processes management: Coordinate the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s) for the approved departmental operational plan. Coordinate the compilation list of internal Business Processes for each unit. Facilitate the analysis and mapping of business processes of approved SOPs of the approved operational plan. Coordinate the compilation and maintenance of departmental business process registers. Obtain relevant approvals for developed SOPs and business process documentation. Compile approved departmental business process reports. To manage and provide organisational development and design services to support organisational effectiveness within the Department. legislative prescripts.

jobs.notes: Please create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credentials. Once registration is complete, log in to the system and you will be directed to the “Welcome Page”. From the Welcome Page, you may browse all vacant positions opportunities listed below. Applicants are strongly advised to complete all information required for the electronic Z83 form on the system before applying for any position. The Z83 form has been adopted into the system, and applications cannot be processed unless all mandatory fields are completed. After completing your profile and Z83 information, you may apply for any relevant advertised position through the system. Ensure that your application is fully completed and submitted before the closing date, as incomplete or late applications will not be considered. Once submitted, the system will provide a confirmation message indicating that your application has been successfully received. The e- Recruitment portal is also accessible via smartphones and other mobile devices. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Organisasie-ontwerp en JOB
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur-pos in Pretoria by die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture wat organisasie-ontwerp- en postevaluering-ondersteuningsdienste implementeer, teen R487197 per jaar.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/ Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate/ NQF level 4 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum driejaar-Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6)/ Degree (NQF Level 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Management Services / Organisation and Work Study / Operations Management / Production Management/ Organisational Development/ Industrial Psychology of enige relevante Organisational Development-kwalifikasie. Job Evaluation Certificate en PERSAL Establishment Certificate is bykomende vereistes. 2-3 jaar relevante ervaring (ten minste 2 jaar op 'n Senior/Officer/ Practitioner-vlak) in organisasie-ontwikkeling, postevaluering en veranderingsbestuur of enige relevante organisasie-ontwikkelingsomgewing. Kennis van Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, ens. Kennis van postevaluering en posgraderingsprosesse. Kennis en begrip van DPSA-riglyne, sirkulêres, PSCBC-resolusies ens. wat van toepassing is op die omgewing van organisasie-ontwikkeling/veranderingsbestuur. Kennis en begrip van organisasie-ontwerpbeginsels en -tegnieke. Begrip van Code of Remuneration (CORE). Kennis van rekenaarsagteware (Excel, OrgPlus, Visio, PowerPoint, ens). Kennis en begrip van diversiteitsbestuur. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Onderhoud- en analitiese denkvaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Fasilitasie- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Rekenaar geletterd. Aandag aan besonderhede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en as 'n span te werk. Vermoë om geklassifiseerde inligting te bewaar.
af.duties: Om organisasie-ontwikkelingsontwerp- en postevaluering-ondersteuningsdienste te implementeer. Monitor en koördineer die ontwikkeling en hersiening van posbeskrywings: Koördineer die ontwikkeling, hersiening en instandhouding van posbeskrywings soos deur die DPSA gemandaat of wanneer nodig. Ontwikkel posbeskrywings in ooreenstemming met die departementele struktuur. Identifiseer posprofiele wat ontwikkel en hersien moet word. Verseker kwaliteit van posbeskrywings vir advertensies. Voer belyning van posbeskrywings uit in ooreenstemming met DPSA-riglyne. Verskaf advies- en tegniese ondersteuning aan werknemers. Verseker dat alle nuut aangestelde werknemers posbeskrywings onderteken het. Onderhou en dateer die databasis van posbeskrywings op. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling en hersiening van posbeskrywingsbeleid, raamwerke en riglyne. Koördineer die hersiening en herontwerpprosesse en veranderingsbestuursintervensies: Koördineer organisasie-ontwerp, herstrukturering en werkstudie-prosesse. Fasiliteer organisasie-funksionaliteits评估ering. Versamel, ontleed en konsolideer organisasie-data om organisasie-ontwerp- en strukturele belyningsprosesse te ondersteun. Koördineer die implementering van goedgekeurde organisasiestrukture en verwante veranderingsintervensies. Fasiliteer die skepping, afskaffing en wysiging van poste op PERSAL in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde organisasiestrukture. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en hersiening van organisasiestrukture, dienslewingsmodelle en Establish vereistes. Berei organisasie-ontwerpsverslae, aanbiedings, aanbevelings en voorleggings vir goedkeuring voor. Ondersteun die implementering van veranderingsbestuursinisiatiewe wat voortspruit uit organisatoriese herstrukturering en transformasieprosesse. Koördineer en verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan bewusmakingsessies, vergaderings en forums. Monitor en voer postevalueringsprosesse uit: Koördineer en fasiliteer die implementering van postevalueringsprosesse binne die departement. Fasiliteer en vestig die nominasie en opleiding van paneellede binne die departement. Ontleed, evalueer en gradeer poste in 'n werk volgens die Public Service Job Evaluation System. Verseker die voorsiening van sekretariële en administratiewe dienste aan die postevalueringspaneelvergadering. Identifiseer en prioritiseer poste wat geëvalueer moet word. Onderhou en monitor postevalueringsregister in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde postevalueringsuitkomste. Voer belyning van posbeskrywings en gradering van vlakke uit in ooreenstemming met DPSA-riglyne. Fasiliteer die implementering van DPSA-riglyne, beleid en raamwerke met betrekking tot postevaluering en gradering. Koördineer die ontwikkeling en hersiening van JE- en posgraderingsbeleid. Fasiliteer bewusmakingsessies, werkswinkels en kapasiteitsbou-initiatiewe oor postevalueringstelsels, beleid en riglyne. Voer organisasie-funksionaliteitsassesserings uit en koördineer dit binne die departement. Koördineer organisasie-funksionaliteits- en bedryfdoeltreffendheidsassesserings. Versamel, ontleed en konsolideer inligting en verslae om organisasie-assesseringsprosesse te ondersteun. Monitor vordering en volg op op organisatoriese verbeteringsaksies en aanbevelings. Neem deel aan stuurkomitee-vergaderings en verskaf administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuning waar nodig. Koördineer vergaderings, inligtingsessies en verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning. Stel inligting op oor die DPSA-organisasie-assesserings- en verslaggewingsjablone. Identifiseer organisatoriese gapings, ondoeltreffendhede en verbeteringsgeleenthede om dienslewering te verbeter. Gebruik AI-instrumente om organisasie-verslae op te stel, Ondersteun AI-ondersteunde besigheidsproseskartering en werkstroomoptimasie-inisiatiewe. Evalueer geleenthede om roetine-organisasie-verslaggewing en administratiewe prosesse te outomatiseer met behulp van goedgekeurde digitale tegnologieë. Bly op hoogte van nuwe AI-tegnologieë en beveel praktiese toepassings aan wat organisatoriese doeltreffendheid en dienslewering verbeter. Koördineer die ontwikkeling en implementering van besigheidsprosesbestuur: Koördineer die ontwikkeling van Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's) vir die goedgekeurde departementele bedryfsplan. Koördineer die opstel van 'n lys van interne besigheidsprosesse vir elke eenheid. Fasiliteer die ontleding en kartering van besigheidsprosesse van goedgekeurde SOP's van die goedgekeurde bedryfsplan. Koördineer die opstel en instandhouding van departementele besigheidsprosesregisters. Verkry relevante goedkeurings vir ontwikkelde SOP's en besigheidsprosesdokumentasie. Stel goedgekeurde departementele besigheidsprosesverslae op. Bestuur en verskaf organisasie-ontwikkelings- en ontwerpsdienste om organisatoriese doeltreffendheid binne die departement te ondersteun. Wetgewende voorskrifte.

zu.title: Osomlilo: Ukwakheka Kolunye Lwemisebenzi Ne-JOB
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsizi weziqu e-Pretoria eMnyangeni wezemidlalo, ezobuciko namasiko, okuphatha ukwakheka kolunye lwemisebenzi kanye nezinkonzo zokwesekwa kokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi, okukhokha i-R487197 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikithelo esiphezulu / Isitifiketi se-Matric / Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 / Isitifiketi se-NQF level 4 noma iziqu ezingaqondaniswe. I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF level 6) / I-Degree (NQF Level 7) okuhlolwe iminyaka emithathu ebonwa ngu-SAQA kumasevisi eMphathazwe / Ukufunda Kolunye Nemisebenzi / Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza / Ukuphathwa Kokukhiqiza / Ukwakheka Kolunye / I-Psychology Yembono noma noma yisiphi isibambi esihambisana nokwakheka kolunye. Isitifiketi sokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi kanye nesitifiketi se-PERSAL Establishmentizindingo ezingeziwe. Ujahule iminyaka engu-2-3 ohlolweni oluhambisanayo (okungenani iminyaka emi-2 ezingeni le-Senior/Officer/ Practitioner) ekwakhekeni kolunye, ukuhlolwa kwemisebenzi nolawulwe ushintsho noma kunoma yisiphi isimo esihambisana nentuthuko kolunye. Ukwazi i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act, njn. Ukwazi inqubo yokuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi nokuqinisekiswa kwezinga lemisebenzi. Ukwazi futhi uqonde imiyalo ye-DPSA, izingcwephe, izinqumo ze-PSCBC, njn. esebenza emhlabeni wokwakheka kolunye/ulawulwe ushintsho. Ukwazi futhi uqonde izimiso nezindlela zokwakheka kolunye. Ukuqonda ikhodi lemvuzo (CORE). Ukwazi isoftwe yekhompyutha (Excel, OrgPlus, Visio, PowerPoint, njn). Ukwazi futhi uqonde ukuphathwa kobunye. Ukuxhumana okuhle nobudlelwano nabantu. Izindlela zokubheka phambili nokuhlela. Izindlela zokusombulula izinkinga. Izindlela zokubuziswa kanye nokuqonda ngokuhlaziya. Izindlela zokuphatha iphrojekthi. Izindlela zokubusa nokuvezwa. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqikelela ngobunyene. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela nangokuba yiqembu. Ikhono lokugcina ulwengo olulinganisiwe.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinkonzo zokwesekwa ekwakhekeni kolunye nokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi. Ukwenganyela nokuhlela inqubo yokwakheka nokubuyekeza inqubo emisebenzi: Ukwenganyela inqubo yokwakheka, ukubuyekeza kanye nokugcina ukuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi njengoba kushiwo yi-DPSA noma lapho kudingeka. Ukuthuthukisa inqubo emisebenzi ngokwezilinganiso zomnyango. Ukuthola amaphrofayela emisebenzi okufanele awuthuthukiswe abuyekeze. Ukuqinisekisa izinga lemininingwane yemisebenzi yokukhangisa. Ukwenza ukulinganiselwa kwemisebenzi ngokwezinkomba ze-DPSA. Ukunikeza izeluleko kanye nokesekwa ngobuchwepheshe abasebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi abasha basayinile inqubo emisebenzi. Ukugcina futhi ukuvuselela isisekelo sedatha yemisebenzi. Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni nakubuyekezeni inqulunqwa yemisebenzi, izakhiwo kanye neziqondiso. Ukuhlanganisa ukubuyekezwa kwezinqubo zokuphinda kwakhiwe kanye nokungenelela ukuqondisa ushintsho: Ukwenganyela ukwakheka kolunye, ukwakheka kabusha, kanye nezinqubo zokufunda umsebenzi. Ukubheka ukusebenza kolunye. Ukuqoqa, ukuhlaziya, futhi uhlanganise idatha yolunye ukusekela ukwakheka nokuqondanisa kwemilinganiso. Ukwenganyela ukuphathwa kwezilinganiso zolunye ezamukelekile kanye nokuqondisa ushintsho. Ukubheka ukwakheka, ukususwa, kanye nokulungiswa kwamaphosti e-PERSAL ngokwezilinganiso zolunye ezamukelekile. Ukubamba iqhaza ekwakhekeni nakubuyekezeni izilinganiso zolunye, izindlela zokuletha izinkonzo, kanye nezidingo zemitholwano. Ukwalunga izibali zokwakheka kolunye, ukwethula, izincomo, nokuthunywa ukuze samukeleke. Ukusekela ukusetshenziswa kolawulo ushintsho okuvela ekwakhekeni kabusha nasezinqubo zoshintsho. Ukwenganyela kanye nokusekela ukubhalisa kuzikhathi zokwazisa, kuhlangano, namaphoromu. Ukwenganyela nokwenza isinqubo sokuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi: Ukubheka ukuphathwa kolunye emhlabeni wokwakheka, ukuqalwe kolunye, futhi uhlele izinqubo zemisebenzi. Ukubheka futhi usungule ukubizwa nokwesekwa kwamalungu eqembu ngaphakathi komnyango. Ukwenza isilinganiso, ukuqinisekiswa, ukubuyekeza, nokulinganisa imisebenzi ngokwesistimu yokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi emkhakheni kahulumeni. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlinzeka ngokubhalisa kanye nesevisi yohlulo olulinganiswayo emhlanganweni weqembu lokuhlola imisebenzi. Ukuqonda futhi ukugqamisa imisebenzi okufanele ihlolwe. Ukugcina nokenganyela isibuko sokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi ngokweziphumo zokuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi ezamukelekile. Ukulinganisela inqulunqwa nemisebenzi nokuqinisekiswa kwezinkomba ze-DPSA. Ukubheka ukuphathwa kwezinkomba, izinqulunqwa, nezakhiwo ezihlobene nokuhlola nokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi. Ukubheka ukwakheka nokubuyekeza izinqulunqwa nokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi e-JE. Ukubheka izikhathi zokuqondisa, amawoksho, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kolunye ezinqubo, izinqulunqwa, kanye nezinkomba zokuqinisekiswa kwemisebenzi. Ukwenza futhi uhlanganise ukwenza izibuko sokusebenza kolunye ngaphakathi komnyango. Ukubheka ukusebenza kolunye kanye nokulinganiswa kokusebenza okuyimphumelelo. Ukuqoqa, ukuhlaziya, futhi uhlanganise ulwange namabhuku ukusekela ukulinganiswa kolunye. Ukwenganyela inqubo futhi ulandele izinyathelo zokuthuthukiswa kolunye kanye nezincomo. Ukubamba iqhaza kuhlangano lweqembu lokubheka futhi unikeze ukwesekwa ngohlulo nangokubhalisa lapho kudingeka khona. Ukubheka izinhlangano, izikhathi zokwazisa futhi unikeze ukwesekwa ngokubhalisa. Ukuqamba ulwange okhishwa yi-DPSA ezifanini zokuqinisekiswa nokubika. Ukuqonda izikhala zolunye, ukungezelelwa, namathuba okwenza ngcono ukuletha izinkonzo. Ukusebenzisa izinsiza ze-AI ekwakheni amabhuku olunye, ukusekela ukumakha amaphrothokholo omsebenzi nokuqonda ukuhlela kwe-AI. Ukuhlola amathuba okuzenzakalisa izibiko zemisebenzi nezinqubo zomsebenzi ngobuchwepheshe obuvunyiwe. Ukubheka okusha ngobuchwepheshe be-AI futhi uncome izinhlelo ezisebenza ngokomzimba ekwenzeni kolunye kungcono kwezinkonzo. Ukubheka ukuphathwa kwezinqubo zemisebenzi: Ukubheka ukuphathwa kwemithetho yokusebenza (SOP’s) yohlelo lomsebenzi olamukelekile. Ukuhlanganisa uhlu lwemisebenzi ngamunye. Ukuhlela ukusebenza kwemisebenzi yamaphrothokholo amukelekile. Ukuhlanganisa kanye nokugcina ukubhaliswa kohlelo lwemisebenzi. Ukuthola izigqibo ezifanele zokubhaliswa kwemisebenzi. Ukuqamba amabhuku womsebenzi ohleliwe. Ukuphatha kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokwakheka kolunye ukusekela ukuqonda okuhle emkhakheni. imithetho yokuhamba.

xh.title: uMlawuli oNcedisayo: uKwakha iNtlangano noMsebenzi
xh.summary: Indima kaMlawuli oNcedisayo ePretoria kwiSebe lezeMidlalo, iZobuBugcisa namasiko eNkonzo ezisebenzisa ulwazi lokuQhutywa koluntu olutsha nokuLinganisa imiSebenzi, ihlawula nge-R487197 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi ePhakamileyo / Isatifikethi seMatric / Isatifikethi soBhedu 12 / iNQF level 4 okanye izifundo ezincamathiselweyo. Isidiploma seSizwe (iNQF level 6) / iDigri (iNQF Level 7) eseminyakeni emithathu njengoko ivunywe yiSAQA kwiiNkonzo zoLawulo / iNtlangano noQhuto lweMisebenzi / uLawulo lweeNkonzo / uLawulo lweNkqubo / uPhuhliso lweNtlangano / iNdalo ngokomTlalo okanye naziphi na izifuno ezingathathwa ngokomTlalo weNtlangano. Isatifikethi soLinganiso loMsebenzi neseSiseko sePERSAL ziimFuno eNgezelelwa. Ulwazi oluFanelekileyo lonyaka (ubuncinane iya kwiminyaka emi-2 kwinqanaba loBhubathi/Onkathxi/umZuli) kwintlangano evelwayo, ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi nokoKutshintsha uLawulo okanye nakuphi na okuQwalathelwa kolwazi lokuQhutywa kwemisebenzi. UkuQonda iMigaqo yeNkonzo yaSixeko, iMigaqo yoLawulo iNkonzo yaSixeko, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yaSixeko, nokoKunye. ukuQonda iNkqubo yoLinganiso loMsebenzi nokuQwalaselwa kwamaNqanaba oMsebenzi. ukuQonda nokuQonda iMiyalelo kaDPSA, iiMiyalezo, iSigqibo soMthethomgaqo wePSCBC, nokoKunye ukuxhasa ulwazi lokuQhutywa koluntu olutsha ngokomTlalo weNtlangano. ukuQonda iimBono neenKqubo zoLawulo lweNtlangano. ukuQonda iMigaqo yeMali yaKho (iCORE). ukuQonda iSofthiwe yeKhompyutha (iExcel, iOrgPlus, iVisio, iPowerPoint, nokoKunye). ukuQonda nokuQonda uLawulo lweNtlongo. ukuNxibelelana okuHle noBudlelwano bomXhono. ukuQamba iNkqubo nokuhlela. iNkqubo yoKusombulula iNgxaki. ukuXoxwa nokuQonda okuPhezulu. iNkqubo yoLawulo loMsebenzi. ukuKhokela nokuBukiwa. ukuQonda iKhompyutha. ukuQwalaselwa iinkcukacha. ukuKwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela nangokwamaQela. ukuKwazi ukugcina ulwazi olufihliweyo.
xh.duties: Ukuze kusebenzise iinkonzo zokuxhasa ezinjengokwakha ukuqwalaselwa kwentlangano nokulinganiswa kwemisebenzi. Ukugqithisa nokuhlanganisa uphuhliso nokuphonononga iinkcazelo zemisebenzi: Hlanganisa uphuhliso, ukuphonononga, nokuqwalasela iinkcazelo zemisebenzi njengoko kulinwe nguDPSA okanye xa kunesidingo. Phuhlisa iinkcazelo zemisebenzi ngokwakho kwisakhiwo se-isebe. Chonga iiprofayile zemisebenzi eziza kuphuhliswa nokuphononongwa. Qinisekisa umgangatho weenkcazelo zemisebenzi eziza kwenziwa izikhangiso. Yenza imilinganiselo yeenkcazelo zemisebenzi ngokwemiqathango kaDPSA. Yaza unikeze inkxaso yengcebiso namalungiselelo abasebenzini. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi abatsha batyikitye iinkcazelo zemisebenzi. Qwalasela ukuze uvuselele idatabeyizi yeenkcazelo zemisebenzi. Nceda kuphuhliso nokuphonononga inkqubomgambiso, iinkqubo zokusebenza nemigaqo yeenkcazelo zemisebenzi. Hlanganisa iinkqubo zokuphonononga nokwenza ngokutsha ukuze kusebenze iinkcuPHuno zokuTyhilwa kweNtlangano: Hlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwentlangano, ukutshintsha inkqubo, neenkqubo zofundo lwemisebenzi. Khokela ikuvi yentlangano yokuqwalaselwa ukusebenza. Qokelela, hlalutywe, uze udibanise iingcombolo zentlangano ukuxhasa ukwakhiwa kwentlangano neenkqubo zokuqwalanisa isakhiwo. Hlanganisa ukusebenzisa iisakhiwo ezamkelweyo zentlangano nokuTyhilwa okuhambelanayo. Khokela ukudalwa, ukususwa, nokuTyhilwa kweesithuba kwi-PERSAL ngokweesakhiwo ezamkelweyo zentlangano. Thatha inxaxheba kuphuhliso nokuphonononga iisakhiwo zentlangano, iimodeli zokuNika iNkonzo, neemfuno zokuMiswa. Lungiselela iingxelo zokwakha intlangano, iNkcazelo, iingcebiso, neeNkqubo eziza kuMiswa. Xhasa ukusebenzisa iinKqubo zoTshintsho luBuntu olusuka kuloo nto kubakho ukuTshintshwa kweNtlangano neenKqubo zoGuqulo. Hlanganisa unikeze iNkxaso yeSikundo kwiNqanaba loQondo, kuqokelelwa iNtlango neeFom. Qwalasela uze usebenzise ukuLinganiswa koMsebenzi: Hlanganisa uze uKhokelo ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zokuLinganisa kwesithuba ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Khokela uze uMise ukuQwalaselwa nokuzinika iGama labaLunga beQela ngaphakathi kweSebe. Hlala uze uQwalasele, uLinganise, uze uNike iNqanaba kwiisithuba ngokweNkqubo yeSizwe yoLinganiso lweeSithuba sezeNkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuNikwa kweNkxaso yeSikundo neseZimo zoLawulo kwiQela loLinganiso lweeSithuba. Chonga uze uBeka phambili imiSebenzi eNokulungwa. Qwalasela uze uLandelisishe ukuBhaliswa kolinganiso lweeSithuba ngokweziPhumo eziPHELELEYO ezamkelweyo. Yenza imiLinganiselo yeNkcazelo yoMsebenzi neeNqanaba ngokwemiQathango kaDPSA. Khokela ukusebenzisa imiQathango, iNkqubo nemiGaqo kaDPSA eThinta uLinganiso loMsebenzi neeNqanaba. Hlanganisa uphuhliso nokuphonononga iNkqubo yoLinganiso loMsebenzi neNkqubo yokwabela amaNqanaba. Khokela ukuQonda, iinKqubo, iNqanaba loQondo kwiNkqubo, iNkqubo nokuQonda kolinganiso lweeSithuba. Yenza uze uHlanganise ikuvi yentlangano yokuQwalaselwa ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Hlanganisa ikuvi yentlangano yokuQwalaselwa ukusebenza nokuQwalaselwa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Qokelela-hlalutya, uze uDibanise iNgcUChama neeNgxelo ukuxhasa iinkqubo zokuQwalaselwa intlangano. Qwalasela ukuQhubeka phambili uze uLandele iNyaniso zokuPhucula iNtlangano neengceBo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkomfa yeeQela zoLawulo uze uNike iNkxaso yoLawulo neyeSikundo apho kufuneka khona. Hlanganisa iiNkomfa, iinKqubo zoQondo uze uNike iNkxaso yeSikundo. Hlela iNgcombolo kumacandelo oQwalaselwa nokuBika kuDPSA. Chonga iSikengeko, ukungasebenzi Ngokuchanekileyo, namathuba okuPhucula iNkonzo. Sebenzisa iiTools ze-AI ukubhala iingxelo zentlangano, Xhasa ukuzoba iNkqubo yoQhuto lweShishini nge-AI nokuQwalaselwa ukuze kusebenze ngokulungileyo. Qwalasela amathuba okuzenzakalela iingxelo eziqhelekileyo zentlangano neenKqubo zoLawulo ngokusebenzisa iiTechnologies eziBhalwe ngokutsha. Hlala uwazi ngeTechnology ye-AI eQhubekayo uze uNike iziSebelo eziSebenzayo eziPhucula ukusebenza kweNtlangano neNkonzo. Hlanganisa uphuhliso nokusebenzisa iNkqubo yoLawulo lweeNkqubo zoShishino: Hlanganisa uphuhliso lweeNkqubo eziQhutywa ngokutsha (iSOPs) zoLwamkelo lweNdlela yoLawulo yesebe. Hlanganisa ukuHlela uLuhlu lweNkqubo zoShishino zeNgaphakathi kwesiQongo ngasinye. Khokela ukuHlalutya nokuZoba iNkqubo zoShishino kweSOPs eziMmelwe yoLwamkelo lweNdlela yoLawulo. Hlanganisa ukuHlela nokuQwalaselwa kweerekhodi zeeNkqubo zoShishino yesebe. Fumana iimVume eziFanelekileyo kweSOPs ezididiyelweyo nakwikcHwecwe leNkqubo yoShishino. Hlela iingxelo zeNkqubo yoShishino yesebe eMmisiweyo. Ukulawula nokuNika iNkonzo yoLwakho lweNtlangano noKwakhiwa ukuxhasa ukusebenza kwentlangano kwiSebe. iNkqubo eMmisiweyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Administration
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Administration at the Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria, facilitating recruitment, conditions of service, and terminations.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate /Grade 12 Certificate/ NQF 4 or equivalent qualification Minimum Three-year National Diploma (NQF level 6) /Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Human Resource Management/ Public Management and Administration/ Industrial Psychology or any relevant Human Resource Management qualification. PERSAL Administration Certificate and Leave Administration Certificate are additional requirements-3 years relevant experience (at least 2 years at an HR Officer/ HR Practitioner level) in recruitment & selection, conditions of service, employee benefits and administration or any human resource administration environment. Knowledge and understanding of the Human Resource Management Framework. Knowledge of HR policies, procedures and implementation strategies. Knowledge and understanding of relevant Directives. Knowledge of Public Service Resolutions, Public Service Act and relevant legislation and prescripts. Knowledge and understanding of PERSAL System. Good communication and interpersonal relations. Problem solving skills. Analytical skills. Computer and digital literacy. Numeracy skills. Planning and organizing skills.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the administration of Recruitment and Selection processes Facilitate the administration of conditions of services, remuneration and employee benefits. Facilitate the processing of appointments, promotions, and transfers to the Department, Facilitate the process of Terminations of Service and Transfers from the Department to another. Provide overall supervision and guidance to subordinates. Contribute toward the digitization and automation of HR processes and systems.
jobs.applications: Applicants must use this link or QR code below to access DSAC E-Recruitment System: https://erecruit.dsac.gov.za/public/login_test.php Hand delivery: Sealed envelope addressed to Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Sechaba House, 202 Madiba Street, Pretoria Central. Postal mail to The Chief Director: Human Resource Management and Development, Private Bag X897, Pretoria, 0001.
jobs.notes: Please create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credentials. Once registration is complete, log in to the system and you will be directed to the “Welcome Page”. From the Welcome Page, you may browse all vacant positions opportunities listed below. Applicants are strongly advised to complete all information required for the electronic Z83 form on the system before applying for any position. The Z83 form has been adopted into the system, and applications cannot be processed unless all mandatory fields are completed. After completing your profile and Z83 information, you may apply for any relevant advertised position through the system. Ensure that your application is fully completed and submitted before the closing date, as incomplete or late applications will not be considered. Once submitted, the system will provide a confirmation message indicating that your application has been successfully received. The e- Recruitment portal is also accessible via smartphones and other mobile devices. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to bring certified copies of ID, Driver’s licence (where required) and qualifications on or before the interview. Should you be in possession of any foreign qualification(s), it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA); Applicants must be South African citizens. Shortlisted candidates must avail themselves for a virtual or in-person panel interview at a date and time determined by DSAC. The applicant should make own arrangement for access to internet connectivity and equipment for this purpose. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks and references will be conducted once they are shortlisted. The appointment is also subject to a positive outcome on these checks, including security clearance, security vetting, qualification/study verification, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, previous employment verification and criminal record. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. We encourage all applicants to declare any criminal and/or negative credit records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and sign an annual performance agreement. The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its Employment Equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of these posts. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes, thus withdrawing this advert by notice on its communication channels. If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie by die Department of Sport, Arts and Culture in Pretoria, wat werwing, diensvoorwaardes en diensbeëindigings fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 Certificate/NQF 4 of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Minimum driejaar- Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6)/Degree (NQF vlak 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Public Management and Administration/Bedryfsielkunde of enige relevante Menslike Hulpbronbestuur-kwalifikasie. Isitifiketi se-PERSAL Administration nesika-Leave Administration yizidingo ezingeziwe. Unyaka woku-3 wokuhlola okuhambisanayo (okungenani unyaka woku-2 ezingeni lama-HR Officer/HR Practitioner) ekubumbeni abasebenzi nokuqasha, izimeni zokusebenza, izinzuzo zabasebenzi nangokuphathwa noma nanoma yisiphi isikhungo sokuphathwa kwemithombo yabantu. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Human Resource Management Framework. Ulwazi ngemigomo ye-HR, izinqamuleli nezindlela zokuzezulula. Ulwazi nokuqonda imiyalo ephathelene naleyo ndawo. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Resolutions, i-Public Service Act nangomthetho ochazayo ophathelene nalokhu. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PERSAL System. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokwakha ubuhlobo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ulwazi ngemikhando yezibali kanye nokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Amakhono okubala. Amakhono okucubungula futhi uhlele.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuphathwa kwenqubo yokubumba abasebenzi nokuqasha. Qondisa ukuphathwa kwezimo zokusebenza, inkokhelo nezinzuzo zabasebenzi. Qondisa ukuqashwa, ukukhushulwa, kanye nokudluliselwa kubasebenzi kulo mnyango. Qondisa inqubo yokuphela kwesivumelwano sokusebenza nokudluliselwa abasebenzi kusuka kulo mnyango kuya kwelinye. Nika abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho ukugada nokuhola okuphelele. Yisisekelo ekwenzeni izinto zangomakhompyutha nangokusikela emisebenzini yamakhompyutha kwezinqubo namasistimu e-HR.

jobs.summary: Environmental Officer providing integrated environmental services and oversight to area offices within the Northern Operations at Hartbeespoort.
jobs.requirements: A relevant Honours Degree in Environmental Science or relevant qualification at NQF level 8) coupled with a minimum of three (3) years working experience post the required qualification. The disclosure of valid unexpired driver’s license. Experience in any of the following fields will service as an added advantage: Environmental Science / Water Resource Management / Environmental Law/Natural Resource Economics / Occupational Health and Safety and Construction Health and Safety. Professional registration as an Environmental Assessment Practitioner (EAP) will be an added advantage. Knowledge in compliance monitoring and enforcement. Working knowledge of National Water Act, 1998 (Act no. 36 of 1998) and related policies. Working knowledge of relevant Environmental Management legislation and related policies. Working knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Act and construction regulations. Knowledge and understanding of Integrated Water Resources Management. Understanding of PFMA and Treasury regulations 16. Knowledge of safety of Sport and Recreation events in terms of the National Water Act. Ability to review technical and scientific reports and provide recommendations. Exposure to construction environment management, technical report writing skills. Ability to provide technical and scientific support to Department of Water and Sanitation units and other government departments. Professional judgement. Good communication, presentation and networking skills. People management skills, planning, organising, conflicts and change management. Excellent problem solving and analysis. The ability to work independently, to interact with communities, professional service providers (PSPs) and planning partners in the water sector. Willing to travel extensively and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Provide support and oversight to three Area offices within the Northern Operations, namely: Hartbeespoort Area Office, Groblersdal Area Office and Tzaneen Area office at Technical Services sub-directorate. To provide integrated environmental services towards the development, maintenance, rehabilitation and refurbishment of bulk water infrastructure including operations and maintenance projects in Civil, Mechanical and Electrical for three Area Offices. This includes amongst others, the undertaking of environmental legislative screening assessment and compile terms of reference for the appointment of environmental assessment practitioners and related services. Compilation of environmental management plans. Provide environmental, health and safety inputs during the planning and construction phase of projects Conduct environmental audits for bulk water infrastructure and operations and maintenance projects. Conduct site inspections, undertake both routine and special inspections and generate technical and monitoring reports. Assist in developing and implementation of commercial recreational and recreational water use policies and guidelines. Implementation of other related legislation dealing with access and use of State Dams. Give inputs on applications for commercial recreational water use at State Dams especially with regards to PFMA and Treasury Regulations 16 requirements. Conduct routine monitoring for GWWs under the management of Northern Operations.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Spesialiseerde Produksie Graad a
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte wat geïntegreerde omgewingsdienste en toesig aan area-kantore binne die Noordelike Operasies by Hartbeespoort bied.
af.requirements: 'n Terugwende Honneursgraad in Omgewingswetenskap of 'n relevante kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 8) tesame met 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar werkervaring na die vereiste kwalifikasie. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring in enigeen van die volgende velde sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien: Omgewingswetenskap / Waterhulpbronbestuur / Omgewingsreg / Natuurlike Hulpbronnekonomie / Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en Konstruksiegesondheid en Veiligheid. Professionele registrasie as 'n Omgewingsassesseringspraktisyn (EAP) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van nakomingsmonitering en -handhawing. Werkende kennis van die Nasionale Waterwet, 1998 (Wet no. 36 van 1998) en verwante beleide. Werkende kennis van relevante Omgewingsbestuurswetgewing en verwante beleide. Werkende kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en konstruksieregulasies. Kennis en begrip van Geïntegreerde Waterhulpbronbestuur. Begrip van die PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies 16. Kennis van die veiligheid van Sport- en Ontspanningsgebeure in terme van die Nasionale Waterwet. Vermoë om tegniese en wetenskaplike verslae te hersien en aanbevelings te doen. Blootstelling aan konstruksie-omgewingsbestuur, vaardighede in tegniese verslagskrywing. Vermoë om tegniese en wetenskaplike ondersteuning aan Department of Water and Sanitation-eenhede en ander regeringsdepartemente te bied. Professionele oordeel. Goeie kommunikasie, aanbiedings- en netwerkvaardighede. Mensebestuursvaardighede, beplanning, organisering, konflik- en veranderingbestuur. Uitstekende probleemoplossing en analise. Die vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, met gemeenskappe, professionele diensverskaffers (PSP's) en beplanningsvennote in die watersektor te skakel. Bereid om wyd te reis en onreëlmatige ure te werk.
af.duties: Bied ondersteuning en toesig aan drie Area-kantore binne die Noordelike Operasies, naamlik: Hartbeespoort Area-kantoor, Groblersdal Area-kantoor en Tzaneen Area-kantoor by die Tegniese Dienste-subdirektoraat. Om geïntegreerde omgewingsdienste te bied ten opsigte van die ontwikkeling, instandhouding, rehabilitasie en opknapping van bulkwaterinfrastruktuur, insluitend bedryfs- en instandhoudingsprojekte in Siviel, Meganies en Elektries vir drie Area-kantore. Dit sluit onder andere die uitvoer van omgewingswetgewende siftingsassesserings in en die opstel van terme van verwysing vir die aanstelling van omgewingsassesseringspraktisyne en verwante dienste. Opstel van omgewingsbestuursplanne. Bied omgewings-, gesondheids- en veiligheidsinsette tydens die beplannings- en konstruksiefase van projekte. Voer omgewingsoudits uit vir bulkwaterinfrastruktuur en bedryfs- en instandhoudingsprojekte. Voer terreininspeksies uit, onderneem beide roetine- en spesiale inspeksies en genereer tegniese en moniteringsverslae. Bystand verleen aan die ontwikkeling en implementering van kommersiële ontspannings- en ontspanningswatergebruiksbeleide en -riglyne. Implementering van ander verwante wetgewing wat toegang tot en gebruik van Staatsdamme reel. Verskaf insette oor aansoeke vir kommersiële ontspanningswatergebruik by Staatsdamme, veral met betrekking tot PFMA- en Tesourie-regulasies 16-vereistes. Voer rooutine-monitering uit vir GWW's onder die bestuur van die Noordelike Operasies.

Ulwazi lokusebenza ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act nemithetho yokuqinisekiswa yokwakha. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNtuthuko Eholayo Yamathambo Amanzi. Ukuqonda i-PFMA nemithetho yeTreasury regulations 16. Ulwazi ngokuphepha kwezinkathi ze Sport and Recreation ngokusho komthetho weNational Water Act. Ikhono lokubuka kabusha imibiko yobuchwepheshe nesesayensi futhi unikeze izincomo. Ukuvezwa ekuphathweni kwezemvelo zokwakha, amakhono okubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ikhono lokunika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe nesesayensi kwamayunithi eDepartment of Water and Sanitation nanakwamanye amaphoyili kahulumeni. Ukwahlulela ngobungcweti. Amakhono anhle okuxhumana, okubamba iqhaza nokuxhumana noxhumano. Amakhono okuphatha abantu, ukweluleka, ukuhlela, ukupatha izinkinga kanye nokuphatha inguquko. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda okuhle kakhulu. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa, ukuxhumana nomphakathi, abanikezinkxaso abangcweti (PSPs) nabalinganiseli abahlelangana kwindawo yamathambo amanzi. ukuba ulungele ukuhamba kakhulu futhi usebenze amahora angajwayelekile.
zu.duties: ukunika inkxaso nokuqapha amahhovisi amathathu endawo ahlethwe kuHlelo Lokusebenza OluseNyakatho, okuyilawa: Hartbeespoort Area Office, Groblersdal Area Office and Tzaneen Area office ephandle elinganeni le Technical Services. Ukunika imisebenzi ehlanganiswe yezemvelo ekuthuthukisweni, ukugcinweni, ukuvuselelweni nokulungisweni kwemiyalo ebanzi yamathambo amanzi kuhlanganise imisebenzi yokuphatha nokugcina kwi Civil, Mechanical and Electrical kwamahhovisi amathathu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa kwezinye, ukwenza isilinganiso sokubuka umthetho wezemvelo kanye nokubhala izinhloso zokuqasha abaphathi bokuqonda imvelo nanamanye imisebenzi ehambisanayo. Ukubhala imigodo yokuphatha imvelo. Ukunika okungenayo mayelana nemvelo, impilo nokuphepha esikhathini sokuhlela nokwakha imisebenzi. Ukwenza ukuhlola imvelo kwemiyalo ebanzi yamathambo amanzi kanye nemisebenzi yokuphatha nokugcina. Ukwenza ukuqapha endaweni, ukwenza ukuqapha kokujwayelekile nakokungajwayelekile futhi udale imibiko yobuchwepheshe nokuqapha. Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni nokuqashweni kwezinqubo zokusebenzisa amanzi okuzijabulisa nokuvakasha kwentengiselwano kanye namagunya okuzijabulisa. Ukuqasha eminye imithetho ehambisanayo ngokuphathwa kokusetshenziswa kwe State Dams. Ukunika okungenayo kuleso sibhalo sokusebenzisa amanzi okuzijabulisa kwentengiselwano kwi State Dams ikakhulukazi ngokuthintana ne PFMA nemithetho ye Treasury Regulations 16. Ukwenza ukuqapha kwansuku zonke kwamakhono aseGWWs aphathwe ku Northern Operations.

xh.title: Iofisa yendalo eKhethekileyo kwiNkqubo yoKukhiqiza inqanaba a
xh.summary: Iofisa yendalo ebonelela ngeenkonzo ezahlulahluleni zendalo nolawulo kwiiofisi ezindawweni ngaphakathi kuNqamlezweni kuMisebenzi woMantla eHartbeespoort.
xh.requirements: IDigri yeHonours ezahlukeneyo kwiZenzululwazi zeNdalo okanye isiqu esifanelekileyo kumgangatho we-NQF level 8) edibene nokuba nobani eminye iminyaka emi-3 (3) yamava okusebenza emva kokufumana isiqu esifunekayo. Ukutyhila ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo nengangaphelelanga. Amandla kunye nolawulo. Amandla okusebenza okanye ulawulo kwikhompyutha. Amava kulo naliphi na kulawula amanye amava oqeqesho lwemisebenzi. Isikhongozeli soLuntu oluSebenzayo. Ukuqonda kwimigaqo-phendulwano esebenzayo nangokumisela inkqubo yokulawula imisebenzi. Ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo ekufezekiseni iinjongo zoNgcino lweMfuyo noLwazi. Amandla okusebenza ngokuzimela nangaphantsi kwesithintelo. Amandla okuxelelana kakuhle nakwabantu abahlukeneyo. Amava kunye nokuvakalelwa kwimfuno yokwakha amakhonco. Amandla okuqamba iingcamango ezintsha ngezinto ezifanelekileyo. Isiqu kwizifundo eziphelayo nakulawulo lwemisebenzi. Amandla okukwazi ukulawula nokuqonda iindlela ezahlukene zokwenza imisebenzi.
xh.duties: Kubonelelwa ngenkxaso nolawulo kwiiofisi ezintathu zoMmandla ngaphakathi kuMisebenzi yoMantla, oko kukuthi: Iofisi yoMmandla weHartbeespoort, Iofisi yoMmandla weGroblersdal ne Iofisi yoMmandla weTzaneen kwesebe ngaphantsi kweNkonzo yeNzululwazi. Ukubonelela ngeenkonzo ezahlulahlulene zendalo ekuqokeleleni, ukugcina, ukulungisa nokulungisa iziseko ezinkulu zolwazi lwamanzi kuquka imisebenzi yokusebenza nokugcina kwiNkqubo yoMmandla weHartbeespoort, weGroblersdal noweTzaneen. Oku kuquka phakathi kwabanye, ukwenza isilinganiselo sokuhlola imigaqo yomthetho yendalo nokuhlela amagama okumisela ukuba bagqithiswe abantu abaqhuba iintluphalo zendalo ngeenkonko ezinxulumene naloo nto. Ukuqokelela iindaba ezimalunga noLuntu noLwazi olusekelwe kwimigaqo yomthetho. Kubonelelwa ngesingeniso ngeendalo, impilo yokhuseleko nakwiNdlela ezingoMmandla weHartbeespoort, weGroblersdal noweTzaneen kwindawo yokwenza imisebenzi yokusebenza nokugcina izinto ezinkulu zamaza. Kufuneka kwenziwe iindaba ezimalunga noLuntu noLwazi olusekelwe kwimigaqo yomthetho.

jobs.title: Administration Officer (HRM)
jobs.summary: Administration Officer in HRM at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Potchefstroom, supervising human resource administration practices including recruitment, registry, and HRD.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma or Degree in Public Management/ Administration/ Human Resources Management or relevant qualification. One (1) to (3) three years relevant experience in Administration or Human Resources. Computer Literacy. PERSAL Certificates. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge and experience in HR processes and legislation. Basic financial management. Knowledge of PFMA and management skills. Problem solving skills and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientated and customer focus. Good communication skills both (verbal and written) Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Supervise and undertake the more complex implementation and maintenance of Human resource administration practices, HRA, HRD, Registry, Recruitment and selection. Handle Human resource administration enquiries HRA, HRD, registry, recruitment and selection. Supervisor human resources staff. Manage and Administer personnel management and administration function within the Area Office. Manage and Administer Human Resources function and office support services. Manage and Administer HRD, training coordination of PMDS. Manage and administer leave management. Manage and Administer service conditions. Recruitment, Selection and Appointment. Provide HR and policy advisory service to all employees within the area office. Ensure that all reports are submitted within the financial year closure. Manage, supervise and develop staff within Corporate Services. Manage and administer Corporate Services functions within the Area office. Manage and administer transport and travel in line with departmental policies. Manage and administer corporate services budget and give budget inputs.

jobs.notes: Candidates must complete a practical and theoretical test. Please be advised that the office will transition to a SANWRIA agency. Een (1) tot (3) drie jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in Administrasie of Menslike Hulpbronne. Rekenaarvaardigheid. PERSAL-sertifikate. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en ervaring van HR-prosesse en -wetgewing. Basiese finansiële bestuur. Kennis van PFMA en bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede en analise. Mens- en diversiteitsbestuur. Bestuur en administer personeelsbestuur en administrasiefunksies binne die Area Office. Bestuur en administer menslike hulpbronfunksies en kantoorondersteuningsdienste. af.title: Administrasieklerk Produksie
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat administratiewe ondersteuning bied, dokumente bestuur, vergaderings koördineer en verslae samestel vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bloemfontein.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of ekwivalent. Vorige administratiewe ervaring sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Basiese begrip van Batho Pele-beginsels. Basiese kennis van Microsoft Excel, Word en PowerPoint. Kennis van klerklike funksies, praktyke, asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en administratiewe statistiek saam te stel. Basiese kennis en insig van Human Resources-voorskrifte. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk. Basiese kennis van probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Kommunikasie. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Direktoraat: Bestuur inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Koördineer die logistiek van vergaderings, neem notule by vergaderings en versprei dokumente/pakkette aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Bied hulp met die samestelling van maandelikse verslae en aanbiedings soos deur die Direkteur vereis. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die Direktoraat. Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die Direktoraat. Hanteer telefoonrekeninge vir die Direktoraat. Hidrologiese data-administrasie: Werk inligting op die OSIRIS-databasis en N-skyfplek by. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Leg die besteding van die Direktoraat vas en werk dit by. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaans- en reiseise van amptenare en dien hulle by die bestuurder vir goedkeuring in. Bied hulp met dokumentlogistiek tussen die kantoor van die Direkteur, ander Direktorate en die kantoor van die Provinsiale Hoof. Bied hulp aan die Direkteur met reisreëlings. Bied hulp met die administrasie wat verband hou met personeelsake, soos die skandeer en stoor van dokumente voordat dit by Human Resources ingedien word.
