Ukuxhumana. Ukuhleleka nokuziphatha ngobuqotho.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokusekelwa okuphathwa kwezomphathi kwiKhanda lezeMisebenzi: Phatha amafayela angena naphuma. Hlela izidingo zemihlangano, ukubhala amaminithi emihlanganweni nokuhambisa amafayela/okufakiwe kubambiqhamba abahlukene njengoba kudingeka. Siza ngokuqoqwa kwemibiko yanyanga zonke kanye namathuliswe njengoba kudingwa nguMqondisi. Gcina uphinde ulondoloze irekhodi lethemba leKhanda lezeMisebenzi. Gcina irekhodi lokushiya leKhanda lezeMisebenzi. Phatha ama-akhawunti ocingo eKhanda lezeMisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kohlwemininingwane hydrological: Buyeza ulwazi kuidathabeysi ye-OSIRIS nendawo ye-N-drive. Usizo ekucutshungulweni kohlwemininingwane hydrological: Siza nokufakwa kanye nokuhanjiswa kwezifundo zemihla ngemihla. Sza ukufakwa kohlwemininingwane kwi-HYDSTRA. Hlinzeka ngokusekelwa okuphathwa kwezomphathi kwezezimali okuhlanganisa ukucela imibiko ye-BAS, ukufaka izimangalo ze-S&T nokufaka amafomu okulinganisa iKhanda lezeMisebenzi nyanga zonke. Xhumana nabambiqhamba bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsizakalo. Faka uphinde ubuyeze izinkokhelo zeKhanda lezeMisebenzi. Hlola ukubukeka kwezimangalo zokuhlala ukuhamze kabanomsebenzi bese uziphatha kumphathi ukuze asagqide. Siza ngohlelo lwamafayela phakathi kwehhisi likaMqondisi, amanye Amakhanda lezeMisebenzi nehhosi leNhloko yesifunda. Siza uMqondisi ngohlelo lokuhamza. Siza ngokuphathwa okuhlobene nezindaba zabasebenzi, njengokuskena nokulondoloza amafayela ngaphambi kokuthi athunyelwe kuNgcweti Yabantu.

xh.title: Inkqundla yolawulo ekwenzeni iinkcukacha
xh.summary: Inkqundla yolawulo enika inkxaso yolawulo, iphatha amaxwebhu, ilungelelanisa iintlanganisela idibene neegxelo kwiSebe leZamanzi nokuQhusula kwaBloemfontein.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba lesi-12 okanye esilinganayo nam. Ngaba uluhlu lolwayo kwindawo yolawo luya kuba luncedoonge. Ukuqonda okusesingeni lemigaqo yeBatho Pele. Ulwazi olusesingeni malunga neMicrosoft Excel, Word nePowerPoint. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yonke nokuzilolonga ngokomthetho, nokulunga ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ukuze ufake iinkcukacha ezibalulekileyo namaxesha okwenza izibalo zolawulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda okusesingeni ngeimigaqo ephatha iZabasebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngendlela yomthetho egcinweyo ephezulu yonke iinkonzo ezenzwa ngurhulumente. Ulwazi ngendlela emila kokusetyenziswa kolawulo ngokwendalo yomsebenzi. Usondelano kwindalo yomxholo-nxaxheba. Ukuqhwesha kolungelelwaniso. Uluntu nemixholo-nxaxheba ngokwesini. Ulwazi olusesingeni ngokuxazulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela ngokucokisekileyo. Ukwengamela ngokusuka komthetho woluntu nokwahlukana ngokwemvelaphi. Ulwazi lokuzinika ngokomxholo-nxaxheba wabathengi ekubeni nalabo abayinika inkxaso ngokubuyela kumthengi. Isazindi esisesingeni kwindimi yomxholo-nxaxheba. Ukuba nolwazi lokuba uzibophezele kwindalo yomxholo-nxaxheba nokwenza imisebenzi yakho ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwindawo ka Direktha: Yenze injongo yokulawula imibhobho yokusika nokuqhutywa kolwazi. Lungelelanisa iindaba ezinkulu-ke ezinxamnye nezinto ezibalulekileyo kwizinto ezinkulu-ke ezinxamnye, ukuthatha iimpawu ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi nezinto ezinxamnye kubantu abangaphandle njengoko kuyimfuneko. Nceda ngokudibanisa iigxelo zenyanga nokuqhutywa kolwazi njengoko kuyimfuneko ngu Direktha. Gcina ulwandiso lwezinto eziguquguquka ngexesha kodwa ezifana nexesha elifanayo kodwa ziyinkcukacha ezifana nexesha elifanayo kodwa ziyinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo ngokwefuthe kwindawo ka Direktha. Qinisekisa ulwandiso lwezinto ezahlukeneyo ngokwefuthe kwindawo ka Direktha. Yenza izinto ezahlukeneyo ngokwefuthe ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi kwindawo ka Direktha. Ulawulo lwamaxwebhu amanzi: Ukuhlaziya inkcazelo kwindawo ephila ethi yi-OSIRIS database nendawo ephila ethi yi-N-drive. Nceda ngokulungisa iinkcazelo zamaxwebhu amanzi: Nceda ngokufaka iinkcazelo ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi njengoko kuyimfuneko. Nceda ngokufaka iinkcazelo ezinxamnye kw-HYDSTRA. Nika inkxaso yolawulo ngeemali ezenza ulwazi oluhle njengoko kubalulekileyo ekutheni ucele iigxelo ze-BAS, ukufaka iimpawu ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi ezinxamnye njengenkcazelo yenyanga kwindawo ka Direktha. Thetha ngeengxoxo ezinxamnye neengxoxo ezinxamnye ngokufuna nokuhambisa izinto ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi njengoko kuyimfuneko. Faka ukuhlaziya iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo ngokwemali kwindawo ka Direktha. Qinisekisa ukuba iimpawu ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi ezinxamnye zichanekile na ezingabazini bayo ukuze uze udibanise naye kwindawo ka Direktha. Nceda ngokulawula iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo ngokwefuthe ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi phakathi kwendlu ka Direktha, ezinye iindlu ezahlukeneyo nendlu yosapho lwaqonda iindawo ezahlukeneyo ngokwendawo. Nceda u Direktha ngokulungiselela uhambo lwakhe. Nceda ngokulawula iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo ngokwendawo yakhe ezinxamnye nokuqhutywa kolwazi njengoko kuyimfuneko.

zu.title: Onqunyiwe OwayeyiSekela: Izimali Ezingenayo
zu.summary: Indima kaSekela Mongameli wezimali ezinggenayo kumnyango wezempihlankankhulu, iFree State Department of Health, okugxile ekubeni ngumuntu obheke ukutholwa kwezimali ezifakiwe, uphando lokusebenzisa imali kanye nokuphathwa kwabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Degree noma isidingo esilinganayo sokufunda esikhundleni esiphezulu kwezimali kuleveli ye-NQF level 7. Iminyaka engu-3 yemisebenzi elawulayo ehlobene nezimali ezingenayo. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa umthetho, okubandakanya i-PFMA kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury, umumo kanye nemigango nemithetho evunywe ukusetshenziswa. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, ukuxhumana okuhle namakhono abaphathi. Amakhono nolwazi: Izici: Ubudlelwano obuhle kabantu, ukuzimela, ukuzethemba, ukuzivumelanisa, ukugcina imfihlo, ukuqotho, isiyalo, ukunembeka, ukwamukelana kahle, nokuthembeka. Isidingo sokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxathu. Amakhono: Amakhono okuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukubumba nokulale imali ebingenzile: Umamkathi wemali, isevisi yokufaka imali kwibhange kanye nokukhokha ngekhompuyutha. Ukuphathwa kwezikweletu, ukuqapha kanye nokubika ngemali ezingenzile. Ukuphathwa kwemali ekhishwayo: Inkwali yabasebenzi, Impahla kanye namasevisi, Ukudluliswa ngezimali nezibonelelo. Ukubika. Ukubuka abasebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke isevisi ephumelelayo yezimali ezingenayo. Lokhu kubandakanya okokuqondene nako: Ukuqapha abasebenzi ngokuvamile, ukwabelana imisebenzi kanye nokulawula ikhwalithi yomsebenzi oqediwe ngumphathi, ukupha abantu abaphansi kwakho izeluleko ngemisebenzi yonke. Ukuphatha ukusebenza, indlela yokuziphatha nesiyalo sobaphathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abaphathi bafundiswa bathuthuke ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wekhwalithi efunwayo kahle. Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa kanye nokulawula amasistimu kanye namaprosesi womsebenzi ukuze kubekhona ukusebenza kahle.

xh.title: Umqondisi wokuLawula kokuBala kweMali

xh.requirements: Isidanga okanye izifundo ezilinganayo zemfundo ephakamileyo ekuLawulweni kweMali kwinqanaba le-NQF 7. Unyaka wama-3 wamava ohlelo ekubaleni kwemali. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngolungelelwano lomthetho, kuquka i-PFMA namaQumbevu oLawulo, inkqubo ngokuhambelana namagqabantshi kunye namazinga afanelekileyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemoving, ikhompyutha, isakhuzo esilunge kakhulu nobuchule bolawulo. Amakhono nolwazi: Iimpawu: Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu, ukuzimela, ukuzimisela, ukuzivocavoca, ukuzigqitha, ulwelo lwangasese, intembeko, isithinti, ukuchanekileyo, nobuhlobo, nokuthembeka. Amandla okusebenza ngxam meko. Amakhono: Amakhono okunxibelelan ngomlomo nangokubhala, namakhono okusombulula
xh.duties: Ukuqokelela nokurekhoda inkomfa: Ukusebenza njengomamathizeni, inkonzo yebhanki nokuhlawula ngokwe-elektroniki. Ulawulo lezikolikho nakugcina iliso nokubika ngemali engenayo. Ulawulo lokuchithwa kwemali: Ihlawulo labasebenzi, Izinto neenkonzo, Iindlela ezinkotha nezibonelelo. Ukubika. Ukulawula abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo efanelekileyo yokuBala kwemali. Oku kuya kubandakanya, phakathi kwezinye izinto, oku kulandelayo: Ukulawula ngokubanzi abasebenzi, ukwaba imisebenzi nokulawula umgangatho womsebenzi ozenziweyo ngabalawuli, Ukupha icebisa kwaye uqhube abalawuliwe ngazo zonke iindawo zomsebenzi. Lawula inkqubo, nokuziphatha nolungelelwano labalawuli. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abalawuli bayakhatshwa baphuhliswe ukuba bakwazi ukuphumeza umsebenzi womgangatho ofunekayo ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle. Yila, uze usebenzise ulawule iinkqubo nemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Head of Clinical UNI (INTERNAL Medicine)

jobs.summary: Lead the Internal Medicine department at Leratong Hospital, overseeing clinical governance, administration services, and patient care standards.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Master of Medicine in Internal Medicine and Fellowship of the college of South Africa). Minimum of 3 years’ experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical specialist. MBCHB and Current registration with HPCSA as a specialist. Be able to work commuted overtime. Computer literacy and additional experience in management or supervision will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Clinical leadership and Governance in the Internal Medicine department. Co- ordinate all clinical and administration services in the department. Improved patient experience of care. Maintain satisfactory clinical, professional, and ethical standards related to these services. Reduction of waiting time of Operations. Ensure effective and efficient specialist services to contribute to optimal and quality health care in line with the vison, mission, and values of Gauteng department of health. Ensure compliance to SOP’s and clinical Protocols. Supervision and effective utilization of medical staff. Responsible for training and teaching of Medical Interns, junior doctors, and medical students. Assist in the implementation of DOH policies and programmes. Full participation in Quality assurance, management of PSI’s and complaints. Participate in academic activities in the hospital and in the cluster. The potential candidate should be highly skilled in performing clinical work and take part in commuted overtime.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Serobatse Tel No: (011) 411-3563 / Ms M Nkuna Tel No: (011) 411- 3677/3516
jobs.applications: should be submitted strictly online at the following E-Recruitment portal: http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za. No hand-delivered, faxed, or emailed applications will be accepted. For assistance with online applications please email your query to healthjobqueries@gauteng.gov.za.
jobs.notes: Kindly note that no payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised by the Gauteng Department of Health. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. Leave the following question blank if they are not in possession of such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”. Application without proof of a new Z83 application form and detailed CV will be disqualified. Applicants must indicate the post reference number on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will receive communication from HR unit to submit certified copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents not older than 6 months on or before the day of the interview). Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks) must be conducted prior appointment. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must furnish the Department with an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Preference will be given to South African citizens. The performance of normal overtime is not mandatory, however it will be based on the operational needs of the hospitals. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Hoof van Kliniese UNI (Interne Geneeskunde)
af.summary: Lei die Interne Geneeskunde departement by Leratong Hospital, hou toesig oor kliniese bestuur, administratiewe dienste en standaarde vir pasiëntsorg.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis moontlik maak (Master of Medicine in Internal Medicine en Fellowship of the college of South Africa). Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese spesialis. MBCHB en huidige registrasie by HPCSA as 'n spesialis. Wees in staat om kommuter-oortyd te werk. Rekenaargeletterdheid en bykomende ervaring in bestuur of toesig sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Kliniese leierskap en bestuur in die Interne Geneeskunde departement. Koördineer alle kliniese en administratiewe dienste in die departement. Verbeterde pasiëntervaring van sorg. Handhaaf bevredigende kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde wat verband hou met hierdie dienste. Vermindering van wagtyd van Operasies. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende spesialisdienste om by te dra tot optimale en gehalte gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die visie, missie en waardes van Gauteng department of health. Verseker nakoming van SOP's en kliniese protokolle. Toesig en effektiewe benutting van mediese personeel. Verantwoordelik vir opleiding en onderrig van mediese internists, junior dokters en mediese studente. Bystand in die implementering van DOH-beleide en programme. Volle deelname aan gehalteversekering, bestuur van PSI's en klagtes. Neem deel aan akademiese aktiwiteite in die hospital en in die cluster. Die potensiële kandidaat moet hoogs vaardig wees in die uitvoer van kliniese werk en deelneem aan kommuter-oortyd.

zu.title: Umkhulu we-UNI yezokwelapha (INTERNAL Medicine)
zu.summary: Hola umnyango we-INTERNAL Medicine esibhedlela i-Leratong Hospital, ulawule izikweletu zezokwelapha, izinsiza zolawulo, namazinga okunakekelwa kwabaguli.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha (I-Master of Medicine ku-INTERNAL Medicine ne-Fellowship of the college of South Africa). Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yokuthola isipiliyoni ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha. I-MBCHB nokubhalisa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe. Ukube ukwazi ukusebenza amahora adluleliswe kalula. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nokuba neminye imfundo yamakhono yokuqonda noma ukubhekisiso kuzoba yinikelo okuhle kakhulu.
zu.duties: Ukuholwa kwemisebenzi nezikweletu kolawulo emnyangweni we-INTERNAL Medicine. Ukubumba ndawonye wonke imisebenzi yezokwelapha nezinsiza zolawulo kulelo mnyango. Ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ukugcina amazinga asemthethweni wezokwelapha, wamakhono nezomnqamulajuqu eehambisana nalezo zinsiza. Ukwehlisa isikhathi sokulinda imisebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa imisebenzi ephumelelayo nesebenzayo yochwepheshe ukuthi inikezele ngokunakekelwa kwempilo okuhle kakhulu futhi kwalitshiwa ngokuhambisana nebubono, umgomo namagugu omnyango we-Gauteng department of health. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana ne-SOP's namaphothokholiwe ezokwelapha. Ukubhekisisa nokusebenzisa ngokuphumelelayo ogogo bokuqapha imithi. Ukubeke icala ekufundeni nokuqeqesheni kwabaqeqeshi bokuqapha imithi, abadokotela abasaqalayo, nabafundi bokuqapha imithi. Ukusiza ekwenzeni amapholisi namaphrogrami e-DOH. Ukuthatha inxaxhebe egcwele ekugcineni izinga, ekuphatheni i-PSI's nezikhulumi. Ukuthatha inxaxhebe kumanyathelo amakhono esibhedlela nasohweni. Umuntu oqokiwe kufanele abe namakhono amakhulu ekwenzeni umsebenzi wezokwelapha futhi athathe inxaxhebe kumahora adluleliswe kalula.

xh.title: Umphathi we-Clinical UNI (INTERNAL Medicine)
xh.summary: Qhuba isebe le-Internal Medicine esibedlele saseLeratong Hospital, ulawule ulawulo lweklinikhi, iinkonzo zolawulo, namazinga enkonzo yabaguli.
xh.requirements: Ifanelekileyo nelifanele ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoSoma wezoNya (Master of Medicine kwi-Internal Medicine neFellowship yecollege yaseSouth Africa). Ubuncinane iiminyaka eliwaka-3 yokulingisa emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoSoma wezoNya. MBCHB kunye nobhaliso lwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengosoma. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza i-commuted overtime. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha nolunye olunxulumene nolawulo okanye ulawulo lomsebenzi kuya kuba lusazo elongeke.
xh.duties: Intsimi yolawulo lweklinikhi noLawulo kwisebe le-Internal Medicine. Yiba nabulumko kuwo onke amasebenzi eklinikhi nolawulo kwicala. Ukuphucula iinkonzo zabaguli. Ukugcina imilinganiselo ebangayo yeklinikhi, yomsebenzi, yemigiqelo yexanduva. Ukunciphisa ixesha lolinda kuMisebenzi. Qinisekisa iinkonzo ezifanelekileyo nasebenzayo zosoma ukunikela ngempatho yempilo egqithisileyo nengcono ngokuhambisana nomgama, injongo, namaxabiso eGauteng department of health. Qinisekisa ukutshatya nge-SOP's namaprotocol eklinikhi. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa kakuhle abasebenzi besazela. Uxanduva lokufundisa nokufundisa abaThatha-khondo bezoNya, oSomakade, nabafundi besazela. Seda ekusebenziseni iinkqubo namacebiso e-DOH. Ukubamba inxaxheba ngokupheleleyo kuQinisekiso loBungakanani, ulawulo lwe-PSI's neengxelo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiimisebenzi yezifundo esibedlele nakwisebe. Iqondo elicheniweyo lifanele libe nolwazi oluphezulu ekwenzeni umsebenzi weklinikhi kalunye athathe inxaxheba kwi-commuted overtime.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist (RADIOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum, (all inclusive) Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum, (all inclusive) Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum, (all inclusive)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Radiology at Leratong Hospital, Gauteng, requiring an MBChB with MMed or FCEM and HPCSA registration as a Radiology Specialist.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery plus MMED (Radiology) or FCEM (SA). Registration Certificate with the HPCSA as a Radiology Specialist. Grade 1: No experience required. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in a normal Specialty. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in a normal Specialty. A resuscitation course such as APLS (or PALS), ACLS, ATLS will be added advantage. Ability to manage a team of junior and senior doctors. Ability to establish excellent working relationships with all the disciplines teams. Good leadership skills, excellent communication (verbal and written) skills, conflict resolution and good interpersonal skills. The successful candidate must be adaptable, disciplined, and self-confident. The candidate must be able to work independently and under pressure and beyond normal working hours and work with diverse team. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team. Knowledge of legislation, policies and procedure pertaining to health care users. Computer Literacy. Experience in the public sector would be an advantage. Candidate will be expected to perform commuted overtime as per service needs.
jobs.duties: Ensuring that there is protocol for the management of Radiology Patients and that there is compliance to the protocol and guidelines. Co-ordinate all clinical and administrative duties within the Department. Involvement in hospital committees and liaison with other departments within the hospital. Staff training theoretical and skills performance of medical doctors and allied medical disciplines at the hospital and referring hospitals. SOPs development and implementation. Provision of clinical support and outreach programs. To participate, support and promote research relevant to Radiology department. Ability to initiate and conduct research will be an advantage. Be a role model for students and staff. Perform duties assigned by the medical manager. Maintain quality assurance standards and other Departmental policies. Provision of efficient Radiology outpatient services. Reduction of waiting time and backlogs. Ensure effective specialist services to contribute to optimal and quality health care in line with the vision, mission, and values of Gauteng department of health. Ensure compliance to SOP’s and clinical Protocols. Supervision and effective utilization of medical staff. Responsible for training and teaching of Medical Interns, junior doctors, and medical students. Attend all relevant meetings. Attend appropriate CME activities. Comply with the Performance Management and Development System (contracting, quarterly reviews and final assessment. Ensure an effective outreach to District hospitals. Participate in academic activities in the hospital and in the cluster. Clinical Governance and Risk Management. Full participation in Quality Assurance Programs, prevention/management of PSI’s and complaints.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis (RADIOLOGY)
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Radiologie by Leratong Hospital, Gauteng, wat 'n MBChB met MMed of FCEM en HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Radiologie Spesialis vereis.
af.requirements: Baccalaureus in Geneeskunde en Baccalaureus in Chirurgie plus MMED (Radiology) of FCEM (SA). Registrasiesertifikaat by die HPCSA as 'n Radiologie Spesialis. Graad 1: Geen ervaring vereis. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in 'n normale spesialiteit. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in 'n normale spesialiteit. 'n Hersussitasiekursus soos APLS (of PALS), ACLS, ATLS sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vermoë om 'n span junior en senior dokters te bestuur. Vermoë om uitstekende werksverhoudinge met al die dissipline spanne te vestig. Goeie leierskapsvaardighede, uitstekende kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) vaardighede, konflikoplossing en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet aanpasbaar, gedissiplineer en selfversekerd wees. Die kandidaat moet in staat wees om onafhanklik en onder druk en buite normale werksure te werk en met 'n diverse span te werk. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Kennis van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures met betrekking tot gesondheidsorggebruikers. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Ervaring in die publieke sektor sal 'n voordeel wees. Van die kandidaat sal verwag word om pendeloortyd te werk soos per diensbehoeftes.
af.duties: Verseker dat daar 'n protokol vir die bestuur van radiologiepasiente is en dat daar aan die protokol en riglyne voldoen word. Koördineer alle kliniese en administratiewe pligte binne die Departement. Betrokkenheid by hospitaalkomitees en skakeling met ander departemente binne die hospitaal. Personeelopleiding teoreties en vaardighedeprestasie van mediese dokters en verwante mediese dissiplines by die hospitaal en verwysende hospitale. Ontwikkeling en implementering van SOP's. Verskaffing van kliniese ondersteuning en uitreikprogramme. Om deel te neem, te ondersteun en navorsing relevant tot die radiologiedepartement te bevorder. Vermoë om navorsing te inisieer en uit te voer, sal 'n voordeel wees. Wees 'n rolmodel vir studente en personeel. Voer pligte uit wat deur die mediese bestuurder toegewys word. Handhaaf gehalteversekeringsstandaarde en ander departementele beleide. Verskaffing van doeltreffende radiologie- buitepasientdienste. Vermindering van wagtyd en agterstande. Verseker effektiewe spesialisdienste om by te dra tot optimale en gehaltegesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die visie, missie en waardes van Gauteng department of health. Verseker voldoening aan SOP's en kliniese protokolle. Toesig en effektiewe benutting van mediese personeel. Verantwoordelik vir opleiding en onderrig van mediese interne, junior dokters en mediese studente. Woon alle relevante vergaderings by. Woon toepaslike VAO-aktiwiteite by. Voldoen aan die Prestasiebestuur- en Ontwikkelingstelsel (kontraktering, kwartaallikse hersienings en finale assessering). Verseker effektiewe uitreik na distrikshospitale. Neem deel aan akademiese aktiwiteite in die hospitaal en in die groep. Kliniese bestuur en risikobestuur. Volle deelname aan gehalteversekeringsprogramme, voorkoming/bestuur van pasientveiligheidsvoorvalle en klagtes.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha (i-RADIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha kwi-Radiology eLeratong Hospital, eGauteng, ofuna i-MBChB nge-MMMed noma i-FCEM nokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe be-Radiology.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Medicine ne-Bachelor of Surgery kanye ne-MMED (i-Radiology) noma i-FCEM (SA). Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe be-Radiology. I-Grade 1: Akukho mplilo edingekile. I-Grade 2: Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yomplilo ofanele njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha esigabeni esijwayelekile. I-Grade 3: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-10 yomplilo ofanele njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha esigabeni esijwayelekile. Ikhosi yokuphilisa njengaleyo ye-APLS (noma i-PALS), i-ACLS, i-ATLS izobe yinzuzo engeziwe. Ikono lokuphatha iqembu labadokotela abancane nabadala. Ikono lokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza namaweqembu wonke amagatsha. Izindlela eziphatha kahle zokuba ngumholi, ukuxhumana okuhle (okusho nangokubhaliwe), ukuxazulula izinkinga nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Umuntu opumelelo kumele akwazi ukuzivumelanisa nokuzihlanganisa, abe nomzila, nokwazi ukuzethemba. Umuntu kumele akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa nangaphansi kwengcindezi nangaphezu kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile zokusebenza futhi asebenze neqembu elihlukahlukene. Ikono lokusebenza eqenjini elinamagatsha ahlukene. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqumela namaphrosedha ahlobene nabasebenzisi bezempilo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nomplilo kwizikhumulo zomphakathi kuzobe yinzuzo. Umuntu oqashiwe kuzomele akwazi ukwenza amahola esikhathi esingeziwe njengoko kudingeka isevisi.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunohlela lokuphatha iziguli ze-Radiology nokuthi kuhanjwa lo hlela nemikhombandlela. Ukuhlanganisa yonke imisebenzi yezokwelapha nemisebenzi yabaphathi ngaphakathi koMnyango. Ukubandakanyeka kumakomidi ekhempthi kanye nokuxhumana namanye amanyango ngaphakathi kwekhempthi. Ukuqeqeswa kobuhlakamu bethiyori nokusebenza kwamakhono abadokotela wezokwelapha namagatsha ezokwelapha ahlobene ekuqashweni kwekhempthi nakwezinye izikhungo ezithumela iziguli. Ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwe-SOPs. Ukunikeza ukwesekwa kwezokwelapha namaphrohulamu okufikelela. Ukubamba iqhaza, ukweseka futhi ukukhuthaza ucwaningo oluhlobene noMnyango we-Radiology. Ikono lokuqala nokwenza ucwaningo luzobe yinzuzo. Ukuba ngwomfanekisile kubafundi nabasebenzi. Ukwenza imisebenzi enikezwe ngumphathi wezokwelapha. Ukugcina izinga lokuthembeka kakhulu lempilo yomsebenzi namanye izinqumela zoMnyango. Ukunikeza isevisi efanele yamabhede abaphathwa bengaphandle be-Radiology. Ukunciphisa isikhathi sabalindile imisebenzi egeziwe. Ukuqinisekisa izinsiza ezifanele zochwepheshe ezoalekela ukunikezwa kobuhle bempilo nangemithetho efanayo ngokuhambisana nokubona, injongo namagugu kaMnyango wezempilo eGauteng. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhanjwa i-SOPs nohlela lwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa kabanzi kwabasebenzi bezokwelapha. Ukuba ngunozungu wokuqeqesha nokufundisa izifundo zabaphili, abadokotela abancane, nabafundi bezokwelapha. Ukubuya yonke imihlangano ehlobene. Ukubuya kumasevisi we-CME ahlobene. Ukuhanjwa isimiso sokuPhatha futhi sokuThuthukisa Ukusebenza (ukuqasha, ukuphathwa kwesigaba ngasinye ukuvivinywa okuyisiphetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukufikelela kwezinsiza ezifanele ezikhungweni ze-District. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yezifundo ekuqashweni nakwisiphanga. I-Governance yezokwelapha nokuphathwa kwezengozi. Ukubamba iqhaza ngokupheleleyo kumaphrohulamu woQinisekiso lokuphila, ukuvimbela/okuphatha izinkinga ezingakaqashwa namadwalwa.

xh.title: Isebe sezengqondo (RADIOLOGY)
xh.summary: Isebe sezengqondo kwi-Radiology e-Leratong Hospital, Gauteng, elifuna i-MBChB ene-MMod okanye i-FCEM neregistration kwi-HPCSA njengesebe sezengqondo se-Radiology.
xh.requirements: I-Bachelor of Medicine kunye ne-Bachelor of Surgery kwaye idityaniswe ne-MMED (Radiology) okanye i-FCEM (SA). Isatifikethi seregistration kwi-HPCSA njengesebe sezengqondo se-Radiology. i-Grade 1: Akukho mphumelelo efunwayo. i-Grade 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-5 yomphumelelo ofanelekileyo njengesebe sezengqondo emva kweregistration kwi-HPCSA njengesebe sezengqondo kwispecialty eqhelekileyo. i-Grade 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yomphumelelo ofanelekileyo njengesebe sezengqondo emva kweregistration kwi-HPCSA njengesebe sezengqondo kwispecialty eqhelekileyo. Iresuscitation course efana ne-APLS (okanye i-PALS), i-ACLS, i-ATLS iya kuba yingenelo eluncedo. Amandla okuphatha iqela lemiganga ephakamileyo nephakamileyo. Amandla okwakha ubudlelwane obuhle bokusebenza namaqela onke amadisiplini. Amandla abuhle bokukhokela, amandla abuhle okunxibelelwana (ngolwimi nangokubhalwayo), ukuxazulula iingxabano n’amandla abuhle okunxibelelwana nabantu. I-kandidati epumeleleyo kufuneka iguquguquke, ithobeke, kwaye iqinisekile ngokwayo. I-kandidati kufuneka ikwazi ukusebenza yodwa nangaphantsi kwegxabo kwaye ngaphaya kweeyure ezizezonke zokusebenza kwaye ivelise nedrawing namaqela abahlukene. Amandla okusebenza kw iqela elinamadisiplini amaninzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho, i-polisi nendlela yokwenza izinto ezimalunga nabasebenzisi beempilo zomzimba. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Umphumelelo kwicala lomphakathi uya kuba yngenelo. I-kandidati iya kulindeleka ukuba yenze i-commuted overtime njengoko kufunwa lisebe.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iprotocol yolawulo lwabaguli be-Radiology kwaye ukuba kuhoywa iprotocol nendlela ezelweyo. Lawula wonke umsebenzi wezoklinikhu nowolawulo kwisebe. Inxulumene namakomiti esibhedlele kwaye unxibelelane namanye amasebe ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngokubalulelwano nangamandla okwenza izinto abaganga kwaye namadisiplini obuchule obudityanisiweyo esibhedlele nakumaxwebhe esibhedlele. Amanqanaba okulungelelanisa nokuthengiswa kwe-SOPs. Ukuqinisekisa inkxaso yezoklinikhu kunye namaphrogramu okufikelela. Ukuthatha inxaxheba, ukuxhasa kwaye ukhuthaze uphononongo olusebenzayo kwisebe le-Radiology. Amandla okuqala nokwenza uphononongo aya kuba yngenelo eluncedo. Yiba ngumzekelo omdala kwabo bafunda nakubasebenzi. Yenza imisebenzi enikiweyo ngumlawuli wezokulapho. Gcina amanqanaba oqinisekiso lomgangatho namanye i-polisi zesebe. Ukuqinisekisa iinkonzo ezilungeleleneyo zabaguli be-Radiology. Ukunciphisa ixesha lolindela nokubuyela emva. Qinisekisa iinkonzo ezizezona ezingcali ukunikela ngemizekelo yokunxulumana nempilo eqinisekileyo kwicala le-Gauteng department of health. Qinisekisa ukuhoywa kwe-SOP's nama-Protocols ezoklinikhu. Ukuqinisekisa nokusebenzisa abasebenzi bezokulapho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nokufundisa kwabo bafunda ezokulapho, abaganga abasha, nabafundi bezokulapho. Zibophelela kumaphulo onke. Thabatha ukuqinisekisa ukwenza izinto ezisezidlangalaleni njengoko kufunwa. Landela iinkqubo eziphuhliswayo nezokulawula umgangatho wokusebenza. Qinisekisa amandla okufikelela ezibhedlele ezikwicala. Thatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi wezemfundo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele nakumaxwebhe ayo. Ukuqinisekisa amandla amakhulu nokulawula ukusingathiwa. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba ngeenkqubo eziphuhliswayo namaphulo ezejantshi esibhedlele.

Improving access of T B, DR-TB and HIV program. Support and monitor quality screening and finding missing cases. To monitor TB treatment completion rate, death and LTFU, Implementation of TB/HIV integrated Health Information System. Liaise with Local Government, different levels of health, community structures to improve service delivery. Conducting quarterly reviews for performance monitoring in the province. af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde Algemeen PNA 7 (HAST, Stepdown
af.summary: Bestuur HAST- en stepdown-verplegingsbedrywighede by Leratong Hospital, implementeer TB-herstelplanne en werk saam met belanghebbendes om HIV- en TB-strategieë uit te voer.
af.requirements: Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde soos geakkrediteer by die SANC volgens Regeringskennisgewing R425 wat die SNC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Minimum van 08 jaar gepaste / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council in Algemene Verpleging. Moet 'n bestuurderslisensie hê. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet gepaste / herkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees (HAST / TB-koördineerder of Operasionele Bestuurder-vlak). Herkenbare ervaring in kliniese HAST- en TB-dienste. Huidige registrasie by SANC. Diploma / Graad in Verplegingsbestuur en rekenaargeletterdheid is verpligtend. Kennis van gesondheids-, verplegings- en staatsdienswetgewing word aanbeveel. Sterk leierskap, goeie kommunikasie en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede is nodig.
af.duties: Effektiewe implementering van die TB-herstelplan. Fasiliteer effektiewe samewerking met alle belanghebbendes en distriksbestuurspanne in die uitvoering van TB-aktiwiteite. Implementering van HAST-strategie en plan in ooreenstemming met die 95,95;95 TB- en HIV-strategie. Wees in staat om die implementering van 1.1 Million Retention to Care en End TB-projek te fasiliteer. Implementering van die TB-strategie-intervensies terwyl die versnelling van TB-behandeling-inisiëring vir volwassenes en kinders gemonitor word. Monitering en ontleding van die 95x95x95 TB-programkaskade. Werk saam en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van die Distrik TB-program en Besigheidsplan. Effektiewe monitering van begrotingstoekenning om te verseker dat hulpbronne op alle vlakke behoorlik geïmplementeer word. Verbetering van toegang tot TB-, DR-TB- en HIV-program. Ondersteun en monitor gehalte-sifting en die opsporing van ontbrekende gevalle. Om TB-behandelingsvoltooiingskoers, sterftes en LTFU te monitor. Implementering van TB/HIV-geïntegreerde Gesondheidsinligtingstelsel. Skakel met Plaaslike Regering, verskillende vlakke van gesondheid, gemeenskapsstrukture om dienslewering te verbeter. Voer kwartaallikse hersienings uit vir prestasiemonitoring in die provinsie. Neem deel aan die Gauteng Provinsie-omkeerstrategie, Primêre Gesondheidsorg-ingenieurswese. Toon 'n hoë vlak van organisatoriese, inisiëtief- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Koördineer en fasiliteer effektiewe, doeltreffende en volhoubare finansiële beplanning en beheer van voorwaardelike befondsing vir TB/HIV/STI-integrasie. Neem deel aan die verwesenliking van die Hospitaal Operasionele Plan. Monitor prestasie deur gebruik te maak van die Performance Management and Development System. Verseker implementering en bevordering van QA-programme (klagte- en pasiëntveiligheidsbestuur), Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer en Gesondheid en Veiligheid-beginsels. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die Nasionale kernstandaarde en Ideal Hospital Realization and Maintenance Framework. Verseker beskikbaarheid van maandelikse, kwartaallikse, jaarlikse prestasieverslae en operasionele planne. Neem deel na ure, nag-toesigskofte en naweke soos gedelegeer om relevante aanbevelings te implementeer.

zu.title: Msizi Mphathi Wezokunakekela Ukugula Ohlangothi Jikelele PNA 7 (HAST, Stepdown
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yokunakekela abagula kwi-HAST nase stepdown esibhedlela i-Leratong Hospital, ukuphatha izinhlela zokuphulukisa i-TB kanye nokusebenzisana nalabo abahilelekile ukuze kusetshenziswe izindlela ze-HIV ne-TB.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma / I-Degree eZokunakekela Abagula njengokugunyazwe yi-SANC ngokusho kwesaziso kahulumu esithi R425 esivumela i-SANC njengesiGqili Sezokunakekela. Okungenani unyaka we-08 wokuqeqeshwa / wokuhlakanipha okufanele ekuqhubeni abagula ngemva kokubhaliswa njengesiGqili Sezokunakekela ne-South African Nursing Council ekuqhubeni abagula jikelele. Kumele ube nelayisense yokushayela. Okungenani eminyaka emi-3 yaleso sikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele ibe ukuhlakanipha okufanele / okuqashelwayo ezingeni lokuqondisa (izinga loMbuquli we-HAST / TB noma ongumqondisi wemisebenzi). Ukuhlakanipha okuqashelwayo kuleminyaka yokunakekela abagula kwe-HAST & TB. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ne-SANC. I-Diploma / I-Degree ekuQondiseni Imisebenzi Yokunakekela kanye nokuqonda ngomakhalekhukhwini kuyadingeka. Ukwazi ngomthetho wezempilo, wokuqhuba abagula kanye noMnyango kaHulumu kunconywa. Amandla okuhola, ukuxhumana kahle kanye namakhono okusebenza nalabo abahilelekile adingeka.
zu.duties: Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwesu lokuphulukisa i-TB. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisana okusebenzayo nalabo bonke abahilelekile namaqembu abaphathi wesifunda ekwenzeni imisebenzo ye-TB. Ukusetshenziswa kwesu le-HAST, uhlelo ngokuhambisana nesu le-95,95;95 le-TB ne-HIV. Ukuba nokwazi ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo elula eliqolo labagula eliye kwenqubo yokuxolisa abagula abangekho kanye ngenqubo yokuphela kwe-TB. Ukusetshenziswa kokungenelela kwesu le-TB kanti ulawule ukusheshiswa kokubhaliswa kokwelapha i-TB kubantu abadala nakubantwana. Ukuqapha nokuhlaziya ukweqa kuhlelo lwe-TB lwe-95x95x95. Ukusebenzisana futhi ukukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kohlelo lwe-TB lwesifunda nohlelo lokusebenza. Ukuqapha okusebenzayo okwabelwe imali ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle emazingeni wonke. Ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kuhlelo lwe-T B, i-DR-TB ne-HIV. Ukusekela futhi ukuqapha ukuhlola izinga lobulula kanye nokuqamba amacala alahlekile. Ukuqapha inani lokugcwaliswa kokwelapha i-TB, ukufa ne-LTFU, ukusetshenziswa kwe-HAST/TB ehlanganiswe ohlelweni lolwazi lwempi loyezwe. Ukuxhumana noMnyango wezezindawo, emazingeni ahlukene wezempilo, izakhiwo zomphakathi ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ukwenza ukuhlolwa kwikota njalo ngesikhathi ukuze kuqaniswe ukusebenza esifundazweni. Ukuthatha inxaxheba eNqubweni yokuphendula yesifundazweni i-Gauteng, kokuqakuliswa kwemisebeni yezempilo yokuqala. Ukubonisa izinga eliphezulu lokuhlela, ukuqalisa, namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlanganisa futhi ukukhuthaza ukuhlela izimali okusebenzayo, okunamandla, nokuhlelekayo kanye nokuqapha imali ehleliwe ye-TB/HIV/STI. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni isu sokuqhuba i-Sibhedlela. Ukuqapha ukusebenza kusetshenziswa iNqubo yokuqapha nokuqeqesha ukusebenza. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kakhuthaza izinhlelo ze-QA (ukuphathwa kwezikhalazo nokuphepha abagula), ukuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka kanye namazinga okuphepha. Ukukhuthaza izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela abagula njengokuhlelwe izilinganiso eziyisiseko eZwe lonke kanye nobume bokuphumelela nokugcina i-Sibhedlela esihle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imibiko yamanye ayiyo, yamakota, yaminyaka yonke yokusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ukubamba iqhaza emahoreni okubuyekeza, kumashemu ebusuku namangesonto njengoba kumiyo ukuphatha okubalulekile.

xh.title: Isikhulu esiPhakamiliyo seSisa seLungiselelo loGcino lweSazisi seGazi kwaye sithatha inqanaba lesi-7 (HAST, Stepdown
xh.summary: Ulawula imisebenzi yesisa seLungiselelo loGcino lweSazisi seGazi nakwala bakhoyo abangapheli kwisibhedlele iLeratong Hospital, ukusebenzisa iindlela zokubuyisela i-TB kunye nokusebenzisana nabanomdla ekuphumezeni iindlela zokuGomela i-HIV nge-TB.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma / i-Degree eNursing njengoko kuvunyiwe yi-SANC ngokwesaziso likahulumeni i-R425. Ukuze kuvunyelwe ukuba nguPhathathi we-SANC njengoko kuvunyiwe yi-SANC njengengcali yeNursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-08 yamava afanelekileyo aqondekele kwiNursing emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha weNursing kunye neNgcweli ye-South African Nursing Council. Kufuneka unelayisensi yokushayela imoto. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 kule minyaka igankunye nomvuzo ongapheli kwamagqabi athathwe ngabaphathi. Ukugcina ibhali elifanelekileyo kwi-PC nokuphucula ulwazi lomntu wonke lwe-SANC. Amava afanelekileyo kwisebe lokuyilwa kwezigulana ezikwingqele enkulu. Amava afanelekileyo kwimisebenzi yesisa seLungiselelo loGcino lwe-Sazisi seGazi nakwe-TB. Ukubhalisa kungamnyama kwi-SANC. I-Diploma / i-Degree eNursing Management nokubhalisa kwikhompyutha ziyaphuma. Kuqatshelwa ulwazi ngemithetho yoNyango, yeNursing neseZentral yokwenzela abantu bonke. Kufunekile ukuba namandla okulawula, ukubonakalisa ulwazi oluhle kwaye unengqiqo yokuba nothando. Amava obuqu obunyuka phezulu kwindlela yokuphatha iinqe ezihamayo ngamnye. Kufuneka ulawule, uphathise kwaye uqonde ngokubhalisa kwaye ukwazi ukukha izicwangciso ezifanelekileyo kwicandelo lendalo elikwiRR.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa iinyephu ezikumgama ongapheli kwezo-TB. Ukuqinisekisa isiseko sokuba nendawo apho kubhaliswa khona amagama amakhulu eHIV. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulawulwa ngokucacileyo amagqabhagqabhaza e-TB/HIV/STI kunye ne-RRC kwindalo yamva. Ukubeka ngqo inqanaba eliphezulu eliphezulu kwisiseko esincitshisayo sokugcina isazisi se-TB seHIV. Ukubeka ngqo iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuthathwa kwamagqabi e-TB/HIV/STI/RR-TB nakwindawo eqonde kwindawo ethile ekuphela kwexesha kwindalo ekhoyo yengqiqo yendlela yokugcina iindlela eziqondiswayo zabantu. Ukubeka ngqo ukuba kubhalewe umbhalo ogqithisayo we-TB/HIV/RR-TB/STI ngokubhalisa ngesazisi esikwisazisi esikumanqanaba aphakamileyo eHIV/HAST/RR-TB/STI. Bevorder kwaliteit van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die Nasionale Kernstandaarde & Ideal Hospital Realization and Maintenance Framework. Verantwoordelik vir die implementering van dissiplinêre maatreëls Neem deel aan buite-ure en nagtoesigskofte soos gedelegeer. Implementeer tersaaklike aanbevelings en prioriteite van die National Strategic Plan for Nurse education, training and Practice. Neem deel aan verwesenliking van die Hospitaal Operasionele Plan. Bystaan om te verseker dat maandelikse, kwartaallikse, jaarlikse prestasieverslae en operasionele planne beskikbaar is Monitor prestasie met behulp van die Management and Development System. Neem deel aan buite-ure, nagtoesig, skofte en naweke soos gedelegeer en implementeer tersaaklike aanbevelings.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Ohloleni Lokusebenza Okukhethekile/cssd
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yohleno lokusebenza okukhethekile ne-CSSD e-Leratong Hospital, faka amandla abahlengikazi uphethe ukunakekelwa okwenziwa phakathi nokuhlinzwa.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma/I-Degree kuNursing njengoba kuyi-Professional / Registered Nurse evunyiwe ne-SANC ngokusho kwe-Government Notice 425 noma ngokulinganayo i-Post basic qualification nobungako bonyaka obungu-1 i-Diploma ku-Medical& Surgical Operating Theatre /Perioperative Nursing Science ngokusho kwe-R212. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-9 yohluvo olufanele/oluhlonzekayo kulolu hlelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo emva kokuqoshwa njenge-Professional Nurse ne-SANC ku-General Nursing. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yohluvo olufanele/oluhlonzekayo emva kokuthola i-one year post basic qualification i-Medical& Surgical Operating Theatre /Perioperative Nursing Science. I-Diploma/I-Degree ku-Nursing Management izokuba yinzuzo futhi ulwazi lwesikhombisi samakhompyutha kuyinto ebalulekile. Kulaphakamiswa ukuba ube nolwazi nge-Mithombo yomthetho yeZempilo, ukuNakekelwa kwezempilo kanye ne-Public Service. Amandla okuba ngumholi, ukuxhumana kahle kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuhlobana nabantu kuyadingeka.
zu.duties: Nika abasebenzi eLeratong Hospital ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nobuholi ngokwalezo zonke imithetho nemigomo ekhona. Hlela ukunakekelwa kwabahlengikazi okukhethekile okuphelele ngokwemilinganiselo esethiwe nangokomthetho ochwepheshile. Phatha ngokusebenzayo ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqondiswa kwemithombo yolwazi. Qaphulisise kwaye ulawule ukungabikho esikhundleni-Hlela ukunikezwa kokuhlolwa nokucwaninga okusebenzayo. Qinisekisa futhi ulinganise imithobo yolwazi nalebhetshi ukuze kufinyelelwe ezinjengweni zesikhungo sokusebenza. Nikeza inkxaso ebalulekile kwiNursing Services. Gcina ukukhula ngobuchwepheshe/izinga labo kanye nokuzithuthukisa. Sunga amaprojekthi ake aqinisekise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okulinganiselayo endaweni ekhethekile. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwaye kukhuthazwe amaprojekthi eNakekelwa kokuthengiswa (Complaints and patient safety management), i-Infection Prevention and Control kanye namagugu eHealth and Safety. Khuthaza izinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo njengoba kuqondiswa yi-National Core Standards & Ideal Hospital Realization and Maintenance Framework. Uyebekwa phansi ekusetshenziseni izinyathelo zodandlwaba Hlanganyela ekusebenziseni kwamashifu obuso bese buhle emva kwemahora nemva kwamashifu ekusihlwa njengoba kunikezwe imiyalo. Yenza imigomo ephathene neNurse education, training and Practice ebalulekileyo kwi-National Strategic Plan. Hlanganyela ekuphumelelisweni kwe-Hospital Operational Plan. Siza ekuvuza athatiwe bakhona iimeko zokuqhelana nokuqhelanisa kwamashifu abo bakhona e-Hospital. Qaphula umsebenzi ngendlela yeManagement and Development System. Hlanganyela ekuphumelelisweni kwe-Hospital Operational Plan. Siza ekubeni iimeko zokuqonda ezingajewayelekanga zibekwe phantsi.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemsebenzi Wokusebenza Kwindawo Yakhethekileyo Yokuvela Iindlebe Kwi-Theatre/cssd
xh.summary: Ulawule iinkqubo zendawo yakhethekileyo yokuvela iindlebe nese-CSSD kwi-Leratong Hospital, unike isikhokelo sokhathalelo lwamagumbathi ulawule ukhathalelo lwexesha lokusebenza.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma/I-Degree kwi-Nursing njengoko kunguProfessional / Registered Nurse evunyiwe nge-SANC ngokwe-Government Notice 425 okanye isifaniso sabo kanye ne-Post basic qualification ngonani lokuhla kwonyaka omnye I-Diploma kwi-Medical& Surgical Operating Theatre /Perioperative Nursing Science ngokuka-R212. Kubandezi ongaphantsi kweminyaka eli-9 yamava afanelekileyo/awazikwayo ukhathalelo lwamagumbathi emva kokuqeshwa njengoProfessional Nurse nge-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Apho owonke umhla weminyaka eli-5 echaziwe ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava afanelekileyo/awazikwayo emva kokufumana i-post basic qualification kwakhona yonyaka omnye i-Medical& Surgical Operating Theatre /Perioperative Nursing Science. I-Diploma/I-Degree kwi-Nursing Management iya kuba yinzuzo kwaye ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwekhompyutha liyaphokoza. Ulwazi nge-Health, Nursing and Public Service Legislation luyacetywa. Isakhokelo esomeleleyo, unxibelelwano oluhle nolunzima lokusebenza nabantu luyimfuneko.
xh.duties: Nika isikhokelo esisebenzayo nakuzo zonke iindawo abasebenzi kwindawo ngokwemithetho yonke egqamileyo nabalinganisayo. Ukuqhubeleka koluntu lokhathalelo lwamagumbathi ngendlela ekhethekileyo ngokupheleleyo kwisimo esiyimigangatho esekiweyo nasendleleni yamagunya. Yonke imisebenzi yokusebenzisa nokuqondisa amathuba. Ukugcina nokuqhubeleka nokuqhubeleka koluntu kwamagumbathi-kulelo lonke ixesha lokusebenza lwe-training ngezenzululwazi. Qinisekisa uhlu namathalu ukwenza iindaba. Ukuhlinzekwa ngesakhokelo esisebenzayo kumagunya e-Nursing. Ukugcina inkqubela namagunya ngokwemigaqo yobuchule nolwazi ngaphezu kwakho. Qalisa iinkqubo eziza kuqinisekisa ukhathalelo oluhle lwamagumbathi kwindawo ekhethekileyo. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwaye kukhuthaze iinkqubo ze-Quality Assurance (management yoluphawu nokhathalelo lwesigulane), i-Infection Prevention and Control nemiqatho ye-Health and Safety. Khuthaza ukhathalelo oluhle lwamagumbathi ngokwalathiso le-National Core Standards & Ideal Hospital Realization and Maintenance Framework. Uxanduva lokusebenzisa izigqibo zoluntu. Thatha inxaxheba kumashifti abo busuku nangemini apho ivunyelwe. Sebenzisa izindulo eziphambili nemiqatho ye-National Strategic Plan for Nurse education, training and Practice. Thatha inxaxheba ekufezekiseni i-Hospital Operational Plan. Nceda uqinisekise ukuba iinkcukacha zenyanga, ezinyanga ezintathu, ezo nyaka ngonyaka nemigangatho yemisebenzi zikho. Qaphela imisebenzi usebenzisa i-Management and Development System. Thatha inxaxheba kwiiyure ezizezolo, ebusuku kwizikhokelo, kwishifti nangamaphela apho ivunyelwe uze usebenzise izindulo eziphambili ezifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Clinical Program Coordinator (HUMAN Resource OHS)
jobs.summary: Clinical Programme Coordinator for Occupational Health and Safety at Leratong Hospital, requiring a nursing diploma, SANC registration, and seven years of nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade12 or equivalent/NQF level/. A R425 qualification (i.e., diploma / degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a professional nurse. Current registration with SANC. A minimum of 7 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing, of which 3 years must be relevant experience in Occupational Health and Safety environment. A post basic nursing qualification with duration of at least 1 year accredited by SANC in Occupational Health Safety. Current SANC registration. Basic computer literacy and driver’s license are mandatory. Knowledge of Occupational Health AND safety Act 85 of 1993, COID Act 130 of 1993 including other related legal framework and PRAAD. Knowledge and application of policies governing the Public Service including Quality Assurance, PILIR, PRAAD and EHWP Strategic Framework. Be able to work independently. Skilled to develop on- going training in OHS principles to all categories of staff good communication, report writing and facilitation skills. Sound organizing, planning, presentation skills. Counselling, decision making, good communication skills.
jobs.duties: Implementation of Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 and COID Act 130 of 1993. Conduct workplace hazard identification and risk assessment (HIRA) in liaison with managers and ensure there are safe operating procedures where necessary. Conduct training to all categories of personnel. Perform medical surveillance. Maintain all appropriate records and documents relevant to OHS. Participate in Institutions’ and Province’s determined Committees, Task Teams, and Forum for service improvement. Facilitate, implementation of National, Provincial legislation regarding OHS protocols and monitoring thereof. Develop and monitor the implementation of education and training programs in field. Active participation in Employees wellness program. Assist with waste management. Management of (IOD)injury on duty. Active participation in PILIR committee development and maintenance of OHS structure according to legal requirements. Working closely with IPC and EAP coordinators.

af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder (Menslike Hulpbron OHS)
af.summary: Kliniese Programkoördineerder vir Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid by Leratong Hospital, wat 'n verpleegkunde-diploma, SANC-registrasie en sewe jaar se verpleegervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of ekwivalent/NQF-vlak. 'n R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as professionele verpleegkundige toelaat. Huidige registrasie by SANC. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde, waarvan 3 jaar relevante ervaring in die Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-omgewing moet wees. 'n Na-basiese verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar geakkrediteer deur SANC in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid. Huidige SANC-registrasie. Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid en bestuurslisensie is verpligtend. Kennis van die Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidswet 85 van 1993, COID-wet 130 van 1993 insluitend ander verwante regsraamwerke en PRAAD. Kennis en toepassing van beleide wat die Openbare Diens regeer, insluitend Kwaliteitsversekering, PILIR, PRAAD en EHWP Strategiese Raamwerk. Kan onafhanklik werk. Vaardig om deurlopende opleiding in OHS-beginsels aan alle kategorieë personeel te ontwikkel, met goeie kommunikasie, verslagskrywing en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Degelike organisasie-, beplannings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Berading, besluitneming en goeie kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Implementering van die Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidswet 85 van 1993 en COID-wet 130 van 1993. Voer werksplek-gevaaridentifisering en risiko-assessering (HIRA) uit in oorleg met bestuurders en verseker dat daar waar nodig veilige bedryfsprosedures is. Verskaf opleiding aan alle kategorieë personeel. Voer mediese waarneming uit. Onderhou alle toepaslike rekords en dokumente wat vir OHS relevant is. Neem deel aan deur die Instelling en Provinsie bepaalde Komitees, Taakspane en Forums vir diensverbetering. Fasiliteer en implementeer nasionale en provinsiale wetgewing rakende OHS-protokolle en moniteer dit. Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van opvoedings- en opleidingsprogramme in die veld. Aktiewe deelname aan werknemers-welsynsprogram. Bystand met afvalbestuur. Bestuur van (IOD) beserings tydens diens. Aktiewe deelname aan PILIR-komitee en ontwikkeling en instandhouding van OHS-struktuur volgens regvereistes. Werk nou saam met IPC- en EAP-koördineerders.

zu.title: Umuhashi Wezinhlela Zokwelapha (Human Resource OHS)
zu.summary: Umuhashi Wezinhlela Zokwelapha wezokuphepha kanye nezempilo ezibambe iqhaza eLeratong Hospital, ofuna idiploma yokuhlengwa, ukubhaliswa ku-SANC, kanye neminyaka eyisikhombisa yokuhamba phambili kokuhlengwa.
zu.requirements: I-Grade12 noma okulinganayo/NQF level/. Isifundo se-R425 (okungukuthi, idiploma / idigri ekuhlengweni) noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogqozi oqeqeshiwe. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-SANC. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-7 yokuhamba phambili okufanele/okuqashelwa ekuhlengweni emva kokubhaliswa njengogqozi oqeqeshiwe ku-SANC ekuhlengweni okujwayelekile, lapho kuyadingeka khona iminyaka eyi-3 yomhlaba-phathi ofanele kwindawo yezokuphepha kanye nezempilo. Isifundo sokuhlengwa esingemuva kwesisekelo esithatha okungenani unyaka owodwa esagunyazwe yi-SANC kwezokuphepha nezempilo ezibambe iqhaza. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-SANC. Ukubazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha okuyisisekelo kanye namalayisensi okushayela kuyadingeka. Ukwazi umthetho we-Occupational Health AND safety Act 85 of 1993, umthetho we-COID Act 130 of 1993 okuhlanganisa nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihlobene kanye ne-PRAAD. Ulwazi kanye nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezibuswa Izikhungo Zomphakathi okuhlanganisa uQinisekiso Lwekhwalithi, i-PILIR, i-PRAAD kanye ne-EHWP Strategic Framework. Akube nokwazi ukusebenza eyedwa. Bakhono bokuthuthukisa ukuqeqeshwa okuhamba phambili kwezimiso ze-OHS kuzo zonke izigaba zabasebenzi ukuxhumana okuhle, ukubhala imibiko kanye namakhono okuhola izinkulumo. Ukuhlela okuhle, ukweluleka, namakhono okubonisa. Ukweluleka, ukuthatha izinqumo, namakhono okuxhumana okuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuqashelwa komthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 kanye no-COID Act 130 of 1993. Ukwenza ukuhlaziwa kokubona ingozi kanye nokuqashelwa komngcipheko (HIRA) kubasebenzi nabaphathi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona izinqubo ezokusebenza ezikuqinile lapho kudingeka khona. Ukwenza ukuqeqeshwa kuzo zonke izigaba zabasebenzi. Ukwenza ukulalela okusesimeni somzimba. Ukugcina yonke imibhalo namadokhumenti ahambisanayo ne-OHS. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwizinkampani, amaqembu asebenzayo, kanye ne-Forum ezinqunyiwe isikhungo kanye neSifundazwe ukuthuthukisa isevisi. Ukuhola ukuqashelwa komthetho weSizwe kanye noweSifundazwe mayelana nezinqubo ze-OHS kanye nokubheka ukuthi ziyasuswa yini. Ukuthuthukisa kanye nokubheka ukuqashelwa kwezinhlela zemfundo nokuqeqeshwa kuleso sikhundla. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo kuhlelo lokuphilisa abasebenzi. Ukusiza ngokuphathwa kwezimpilo. Ukuphathwa kwe-(IOD) ukulimala esebenzini. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo ekuthuthukiseni ikomidi ye-PILIR kanye nokugcina isakhiwo se-OHS ngokwesidingo somthetho. Ukusebenza ngokuseduze nabahhashi be-IPC kanye ne-EAP.

xh.title: Umquwele wenkqubo yezempilo (Ulawulo lweZeMvelo lwe-OHS)
xh.summary: Umquwele wenkqubo yezempilo yoLawulo lweZeMvelo nokuKhuseleko eLeratong Hospital, ofuna idiploma yokongeza, ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC, namashumi asixhenxe eminyaka yamava kwinkonzo yokongeza.
xh.requirements: IGrade12 okanye efanayo/NQF level/. Isiqinisekiso se-R425 (okt kuthi idiploma / idigri yokongeza) okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqirha bokongeza osebenza ngobuchwepheshe. Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwi-SANC. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-7 yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo enkonzweni yokongeza emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha boKongeza osebenza ngobuchwepheshe kwi-SANC kwuQeqesho lweZempilo jikelele, apho iminyaka eli-3 kufuneka ibe ngamava ahlobene nendawo yoLawulo lweZeMvelo nokuKhuseleko. Isiqinisekiso sokongeza esiyimvelaphi esinesixa sexesha esingathanga ngaphantsi kwonyaka o-1 esemthunywa nguSANC kuLawulo lweZeMvelo nokuKhuseleko. Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwi-SANC. Ulwazi olusisiseko lwekhompyutha nelayisenisi yemoto ziyaphothulwa. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweZeMvelo NOKUkhuseleko u-85 ka-1993, uMthetho we-COID u-130 ka-1993 kuquka nezinye iinkqubo zamathetho ahlobene nefaPRAAD. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa iinkqazimiso ezilawula iNkonzo kaLuntu kuquka nokuQinisekisa umgangatho, i-PILIR, i-PRAAD kunye neNkqazo ye-EHWP eSikweni. Ukwazi ukusebenza kwodwa. Unobuchule bokwakha uqeqesho oluya phambili kwemigaqo ye-OHS kuzo onke amaqela abasebenzi, ukunxibelelana kakuhle, ukubhala iingxelo namanobuchule okukhokeza. Amakhono alungele ukuqamba, ukuceba, okunokubonakalayo. Ukuvela, ukuthatha izigqibo, amakhono okunxibelelana kakuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze kusebenziswe uMthetho woLawulo lweZeMvelo nokuKhuseleko u-85 ka-1993 noMthetho we-COID u-130 ka-1993. Ukuqhuba ukuchonga iingozi zendawo yokusebenza nokuhlola ingozi (HIRA) ngokubonisana nabaphathi kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho iinkqubo zokuqhuba ngokhuseleko apho kufuneka khona. Ukuqhuba uqeqesho kuwo onke amaqela abasebenzi. Ukuqhuba ukuqwalasela kwezempilo. Ukugcina onke amarekhodi namaxwebhu afanelekileyo ahlobene ne-OHS. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiKomiti, kuqela loMsebenzi, kunye neNkqazo ezqunyiweyo zeSiseko kunye nePhondo ukuze kuphuculwe inkonzo. Uku khokeza, ukusebenzisa oMthetho weSizwe nwePhondo ngokwemigaqo ye-OHS nokuqwalasela oko. Ukuqamba kuze kuqwalaselwe ukusebenzisa iinkqazo zeqeqesho nolwazi lwemigaqo kule ndawo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuqhakamllshayo kwenkqabo yeempilo zabasebenzi. Uncedo ekulawuleni iinkqubo zokutshatyalaliswa kwezinto ezingasafuneki. Ukulawula (IOD) ukwaluka kwamandla xa usebenza. Ukuthatba inxaxheba ngokuqhakamllshayo ekuphuhliseni komkhosi we-PILIR nasekugcineni kwesakhiwo se-OHS ngokwemfuno yamathetho. Ukusebenza ngokuqondisisa nabaququi baka-IPC nabe-EAP.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Fraud, Corruption and Integrity
jobs.centre: Johannesburg (Head Office) REQUIRMENTS   :   National Diploma (NQF Level 6)/Degree (NQF level 7) in Forensic Investigation/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing / Forensic Auditing. 3-5 years' experience at Assistant Director level (Junior Management) within Fraud and Anti-Corruption and Investigation environment. Knowledge and Skills: GPG and GPDRT policies and procedures, Knowledge and understanding of relevant legislation and Public Service Regulations. Knowledge of Fraud and corruption environment, Written and verbal communication (at an executive management level) and Ability to communicate at all levels and across all sectors using various medium (e.g. presentation). Analytical and problem- solving skills, Report writing, Policy and strategic planning and Problem solving and analysis.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director leading fraud and corruption investigations, evidence collection and prevention strategies at the Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport Head Office.
jobs.duties: Investigate all fraud and corruption. Investigate all allegations of fraud and corruption received from internal and external persons. Conduct statement taking, evidence collection and draft preliminary investigative reports. Prevent fraud and corruption within the Department. Conduct research on latest fraud and corruption legislation and develop educational programs. Develop and implement fraud prevention and anti-corruption strategies and programmes. Conduct fraud risk assessment. Detect fraud and corruption. Detect suspicious/hidden patterns and abnormal behaviour across data types. Manage the preparation of detection reports and closure. Create an ethical environment and improve good governance. Liaise with both internal and external stakeholders and draft an annual schedule of awareness sessions. Develop, implement and review anti- corruption and integrity management policies, strategies and procedures of the unit. Develop strategic framework on anti-corruption and integrity management fraud prevention plan. Manage integrity management measures and promote ethical conduct in the department. Ensure SMS members and other categories of designated employees submit Financial Disclosures in line with the Financial Disclosure Framework. Manage the development of fraud and ethics risk register for the Department. Ensure submission of fraud risk action plan progress reports by business. Manage Resources (human, equipment/asset etc.). Manage grievances according to prescribed procedures.

af.title: Onderadjunkdirekteur: Bedrog, Korrupsie en Integriteit
af.summary: Onderadjunkdirekteur wat bedrog- en korrupsie-ondersoeke, bewysversameling en voorkomingsstrategieë by die Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport Hoofkantoor lei.
af.duties: Ondersoek alle bedrog en korrupsie. Ondersoek alle beskuldigings van bedrog en korrupsie wat van interne en eksterne persone ontvang word. Neem stellings, versamel bewyse en opname van voorlopige ondersoekverslae. Voorkom bedrog en korrupsie binne die Departement. Doen navorsing oor die jongste bedrog- en korrupsiewetgewing en ontwikkel opvoedkundige programme. Ontwikkel en implementeer bedrogvoorkoming- en antikorrupsie-strategieë en programme. Doen bedrogrisiko-assesserings. Bespeur bedrog en korrupsie. Bespeur verdagte/verborge patrone en abnormale gedrag oor datatipes. Bestuur die voorbereiding van bespeuringsverslae en afsluiting. Skep 'n etiese omgewing en verbeter goeie bestuur. Skakel met beide interne en eksterne belanghebbendes en stel 'n jaarlikse skedule van bewustheidsessies op. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien antikorrupsie- en integriteitsbestuursbeleid, -strategieë en -prosedures van die eenheid. Ontwikkel strategiese raamwerk oor antikorrupsie- en integriteitsbestuur se bedrogvoorkomingsplan. Bestuur integriteitsbestuursmaatreëls en bevorder etiese gedrag in die departement. Verseker dat SMS-lede en ander Kategorieë van aangewese werknemers Finansiële Vrywullings indien ooreenkomstig die Raamwerk vir Finansiële Vrywullings. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van die bedrog- en etiese risikoregister vir die Departement. Verseker indiening van vorderingsverslae oor die bedrogrisiko-aksieplan deur besigheid. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslik, toerusting/bates ens.). Bestuur griewe volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Esingenele: Ukuqhathwa, Ukukhwelana Nomsebenzi ongihlaza Nokuqinisekisa Ukuzethemba
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Esingenele esiholisa ukuphenya ukuqhathwa nokukhwelana umsebenzi ongihlaza, ukuqoqa izibonakaliso nemikhuba yokuvikela eGauteng Department of Roads and Transport Head Office.
zu.duties: Phonononza yonke imisebenzi engihlaza nokukhwelana. Phonononza yonke imikhalifano yomsebenzi ongihlaza nokukhwelana etholwe kubantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Yenza ukuthathwa kwezinkulumo, ukuqoqwa kwezibonakaliso ulenze imibhalo yokuqala yophenyo. Vimba umsebenzi ongihlaza nokukhwelana ngaphakathi kweMnyango. Yenza uphando ngemithetho yakamuva yomsebenzi ongihlaza nokukhwelana uphinde ucwebe izinhlela zemfundo. Cweba uphinde usebenzise imikhuba yokuvikela umsebenzi ongihlaza nokuqwathanisa nokukhwelana kanye nezinhlela. Yenta isilinganiso sokuba sengozini yomsebenzi ongihlaza. Thola umsebenzi ongihlaza nokukhwelana. Thola amaphethini asengozini/afihliwe kanye nokuziphila okungalungile kuzo zonke izinhlobo zedatha. Phatha ukulungiswa kwemibhalo yokuqaphela kanye nokuvalwa. Dala isimo sokuziphenda okuhle uphinde ukhulise ukuphathwa kahle. Xhumana nabandulelangaphakathi nabangaphandle uphude ulunge ishejuli yonyaka yeziqephu zokwazisa. Cweba, usebenzise uphinde uphinde ubuke imigqatho, imikhuba nemikhuba yeqoqo elibhekene nokukhwelana kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuzethemba. Cweba umnqophozo wokwesekwa ukukhwelana nendlela yokuphathwa kokuzethemba nenhlelo yokuvikela umsebenzi ongihlaza. Phatha izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuzethemba uphide ukhuthaze ukuziphenda okuhle kumnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi amalungu eSMS kanye nalelo elinye iqoqo lezigaba zabasebenzi abakhethiwe athumela izivezo zeziimali ngokusho kweNguqulo yeziZivezo zeMali. Phatha ukucweba isiqondiswa sezengozi zomsebenzi ongihlaza kanye nokuziphenda kuMnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwemibalo yokuqhuba iqaphelozinhlelo zenzo zengozi zomsebenzi ongihlaza yimibhizinisi. Phatha izinsiza (abantu, izisetshenziswa/izimpahla njll.). Phatha izikhalazo ngokusho kwezindlela ezilawulwayo.

xh.title: Titshala Wengeniso: Ulwengube, Ubandlululo Nokwamkela iMigaqo
xh.summary: Titshala wengeniso: Ukukhokelwa kukadityalwa uphando kwisenzo esingalunganga nokubandlululo, ukuqokelela ubungqina nokuqamba iindlela ezithintela oko kwikomkhulu lomnyango weendonga zobuse Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport.
xh.requirements: summary
xh.duties: Phanda zonke izenzo zodlwengube nobandlululo. Phenya zonke iimpiko ezimalunga nodlwengube nobandlululo ezivela kubantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Thabatha iinkcazelo, qokelela ubungqina uzobe nengxelo yophando yokuqala. Thintela udlwengube nobandlululo ngaphakathi kwisebe. Yenza uphando ngomthetho wetshanje wedlwengube nobandlululo uze uqhube iinkqubo zemfundo. Yakhe uze usesibe iindlela zokuthintela udlwengube nezokuchasana nobandlululo. Yenza inkalo yengozi yedlwengube. Hlola udlwengube nobandlululo. Hlola iidathini ezikrwelecekileyo/ezifihliweyo nokuziphatha okungalangaqangiyo kuzo zonke iindidi zedatha. Lawula ulungiselelo lweengxelo zokuhlola nokuvala. Yakhe indawo enemigaqo yobomi ukuze kube khona ulawulo olulungileyo. Xhumana namabango angaphakathi nangaphandle uze udibe ishedyuli yonyaka yeenkundla zokwazisa. Yakhe, sethube uze uhlolate iingqinqo, iindlela nenkqubo yolawulo lokuchasana nobandlululo nolawulo lwakho ngokwexabiso kwicandelo. Yakhe inkqubo ebalulekileyo ngeplani yokuthintela udlwengube yolawulo lokuchasana nobandlululo nolwalo ngokwexabiso. Lawula izigqibo zolawulo ngokwexabiso uze ukhuthaze ukuziphatha ngokwemigaqo kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuba amalungu e-SMS nala magqoka abasebenzi abachaziweyo ngaphakathi banike iinkcazelo zeemali ngokweNkqubo yeNkcazelo zeMali. Lawula uphuhliso lwegenda yeengozi zedlwengube nemigaqo yexabiso yesebe. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweengxelo zent Progress eyandayo yedatha ngamashishini. Lawula izibonelelo (abantu, izixhobo/izipho zokusebenza njl.njl.). Lawula iingxaki ngokweendlela ezichaziweyo.

Minimum of 3 – 5 years of experience in Labour Relations, collective bargaining, legal environment and/or case management, of which 2 years must be at a supervisory level. Knowledge and skills: GPG and GPDRT policies and procedures, and relevant legislation and Public Service Regulations, people management and empowerment and problem-solving analysis.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Saakbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir saakbestuur by die Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport in Johannesburg, wat wan gedrag-sake en arbeidsverhoudinge bestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en onderhou 'n saakbestuurstelsel. Erken en registreer alle sake in die Departement. Analiseer ontvang verslae en kla werknemers in om gronde van wangedrag te bepaal. Verseker dat ondersoeke uitgevoer word en skakel met arbeidsunies se verteenwoordigers en maak aanbevelings. Fasiliteer geskilbeslegting. Woon die bemiddelings- en arbitrasieverrigtinge by vir alle vasgestelde geskille. Koördineer en fasiliteer dissiplinêre prosesse. Fasiliteer die erkenning en ontvangs van arbitrasie-toekenning. Ontwikkeling van arbeidsverhoudingsbeleid, handleidings en riglyne.

zu.summary: Onozimele wobhaliswe njengwaNkomishi wezokuqondisa icala eGauteng Department of Roads and Transport eJohannesburg, ephathele izinkomba zokuziphatha kabi kanye nezindaba ezimalunga nodlelwano abantu abasebenzisana , ephethe izinkomba ezimalunga nokuziphatha kabi nezindinganiso zendabuko.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ugcinde inkqubo yokuqondisa icala. Yakaza futhi ubhalise wonke amacala kuMnyango. Hlaziya imibiko etholiwe futhi ususe izinkomba kubasebenzi ukuze kunqunywe izizathu zokuziphatha kabi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa iziphopho futhi uxhumane nezithunywa zabaluleki bezamabutho abasebenzi uphinde wenze izincomo. Siza ekuxazululeni izinkinga. Zibandakanye ekuxazululweni ngokuvumelana nasekuqahleni kwezinkinga ezinhle zokuqediswa. Hlela futhi usize izinqubo zezhlakalo zokuziphatha kabi. Siza ekuyakuzeni nasekwamukeleni izinqumo zokuqaha. Hlela futhi usize izinqubo zezhlakalo zokuziphatha kabi. Zibandakanye kulo lonke izingxoxo ezisemtsetfweni zezhlakalo zokuziphatha kabi kanye nobuholi obuhamba phambili kuMnyango. Khuthaza amasu afanele ahle kahle wobudlelwano bezamabutho abasebenzi kuMnyango. Nikeza iseluleko kuzo zonke izindaba kanye nobunzima bezamabutho abasebenzi. Intuthuko yobudlelwano bezamabutho abasebenzi. Intuthuko yemigomo yobudlelwano bezamabutho abasebenzi, izincwadi zokuhola kanye nemiyalo.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkokeli: Uqulo LweziGxeko
xh.summary: UMncedisi wenkokeli wokuqula iingxaki eGauteng Department of Roads and Transport eJohannesburg, elawulayo iingxeko zokuziphatha kakubi nezodibanisano kolusebenzo.
xh.duties: Lawula igcina inkqubo yokulawula iingxeko. Vuma ubhalise zonke iingxeko kwisebe. Hlola iingxelo ezifunyenwe zendulawulo abasebenzi ukuba umisise izizathu zokuziphatha kakubi. Qinisekisa ukuba kuphando kunyenzwa udibanise nabameeli beLabour Unions wenze izindululo. Yenza inkqubo yokuqulwa kweengxabano. Khonza iinkqubo zokuyelekana nokuziphatha kwengxelo kuzo zonke iingxeko ezingeniswayo. Hlela futhi usekelwe inkqubo yohlwayo. Sebenzisa ukuvuma nokwamkela iziphatho zokuziphatha kwengxelo. Hlela futhi usekelwe inkqubo yohlwayo. Khonza kuzo zonke iinkqubo ezisemthethweni zokuziphatha kakubi kolunyazo kwisebe. Sekela iziseko ezilunge neLungilelolusebenzo ezisebenzayo kwisebe. Nikezelana ngolwazi kuzo zonke izinto ezibalulekileyo zodibanisano kolusebenzo namadinga. Phuhlisa iziseko zodibanisano kolusebenzo. Phuhlisa amagqabantshusti odibanisano kolusebenzo, amagqabantshusti namathunjana eziseko zolawulo.

Knowledge and Skills: Project management methodologies Business performance management Community relations & Stakeholder relationship management. Analytical thinking Research, Computer utilization, Policy formulation Conflict management, financial management, Adaptability during changes to meet the goals Strategic management Change/diversity management. Knowledge of GPG and DPSA policies and procedures, relevant legislation and Public Service, Regulations Understanding of expectations of customers Knowledge of SLAs. Management information knowledge of GPG political and executive structures.
jobs.summary: Manage employee health and wellness programmes including disease management, mental health and occupational health policies at the Department of Roads and Transport Head Office in Johannesburg.
jobs.duties: Develop and promote disease and chronic illnesses management programmes. Manage and promote mental health and psychosomatic illnesses. Manage injury on duty and incapacity due to ill health. Develop and implement policies, procedures, guidelines and promote occupational health education. Manage resources (Human / equipment / Assets). Conduct awareness programmes on the functions and purpose of health surveillance and the relevant laws and regulations. Develop and implement a toolkit for Mental Health Promotion in the workplace which looks at practical steps for addressing mental health. Measure the impact of programmes that reduce the psychosocial and physical demands of the workplace that trigger stress. Develop and implement strategies to reduce stigma and discrimination against people living with mental diseases as well as the promotion of human rights and wellness. Provide and promote utilization of counselling and support services. Develop cost effective health care programmes to quantify Return on investment ROI. Develop Departmental Health and Productivity Management Policy and flexible policies that address work-life balance. Coordinate the implementation of wellness programmes, projects and interventions. Manage staff Plan, organize and control activities pertaining to the functions of the programme Provide technical advice to management Evaluate and monitor performance of employees to ensure achievement of strategic goals.
