af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Gesondheid en Welstand
af.summary: Bestuur werknemergesondheids- en welstandsprogramme, insluitend siektebestuur, geestesgesondheid en beroepsgesondheidsbeleid by die Department of Roads and Transport Hoofkantoor in Johannesburg.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en bevorder bestuursprogramme vir siektes en chroniese siektes. Bestuur en bevorder geestesgesondheid en psigosomatiese siektes. Bestuur beserings op diens en onvermoë as gevolg van swak gesondheid. Ontwikkel en implementeer beleid, prosedures, riglyne en bevorder beroepsgesondheidsopvoeding. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslik / toerusting / bates). Voer bewustheidsprogramme uit oor die funksies en doel van gesondheidsurveillance en die toepaslike wette en regulasies. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n nutskits vir geestesgesondheidsbevordering in die werkplek wat praktiese stappe ondersoek vir die hantering van geestesgesondheid. Meet die impak van programme wat die psigososiale en fisiese eise van die werkplek wat stres veroorsaak, verminder. Ontwikkel en implementeer strategieë om stigmatisering en diskriminasie teen mense met geestesiektes te verminder, asook die bevordering van menseregte en welstand. Verskaf en bevorder die benutting van berading- en ondersteuningsdienste. Ontwikkel kostedoeltreffende gesondheidsorgprogramme om Return on investment ROI te kwantifiseer. Ontwikkel Departementele Gesondheids- en Produktiwiteitsbestuursbeleid en buigsaam beleid wat werk-lewe balans aanspreek. Koördineer die implementering van welstandsprogramme, projekte en intervensies. Bestuur personeel. Beplan, organiseer en beheer aktiwiteite met betrekking tot die funksies van die programma. Verskaf tegniese advies aan bestuur. Evalueer en monitor prestasie van werknemers om versekering van die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte.

zu.title: Umncedisi Wezondolo Nobuhlakani: Empilo Nepilimpilo
zu.summary: Phatha amaphrogramu empilo nepilimpilo yabasebenzi okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwezifo, impilo yengqondo namapholisi empilo kumsebenzi eNdibe Yomnyango Wezindlela Nezokuthutha eJohannesburg.
zu.duties: Qamba futhi ukhuthaze amaphrogramma okuphathwa kwezifo nezifo ezingapheli. Phatha futhi ukhuthaze impilo yengqondo nezifo ezibangelwa isimo sabangongoma. Phatha izilimo ezibangelwa umsebenzi nokuntuleka amandla ngenxa yokugula. Qamba futhi usebenzise amapholisi, izinqubo, iziqondiso futhi ukhuthaze imfundiso ngempilo yomsebenzi. Phatha izinsiza (Abantu / izisetshenziswa / izimpahla). Qamba amaphrogramma okwazisa ngezenzo ngenjongo yokubheka impilo namapholisi amileyo. Qamba futhi usebenzise ithuluzi elilodwa lokukhuthaza impilo yengqondo emsebenzini elicabangela izinyathelo ezibonakalayo zokuxazulula impilo yengqondo. Linganisa umphumela wamaphrogramma anciphisa izidingo ezengqondweni nangomzimba ezibangela ukucindezeleka. Qamba futhi usebenzise izindlela zokunciphisa ukwenyanya ukwedluliswa kanye nokuqambela abantu abaphila nabezifo bengqondo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwamalungelo abantu. Qinisekisa futhi ukhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokweluleka nokuhasa. Qamba amaphrogramma aphathekayo emiboniso yemali ahlenga isidingo semali. Qamba umthetho weholo nomsebenzi weholo nepilimpilo kanye namapholisi abambelelayo axazulula ibhalansi yomsebenzi nokupila. Lungisa amaphrogramma okuphathwa kwepilimpilo, amaphrojekthi kanye nokungenelela. Phatha abasebenzi. Hlela, lungisa futhi ulawule izenzo ezihlobene nemisebenzi yephrogramma. Nikeza izeluleko zezobuchwepheshe kubaphathi. Hlola futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza amaqhinga amabalengwe.

xh.title: Umphathi woMncedi: iMpilo nokuPhila kakuhle
xh.summary: Lawula iinkqubo zempilo kunye nobomi abantu basebenzayo, kuquka ulawulo lwesifo, impilo yengqondo, kunye neenkqubomgomo zeempilo zomsebenzi kwiSebe leeNdlela nakuThutho kwindlu eNkulu eJohannesburg.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa kunye nokukhuthaza iinkqubo zolawulo lwesifo nezifo ezihlala njalo. Lawula kunye nokukhuthaza impilo yengqondo nezifo ezibangelwa kukuba khona kwengqondo. Lawula umonakalo owenzekayo esikhundleni somsebenzi kunye nokungabi namandla ngenxa yokugula. Phuhlisa kunye nokusebenzisa iinkqubomgomo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo kunye nokukhuthaza imfundo yeempilo zomsebenzi. Lawula izixhobo (Abantu / izixhobo / Iimpahla). Qhube imikhakha yokuqonda ngeenkqubo ngenjongo yokulondolozwa kwempilo kunye namacebo amanqanaba kwaye athethe amagunya. Phuhlisa kunye nokusebenzisa isixhobo somsebenzi sokuKhuthaza impilo yengqondo kwindawo yokusebenza esibheka iinyathelo zokwenza ngoko ngenxa yokusingatha impilo yengqondo. Linganisa umphumo weenkqubo ezinciphisayo iimfuno ezibangela ingcinezelo ezingqondweni nakumzimba endaweni yokusebenzi. Phuhlisa kunye nokusebenzisa iindlela zokunciphisa ukuqhawula nokwahlukanisa abantu abaphila ngezifo zengqondo, kunye nokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu nobuhlaza bempilo. Yaza ukusebenziswa kweenkonzo zokuwelula kunye nenkxaso. Phuhlisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo ngesixa semali zeziphe impilo ukulinganisa iPhindo lemali yotyalo-mali. Phuhlisa iNkqubomgomo yeMpilo yeNkonzo kunye noLawulo lwoMsebenzi kunye neenkqubomgomo eziguquguqukayo ezibhekisa kumlinganiselo wobomi kunye nomsebenzi. Lawula abasebenzi. Cwangcisa, yahlule kunye noLawulwa kwezinto ezinxulumene nomsebenzi weenkqubo. Yaza ingcebiso yobugcisa kuqeqesho. Linganisa ubugcisa kubasebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukufezekiswa kwemigangatho ebalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY) (THEATRE)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum, Plus Rural Allowance 8% Benefits: 13th Cheque, medical aid (optional), Housing Allowance (Employees must meet the prescribed requirements) Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum, Plus Rural Allowance 8% Benefits: 13th Cheque, Housing Allowance (Employees must meet the prescribed requirements), medical aid (optional).
jobs.summary: Professional nurse specialised in theatre nursing sought for Niemeyer Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, providing holistic specialised patient care and supervising junior staff.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate or recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Plus one year Post basic qualification in Operating Theatre Nursing. Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate or recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in a speciality after obtaining one year post basic qualification in the relevant speciality. Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification. Degree/ Diploma in General Nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. One (1) year post basic qualification in Theatre. Current registration with South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse (2026 SANC receipt) a minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Experience and Competencies Required: Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills. Ability to make independent decision. An understanding of the challenges facing the public health sector. Ability to prioritize issues and other work related matters and to comply with time frames. High level of accuracy. Depth knowledge of Acts, procedures, prescripts and legislation.
jobs.duties: Render an optimal holistic specialized nursing care to patients as member of the Multidisciplinary team. Train and supervise junior staff and student nurses. To execute Professional Nursing Duties and functions with proficiency in support of the aims and strategic objectives of the institution and to perform duties within the prescripts of all applicable legislation. To assist the Operational Manager in charge of the Theatre with the overall management and the necessary support for the effective functioning of the Theatre. Develop competencies in scrub, circulating, recovery room and set room duties. Ensure safe environment to achieve desired outcome of surgical interventions. Work collaboratively with Surgeons and Anesthetists to meet patient needs during theatre procedures and ensure responsibility for patient care. Ensure safe environment for patients by assisting junior nursing staff members through teaching and supervising. Plan, provide and supervise nursing activities in the different allocated specialty. Ensure fiscal control of materials, supplies and equipment. Provision of efficient floor nurses duties. Manage/ co-ordinate the smooth functioning of the instrument room.
jobs.applications: Please forward applications quoting reference number to: Human Resource Management, Niemeyer Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X1004, Utrecht, 2980 email: Niemeyer.Intern@kznhealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: NB: Equity Target: Male African. Directions to Candidates: The following documents must be submitted: Applications are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant document on application but must submit the Employment Form (Z83) and the detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of certificates and other relevant documents will only be requested from shortlisted candidate on or before the interviews. Therefore only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. It will be expected candidate(s) to be available for interview process on a day, all shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on form Z83 e.g. Reference Number (NMH/THRT2026) Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify the applicants. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the State Security Agency (SAA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers. Please note that due to a large number of applications received, applications will not be acknowledged, however, only the short-listed applicants will be advised of the outcome. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. (This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity at all levels of different Occupational Categories in the Department). OTHER POST

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige (SPESIALITEIT) (TEATER)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat in teaterverpleging gespesialiseer is, gesoek vir Niemeyer Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat holistiese gespesialiseerde pasiëntversorging bied en toesig hou oor junior personeel.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste of herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Plus een jaar se post-basiese kwalifikasie in Operasieteaterverpleging. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste of herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet gepaste of herkenbare ervaring in 'n spesialiteit wees na verkryging van een jaar se post-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Graad/ Diploma in Algemene Verpleging of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Een (1) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Teater. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026 SANC kwitansie) 'n minimum van 4 jaar gepaste of herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Ervaring en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Sterke interpersoonlike, kommunikasie- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklike besluite te neem. 'n Begrip van die uitdagings wat die openbare gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar. Vermoë om kwessies en ander werkverwante aangeleenthede te prioriteer en met tydraamwerke te voldoen. Hoë vlak van akkuraatheid. Diepgaande kennis van Wette, prosedures, voorskrifte en wetgewing.
af.duties: Lewer optimale holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg aan pasiënte as lid van die Multidissiplinêre span. Tree op en hou toesig oor junior personeel en studentverpleegkundiges. Voer Professionele Verpleegpligte en -funksies met vaardigheid uit ter ondersteuning van die doelwitte en strategiese oogmerke van die instelling en verrig pligte binne die voorskrifte van alle toepaslike wetgewing. Bied bystand aan die Operasionele Bestuurder in beheer van die Teater met die algehele bestuur en die nodige ondersteuning vir die doeltreffende funksionering van die Teater. Ontwikkel bevoegdhede in skrop-, sirkulasie-, herstelkamer- en stelkamerpligte. Verseker 'n veilige omgewing om die gewenste uitkoms van chirurgiese ingrepe te bereik. Werk saam met Chirurge en Narkotiste om pasiëntbehoeftes gedurende teaterprosedures te dien en om verantwoordelikheid vir pasiëntsorg te verseker. Verseker 'n veilige omgewing vir pasiënte deur junior verpleegkundige personeel by te staan deur onderrig en toesig. Beplan, verskaf en hou toesig oor verpleegaktiwiteite in die verskillende toegewysde spesialiteite. Verseker fiskale beheer oor materiaal, voorrade en toerusting. Verskaffing van doeltreffende vloerverpleegkundige pligte. Bestuur en koördineer die gladde funksionering van die instrumentkamer.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi oyingcwelo (SPECIALTY) (THEATRE)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi oyingcwelo obhizinisele ekuhlinzweni eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, onikeza ukunakekelwa okubaluleke kakhulu kwesiguli njengoba ethumba noma eqondisa abasebenzi abancane.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni: Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yisipiliyoni esifanele noma esiyaziwayo ekuhlinzweni emva kokuqoshwa njengomhlengikazi oyingcwelo ne-SANC ekuhlinzweni jikelele. Kanye nenkathi engu-1 yezifundo ezingemuva kokuqeqeshwa ekuhlinzweni kwabahlengikazi. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni: Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yisipiliyoni esifanele noma esiyaziwayo ekuhlinzweni emva kokuqoshwa njengomhlengikazi oyingcwelo ne-SANC ekuhlinzweni jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanele noma esiyaziwayo esikhundleni esibalulekile emva kokuthola inkathi engu-1 yezifundo ezingemuva kokuqeqeshwa esikhundleni esibalulekile. Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu noma izifundo ezingulinganisayo. I-diploma noma idigri ekuhlinzweni jikelele noma izifundo ezingulinganisayo ezivumela ukuqoshwa ne-SANC njengomhlengikazi oyingcwelo. Inkathi engu-1 yezifundo ezingemuva kokuqeqeshwa kwi-Theatre. Ukuqoshwa okwamanje neSouth African Nursing Council njengomhlengikazi oyingcwelo (isesipho sika-2026 se-SANC) okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yisipiliyoni esifanele noma esiyaziwayo ekuhlinzweni emva kokuqoshwa njengomhlengikazi oyingcwelo ne-SANC ekuhlinzweni jikelele. Ulwazi, amakhono, isipiliyoni namandla adingekayo: Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana, okuxoxa nokubonisa. Ikhono lokwenza izinqumo ngokuzimele. Ukuqonda izinselele ezibhekwa umnyango wezempilo yomphakathi. Ikhono lokubeka izinto ezingokubaluleka kanye nezinye izindaba eziphathelene nomsebenzi futhi uguquise ngosuku olumisiwe. Izinga eliphezulu lokunemba. Ulwazi olujulile ngemithetho, izinqubo, imithetho yesiHlalo nomthetho.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa okubaluleke kakhulu kwesiguli njengomhlengikazi ohlelele njengelungu leqembu elihlangene. Qeqesha futhi uqondise abasebenzi abancane kanye nabafundi bokuholwa. Ukwenza imisebenzi nomsebenzi womhlengikazi oyingcwelo ngobuhlakani ukuze useke izinjongo kanye nemigomo eyisisekelo yesikhungo futhi uzenze imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwemithetho yonke efanele. Usize umphathi wezokusebenza ophethe i-Theatre ngokuphatha okuphelele kanye nensizo efunekayo ukuze i-Theatre isebenze ngempumelelo. Thuthukisa amandla ekusingeni izinto, ekuzungezeni, egumbi lokubuyisela nasegumbi lezokulungiselela. Qinisekisa indawo ephephile ukuze kufinyelelwe esiphethweni esifunekayo sezokuhlinza. Sebenzisana nabachibi kanye nabanikezi we-anesthesia ukuze kuhabezwe izidingo zesiguli ngesikhathi kwenziwa imisebenzi ye-theatre futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ngaphathwa kahle ukunakekelwa kwesiguli. Qinisekisa indawo ephephile yeziguli ngokusiza abahlengikazi abancane ngokufundisa nokuqondisa. Cwangcisa, nikeza futhi uqondise imisebenzi yokuholwa kwesikhundla esibalulekile esahlukanisiwe. Qinisekisa ukulawula izimali kwemishwana, izimpahla kanye nempahla. Nikela ngomsebenzi ophumelelayo wabahlengikazi baphansi. Phatha/hlelela ukusebenza okuhamba kahle kwendawo yezikhali.

xh.title: Umntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli (ISIKOLO) (ITHIYETHA)
xh.summary: Kufunakwa umntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli oqeqeselwe ekunyuselekeni kwethiyetha eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, ukunika ukhathalelo olubambiselayo oluchanekileyo kubaguli nokulawula abasebenzi abancinane.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Abambelelo: Ukuba nomvuzo opheleleyo we minyaka emi-4 ehambelanayo okanye eyaziwayo ekunyuselekeni emva kokubhalisa njengomntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli kwi-SANC kwisoqeqeselo jikelele. Kwaye kunyaka omnye wesoqeqeselo emva kwesiseko sokusebenza ekunyuselekeni kwethiyetha. Inqanaba 2: Abambelelo: Ukuba nomvuzo opheleleyo we minyaka emi-4 ehambelanayo okanye eyaziwayo ekunyuselekeni emva kokubhalisa njengomntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli kwi-SANC kwisoqeqeselo jikelele. Okona kunye neminyaka eli-10 kuloo mikhondila echazwe apha ngenhla kufuneka ibe ngabambelelo ahambelanayo/eyaziwayo kwisiko elithile emva koku fumana isoqeqeselo somnyaka omnye emva kwesiseko kwesiko elithathelene nalo. Isetifikethi esiphakamileyo okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Isidanga/ I diploma ekusoqeqeselo jikelele okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganako esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli. Isoqeqeselo somnyaka (1) omnye emva kwesiseko kwithiyetha. Ukubhalisa ngokuSouth African Nursing Council njengomntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli (2026 SANC receipt) ukuba nomvuzo opheleleyo we minyaka emi-4 ehambelanayo/eyaziwayo ekunyuselekeni emva kokubhalisa njengomntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli nge-SANC kwisoqeqeselo jikelele. Ulwazi, Amandla, Abambelelo namakhono afunekayo: Amandla amakhulu okudibana nabantu, okunxibelelanakunokubonisa. Amandla okwenza izigibo ezingathintelwa ngabanye. Ukuqonda iingxaki ezibhekisiswa ngummandla wezoempilo kazwelonke. Amandla okubeka izinto phambili nezinye iindaba ezinxulumene nomsebenzi nokuthobela iinkqubo zexesha. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuqinisekisa uchane. Ulwazi olujulile ngoMthetho, iinkqubo, imilayo nomthetho.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngokhathalelo oluchanekileyo olubambiselayo ekunyuselekeni kubaguli njengelungu leqela elinamandla amaninzi. Ukuqeqesha nokulawula abasebenzi abancinane nabafundi bakwa hloli. Ukwenza imisebenzi namagunya omntu oqeqeselweyo kwabahloli ngobuchule ngenkxaso yamabhango namajonga amagqabantshintshi seluleko nokwenza imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwemilayo yonke imithetho esekezayo. Ukuncedisa umphathi weesebe ezijonge iThiyetha ngolawulo jikelele noncedo olufunekayo ukuze ithiyetha isebenze ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuphuhlisa amakhono ekugqwalisa, okujikeleza, kwigumbi lokubuyela emva kunye nemisebenzi yegumbi lokulungiselela. Ukuqinisekisa indawo ekhuselekileyo ukufezekisa iziphumo ezifunwayo zokungenisa okuhlinzwayo. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nabachibize abahlinzayo kunye nabanyuzi abaphatha ukubethwa komzimba ukuyalelana iimfuno zabaguli ngexesha leenkqubo zethiyetha ukuze bagcade ubuxanduva bokhathalelo labaguli. Ukuqinisekisa indawo ekhuselekileyo kubaguli ngokunceda abasebenzi bahleli abancinane ngokufundisa nokulawula. Ukuca, ukubonelela nokulawula imisebenzi yokhathalelo kumacandelo ahlukeneyo abekiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo lwezinto, ezixhobo nezithengiswa. Kubonelele ngomsebenzi osebenzayo we floor nurses. Ukulawula/ ukulungelelanisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwegumbi lezixhobo.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Programbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir programbestuur in die Midlands-streek, wat toezig hou oor programimplementering, bestedingsmonitering en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid binne die beboude omgewing.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n tersiêre kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 in die beboude omgewing of 'n verwante veld. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se verwante ervaring in die beboude omgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Woordverwerking, Sigblad, Voorlegging en Outlook). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van programme binne die streek. Bestuur en moniter programbesteding en die voorbereiding van finansiële vorderingsverslae. Fasiliteer effektiewe bestuur van belanghebbendes en WIMS. Lewer beleide en strategieë wat daarop gemik is om dienslewering te verbeter. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die sub-direktoraat.

zu.title: Usomlilo: Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo
zu.summary: Usomlilo wokuphathwa kwezinhlele e-Midlands Region, obheka inqubo yokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo, ukulawula ukuchithwa kwemali kanye nokuxhumana namahlunga ngaphakathi kwendawo yakhiwe.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nesidumbu esifanele samabanga aphakeme e-NQF level 6 endaweni yakhiwe noma ombhalweni ohlobene. Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yohluva oluhlobene nendawo yakhiwe. Ukubhalisele kwesikhompiyutha (Word processing, Spreadsheet, Presentation kanye ne-Outlook). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha inqubo yokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Lawula bese ubuka ukuchithwa kwemali yezinhlelo kanye nokuqhathanisa imibiko yesiphakamiso sezimali. Yenza kube lula ukuxhumana kahle namahlunga kanye nokuphathwa kwe-WIMS. Hlela izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela ezihlose ukuphucula ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Phatha izinsiza ze-Sub-Directorate.

xh.title: Isebe leNkulumbuso: Ulawulo lweNkqubo
xh.summary: Isebe leNkulumbuso lolawulo lwenkqubo kwiMidlands Region, luphethe ukuphunywa kwenkqubo, ukulandela ukusebenzisa imali nokuthatha inxaxheba babathintelwayo ngaphakathi kwendawo esakhiweyo.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 kunye nesidanga esifanelekileyo saseyunivesithi kwinqanaba le-NQF 6 kwindawo esakhiweyo okanye indawo edibene nayo. Isiqingatha seminyaka eli-3 yokuba namava kwindawo esakhiweyo. Ukubakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ukuqhuba amagama, Spreadsheet,okuvezwa okubhalweyo kunye ne-Outlook). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphunywa kweenkqubo ngaphakathi kwiRegion. Lawula ulandele imali yenkqubo nolungiselelo lwemibiko yentuthuko yemali. Yenza abathintelwayo abasebenzayo ulawulo lwe-WIMS lifanelekile. Zeza iinkqubo nezicwangciso ezijolise ekuphuculweni kokuhlinzwa ngenkonzo. Lawula amakhono eSub-Directorate.

zu.title: Injiniya (PRODUCTION) Isigaba a

Uqinisekise ukugqamwa kokuthobela imithetho ehlobene, imithethonqubo, imithethonqubo yomnyango kanye nenqubo. Uhlanganise futhi wenze konke ukuphenya okungalungile, kokushoda kwemali echithiwe kanye nobugebengu. Unikeze izinto ezilungiswayo ekuthuthukisweni nakubuqoshi kobunye imithethonqubo yolawulo langaphakathi lomnyango, izakhiwo, kanye namabhuku wenqubo.

zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngamasevisi okuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Hlinzeka ngamasevisi angemuva kokuqashwa esifundeni. Bheka futhi ulawule ukunwetshwa kwemikhawulo yezinsuku zokuqina kanye nokuphathwa kokusayina. Lawula ukukhokhwa kwabahlinzeki, abakhiyo kanye nababoni ngazo mzimba. Qondisa izempesheni/abasebenzi.

xh.title: Ofisi Wolawulo: Isithuba BID
xh.summary: Ofisi Wolawulo etla bobonakalise iinkonzo zolawulo lesinxulumene nesebe lexabiso emva kwexabiso, ulawulo lokuqhutywa kweentlawa kumatshisiweyo kwaye alalele abasebenzi kw canduvo le Midlands, ifuna isidanga okanye idiploma phakathi komnye unyaka wamava.
xh.requirements: Isigidimi seBanga le-12 lengenelo ngesidanga esinxulumeneyo okanye iDiploma yeSizwe. Ubuncinane bonye (1) unyaka wamava asebenzayo onxulumeneyo. Ukuba nobugcisa bekhompyutha kwiinkqubo zobucwecwe be-ofisi ezo ngu-Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Ilayisensi yokuqhayisa esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngeenkonzo Zolawulo Lwesebe lexabiso. Kubonelele iinkonzo zangemva kwe-Bid kw canduvo. Qaphela ulawule ukwandiswa kweexesha ezisezinyeni kunye nolawulo lokusayina. Lawula intlawulo yomatshisiweyo, wokusingatha inkqubo kunye nabacebi. Lawule iziseko zeZaBantu/Abasebenzi.

jobs.summary: Supervise human resource administration practices, personnel records, EPMDS and HRD matters at the Zululand District Office in Ulundi.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi
zu.summary: Qondisise izinqubo zolawulo lwabasebenzi, irekhodi labasebenzi, izindaba ze-EPMDS neze-HRD eZululand District Office eUlundi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade12 noma esilinganayo. Okungezona ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-3 yohluhlelo oluhambisanayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (Ms Word, PowerPoint, Excel nge-imeyili). Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Qondisise futhi wenze ukuphatha nokugcina izinqubo ezindzima zolawulo lwabasebenzi. Qaphela irekhodi labasebenzi. Hlela futhi usebenzise izindaba ze-EPMDS esifundazweni. Hlela izindaba ze-HRD. Qondisise abasebenzi/bantu basebenzayo.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12 okanye esilinganayo. Isipho esingaphantsi kweminyaka eli-3 yamava ahambelana nalomsebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-Ms Word, i-PowerPoint, i-Excel nge-email). Ilayisense yokuqhuba esemthethweni.

jobs.title: Legal Administration Officer Mr3/mr4/mr5
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: MR3: R337 563 - R385 965 per annum MR4: R403 929 - R461 838 per annum MR5: R483 219 - R685 812 per annum Dependant on number of years of post qualification relevant experience [as per the provisions contained within the Occupational Specific Dispensation (OSD) for Legally Qualified Personnel in the Public Service]
jobs.summary: Legal Administration Officer at MR3 to MR5 level providing litigation advisory, legal opinions, and drafting services for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 plus an appropriate Bachelor of Laws (LLB) degree or equivalent qualification. MR3: At least 2 years’ appropriate post-qualification legal experience and MR4: At least 5 years’ appropriate post-qualification legal experience and MR5: At least 8 years’ appropriate post-qualification legal experience. Experience preferably in commercial litigation, property law/conveyancing and contract drafting matters. Admission as an Attorney or an Advocate. Computer Literacy in Word processing, Spreadsheet, Presentation and email software programmes & a valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Interpret, draft and edit a wide variety of legal documents such as a contract, guarantees etc. in order to protect the interests of the Department. Providing litigation advisory services for the Department. Provide accurate and well – researched legal opinions and advice. Advising and dealing with general public service and policy issues, ensuring compliance with legislation and keeping abreast of legal developments and conducting research on the law. Developing and drafting of provincial legislation as required by the Department. Assist with the development of Departmental policies.

af.title: Regsadministrasiebeampte Mr3/mr4/mr5
af.summary: Regsadministrasiebeampte op MR3- tot MR5-vlak wat litigasie-advies, regsmenings en opsteldienste vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pietermaritzburg verskaf.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike Baccalaureus Legum (LLB)-graad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. MR3: Ten minste 2 jaar se toepaslike post-kwalifikasie regservaring en MR4: Ten minste 5 jaar se toepaslike post-kwalifikasie regservaring en MR5: Ten minste 8 jaar se toepaslike post-kwalifikasie regservaring. Ervaring verkieslik in kommersiële litigasie, eiendomsreg/transport en kontrakopstel sake. Toelating as 'n Prokureur of 'n Advokaat. Rekenaarvaardigheid in woordverwerking, sigblad, voorlegging en e-pos sagtewareprogramme & 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Tolk, opstel en redigeer 'n wye verskeidenheid regsdokumente soos kontrakte, waarborge, ens. om die belange van die Department te beskerm. Verskaf litigasie-adviesdienste vir die Department. Verskaf akkurate en deeglik nagevorsde regsmenings en advies. Adviseer en hanteer algemene openbare diens- en beleidsake, verseker nakoming van wetgewing en bly op hoogte van regsontwikkelings en doen navorsing oor die reg. Ontwikkel en opstel provinsiale wetgewing soos deur die Department vereis. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling van departementele beleid.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomthetho Wezokuphathwa MR3/MR4/MR5
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezomthetho Wezokuphathwa emazingeni MR3 kuya ku MR5 ohlinzeka ngeluleko lemikangiswano, izincomo ezomthetho, kanye nezinsizakalo zokubhala umthetho we-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ePietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Isigaba se-12 kanye nendeqe efanele ye-Bachelor of Laws (LLB) degree noma iziqu ezilinganayo. MR3: Okungenani eminyaka emi-2 yohlu lwamava olufanele ngemva kokuqeqeshwa ngokomthetho futhi MR4: Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yohlu lwamava olufanele ngemva kokuqeqeshwa ngokomthetho futhi MR5: Okungenani eminyaka emi-8 yohlu lwamava olufanele ngemva kokuqeqeshwa ngokomthetho. Amava abuye abe ngaphansi komkhakha wezomikangiswano yezentengiso, umthetho wezimpahla/okudluliswa kwezimpahla kanye nokubhala izinkulumo-mvume. Ukwamukelwa njengoMmeli noma njengoSokitsha. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kumahlelokusebenza okucubungula amagama, amashidi okubala, okuhlobo kukawonke-wonke namahlelokusebenza we-imeyili kanye nelesihephu sokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Humusha, bhala futhi uhlele uhlu olubanzi lwemibhalo yomthetho njengesivumelwano, izinhlaziyo, njll. ukuze uvikele izinhloso zikaMnyango. Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zeluleko lemikangiswano kuMnyango. Nikeza izincomo ezomthetho ezinembile futhi ezihlolwe ngokucophelela kanye neluleko. Luleka futhi uphathisise ngezinkinga ezijwayelekile zesevisi yomphakathi kanye nenqubomgomo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho futhi ugcine ukwaziswa ngemikhakha yomthetho futhi uzenze ucwaningo ngomthetho. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukubhala umthetho wesifundazwe njengoba kudingeka nguMnyango. Siza ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo zikaMnyango.

xh.title: Igosa lezomthetho seNqanaba lesi-3/4/5 (MR3/MR4/MR5)
xh.summary: Apho kubekho igosa lezomthetho (Legal Administration Officer) kuqondo lwe-MR3 ukuya ku-MR5 lokukhokeza inkxaso-mbono ngomthetho, imibono yomthetho, nokuqhubelela phambili iinkonzo ezibalulekileyo kwisebe loMsebenzi kaRhulumente nokuQezu kwakho (Public Works and Infrastructure) e-Pietermaritzburg.
xh.requirements: Izithuba ezihamba ngonobumba (Grade 12) ukuya kwisiqingatha sethuba elincinane (Bachelor of Laws) okanye isidanga esingulinganisana. MR3: Ubuncinane iya kwisithuba seminyaka (2) egqithisweyo, ngokusetyenziswa ngokutsha kumthetho okufunyanisweyo. MR4: Ubuncinane iya kwisithuba seminyaka (5) egqithisweyo, ngokusetyenziswa ngokutsha kumthetho okufunyanisweyo. MR5: Ubuncinane iya kwisithuba seminyaka (8) egqithisweyo, ngokusetyenziswa ngokutsha kumthetho okufunyanisweyo. Ulwazi olunqwenela ukuba lusemthethweni wezentengiselwano, umthetho weempahla/ukudlulisa iimpahla nokuqhubeleka phambili iikontraki. Ukungena njengommeli okanye njengomnqweno-mthetho. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha kumagama ashicilelwayo, iispredshiti, iipesenteyishini, i-imeyile, kunye nelayisensi yokuqhuba egqithisweyo.
xh.duties: Kuqucuza, kwabhala nokuhlela uhlobo oluninzi lwemibhalo yomthetho njengekontraki, iinketho njalo njalo ukukhusela izinto ezithunditha isebe. Nika inkxaso-mbono yemigbequko yomthetho kwisebe. Nikezela ngemibono yomthetho egqithiswe kakhulu ngeenelo ezichanekileyo nezilungileyo. Uyalela uphathiswe nemiqobo yesebe lotheirishi nakumigqobhozo, ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana nomthetho, kugcinwe ulwazi ngamashishini omthetho uphando ngeenjongo zomthetho. Phezulu wenza umthetho wephondo, uphando namaxabiso njengoko kufunwa sisebe. Ncedisa ekwakheni iinkqubo zocalulo ezisebe.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Structural: Harry Gwala – Ixopo Ref No: WI/STRUCT/HG/SR26 Mechanical: Umgungundlovu -PMB Ref No: WI/MECH/UMG/SR26

af.duties: Produceer ontwerpe volgens kliëntspesifikasie en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produceer voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspecificasies en erkende standaarde. Voer gehalteversekering uit op geproduceerde voorwerpe. Inspekteer toerusting en/of fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Toets herstelde toerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en/of fasiliteite volgens skedule. Verseker gehalte van onderhoude en gediende toerusting en/of fasiliteite. zu.title: Umsebenzi wesandla
zu.summary: Amaphuzu amabili omsebenzi wesandla (kagesi nendwebi) e-Harry Gwala District Office e-Ixopo, adinga ukuhlolwa kobungcali kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Khiqiza izakhiwo ngokwesitshelo somthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yenkonzo yokukhiqiza. Khiqiza izinto ngezinto ezisetshenziswa nangesisetshenziswa ngokwesitshelo somsebenzi nasemigqeni eqapeliwe. Yenza isiqiniseko sokulingana kwezinto ezenziwe. Hlola isisetshenziswa nezindawo noma kuba nomonakalo ochwepheshe. Lungisa isisetshenziswa nezindawo ngokwemigqasimbe. Hlola isisetshenziswa nezindawo ezilungisiwe ngokwesitshelo. Phathela isisetshenziswa nezindawo ngokuhlelo kwesikhathi. Qinisekisa isilinganiso sesisetshenziswa nezindawo ezinakekiwe nezindawo. Yenza imisebenzi yentlupheko nezinye imisebenzi ehdutshelwe: Hlanganisa futhi uhwele imibiko; Nikeza imibiko ohlelweni lokusebenza; Gcina futhi unake amarekhodi/siqondiso somsebenzi; futhi ulawule futhi ubeke endleleni abasebenzi. Hlala unezakhono futhi qinisekisa ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo komuntu ngamunye ukugcina izinga lezobuchwepheshe ezintsha nendlela zokwenza. IMIBUZO : Nk TW Nkomo Umshini Wocingo: (039) 834 0700

xh.title: Umsebenzi wezandla
xh.summary: Amakhosi amabini abasebenzi ngazandla (abakhezelo kagesi nombathi) kwiOfisi yeSithili sikaHarry Gwala eIxopo, afuna ukuhlolwa kobugcisa bokusebenza ngazandla nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
xh.duties: Dala izimvo ngokwesicelo somthengi kunye nakumda wamandla okudalwa. Dala izinto ngesixhobo nokusesinye isixhobo ngokwesicelo somsebenzi nangokweemigangatho ekuqwalaselwayo. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwemigaqo kwezinto ezedalwe. Hlola izixhobo kwaye noma iindawo zokusingathwa zolwazi-tech. Lungisa izixhobo nendawo zokusingathwa ngokweemigangatho. Zama ukulungisa izixhobo kwaye noma iindawo zokusingathwa ngokwezicelo. Nika izixhobo kwaye noma iindawo zokusingathwa inkonzo ngokohlelo. Qinisekisa ulwazi lemigaqo kwezixhobo ezinikiwe inkonzo kwaye ezikhonzile kwaye noma iindawo zokusingathwa. Yenza imisebenzi yophando kunye nemisebenzi edityaniswe kuyo: Qamba kwaye ungenise iingxelo; Nikezela izixhobo kwiplani yokusebenza; Gcina kwaye ulondoloze irekhodi/hlelo lokubhalisa lemisebenzi; kwaye ulawule kwaye ululele abasebenzi. xh.duties: Dala iimodeli ngokwemigaqo yomthengi kwaye ungagqithi kumda wamandla okuvelisa. Dala izinto ngesixhobo nemizekelo ngokwemigaqo yomsebenzi nangokwemigaqo eqapheliweyo. Qonda nokuqinisekisa ngangokunokwenzeka iindlela zokwenza izinto. Hlola izixhobo kwaye nokwazi iindawo ukuba zikho iimpazamo. Lungisa izixhobo naziindawo ngokwemigaqo. Vavanya ukulungelelwa izixhobo kwaye / nokuzindawo ezingaqinisekiswa ngokwemigaqo. Zonke izixhobo nakuzo zonke iindawo ziboniswe ngomhla wokuqwalaselwa. Qinisekisa ithuba elenze ngalo umntu ngamnye Iintlobo ezingezizo ngokubakho kwazo ngokwenkqubo. Yenza imisebenzi ehambelana nendima ethunyiweyo kunye nolunye ulwimi: Qamba uluntu kwabaxhaphiweyo zibe zizicatshulwa ezikho kuluntu oqinisekise ngakumbi uluntu olukhoyo nakulo nalapho inqaku elidulisweyo selisenziwe, lisebenze ukuba kufuneka ngendlela yokuqwalaselwa ngakumbi lizingela ukuba ngowokusetyenziswa njani ukubakho kwesixhobo ukuba kuye kubekho ukubhalwa kwesicatshulwa esingeniswa ebantwini abangenwa kukhuphiswano, kwaye alale abantu abangenwa kusebenza ngakumbi nto leyo ibakho abayaziyo nokuba baze bafunde ngakumbi into abayaziyo ukuba bazi ngakumbi baze bafunde ngakumbi baze bagqithise kubomi ukwazi nokuba bazi intetho entsha ekuhlaleni.
