jobs.title: Deputy Director: Human Resource Practices and
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive TCE package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Human Resource Practices at the Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Kimberley, managing service benefits and employee terminations.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a tertiary NQF level 7 Degree in Human Resource Management. A minimum of 3-4 years’ relevant experience at Assistant Director level within a Human Resource Management environment. Valid Driver’s license. Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management environment. Knowledge of the PERSAL System (Added advantage: PERSAL controller), Knowledge of policies/ implementation strategies. Knowledge of Human Resource Management Legislation/ Directives. Leadership Skills. Planning and organising skills. Problem-solving skills. Policy Development Skills. Presentation Skills. Interpretation skills. Interpersonal skills. Conflict Management skills. Analytical thinking. Communication skills (verbal/written). Computer skills. Research skills. Project management skills.
jobs.duties: Managing service benefits within the Department: Manage the application and implementation of all service benefits (GEPF, GEHS, PILIR, etc.). Manage coordination of employee service terminations (retirements, resignations, etc.). Ensure the accurate implementation of leave on PERSAL, leave audits of employees and payment of leave gratuities and provision of advice and support regarding leave management. Manage exit interviews. Managing Recruitment and Selection services within the department: Manage the recruitment, selection and appointment of employees whilst ensuring compliance with employment laws and regulations during the recruitment and Selection process (advert, interviews and appointments). Manage and monitor the departmental vacancy rate. Ensure proper administration of appointments, promotions etc. Ensure accurate capturing of personnel information on PERSAL. Management of HR records: Ensure proper human resource record keeping. Ensure an updated filing system. Implement filing control measures. Provide support during Audits. Coordinate submission of HR records reports. Provide operational leadership in management, coordination, monitoring and evaluation of human resources and activities within the HRA &P unit: Management of human resources including Discipline management. Training and Development, PMDS, EHW management, Attendance and leave management, Mainstreaming of females, youth and persons with disabilities. General management in terms of: Budget monitoring. Input, preparation, implementation, monitoring and reporting on Strategic/ Annual Performance/ Operational and HR Plan of the unit. Management of governance structures and systems e.g. PERSAL. Utilisation and care of assets within the unit. Determine specifications for procurement of goods and services. Provision of accurate human resource information, i.e. vacancy rate, turnover rate, etc., for reporting purposes, e.g. HR Plan, HRPIR, EE Report, MANCO Presentations. Attend strategic sessions. Provide input towards the Risk register of the sub- directorate. Attending quarterly forums on HR-related matters which impact audit outcomes. Presenting to and attending internal forums e.g. Staff information sessions, Planning Forum, EMC, Strategic sessions etc. to create awareness and educate on correct application and implementation procedures relating to HR matters to minimise risks associated with audit queries and findings
jobs.applications: Applications quoting the relevant reference should be forwarded as follows: The Head of the Department, Post To: Department of Economic Development and Tourism P/Bag X6108, Kimberley, 8300 or Hand Deliver to: MetLife Towers, (Post Office Building), T Floor (Registry Office), Post Office Building, Kimberley or Email applications to: HRA@ncdedat.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms. M. Musa
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications for employment to the address specified above. The application must include a duly completed and signed new Form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at https://www.dpsa.gov.za/, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae CV; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please note a separate application is required for each position applied for. Applications received using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each application for employment form must be fully completed, initialled and signed by the applicant. Failure to fully complete, initial and sign this form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applicants are not required to submit/attach copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new (Z83) form and detailed curriculum vitae only. The provision of certified documents will only be required from shortlisted candidates for submission on or before the day of the interview following a formal communication from Human Resources unit. In instances where applicants are in possession of a foreign qualification, it is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and only submit proof of such evaluation upon being shortlisted for a post. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders will be required to submit a copy of their Permanent Residence Permits only if shortlisted. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned instruction/ requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the above post/s. Applications, including those submitted via registered mail must reach the department before 16:00 on the day of the closing date. Incomplete applications, or applications received after the closing date will be disqualified. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Please note that suitable candidates will be subjected to a technical assessment as well as satisfactory personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial-asset record check, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification. Successful candidates will also be subjected to a security clearance process. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will be required to sign the performance agreement within three months from the date of assumption of duty. It will also be required that the successful candidate declare to the EA particulars of all registrable financial interests. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. The successful candidate will be appointed subject to positive results of the security clearance process and the verification of educational qualification certificates. Appointment of these positions will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. The Department is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The Employment Equity Plan of the Department shall inform the employment decision. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s). OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronpraktyke en
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Menslike Hulpbronpraktyke by die Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Kimberley, wat diensvoordele en werknemerbeëindigings bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n tersiêre NQF vlak 7-graad in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur hê. 'n Minimum van 3-4 jaar se relevante ervaring op Assistentdirekteur-vlak binne 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van die Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing. Kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel (Bygevoegde voordeel: PERSAL-beheerder), Kennis van beleide/implementeringstrategieë. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuurswetgewing/Riglyne. Leierskapvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Beleidsontwikkelingsvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Interpretasievaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Analitiese denke. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings/skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardighede. Navorsingsvaardighede. Projektbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur van diensvoordele binne die departement: Bestuur die toepassing en implementering van alle diensvoordele (GEPF, GEHS, PILIR, ens.). Bestuur koördinering van werknemerdiensbeëindigings (aftrede, bedankings, ens.). Verseker die akkurate implementering van verlof op PERSAL, verlofoudites van werknemers en betaling van verlofgratifikasies en verskaffing van advies en ondersteuning rakende verlofbestuur. Bestuur uitgangsonderhoude. Bestuur van Werwings- en Seleksiedienste binne die departement: Bestuur die werwing, seleksie en aanstelling van werknemers terwyl nalewing van dienswette en -regulasies tydens die werwings- en seleksieproses verseker word (advertensies, onderhoude en aanstellings). Bestuur en monitor die departementele vakansiesyfer. Verseker behoorlike administrasie van aanstellings, bevorderings ens. Verseker akkurate vaslegging van personeelinligting op PERSAL. Bestuur van HR-rekords: Verseker behoorlike menslike hulpbronrekordhouding. Verseker 'n opgedateerde lêerstelsel. Implementeer lêerbeheermaatreëls. Verskaf ondersteuning tydens oudits. Koördineer indiening van HR-rekordverslae. Verskaf operasionele leierskap in bestuur, koördinering, monitering en evaluering van menslike hulpbronne en aktiwiteite binne die HRA&P-eenheid: Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne insluitend dissiplinebestuur. Opleiding en Ontwikkeling, PMDS, EHW-bestuur, Bywoning en verlofbestuur, Hoofstrooming van vroue, jeug en persone met gestremdhede. Algemene bestuur in terme van: Begrotingsmonitering. Invoer, voorbereiding, implementering, monitering en verslagdoening oor Strategiese/Jaarlikse Prestasie-/Operasionele en HR-plan van die eenheid. Bestuur van bestuursstrukture en -stelsels bv. PERSAL. Benutting en sorg van bates binne die eenheid. Bepaal spesifikasies vir verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verskaffing van akkurate menslike hulpbroninligting, d.w.s. vakansiesyfer, omsetsyfer, ens., vir verslagdoeningsdoeleindes, bv. HR-plan, HRPIR, EE-verslag, MANCO-aanbiedings. Bywoon strategiese sessies. Verskaf insette tot die Risikoregister van die subdirektoraat. Bywoon kwartaalforums oor HR-verwante aangeleenthede wat oudit-uitslae beïnvloed. Aanbieding by en bywoning van interne forums bv. personeelinligtingsessies, Beplanningsforum, EMC, Strategiese sessies ens. om bewustheid te skep en te onderrig oor korrekte toepassings- en implementeringsprosedures rakende HR-aangeleenthede om risiko's wat met ouditnavrae en -bevindings gepaard gaan, te minimaliseer

zu.title: Deputy Director: Human Resource Practices and
zu.summary: I-Deputy Director yezi-Human Resource Practices e-Department of Economic Development and Tourism e-Kimberley, ephatha izinzuzo zokusebenza kanye nokuphuma kwabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Abafakizicelo kumele babe nendima ye-NQF level 7 Degree kwe-Human Resource Management. Okuncane kweminyaka engu-3-4 yamava ahambisanayo esigabeni sika-Assistant Director ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ilicense evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi & Amakhono: Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda kwendawo ye-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi ngendlela ye-PERSAL System (Inzuzo engeziwe: PERSAL controller), Ulwazi ngamasu okwenza/imithethonqubo. Ulwazi ngokuQashwa kwe-Human Resource Legislation/Izinkomba. Amakhono obuholi. Amakhono okucubungula futhi uhlele. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuthuthukisa imithethonqubo. Amakhono okuzethula. Amakhono okuhumusha. Amakhono abantu. Amakhono okuphathwa kwezingxabano. Ukuhlela okuhlukaniswe kanye nokuhlanganiswa. Amakhono okuxoxa (ngomlomo/okubhalwayo). Amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono ocwaningo. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezinzuzo zokusebenza ngaphakathi komnyango: Phatha isicelo nokuphathekwa kwayo yonke iminzuzo yokusebenza (GEPF, GEHS, PILIR, njll.). Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kokuphela kwenkonzo yabasebenzi (okuhamba emthwalweni, ukushiya umsebenzi, njll.). Qinisekisa ukuphathekwa okuyiqiniso kwesikhathi sokuhlala kunye nesikhathi sokuphumula kwi-PERSAL, ukuhlolwa kwesikhathi sabasebenzi kanye nokuqhutywa kwezinkokhelo zesikhathi sokuphumula kanye nokunikezwa ngeluleko nesekelo mayelana nokuphathwa kwesikhathi. Phatha izingxoxo zokuphuma. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zokubuyekezwa nokukhethwa ngaphakathi komnyango: Phatha ukubuyekezwa, ukukhethwa kokuqashwa kbasebenzi nokuqashwa kwabo ukuze kuqhutshwe imithetho nemithethonqubo yokusebenza ngesikhathi senqubo yokubuyekezwa nokukhethwa (isikhangiso, izingxoxo nama-appointment). Phatha futhi ulawule izinga lokungabi nabasebenzi komnyango. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kokuqashwa, ukukhushulelwa eziteshini, njll. Qinisekisa ukufakwa okuyiqiniso kolwazi lwabasebenzi kwi-PERSAL. Ukuphathwa kwezinkampani ze-HR: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okufanele kwezinkampani zezinsiza zabantu. Qinisekisa indlela egcwele yakamuva yokulondoloza izinkampani. Yenza izinyathelo zokulawula ukugcinwa kwezinkampani. Nikeza isekelo ngesikhathi kokuqashwa. Hlanganisa ukuhumusha imibiko yezinkampani ze-HR. Nikeza ubuholi bokusebenza ekuphathweni, ukuhlanganiswa, ukulawula kanye nokuqashwa kwezinsiza zabantu kanye nemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-HRA &P unit: Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu kubandakanya ukuphathwa kwenhlalo yokuziphatha. Ukuqeqeshwa nokuqashwa, i-PMDS, ukuphathwa kwe-EHW, ukubakhona kanye nokuphathwa kwesikhathi sokuhlala, ukufakwa kabanzi kwabesifazane, outhi nabantu abakhubazekile. Ukuphathwa jikelele ngokuka: Ukulawula ibhajethi. Ukufaka idatha, ukulungiselela, ukuqashwa, ukulawula nokubika ngokuQashwa okuyisinqumo/isikhathi somnyaka sokusebenza/nokusebenza kanye ne-HR Plan yaleyo unit. Ukuphathwa kwezakhiwo zokubusa kanye nezinhlelo ezifana ne-PERSAL. Ukusetshenziswa kanye nenakekelwa kwempahla ngaphakathi kwe-unit. Bathole izinkomba zokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsizakalo. Ukunikezwa kolwazi oluyiqiniso lwezinsiza zabantu, okungukuthi, izinga lokungabi nabasebenzi, izinga lokushintsha, njll., ngenjongo yokubika, isb. HR Plan, HRPIR, i-EE Report, izethulo ze-MANCO. Zivakashele izikhathi eziyisinqumo. Nikeza ngolwazi ekuqashweni kophawu lobungozi be-sub-directorate. Ukuhlala kumikhakha ethathwa njalo ngesikhashana ngemindabo ehlobene ne-HR enomthelela ezimfenekweni zokuhlolwa. Ukuzethula kubuyekeza nokuhlala kumikhakha yangaphakathi njll.

xh.title: I Sekela Mongameli: Iindlela zoQeqesho lweBasebenzi
xh.summary: I Sekela Mongameli wee Ntlekele zoQeqesho lweBasebenzi kwi Ngingqi yoPhuhliso loQoqosho noKhenketho kwi Kimberley, elawula iinkonzo ezinzuzwayo kunye nokuphela kokusebenza kwabasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Izicelo mazibe nakwisidanga se tertiary NQF level 7 Degree kwisoQeqesho soLawulo lweBasebenzi. Isiphumo esingaphantsi kweminyaka engama-3-4 yesiphaluka esifanelekileyo kwinqanaba le Assistant Director ngaphakathi kwendawo yoLawulo lweBasebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi & Amakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda indawo yoLawulo lweBasebenzi. Ulwazi lwe PERSAL System (Inzuzo yongezelelweyo: PERSAL controller), Ulwazi ngemigaqo/iindlela zokuqhuba phambili. Ulwazi lweMigaqo yaseMthethweni yoLawulo lweBasebenzi/Izikhokelo. Amakhono oBunkokeli. Amakhono oCwangciso nokuqamba izinto. Amakhono gaxa ebunzimeni. Amakhono oPhuhliso weMigaqo. AmakhonookuPapasha. Amakhono eNkcazelo. Amakhono apha phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono oLawulo lwengxaki. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya. Amakhono eNtetho (ngomlomo/ebhaliweyo). Amakhono eKhompyutha. Amakhono ePhando. Amakhono oLawulo lweProjekthi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinkonzo ezinzuzwayo ngaphakathi kwi Isebe: Lawula isicelo nokusebenzisa zonke iinkonzo ezinzuzwayo (GEPF, GEHS, PILIR, njl.). Lawula ukuqamba ngokubakonweni kokuphela kokusebenza kwabasebenzi (iinyanga ezithintelweyo, ukushiya umsebenzi, njl.). Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwamalanga okuphumla kwi PERSAL, ukuhlolwa kwamalanga okuphumla abasebenzi nentlawulo yemivuzo yolwazi lokuphumla kunye nokunikela ngengcebiso ninkxaso malunga nalawulo lamalanga okuphumla. Lawula iintsingiselo zokuphuma. Ulawulo lweenkonzo zoQeqesho kunye noKhetho ngaphakathi kwesebe: Lawula uqeqesho, ukhetho kunye nokuqeshwa kwabasebenzi ngelixa uqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho yolusebenzi namagunya ngexesha loqeqesho noludlu loKhetho (isaziso, iintsingiselo kunye nokwesinye). Lawula ulandelelwano lwesixa samathuba abeketele abangenayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluCHANEKILEYO lokuqeshwa, ukukhuliswa njl. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokuchanekileyo kolwazi lwabasebenzi. ULawulo lwamarekhodi eHR: Qinisekisa ulondolozo olufanelekileyo lwezikhwama zabasebenzi. Qinisekisa indlela egqityiweyo yokulondoloza iifayili. Sebenzisa iindlela zolawulo lwezifayili. Nikela ngenkxaso ngexesha lokuvavanya. Qamba ukungenisa kwamabali ezikhwaba zeHR. Lawula inkokheli esebenzayo ekulawuleni, ukuqamba, ukuqwalasela nokugqiba ulwazi lwabantu nemisebenzi ngaphakathi kweyuniti ye HRA &P: Ulawulo lwabantu kuquka ulawulo lweSohlwayo. UQeqesho noPhuhliso, iPMDS, ulawulo lwe EHW, ulawulo lobukho namalanga okuphumla, ukungenisa kwabasetyhini, intsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo. Ulawulo olujikeleze ngeendlela ezilandelayo: Ukuqwalasela imeko yeNgemali. Ukuqhuba phambili, ulungiselelo, ukusebenzisa, ukuqwalasela nokubika ngocwangciso/Unyaka woPhumelelo/okuSebenzayo ne HR Plan yeyuniti. Ulawulo lwezakhono zobulungisa kunye nezindlela ezifana ne PERSAL. Ukusetyenziswa kunye nokukhathaleka kwempahla ngaphakathi kweyuniti. Misela iingqwalasela zokuthenga iimpahla neenkonzo. Nikela ngolwazi oluchanekileyo ngeempahla zabantu, oko kukuthi, isixa samathuba kwindalo egqitha ngokomthamo, njl., ngenjongo yokubika, oko kukuthi i HR Plan, i HRPIR, i EE Report, i MANCO Presentations. Zithathe inxaxheba kwiintsingiselo zoCwangciso. Nikela nengxelo kwi Risk Register yesigqeba esincinci. Ukuzithatha inxaxheba kwiiFORAMU zethumba ezimalunga nezinto ze HR ezenza isiphumo sokuvavanya. Oku papashwa kwaye kukuthatha inxaxheba kwindawo yabaphakathi njl. ngeendaba ezifana noQeqesho lwabasebenzi, isiCwangciso, i EMC, iintsingiselo zoCwangciso njl. ukwakha ulwazi nokufundisa ngokusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo nokuqhuba phambili iindlela ezinxulumene nezinto ze HR ukunciphisa iingozi ezingcolisa iziphumo ezivela kwiintsingiselo nokubakho kwengxaki.

jobs.title: Deputy Director
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive TCE package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director managing internal and external communication strategies for the Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Kimberley, requiring an NQF level 7 degree and communications experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a tertiary NQF level 7 Degree in Communication/ Journalism. A minimum of 3-4 years’ experience at Assistant Director level within a communications environment. A valid driver's license. Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of government communication frameworks. Understanding of the Public Service Act and Public Service Regulations. Familiarity with the Government Communication and Information System (GCIS) prescribed standards. Expertise in integrated communication planning and stakeholder engagement models Grasp of risk- and crisis-communication protocols in a public-sector context. Communication Skills. Interpersonal skills. Team leadership. Computer literacy. Graphic Design. Professional writing and editing skills. Strategic and Planning skills. Basic Project Management.
jobs.duties: Manage the development and implementation of the communication strategy in terms of both internal and external departmental communication: Develop and maintain an internal and external communication policies and strategies aligned with Departmental goals. Manage the development (including layout, design) and distribution of a regular employee newsletter featuring project updates, success stories, and upcoming events. Manage and update the departmental intranet or collaboration platform with news, policy changes, and resource libraries. Quality-assure leadership messages, memos, and all-staff emails before publishing. Provide communication toolkits and templates for officials to ensure consistent application/ adherence to Corporate Image standards of the department. Produce and distribute press materials, including press releases, media advisories, and executive statements to announce news, product launches, and corporate milestones. Manage corporate content which promotes the departmental public image on social-media channels; schedule regular posts, monitor engagement, and update messaging for consistency and timeliness. Maintain relationships with journalists, analysts, influencers, and industry partners; maintain segmented media and influencer databases for targeted outreach. Provide input to and implement proactive and reactive crisis-communication strategies and protocols; assisting in drafting of holding statements, manage rapid response workflows, and liaise with legal and leadership to protect reputation. Provide content management and media liaising support services: Develop and maintain an integrated content calendar covering digital, social, print, and multimedia channels. Edit and publish articles, blog posts, videos, infographics, and podcasts, ensuring alignment with brand voice and objectives. Review and distribute press releases, media advisories, talking points, and backgrounders to announce news, events, and milestones. Coordinate interviews, press conferences, and media visits; brief spokespeople and provide necessary materials. Respond promptly to media inquiries, fact-check requests, and interview arrangements; serve as the central liaison between journalists and internal subject-matter experts. Maintain diplomatic content and media interactions, comply with legal, regulatory, and brand guidelines and secure necessary approvals before publication. Implement a rapid-response protocol for crisis situations, ensuring timely content updates and press handling to protect reputation. Provide public liaison and events management services: Develop and maintain a public liaison and events strategy aligned with organisational objectives and community needs. Coordinate distribution of public outreach materials, including newsletters, brochures, social-media posts, and community notices. Liaise with government officials, local authorities, and community leaders to secure permits, endorsements, and participation. Facilitating activities relating to media accreditation, press zones, and interview schedules; prepare spokespeople with talking points and Q&A briefs. Provide post-event follow-up services: distribute thank-you notes, collect feedback via surveys, analyse satisfaction metrics and produce impact/feedback reports. Maintain and refine an events toolkit: templates, checklists, vendor lists, risk-assessment forms, and promotional collateral. Provide operational leadership in the management, coordination, monitoring and evaluation of human resources and activities within the Communications unit: Management of human resources including Discipline management, Training and Development, PMDS, EHW management, Attendance and leave management, Mainstreaming of females, youth and persons with disabilities. General management in terms of: Budget monitoring, Input, preparation, implementation, monitoring and reporting on Strategic/ Annual Performance/ Operational and HR Plan of the unit. Utilisation and care of assets within the unit. Recordkeeping and reporting.
jobs.applications: Applications quoting the relevant reference should be forwarded as follows: The Head of the Department, Post To: Department of Economic Development and Tourism P/Bag X6108, Kimberley, 8300 or Hand Deliver to: MetLife Towers, (Post Office Building), T Floor (Registry Office), Post Office Building, Kimberley or Email applications to: HRA@ncdedat.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms. M. Musa
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications for employment to the address specified above. The application must include a duly completed and signed new Form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at https://www.dpsa.gov.za/, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae CV; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please note a separate application is required for each position applied for. Applications received using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each application for employment form must be fully completed, initialled and signed by the applicant. Failure to fully complete, initial and sign this form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applicants are not required to submit/attach copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new (Z83) form and detailed curriculum vitae only. The provision of certified documents will only be required from shortlisted candidates for submission on or before the day of the interview following a formal communication from Human Resources unit. In instances where applicants are in possession of a foreign qualification, it is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and only submit proof of such evaluation upon being shortlisted for a post. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders will be required to submit a copy of their Permanent Residence Permits only if shortlisted. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned instruction/ requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the above post/s. Applications, including those submitted via registered mail must reach the department before 16:00 on the day of the closing date. Incomplete applications, or applications received after the closing date will be disqualified. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Please note that suitable candidates will be subjected to a technical assessment as well as satisfactory personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial-asset record check, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification. Successful candidates will also be subjected to a security clearance process. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will be required to sign the performance agreement within three months from the date of assumption of duty. It will also be required that the successful candidate declare to the EA particulars of all registrable financial interests. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. The successful candidate will be appointed subject to positive results of the security clearance process and the verification of educational qualification certificates. Appointment of these positions will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. The Department is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The Employment Equity Plan of the Department shall inform the employment decision. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s). OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderdirekteur
af.summary: Onderdirekteur wat interne en eksterne kommunikasiestrategieë vir die Department of Economic Development and Tourism in Kimberley bestuur, met 'n vereiste van 'n NQF-vlak 7-graad en kommunikasie-ervaring.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n tersiêre NQF-vlak 7-graad in Kommunikasie/Joernalistiek hê. 'n Minimum van 3-4 jaar se ervaring op Assistente-direkteur-vlak binne 'n kommunikasie-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van regeringskommunikasieraamwerke. Begrip van die Public Service Act en Public Service Regulations. Bekendheid met die voorgeskrewe standaarde van die Government Communication and Information System (GCIS). Kundigheid in geïntegreerde kommunikasiebeplanning en belangehebbende-betrokkenheidsmodelle. Begrip van risiko- en krisiskommunikasieprotokolle in 'n openbare-sektor-konteks. Kommunikasievaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Spanleierskap. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Grafiese ontwerp. Professionele skryf- en redigeervaardighede. Strategiese en beplanningsvaardighede. Basiese projekbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van die kommunikasiestrategie in terme van beide interne en eksterne departementele kommunikasie: Ontwikkel en handhaaf interne en eksterne kommunikasiebeleid en -strategieë wat met departementele doelwitte ooreenstem. Bestuur die ontwikkeling (insluitend uitleg en ontwerp) en verspreiding van 'n gereelde werknemersnuusbrief met projekopdaterings, suksesverhale en komende gebeurtenisse. Bestuur en dateer die departementele intranet of samewerkingsplatform op met nuus, beleidswysigings en hulpbronn biblioteke. Verseker gehalte van leierskapsboodskappe, memo's en e-pos aan alle personeel voor publikasie. Verskaf kommunikasie-nutspakkette en -sjablone vir amptenare om konsekwente toepassing en nakoming van korporatiewe beeldstandaarde van die departement te verseker. Produseer en versprei persmateriaal, insluitend persvrystellings, mediaadvise en uitvoerende verklarings om nuus, produklopvelanse en korporatiewe mylpale aan te kondig. Bestuur korporatiewe inhoud wat die departementele openbare beeld op sosiale-media-kanale bevorder; skedule gereelde plasings, monitor betrokkenheid en dateer boodskappe op vir konsekwentheid en tydigheid. Handhaaf verhoudings met joernaliste, ontleders, invloedmakers en bedryfspartners; handhaaf gesegmenteerde media- en invloedmakerdatabasisse vir gerigte uitreik. Verskaf insette tot en implementeer proaktiewe en reaktiewe krisiskommunikasiestrategieë en -protokolle; help met die opstel van tydelike verklarings, bestuur vinnige-reaksie-werkvloei en skakel met regspan en leierskap om reputasie te beskerm. Verskaf inhoudbestuur- en medialiaisonondersteuningsdienste: Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n geïntegreerde inhoudskalender wat digitale, sosiale, gedrukte en multimediar-kanale dek. Redigeer en publiseer artikels, blogplasings, video's, infografieke en podsends, en verseker ooreenstemming met handelsmerkstem en doelwitte. Hersien en versprei persvrystellings, mediaadvise, praatpunte en agtergrondinligting om nuus, gebeurtenisse en mylpale aan te kondig. Koördineer onderhoude, perskonferensies en mediabesoek; lig woordvoerders voor en verskaf nodige materiaal. Reageer vinnig op media-navrae, feitstoets versoeke en onderhoudreëlings; dien as die sentrale skakel tussen joernaliste en interne vakspesialiste. Handhaaf diplomatieke inhoud en mediawisselwerking, voldoen aan regs-, regulerings- en handelsmerkriglyne en verkry nodige goedkeuring voor publikasie. Implementeer 'n vinnige-reaksie-protokol vir krississituasies, wat tydige inhoudopdaterings en pershantering verseker om reputasie te beskerm. Verskaf openbare-liaison- en gebeurtenisbestuurdienste: Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n openbare-liaison- en gebeurtenisstrategie wat met organisatoriese doelwitte en gemeenskapsbehoeftes ooreenstem. Koördineer verspreiding van openbare uitreikmateriaal, insluitend nuusbriewe, brosjures, sosiale-media-plasings en gemeenskapskennisgewings. Skakel met regeringsamptenare, plaaslike owerhede en gemeenskapsleiers om permits, goedkeurings en deelname te verseker. Fasiliteer aktiwiteite rakende media-akkreditasie, perssones en onderhoudskedules; berei woordvoerders voor met praatpunte en V&A-kortliggings. Verskaf na-gebeurtenis-opvolgdiens: versprei dankie-briewe, versamel terugvoer via opnames, analiseer tevredenheidsmetrieke en produseer impak-/terugvoerverslae. Handhaaf en verfyn 'n gebeurtenisnutspakket: sjablone, kontrolelyste, verskafferlyste, risiko-assesseringsvorms en promosiemateriaal. Verskaf operasionele leierskap in die bestuur, koördinering, monitering en evaluering van menslike hulpbronne en aktiwiteite binne die Kommunikasie-eenheid: Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne insluitend dissiplinebestuur, Opleiding en Ontwikkeling, PMDS, EHW-bestuur, Bywoning en verlofbestuur, Hoofstrooming van vroue, jeug en persone met gestremdhede. Algemene bestuur in terme van: Begrotingsmonitering, insette, voorbereiding, implementering, monitering en verslaggewing oor Strategiese/Jaarlikse Prestasie-/Operasionele en HR-plan van die eenheid. Benutting en sorg van bates binne die eenheid. Rekordhouding en verslaggewing.

zu.title: Ononinimqondisi
zu.summary: Ononinimqondisi obhaliswe ekuphatheni izindlela zokuxhumana ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwi-Department of Economic Development and Tourism e-Kimberley, okudinga iziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 nokuhlangenwe nakho kokuxhumana.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nemvulelo yesiqu se tertiary NQF level 7 Degree in Communication/ Journalism. Okungenani okuhlangenwe nakho eminyakeni engu-3-4 esezingeni lika-Assistant Director endaweni yokuxhumana. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi nethalente: Ulwazi ngezindlela zikahulumeni zokuxhumana. Ukuqonda i-Public Service Act kanye ne-Public Service Regulations. Ukuqonda izindinganiso ezibekwe yi-Government Communication and Information System (GCIS). Amakhono okuhlela ukuxhumana okuhlangene namamodeli wokubandakanya iziphoqangi. Ukuqonda izinhlelo zokuphatha ingozi nokuvela kwezinkinga ngokushesha ezweni lomphakathi. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukukhokha iqembu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlela imiklamo. Amakhono okubhala ngobungcweti nokuhlela. Amakhono okuhlela okusuka kude nokuqhakambisa. Ukuphathwa kwamaprojekthi okuyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwendlela yokuxhumana mayelana nokuxhumana komnyango ngaphakathi nangaphandle: Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze izindlela zokuxhumana ngaphakathi nangaphandle ezihambisana namagolo omnyango. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa (okuhlanganisa isakhiwo, umklamo) nokusatshazelwa kwesitshexumva sabasebenzi esijwayelekile esiveza izibuko zamaphrojekthi, izindaba zempumelelo, kanye nemicimbe ezayo. Phatha futhi uvuselele i-intranet yomnyango noma inkundla yokusebenza ndawonye ngezindaba, inguquko zezindlela, namalabhulali wemithombo. Qinisekisa izinga lemithombo yemiyalezo yabaholi, okubhaliwe, kanye nameyili awo wonke abasebenzi ngaphambi kokushicilelwa. Nikeza abasebenzi nathuluzi nokulungiwe kokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa okuvumelana nezindinganiso zesithombe somnyango. Hlela futhi usatshazele imithombo yabezindaba, okuhlanganisa izitatimende zabezindaba, izeluleko zabezindaba, kanye nezitatimende zabaphathi ukumemezela izindaba, ukusukunyiswa kwemikhiqizo, kanye namagagasi omnyango. Phatha okuqukethwe komnyango okuthuthisa isithombe somnyango somphakathi kumakhaladi ezokuxhumana kube ngezenhlalo; hlela okuthunyelwe njalo, qapha ukuthonywa, futhi uvuselele imiyalezo ukuze kuhambisane nokuvumelana nangesikhathi. Gcina ubuhlobo nababhali bezindaba, abahlaziyi, abanethonya, kanye nabalingani bembona; gcina amadethibhesi abezindaba nabanethonya abahlukaniswe ukuze kufinyelelwe kwelungelo elibekiwe. Nikeza okokufaka kanye nokusebenzisa izindlela zokuxhumana ezibhekene nengozi ngaphambi kwayo nangemva kwayo; usize ekubhalweni kwezitatimende ezibamba isikhundla, phatha ukuphathwa kwenhlelo yokuphendula ngokushesha, futhi uxhume nomthetho nabaholi ukuvikela udumo. Nikeza okuqukathwe ukuphathwa kanye nensekelo yokuxhumana nezindaba: Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze ikhalenda yokukhetha okuqukethwe okuhlangene okubheka amakhaladi we-digital, social, print, kanye ne-multimedia. Hlela futhi ushicilele izihloko, okuthunyelwe kumabhulogi, amavidiyo, izixhumi zolwazi, kanye namapodikhesi, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nelifa lomsuka namagolo. Buka futhi usatshazele izitatimende zabezindaba, izeluleko zabezindaba, izinto ezibalulekile zokukhuluma, kanye nemininingwane yangemuva ukumemezela izindaba, imicimbe, kanye namagagasi. Hlela abaxhumi, izinkulumo nezindaba zabezindaba, kanye nokuvakashelaabezindaba; umemeze abakhulumi baphethe izinto ezibalulekile futhi ubanikeze okudingekayo. Phendula ngokushesha imibuzo yabezindaba, uhlole iqiniso lokuceliwe, kanye nezinhlelo zoxhumo; yiba ngumxhumanisi ophakathi kwezindaba nabazalwane abanolwazi ngaphakathi. Gcina okuqukethwe okuhloniphekile kanye nokuxhumanaabezindaba, hambisana nemithetho, izimiso zomthetho, nezindlela zomsuka futhi uthole imvume ebalulekile ngaphambi kokushicilelwa. Sebenzisa isinqumo sokuphendula ngokushesha ezimeni zengozi, ukuqinisekisa uvuselelo olwanele lwesikhathi okuqukethwe nokuphathwaabezindaba ukusiza ngokuvikela udumo. Nikeza insekelo yokuxhumana nomphakathi nakokuphathwa kwemicimbe: Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze indlela yokuxhumana nomphakathi nokuphathwa kwemicimbe ehambisana namagolo embona kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. Hlela ukusatshazelwa kwezinto zokuqonda komphakathi, okuhlanganisa okuthunyelwe kwesitshexumva, amabhulokhi, okuthunyelwe kumakhaladi ezokuxhumana kube ngezenhlalo, kanye nezazomphakathi. Xhuma nabasebenza kahulumeni, iziphathimandla zendawo, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi ukuthola imvume, ukusekela, kanye nokuNqanyiswa. Ukwenza okuhlobene namakhaladi ezindaba, izindawo zabezindaba, kanye nohlelo lokuxhumana; lukhulumi bambele ngezinto ezibalulekile nokuthi bazophendula kanjani. Nikeza insekelo ngemuva kwesikhathi somcimbe: satshazela amabonge, qwala imibono ngokuxhuma imibuzo, hlela izigaba zethemba kanti futhi ukhiqize imibiko yesiphephelo esisebenzayo. Gcina futhi uthuthukise ithuluzi lamakhaladi: izixhumi, ukulunga, izinkomba zomsebenzisi, amafomu esengozi, kanye nokulunga okukhuthazayo. Nikeza inkulezo ephathwayo ekuphathweni, ukuhlela, ukuphenya nokubuyekeza wabantu nemicimbe phakathi kwesebe lokuxhumana: Ukuphathwa kwabantu okuhlanganisa ukuphatha inkinga yokungalaleli, ukuzifundisa nokuthuthuka, PMDS, ukuphathwa kwe-EHW, ukubukwa kwabakhonza nokuvela, ukufaka abesimame, intsasa nabantu abakhubazekile ekuphathweni. Ukuphathwa okujwayelekile mayelana: ukulawula imali, ukufaka, okulungile, ukusetshenziswa, ukulawula kanye nokubika ukuhlela okuqondene namaphuzu okusebenza ngonyaka/okuphathwayo kanye neNkqubo ye-HR yesebe. Ukusetshenziswa nokuqedwa kwempahla esebeni. Ukugcina kanye nokwenza imibiko.

xh.title: Isekela-Nkulumbuso
xh.summary: Isekela-Nkulumbuso oluphethe iindlela zokunyathelisana ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwiSebe leNtshukumo yezoQoqosho noKhenketho eKimberley, elifuna izidanga ezikwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 namava kwinkqubo yokunyathelisana.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nedigri yeqela lesithathu elikwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 kwiNkqubo yokuNxulumanisa/ uTshilo ndaba. Iqondo elingaphantsi kweminyaka engama-3-4 yamava kwinqanaba lkaMncedisi woLawulo kwimeko yokunxulumanisa. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngeendlela zolawulo zokunxulumanisa karhulumente. Ukuqonda umGaqo-nkqubo woSebe lkaRhulumente noMthetho woRhelxo woSebe lkaRhulumente. Ukuqonda amagqabantshshi eGovernment Communication and Information System (GCIS). Inqaku ekubekeni iindlela zokunxulumanisa ezidityanisiyo neendlela zokuqhuba abanye abantu ngenxulumano. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokunxulumanisa ngexesha lengozi nakwingxaki kwindawo karhulumente. Amakhono okuNxulumanisa. Amakhono obuntu phakathi kwabantu. Ukukhokela iqela. Ulwazi olusemthethweni lwekhompyutha. uLwluvo lokuKhusela iNgcaciso yemFuziselo. Amakhono okuBhala ngokusemthethweni nokuhlela. Amakhono esiCwangciso nokuCwangcisa. uLawulo lweziNxuMamiso eziLula.
xh.duties: Qondisa uphuhliso nokuzeqiswa kwindlela yokunxulumanisa ngokwokunxulumanisa kwesebe ngaphakathi nangaphandle: Phuhcisa ulondoloze iinkqubo neendlela zokunxulumanisa ngaphakathi nangaphandle ezingqamaniselwe nemigqibelo yesebe. Lawula uphuhliso (kuquka ulwvo lwendlela yombhalo, nomfanekiso) nokusatyalaliswa kwe-employee newsletter ephindaphindiweyo evakalisa iindaba zemigwebo, iindaba zemigwebo ngenxa yokuphumelela, namava kumanqwanqwa. Lawula uhlaziye isixhobo sangaphakathi kwiSebe okusetyenziswa kuso ngokubambisana nesinxibo ngeendaba, utshintsho kwinkqubo, neziqu zemiyalezo. Qinisekisa umgangatho wemiyalezo yabalawuli, namemo, namagama abasebenzi bonke ngaphambi kokushicilelwa. Zeza iinkqubo zokunxulumanisa neendlela ezisetyenziswa ngamaphethli ukuze kuqinisekiswe isixhobo esifanayo/ ukulandela imigqibelo yeNgcaciso yomFanekiso wesebe. Tya satyalalisa iinkcukacha zendaba, kuquka iindaba ezipapashwayo, iingcebiso zendaba, namagama abaphathi ukuvakalisa iindaba, ukuqaliswa kweemveliso, namava eSebe. Lawula iinkcukacha ezikhuthaza isixhobo somfanekiso wesebe kumajelo onxibelelaniso nawo ngeenethiwekhi; cwangcisa iindaba eziphindaphindiweyo, qondanisa ukuthathwa kwexesha, uze uhluaze imiyalezo ukuze kubekho isixhobo esifanayo nokuqeshiswa kwexesha. Gcina iindibaniselano nabatshili bendaba, nabahlalutyi, nabanxibelelanisi namabonwa abakwindalo, namadoda anegalelo kuluntu; gcina iidatabase zendaba abazinika iindaba nabagxalathi abanegalelo kuluntu ezahluleni ezahlukeneyo ukuze kubekho ukufikelela okujoliswe kakhulu. Zeza ingeniselo nakuzeqa iindlela zokunxulumanisa ezibumbene nobunyani bokungqina ubukho beGcisa kuqondiswe ngokuchasene neengxaki nangeendaba ezingalindelekanga ezijoliswe kwizinto ezibangelwa yingozi; size nceda ekubhaleni izitatimende ezisuka kumyalezo wokuqala, lawula iindlela zokuphendula ngokukhawuleza, uze unxibelelane nabamthetho nabaphathi ukuze kuvikelwe isidima. Zeza inkonzo yokuNxulumanisa nokuLawula iNkqubo yokunxulumanisa: Phuhcisa ulondoloze ikhalenda ezeqwe ngokubumbene eya kumanxweme e-internet, eendaba, ezoshicilelwayo, nakumanxweme amaninzi. Hlela ushicilele iindaba, amagama athunyelwayo, iindwomane, iindaba ezingengomanqwanqwa, namaxhobo okusasazwa ngokwesandi, kuqinisekiswe ukuba ngqamaniselwe nesidima somfanekiso nemigqibelo. Qonda ngqina uthumela iindaba ezipapashwayo, iingcebiso zendaba, iinkcukacha zabaphetha bubini, nemiyalezo engasemva ukuvakalisa iindaba, amanqwanqwa, namagqabantshshi. Lungiselela iinterviw, iinkqubo zendaba, nendwendwe lwabatshili bendaba; yaza abathetha ngokwakwesbe baze ubanike iinkcukacha eziyimfuneko. Phendula ngokukhawuleza kumabuzo eendaba, qinisekisa amaqinisekiwo, nakuqwalasela iinterviw; ze ube ngummeli ophakathi kwabatshili bendaba nabangaphakathi abanolwazi ngemiba. Gcina amaxhobo eendaba okusasazwa kunxibelelwano nabantu, landela iinkqubo zamathetho, namagqabantshshi, ukuze uvumeleke ngaphambi kokushicilelwa. Zeza iinkqubo zokuphendula ngokukhawuleza ngamava okungqina kwizingxaki, ukuqinisekisa ukulungiswa kwexesha nakuzeqiswa kweendaba kwindawo ephathwa ngabatshili bendaba ukuze kuvikelwe isidima. Zeza inkonzo yokunxulumanisa nomphakathi nokuLawula iNdwendwe: Phuhcisa ulondoloze iindlela zokunxulumanisa nomphakathi nokuLawula iNdwendwe ezimisela ngokumgqibelo weqela nemfuneko yoluntu. Lawula ukusatyalaliswa kwamaxhobo okufikelela oluntwini, kuquka iindaba eziphindaphindiweyo, iindaba ezimfutshane, iindaba kumanxweme eendaba, iindaba ezijoliswe kuluntu. Nceda nxibelelane namaphethli karhulumente, namagunya obuzwe, namadoda anegalelo kuluntu ukuze kufunyaniswe iimvume, iingcebiso, noluntu oluthath'inxaxheba. Yenza imisebenzi enxulumene nokuqinisekiswa kwabatshili bendaba, iindawo zokubamba iindaba, noxwebhu lweenterviw; lungiselela abathetha ngokwakwesbe ngeenkcukacha namaxwebhu umbuzo-nempendulo. Zeza inkonzo ekulandeleni iNdwendwe emva kwamanqwanqwa: satyalalisa iindaba ezibulela umdla, qokelela iingcinga ngokusebenzisa iingxelo zophando, hlela iingxelo ezinika isigqibo ngokwamava abantu ubizeqo lwamanqwanqwa eNdwendwe. Gcina ulungiselele iinkqubo ezisezantsi zeNdwendwe: iinkqubo, iindaba ezibekiweyo, iindwomane zabathengisi, iinkqubo ezinike isigqibo ngobungozi, namaxhobo azeqwayo. Zeza inkqubo ekuLawuleni, ukuNgqamanisa, ukuQwalasela nokunika isigqibo ngamandla abantu nemisebenzi engaphakathi kwindawo yeNkqubo yokuNxulumanisa: uLawulo lwamandla abantu kuquka uLawulo loBugxoki, uQeqesho nokuKhula, i-PMDS, uLawulo lwe-EHW, uLawulo loBukho nokurhoxa, ukuFakwa kwamakhosikazi, abasha, nabantu abakhubazekileyo. uLawulo olubanzi ngokwemigqibelo: uQwalaselo loQoqosho, iNgeniso, ulungiselelo, ukuQeqwa, ukuQwalasela nokunikela iNgxelo kwiNkqubo eNkulu/ uQoqosho lweMfuziselo kaNyaka/ uLawulo nakuQoqosho lweMandla aBantu. uLawulo nokunyamezela iimpahla ngaphakathi kwindawo. uGcino lwezixa nokuNika iNgxelo.

jobs.title: Labour Relations Officer
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.summary: A Labour Relations Officer is needed at the Kimberley Office to provide advisory services on labour relations matters, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a tertiary NQF level 6 qualification in Labour Law/ Labour Relations/HRM or related fields. 1-2 years relevant experience within a Labour Relations field. A valid driver licence will be an added advantage. Skills & Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of Labour Relations Legislation, Processes of Labour Relations matters, Knowledge of the Public Service Act & regulations, Processes of the CCMA, PSCBC and GPSSBC. Good communication skills, computer literacy, facilitation skills, conflict resolution skills, analytical skills, presentation skills, negotiation skills, organising skills and interpersonal relationship skills.
jobs.duties: Rendering of Labour Relations Advisory Services: Provide advice and guidance on labour relations issues to management and employees, ensuring alignment with legislative frameworks. Conducting relevant research to keep abreast with changes in legislation. Ensure adherence to labour laws, regulations, collective agreements, and internal HR policies, supporting the Department's compliance goals. Act as an advisor to management on proactive strategies to minimise workplace conflicts, ensuring a fair and consistent approach to employee relations. Attend, participate and present at internal and external forums/sessions. Conducting relevant research and interpreting results in order to advise accordingly. Provision of dispute resolution & case management services: Investigate employee grievances, misconduct, and disputes. Represent the department in disciplinary hearings, grievance procedures, and mediation processes. Proactively manage case files and track outcomes. Liaise with unions and other stakeholders on dispute resolution and collective bargaining matters. Compilation of charge sheets. Accompanying and/ or serving documents to stakeholders. To capture, report, track and safeguard information pertaining to Labour/Employee Relations: Establish, maintain and update/ capture information on relevant systems databases. Collection of and coordination/ consolidation of information collected for compliance reporting. Compilation of draft compliance reports and escalating for quality assurance. Record keeping of compliance reports/ dispute resolution bundles and outcomes and consequence management related documents. Compile and distribute agendas relating to Labour relations sessions to members of relevant meetings/ committees/ sessions etc. Compilation of draft minutes of Labour Relations sessions held in line with discussions and decisions. Coordinating meetings and information sharing sessions with internal and external stakeholders ensuring logistical arrangements are in place. Preparing bundles/ case files. Input into policy development/ reviewal. Provide capacity building services within the department: Coordinating meetings and information sharing sessions with internal and external stakeholders which included presenting/ sharing information in terms of Labour Relations processes and procedures. Liaising with HR to ensure training programs align with organisational needs and strategic HR goals.
jobs.applications: Applications quoting the relevant reference should be forwarded as follows: The Head of the Department, Post To: Department of Economic Development and Tourism P/Bag X6108, Kimberley, 8300 or Hand Deliver to: MetLife Towers, (Post Office Building), T Floor (Registry Office), Post Office Building, Kimberley or Email applications to: HRA@ncdedat.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms. M. Musa
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications for employment to the address specified above. The application must include a duly completed and signed new Form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at https://www.dpsa.gov.za/, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae CV; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please note a separate application is required for each position applied for. Applications received using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each application for employment form must be fully completed, initialled and signed by the applicant. Failure to fully complete, initial and sign this form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applicants are not required to submit/attach copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the new (Z83) form and detailed curriculum vitae only. The provision of certified documents will only be required from shortlisted candidates for submission on or before the day of the interview following a formal communication from Human Resources unit. In instances where applicants are in possession of a foreign qualification, it is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and only submit proof of such evaluation upon being shortlisted for a post. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders will be required to submit a copy of their Permanent Residence Permits only if shortlisted. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned instruction/ requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the above post/s. Applications, including those submitted via registered mail must reach the department before 16:00 on the day of the closing date. Incomplete applications, or applications received after the closing date will be disqualified. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Please note that suitable candidates will be subjected to a technical assessment as well as satisfactory personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial-asset record check, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification. Successful candidates will also be subjected to a security clearance process. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will be required to sign the performance agreement within three months from the date of assumption of duty. It will also be required that the successful candidate declare to the EA particulars of all registrable financial interests. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. The successful candidate will be appointed subject to positive results of the security clearance process and the verification of educational qualification certificates. Appointment of these positions will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. The Department is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The Employment Equity Plan of the Department shall inform the employment decision. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s). OTHER POSTS

af.title: Arbeidsverhoudingsbeampte
af.summary: 'n Arbeidsverhoudingsbeampte word by die Kimberley-kantoor benodig om voorligtingsdienste oor arbeidsverhoudingsake te verskaf en sodoende nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing te verseker.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n tersiêre NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Arbeidsreg/Arbeidsverhoudinge/HRM of verwante velde hê. 1-2 jaar relevante ervaring binne 'n Arbeidsverhoudingsveld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Vaardighede en Kennis: Diepgaande kennis van Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing, prosesse van arbeidsverhoudingsake, kennis van die Public Service Act en regulasies, prosesse van die CCMA, PSCBC en GPSSBC. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, rekenaargeletterdheid, fasiliteringsvaardighede, konflikoplossingsvaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardighede, organisatoriese vaardighede en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaffing van Arbeidsverhoudingsvoorligtingsdienste: Verskaf advies en leiding oor arbeidsverhoudingsake aan bestuur en werknemers, en verseker belyning met wetgewende raamwerke. Voer tersaaklike navorsing uit om tred te hou met veranderinge in wetgewing. Verseker nakoming van arbeidswette, regulasies, kollektiewe ooreenkomste en interne HR-beleide, en ondersteun die departement se nakomingsdoelwitte. Tree as adviseur tot bestuur op oor proaktiewe strategieë om werkplekkonflikte te minimeer, en verseker 'n billike en konsekwente benadering tot werknemerverhoudings. Woon by, neem deel en bied voor by interne en eksterne forums/sessies. Voer tersaaklike navorsing uit en interpreteer resultate om dienooreenkomstig advies te gee. Verskaffing van geskiloplossings- en sakebestuursdienste: Ondersoek werknemergriewe, wangedrag en geskille. Verteenwoordig die departement in tugverhore, grievesprosedures en bemiddelingsprosesse. Bestuur saaklêers proaktief en hou uitkomste dop. Skakel met vakbonde en ander belanghebbendes oor geskiloplossing en kollektiewe onderhandelingsake. Opstel van klagstate. Begelei en/of dien dokumente aan belanghebbendes. Om inligting rakende Arbeids-/Werknemerverhoudings vas te lê, te rapporteer, op te spoor en te beskerm: Vestig, handhaaf en werk inligting op relevante stelseldatabasisse by/vas. Versameling en koördinering/konsolidasie van versamelde inligting vir nakomingsverslagdoening. Opstel van konseptnavingsverslae en verwysing vir gehalteversekering. Rekordhou van nakomingsverslae/geskiloplossingsbundels en uitkomste en gevolgbestuurverwante dokumente. Stel agendae op en versprei dit rakende Arbeidsverhoudingsessies aan lede van tersaaklike vergaderings/komitees/sessies ens. Opstel van konsepnotule van Arbeidsverhoudingsessies wat gehou is in ooreenstemming met besprekings en besluite. Koördineer vergaderings en inligtingdelingsessies met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes en verseker dat logistieke reëlings in plek is. Voorbereiding van bundels/saaklêers. Bydrae tot beleidontwikkeling/hersiening. Verskaf kapasiteitsboudienste binne die departement: Koördineer vergaderings en inligtingdelingsessies met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes wat voorstelliging/deling van inligting ten opsigte van Arbeidsverhoudingsprosesse en -prosedures insluit. Skakel met HR om te verseker dat opleidingsprogramme met organisatoriese behoeftes en strategiese HR-doelwitte belyn.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezindaba Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wezindaba zabasebenzi eKimberley Office ukuba ahlinze ngemiyalo ephathelene nezindaba zabasebenzi, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho ohlukene.
zu.requirements: Abafake izicelo kufanele babe nesifundo esiphakeme esingeni le-NQF level 6 ku-Labour Law/ Labour Relations/HRM noma emikhakheni ephathelene naleyo. 1-2 iminyaka yeminyaka yemisebenzi ehambisana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ilayisense yokuqoba kuzobe yinto engeze inani. Amakhono & Ulwazi: Ulwazi olujulile ngomthetho wezindaba zabasebenzi, inqubo yezindaba zabasebenzi, ulwazi ngomthetho wezeNkonzo kaHulumeni & imitheshwana, inqubo ye-CCMA, PSCBC ne-GPSSBC. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, amakhono okuhola ingqungquthela, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okubonisa, amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okuhlela kanye namakhono okwakha izimbangi ezihle.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemiyalo ephathelene nezindaba zabasebenzi: Nikela ngemiyalo nokuqondisa ngezindaba zabasebenzi kubaphathi nasebasebenzini, uqinisekisa ukuvumelana nezinhlelo zomthetho. Funda ngokubalulekile ukuze ugaphe uthutha ezimeni zomthetho. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhonjiswa emthethweni wabasebenzi, imitheshwana, izivumelwano ezihlangene, kanye namapholisi angaphakathi e-HR, usekela imigomo yokuhambisana komnyango. Yiba ngumeluleki kubaphathi ngezinqubomgomo ezingaphambili ukuze kuncishwe izinkinga esikhundleni somsebenzi, futhi uqinisekise indlela elungile futhi efanayo ezindabeni zabasebenzi. Hlala ubambe iqhaza futhi ubonise emikhosini/amaseshini angaphakathi nangaphandle. Funda ngokubalulekile futhi uchaze iziphakamiso ukuze ube nomyalo ochanekile. Nikela ngesevisi yoxazululo lwezinkinga & yokuqhuba izicelo: Phenya izikhalazo zabasebenzi, ukuziphatha kabi, kanye nezinkinga. Mela umnyango ezinkululekweni zeziyalezo, inqubomgomo yezikhalazo, kanye nemicimbi yokuxazulula ngomuthwano. Qaphaza izicelo futhi ulandele iziphetho. Xhumana namashembulu nabanomzinkathazo abanye ekuxazululeni izinkinga nasemicimbini yezivumelwano ezihlangene. Hlela amashidi ezikhombisa. Landa futhi/ noma uhlinze ngezixhumanisi kubanomzinkathazo. Ukuthwebula, umbiko, ukulandela nokuvikela ulwazi oluphathelene nezindaba/izindaba zabasebenzi: Sunga, gcina futhi uvuse/ uthwebule ulwazi kumasistimu okulondoloza imininingwane. Qoqa futhi uhlele/ udibanise ulwazi oluqoqiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana emibikweni. Hlela imibiko yokuhambisana futhi uyehlule ukuze ivivinywe. Gcina imibiko yokuhambisana/ iziqu zoxazululo lwezinkinga kanye neziphetho futhi ulawule ukubhalwa kwemibhalo ephathelene nezindleko. Hlela futhi wabelane ngendlela yemihlangano ephathelene nezindaba zabasebenzi kubalulekile kwabangamalungu/ amakomidi/ amaseshini. Hlela imininingwane yemaseshini ezindabeni zabasebenzi ngokuhambisana nenkulumo kanye nezinqumo. Hlela imihlangano futhi wabelane ngolwazi kubanomzinkathazo abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlelelwe zonke izidingo. Lungiselela iziqu/ izicelo. Faka izimpendulo ekuthuthukiseni/ ukubuyekeni amapholisi. Nikela ngesevisi yokwakha amandla umnyango: Hlela imihlangano futhi wabelane ngolwazi kubanomzinkathazo abangaphakathi nangaphange okuhlanganisa ukubonisa/ ukwabelana ngolwazi mayelana nezinqubo kanye namanyathwe ezindaba zabasebenzi. Xhumana ne-HR ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zihambisana nezidingo zenhlangano kanye namagugu e-HR ebuholi.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Ekonomiese Beplanning
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur vir Ekonomiese Beplanning in Mahikeng, wat 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Ekonomie en uitgebreide ervaring in ekonomiese ontwikkeling vereis, op salarisvlak 14.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7) op die gebied van Bedryfsekonomie / Ekonomiese Beplanning of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Nagraadse kwalifikasie(s) in die studieveld Ekonomie sal 'n voordeel wees. Uitgebreide ervaring op die gebied van ekonomiese ontwikkeling, uitvoer- en beleggingsbevordering. Kennis en begrip van die ekonomiese ontwikkelingssektor, asook nywerheidsontwikkeling. Ervaring in die uitvoer van navorsing oor ekonomiese ontwikkeling. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op seniorbestuursvlak of gelykstaande aan SMS-vlak uit ander sektore. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Program- en projekbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Dienslewering en innovasie. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Klïentgerigtheid en kliëntefokus. Kommunikasie. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Voer funksies as Hoofekonoom uit. Ontwikkel en implementeer ingrypings en strategieë om ekonomiese groei en ontwikkeling deur nywerheidsontwikkeling, handel en beleggingsbevordering te stimuleer. Fasiliteer en koördineer die ontwikkeling van die hoof provinsiale ekonomiese sektore (agroverwerking, vervaardiging, mynbou-batenutting, toerisme en groen ekonomie). Fasiliteer die ondersteuning van nywerhede om by te dra tot die versnelling van die ekonomiese groeikoers. Adresser die millennium-ontwikkelingsdoelwitte, nasionale en provinsiale doelwitte van werk skepping en die grondwetlike mandaat. Fasiliteer en onderneem navorsing wat inligting sal verskaf vir die ontwikkeling en hersiening van ekonomiese ontwikkelingsplanne, beleide en strategieë in ooreenstemming met nasionale en provinsiale prioriteite. Voer navorsing en haalbaarheidstudies uit oor voornemende projekte ten opsigte van, onder andere, tegniese, sosio-ekonomiese, omgewings- en finansiële bestuur en markprosesse om besluitneming oor die tipe projekte-ondersteuning en skakels met sektorontwikkeling te vergemaklik. Bestuur die implementering van breë ekonomiese strategieë en ander noodsaaklike inisiatiewe om die provinsiale ekonomie te transformeer, bv. Spesiale Ekonomiese Sones (SEZ), Swart industrialiste en Nywerheidspark. Ontwikkel en implementeer sleutel ekonomiese sektorstrategieë wat provinsiale ekonomiese groei en ontwikkeling beïnvloed. Fasiliteer en bestuur die skepping van 'n ondersteunende omgewing vir sleutel provinsiale nywerhede wat die potensiaal het om beduidend by te dra tot werk skepping, vaardigheidsontwikkeling, die vestiging en groei van klein, medium en groot besighede, en om BBBEE te ondersteun deur landelike en township-ekonomie binne die vier distrikte van die Provinsie. Om die mededingendheid van die provinsie se prioriteit ekonomiese sektore te verbeter en te verseker dat hulle op 'n globale, kontinentale en internasionale skaal kan meeding. Bestuur strategiese projekte en vennootskap-/diensvlakooreenkomste met sleutelbelanghebbendes in provinsiale geprioritiseerde ekonomiese sektore en verseker dat hulle suksesvol voltooi word binne begrotingstydlyne en prestasievereistes. Bestuur die prestasie van die Hoofdirektoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi oyiNkulu: Ukuhlelwa Komnotho
zu.summary: Umphathi oyiNkulu Wokuhlelwa Komnotho eMahikeng, ofuna iziqu ze-Bachelor ku-Economics namava amakhulu ekuthuthukiseni komnotho, ezingeni leholo 14.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) enkundleni ye-Business Economics / Economic Planning noma isiqu esilingana njengokuthathwa ngu-SAQA. Iziqu ze-Postgraduate enkundleni ye-Economics zizobe yithamsanqa. Amava amakhulu enkundleni yokuthuthukiswa komnotho, ukukhungelwa kwezimpahla kanye nokuKhuthaza Utshalomali. Ulwazi nokuqonda inkundla yokuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nokuthuthukiswa koshintshi. Amava okwenza ucwaningo lokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Uncike emthethweni wezimoto. Amava okungenani eminyaka emi-5 ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha noma esilingana nelinga le-SMS kwezinye izinto. Ikhono: Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Ikhono lokubamba iqhaza nokuhola; Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi; Ukuphathwa oshintsho; Ukuphathwa kolwazi; Intuthuko ekulethweni kwezinsizakalo; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukuphatha abantu nokuBusa; Ukugxila kubathengi; Ukuxhumana; Ukuqotho nokuba nesibindi; Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Kwenze imisebenzi njengoSosayethi oyiNkulu wEzomnotho. Kuthuthukiswe futhi kusetshenziswe izindlela zokungenela izinto namasu okukhuthaza ukukhula nokuthuthuka komnotho ngokuthuthukiswa koshintshi, ukuhweba kanye nokuKhuthaza Utshalomali. Kusizakalwe futhi kuhlanganiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkundla eziyinhloko ezinga leSifunda zomnotho (ukucubungula izolimo, ukukhiqiza, ukubumba ngcolosi, ezokuvakasha nomnotho oluhlaza). Kusizakalwe oshintshi ukuze kuthuthuke izinga lokukhula komnotho. Kubhekwe imigomo ehlukile, imigomo yesifunda nasezweni yokuqamba imisebenzi kanye nesibopho somthethosisekelo. Kusizakalwe futhi kwenziwe ucwaningo oluzokwazisa ukuthuthukiswa nokubuyekeza izinhlela zokuthuthukiswa komnotho, imigomo namasu ngokuvumelana nezinto eziyinhloko ezinga lesifunda nasezweni. Kwenziwe ucwaningo kanye nokuhlolwa kokusebenza kwamaphrojekthi ayesethwe, maqondana nalokhu, ubuchwepheshe, ezenhlalo nomnotho, ezingcoliso nasekuphathweni kwezimali kanye nokuqhuba imakethe ukuze kusize ekwenzeni isinqumo ngohlobo lwesixhaso samaphrojekthi nokuxhumanisa nokuthuthukiswa kwenkundla. Kuphathwe ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakulo ezeqene ezingokomnotho kanye nezinye izindlela ezingeyo ukuguqula umnotho wesifunda njengoba. Special Economic Zones (SEZ), Black industrialists and Industrial parks. Kuthuthukiswe futhi kusetshenziswe amasu ayinhloko enkundleni yomnotho azokwazi ukukhuthaza ukukhula nokuthuthuka komnotho esifundeni. Kusizakalwe futhi kuphathwe ukudalwa kwesimo esivumela oshintshi abayinhloko eSifundazweni abanethamsanqa likakhulu ekuyweni imisebenzi, ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, ekusungulweni nasekhuleni kwezoshintshi ezingaphansi kanye namakhulu omkhakha kanye nokuxhasa i-BBBEE ngomnotho wemiphakathi namaphandle kuzifunda ezine zeSifunda. Ukukhulisa amandla okuncintisana kwezinkundla eziyinhloka zomnotho zesifunda ukuze zikwazi ukuncintisana emazingeni e global, continental and international. Kuphathwe amaphrojekthi ayinhloko kanye nezinkambiso zokusebenza nabalingane / izinkambiso ze service level agreements nabalingane abayinhloko ezinkundleni zomnotho eziyinhloka zesifunda futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziqedwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe eshibile nangemfuneko yokusebenza. Kuphathwe ukusebenza kweSikhundla sabaphathi abayiNkulu.
