zu.duties: Qapha ukunikelwa kwamasevisi okuphathwa nentuthuko yabalimi bezimali ngesikhundla kulo lonke umnyango. Phatha ukunikezwa kwasiza okuyisikhungo namasevisi engqungquthelomphathi. Qapha amasevisi wesiza lomthetho kulo lonke umnyango. Qapha ukuze kuhlonelwe izinto ezivikela kanye nenguquko kulo lonke umnyango. Qapha ukuphathwa kwe-ICT, yokuxhumana nomnyango nolwazi kulo lonke umnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi umnyango uyahlonipha i-PAIA ne-POPIA. Qapha amasevisi okuxhumana kulo lonke umnyango. Bambisana ekwenzeni uhlelo lwesikhathi, amaphuzu ohlelo neshishini. Qoqa imibiko yokusebenza kweqembu njalo kwikota nangonyaka. Phatha nikeza amasevisi esiza kuwo wonke umnyango. Phatha ulwazi ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke ulwazi kulo lonke umnyango luqinisekile/luqhamukayo/ethembekile futhi luguquliwe ngendlela efanele. Nciphisa ingozi kulo lonke umnyango ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kulawulo lwazo zonke inqubo zangaphakathi. Sungula uphumelelise amasistimu okubika ohlelekile ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ezifanele ngaphakathi ngabaphathi. Phatha i-PMDS yomnyango yonke imisebenzi yobuqondisi obuphezulu ngokuhambisana nohlelo lokusebenza lonyaka nohlelo lokuphumelelisa kanye nombiko wonyaka. Nikeza inkombandlela yezimali nabantu futhi uqinisekise ukuphathwa nolawulo lujwayelekile lweNkundla yobuQondisi bezenkolo zeZinkampani.

xh.title: Ikhaka leenkokeli: Iinkonzo zeNkampani
xh.summary: Ikhaka leenkokeli leeNkonzo zeNkampani kwiNorth West Department of Economic Development, likhokela imisebenzi ye-HR, yomthetho, yookhuseleko nolawulo kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 14.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekile se-Bachelor’s (NQF Level 7) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo oluphezulu okanye elingana nenganaba le-SMS kwezinye iindawo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda kulawulo lweenkonzo zenkampani kwisebe loluntu. Iakhono: Ikhono lokukhokela nokubakho koluntu-msebenzi. Iakhono lolawulo lwamaqonga namanqaku. Iakhono lolawulo lweemali. Iakhono lolawulo lokutshintsha. Iakhono lolawulo lolwazi. Iakhono lokuqamba iindlela entsha zokuhambisa iinkonzo. Iakhono lokuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Iakhono lolawulo labantu nokubakhulisa. Uqwalaselo kwabathengi nokugxila kubo. Iakhono lokunxibelelana. Inyaniso nokuqinisekisa. Iakhono lokudibanisa abantu nokupebenta. Iakhono zekhompyutha. Ulwazi olugqithisileyo, olujulileyo nokuqonda ngazo zonke iinkqubo zemigaqo ezilawula candelo loluntu.
xh.duties: Phatha ubomi bokuhambisa iinkonzo zoLawulo nophuhliso lweZenzo zabantu ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Lawula ukubonelela ngenkxaso nolawulo lweenkonzo ezibalulekileyo. Phatha iinkonzo zenkxaso yomthetho zeSebe. Phatha ukuhambelana kolawulo lookhuseleko notshintsho ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Phatha ulawulo lwe-ICT, unxibelelwano lwenkampani nolawulo lolwazi ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kweSebe kwi-PAIA ne-POPIA. Qwalasela iinkonzo zonxibelelwano ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Lungiselela ijikelo locandelo lweplani ebalulekileyo, iiplani ezibalulekileyo nezoshishino. Qokelela iingxelo zemveliso yentshiqlaliseko ngekhota ngamnye ngamnyaka. Lawula ukuze kube ngenkxazo yeenkonzo kuso sonke isebbe. Lawula ulwazi ngokuqinisekisa ukuba lonke ulwazi kwisebe lusekhuselekile/ lufikelelekayo/ luthembekile ludityaniswe kakuhle. Nciphisa ingozi kwisebe ngokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ulawulo kuzo zonke iinkqubo zangaphakathi. Yakha uze usebenzise iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokubika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzenza okufanelekileyo kwezigqibo zangaphakathi kolawulo. Lawula i-PMDS yesebe kwiinkonzo zoLawulo oluphezulu ngokweplani yoMnyaka woMveliso neplani yokuzekenyo kanjalo nengxelo ngamnyaka. Nikeza inkxaso yemali nabantu uze uqinisekise ulawulo nolawulo jikelele loLawulo oluPhakamileyo lweenkonzo zenkampani.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Integrated Economic Development Services
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation, and Tourism
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive remuneration package), 60% or 70% of the inclusive salary package must go into the basic salary.
jobs.closing_date_text: 07 August 2026 NOTES : Application must be submitted on a newly subscribed Z83 Form, obtainable from any Public Service Department, which must be signed and dated (and unsigned and not dated Z83 form will disqualify an application) and must be accompanied by a recently updated, comprehensive CV, including the details of at least three contactable referees (should be people who recently worked with the applicant). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not being contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). No faxed and late applications will be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service (SMS Pre Entry Certificate) is required prior to finalisation of an appointment into any SMS post. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training -course/sms-pre-entry programme. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Successful applicants will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. Disclosure of financial interests is a requirement. NB: Applicants who previously applied for these posts need not re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON
jobs.summary: Chief Director sought to lead integrated economic development services, managing strategic projects, stakeholder partnerships and regulatory reform at the North West Head Office.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) or equivalent as recognised by SAQA. A higher qualification in Economics / Economic Development / Economic Management and Analysis / Business Entrepreneurship will serve as an added advantage. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a senior management level or equivalent to SMS level from other sectors. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Financial management, Strategic Capability and Leadership, Programme and Project management, Change management, Knowledge management, Service delivery innovation, Problem solving and Analysis, People management and Empowerment, Client orientation and customer focus, Communication, Honesty and Integrity. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Manage the contribution by the Department to the local economic growth and development. Identify regulatory burdens that negatively affect business development. Manage strategic projects and partnership / service delivery level agreements with key stakeholders in the sector and ensure that they are successfully completed within the budgetary timelines and performance requirements. Manage the empowerment of enterprises of the designated groups with the aim of addressing economic disparities. Manage the implementation of broad economic strategies and other imperative initiatives to transform the provincial economy. Conduct viability and financial management and market processes to aid decision-making about the type of project support and links to support programmes. Assess the impact on increased coordination and partnership regarding funding of enterprises (SMMEs and Cooperatives). Facilitate the alignment of all procurement policies to empower Cooperatives and SMMEs at provincial and local levels. Ensure proper implementation of the incubation and skills development programme to sustain small businesses in the province. Manage the implementation of Departmental Risk Management policy. Collaborate with municipalities through their integrated development plans to develop and implement enterprise development programmes towards improved Local Economic Development. Manage the provision of technical support to the Province and municipalities during the implementation of Small Business Portfolio programmes within the districts/municipalities (DDM). Manage and ensure effective and efficient utilisation of the financial, human and physical resources of the Chief Directorate in line with the applicable legislation. Communication (verbal, written and formal presentations, etc) with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds and deliver relevant information.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. R. E. Mofokane Tel No: (018) 388 5823
jobs.applications: Completed application forms and the Comprehensive CV quoting the relevant reference number, may either be hand-delivered to Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation and Tourism, NWDC Building, Cnr University Drive and Provident Street, Mmabatho, 2745. OR E-mail: dedectapplications@nwpg.gov.za

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Geïntegreerde Ekonomiese Ontwikkelingsdienste
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur gesoek om geïntegreerde ekonomiese ontwikkelingsdienste te lei, met die bestuur van strategiese projekte, belanghebbendevennootskappe en regulatoriese hervorming by die North West Head Office.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Level 7) of ekwivalent soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Hoër kwalifikasie in Ekonomie / Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling / Ekonomiese Bestuur en Analise / Besigheidsondernemerskap sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op seniorbestuursvlak of ekwivalent aan SMS-vlak vanuit ander sektore. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Finansiële bestuur, Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en projekbestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Kennisbestuur, Diensleweringinnoviasie, Probleemoplossing en analise, Mensebestuur en bemagtiging, Kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus, Kommunikasie, Eerlikheid en integriteit. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die bydrae van die Departement tot plaaslike ekonomiese groei en ontwikkeling. Identifiseer regulasioneel las wat besigheidsontwikkeling nadelig beïnvloed. Bestuur strategiese projekte en vennootskap-/diensleweringsooreenkomste met sleutelbelanghebbendes in die sektor en verseker dat hulle suksesvol voltooi word binne die begrotingstermyne en prestasievereistes. Bestuur die bemagtiging van ondernemings van die aangewese groepe met die doel om ekonomiese wanbalanse aan te spreek. Bestuur die implementering van breë ekonomiese strategieë en ander noodsaaklike inisiatiewe om die provinsiale ekonomie te transformeer. Voer lewensvatbaarheid, finansiële bestuur en markprosesse uit om besluitneming oor die tipe projekondersteuning en skakels met ondersteuningsprogramme te bevorder. Evalueer die impak van verhoogde koördinasie en vennootskap met betrekking tot befondsing van ondernemings (KMO'e en Koöperasies). Fasiliteer die belyning van alle verkrygingsbeleid om Koöperasies en KMO'e op provinsiale en plaaslike vlak te bemagtig. Verseker behoorlike implementering van die inkubasie- en vaardigheidsontwikkelingsprogram om klein besighede in die provinsie volhoubaar te hou. Bestuur die implementering van die departementele risikobestuurbeleid. Werk met munisipaliteite saam deur hul geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsplanne om ondernemingsontwikkelingsprogramme te ontwikkel en te implementeer tot verbeterde Plaaslike Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling. Bestuur die verskaffing van tegniese ondersteuning aan die Provinsie en munisipaliteite tydens die implementering van Kleinbesigheidsportefeuljeprogramme binne die distrikte/munisipaliteite (DDM). Bestuur en verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van die finansiële, menslike en fisiese hulpbronne van die Hoofdirektoraat in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike wetgewing. Kommunikasie (mondelings, skriftelik en formele aanbiedings, ens.) met belanghebbendes uit uiteenlopende agtergronde en verskaf tersaaklike inligting.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Ohamba: Izinsebenze Ezihiyanisiwe Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezomnotho
zu.summary: Kufunwa Onjiniyela Ohamba ukuba ahole izinsebenze ezihiyanisiwe zokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, aphethe imiklamo yokubeka uhlelo, ubudlelwano nabalingani, kanye nenguqulo yemithethonqondo eNdiwo yaseNorth Head Office.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) ezifanele noma okulingana nalezo njengoba ziqinisekiswa i-SAQA. Isiqu esiphakeme kwezomnotho / ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho / ukuphathwa kwezomnotho nanhlaziyo / ubambe-mluwo wezamabhizinisi kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ukwazi okungaphansi kweminyaka engu-5 ohlelweni lwabaphathi abaphezulu noma okulingana nazinga le-SMS kulezinye izinto. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Amandla: ukuphathwa kwezimali, amandla okubeka uhlelo nokuba ngumholi, ukuphathwa kwemiklamo nemikhiqizo, ukuphathwa kwenguqulo, ukuphathwa kolwazi, intshisakalo ebusisekile ekulethweni kwesevisi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokugasaba kwabo, ukuqondisa kubathengi kanye nokugxila kubathengi, ukuxhumana, ukuqiniseka nokwethembeka. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Phatha kongeza umnyango ekukhuleni kwakho nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho endawo. Chaza izithiyo zemithethonqondo ezithinta kabi ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi. Phatha imiklamo yokubeka uhlelo namasivumelwano abalingani / amasivumelwano ezinga lenkonzo nabalingani ababalulekile kuleso saba bese uqinisekisa ukuthi aqedwa ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe kwisabelomali kanye nezidingo zokusebenza. Phatha ukugasaba kwamabhizinisi amaqembu abekiwe nenhloso yokulungisa ukungalingani kwezomnotho. Phatha ukuqaliswa kwezinhlelo zomnotho ezibanzi kanye nezinye izenzo eziyisimiso ukwenza inguqulo kwezomnotho esifundazweni. Yenza ukuhlolwa kokusebenza kokuphathwa kwezimali nemikhuba yemakethe ukweseka ukwenza izinqumo ngohlobo lwesikelo emiklameni nangokuxhumanisa emiklameni yokusekela. Linganisa umthelela ekweniweni kokubambisana nokuxhumana ngemali yokusekela amabhizinisi (i-SMMEs kanye nama-Cooperatives). Yenza ukuthi zonke izinkambonqondo zokuthenga zihambisane ukukhulisa ama-Cooperatives kanye nama-SMME esifundazweni nendawo. Qinisekisa ukuqaliswa okufanele kwemiklamo yokufundisa nokuthuthukiswa kwezamakhono ukuze kugcinwe amabhizinisi amancane esifundazweni. Phatha ukuqaliswa kwenkambonqondo yomnyango yokuphathwa kwezengozi. Sebennisana nemimango ngemiklamo yayo yokuthuthukiswa ehiyanisiwe ukuthuthukisa kanye nekuqalisa imiklamo yokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ngokuqondisa ekuthuthukisweni kwezomnotho endawo. Phatha ukunikezwa kwesikelo sobuchwepheshe esifundazweni nakumimango ngesikhathi sokuqaliswa kwemiklamo yesevisi yamabhizinisi amancane ngaphakathi kwamasifunda / amamimango (i-DDM). Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwemali, abantu nemithombo engokoqobo yale ndlu yonjiniyela ngokuhambisana nemithetho ebekwayo. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo, okubhaliwe kanye nezethulo ezisemthethweni, njll) nabalingani bemvelo ehlukene bese unikeza ulwazi olubalulekile.

xh.title: INkulumbuso eliNggada: Iinkonzo eziDityanisiweyo zoPhuhliso lweRhulumente weRhwebo
xh.summary: Kufunwa iNkulumbuso eliNggada eliya kuba nogunya lokulawula iinkonzo ezidityanisiweyo zokuphuhlisa urhulumente, ukulawula iiprojekthi ezingundoqo, ukuqaliswa kolwamkelo komxhasi, kunye noshintsho ngokomthetho kwindlu eNkulu yeNtliko ye North West.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor esifanelekileyo (NQF Level 7) okwa salingana naso njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA. Isidanga esiphezulu kwamaphulo / ekuPhuhlisweni koRhwebo / ekuLawulweni kweRhwebo nokuQwalaselwa / kweShishino ekuQalweni kwezoshishino kuya kuba lusengo lonwabo olwongeziweyo. Amava anomlinganiselo o-5 eminyaka ubudala ongundoqo wolawulo noma olingana nenzalo yeendidi ezivela kumanye amacandelo. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Iikhompothensi: ulawulo lwezimali, iKhono leNtshukumo nokuLawula abantu, ulawulo lweNkqubo nezeProjekthi, ulawulo lwaokuTshintsha, ulawulo lwesiCwangciso, iNkonzo eNtsha yokubonelela iNtshukumo, iNgxaki-miba yokuLawula iNkqubo kunye nokwenza iSigqibo, ulawulo lwaBantu nokuBa nakho ukuzinika amandla abantu ngokulinganayo, ukuQwalasela umXhasi nokuGxila kuBakho, iNkqubo yokuThethelana phakathi kwabantu, iQiniso nokuQonda iYure. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Lawula inegalelo eliselweyo lesebe ekukhuleni nasekuphuhlisweni kwamaphulo amakhulu. Phawula izithwathwa zolawulo ezithinta ngokungalunganga ukuphuhliswa koshishino. Lawula iiprojekthi ezingundoqo nemigqaliswano yonikezelo lweenkonzo / iinkqubo zovumelwano nabaphathi ababalulekileyo kule candelo uze uqinisekise ukuba zigqitywa ngempumelelo ngexesha elidlulisiweyo kwisikhathi sobhajeti nakuwo wonke amafunyo okusebenza. Lawula ukuzinika amandla amashishini amagatya abekiweyo ngenjongo yokulungisa ngokulinganayo iingqiqo zamaphulo. Lawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo ezibanzi zamaphulo nakwezinye iinjongo ezingundoqo zokutshintsha urhwebo lwerhulumente wephondo. Yenza uphononongo lokusebenza kobomi, ulawulo lwemali, neenkqubo zomthengisi ukunceda ukwenza izigqibo malunga nohlobo lwesenzo kwindawo yeprojekthi kunye nokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo zokuxhasa. Linganisela isiphumo samaxhesho aphakamisileyo kumanyano nokuhlanganisana ngemali exhasa amashishini (ii-SMMEs kunye neziQhakamshelwano). Khuthaza ukuhambelana kweenkqubo zonke zokuthenga ukuze kunikwe amandla iziQhakamshelwano nee-SMMEs kwinqanaba lephondo nasedoropeni. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kwenkqubo yokukhulisa nokuqeqesha amakhono ukuze kugcinwe kusinwe amashishini amancinci kwiphondo. Lawula ukusebenza kwenkqubo ye-Isebe yokulawula iingozi. Sebenzisana namadolophu ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zazo ezingundoqo zokuphuhlisa amashishino ukuze kuphuhliswe kuze kwakhiwe iinkqubo ezithuthuzelayo zokuphuhliswa kwamashishini kuze kube kukuphuhliswa okuphuculiweyo kobuRholodo beSehlango. Lawula ukunikwa kwenkxaso yobuchwepheshe kuPhondo nakumadolophu ngelixa ixhaswa iinkqubo zoBukiwe bamaShishini amaNcinci kumaphondo/amadolophu (DDM). Lawula uze uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo nangokusebenzisana koBulele bobuNinzi, abantu, namakhono eNqanaba eliPhakamileyo loLawulo ngokwemigaqo-nkqubo esebenzayo. Unxibelelwano (ngokuthetha, nokubhalayo, nokubonisa ngokusesikweni, njl) namaphathi abavela kumaphakamshelelo ahlukeneyo unike izinto eziphathelene nendlu yakho.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Besigheidsregulering en Verbruiker
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur-pos wat toesig hou oor besigheidsregulering, verbruikersake en nakoming van dranklisensies by die North West Department of Economic Development in Mahikeng.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Level 7) of ekwivalent soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Hoër kwalifikasie in Business Administration / Business Management / Management sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. jobs.title: Director: Human Capital Management
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation, and Tourism
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive remuneration package), 60% or 70% of the inclusive salary package must go into the basic salary.
jobs.closing_date_text: 07 August 2026 NOTES : Application must be submitted on a newly subscribed Z83 Form, obtainable from any Public Service Department, which must be signed and dated (and unsigned and not dated Z83 form will disqualify an application) and must be accompanied by a recently updated, comprehensive CV, including the details of at least three contactable referees (should be people who recently worked with the applicant). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not being contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). No faxed and late applications will be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service (SMS Pre Entry Certificate) is required prior to finalisation of an appointment into any SMS post. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training -course/sms-pre-entry programme. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Successful applicants will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. Disclosure of financial interests is a requirement. NB: Applicants who previously applied for these posts need not re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON
jobs.summary: Lead the Human Capital Management Directorate at the North West Department of Economic Development, providing strategic HR direction and overseeing organisational development.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) in Human Resource Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Industrial Psychology or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years relevant experience at a middle/senior management level or equivalent to SMS level from other sectors. Client focussed HR strategist. A thorough understanding of policy formulation and coordination. Proven experience in or through understanding of the Human Capital Management and broader talent management strategies. A good background in turnaround and change management strategies. Experience and insight into legislation that impacts on human resource practices and administration. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: A result-driven, customer-focused approach, with excellent planning, organisational communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills. Analytical and innovative thinking. Knowledge of human and financial resource management. Good computer literacy in the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). The ability to work in highly pressured environment and driven by a sense of urgency to meet deadlines. Leadership skills. Research and policy formulation. Presentation and facilitation skills. Executive report-writing skills. People management. Financial management. Strategic planning. Project management. Change and knowledge management. Negotiation skills. Knowledge of Government systems (PERSAL).
jobs.duties: Provide leadership and strategic direction in the Directorate. Ensure the provision of comprehensive organisational development support. Co-ordinate and integrate the service delivery programmes of the department. Manage and utilise resource practice and administration. Manage overall employee relations. Develop and manage employee health and wellness. Manage and co-ordinate human capital planning, salaries and information systems services that support the departmental strategy. Design and manage strategic human resource training and development services. Manage and utilise resources in accordance with relevant directives and legislation.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M. J. Matebesi Tel No: (018) 388 1335
jobs.applications: Completed application forms and the Comprehensive CV quoting the relevant reference number, may either be hand-delivered to Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation and Tourism, NWDC Building, Cnr University Drive and Provident Street, Mmabatho, 2745. OR E-mail: dedectapplications@nwpg.gov.za

af.title: Direkteur: Menslikekapitaalbestuur
af.summary: Lood die Direktoraat Menslikekapitaalbestuur by die North West Department of Economic Development, verskaf strategiese HR-rigting en hou toesig oor organisatoriese ontwikkeling.
af.requirements: ’n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7) in Menslikehulpbronbestuur / Openbare administrasie / Openbare bestuur / Bedryfsielkunde of ’n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. ’n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op ’n middel-/ seniorbestuursvlak of gelykstaande aan SMS-vlak uit ander sektore. Kliëntgefokusde HR-strateeg. ’n Deeglike begrip van beleidsformulering en -koördinering. Bewese ervaring in of deur begrip van die Menslikekapitaalbestuur en breër talentbestuurstrategieë. ’n Goeie agtergrond in herstel- en veranderingsbestuurstrategieë. Ervaring en insig in wetgewing wat menslikehulpbronpraktyke en -administrasie beïnvloed. ’n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: ’n Resultaatsgedrewe, kliëntgefokuste benadering, met uitstekende beplannings-, organisatoriese Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling) en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Kennis van menslike en finansiële hulpbronbestuur. Goeie rekenaargeletterdheid in die Microsoft Office-pakket (Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Die vermoë om in ’n hoëddrukomgewing te werk en gedryf deur ’n sin van dringendheid om sperdatums te haal. Leierskapsvaardighede. Navorsing en beleidsformulering. Aanbiedings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Uitvoerende verslagskryfvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese beplanning. Projekbestuur. Veranderings- en kennbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Kennis van Regeringstelsels (PERSAL).
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap en strategiese rigting in die Direktoraat. Verseker die verskaffing van omvattende organisatoriese ontwikkelingsondersteuning. Koördineer en integreer die diensleweringprogramme van die departement. Bestuur en benut hulpbronpraktyk en -administrasie. Bestuur algehele werknemerverhoudinge. Ontwikkel en bestuur werknemergezondheid en -welstand. Bestuur en koördineer menslikekapitaalbeplanning, salarisse en inligtingstelseldienste wat die departementele strategie ondersteun. Ontwerp en bestuur strategiese menslikehulpbronopleiding en -ontwikkelingsdienste. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike richtlyne en wetgewing.

zu.title: Umluleki: Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Hola iDirectorate Yokuphathwa Kwabasebenzi eNorth West Department of Economic Development, nikeza isiqondiso sobuchwepheshe se-HR futhi ulawule ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlanga.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yesibili esifanele (NQF Level 7) e-Human Resource Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Industrial Psychology noma izifundo ezilinganayo njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ukwesaba okuncane kweminyaka engu-5 yohlelo oluhambisana nelinga lephakathi/eliphezulu lokuphatha noma elilingana nelinga le-SMS kwezinye izigaba. Isinyalawegqodzi se-HR esigxile kumthengi. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokwakhiwa kohlaka kanye nokuhlanganiswa. Uhlelo lokusebenza esiqinisekisiwe ekuboneni noma ukuqondeni okujulile kokuphathwa kwabasebenzi kanye nezindlela ezibanzi zokuphatha amakhono. Isizinda esihle ekujuliseni kanye nezindlela zokushintsha ukuphatha. Uhlelo lokusebenza kanye neqondo emthethweni othinta izindlela zokuphatha abasebenzi nokuphatha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe. Ikhono: Indlela ebuswa yiziphumo, egxile kumthengi, enohlelo oluhle, ukuxhumana kwezinhlanga (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa) kanye namakhono okwethula. Ukuhlukanisa kanye nokucabanga okusha. Ulwazi lokuphatha abantu nabemali. Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngemishini kuma-Office e-Microsoft (Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ikono lokusebenza endaweni enengcindezi ephezulu futhi qhuba umuzwa wezinsuku eziyisikhathi esibekiwe ukugcina izinsuku eziyisikhathi. Amakhono okuba ngumholi. Ucwaningo kanye nokwakhiwa kohlaka. Amakhono okwethula kanye nokweseka. Amakhono okubhala imibhalo yokuphatha. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuhlela okubalulekile. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukushintsha kanye nokuphatha ulwazi. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Ulwazi lwamasistimu kahulumeni (PERSAL).
zu.duties: Nikeza ukuba ngumholi nesisindo sobuchwepheshe kwiDirectorate. Qinisekisa inikezwa lokusekela ukuthuthukiswa okubanzi kwezinhlanga. Hlanganisa kanye nokuhlanganisa izinhlela zokuletha izinsiza zomnyango. Phatha futhi usebenzise izindlela zokwenza kanye nokuphatha. Lawula ubudlelwano babasebenzi ngaphezu kwazo zonke. Yakha futhi uphathe impilo kanye nentokozo yabasebenzi. Lawula futhi uhlanganise ukuhlela abantu, amaholo kanye namasistimu wolwazi asekela isu lomnyango. Diza futhi uphathe izinsiza zobuchwepheshe zokuhlela kokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinsiza ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ehambisanayo kanye nomthetho.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ulawulo lwamandla abantu
xh.summary: Qhuba iDirektorate yoLawulo lwamandla abantu kwiNorth West Department of Economic Development, nibonelela ngokuqondisa okuyingcamango kwi-HR nilawule uphuhliso loluntu.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo zeBachelor (NQF Level 7) kwilawulo labasebenzi / kulawulo karhulumente / kulawulo karhulumente / kwipsikholoji yoshishino okanye isidanga esilinganayo njengoko sivunywa yiSAQA. Amava afanelekileyo angaphezulu kwe-5 emsebenzini ongqangweni wolawulo waphakathi / ophezulu okulingana nongqangweni we-MS kwiinye iindawo. Uchungechunge lwe-HR olugxile kwindima. Ukuqonda okupheleleyo ekubhenzeni nasekulungiseni iindlela. Amava abonwayo ekungeniseni okanye ngekuqonda kolawulo lwamandla abantu namacebo amaninzi olawulo lwamandla. Isikhundo esimhle ekujikeni nasekulawuleni ushintsho. Amava nokuqonda umthetho ochaphazela iindlela zokusebenza nolawulo lwamasebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono: Indlela egxile kziphumo, egxile kwindima, enobuchule obukhulu bokucwangcisa, ukuzimisela koluntu (elubhalweyo noluthethwayo) namakhono okubonisa. Ukucinga ngokwahluka nokubuda iingcamango. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwamandla abantu nemali. Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza kwikhompyutha kwiMicrosoft Office suite (Word, Excel nePowerPoint). Ikhono lokusebenza kwindawo enomfutho omkhulu kwaye ngenxaxheba yokuba sifiso sokugqiba kwiinxesha ezimisiweyo. Amandla okukhokha. Uphononongo nokuqamba iindlela. Ikhono lokubonisa nokulawula iingxoxo. Amandla okubhala iingxelo ezikumgangatho ophezulu. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ulawulo lwemali. Ukucwangcisa ngamacebo. Ulawulo lweeprojekthi. Ushintsho nolawulo lolwazi. Ikhono lokuxoxa. Ulwazi ngamajonquba karhulumente (PERSAL).
xh.duties: Bonelela ngamandla okukhokisa ukuze kujongwe ndlela ekuyingcamango kwiDirektorate. Qinisekisa ukunikwa koxhaso olupheleleyo lwophuhliso loluntu. Lungisanisa kwaye udibanise iinkqubo zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo kwisebe. Lawula kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokusebenza nolawulo. Lawula amacandu abasebenzi jikelele. Phuhlisisa kwaye ulawule impilo nempilo yomntu. Lawula kwaye ulungisanise uqeqesho lwamandla abantu, imivuzo kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zolwazi ezixhasa iindlela zesebe. Yila kwaye ulawule ulawulo lwabasebenzi oluqeqeshwe ngamacebo nolawulo. Lawula kwaye usebenzise amandla ngokwemiyalelo nangokomthetho ochanekileyo.

xh.duties: Yila, phumeza ukuze uthuthaze izigqibo eziqinisekisa amalungelo neenzintso zogxathwathathwayo. Yenzela imfundo yogxathwathathwayo nemisebenzi yokunikezela iinkonzo. Yonikezele nokuvala nokulawula iinkqubo zoshishino ezingelingeyiyo kwizintso nokuKhuselwa kogxathwathathwayo. Phando iingxelo zogxathwathathwayo. Yenzela iinkonzo zekhofu zezezigqibo zogxathwathathwayo. Yenzela imfundo yabagxathwa nemisebenzi yokucebisa abagxathwa. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba nokuphumeza umthetho ohlobene nokurhangqwa.

jobs.title: Director: Supply Chain and Fleet Management
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation, and Tourism
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive remuneration package), 60% or 70% of the inclusive salary package must go into the basic salary.
jobs.closing_date_text: 07 August 2026 NOTES : Application must be submitted on a newly subscribed Z83 Form, obtainable from any Public Service Department, which must be signed and dated (and unsigned and not dated Z83 form will disqualify an application) and must be accompanied by a recently updated, comprehensive CV, including the details of at least three contactable referees (should be people who recently worked with the applicant). Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not being contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). No faxed and late applications will be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service (SMS Pre Entry Certificate) is required prior to finalisation of an appointment into any SMS post. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training -course/sms-pre-entry programme. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Successful applicants will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. Disclosure of financial interests is a requirement. NB: Applicants who previously applied for these posts need not re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON
jobs.summary: Lead supply chain, asset and fleet management functions at a strategic level for the North West Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation, and Tourism.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) in Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Economics / Auditing or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years relevant experience at a middle/senior management level or equivalent to SMS level from other sectors. Knowledge and experience in Supply Chain, Assets and Fleet management. Must be computer literate and must have worked on an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership. Programme and project management. An in-depth knowledge of applicable financial legislations and regulations, including exposure to Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Broad- based black empowerment Act, Standards of Generally Recognised accounting Practice and the Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge and understanding of Government imperatives and priorities. Knowledge and understanding of the white paper on the transformation of public service delivery (Batho Pele). Proven leadership, management, project management, communication, interpersonal, conflict resolution, analytical and financial management skills. Must be able to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic direction, leadership and management regarding Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management functions. Develop, manage and execute the key strategic objectives and business plans of the Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management. Ensure the necessary organisational capacity is created and managed for delivery on core operational requirements. Manage the performance of the unit to ensure quality service delivery and achievement of key strategic objectives. Ensure effective financial and human resources management. Interpret, understand and implement Supply Chain Management and asset management as contained in relevant legislation, regulations and GRAP standards. Develop and implement relevant policies and procedures with respect to Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management. Develop and implement internal control procedures to ensure the effective functioning of the unit and management of risk. Ensure sound contract management systems.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. K. C. Molosiwa Tel No: (018) 388 5922
jobs.applications: Completed application forms and the Comprehensive CV quoting the relevant reference number, may either be hand-delivered to Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation and Tourism, NWDC Building, Cnr University Drive and Provident Street, Mmabatho, 2745. OR E-mail: dedectapplications@nwpg.gov.za

af.title: Direkteur: Voorsieningsketting- en Vlootbestuur
af.summary: Lei voorsieningsketting-, bate- en vlootbestuursfunksies op 'n strategiese vlak vir die North West Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation, and Tourism.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7) in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Finansiële Bestuur / Ekonomie / Oudit of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak of gelykstaande aan SMS-vlak vanuit ander sektore. Kennis en ervaring in Voorsieningsketting-, Bate- en Vlootbestuur. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees en op 'n ondernemingshulpbronbeplanningstelsel (ERP) gewerk het. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Program- en projeksbestuur. 'n Diepgaande kennis van toepaslike finansiële wetgewing en regulasies, insluitende blootstelling aan die Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Broad-based black empowerment Act, Standards of Generally Recognised accounting Practice en die Public Finance Management Act. Kennis en begrip van Regeringsimperatiewe en -prioriteite. Kennis en begrip van die witboek oor die transformasie van openbare dienslewering (Batho Pele). Bewese leierskap-, bestuurs-, projeksbestuurs-, kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike-, konflikoplossings-, analitiese en finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Moet onder druk kan werk.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese rigting, leierskap en bestuursbegeleiding ten opsigte van Voorsieningsketting-, Bate- en Vlootbestuursfunksies. Ontwikkel, bestuur en voer die sleutel strategiese doelwitte en besigheidsplanne van Voorsieningsketting-, Bate- en Vlootbestuur uit. Verseker dat die nodige organisatoriese kapasiteit geskep en bestuur word vir die levering op kern bedryfsvereistes. Bestuur die prestasie van die eenheid om gehalte dienslewering en die bereiking van sleutel strategiese doelwitte te verseker. Verseker effektiewe finansiële en menslikehulpbronbestuur. Interpreteer, verstaan en implementeer Voorsieningskettingbestuur en batebestuur soos vervat in relevante wetgewing, regulasies en GRAP-standaarde. Ontwikkel en implementeer relevante beleide en prosedures ten opsigte van Voorsieningsketting-, Bate- en Vlootbestuur. Ontwikkel en implementeer interne beheerprosedures om die effektiewe funksionering van die eenheid en die bestuur van risiko te verseker. Verseker deeglike kontrakbestuurstelsels.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukuphathwa Kwenani Lokuthengisa Nemoto
zu.summary: Qondisa emzinganweni ophakeme iimiso zokuphathwa kwenani lokuthengisa, izimpahla nemoto e North West Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation, and Tourism.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor eziyinhloko (NQF Level 7) e-Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Economics / Auditing noma iziqu ezilinganayo njengoba zivunywe yi-SAQA. Ukwazi okuncane eminyakeni engu-5 ngemisebenzi ehambisana nalesi sikhundla esimeni se-middle/senior management noga kulingana nazinga le-SMS kwezinye izinkalo. Ulwazi nohlu lwemisebenzi e- Supply Chain, Assets and Fleet management. Kufanele ube nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha futhi kufanele usebenze kusistimu ye-enterprise resource planning (ERP). Ilayisense yokushayela okuyiso. Ikhono: Ikhono lokuhola nokuqondisa. Ukuphathwa ohlelweni namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi olujulile ngemithetho nemiqathango yezimali, kuhlanganise nokuthi uqaphele i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), i-Broad-based black empowerment Act, kanye nezindinganiso ze-Standards of Generally Recognised accounting Practice kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act. Ulwazi noqonde ngezidingo nezinhloso zikahulumeni. Ulwazi noqonde nge-white paper on the transformation of public service delivery (Batho Pele). Ikhono le-ukuphathwa, ukuhola, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuxhumana nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya futhi nokuqonda izimali elibonisiwe. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulu.
zu.duties: Nikeza isiqondiso, iqondo eliphezulu nelokubusa ngesimo sokuphathwa kwenani lokuthengiswa, izimpahla nemoto. Bumba, uphathe futhi uphumelelise iinhloso eziphakeme zesimiso namapulani e- Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona amandla aqinile aphathwa kalule kwezinhlanganeni ukuze kuqiniseke ukuqinisekiswa kwezidingo zemisebenzi. Phatha imisebenzi yegatsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kalule kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinhloso eziphakeme. Qinisekisa ukulawula kwezimali nabantu. Humusha, uqonde futhi usebenzise i- Supply Chain Management kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla njengoba kubhalwe emthethweni, kuyo yonke imithetho nemiqango kanye nezindinganiso ze-GRAP. Bumba futhi usebenzise imithetho nokuqondisa okuhlobene ne- Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management. Bumba futhi usebenzise izindlela zokulawula ngaphakathi ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza kahle kwesigaba nokuqonda ubungozi. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwesistimu yokuphathwa kwamakontrakti.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ulawulo Lwe-Supply Chain nge-Fleet Management
xh.summary: Phatha iinkalo zolawulo lwe-supply chain, iimpahla nolawulo lwefleet kwinqanaba elilungiselelwe i-North West Department of Economic Development, Environment, Conservation, and Tourism.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokuqala esifanelekileyo (NQF Level 7) kwi-Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Economics / Auditing okanye isidanga esilinganayo njengoko sivunywa yi-SAQA. Amava afanelekileyo angange-5 eminyaka kwinqanaba lalawulo phakathi naphakathi kwabaphezulu okanye elingana nengangabango le-SMS level kwezinye iindawo. Ulwazi namava kulawulo lwe-Supply Chain, iimpahla nolawulo lwefleet. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwaye usebenze kwindlela ye-enterprise resource planning (ERP). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iakhono: Ikhalathi yokulungiselela isimo eselungileyo nokuqamba iindlela nokulawula. Ulawulo lweenkqubo ngeenkqubo. Ulwazi oluqhubekayo ngemigaqo nemithetho eyalelayo kwezemali, kuquka noqobo lokusebenza nge-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Broad-based black empowerment Act, Standards of Generally Recognised accounting Practice naku-Public Finance Management Act. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimfuno nangaphambili karhulumente. Ulwazi nokuqonda iphepha elimhlophe malunga noguqulo lwenkonzo karhulumente (Batho Pele). Amakhono obuqukuqisi abaqondi, ulawulo, ulawulo lweenkqubo, ukunxibelelana, ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, isisombululo seengxixa, ulwazi lokuhlalutya nolawulo lwezemali abe gqithisisiweyo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Nika inkqubo elungiselelwe isimo eselungileyo, iqondo eliphezulu lokulawula nolawulo malunga nemiqathango ye-Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management. Yakha, ulawule uphumeze iinjongo ezibalulekileyo ezilungiselelwe isimo eselungileyo neendwambo zamashishini ze-Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management. Qinisekisa ukuba ikhono elidingekayo le-ntshilo liyakhiwe lize liphathwe ukuze kuzaliseze iimfuno eziphathilwe ekuqhubeni. Lawula ukusebenza kweqela ukuze uqinisekise ukubonelelwa ngokukhulu nangochane nokufikelela kwiinjongo ezibalulekileyo ezilungiselelwe isimo eselungileyo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwezemali nolwabantu. Tolika, uqonde uphumeze i-Supply Chain Management nolawulo lwempahla njengoko kubhaliwe kwimithetho, imigaqo ne-milinganiselo ye-GRAP. Yila uphumeze iimigaqo nolwazi olufanelekileyo malunga ne-Supply Chain, Asset and Fleet Management. Yila uphumeze iinkqubo zolawulo lwangaphakathi ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza okusebenzayo kweqela nolawulo lwengozi. Qinisekisa iinkqubo ezilungileyo zolawulo lweendibano.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: RED Tape Reduction
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.centre: Department of Economic Development and Tourism, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in the Western Cape Government focusing on reducing regulatory red tape and facilitating economic growth, requiring a diploma or degree and three years of management experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year National Diploma/B-Degree (equivalent or higher qualification); A minimum of 3 years management experience; A valid (Code B or higher) driving license. NB: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities, but who have reasonable access to transport, may also apply. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: National and Provincial instruments and legislation pertaining to Strategy Development and Stakeholder management; Global, regional and local political, economic and social affairs impacting on the provincial government of the Western Cape; Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector; SMME sector, including policies, dominant issues, role- players and service providers. Skills in the following: Written and verbal communication; Computer literacy in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Analytical; Report writing; Interpersonal skills; Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
jobs.duties: Identify blockages and inhibitors to economic growth and development; Advocate and create awareness amongst stakeholders of the significance of red tape; Facilitate the resolving of identified blockages and regulatory restraints; Management of Human resources and Finance.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: RED Tape Reduction

af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/B-Degree (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie); 'n Minimum van 3 jaar bestuurservaring; 'n Geldige (Kode B of hoër) bestuurslisensie. Vaardighede in die volgende: Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Analities; Verslagskrywing; Interpersoonlike vaardighede; Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Identifiseer blokkades en hindernisse vir ekonomiese groei en ontwikkeling; Bepleit en skep bewustheid onder belanghebbendes oor die belangrikheid van rooi linte; Fasiliteer die oplossing van geïdentifiseerde blokkades en regulatoriese beperkings; Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne en Finansies.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaPhakeme: Ukuncishiswa kweBhandi EliBomvu
zu.summary: Indima kaPhakeme osomlilo ohlinzeka kahulumeni we Western Cape okugxile ekunciphiseni ibhandi elibomvu elibekiwe yomthetho kanye nokuqhubela phambili ukukhula kwezomnotho, kufuna idiploma noma isiqu kanye namava eminyaka emithathu yomphathi.

zu.duties: Ukuhlonza izithiyo nezinkhungo ezibambezela ukukhula kwezomnotho nentuthuko; Ukukhuthaza futhi kwakhe ingqondo kubaphathi abahlobene ngokubaluleka kwebhandi elibomvu; Ukubeka izindinge zokuxazulula izithiyo ezihlonziwe nezinkinga ezibekwe umthetho; Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomuntu nezimali.

xh.summary: Indima yomphathi wesibini kuphuhliso koluntu ngokubandakanya uluntu olubuzwa ngokususela ekuqaleni kokubakho, nokubonelela ngoluntu kumashishini wonke ukuba aphuhliswe ngokulungelelana ngokwakoluntu ngokuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo.

xh.duties: Tsala iidili kwaye zithintelwe kutyayo ukukhula kwezithethe nezithintelo ekuphuhlisweni kwamashishini; Yixela kwaye udale ingqondo kwabathathi nxaxheba ngokuqukelela iRed Tape; Phatha uxabiso lwexesha kwaye ulungise iidili eziphawulweyo kunye nezithintelo ezingezantsi kolawulo; Lawulwa okuhle kweemisebenzi yabantu kwezo nyango zolawulo lweentsapho nabantu baseziko nakumalinge abakulungele uluntu; Wawusele kulungelelanisa nokuhlawulelwa ngokusesikweni kweenkonzo ezahlukeneyo ngokomsebenzi wosazo, izibonelelo ezisuka kubantu abasahlukeneyo, uluntu olukumathongo nkqo, kaloku uluntu lwesiXhosa alulinganga ngenkxaso yemimandla ehloniphekileyo, ngokudibanisa uluntu ngokutsha koluntu ekuphuhliseni amandla karhulumente ophakathi njengoko lisuka kumazantsi eNingizimu Afrika kummandla opheleleyo ukuya kwilali yonke lephakathi.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Cape Catalyst
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur gesoek vir die Cape Catalyst-program om projekteadministrasie-ondersteuning te verskaf, befondsingsvoorstelle te ontwikkel en prosesvereiste vir ekonomiese ontwikkelingsprojekte te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/B-Grade (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie); 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se administratiewe of projekbestuurservaring in 'n ekonomiese ontwikkelingsomgewing. Bevoegdhede: Werkende kennis van die volgende: Infrastruktuurontwikkeling/Sektorontwikkeling; Openbare administrasie; Toepaslike wetgewende en regulerende vereistes, beleide en standaarde; Projekbestuur; Verhoudingsbestuur; Monitering en evalueringsmetodes, -hulpmiddels en -tegnieke; Vaardighede in die volgende: Syfervaardigheid; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Taal; Analities; Beplanning en organisering; Probleemoplossing; Navorsing; Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling); Fasilitering; Voorlegging; Monitering en evaluering; Belanghebbende bestuur; Projekbeplanning.
af.duties: Verskaf projekteadministrasie-ondersteuning ten opsigte van projekte en programme: Ontwikkel en berei befondsingsvoorstelle vir projekte en programme voor; Verskaf projekkantoordienste en administrasie soos dit verband hou met die programme; Ontwikkel en administer prosesvereiste of oordragte van projekte; Ontwikkel terme van verwysing (Tor) en nakomingsprosesse; Hou toesig oor diensverskaffers en implementerende agentskappe se nakoming van die bepalings en voorwaardes van projekte; Monitor en evalueer projekvordering om die belyning van projeksdoelwitte te verseker; Identifiseer projekrisiko's; Implementeer risikobeperkingsmaatreëls en administer rooi lint-uitdagings; Neem deel aan strategiese en besluitnemingsprosesse: Voer inligtingsversameling en ontleding van bevindings uit; Stel 'n inventaris van databronne op; Ontwikkel en administer databasisse en inligtingstelsels; Verskaf insette by die ontwikkeling van strategieë; Dra by tot die konseptualisering van projekte en programme belyn met die departement se strategiese raamwerk en doelwitte; Koördineer geskikte en voorkeur-belanghebbendes vir die ontwikkeling en implementering van projekte en programme: Formuleer en implementeer belanghebbende bestuurstrategieë wat verband hou met projekte en programme; Ontwikkel en onderhou die vereiste belanghebbende verhoudings; Verskaf 'n sekretariatsdiens by belanghebbende forums en met taakspanne; Administer die belanghebbende databasis; Ontwikkel en implementeer kommunikasie- en inligtingsdelingsmetodes; Koördineer Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsbeplanning: Verskaf ondersteuning om belyning met munisipale Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsplanne (IDP's) en Ruimtelike Ontwikkelingsraamwerke (SDF's) te verseker; Bystand verleen met die ruimtelike ontleding en kartering van Cape Catalyst-projekte in verband met bogenoemde; Skakel met munisipale beplannings-, infrastruktuur- en ekonomiese ontwikkelingsamptenare om belyning te fasiliteer; Dra by tot die voorbereiding van beplanningsinsette, belyningsverslae, kennigsgewingsnotas en voorleggings vir besluitnemingsstrukture; Hou 'n logboek van ekonomiese katalitiese infrastruktuurmoontlikhede wat voortspruit uit provinsiale asook munisipale infrastruktuurbates; Verskaf ondersteuning ten opsigte van begrotingsbeplanning en finansiële bestuur: Dra by tot die voorbereiding van korttermyn- (1 jaar) en langertermyn- (2-5 jaar) begrotingsplanne; Ondersteun die monitering van besteding vir die doel van goeie fiskale verantwoordelikheid; Ondersteun die voorbereiding van gekonsolideerde finansiële verslae vir besluitnemingsassessering.
