zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yomphathi wamaphrojekthi ngokuphathelene namaphrojekthi nokuqaquliswa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi; cwebezela isiphakamiso samaphrojekthi emali ngokuphathelene namaphrojekthi; nikeza inkxaso yohlelo lomsebenzi lomphathi wezinhlelo namaphrojekthi nakuwo wonke umphathi ahlobene nezinhlelo; sincikezelele izinhlelo zokuthenga okuqukethwe kuzona izinto ezithunyelwayo namaphrojekthi okuhambisana nayo; sincikezelele imithetho yokumataniswa (Tor) nezinhlaka zokuqoqa izinto ezingamukelekanga; qapha abahlinzeki bezinsiza izinkomba ezithile namaphrojekthi alawula ukuze ahambisane nemibandela nokuqinisekiswa kwamaphrojekthi ahambisana nemibandela ekuchazwe kuyo; qapha futhi uhlole ukuthi amaphrojekthi asuke aphendula kanjani ukuze ahambisane nokuqoqwa kwephrojekthi ekuyiyona imigomo; chaza izinsongo zamaphrojekthi; siphe isixaziso kulezo zinsongo ezifakelwe emaphrojekthini ezezelwe izinsongo ezibangelwa ukusabela kwalezo zinsongo, zibe ngamathuba ahwebelayo nangaphandle kwalezo zinsongo kodwa angaphansi kwemigomo efakwa; sekela isimo sokuhlela ukuthathwa kwezigqibo eziqukethe inhlangothi eziningana ezithinteka emaphrojekthini: qoqa izinkomba ezitholakala kuyo nokuqoqwa kwalezo zinto ezibangelwa imigomo emaphrojekthi; hlela uhlu lwamaphrojekthi nezinsiza ezikwazi ukuthi zisebenze emaphrojekthini; zibeke ngokwesibonelo amaphrojekthi ohlelo lwemali.uthi oluzoba ngamaphrojekthi ahambisana nesakhiwo nezimphophomthakathi zomnyango eziqanjwe kumphathi wokuqala phansi; xhumanisa abantu abahleliweyo abathandwa nabanokubakho emaphrojekthini okuyiyona imigiqibo: buyisa futhi uqonde imigiqibo yemibuzo yamaphrojekthi ahleliweyo okubalulekileyo kuyo; hlela uhlu abafaki-maphrojekthi ahambisanayo nezingqinamba ngokuthi ngamaphrojekthi ezinhlelo zomsebenzi ahleliwe; sekela kwaye igcine ubudlelwano kwindalo ekudingwa ngamaphrojekthi; nikeza inkxaso komkhosi abavumi ukwenza imithetho efanayo namaphrojekthi; liyinkundla kwindawo abaluphathe kwaye benza imisebenzi, ngamaphrojekthi; zihleliweyo ngabasebenzisi bamaphrojekthi mayelana nemithetho ethize esuka kumaphrojekthi ahambisanayo; hlela kwaye uphawule imibuzo esuka kulandelayo; kubantu abasuka kunoma yikuphi ukudibana okukhululekileyo okuphathelene namaphrojekthi: cwangcisa futhi uphathwe imisebenzi esuka kwimibuzo nemiqondiso yokuthathwa kwemigiqibo nokuqoqwa kwemibuzo ekuyiyona iplani yokuqoqa imibuzo efunwa kwindawo apho kubalulekile khona namaphrojekthi ahambisana neplani yemisebenzi; thola imibuzo namaphrojekthi kwimizamo yokuphuhliswa ngokuhlangeneyo; kumda imisebenzi eguquguquka kulelo zinga eliphezulu kwaye uphathe amaphrojekthi athile kwindalo engafanele ukudibana namaphrojekthi angahlukileyo.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Cape Catalyst
xh.summary: Kufuneki kubekho uMncedisi woMlawuli winkqubo ye Cape Catalyst ukunika inkxaso yolawulo lweenqobo, ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zoxhaso lemali nokulawula iinkqubo zokuthena zeenqobo ezingaphezu kwamaphulo aphuhlisayo.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma ye-3 yiminyaka / i-B-Degree ngokufanelekileyo (izifundo ezilingana nale okungenam ndawo iphakamile); Ingcambu eyi-3 yamava okulawula okanye olawulo lweenqobo kwindawo ephuhliswa ngokwezanolozo. Ukuzikwazisa: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngoku landelayo: Iphuhliso loLawulo / Iphuhliso leNdawo; Ulawulo koluntu; Iinkqubo zomthetho nezabucala nengagqithiswanga namagqabantshintshi namacebo afanelekileyo; Ulawulo lweenqobo; Ulawulo lweziqu neziqu; Iindlela nezixhobo neendlela zokuphonononga nokuqikelela; Amaphefumlelwe alandelayo: Imininzi; Ulwazi lweekhompyutha; Ulimi; Ukwenza uphando; Ulungiselelo nokuhlelwa; Iindlela zokuxazulula iingxaki; Uphononongo; Amaphefumlelwe okunxibelelan a (okubhal a nokuva nangomlomo; Ukukhuthaza; Isetyhengiso; Ukuphonononga nokulingan isisa; Ulawulo lwaban n abathints hwa; Ulungiselelo lwenqobo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo lwenqobo malunga neenqobo neenkqobo ze nkqobe kwaye zivelise namacebo; Ndini se inkxaso yof isi lenqobo kwaye ndenze ukulawula njengoko kusoku kwenziwa nkqobe; Ndini se inkqobo ze nkqobe kwaye ndenze ukulawula njengoko kwenziwa eku setyenzisweni kwenqobo; Velisa iindlela ezisemthethweni ne zenkqobo kwaye ndenze ukulawula iinkqobo njengoko zisemthethweni; Qwalasela inkonzo ze nkonzi ze mikhwa ze nkqobo ukuba zihambisana namagqabantshintshi ne nkqobo; Qwalasela kwaye ulinganise inkqobo ze nkqobe ukuze uqiniseke ngokuhambahambisa iinjongo zen qobo; Qaphela iingozi zen qobo; Zisebenzise iindlela zokunciphisa iingozi kwaye ulawule iingxaki zentlobo ezinkqo thwa; Yiba ngamehlo kulawulo kwaye ndini se inkqobo zenkqobo; Yenzise ukuqokelelwa kolwazi kwaye ulinganise iindingedwa zen qobo; Qulunq e izibuko bolwazi nengcombolo; Zisebenzise izibuko ze nkqobo kwaye ulawule ulwazi kwi nkqo bo ze k ukwazisa; Nika isandla ekuphuhlisweni kweekhetho; Yonke le nto kufuneka igqitywe ngokusebenzisa iinjongo zoluntu nokuziphilisa kwelinye ilizwe.

jobs.title: Director: Financial Accounting
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), an all-inclusive salary package consists of a basic salary and the employer’s contribution to the Pension Fund. The remainder of the package may be structured according to your personal needs.
jobs.summary: Director of Financial Accounting for the Western Cape Education Department, responsible for departmental accounting policies, bank reconciliation and revenue management.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA. At least 5 years of experience at middle or senior management level. Successful completion of the Certificate for entry into Senior Management Service (SMS). Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge: Applicable legislative and regulatory framework. Principles and practice of financial accounting. Proven knowledge of financial statements. Tools and techniques for accounting and reporting. Government financial systems. Systems approach to solving problems. Change management and people skills. The ability to give clear direction in realising objectives and clear and concise communication. Leadership, team building and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy (Excel, Word and PowerPoint). Proficiency in at least two of the three official languages of the Western Cape.
jobs.duties: Act as Departmental Accountant for the Western Cape Education Department. Develop, implement, monitor and review departmental accounting policies, procedures and processes. Responsible for the reconciliation and management of the Departmental Bank Account. Manage own revenue policies, tariffs, systems and procedures. Perform month-end and year-end accounts closure process. Prepare the Quarterly and Annual Financial Statements and supporting working papers. Manage liabilities and commitments within budget constraints, including; recording, reconciliation and settlement. Monitor Departmental Asset and Liability accounts. Manage receivables due to the department, including; the recording, collection, banking and write-off of irrecoverable amounts. Responsible for Salary Administration and the pay-over of statutory deductions, i.e. tax, pensions, etc. Consolidate and reconcile payroll data and prepare statutory and other payroll returns. Maintain statutory and other required registers with supporting documents, including but not limited to registers of unauthorised, fruitless and wasteful and irregular expenditure and register of losses, damages and claims. Manage all audit responses including the Auditor- General, Internal Audit and Forensic Investigative Unit. Manage and maintain transversal financial systems. Identify staff capacity needs and ensure training interventions. Manage directorate’s budget in line with the strategic objectives of the Department. Provide strategic direction for Financial Administration within the Department.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted by using the following URL https://www.westerncape.gov.za/education via Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox.
jobs.notes: The applicants are advised to read the foreword available on the WCED website before applying for the post/s. Applications must be made via the department’s on-line E-Recruitment system. The on-line system will automatically generate a Curriculum Vitae; applicants are therefore required to ensure that their profiles are fully completed. Certified copies of Identity Document, Senior Certificate and the highest required qualification as well as a driver’s license where necessary, will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates to HR on or before the day of the interview date. All applicants must be SA Citizens/Permanent Residents or Non-SA Citizens with a valid work permit. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and competency assessments at a time, date and place as determined by Western Cape Education Department (WCED). The Department reserves the right to conduct pre-employment security screening and appointment is subject to positive security clearance outcome. Applicants must declare any/pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered post the interview the application will not be considered for the post and in the unlikely event that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Finansiële Rekenkunde
af.summary: Direkteur van Finansiële Rekenkunde vir die Western Cape Education Department, verantwoordelik vir departementele rekenkundige beleid, bankafstemming en inkomstebestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring op middel- of seniorbestuursvlak. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Service (SMS). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Toepaslike wetgewende en regulatoriese raamwerk. Beginsels en praktyk van finansiële rekenkunde. Bewese kennis van finansiële state. Gereedskap en tegnieke vir rekenkunde en verslagdoening. Regering se finansiële stelsels. Stelselbenadering tot die oplos van probleme. Veranderingsbestuur en mensevaardighede. Die vermoë om duidelike rigting te gee in die bereiking van doelwitte en duidelike en bondige kommunikasie. Leierskap, spanbou en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Excel, Word en PowerPoint). Vaardigheid in ten minste twee van die drie amptelike tale van die Western Cape.
af.duties: Tree op as Departementele Rekenmeester vir die Western Cape Education Department. Ontwikkel, implementeer, monitor en hersien departementele rekenkundige beleid, prosedures en prosesse. Verantwoordelik vir die afstemming en bestuur van die Departementele Bankrekening. Bestuur eie inkomstebeleide, tariewe, stelsels en prosedures. Voer die maandeinde en jaareinde rekeningsluitingsproses uit. Berei die Kwartaallikse en Jaarlikse Finansiële State en ondersteunende werksdokumente voor. Bestuur laste en verbintenisse binne begrotingsbeperkings, insluitend; opname, afstemming en skikking. Monitor Departementele Bate en Las rekeninge. Bestuur debiteure as gevolg van die departement, insluitend; die opname, invordering, bank en afskryf van onherwinbare bedrae. Verantwoordelik vir Salarisadministrasie en die oorbetaling van statutêre aftrekkings, d.w.s. belasting, pensioene, ens. Konsolideer en stem salarisdata af en berei statutêre en ander salarisopgawes voor. Handhaaf statutêre en ander vereiste registers met ondersteunende dokumente, insluitend maar nie beperk nie tot registers van ongemagtigde, ydelose en kwynende en onreëlmatige besteding en register van verliese, skade en eise. Bestuur alle ouditreaksies insluitend die Auditor- Generaal, Interne Oudit en Forensiese Ondersoekseenheid. Bestuur en handhaaf transversale finansiële stelsels. Identifiseer personeelkapasiteitsbehoeftes en verseker opleidingsintervensies. Bestuur die direktoraat se begroting in ooreenstemming met die strategiese doelwitte van die Departement. Verskaf strategiese rigting vir Finansiële Administrasie binne die Departement.

zu.title: Umlawuli: Ukubhala izimali zezezimali
zu.summary: Umphathi wokubhala izimali zezezimali kwi-Western Cape Education Department, ongumuntu ophethe izinqubomgomo zokubhala izimali zomnyango, ukuqinisekisa isibanki kanye nokuphathwa kwemali engenayo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwezinga le-NQF level 7 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Umkhulu wanga-5 usebenza ezingeni lokuphatha eliphakathi noma eliphezulu. Ukuqedela ngempumelelo izitifiketi zokungena ku-Senior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisensi yokuqamba ehambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi: Umthetho osetshenziswayo ohlobene nomthetho nemithesho. Imigomo kanye nokusebenza kokubhala izimali. Ulwazi olubonakaliswe ngezitatimende zezezimali. Amathuluzi namatekniki wokubhala izimali nokubika. Izinhlelo zezezimali kahulumeni. Indlela yezinhlelo yokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kokushintsha kanye namakhono abantu. Ikono lokunika isiqondiso esicacile ekufeni izinhloso kanye nokuqhuba ngokucacile futhi ngamafuphi. Amakhono okuhola, ukwakha iqembu kanye nobudlelwano nabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (Excel, Word kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ukuzithoba ukubaluleka okungenani ezilimi ezimbili zamagunyazi amathathu ase-Western Cape.
zu.duties: Ziba njengomabhala-mali womnyango kwi-Western Cape Education Department. Hakabisa, phumeza, qhaphe futhi ubuyekeze izinqubomgomo, izinqubo namapulani okubhala izimali womnyango. Qaphele ukuvumelanisa futhi uphathe i-akhawunti yasebhange lomnyango. Phatha izinqubomgomo zakho zemali engenayo, izimali ezibizwayo, izinhlelo nezinqubo. Qhuba inqubo yokuvala ama-akhawunti ekupheleni kwenyanga kanye nekwindla. Lungiselela izitatimende zezezimali ze-Kota kanye nezeMinyaka yonke namaphepha okusebenza awasekelayo. Phatha izikweletu nezibopho ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yesabelomali, okuhlanganisa; ukubhala, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana kanye nokuqedela izikweletu. Qaphelela ama-akhawunti wesithombe-mali kanye nezesikweletu somnyango. Phatha imali etholwe umnyango, okuhlanganisa; ukubhala, ukuqoqa, ukufaka kwebhange kanye nokususa imali egekeke kakhoneka. Qaphelele ukuphathwa kweholo kanye nokuqedela izinyathelo zomthetho ezikhishwa eholweni, njengesithulu, izimali zokukhuluphala, njll. Hlanganisa futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana kwemininingwane yamaholo ulungiselele izibuyekiso zomthetho kanye nezinye eziyimaholo. Gcina izibuyekezo zomthetho kanye nezinye ezidingekayo nezixhaswe amafayela, okuhlanganisa kodwa akugqamiseki izibuyekezo zokusebenzisa imali ngokungalungile, ukuchitha imali ngokungalungile kanye nokusebenzisa imali ngendlela engahambisana nomthetho kanye nesibuyekezo sezinto ezilahlekile, ezilimele kanye nezinkomba. Phatha zonke izimpendulo zokuhlola okuhlanganisa i-Auditor- General, i-Internal Audit kanye ne-Forensic Investigative Unit. Phatha futhi ugcine izinhlelo zezezimali eziphakanyiswayo. Hlola izidingo zomthamo wabasebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukufundiswa. Phatha isabelomali sedolobha ngokuhambisana nemigomo ebalulekile yomnyango. Nikeza isiqondiso esibalulekile sokuLawulwa kwezezimali ngaphakathi komnyango.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Isibalo seMali
xh.summary: Umlawuli weSibalo seMali kwiWestern Cape Education Department, unobulumko beengqobe zesibalo sesebe, ulungelelaniso lwebhanki kunye nolawulo lwemali ingeniswayo.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezisezantsi (NQF level 7) ezivunywe yiSAQA. Ubuncinane iiminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo lwaphakathi okanye eliphezulu. Ukuqhuba kakuhle iCertificate yokungena kwiSenior Management Service (SMS). Ilayisenesi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi lweNgqobe nezakhulo zomthetho ezifanelekileyo. Iimvisiswano kunye nenkqubo yesibalo semali. Ulwazi olubonwayo malunga nezitatimende zemali. Iixhoba neendlela zokusebenziswa zesibalo nokuchaza. Iinkqubo zemali zorhulumente. Indlela yeenkqubo zokusombulula iingxaki. Ulawulo lwezitshintsho nobugcisa bokusebenza nabantu. Ikono lokunika isalathiso esicacileyo ekuphothulweni iinjongo nokunxibelelana ngokucacileyo nangokufutshane. Amakhono obuqhawe, ukwakha iqela namakhono okunxibelelana nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Excel, Word and PowerPoint). Ukuziphatha kakuhle kubuncinane kweelwimi ezisemthethweni ezintathu zeWestern Cape.
xh.duties: Ukusebenza njengoMgqibi weSibalo sesebe kwiWestern Cape Education Department. Ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa, ukujonga nokuhlola iingqobe, iinkqubo neenkqubo zesibalo sesebe. Unobulumko kokulungelelanisa nolawulo lweAkhawunti yeBhanki yesebe. Ukulawula iingqobe zemali ingeniswayo, iindleko, iinkqubo neenkqubo zakho. Ukwenza inkqubo yokuvala iakhawunti ngenyanga ekupheleni kwanyanga nangomhla ekupheleni konyaka. Ukulungiselela iZitatimende zeMali zeKota kunye nezeNgqondo kunye namaphepha okusebenza axhasayo. Ukulawula amatyala nemizimisolo ngaphakathi kweemigangatho yesikhwendla, kuquka; ukubhala, ukulungelelanisa nokuhlawula. Ukujonga iAkhawunti zeMatyali naseMatyala zesebe. Ukulawula imali esifuneka ihlawulelwe isebе, kuquka; ukuyibhala, ukuyiqokelela, ukuyifaka kubhanki nokuyayeka imali engenakuzimbiwa. Unobulumko kwiLawulo loMvuzo nakuhlawulweni kwezinyuli ezisemthethweni, oko kukuthi irhafu, imiphefumlo, njl. Ukudibanisa nokulungelelanisa idatha yomvuzo nokulungiselela iinyuli zomthetho nezinye iziphango zomvuzo. Ukugcina iresidata ezisemthethweni nabezinye efunekayo namaxwebhu axhasayo, kuquka kodwa akugqityelwa kunesidata yokuqhuba ngaphandle kwesigqibo, yokuchitha ixesha ngaphandle kwenzuzo nengachanekanga yemali enkulu kunye neresidata yeziphelalo, zolonakolo nezicala. Ukulawula yonke imibuzo yokuphindayo kuquka i-Auditor- General, iNgqibo yangaphakathi neNyumba yoPhando. Ukulawula kwaye ugcine iinkqubo zemali ezingathunyelwayo. Ukumisela iimfuno zamandla abasebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukungenelela kolweso. Ukulawula isikhwendla sediredhale ngokulandelelana iinjongo ezibalulekileyo zesebe. Ukunika isalathiso esibalulekileyo kwiLawulo leMali ngaphakathi kwisebe.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (OBSTETRICS and
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology sought for Paarl Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration, to deliver specialist obstetric and gynaecological clinical services across Grades 1 to 3.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Inherent requirement of the job: The successful candidate will be required to engage in the remunerated commuted overtime system and participate in the after-hours call system. Participation in the termination of pregnancy services. Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license, willingness, and ability to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): A proven ability to perform basic gynaecological and obstetric ultrasounds is needed. The candidate must have an excellent track record of clinical, research and educational skills. Clinical experience with high- risk obstetrics, gynaecological surgery, and ultrasound is required. The ability to achieve and maintain good interpersonal relations with staff, patients, and their families is essential. Clinical notes and referral writing skills must be of a high standard. Verbal and written communication skills as well as analytical and problem-solving skills must be exemplary. Experience with teamwork, planning, organisation and co-ordination of the safe management of a labour ward is indispensable. Computer literacy in the use of MS Word and Excel, as well as the ability to use online resources, is required.
jobs.duties: Ensure the delivery of a safe, efficient, patient-centred, high-quality and cost- effective clinical service that addresses the burden of disease within the Rural West Health Ecosystem by providing comprehensive specialist obstetric and gynaecological services, including the independent and safe performance of major and minor gynaecological surgical procedures. Managing high-risk obstetric patients and specialist gynaecology outpatient clinics, ensuring evidence-based assessment, appropriate management, and continuity of care. Performing and supervising complex obstetric procedures, including assisted vaginal deliveries, breech deliveries, postpartum sterilisations, and complicated caesarean sections. Performing and interpreting obstetric and gynaecological ultrasound examinations and providing clinical supervision and training to junior medical staff in ultrasound practice. Providing clinical leadership, supervision, teaching, mentoring and skills development to medical officers, registrars, interns, and other healthcare professionals to promote high standards of clinical practice. -Ensuring the maintenance of accurate, comprehensive and high-quality clinical records in accordance with legal, ethical and departmental requirements. Complying with all applicable administrative policies, legislation, protocols and prescripts of the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Promoting effective and efficient utilisation of human, financial and material resources to support sound financial management and service sustainability. Participating in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, in-service training, continuous professional development, clinical governance, and quality improvement initiatives. Contributing to the development, review and implementation of clinical guidelines, protocols and standard operating procedures. Participating in specialist outreach services to district hospitals within the Rural West Health Ecosystem to strengthen service delivery, clinical support and capacity building. Participating fully in the provision of termination of pregnancy services in accordance with applicable legislation, ethical standards and departmental policies.
jobs.enquiries: Dr H Le Riche, email: Heloise.LeRiche@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for registration for the first time in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (VERLOSKUNDE en
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie gesoek vir Paarl Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, om spesialiste verloskundige en ginekologiese kliniese dienste oor Grade 1 tot 3 te lewer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Inherent vereiste van die werk: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verlang word om deel te neem aan die vergoede pendel-oortydstelsel en om deel te neem aan die buite-ure oproepstelsel. Deelname aan die dienste vir swangerskapafbreking. Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie, bereidwilligheid en vermoë om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): 'n Bewese vermoë om basiese ginekologiese en verloskundige ultraklank uit te voer, word vereis. Die kandidaat moet 'n uitstekende rekord van kliniese, navorsings- en opvoedkundige vaardighede hê. Kliniese ervaring met hoërisiko-verloskunde, ginekologiese chirurgie en ultraklank word vereis. Die vermoë om goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings met personeel, pasiënte en hul gesinne te bereik en te handhaaf, is noodsaaklik. Kliniese notas en verwysingskryfvaardighede moet van 'n hoë standaard wees. Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede asook analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede moet voorbeeldig wees. Ervaring met spanwerk, beplanning, organisasie en koördinering van die veilige bestuur van 'n kraamsaal is onontbeerlik. Rekenaarvaardigheid in die gebruik van MS Word en Excel, asook die vermoë om aanlyn hulpbronne te gebruik, word vereis.
af.duties: verseker die lewering van 'n veilige, doeltreffende, pasiëngerigte, hoëgehalte- en kostedoeltreffende kliniese diens wat die siektelasting binne die Rural West Health Ecosystem aanspreek deur omvattende spesialiste verloskundige en ginekologiese dienste te verskaf, insluitend die onafhanklike en veilige uitvoering van hoof- en klein ginekologiese chirurgiese prosedures. Bestuur van hoërisiko-verloskundige pasiënte en spesialiste ginekologie-uitpasiëntklinieke, om verseker word dat daar getuienisgebaseerde assessering, toepaslike bestuur en deurlopendheid van sorg is. Uitvoer en toesig hou oor komplekse verloskundige prosedures, insluitend geassisteerde vaginale afleverings, stuitafleverings, postpartum-sterilisasies en ingewikkelde keisersne-e. Uitvoer en interpreteer van verloskundige en ginekologiese ultraklankondersoeke en verskaf van kliniese toesig en opleiding aan junior mediese personeel in ultraklankpraktyk. Verskaf van kliniese leierskap, toesig, onderrig, mentorskap en vaardigheidsontwikkeling aan mediese beamptes, registrateurs, internes en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionele om hoë standaarde van kliniese praktyk te bevorder. -Verseker die handhawing van akkurate, omvattende en hoëgehalte kliniese rekords in ooreenstemming met wetlike, etiese en departementele vereistes. Voldoen aan alle toepaslike administratiewe beleide, wetgewing, protokolle en voorskifte van die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Bevorder van effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van menslike, finansiële en materiële hulpbronne om gesonde finansiële bestuur en diensvolhoubaarheid te ondersteun. Neem deel aan voor- en nagraadse onderrig, in-diens opleiding, deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling, kliniese bestuur en gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Bydrae tot die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van kliniese riglyne, protokolle en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Neem deel aan spesialis-uitreikdienste na distrikshospitale binne die Rural West Health Ecosystem om dienslewering, kliniese ondersteuning en kapasiteitsbou te versterk. Neem volledig deel aan die verskaffing van swangerskapafbrekingsdienste in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing, etiese standaarde en departementele beleide.

zu.title: Uchwenjane Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (OBSTETRICS ne)
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhulu sezokwelapha esizimele ngokweso ngokwamazwi e-Obstetrics and Gynaecology efuna ibhedlela i-Paarl, esidinga ukuqinisekiswa i-HPCSA, ukuze sinikeze izinkonzo ezihlukene ngokwamakhono okubeletha nezobuchachasi kumaGrades 1 kuye ku-3.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Iziqu ezifaneleko ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulu ezokubeletha nezobuchachasi. Ukuqinisekiswa kumkhulu wabachwepheshe: Ukuqinisekiswa ngokubhalwa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha kwezokubeletha nezobuchachasi. Isipiliyoni: IGrade 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhalwa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha kwezokubeletha nezobuchachasi. IGrade 2: Ukuze kube khona iminyaka eyi-5 ngaphezulu yesipiliyoni esifanelekile njengesikhulu sezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalwa ku-HPCSA (kumeya wesikhulu esikhethwe kunamaMkhulu wobuchwepheshe bepilwana bangaphandle) njengesikhulu sezokwelapha kwezokubeletha nezobuchachasi. IGrade 3: Ukuze kube khona iminyaka eyi-10 ngenhla yesipiliyoni esifanelekile njengesikhulu sezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalwa ku-HPCSA (kumeya wesikhulu esikhethwe kunamaMkhulu wobuchwepheshe bepilwana bangaphandle) njengesikhulu sezokwelapha kwezokubeletha nezobuchachasi. Isidingo esingokoqobo somsebenzi: Umphakethi ophumelelayo uzodingeka ukuba angene esimeni sokusebenza amahora amaningi okuhluzwa ngokwemali kanye nokubamba iqhaza esimeni sokubiza ngemva kwamahora. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphetheni imisebenzi yokuqeda isikhathi eside sokukhulelwa. Isivumelwano se-(Code B/EB) sokushayela, isifiso nengxenye yokuhamba. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Kudingeka ubuso obungayibona ngokusobala bokwenza isidlidlileko sezobuchachasi nezokubeletha ngesuntshoko. Umphakethi kumele abe nerekhodi elihle kakhulu lamakhono okwelapha, ukutadisha nokufundisa. Kudingeka isipiliyoni sokwelapha kwezokubeletha ezinengozolo efinyelelekile, inkqubo yokuqhuba izokwelapha, nokuqhathanisa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Isikhundla sokufuna futhi sigcine ubuhlobo obuhle kwabasebenzi, abaguli, kubaphathi babo, kubalulekile. Amawofi emiholiding kanye namakhono okubhala ngokokuqondisa aze abe nzinga eliphezulu. Amakhono okucabangela nokuxazulula izinkinga kumele abe nomhlaba obovu kabi. Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala kanye namakhono okuhlaziya nokusombulula izinkinga kumele abe khona ngaphezulu. Isipiliyoni sokusebenza njengoti, ukuleta, ukwakha kanye nokuhlanganisa ekuphatweni okuphepha kwikhayini lokubeletha akudingekiwe. Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa i-MS Word ne-Excel, kanye namakhono okusebenzisa izinto ezikhona kwi-inthanethi, kudingeka.
zu.duties: Qinisekula ukulethwa kwesevisi yezokwelapha ephephile, esebenzayo, egxile kumuntu ogulayo, ekuality ephezulu futhi enentengo efaneleko ehlanganisa isikhundla sesifo phakathi kwe-Rural West Health Ecosystem ngokuhlinzka ngezinkonzo eziguquguqukayo zezokubelethiswa nezobuchachasi obuzimisele, okubandakanya ukwenza ngokuzimela nangokuphepha izinqubo ezenzwa ngokuhlinzwa kwezobuchachasi ezinkulu nancane. Ukuphatha abaguli ababekezela kakhulu ezinkulungwaneni zokubeletha kanye namakliniki angaphandle abukeka ngabachwepheshe bezobuchachasi, eqinisekisa ukuhlolwa okusekelwe ubufakazi, ukuphathwa okufanele, nokuhlala kunakekelwa. Ukwenza futhi uqaphe izinqubo eziyinkimbinkimbi zokubeletha, okubandakanya ukubelethwa okusizwa ngasesithweni, ukubeletha ngobumbu, ukuvalelwa ngemva kokubeletha, nezinqubo zokuqeqeshwa ngokudayisa eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ukwenza futhi uhumushe ukuhlolwa kwangaphakathi ngesandi ezokubeletha nezobuchachasi, futhi unikeze ukugcina phansi kokwesikhashana nokuqeqesha abasebenzi bezokwelapha abasha kwenza izinhlelo zokuhlolwa kwesandi. Ukunikeza ubuqhawe bezokwelapha, ukugcina phansi, ukufundisa, ukuletha isifiso nentuthuko yamakhono kubaphathi bezokwelapha, kubarejista, kubafundi abenza isikhundla esikhethwe kubanye, nakwezinye izinkampani zezokwelapha ukukhuthaza izinga eliphezulu lenkqubo yokwelapha. Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokugcina okubhaliwe okuhlakaniphile, okugqamile kakhulu futhi onekhwalithi ephezulu ngesikhathi sokugcinwa kwezokwelapha, ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho, zokuziphatha kanye nomnyango. Ukuzinza ngazo zonke izinqubo eziyimithetho noma imiyalelo yokuphatha, umthetho, amaphrothokholi kanye nemiyalelo yomnyango we-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nokuhamba kahle kolwazi, imali, nezinsiza ezintlinti ukusekela ukuphathwa kuhle kwezimali nokuthula kwesevisi. Ukubamba iqhaza ekufundiseni abafundi abangenayo nabaphothula isikhathi eside, ekugqamiseni izinga lokusebenza, ekuqhubekeni nentuthuko yamakhono, ekubukeni amakhadi wezokwelapha, nasemigubhasini wokuthuthukiswa. Ukufaka isandla ekwakheni, ekubukeni futhi ekusetshenziseni imigomo yezokwelapha, amaphrothokholi, kanye nezinqubo ezimiso. Ukubamba iqhaza kwezinsiza zokwelula izandla ezingabachwepheshe ezibhedlela ezitholakala kulo mmeboni we-Rural West Health Ecosystem ukuqinisa ukulethwa kwesevisi, ukwesekwa ngokwelapha nokuqinisa amandla. Ukubamba ngokuphelela iqhaza ekunikeni izinkonzo zokuphetha isikhathi eside sokubeletha ngokuvumelana nomthetho ongakwaziyo, izinga lokuziphatha kanye nemigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: Ispecialista yezorhwebo ezingangeni inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (OBSTETRICS and
xh.summary: Kufunwa ispecialista yolugundo lolwazi lokuzala nokolunyango lwamadoda i-Obstetrics and Gynaecology kwi-Spitala yasePaarl, edinga ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA, ukunika iinkonzo zorhwebo ezichanekileyo zokuzala nolunyango lwamadoda kumanqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ubhaliso kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengespecialista kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Ubhaliso kolunge lwezonyanga: Ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengespecialista yezonyanga kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengespecialista yezonyanga kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengespecialista yezonyanga emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA (okanye kolunge lwamanye amazwe oluvunyiweyo lwamagosa ezonyanga malunga nogqabo oqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazima) njengespecialista yezonyanga kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengespecialista yezonyanga emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA (okanye kolunge lwamanye amazwe oluvunyiweyo lwamagosa ezonyanga malunga nogqabo oqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazima) njengespecialista yezonyanga kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Iimfuno ezibalulekileyo somsebenzi: Umphathi opumelelayo uya kudingwa ukuba athathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo ezihlawulwayo nasekubeni kwinkqubo yokubizwa emva kweeyure zomsebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkonzo zokuphela kokukhulelwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) eseleyo, inkathalo noku kukwazi ukuhamba. Iimpawu zokwazi (ulwazi/isebe): Kudingeka kukwazi ukwenza izifundo ezingundoqo zolunyango lwamadoda nolwazi lokuzala. Umphathi makabe nerekhodi elilungileyo lesebe, lolwazi lwophando nolophico lokufundisa. Kudingeka abe namava okusebenza ngobuchule kwi-obstetrics ebangego inzondo, unyango lwamadoda ngolwangelo, nolwazi lokubona ngaphakathi olwaziwo. Ukwazi ukuze uze ugcine ubuhlobo obuhle nabasebenzi, nabaguli, nabo bentsapho babo ngokomntu ngamnye yinto ebalulekileyo. Amaxesha okuqaqamba ngolweyo lwezonyanga nolwazi lokubhala okuya kubakho kumagosa kufuneka abe ngowona mgangatho ophezulu. Amakhono okunxibelelwana ngomlomo nakubhalwa njengoko nakwakhono okuhlalutyo nokusombulula iingxaki kufuneka abe ngowona mgangatho ophezulu. Amava wokusebenza njengesiqhaga, iplani, uyilo nolungelelanisa lolawulo olukhuselekileyo lwegumbi lokubeletha luyinto ekerkeleyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha ekusebenziseni i-MS Word ne-Excel, nakukwazi ukusebenzisa iinkonzo ezikwi-intanethi, kudingeka.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwenkonzo yorhwebo ekhuselekileyo, esebenzayo, egxile kumguli, ebangasinye samagqabantungathu kwaye iguqulela ngeemali ekuwohlo kwi-Rural West Health Ecosystem ngokunikwa iinkonzo ezibanzi ezingorhwebo zokuzala nolunyango lwamadoda, kuquka ukuzenzela ngodidi ngokukhuselekileyo iindlela zolunyango oluzinzileyo noluncinci zolwangelo lwamadoda. Ukuqamba abaguli ababengo inzondo yokuzala kunye neekliniki zabaguli bezorhwebo iyaqatshelwa, kuqinisekiswa ukulandelelana kolwazi, ulawulo olufanelekileyo, nakuqhubeka kokunyanga. Ukwenza nokuqhuba iindlela zorhwebo ezibangainzondo, kuquka nokulekela ukuzala ngeendlela ezincedwayo, ukuzala ngokubetha, i-sterilisations emva kokuzala, kunye neesection ezingqukuva. Ukwenza nokutolika iindlela zokuzala nolunyango lwamadoda zokubona ngaphakathi nokuqaqamba ulwazi lokusika kumacandolo abasebenzi bezonyanga abasese ngokolwazi lokusebenzisa iultrasound. Ukunika isikhokelo solwazi, ulawulo, ukufundisa, ukukhuthaza nophuhliso lwamakhono kubagosa bezonyanga, oomagistrata, iintanga, nabo bonke oogqirha bezonyanga ukukhuthaza iimpawu ezibalulekileyo zolwazi lorhwebo. -Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kolwazi oluchanekileyo, olubanzi nolubangasinye samagqabantungathu kumagosa ngokwemigaqo yomthetho, komoya nesebe nemiqathango ka-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Ukuhambelana nayo onke amagqabantungathu olawulo, omthetho, iinkqubo nemiqathango ka-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisa abantu, iimali nezixhobo ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle ukuxhasa ulawulo oluhle lweemali nokuza kusebenza ngenkonzo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni abangenayo nakuba bengenayo, ekufundiseni ngexesha lomsebenzi, ukuphuhlisa ulwazi ngokuphila, urhulumente wolwazi nokuphucula iimpawu. Ukunegalelo ekuphuhliseni, ukuphononceda nokusebenzisa iinkqubo, iinkqubo nemiqathabo yokusebenza eqhelekileyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkonzo yamagosa ngokuhamba kwiisibhedlele zeziqanga ngaphakathi kwe-Rural West Health Ecosystem ukuqinisa ukunikwa kwenkonzo, uxhaso ngokulwazi nokuzaqathanwa. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokupheleleyo ekunikweni kwezinkonzo zokuphela kokukhulelwa ngokuhambelana nomthetho, namagqabantungathu esiko namagqabantungathu esebe.

jobs.title: Manager: Pharmaceutical Services
jobs.salary_text: R1 375 245 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs).
jobs.summary: Manage pharmaceutical services and provide strategic leadership for pharmacy operations in the Khayelitsha Eastern sub-structure of the Western Cape Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic qualification accredited with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) that allows registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Pharmacy Council as a Pharmacist. Experience: A minimum of 3 years’ appropriate experience after registration as a Pharmacist with the SAPC. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Willingness to travel in the Metro. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Strong leadership, inclusive of management, professional mentorship, organisation and strategic planning. Project management skills. Computer Literacy and data use and analysis. Appropriate experience in Pharmaceutical systems used in the public sector. Appropriate supervisory/managerial experience. Appropriate Training and experience in Drug Supply Management.
jobs.duties: Strategic planning and implementation and monitoring and evaluation of relevant policies. Technical support to the pharmacy staff and pharmacy for quality assurance and clinical services governance. Overall leadership and coordination of the Pharmacy services within the Khayelitsha/ Eastern Sub- structure. Ensure good Pharmacy practices are institutionalised in the service platform. In-depth knowledge of the Health Act, National Drug Policy, Pharmacy Act, World Health Organisation and relevant policies of the WCG: Health and Wellness.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Bestuurder: Farmaseutiese Dienste
af.summary: Bestuur farmaseutiese dienste en verskaf strategiese leierskap vir apteekbedrywighede in die Khayelitsha Oostelike sub-struktuur van die Western Cape Department of Health.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) wat registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Apoteker moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die South African Pharmacy Council as 'n Apoteker. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Apoteker by die SAPC. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om in die Metro te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Sterk leierskap, insluitend bestuur, professionele mentorskap, organisasie en strategiese beplanning. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid en data-gebruik en -analise. Toepaslike ervaring in Farmaseutiese stelsels wat in die openbare sektor gebruik word. Toepaslike toesighoudende/bestuurservaring. Toepaslike opleiding en ervaring in Drug Supply Management.
af.duties: Strategiese beplanning en implementering en monitering en evaluering van relevante beleide. Tegniese ondersteuning aan die apteekpersoneel en apteek vir gehaltversekering en kliniese dienste-besture. Algehele leierskap en koördinering van die apteekdienste binne die Khayelitsha/ Eastern Sub- structure. Verseker goeie apteekpraktyke word in die diensplatform geïnstitusionaliseer. Diepgaande kennis van die Health Act, National Drug Policy, Pharmacy Act, World Health Organisation en relevante beleide van die WCG: Health and Wellness.

zu.title: Umphathi: Amasevisi Ezezokwelapha
zu.summary: Phatha amasevisi ezezokwelapha futhi nikeza ubuholo bokuhlelela imisebenzi yethiya eKhayelitsha Eastern sub-structure eKwisikhungo Sempilo saseWestern Cape.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okuncane: Isidingo esisisiseko esiqinisekiswe yiSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) esivumela ukubhalisa kuSAPC njengoGqithiwezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kubhodi yezobungcali: Ukubhalisa kuSouth African Pharmacy Council njengoGqithiwezokwelapha. Isipiliyangi: Okuncane iminyaka engu-3 yisipiliyangi esifanele ngemva kokubhalisa njengoGqithiwezokwelapha kuSAPC. Izidingo ezingaphakathi kwesikhundla: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (Code B/EB). Inkululeko okuthanda ukuhamba kulo iMetro. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ubuholo obunamandla, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha, ukweseka izobungcali, ukuhlelela nokuhlelela ngokuhlele. Amakhono okuphatha amaphulo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokusebenzisa nokuhlaziya idatha. Isipiliyangi esifanele kumasistimu ezezokwelapha asetshenziswa kwilungelo lomphakathi. Isipiliyangi esifanele sokuba ngumphathi/abaphathi. Ukufundiswa okufanele nesisipiliyangi ekuqondweni nokuphathwa kwezamakhaya.
zu.duties: Ukuhlelela ngokuhlele nokuphumeza nokubuka nokuhlola izinqubomgomo ezifanele. Ukusekela ngokobuchwepheshe basebenzi bathiya kanye nethiya ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga futhi kuqhutshwe izisebenzi zokwelapha. Ubuholo obubanzi nobuhlelela amasevisi Etheya phakathi kweKhayelitsha/ Eastern Sub-structure. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindlela ezinhle zokuThiya zisetshenziswa ngokusesilinganisweni enkundleni yamasevisi. Ulwazi olunjengobunzulu ngoMthetho Wezempilo, iNational Drug Policy, iPharmacy Act, iWorld Health Organisation kanye nezinqubomgomo ezifanele zeWCG: Health and Wellness.

xh.title: Umphathi: Iinkonzo zezeMithi
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zezemithi kwaye uze nikeze inkokeli ephuhlisayo kwinkqubo yemisebenzi yethubhu kwisiqhingi saseKhayelitsha saseMzantsi kwiSebe lezeMpilo loMmandla weNtshona Koloni.
xh.requirements: Iminikelo yemfundo evamileyo: Iminikelo yemfundo esemgangathweni evunyiweyo yiSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) enika igunya lokubhalisa kwiSAPC njengogqirha wezemithi. Ukubhalisa koluntu lweemvumelwano: Ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Pharmacy Council njengogqirha wezemithi. Iimpaphezocwangciso: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wezemithi kwiSAPC. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zendlela: Ilayisenisi eliyilwayo (Code B/EB) yokuqhuba. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kulo lonke iMetro. Amakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba nguqamba-gqo ekubeni nkokeli, kuquka kulawulo, ukukhokela ngobuchwepheshe, ukuqamba ngendlela kunye necwangciso eliphuhlisayo. Izakhono zolawulo lweeprojekthi. Ukubhaliswa kwabakompyutha nokusetyenziswa nokuphonononga idatha. Amanqanaba afanelekileyo eenkqabeni zezeMithi ezisetyenziswa kwicala lolawulo. Amanqanaba afanelekileyo obukhosi bobukhosi-mphathi. Uqeqesho namava afanelekileyo kulawulo loHambiso lweziYobosi.
xh.duties: Ucwangciso oluphuhlisayo nolusebenzisayo kunye nokuqwalasela nokuhlonitshwa kwemigaqo ephathwayo. Inkxaso yobugcisa kuquba abasebenzi bethubhu lemithi nakwithubhu lemithi ukuqinisekisa imigangatho nolawulo lweenkonzo zonyango. Ukuba ngumanyano weenkokeli nakwilungiselelo lweenkonzo zeThubhu leMithi ngaphakathi kwisebe saseKhayelitsha/ saseMzantsi. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba iziqendu ezilungileyo zokwenza ngemithi zifakwe kwindalo yenkqubo yeenkonzo. Ulwazi oluthe nkqo lweMigaqo yezeMpilo, iNqumammina-migaqo yeZiyobosi yasezweni, iMigaqo yeThubhu leMithi, iWorld Health Organisation namagama aphathwayo alawulwa yiWCG: izeMpilo neMfihlo.

zu.summary: Umkhulu Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 kwezokwelapha izifo eziphuthumayo e-Victoria Hospital, Western Cape, edinga ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha.

Ukubhaliswa kwiholo lezobungcweti: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha. Isiphephelo: Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanele njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-11 yamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhaliswa njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Holho Lezobungcweti Bezempilo Elaziwayo Lomzabo mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo kwezinye izwe, labo abangingadingi ukwenza Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhaliswa njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka olulanda yamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhaliswa njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Holho Lezobungcweti Bezempilo Elaziwayo Lomzabo mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo kwezinye izwe, labo abangingadingi ukwenza Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yamava afanele njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-6 yamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhaliswa njenge-Dokotela Wezokwelapha kwi-Holho Lezempilo Lomzabo Elaziwayo mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe izifundo kwezinye izwe, labo abangingadingi ukwenza Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibangelwa yisikhundla: Ilayisense yokuqamba evumelekile (Code B/EB). Isitifiketi se-Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS), ne-Advanced Paediatric Life Support (APLS/PALS). Amandla (ulwazi/iziqondiso): Amava ezokwelapha kanye nokuziqamba ekwelapheni Izifo Eziphuthumayo. Amandla okuxhumana aphezulu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo kugqo olubumbene lwemisebenzi eluhlukahlukene nokuxhumana ngobungcweti nabasebenzi kumazinga onke ohlelweni. Ukwethembeka ekufundiseni, ekweliseni, nakuthuthukiseni umsebenzi wezemfundo ekwelapheni Izifo Eziphuthumayo. Amandla okwenza izinqumo ezilula ezokwelapha kanye nohlangothi olubalulekile ezindaweni ezinobungozi. Isitifiketi se-Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS).
zu.duties: Nika imphatha ephelele ezokwelapha yawo wonke amaguli afika eNyuvesi Yesimo Esiphuthumayo, okuhlanganisa abasanda kuzalwa, izingane, abasha, nabadala. Hlola, qinisa, susa isimo sobunzima, uphathe abaguli abagula kabi futhi abalimele. Qapha, uxase, futhi ufundise abafundi abangakathathi iziqu, abafundi bezokwelapha abasakwamakhono, abaholi besebenzo lomphakathi, nezinkulu ezempilo ezisebenza eNyuvesi Yesimo Esiphuthumayo. Ukuba mbathathi kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni iziqu ngokuqhubeka, kumagalelo okuthuthukisa izinga, kumasebenzi okulawula izokwelapha, nakuhlelweni lwezemfundo. Thatha inxaxhebe ohlelweni lwebanga elingaphezulu lolweminyango njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza inkxaso ezokwelapha kwezinye izingxenye zesibhedlela lapho kudingeka ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zokuletha inkonzo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Provide clinical care to outpatients and emergency clients at Vanguard CHC in the Southern/Western Sub-structure, including chronic, HIV, TB and women's health services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA-qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign-qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA- qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign-qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA-qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign- qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: A Valid driver’s licence. Willingness to work within the Geographical area at various facilities. Willingness to perform Commuted overtime at the geographical 24-hour facilities as well as ability to work after-hours. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and management of general medical and surgical conditions as well as emergency conditions at a PHC level. Experience working at a Primary Care level after community service. Knowledge applicable to South African TB and HIV care guidelines, mental health care and other chronic diseases, woman and child health care and management of emergencies and acute presentations. Comprehensive, evidence based, direct patient-centered clinical service provision at a primary care level. Computer literacy (MS Excel, Word, Outlook etc.) and good interpersonal, organizational and teamwork skills. Ability and willingness to perform outreach services within the Southern Western substructure and to provide support and guidance to junior colleagues and nurses.
jobs.duties: Provide quality clinical care to outpatients and emergency clients presenting at primary care facilities in Southern Western Substructure. This includes chronic care, HIV and TB, woman and child health, undifferentiated clients and emergencies. Participate in skills transfer and training and development activities. Active involvement in clinical governance activities at the facility and in the substructure. Leadership and management at facility level.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/written or oral assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Mediese Offisier Graad 1 tot 3
af.summary: Verskaf kliniese sorg aan buitepasiënte en noodgevalle by Vanguard CHC in die Suidelike/Westelike Substruktuur, insluitend chroniese, HIV-, TB- en vrouegesondheidsdienste.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om gemeenskapsdiens soos in South Africa vereis te verrig nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om gemeenskapsdiens soos in South Africa vereis te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om gemeenskapsdiens soos in South Africa vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om binne die geografiese gebied by verskeie fasiliteite te werk. Bereidwilligheid om Wisselende oortyd by die geografiese 24-uur fasiliteite te verrig asook die vermoë om na ure te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en bestuur van algemene mediese en chirurgiese toestande asook noodtoestande op 'n PHC-vlak. Ervaring in werk op 'n Primêresorgvlak na gemeenskapsdiens. Kennis toepaslik op South Africa se TB- en HIV-sorgriglyne, geestesgesondheidsorg en ander chroniese siektes, vrou- en kindgesondheidsorg en bestuur van noodgevalle en akute aanbiedings. Omvattende, bewysgebaseerde, direkte pasiëntgesentreerde kliniese diensverskaffing op 'n primêresorgvlak. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Excel, Word, Outlook ens.) en goeie interpersoonlike, organisatoriese en spanwerkvaardighede. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om uitreikdienste binne die Suidelike Westelike substruktuur te verrig en om steun en leiding aan junior kollegas en verpleegkundiges te bied.
af.duties: Verskaf gehalte kliniese sorg aan buitepasiënte en noodgevalle wat by primêresorgfasiliteite in die Suidelike Westelike Substruktuur aanbied. Dit sluit chroniese sorg, HIV en TB, vrou- en kindgesondheid, ongedifferensieerde kliënte en noodgevalle in. Neem deel aan vaardigheidsoordrag en opleidings- en ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite. Aktiewe betrokkenheid by kliniese bestuursaktiwiteite by die fasiliteit en in die substruktuur. Leierskap en bestuur op fasiliteitsvlak.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Wezokwelapha izinga 1 kusiya kwelinga 3
zu.summary: Unikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha ezibambekayo kubafundi baphuma bengena esibhedlela nabakliyenti abadinga usizo oluphuthumayo e-Vanguard CHC kwisakhiwo esingaphansi esiseNingizimu/Ntshonalanga, okuhlanganisa izinsizakalo ezingapheli zezifo ezingajijeki, i-HIV, i-TB nempilo yabesifazane.
zu.requirements: Imininingwane yemfundo edingekayo: Isimfundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha. Ukwethweswa kakhona esikoleni: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingeko emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abavela eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka oyedwa wobunikelo bokuqatha emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA esamukelekwe mayelana nabasebenzi abavela kunamanye amazwe, abangingadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yokusetbenziswa okufanele njengomunyazi wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abavela eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-6 yomnikelo bokuqatha emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA esamukelekwe mayelana nabasebenzi abavela kunamanye amazwe, abangingadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yokusetbenziswa okufanele njengomunyazi wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abavela eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-11 yomnikelo bokuqatha emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA esamukelekwe mayelana nabasebenzi abavela kunamanye amazwe, abangingadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingeyimoto yalolu msebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuthanda ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwendawo ejejwayelekile ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukuthanda ukwenza isikhathi esingejwayelekile sokusebenza endaweni ejejwayelekile yamahora angu-24 kanye nokuba nokwazi ukusebenza ngemva kwamahora. Amandla (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi nolawulo lwezifo ezingajijeki zezezulwini nezokwelapha kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo ezingeni le-PHC. Isipiliyoni sokusebenza ezingeni lokunakekelwa kwasekhaya emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi oluhambisana nemihlahlandlela eNingizimu Afrika yezokunakekela i-TB ne-HIV, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo nezinye izifo ezingajijeki, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo yomuntu nosana nokulawula izimo eziphuthumayo nezibonakalayo. Unikeza izinsizakalo ezibandakanya ukwelapha ngqo komuntu ngamunye ezingeni lokunakekelwa kwasekhaya. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Excel, Word, Outlook njll.) nokuba nezakhono ezinhle zokuxhumanisa nabantu, zokuhlela kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu. Ikhono nokuqinisekela ukwenza izinsizakazo zokufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esiseNingizimu Ntshonalanga kanye nokunikeza inkokhelo nokuqondisa ozakwabo abancane kanye nezinja zokwelapha.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngabanikela ngokwelapha abangangabambekile abafike ezindaweni zokunakekelwa kwasekhaya eSakhiweni esiseNingizimu Ntshonalanga. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwezifo ezingajijeki, i-HIV ne-TB, impilo yomuntu nosana, abakliyenti abangaqondakaliyo nezimo eziphuthumayo. Bamba iqhaza ekudlulisweni kwezakhono kanye nokuthuthukisa izinkalo. Ukubandakanyeka okusebenzayo ezimeni zokuphathwa kwezokwelapha esikhungweni nakwisakhiwo esingaphansi. Ukubusa nokulawula ezingeni lesikhungo.

xh.title: Isebe lezonyango inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Yeza unyango lwezempilo kubaguli abangabhalisiweyo nakubakwizingxwabo ezibalekayo eVanguard CHC kwisebe elingaphantsi leSouthern/Western, kuquka iinkonzo ezingahoyiyo nge-HIV, i-TB kunye neempilo zabasetyhini.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zomgangatho wemfundo: Ifundo efanelekileyo evumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomganga wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwikhaladi yabasebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengomganga wezempilo. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuneko yamava emva kokubhalisa njengomganga wezempilo kwiHPCSA malunga nbasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eMzantsi Afrika. Unyaka omnye wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomganga wezempilo kwiKhaladi yamagosa ezempilo yamanye amazanga emigaqo ekwamkelekileyo malunga nbasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekwa eMzantsi Afrika. Inqanaba 2: Amava afanelekileyo angezantsi kweminyaka eli-5 njengomganga wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengomganga wezempilo malunga nbasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eMzantsi Afrika. Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-6 emva kokubhalisa njengomganga wezempilo kwiKhaladi yamagosa ezempilo yamanye amazanga ekwamkelekileyo malunga nbasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekwa eMzantsi Afrika. Inqanaba 3: Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-10 njengomganga wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengomganga wezempilo malunga nbasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eMzantsi Afrika. Amava afanelekileyo angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-11 emva kokubhalisa njengomganga wezempilo kwiKhaladi yamagosa ezempilo yamanye amazanga ekwamkelekileyo malunga nbasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekwa eMzantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezingeyilo msebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela eseleyo. Ulwelo lokusebenza kulawulo lommandla kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwelo lokwenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo zomsebenzi kwindawo yommandla esebenza ama-24 yure kwaye nako ukwazi ukusebenza nangemva kweeyure ezizele. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nolawulo lwezifo zezempilo ngokubanzi kwaye kunye nokuqhuba iimeko eziphuthumayo kwindawo yokunyanga ekuqaleni. Amava okusebenza kwinqanaba lelondolozo elisebenza phakathi kwabantu emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kwimizila yokuqonda i-TB neHIV eMzantsi Afrika, ukhathalelo lwezempilo yengqondo nezinye izifo ezihlala ixesha elide, ukhathalelo lwezempilo lweemama nabantwana nolawulo lwezingxwabo ezibalekayo. Unyango olubanzi, olusekwe kubungqina, olubhekise kumagosa abakhulelweyo kwindawo yokunyanga ekuqaleni. Ukusetyenziswa kweekhompyutha (MS Excel, Word, Outlook nokunye) kunye namakhono amaninzi okuzipatha, amaninzi okuququzelela nokusebenza njengesiqhanga. Ikhono nolwelo lokwenza iinkonzo zokukhusela ngenkxaso phakathi kweisebe elingaphantsi leSouthern Western kwaye ukhuphe inkxaso nomlengezelo kubasebenzi abancinane kunye neenkoseki.
xh.duties: Yeza unyango oluhle lwezempilo kubaguli abangabhalisiweyo nabakwizingxwabo ezibalekayo abayeza kwiindawo zonyango lokuqala kwiSouthern Western Substructure. Oku kuquka unyango lwezifo ezihlala ixesha elide, iHIV neTB, impilo yabasetyhini nabantwana, abaguli abangaqondwanga iimeko zabo nezingxwabo. Yiba nabandakanyo aktif kwinkqubo yokudlulisa amakhono nakwezonyango nophuhliso. Yiba nabandakanyo omtsha kumashishini olawulo lezempilo kwifasilithi nakwisebe elingaphantsi. Bonisa inkokeli nolawulo kwinqanaba lefasilithi.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R907 617 per annum Grade 2: R1 055 292 per annum Grade 3: R1 221 843 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Clinical psychologist wanted at Valkenberg Hospital in the Western Cape to provide psychological assessments, therapy and rehabilitation services across three grade levels.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Psychologist in Clinical Psychology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Psychologist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as with the HPCSA as a Psychologist in respect of RSA qualified employees. 1 Year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Psychologist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 8 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Psychologist in respect of RSA qualified employees. Minimum of 9 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Psychologist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 16 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Psychologist in respect of RSA qualified employees. A minimum of 17 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Psychologist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa Inherent requirement of the job: Valid Driver’s License. Willingness to travel independently between wards and service areas on hospital premises in the performance of your duties. Willingness to arrange your own transport to attend occasional off-site facilities/meetings in the performance of your duties. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Sound knowledge of clinical psychology assessment, diagnosis, psychotherapeutic interventions and psychometric assessment. Ability to function effectively within a multidisciplinary mental health team in a specialist psychiatric setting. Knowledge of relevant legislation including the Mental Health Care Act, Criminal Procedure Act, Child Care and Protection legislation, HPCSA ethical guidelines and applicable Department of Health policies. Ability to provide psychological consultation, supervision, teaching and training to students, interns and other healthcare professionals. -Good organisational, administrative, report writing, problem-solving and time management skills. Computer literacy and the ability to maintain accurate clinical and statistical records. Excellent verbal and written communication. Ability to work independently, demonstrate professional leadership, and adapt to different clinical service environments.
jobs.duties: Render comprehensive clinical psychology services including psychological assessment, diagnosis, psychometric evaluation, risk assessment, formulation, treatment planning and report writing. Provide evidence-based individual, group and family psychotherapy and contribute to psychosocial rehabilitation and mental health promotion programmes. Participate in multidisciplinary clinical activities including ward rounds, case discussions, and consultation and liaison services. Maintain clinical governance standards through appropriate administration, record keeping, referral management, statistics reporting and participation in quality improvement activities. - Contribute to the training, supervision and evaluation of intern psychologists and other students in accordance with HPCSA requirements. Participate in academic, teaching, research, continuing professional development and service development activities. Represent Psychology on relevant hospital and departmental committees and contribute to the strategic development of psychological services. Provide outreach, consultation and support services to district hospitals, community facilities and other stakeholders as required.
