af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Sielkundige in Kliniese Sielkunde toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Sielkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Sielkundige ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1 Jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Sielkundige ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 8 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Sielkundige ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 9 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Sielkundige ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 16 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Sielkundige ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 17 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Sielkundige ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers, wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om onafhanklik tussen saale en diensareas op hospitaalpersele te reis in die uitvoering van u pligte. Bereidwilligheid om u eie vervoer te reël om af en toe buite-perseel fasiliteite/vergaderings by te woon in die uitvoering van u pligte. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Deeglike kennis van kliniese sielkundige assessering, diagnoses, psigoterapeutiese intervensies en psigometriese assessering. Vermoë om doeltreffend binne 'n multidissiplinêre geestesgesondheidspan in 'n spialispsigiatriese omgewing te funksioneer. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing insluitend die Mental Health Care Act, Criminal Procedure Act, Child Care and Protection-wetgewing, HPCSA-etiese riglyne en toepaslike Department of Health-beleide. Vermoë om sielkundige konsultasie, toesig, onderrig en opleiding aan studente, internstudente en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionals te verskaf. -Goed georganiseerde, administratiewe, verslagdoenings-, probleemoplossings- en tydbestuurvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om akkurate kliniese en statistiese rekords te hou. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, professionele leierskap te toon, en by verskillende kliniese diensomgewings aan te pas.
af.duties: Lewer omvattende kliniese sielkundedienste insluitend sielkundige assessering, diagnoses, psigometriese evaluering, risikoassessering, formulering, behandelingsbeplanning en verslagdoening. Verskaf bewysgebaseerde individuele, groep- en gesinsterapie en dra by tot psigososiale rehabilitasie en geestesgesondheidsbevorderingsprogramme. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre kliniese aktiwiteite insluitend saalrondes, gevalbesprekings, en konsultasie- en skakeldienste. Handhaaf kliniese bestuursstandaarde deur toepaslike administrasie, rekordhouding, verwysingsbestuur, statistiese verslagdoening en deelname aan gehalteverbeteringsaktiwiteite. - Dra by tot die opleiding, toesig en evaluering van intern-sielkundiges en ander studente in ooreenstemming met HPCSA-vereistes. Neem deel aan akademiese, onderwys-, navorsings-, voortgesette professionele ontwikkelings- en diensontwikkelingsaktiwiteite. Verteenwoordig Sielkunde op toepaslike hospitaal- en departementele komitees en dra by tot die strategiese ontwikkeling van sielkundige dienste. Verskaf uitreik-, konsultasie- en ondersteuningsdienste aan distrikshospitale, gemeenskapsfasiliteite en ander belanghebbendes soos vereis.

zu.title: Umgangatho wePsychologist Yasezokwelapha 1 kuye kuka-3
zu.summary: Kudingeka psychologist yasezokwelapha eValkenberg Hospital eWestern Cape ukunikeza ukuhlola ngokwengqondo, unyuso lokwelapha namasevisi okulungisa abantu kwizigaba ezintathu zamazinga.
zu.requirements: Imininingwane yemfundo edingekayo: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengePsychologist kuClinical Psychology. Ukubhalisa kunbuzo ogunyaziwe: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengePsychologist Yasezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: IGrade 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njengePsychologist mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu e-RSA. Unyaka o-1 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengePsychologist mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, abangingadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. IGrade 2: Okuncane unyaka ongu-8 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengePsychologist mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu e-RSA. Okuncane unyaka ongu-9 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengePsychologist mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, abangingadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. IGrade 3: Okuncane unyaka ongu-16 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengePsychologist mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu e-RSA. Okuncane unyaka ongu-17 wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengePsychologist mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, abangingadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqisha esevisayo. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kodwa phakathi kwezindawo zokwelapha namanye amagumbi esikhungini esibhedlela ekwenzeni imisebenzi yakho. Ukuzimisela ukulungela izithulu zakho ukuze uhlangane namanye amagumbi noma amagumbi abhale imihlangano ezingaphandle ngesikhathi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yakho. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi olujulile ngehlolo lezengqondo, ukuhlola ukuxilonga, unyuso lokwelapha ngokwengqondo nokuqamba ukuhlola izinombolo. Amandla okusebenza kahle eqenjini elijula elisebenza ngengqondo ngokwezinhlanga ezahlukene esibhedlela. Ulwazi ngemithetho ephathelene noMthetho Wokwelaphwa Ngengqondo, uMthetho Wokuqhuba Icala, imithetho yokuvikela nokuqasha izingane, imihlahlandlela yamandla ka-HPCSA namapholisi abantu abalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Amandla okunikeza inqulumo-mengqondo, ukuletha abafundi, ukufundisa nokwesigqila abafundi, abakwesigqila nabanye abantu abasebenza kwezokwelapha. -Amandla okuhlela, okuphatha izinto ezincane, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha isikhathi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha nokuqhuba izinongo zamaphupho nokuqamba izinombolo ngendlela eqondile. Amandla okukhuluma kahle nokuqamba amaphupho kahle. Amandla okusebenza kodwa, ukubonisa ukukhokha ngobuhlakani, nokuzivumelanisa nezinhlanga ezahlukene ezisebenza kwezokwelapha.
zu.duties: Yenza amasevisi ahlukene engqondo kwezokwelapha kuhlanganise ukuhlola kwengqondo, ukuhlola, ukuqamba izinombolo, ukuhlola ingozi, ukudala izindlela, ukwelapha nokubhala imibiko. Nikeza ukwelapha okususelwa kubufakazi bomuntu ngamunye, eqenjini nasemndenini futhi wonge ekwakhiweni kwezengqondo futhi unyuse imihlahlandlela yezimpilo yomphakathi. Ngenxa yeqembu elisebenza ngokwezinhlanga ezahlukene kuhlanganise amagumbi wamaphupho, izinkulumo ngamaphupho, futhi uhlanganyele ekwakhiweni kwemihlangano nasekusebenzeni nabanye. Gcina amaphupho kahle ngokuphatha izinto ezincane, ukugcina imibiko, ukulawula ukudluliswa kwamaphupho, ukubika izinombolo nokuhlanganyela ekweni izinto zibe nhle. - Yonge ekufundiseni, ekuletheni nasekuhloleni abafundi abangakwesigqila nabanye abafundi ngokufanelekile namandla ka-HPCSA. Hlanganyela ezintweni zemfundo, ekufundiseni, ekuphenyeni, ekwakhiweni kwemfundo nokwakhiweni kwamasevisi. Mele abantu abasebenza ngengqondo kumagumbi amakhulu esibhedlela kanye namaphupho abantu abalulekile futhi wonge ekwakhiweni kwamasevisi. Nikeza amasevisi okuhamba kude, inqulumo-mengqondo nesevisi yosizo kumagumbi amakhulu, izindawo zomphakathi nabanye abantu abalulekile njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Clinical Psychologist Grade 1 to 3
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe Clinical Psychologist Grade 1 to 3 kw-Valkenberg Hospital kw-Western Cape, ukuze anikeze iinkonzo zokulinganiswa kwengqondo, unyango, nokuPhinda ulungelelwe emgangathweni wezempilo kumanqanaba amathathu.
xh.requirements: I-Minimum yamagama afanelekileyo emfundo: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomzekeli wezolule lemviki ekwindawo apho kubhalwa khona abantu abangangenwa bubugcisa bokulawula izifo zabantu. Ukubhalisa kwikomishoni yabasebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomzekeli wezolule lemviki. Amaxesha e-1: Akukho ntsebenzo efanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengengcali kw-HPCSA, kubasebenzi abangabasebenzii base-South Africa. Unyaka o-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengengcali kw-HPCSA, kubasebenzi abangengabantu base-South Africa, abangafuneki ukwenza iinkonzo zomthetho ophatha iindawo ezithile ezisemthethweni woMzantsi-Afrika. Inqanaba lesi-2: Iminyaka yonke engama-8 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengengcali kw-HPCSA, kubasebenzi base-South Africa abangangenwa bubugcisa bokusebenza. Iminyaka yonke engama-9 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengengcali kw-HPCSA, kubasebenzi abangengabantu base-South Africa, abangafuneki ukwenza iinkonzo ezithile zomthetho osetyenziswa eMzantsi-Afrika. Inqanaba lesi-3: Iminyaka engama-16 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengengcali kw-HPCSA, kubantu base-South Africa. Iminyaka engama-17 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengengcal
xh.duties: Nikezela iinkonzo ezibanzi zezolule lemviki, kuquka aksment yobuntu, ulwazi lokuqwala izifo, ukulinganisa ngokwezobuchwepheshe, aksment yomngcipheko, ukulungelelanisa indlela yokwenza izinto, ilungelelwaniso lokunyanga, kunye nokuqaqmba iirepothi. Nikezela uginyo lokunyanya ngobuqhungu (psychotherapy) komntu ngamnye, qothingo, kunye nosapho, kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwinz olukhuthaza ukubuyela kolwangoku kwentlalo kunye nezinkonzo zokukhusela impilo yomntu. Thathe inxaxheba kumasebe amaninzi okuqhuba iinkonzo zeClinical, kubandakanya iindlela ezithile ezingenwa ngayo imibuzo egumbini lokulala, ingxoxo yemiba yabantu abaguleyo, kunye neenkonzo zokuncedana ngolwazi. Gcina inqanaba elifaneleyo lokulawula izigqibo ngokusebenzisa uhlelo olululo, ukugcina iirekhod, ukulawula ukuthumela kwindawo ezifanelekileyo, ukwenza iirepothi zeestatistiki, kunye nokuhanjiswa kumashishini aimhlophe ngokwamava. - Yonakalisa ngokuthabatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni, ekulawuleni, nakuvavuweni kolonke abafundi kunye nabanye abafundi ngokweemfuno ze-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Thathe inxaxheba kumashishini amaninzi amhlophe, nokugcinwa kolwazi ekuqhubeni iinkonzo zakho. Mela isikhundla sakho nakumagatya lamanyathelo abeko emaziko apho ukhule a, kwaye uncedise ekwakheni ulwazi oluluncedayo lokuziphilisa ngokomthetho wakho.

jobs.title: Pharmacist Grade 1 to 3
jobs.centre: Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Structure Office (X1 Post) Khayelitsha/Eastern Sub-Structure Office (X1 Post) Southern/Western Sub-Structure Office (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R882 816 per annum Grade 2: R954 339 per annum Grade 3: R1 041 402 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Pharmacist positions at Western Cape Health sub-structure offices requiring SAPC registration, with duties including pharmacy training coordination and regulatory compliance.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic qualification accredited with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) that allows registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with SAPC as a Pharmacist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Pharmacist with the SAPC in respect of SA employees. One-year relevant experience after registration as Pharmacist with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A Minimum of 5 years relevant experience after registration as Pharmacist with a recognised foreign health professional council in respect of SA qualified employees. 6 Years relevant experience after registration as Pharmacist with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 13 years relevant experience after registration as Pharmacist with the SAPC in respect of SA qualified employees. 14 years’ relevant experience after registration as Pharmacist with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in SA. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate knowledge of National and Provincial Health Policies and Pharmaceutical acts and laws and sound understanding of GPP compliance Ability to work accurately under pressure and maintain a high standard of professionalism. Sound Management, communication and conflict handling skills. Computer literacy and experience in quality and data management. Experience in working as a member of a multidisciplinary team and in stakeholder engagement. training and capacity development in pharmaceutical services.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and manage pharmacy training, internship, community service and learner programmes and ensure SAPC regulatory compliance, pharmacy registrations, licensing and accreditation requirements. Provide guidance on pharmacy legislation, Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP) standards and quality assurance processes. Support tutor development, learner monitoring, assessments and professional development programmes and provide operational and service delivery support to pharmacy facilities, including acting management responsibilities when required. Coordinate pharmaceutical financial reporting, expenditure monitoring and statutory submissions and contribute to workforce planning, capacity building and the establishment of future training sites. Manage private provider pharmaceutical order processes and statistical reporting. Coordinate and strengthen Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS) programmes to promote appropriate medicine use and clinical governance and support and monitor cold chain management compliance across facilities.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T Parker Tel No: (021) 815-8876 for NTSS, Mr J Van Niekerk Tel No: (021) 360-4641 for KESS, Mr A Joseph Tel No: (021) 202-0981 for SWSS
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview.” This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status)”. Candidates will be subjected to a practical/written and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Pharmacist Grade 1 to 3
af.summary: Aptekerposte by Western Cape Health-substruktukantore wat SAPC-registrasie vereis, met pligte wat apteekopleidingskoördinering en regulasienakoming insluit.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) wat registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Apoteker toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by SAPC as 'n Apoteker. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Apoteker by die SAPC met betrekking tot SA-werknemers nie. Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Apoteker by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Apoteker by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Apoteker by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 13 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Apoteker by die SAPC met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 14 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Apoteker by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in SA vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike kennis van Nasionale en Provinsiale Gesondheidsbeleid en Farmaseutiese wette en wetgewing en 'n deeglike begrip van GPP-nakoming. Vermoë om akkuraat onder druk te werk en 'n hoë standaard van professionaliteit te handhaaf. Soliede bestuurs-, kommunikasie- en konflikhanteringsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid en ervaring in gehalte- en databestuur. Ervaring in die werking as 'n lid van 'n multidissiplinêre span en in belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Opleiding en kapasiteitsontwikkeling in farmaseutiese dienste.
af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur apteekopleiding, internskap, gemeenskapsdiens en leerderprogramme en verseker SAPC-regulasienakoming, apteekregistrasies, lisensiëring en akkreditasievereistes. Verskaf leiding oor apteekwetgewing, Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP)-standaarde en gehalteversekeringsprosesse. Ondersteun tutorontwikkeling, leerdermonitering, assesserings en professionele ontwikkelingsprogramme en verskaf bedryfs- en diensleweringsondersteuning aan apteekfasiliteite, insluitend waarnemende bestuursverantwoordelikhede wanneer vereis. Koördineer farmaseutiese finansiële verslagdoening, bestedingsmonitering en statutêre voorleggings en dra by tot mannekragbeplanning, kapasiteitsbou en die vestiging van toekomstige opleidingsplekke. Bestuur privaat verskaffer se farmaseutiese bestelprosesse en statistiese verslagdoening. Koördineer en versterk Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS)-programme om toepaslike medisynegebruik en kliniese bestuur te bevorder, en ondersteun en monitor kouekettingbestuursnakoming dwarsoor fasiliteite.

zu.title: Umthi wekhemisi Isigaba 1 kuya ku 3
zu.summary: Izikhundla zokuba ngumthi wekhemisi emahhovisi wesakhiwo esingaphansi se-Western Cape Health adinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC, lapho imisebenzi ifaka phakathi ukulungiselela ukuqeqeshwa kwesikhungla sokuphathwa kwamakhemisi nokuhambisana nemithetho.
zu.requirements: Imininingwane yemfundo edingekayo: Isifundo esisisiseko esivunywe yi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomthi wekhemisi. Ukubhaliswa ekhansini lemisebenzi yemikhakha: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengomthi wekhemisi. Isiphephelo: Isigaba 1: Akukho okudingeko emva kokubhalisa njengomthi wekhemisi kwi-SAPC maqondana nabasebenzi base-SA. Unyaka omunye wokuhluhleka okuhlobene nawo emva kokubhalisa njengomthi wekhemisi ekhansini elivunyiwe lezempiro yezempilo yamanye amazwe maqondano nabasebenzi abafundile koMzantsi afrika okungalodingwa ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isigaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yohluhleko oluhlobene nawo emva kokubhalisa njengomthi wekhemisi ekhansini elivunyiwe lezempiro yezempilo yamanye amazwe maqondana nabasebenzi abafundile eSA. Iminyaka eyi-6 yohluhleko oluhlobene nawo emva kokubhalisa njengomthi wekhemisi ekhansini elivunyiwe lezempiro yezempilo yamanye amazwe maqondana nabasebenzi abafundile kwamanye amazwe okungalodingwa ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isigaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-13 yohluhleko oluhlobene nawo emva kokubhalisa njengomthi wekhemisi kwi-SAPC maqondana nabasebenzi abafundile eSA. Iminyaka engu-14 yohluhleko oluhlobene nawo emva kokubhalisa njengomthi wekhemisi ekhansini elivunyiwe lezempiro yezempilo yamanye amazwe maqondana nabasebenzi abafundile kwamanye amazwe okungalodingwa ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eSA. Isidingo sokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqamba evumelekile (Code B/EB). Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olufanele mayelana namapholisi eZezempilo ezwelonke naseZifundazweni kanye nemithetho yezeMithi nokuqonda okuhle ngokuhambisana ne-GPP. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokunembile ngaphansi kwegagasi kanye noku-gcina izinga eliphezulu lobungcweti. Amakhono okuphatha, okuxhumana kanye nokupatha iziphixiphixi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nolwazi lokuphatha izinga nendlela yolwazi. Ulwazi lokusebenza njengelungu lenqaba eqeqeshwa kumakhondo ahlukene kanye nokuqhubisana nabalingani. Ukuqeqeshwa kanye nentuthuko yamandla kumasevisi wezemithi.
zu.duties: Lungiselela futhi uphathe ukuqeqeshwa kwesikhungla sokuphathwa kwamakhemisi, ukufundela umsebenzi, inkonzo yomphakathi namuhlelo wabafundi, futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana nemithetho ye-SAPC, ukubhaliswa kwesikhungla sokuphathwa kwamakhemisi, ukukhishwa kolayisense nezidingo zokuvunywa. Nikeza imiqondo mayelana nemithetho yesikhungla sokuphathwa kwamakhemisi, amazinga e-Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP) kanye nenqubo yokuqinisekisa izinga. Sekele ukuthuthukiswa kwabafundisi, ukulandwa kwabafundi, ukuhlolwa namuhlelo wokuthuthukiswa kobungcweti, futhi uhlinzeke ngesekelo lokusebenza nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo kumafasiliti wezemithi, okuhlanganisa namandla okuphatha uma kudingeka. Lungiselela umbiko wezezimali wezemithi, okulandwa kokuchitha kanye nokuhumusha okusemthethweni, futhi wenze umniko ekuletheni abasebenzi, ukwakha amandla kanye nasokusungwa amasayithi okuqeqeshwa esikhathini esizayo. Phatha inqubo yokulandelwa kwezemithi yabaphathi abangasese kanye nombiko wesibalo. Lungiselela futhi uqinise amahlelo e-Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS) ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemithi okufanele kanye nokulawula okusebukhosini, futhi usekele futhi ulawule ukuhambisana nokuphathwa kweqoqo elibandayo kubo bonke amafasiliti.

xh.title: Umthengisi weziyeza inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Izithuba zomthengisi weziyeza kwiiofisi zesebe le-Western Cape Health sub-structure ezifuna ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC, kunye nemisebenzi equka ulawulo lokuyala amakhosi wekhampasi kunye nokuhambelana nemigaqo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga semfundo esingaphantsi: Isidanga esisisiseko esamkelwe yi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomthengisi weziyeza. Ukubhalisa kwisigqeba sabasebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomthengisi weziyeza. Isiphalazwe: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mva kokubhalisa njengomthengisi weziyeza kwi-SAPC malunga nabasebenzi base-SA. Unyaka omnye wamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthengisi weziyeza kwigqeba elisemthethweni lezozezo le Health Professional lamazwe ngamazwe malunga nabasebenzi abagqityiweyo kwamanye amazwe abangafunekiweni ukuba benze iNkonzo yoLuntu njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-5 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthengisi weziyeza kwigqeba elisemthethweni lezozezo lezezempiro lamazwe ngamazwe malunga nabasebenzi abagqityiweyo base-SA. Iminyaka eli-6 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthengisi weziyeza kwigqeba elisemthethweni lezozezo le Health Professional lamazwe ngamazwe malunga nabasebenzi abagqityiweyo kwamanye amazwe abangafunekiweni ukuba benze iNkonzo yoLuntu njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-13 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthengisi weziyeza kwi-SAPC malunga nabasebenzi abagqityiweyo base-SA. Iminyaka eli-14 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengomthengisi weziyeza kwigqeba elisemthethweni lezozezo le Health Professional lamazwe ngamazwe malunga nabasebenzi abagqityiweyo kwamanye amazwe abangafunekiweni ukuba benze iNkonzo yoLuntu njengoko kufuneka e-SA. Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Ilayisenesi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olufanelekileyo malunga namagqabantshintshi ezezempiro eKawonkeWoZwe nakwiPhondo, namagqabantshintshi namathetho eziyeza, nokuqonda kakuhle ukuhambelana ne-GPP; Amandla okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo phantsi koxinzelelo nogcinwa kwisidanga esiphezulu sobungcali. Amandla olawulo, abantulwanayo nokusingatha iingxabano. Ukuba gqithisele kwiikhompyutha namava ekulawuleni izinga namanani. Amava okusebenza njengelungu leqela elingabantu abaninzi abanemimiselo yamakhono kunye nokubamba iqhaza kubahlali. Ukuyala ukunyuka amandla ekunikezeleni iinkonzo zeziyeza.
xh.duties: Yulawula ulawulo lokuyala iikhampasi, abafundi abasebenza ngexesha elifanelekileyo, iNkonzo yoLuntu namakhosi, uqinisekise ukuhambelana kwemigaqo ye-SAPC, ukubhaliswa kweekhampasi, ukunikwa kwamalayisenisi nokuqinisekiswa kweemfuno. Yike nkqumbo malunga namathetho ekhampasi, amazinga e-Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP) neenkqubo zokuqinisekisa izinga. Xhasa ukuphuhliswa koyili, okulandelelwa kwabafundi, ukuqwalaselwa namakhosi okuphuhliswa obungcali, unikeze inkxaso yokusebenza nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo kweziko leziyeza, kuquka neenkokeli ezithatha izigqibo ezingabambebeyo xa kufuneka. Lawulisa iinkcazelo zezimali weziyeza, okulandelelwa kokuchitha nokunikezwa okusesikweni, unikeze konke ekucwangcwiseni abasebenzi, kwakhiwo lwamandla nasekusekweni kweendawo zokuyala kwixesha elizayo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuyalelwa iziyalezo zeziyeza abanikezeli banga butho kunye neenkonzo zeziyalezo namanani. Lawula uqinise isebe iinkqubo ze-Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS) ukuze kunyuselwe ukusetyenziswa kweziyeza ngokufanelekileyo kunye nogqabo lokulawula izigulo, uxhase ulandele ulawulo lokuqhuba i-chain ebandayo kuzo zonke iindawo.

A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited in Emergency Nursing or Critical Care Nursing (Adult). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant speciality. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Willingness to work after hours (weekends, public holidays and night duty). Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of appropriate legislation, regulations and Departmental Policies. Knowledge of Hospital and Emergency Centre Triage Information System (HECTIS) and South African Triage System (Basic knowledge and experience in human resource management, labour relations, financial and supply chain procurement processes. Experience in the use of clinical equipment and control of budget levels. The ability to promote quality patient care through the setting, implementation, and monitoring of standards. Effective communication, interpretation, leadership, execute discipline, decision-making and conflict resolution skills.

xh.summary: Lawula iNkqubo yeQinisekiso lobuMgangatho yaseRed Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, kuquka ulawulo babantu, umbeko wemigaqo nophuhliso lwezicwangciso.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowona siphelo: iDiploma/iDegree yeminyaka emine efanelekileyo oku kunye nayo kwiZifundo zezeMPilo ezinokubhaliswa kwiSouth African Statutory Health Professions Council okanye kwi-South African Nursing Council. Isamaphulo: Isamaphulo esifanelekileyo kwimeko yempilo. Isamaphulo sobulawu esifanelekileko. Imfuno yomsebenzi: ilayiseni yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni nokuzimisela ukuhamba. Iimpawu (ulwazi/amaziko): Amakhono obuchwepheshe obumpilibombe obugqwesileyo (MS Word. Excel and Power Point), amakhono oluntu alungelelaniswa, obulawu, olunikwayo nokuqhatha. Ulwazi olugqwesileyo nesamaphulo esifanelekileko kwisiQinisekiso sobuGangatho, uLawulo lweengozi, uLawulo lweMPilo nokuKhuseleka, nokuThintela ukuTyalwa kweZifo nokuLawula. Amakhono obuvelwani obuqwesileyo bokuqamba nokuGGCAZisa, nabalinganiswa. Amakhono obucukucezelayo, bokucinga ngokwelwa nokuqamba. Imandlaok (okukodwa) efaka, ithiyore Ikhwire ithi ingcwaba eNgesi nakunye namva ngokubhaliweyo. Ikhono lokubamba, ukutolika nokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokucinga nokusebenza kodwa nokuhlola idatha ngokucokisekileyo.
xh.duties: Zonwabisa nokuphila ngokwamaxabiso amakhulu e-Western Cape Department of Health & Wellness. Ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusebenzayo lweNqubomgomo yeQinisekiso lobuMgangatho yesebe. Ulawulo olusebenzayo labantu ngaphakathi kwiSebe leQinisekiso lobuMgangatho. Umbeko wemigaqo esebenzayo eyimiqondiso kunye namacebo okuphucula umgangatho nokukhokeza ukusetyenziswa kwayo. Ulungelelwaniso olusebenzayo, ulawulo, okuqwalaselwa nokuphonononga kwenkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho, ulawulo lwengozi, impilo nokhuseleko kwesebenza, kunye nokuthintela ukutyalwa kwezifo nokulawula, ngokuvumelana namagqabantshintshi empilo kunye nemiqathango namazinga okulawula. Unceda iimimimangambo ukuba zifikelele kokuvunyelwa kwiNqubomgomo yeQinisekiso lobuMgangatho. Ixhasa nokukhuthaza izikhokelo zemfundo nentlulaliso yabasebenzi. Iqokelela iqondanisa idatha inike iingxelo zobuchwepheshe kubaphathi abangaphakathi nangaphandle. -Njengelungu leKomiti yoLawulo eNgcwele, banika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe nolwelwazi kuCEO nakwiqela loLawulo kuzo zonke iindawo zokuphucula umgangatho, ulawulo lwengozi, impilo nokhuseleko kwisebenza, kunye nokuthintela ukutyalwa kwezifo nokulawula. Khuthaza inkqubo yolwalamano olugqwesileyo, ebuzwayo, yokufunda ngokuqhubeka nongqoqo lomngeni olugxile kumendi kwizona i-Cape Town.

jobs.title: Social Worker Supervisor Grade 1 to 2
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R496 668 per annum Grade 2: R608 859 per annum
jobs.summary: Supervise social work services at Khayelitsha District Hospital, providing clinical and administrative leadership across inpatient, outpatient and specialised service areas.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification in Social Work that allows for registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professionals (SACSSP) as a Social Worker. Registration with a professional council: Registration with a Professional Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as a Social Worker. Experience: A minimum of 7 years appropriate experience in social worker after registration as Social Worker with SACSSP. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Sound knowledge of relevant legislation including the Mental Health Care Act, Children’s Act and Domestic Violence Act. Knowledge of hospital-based social work services and integrated health and social development services delivery. Proven supervisory, leadership and people management skills. Ability to manage statutory process, governance, reporting and compliance. Excellent communication, report writing, problem solving and decision-making skills. Computer literate (MS Office, data and Information Management Systems).
jobs.duties: Provide operational and professional leadership in the management of Social Work services across all inpatients, outpatient and specialized service areas within a large Metro District Hospital, including the Acute Psychiatric Unit. Manage the social work department and provide clinical and administrative supervision to social workers and students in accordance with SACSSP, OSD and WCDOH prescripts. Ensure effective delivery of statutory, psychosocial and mental social work services through quality assurance, case review and ethical oversight. Coordinate social work input into multi-disciplinary patient care, discharge planning and referral pathways to promote continuity of care and reduce avoidable delays. Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, policies, protocols and governance requirements, including accurate record keeping and reporting. Manage service statistics, compile reports and participate in audits, quality improvements initiatives and clinical governance processes. Facilitate in-service training, capacity development and professional development of staff and students.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Maatskaplike Werk Toesighouer Graad 1 tot 2
af.summary: Hou toesig oor maatskaplike werkdiens by Khayelitsha District Hospital en verskaf kliniese en administratiewe leierskap oor ingeligte, uitligte en gespesialiseerde diensareas.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk wat registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professionals (SACSSP) as 'n Maatskaplike Werk toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Professional Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as 'n Maatskaplike Werk. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike ervaring as maatskaplike werker na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by SACSSP. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Deeglike kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, insluitend die Mental Health Care Act, Children's Act en Domestic Violence Act. Kennis van hospitaalgebaseerde maatskaplike werkdienste en geïntegreerde gesondheids- en maatskaplike ontwikkelingsdienslewering. Bewese toesighoudende, leierskap- en mensebestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om statutêre prosesse, bestuur, verslagdoening en nakoming te hanteer. Uitstekende kommunikasie-, verslagdoenings-, probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterd (MS Office, data- en inligtingbestuurstelsels).
af.duties: Verskaf operasionele en professionele leierskap in die bestuur van maatskaplike werkdiens oor alle ingeligte, uitligte en gespesialiseerde diensareas binne 'n groot Metro-distrikshospitaal, insluitend die Akute Psigiatriese Eenheid. Bestuur die maatskaplike werkdepartement en verskaf kliniese en administratiewe toesig aan maatskaplike werkers en studente in ooreenstemming met SACSSP-, OSD- en WCDOH-voorskrifte. Verseker effektiewe lewering van statutêre, psigososiale en geestelike maatskaplike werkdiens deur gehaltversekering, saakhersiening en etiese toesig. Koördineer maatskaplike werkbydraes tot multidissiplinêre pasiëntsorg, ontslagbeplanning en verwysingsroetes om deurlopendheid van sorg te bevorder en vermydelike vertraag te verminder. Verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing, beleide, protokolle en bestuursvereistes, insluitend akkurate rekordhouding en verslagdoening. Bestuur diensstatistieke, stel verslae op en neem deel aan oudits, gehaltsverbeteringsinisiatiewe en kliniese bestuursprosesse. Fasiliteer in-diensopleiding, kapasiteitsontwikkeling en professionele ontwikkeling van personeel en studente.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Bezenhlalo Nokuxhumana Ibanga 1 kuye kweBanga 2
zu.summary: Qaphisise izinsiza zabasebenzi bezenhlalo nokuxhumana eKhayelitsha District Hospital, unikeze ubuholi bokwelapha ngebhokisi kanye nobungqondwana emikhakheni yesevisi yabalwa esibhedlela, abangangeni esibhedlela kanye namabhizinisi amakhonza ngokukhethekile.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingavunyelwe ukuba ngaphansi kwalezi: Isifundo esifanele kumsebenzi Wezenhlalo Nokuxhumana esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professionals (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi Wezenhlalo Nokuxhumana. Ukubhaliswa kubuhlakani obuphathwayo: Ukubhaliswa kuProfessional Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi Wezenhlalo Nokuxhumana. Isipiliyoni: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-7 yonke isipiliyoni esifanele njengomsebenzi wezenhlalo nokuxhumana emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wezenhlalo nokuxhumana ku-SACSSP. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi olulungile ngemithetho ehlobene nakho okuhlanganisa i-Mental Health Care Act, i-Children's Act kanye ne-Domestic Violence Act. Ulwazi ngesevisi yomsebenzi wezenhlalo nokuxhumana osukela esibhedlela kanye nesevisi yokuhlanganisa impilo kanye nentuthuko yezensiza zomphakathi. Amakhono obuholi, abaqaphisi kanye nabantu abasohlwini abaqinisekisiwe. Amandla okuphatha inqubo yomthetho, ukulawula, okubalwa kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho. Amakhono ohlelo lokunxibelelwano, okubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuhlakanipha ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha (MS Office, idatha kanye namasimu okuphatha ulwazi).
zu.duties: Nika abaqaphisi amandla asebenzayo kanye nobuholi obungcali ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zabasebenzi bezenhlalo nokuxhumana kuyo yonke imikhakha yokwelashwa kwabalwa esibhedlela, abangangeni esibhedlela kanye namabhizinisi amakhonza ngokukhethekile ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela esikhulu se-Metro District, okuhlanganisa i-Acute Psychiatric Unit. Phatha umnyango wabasebenzi bezenhlalo nokuxhumana baphathe ngokwelapha ngebhokisi kanye nobungqondwana abasebenzi bezenhlalo nokuxhumana kanye nabafundi ngokuhambisana nemiyalo ye-SACSSP, ye-OSD kanye ne-WCDOH. Qinisekisa ukulethwa ngempumelelo kwezinsiza zomthetho, ezengqondweni kanye nezobuhlakani bomsebenzi wezenhlalo nokuxhumana ngokuhlinzeka ngomgangatho, ukuhlola izinkinga kanye nokugqamisa ukuziphatha. Linganisa iminikelo yomsebenzi wezenhlalo nokuxhumana ekunakekelweni kwesiguli okuhlanganisiwe, ukuhlela ukukhishwa esibhedlela kanye nezindlela zokuqondisa ukuze kube khona ukuqhubeka ngenakekelo kanye nokunciphisa izingqinamba ezingadingekile. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho ehlobene nakho, izinqubomgomo, amaphulothokholo kanye nezidingo zokulawula, okuhlanganisa ukugcina imibhalo ngokunembile kanye nokubika. Phatha izibalo zezevisi, hlanganisa imibiko bese ubambe iqhaza ekubukeni, ekuthuthukiseni izinga kanye nasezinqubweni zokulawula ukwelapha. Phatha isiqondiso sokuqeqesha abasebenzi, ukuthuthukisa amandla kanye nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi kanye nabafundi ngobungcali.

xh.title: Umphathi weBasebenzi bentlalo Jongono inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2
xh.summary: Kulawulwe iinkonzo zomsebenzi wentlalo e Khayelitsha District Hospital, kunikezwa intsebeliso ebalulekileyo yolawulo kwiiwadi, kumagumbi ebalulekileyo nakwindawo yeenkonzo ezingathathi hlangothi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingoko ubuncinane: Isifundo esifanelekileyo kwibasebenzi bentlalo esivumela ukubhaliswa e South African Council for Social Service Professionals (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wentlalo. Ukubhaliswa kwikhabhu yabanini: Ukubhaliswa kwikhabhu yabanini ekulawulweni kolwazi ngabasebenzi bentlalo (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wentlalo. Iqondo lolwazi: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-7 yamava afanelekileyo ekubeni ngumsebenzi wentlalo emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wentlalo e SACSSP. Iinkalo (ulwazi/akhondo): Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngemigaqo esebenzayo nakumthetho wezempilo yengqondo, umthetho wabantwana nomthetho wendlela ezingcali zisetyenziswa ngayo ekhaya. Ulwazi ngeenkonzo zomsebenzi wonyango oluse kwindawo yokhathalelo lwesixeke noluhamba hambe nolonikezelo lweenkonzo ezahlukeneyo zokhathalelo nokwakha uluntu. Ikhondo ebonakalisa ukukwazi ukulawula, ukuba ngumphathi kunye nokulawula abantu. Isakhono sokulawula iinkqubo zomthetho, ukulawulwa kwentlalo, iintatho ngokubhalisa nokuhambelana nemigaqo. Ikhondo elingcono ekuthetheni, ekubhaleni iingxelo, ekusombululeni iingxaki nasekwenzeni izigqibo. Ukusebenzisa ikhomyutha (MS Office, ulwazi kunye nokulawulwa kwesixhobo sekhompyutha).
xh.duties: Kunikezelwa intsebeliso yolawulo ebalulekileyo ekulawulweni kweendawo ezahlukeneyo zokhathalelo ezingangeni esibhedlele, nakumagumbi abalulekileyo angenangomso eSixekeni esikhulu, kubandakanya indawo yokhathalelo lwengqondo ekhawulezayo. Kulawulwa indawo yomsebenzi wentlalo kunye nokunikela isikhokelo kolawulo lwekhlinikhi nolawulo lwabasebenzi basebekhaya nabafundi ngokuhambelana nemigaqo ye SACSSP, OSD ne WCDOH. Kuqinisekiswa ukunikela ngokusebenza kolwazi ngomsebenzi wentlalo, ezempilo yengqondo nangokwengqondo ngokukhangela ukusebenza kakuhle, ukukhangela amacala nokulawula izigqibo. Kuhlelwa ulwazi lwomsebenzi wentlalo kwinkqabo yokhathalelo lwesigulana ehamba hambe nabanye ochwepheshe, ulawulo lokuphuma kwesibhedlele nendlela ezisuke kwezinye iindawo ukuze kuqhubeke kukhathalelwa isigulana nokunciphisa iinkqubo ezize zingenwe. Kuqinisekiswa ukuhambelana nomthetho, namagqabantshathi nemigaqo yolawulo, kubandakanya ukugcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo nokubhala iingxelo. Kulawulwa izibalo zolwazi, kubhalwa iingxelo nokubandakanyeka ekukhangeleni ukusebenza kakuhle, kuqwalaselwa izigqibo zokuphucula iinkonzo kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lwesifo. Kukhuthazwa ukuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi ekusebenzeni, ukuphuculwa kwakhona nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi nabafundi.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 and 2 (PRIMARY Health
jobs.centre: Vanguard CHC (X2 Posts) Du Noon CHC (X1 Post) District Six CDC (X3 Posts) Lotus River CDC (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Clinical nurse practitioners needed across multiple Cape Town primary healthcare facilities to provide comprehensive clinical services and health promotion.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year Diploma in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care accredited with the SANC (R48). OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-graduate Diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant speciality. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB). Willingness to work overtime when necessary. Willingness to work at other facilities within the Southern/Western Sub-Structure. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Basic computer skills in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies of the Department of Health Western Cape. Communication skills (written and verbal).
jobs.duties: Assist with the provision of Comprehensive PHC clinical service to surrounding communities. Plan and implement Health Promotion and Prevention activities in facility and community as part of COPC. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders as part of the multi-disciplinary team. Clinical governance as part of quality assurance. Information Management and timeous submission of reports and participation in facility audits. Assist with management of human resources and the development of staff.
jobs.enquiries: Mr M Lingani Tel No: (021) 695-8200 - Vanguard CHC, Mr R Hall Tel No: (021) 200-4501-Du Noon CHC, Ms N Diedericks Tel No: (021) 833-5400-District Six CDC, Ms Z Sambo Tel No: (021) 703-313- Lotus River CDC
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Kliniese Verpleegkundige Praktisyn Vlak 1 en 2 (PRIMÊRE Gesondheid
af.summary: Kliniese verpleegkundiges benodig by verskeie Cape Town primêre gesondheidsorgfasiliteite om omvattende kliniese dienste en gesondheidsbevordering te verskaff.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Na-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar Diploma in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care geakkrediteer by die SANC (R48). OF 'n 4-jarige Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse Diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorgverpleegkunde. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring na verkryging van die 1-jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteitsrigting wees. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB). Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer nodig. Bereidwilligheid om by ander fasiliteite binne die Southern/Western Sub-Structure te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Basiese rekenaarvaardighede in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleide van die Department of Health Western Cape. Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling).
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die verskaffing van 'n omvattende PHC-kliniese diens aan omliggende gemeenskappe. Beplan en implementeer Gesondheidsbevordering en -voorkomingsaktiwiteite in fasiliteite en die gemeenskap as deel van COPC. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes as deel van die multidissiplinêre span. Kliniese bestuursbeheer as deel van gehalteversekering. Inligtingbestuur en tydige indiening van verslae en deelname aan fasiliteitsoudits. Bystand verleen met die bestuur van menslike hulpbronne en die ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Umkhakha wezokunursing wezokwelapha ochwephishele ongakafundiswa izinga 1 kanye no-2 (PRIMARY Health
zu.summary: Abasebenzi bezokunursing abachwephishele badingeka kumazwe amanji nasezikhungweni ezihlukene zezempilo e-Cape Town ukuze banikeze izinsiza ezigcwele zezokwelapha kanye nokuqashelwa kwempilo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiselo: Isidingo se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ezokunursing) noma isidingo esilingana (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Nurse ochwephishele. Isidingo sokunursing semva kokusesikweni esibhekele unyaka osukhona ongalinganiselwa u-1 Diploma in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care esimtholakale ku-SANC (R48). Noma i-4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) noma isidingo esilingana (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Nurse ochwephishele. I-Post-graduate Diploma (R635) ekuqinisekiswe i-SANC ekusebenzeni kwezunursing ezingunaphakade. Ukubhalisa kubhungwano ochwephishele: Ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengo-Nurse ochwephishele. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni esingafani esingangeminyaka eyi-4 esifanele/esiye saphawulwa kule minyaka yokusebenza emkhakheni wezunursing ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengo-Nurse ochwephishele ku-General Nursing. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingafani esingangeminyaka eyi-14 esifanele/esiye saphawulwa kule minyaka yokusebenza emkhakheni wezunursing ngemuva kokubhalisa njengo-Nurse ochwephishele ku-SANC ku-General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yaleso sikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esiye saphawulwa ngemuva kokuthola lesi sidingo semva kokusesikheni unyaka osukhona noma i-post-graduate diploma kuleyo ndawo ekhethekile. Isidingo esibekwa ngumsebenzi ngokwemvelo: Ilayisensi yokushayela okusemthethweni (Code B/EB). Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi uma kunesidingo. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza kwezinye izikhungo ngaphakathi kwe-Southern/Western Sub-Structure. Izindlela eziyingqayizivele (ulwazi/izikhindi): Ulwazi olulula lokusebenza kwikhompyutha ku-MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namapholisi e-Department of Health Western Cape. Amakhono okuxhumana (abhalwe nokuqoshwa).
zu.duties: Siza ekuboneleleni ngekonke lesevisi yezokwelapha ye-PHC emiphakathini ezungezile. Hlela futhi ufake izinkomba zokuqashelwa kwempilo nokuvikela esikhungweni nasemphakathini njengengxenye ye-COPC. Xhumana nabaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle njengengxenye yethimba elihlukahlukene emkhakheni wemisebenzi. Ukuqondiswa kwezokwelapha njengengxenye yezenzo eziqinisekisa izinga lenhloso. Ukuphathwa kolwazi kanye nokuhambiswa kwemibiko ngasikhathi sinye kanye nokubamba iqhaza ekuhloleni isikhungo. Siza ekuphathweni kolabo abasebenza emnyangweni nakuthuthukisweni kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umpraktisikhola woongqongqoshe wezempilo Beka lokuqala neli lesi-2 (IMPILo ePhambili
xh.summary: Kufuneki abapraktisikhola boongqongqoshe beempilo kumaziko amaninzi ezempilo ephambili eCape Town ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zempilo ezingamanzi nokuqhutywa kwezempilo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingowona sincinci semfundo: Isidanga soqeqesho loR425 (okt. ipleyidi/idegri ekwitshisho lokongqongqosha) okanye isidanga esilinganayo (R683 nengoR254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqongqoshe weNtlalo. Isidanga sokongqongqoshe sangemva kwesidanga sokuqala esithatha ixesha elongezelelweyo lonyaka unye weDiploma kwiNzululwazi lokongqongqoshe lokonyango: ukuLinganisa iMephu yeZempilo, ukuNyanga noNakekelo esimiswe ngayo iSANC (R48). OKT Idegri yonyaka wesi-4 kwiNkqubo yoQeqesho lokongqongqosha (R174) okanye isidanga esilinganayo (R683 nengoR1497 okt iR171 nengoR1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqongqoshe weNtlalo. I-Diploma yesidanga sasemva (R635) eqeqeshwe yiSANC kwiNtlalo yoNyango lweNtlalo. Ukubhalisa kwiBhungo leMisebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqongqoshe weNtlalo. Isiphaluka: Iqela lokuqala: Iminyaka emi-4 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/aqhelekayo ekwitshisho lokongqongqoshe emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqongqoshe weNtlalo woNyango lweNtlalo. Iqela lesi-2: Iminyaka eyi-14 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/awaqhelekayo ekwitshisho lokongqongqoshe emva kokubhalisa njengoGqongqoshe weNtlalo kwiSANC kuNyango lweNtlalo. Iminyaka eli-10 ubuncinane lexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka libe ngamava afanelekileyo/aqhelekayo emva kokufumana isidanga sonyaka wokuqala kwisidanga sasemva okanye i-Diploma yesidanga sasemva kwesithili esiqhelekileyo. Imfuno ebalulekileyo yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo (iKhowudi B/EB). Ukulunga ukusebenza ngaphezulu kweyure eqhelekileyo xa kuyimfuneko. Ukulunga ukusebenza kumaziko amanye ngaphakathi kwendlela eNingizimu/iNtshona. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Izakhono ezingowona siseko zekhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, noOutlook. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemigaqo-nkqubo ephathelene nesebe leZempilo laseWestern Cape. Izakholo zoxoxo (ezibhalwayo nezothethwayo).
xh.duties: Nceda ekuboneleleni ngenkonzo yempilo ye-PHC ebanzi kuqoqosho lwamahlale. Cwangcisa uze uphumeze imisebenzi yeziQendu zokuKhuthaza iMpilo nokuThintela iNtlazo kuluntu nakweliso njengengxenye yeCOPC. Qinisekisa unxibelelwano nabanxibelelanisi bangaphakathi nangaphandle njengengxenye yeqela elinabantu abanemisebenzi eyahlukileyo. Ulawulo lweenkonzo zonyango njengengxenye yokuqinisekisa umgangatho. uLawulo lweMininingwane nokungenisa iingxelo ngexesha elifanelekileyo nokuThatha inxaxheba kulungiso lwamava ewindweni. Nceda ekulawulweni kwamandla abantu nasekuqhutyweni abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Lecturer Nursing Grade 1 to 2 (UNDERGRADUATE)
jobs.centre: Boland/Overberg, Southern Cape Karoo and Metro Campus
jobs.city: Southern Cape Karoo and Metro Campus
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Lecturer in Nursing (Grade 1 to 2) for undergraduate programmes across Boland/Overberg, Southern Cape Karoo and Metro Campus in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Nursing Education (R212). Or A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Nursing Education. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognisable nursing experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Possess good communication (written & verbal) and presentation skills. Possess knowledge of relevant Legislation, Acts, Prescripts and Policy frameworks informing the area of operation. Knowledge of nursing education programmes and curriculum. Proficiency in teaching and assessment in Nursing Education including evaluation approaches. Knowledge of policy development, interpretation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation. Sound conflict management and decision making/problem solving skills. Good research and analytical skills. Good managerial and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide education and training to student nurses. Coordinate clinical learning exposure to students between college and clinical areas. Conduct clinical accompaniment of students. Coordinate the teaching and learning of nursing programmes. Develop and ensure implementation of quality assurance programmes. Collaborate with other internal and external stakeholders and build a sound relationship within the Department. Supervision of students. Participate in the development and review of nursing curricula for Undergraduate Diploma Programmes. Implements the new nursing programmes in line with SANC and CHE regulations. Participate in the provisioning of Continuous Professional Development (CPD) activities at the Campus. Participate in all governance structures of the College. Support the mission and promote the image of the College.
jobs.enquiries: Dr Magerman Tel No: (021) 684-1202 / Dr S Mottian Tel No: (044) 813-1993 (Southern Cape/Karoo Campus) / Ms L Strauss Tel No: (023) 814-0090 (Boland/Overberg Campus)
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a competency test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post- basic qualification or post-graduate qualification in the relevant speciality. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Lektor Verpleegkunde Graad 1 tot 2 (ONDERGRAAD)
af.summary: Lektor in Verpleegkunde (Graad 1 tot 2) vir voorgraadse programme by Boland/Overberg, Southern Cape Karoo en Metro Campus in die Western Cape.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880 plus R254) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC in Verpleegkunde-onderwys (R212) geakkrediteer is. Of 'n 4-jarige Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC in Verpleegkunde-onderwys geakkrediteer is. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegkundige ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verwerwing van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Beskik oor goeie kommunikasie (geskrewe en mondelingse) en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Beskik oor kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing, wette, voorskrifte en beleidsraamwerke wat die bedryfsarea onderlê. Kennis van verpleegkunde-onderwysprogramme en kurrikulum. Bedrewenheid in onderrig en assessering in Verpleegkunde-onderwys, insluitend evalueringsbenaderings. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling, -interpretasie, -implementering, -monitering en -evaluering. Boonste konflikbestuur en besluitneming/probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie navorsings- en analitiese vaardighede. Goeie bestuurs- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf onderwys en opleiding aan studenteverpleegkundiges. Koördineer kliniese leersblootstelling aan studente tussen kollege en kliniese areas. Voer kliniese begeleiding van studente uit. Koördineer die onderrig en leer van verpleegkunde-programme. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van gehaltversekeringsprogramme. Werk saam met ander interne en eksterne belanghebbendes en bou 'n gesonde verhouding binne die Departement. Toesig oor studente. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en hersiening van verpleegkundige kurrikula vir Voorgraadse Diploma-programme. Implementeer die nuwe verpleegkunde-programme in ooreenstemming met SANC- en CHE-regulasies. Neem deel aan die voorsiening van Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling (DPO)-aktiwiteite by die Campus. Neem deel aan alle bestuursstrukture van die Kollege. Ondersteun die missie en bevorder die beeld van die Kollege.

zu.title: Onjengzincwadi wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-2 (UNDERGRADUATE)
zu.summary: Onjengzincwadi wezokwelapha (Izinga 1 kuya ku-2) ohlelweni lweziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu eziphakeme kuyo yonke i-Boland/Overberg, i-Southern Cape Karoo ne-Metro Campus e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi komgwaqo wezemfundo: Ikhwalifikheshini ye-Basic R425 (okusho idiploma/iziqu zobuchwepheshe noma iziqu eziphakeme kwezokwelapha) noma ikhwalifikheshini ekwelayo (R683 okanye R880 okanye R254) evumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogesiwe wezokwelapha. Ikhwalifikheshini yokwelapha ngemva kweziqu eziphakeme enesikhathi esingabhali ngaphansi konyaka unyaka ogunyaziwe yi-SANC eMfundeni yezokwelapha (R212). Noma Iziqu eziphakeme ziningi ezingamashumi amane wezokwelapha (R174) noma ikhwalifikheshini ekwelayo (R683 okanye R1497 noma R171 okanye R1497) evumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogesiwe wezokwelapha. Idiploma yokufunda ngemva kweziqu eziphakeme (R635) egunyaziwe yi-SANC eMfundeni yezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa ekhansini lwebangcla: Ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogesiwe wezokwelapha. Isiphephelo: Izinga 1: Ukutholwa kweminye eminingi yonke emihlanu yokwelapha okulinganyelwe/okuhlonishwe emva kokubhalisa njengogesiwe wezokwelapha ku-SANC eNakweni jikelele. Izinga 2: Ukutholwa kweminye eminingi yonke eyishumi nane yokwelapha okulinganyelwe/okuhlonishwe emva kokubhalisa njengogesiwe wezokwelapha ku-SANC eNakweni jikelele. Ubcane isikhathi esingaphezulu kweminye eyishumi kwesikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele kube ukwelapha okulinganyelwe/okuhlonishwe emva kokuthola ikhwalifikheshini yokwelapha ngemva kweziqu eziphakeme noma idiploma yokufunda ngemva kweziqu eziphakeme kwesigaba esihlukile. Isidingo sokwaziswa ngaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (i-Code B/EB) ekuqinisekisiwe. Ukuqiniseka ukuthanda ukuhamba. Ukusebenza (ulwazi/amasu): Ukuqonqoza obala ngokuxoxa (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa) namasu okubonisa. Ukuba nolwazi lwe-Mthetho, i-Acts, i-Prescripts nezinhlelo zomgwaqo ezihlolisisa indawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zemfundo yezokwelapha nesifundo. Ubuchwepheshe ekufundiseni nokuhlola kuMfundo yezokwelapha okuhlanganisa namasu okuhlola. Ulwazi lokuthuthukisa, ukuhumusha, ukuphatha, ukubuka nokuhlola izinhlelo zomgwaqo. Amasu obala okulawula ingxabano nokwenza izinqumo/ukuxazulula izinkinga. Amasu obala okucwaninga nokuhlaziya. Amasu obala okuphatha nokuxhumana nabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nika imfundo nokwelatwa abafundi bezokwelapha. Hlelela okubonakalayo ukufunda kwabafathi kubhaliselwe emkhakheni wezokwelapha phakathi kwekolishi nezindawo zokwelapha. Qondanisa abafathi ukuba balandelwe ezindaweni zokwelapha. Hlelela ukufundisa nokufunda kwezinhlelo ezokwelapha. Thuthukisa futhi uqinisekise ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo eziqinisekisiwe. Sebenzisana nabanye abaphathi abangaphakathi nangaphandle futhi wakhe ubuhlobo obuhle kuleyo Ministry. Ukuqondanisa abafundi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni nokubuyekezwa izifundo zezokwelapha kwezinhlelo ze-Diploma ezingaphansi kweziqu eziphakeme. Phathisa izinhlelo ezintsha zezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nemithetho ye-SANC ne-CHE. Thatha inxaxheba ekunikezeni izenzo zokuqina ukuthuthuka kakhulu (CPD) e-Campus. Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke izakhiwo zokuphatha iKolishi. Sekela umnyakato womsebenzi futhi ukhuthaze isithombe seKolishi.

xh.title: Onyathi woMsebenzi woKongikazi Isidanga 1 ukuya ku 2 (ABAFUNDI ABANGAKAFUMANGA IZIDANGA)
xh.summary: Onyathi (Lecturer) woMsebenzi woKongikazi (Isidanga 1 ukuya kwi 2) weenkqubo zabafundi abangakafumanga izidanga kumajoni anjengeBoland/Overberg, iSouthern Cape Karoo neMetro Campus eWestern Cape.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingowona sifundo esingaphantsi: Isidanga seR425 esisisiseko (okt. idiploma/isidanga ekuqwalaselweni kwabongikazi) okt isidanga esilinganayo (R683 ngaphezu kwe R880 ngaphezu kwe R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqirha woMsebenzi woKongikazi. Isidanga sobugqirha bokongikazi esimva kwesidanga nangesithuba esinganyakuliyo unyaka o-1 esamkelwe yi SANC ekuqwalaselweni koMsebenzi woKongikazi (R212). Okt Isidanga seBachelor seminyaka emi-4 ekuqwalaselweni kwabongikazi (R174) okt isidanga esilinganayo (R683 ngaphezu kwe R1497 okt R171 ngaphezu kwe R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqirha woMsebenzi woKongikazi. Idiploma yemfundo ephakamileyo (R635) esamkelwe yi SANC ekuqwalaselweni koMsebenzi woKongikazi. Ukubhalisa kwikhorum yabasebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqirha woMsebenzi woKongikazi. Iimfundo zokusebenza: Isidanga 1: Ukuba nakho isipilo esingaphantsi kweminyaka emi-4 esifanelekileyo/ esiyaziwayo sokongikazi emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha woMsebenzi woKongikazi kwi SANC kuqwalaselwa lwaMantla woKongikazi. Isidanga 2: Ukuba nakho isipilo esingaphantsi kweminyaka eli-14 esifanelekileyo/ esiyaziwayo sokongikazi emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha woMsebenzi woKongikazi kwi SANC kuqwalaselwa lwaMantla woKongikazi. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 edxelwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe yisipilo esifanelekileyo/ esiyaziwayo emva kokuqokelela isidanga sobugqirha esimva kwesidanga esingunyaka o-1 okt idiploma yemfundo ephakamileyo kulawulo oluchanekileyo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zendlela yomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukulungele ukuhamba. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuba nolwimi oluluhle (olubhalwayo noluthethwayo) nolwazi lokuncomisa. Ulwazi ngeMigaqo-nkqubo, uMthetho, iMiyalelo namaCandiso osiko ecela indlela esebenza kuyo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokongikazi nokulinganisa inkqubo yemfundo. Ukuba nabuchule bokufundisa nokulinganisa kuMsebenzi woKongikazi kuquka iindlela zokuqwalasela. Ulwazi ngophuqo, incazelo, ukuphunyezwa, ukuqwalaselwa, nokulinganiswa kweemigaqo-nkqubo. Amakhono amaninzi wokulawula iingxabano nokwenza izigqibo/ ukusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono amaninzi wophando nokuqwalasela. Amakhono amaninzi okulawula nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika izifundo nolungelelwaniso kwabafundi abafundela ukuba ngabongikazi. Linganisela isipilo sokufunda ngokwesibini esebenzayo kwabafundi phakathi kwekholeji nendawo esebenzayo. Yenza ukulandelela ngokwesibini koosapho kwabafundi. Linganisela ukufundisa nokufunda kweenkqubo zokongikazi. Phepha nokuba nakho ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ziqinisekiso lwemigangatho. Sebenzisana namanye amahlathi angaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze wakhe ubudlelwane obuqinileyo ngaphakathi kwiSebe. Ulawulo abafundi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphepheni nokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo zokongikazi zeDiploma yabafundi abangakafumanga izidanga. Phumeza iinkqubo ezintsha zokongikazi ngokwemigaqo ye SANC ne CHE. Thatha inxaxheba ekuboneleleni ngeziseko zenkqubo zoPhuhliso olusoloko luxhaphaka (CPD) kwiKhabhisi. Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke iinkqubo zolawulo zeKholeji. Sekela injongo yakumbi uze unyuse isithombe-sicwangciso seKholeji.

zu.requirements: Izifundo ezidingekayo ezisezingeni elincane: I- National Diploma noma i- Degree ezifanele yeminyaka engu-3. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni nokwazi okufanele ekuphathweni kwamasevisi okusekelo ngokubhekisela ekuphathweni kwabantu, kwezezimali nakokwenza izinto ngomzila wokusabalalisa kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza kanye nokuqapha. jobs.title: Occupational Therapist Grade 1 to 3 (MENTAL Health)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Occupational Therapist needed for community mental health services across Grades 1 to 3 at the Southern Western Sub-Structure Office in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Occupational Therapist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Occupational Therapist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist. One-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist. Minimum of 11-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist. Minimum of 21-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good interpersonal and communication skills. Computer literate (Microsoft Office). Knowledge of PFMA, Ideal Clinic, and other relevant policies, protocols, and guidelines. Ability to work within a multidisciplinary team to ensure holistic care. Report writing skills. Analytic thinking, independent decision-making and problem-solving skills. Experience in community Occupational Therapy services. Must be proactive, innovative and an independent team leader. Experience in setting up treatment programs within a PHC setting. Knowledge of mental health legislations and related legal and ethical practices. Knowledge of public service acts and regulations.
jobs.duties: Assessment and treatment of community mental health patients. Contribute to the development and implementation of Occupational Therapy programs in the community. Follow the relevant policies and SOPs within the Occupational Therapy field. Administrative duties. Develop objectives and action plans for own area of work. Co-ordination of services in the district. Contribution to the awareness, promotion of mental health, and prevention of mental illness.
jobs.enquiries: Mr B Van Der Schyff Tel No: (021) 799-1103
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. zu.title: Therapist Yomsebenzi Wezinga 1 kuye ku-3 (EZEMLINI EKHANAYO)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Therapist Yomsebenzi wesevisi yezempilo yezengqondo emphakathini kuzo zonke izinga 1 kuye ku-3 eNdiweni ye-Southern Western Sub-Structure Office e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane semfundo: Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi. Ukubhalisa komhlaba wonke jikelele: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho esidingekile ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi. Unyaka oyisikhombisa wokuzijwayela emsebenzini ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi yamava ahambisana nomsebenzi ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi. Okungenani unyaka owungiyikhomba elilodwa lokuzijwayela emsebenzini ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi yamava ahambisana nomsebenzi ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi. Okungenani unyaka owungamashumi amabili nalodwa wamava ahambisana nomsebenzi ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Therapist Yomsebenzi mayelana nabasebenzi abathweswe iziqu kwamanye amazwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibangelwe umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esevisayo. Amandla okusebenza (ulwazi/izakhono): Amandla ahle ekuxhumaneni nabantu nasekukhulumeni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomyutha (Microsoft Office). Ulwazi ngo-PFMA, Ideal Clinic, namanye emikhakheni ebandakanya imithetho yolwazi, amandla abantu, nemibandela ephathelene nomsebenzi kahulumeni, nemigomo. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba elinabantu abambalwa ukunakekelwa okuphelele. Amandla ekuqopha imibiko. Ukucabanga ngesimo somuntu ngamunye, ukuzimisela ukwenza izinqumo, kanye namandla okuxazulula izinkinga. Isipiliyoni ekunikezeni isevisi ka-Therapist Yomsebenzi emphakathini. Ukuba ngumuntu ongathathi hlangothi, onesibindi, futhi engumholi othimba langaphandle. Isipiliyoni ekwakheni izinhlelo zokwelapha endaweni yokunakekelwa kwesikhathi esibambezelekile. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezempilo yezengqondo nemikhakha ephathelene nemitsetfo nemigiqelo. Ulwazi ngomthetho kahulumeni nemikhakha ephathelene nemitsetfo yomsebenzi kahulumeni.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola nokwelapha abaguli bezimpilo yezengqondo emphakathini. Ukufaka isandla ekwakheni nasekuphumeleleni izinhlelo zokusebenza komuntu siqu emphakathini. Ukulandela imithetho nemikhakha ephathelene nomsebenzi kahulumeni kanye nemigiqelo emkhakheni ka-Therapist Yomsebenzi. Imisebenzi yokulawula imibhalo kahulumeni. Ukuqamba imigiqelo nokubeka izinhlelo zokusebenza esibangeni sakho. Ukulawula imisebenzi kahulumeni kanye nokuqonda imithetho yolwazi kahulumeni. Ukufaka isandla ekwaziseni abantu ngomsebenzi kahulumeni.
