af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Ondersteuningsdienste (REPSIE)
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte benodig by Khayelitsha CHC om registerdienste te koördineer en ontvangsadministrasie te bestuur, met 'n Senior Sertifikaat en tersaaklike ondervinding as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ondervinding: Geskikte administratiewe en toesighoudende ondervinding in ontvangs. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Beskikbaarheid na kantoorure om administratiewe ondersteuning vir skofpersoneel te verskaf. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Sterke leierskapsvermoëns om korrektheid van werk te verseker. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). PHCIS, afspraakstelsel en duplikasieverslae. Uitgebreide kennis van Clinicom/PHCIS.
af.duties: Koördineer registerdienste en vouerbestuur van die fasiliteit. bestuur, bestuur en ontwikkel ontvangsadministrasie, insluitend die verwelkomings-hulptoonbankklerk met betrekking tot rekordhouding, klagtebestuur, skakelbordbedryf, vouerhigiëne en die bedryf van die pasiëntregistrasiestelsel. Verantwoordelik vir MVA-eise, J88. Ondersteun die fasiliteitsbestuurder en lynbestuurders met betrekking tot die administratiewe bestuur van die ontvangs, rekordbestuur, argivering en beskikking en inkomste_generering. Ondersteun met infrastruktuur, IT-toerusting en bates en dien daaglikse statistiek in. Bestuur HR-funksies, SPMS, opleiding van ondergeskiktes, verlofadministrasie diensroosters, oortyd, en help met Arbeidsverhoudinge.

zu.title: Iofisa Olawula: Izenkonzo Zokusekela (UKWAMUKELA)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Iofisa Olawula e-Khayelitsha CHC ukuba ahlozonze izinkonzo zeregistry aze aphathe ukuphatwa kokwamukela, kudingwa i-Senior Certificate nomuhla obonakalayo wokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esiphansi semfundo: i-Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo). Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanele sokuphatha nokubukeka kokwamukela. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha (Code B/EB) evumelekile. Ukubaitholakala emva kwezihora ukuze kunikezwe inkxaso yolawula abasebenzi beshifti. Amandla (ulwazi/ikhono): Amakhono amahle okuxhumana. Amandla amakhulu okuhola ukuze kuqiniseke ukulungiswa komsebenzi. Ulwazi olugqamile lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). I-PHCIS, isistimu yezinsuku zokubonisana nokubika okuphindiwe. Ulwazi olunzulu nge-Clinicom/PHCIS.
zu.duties: Hlozonza izinkonzo zeregistry nolawulwamafolda kwesisiphakamisi. Qapha, phatha futhi uthuthukise ukuphatwa kokwamukela, okuhlanganisa noKlerki wesikhululo sokwamukela ngokuqondene nokugcina amarekhodi, ukuphatwa kwezimala, ukusebenza kweswitchboard, ukuhlanzwa kwamafolda nokusebenzisa isistimu yokuqasha iziguli. Uxulumene namaphuzu e-MVA, i-J88. Siza umPhathi wesisiphakamisi nabaphathi beKhondo ngokuqondene nolawulo lolawula lokwamukela, ukuphathwa kwamarekhodi, ukugcina nokuqamula izinto, nokukhiqiza imali. Siza nokuqashwa kohlakalomnotho nokuqashwa kwamapulanga, futhi uhambise izibalo nsuku zonke. Phatha imisebenzi ye-HR, i-SPMS, ukuqeqesha abangaphansi kwakho, ukuphatha ukhishi, amashejuli wemisebenzi, njll. futhi usize nokuqondaniswa nokuqashwa.

xh.title: Iofisa Ozelweyo: Iinkonzo zoXhaso (UKWAMKELWA ABANTU)
xh.summary: Kufuneka iOfisa Ozelweyo eKhayelitsha CHC ukulungisa iinkonzo zeregistry nokulawula ulawulo lokwamkelwa kwabantu, kwaye kudingwa iSenior Certificate nemvelaphi efanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokuphela esingaphantsi: iSenior Certificate (okanye okulinganayo). Imvelaphi: Imvelaphi efanelekileyo yolawulo nokulawula kokwamkelwa kwabantu. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukufumaneka emva kweyure zomsebenzi ukuze kunikezelwe inkxaso yolawulo kubasebenzi bashukuma. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaziko): Amakhono obulumko alungileyo. Amakhono obuqukuquli amakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchaneka komsebenzi. Ukuba gushele kakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Iinkcazelo zePHCIS, indlela yokubiza umhla nesinxibo ephindwe kabini. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeClinicom/PHCIS.
xh.duties: Lungisa iinkonzo zeregistry nokulawula iifolda kwisikhululo. Lawula, phatha uphuhlise ulawulo lokwamkelwa kwabantu, kuquka nomncedisi wekhusi lokwamkela malunga nokugcina iirekhodi, ulawulo lwezinto ezingamkelwanga ngokwemigaqo, ukuqhuba iswithibhodi, ukucoca iifolda nokuqhuba inkqubo yobhaliso lwabaguli. Phendula ngemityalelo yeMVA, iJ88. Ncedisa uMphathi wesikhululo namaManabala eMigca malunga nolawulo lolawulo lokwamkelwa kwabantu, ulawulo lweekhodi, ukugcina iifayile ezindala noku zalahla nokwenza imali. Ncedisa ngenzululwazi, iqedo lekhompyutha namaxhapho mali uze unikeze izibalo zemihla ngemihla. Lawula imisebenzi yeHR, iSPMS, uqeqesho labo bekusezantsi, ulawulo lwamalanga okuhlala, uluhlu lomsebenzi wemihla, amaxesha amaninzi, uncedise nokuQwalasela uBudlelwane.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Information Management
jobs.summary: Administrative officer needed in Khayelitsha to coordinate health statistics, data verification and facility audits within the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in Information Management. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) drivers’ licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills (written and verbal) in at least two of the three official languages of the Western Cape. Good working knowledge and experience in Health Information System (SINJANI; PHCIS; IDEAL CLINIC MONITORING SYSTEM & DHIS). Advanced computer literacy in MS Windows (Word and Excel, Power Point & Outlook). Logical thinker, with an eye for detail and ability to produce accurate and reliable outputs within a pressured and deadline driven environment.
jobs.duties: Co-Ordinate all health statistics in sub-structure. Data verification and submission to district information office in prescribed format, within set time frames and according to the Information Management Policy. Conduct and assist with audits at facility level. Participate in Sub-structure health information co-ordinating activities. Supervision and staff performance management. Information management support to all health facilities within sub-structure.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be required to undergo a competency assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Inligtingsbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte benodig in Khayelitsha om gesondheidsstatistieke, dataverifikasie en fasiliteitsoudits binne die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Inligtingsbestuur. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling) in ten minste twee van die drie amptelike tale van die Wes-Kaap. Goeie werkkennis en ervaring in Health Information System (SINJANI; PHCIS; IDEAL CLINIC MONITORING SYSTEM & DHIS). Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Windows (Word and Excel, Power Point & Outlook). Logiese denker, met 'n oog vir detail en die vermoë om akkurate en betroubare uitkomste binne 'n druk- en sperdatuurgedrewe omgewing te lewer.
af.duties: Koördineer alle gesondheidsstatistieke in sub-struktuur. Dataverifikasie en voorlegging aan distriksinligtingskantoor in voorgeskrewe formaat, binne vasgestelde tydraamwerke en volgens die Inligtingsbestuurbeleid. Voer oudits op fasiliteitsvlak uit en help daarmee. Neem deel aan sub-struktuur se gesondheidsinligtingskoördineringsaktiwiteite. Toesig en werknemersprestasiebestuur. Inligtingsbestuuronsisteun aan alle gesondheidsfasiliteite binne sub-struktuur.

zu.title: Ofisa wezokuphatha: Ukuphathwa Kwaziswa
zu.summary: Kudingeka ofisa wezokuphatha eKhayelitsha ukuze ahlonze izibalo zempi, ukuqinisekisa idatha nokwenza ukuvivinywa kwendawo ngaphakathi kweWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesibali: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme (noma okulinganayo). Isiphalo: Isiphalo esifanele ekuqondweni kwezokwaziswa. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Isilayisense lesipokuqamba (Code B/EB) esivumelekile. Ukuziqoqa ngezindlela zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/indlela yokusebenza): Ukukhuluma kahle (okubhaliwe nasezweni) ezilwini ezisemthethweni ezintathu zaseningizimuntshaNgcolosi ezingeni elifingqiwe. Ukuqonda kahle nendlela yokusebenza ngesiphalo Esimo Isixhumanisi sezibalo zempi (HIS; PHCIS; IDEAL CLINIC MONITORING SYSTEM no DHIS). Ulwazi lwesigaxa eliphezulu ngokusikatara kwi-MS Windows (Word; Excel; PowerPoint no Outlook). Ukucabanga ngenqondo enophawu, nokuba nendlela yokubuka izinto ngosobuco futhi nokugqamisa okunembile nokethwe okuhambisana namandla kanye nokugqamisa okulawulwa yisikhathi esibekiwe.
zu.duties: Ukucotha zonke izibalo zezempilo esakhiweni esincane. Ukuqinisekisa idatha nokuyinikela ofisini yezokwaziswa yesifunda ngesakhiwo esibekiwe, phakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe nangokuvumelana neNqubomgomo Yokuphathwa Kwaziswa. Ukuqhuba futhi usize ngevivinyo nazinga ezindaweni ezinempilo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yokuhlomleka kokwaziswa ngezempilo esakhiweni esincane. Ukugcina iliso nokuphathwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ukusekelwa kokuphathwa kwaziswa kuzo zonke izindawo zezempilo ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esincane.

xh.title: Ofisa Wezolawulo: Ulawulo Lwolwazi
xh.summary: Kufuneka kufunwe ofisa wolawulo e Khayelitsha ukwenzisa ulungelelwaniso lwezibalo zempilo, ukuqinisekisa iingcombolo nokwenziwa kwezihloko zeziko kwi Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esincinane semfundo: Isatifikethi esiPhakamileyo (okwa silinganayo). Imfundo: Isipilo esifanelekileyo kwi Ulawulo Lwolwazi. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zendima: Ilayisenisi yokushuka (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuzenzela ngamandla (ulwazi/amaxabiso): Amaxabiso amaninzi okunyaniselelwa (okubhaliweyo nokusithethwayo) sani ngosuku oluninzi kwezilumko ezintathu ezisesikhundleni sika Western Cape. Ulwazi olusebenzayo olulungileyo nemfundo kwi Health Information System (SINJANI; PHCIS; IDEAL CLINIC MONITORING SYSTEM & DHIS). Ulwazi oluphakamileyo lwekhompyutha kwi MS Windows (Word and Excel, Power Point & Outlook). Umthandi olulaqatayo oneliso lokucuka nangamandla okukhiqiza iziphumo ezichanekileyo nethembekileyo kwindawo egcwele ingcindezi ehamba ngexesha elifunekayo.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa zonke izibalo zempilo kwisakhiwo esingaphakathi. Ukuqinisekisa iingcombolo nokuzinika kwindlu yolwazi wesithili ngendlela efunekayo, phakathi kwexesha elihleliweyo nangokulandela iNkulumbulo kaHulumeni yokuLawula iNkcazelo. Ukwenza kwaye uncede ngokhetho kwinqanaba leziko. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiindbanrobo zolwazi ngeenjongo ezahlukeneyo zempilo kwisakhiwo. Ukulawula nolawulo lwemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Ukuxhasa ulawulo iNkcazelo zonke izindlu ezingagqitywa kwisakhiwo esingaphakathi.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL: Surgery Female)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 sought for the female surgery ward at Paarl Hospital, requiring SANC registration and a nursing diploma or degree.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 3 year Diploma in Nursing (R171) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS A General Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse or General Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts, night duty, overtime, public holidays and weekends. Willingness to rotate to other wards in the facility excluding maternity. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of Nursing Care processes and procedures Nursing Act. Problem solving and decision-making. Report writing skills. Good interpersonal skills. Health promotion and team building.
jobs.duties: Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan (clinical practice or patient care). Implement standards, practices, criteria, and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. -Maintain constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. -Utilise human, material, and physical resources efficiently and effectively.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S Arendse Tel No: (021) 860-2564 or email: Stephanie.Arendse@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). The pool of applicants will be considered for similar vacant posts within Chief Directorate: Metro Health Services for a period of 3 months from date of advert. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Profesionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3 (ALGEMEEN: Heelkunde Vroulik)
af.summary: Profesionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3 gesoek vir die vroulike heelkundesaal by Paarl Hospital, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n verpleegkundediploma of -graad vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Profesionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. OF 'n 4 jaar Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Profesionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. OF 'n 3 jaar Diploma in Verpleegkunde (R171) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Profesionele Verpleegkundige of Algemene Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Profesionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Profesionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Profesionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte, nagdiens, oortyd, openbare vakansiedae en naweke te werk. Bereidwilligheid om na ander sale in die fasiliteit te roteer, met uitsondering van verloskunde. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures Nursing Act. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Goie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Gesondheidsbevordering en spanbou.
af.duties: Verskaf leiding en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk of pasiëntesorg). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (gehalte van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat relevant is tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. -Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. -Benut menslike, materiaal- en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief.

zu.title: INesi ePhathamthetho Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (OKUQOBE: Ukuhlinzwa Kwesifazane)
zu.summary: Kufunwa iNesi ePhathamthetho Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 kwesibaya sabesifazane sokuhlinzwa ePaarl Hospital, idinga ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nediploma noma iziqu zesondlo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi: Ithuluzi eliyisisekelo le-R425 (okt. idiploma/iziqu ksondlo) noma okulinganayo (R683) okuvumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiHlengikazi esiphathamthetho. Noma Iziqu zeBachelor zeminyaka engu-4 eziNgqiningweni zoSonddlo (R174) ezivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiHlengikazi esiphathamthetho. Noma Idiploma yeminyaka engu-3 eziNgqiningweni zoSonddlo (R171) ezivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiHlengikazi jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kwabaphathi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengesiHlengikazi esiphathamthetho noma esiHlengikazi jikelele. Okuhlangenwe nakho: Izinga 1: Akukho okuhlangenwe nakho emva kokuqashwa njengesiHlengikazi esiphathamthetho kwi-SANC ekuSonddlweni jikelele. Izinga 2: Uuncobo ongaphansi kwawo weminyaka eyi-10 wokuhlangenwa nakho okufanele/okuqashwayo esondlweni emva kokuqashwa njengesiHlengikazi esiphathamthetho kwi-SANC ekuSonddlweni jikelele. Izinga 3: Uuncobo ongaphansi kwawo weminyaka engu-20 wokuhlangenwa nakho okufanele/okuqashwayo esondlweni emva kokuqashwa njengesiHlengikazi esiphathamthetho kwi-SANC ekuSonddlweni jikelele. Isidingo esingokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ukuthanda ukusebenza ngokushintshana, ubusuku, amahora amaningi, izinsuku zomphakathi namasonto. Ukuthanda ukujika kwezinye iziguli kolunye uhlangothi lwezinsizakalo ngaphandle kwababelethi. Izinkomba (ulwazi/izinhlakalo): Ulwazi lwezinhlaka zokunakekelwa ksondlo Nomthetho weSonddlo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu. Ukukhuthaza impilo nokwakha ithim.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso nobuqwempile ekusebenziseni uhlelo lwesondlo (izinzigaba zokwelapha noma ukunakekelwa kwesiguli). Sebenziza amazinga, izindlela, izindlela zokuqinisekisa, nezinkomba zesondlo esingcono (isimo sokusebenza). Yenza isondlo nokunakekelwa kwempilo ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemithesho ehlobene nalesondlo nokunakekelwa kwempilo. -Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabasebenzi basondlo nabanye abahlanganyeli. -Sebenzisa ngempumelelo nangokusebenzayo izinsizakalo zomuntu, izinto, nezinsiza eziyingqayizivele.

xh.title: Ummathi weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (Jikelele: Ukulaliswa kwabafazi)
xh.summary: Kufunwa ummathi weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 wesebe lokulaliswa kwabafazi esibhedlele sePaarl, kufuneka abhalwe kwiSANC abe nediploma okanye idigri yokuhlola.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esibi sekuncinane: Isifundo seR425 esisisiseko (okt idiploma/idigri yokuhlola) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalwa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengommati weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu. OKUZE Idigri yobuxhwebebeke beMinyaka emi-4 yokuhlola (R174) evumela ukubhalwa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengommati weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu. OKUZE Idiploma yobuxhwebebeke beMinyaka emi-3 yokuhlola (R171) evumela ukubhalwa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) NJENGE Mali yoQeqesho eJikelele. Ukubhalwa kwisikolo sommathi: Ukubhalwa kwiSANC njengommati weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu okanye iMali yoQeqesho eJikelele. Isipili: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhaliswa njengommati weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu kwiSANC kuQeqesho eJikelele. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi efunekayo/eyaziwayo yokuhlola emva kokubhaliswa njengommati weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu kwiSANC kuQeqesho eJikelele. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinesibhozo efunekayo/eyaziwayo yokuhlola emva kokubhaliswa njengommati weMali yoQeqesho eliphezulu kwiSANC kuQeqesho eJikelele. Iminikelo edityaniswe nomsebenzi: Ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza ngokutshintshiselana, isebeni esibusuku, ixesha elingaphezu kwalo, iintsuku zihlola abantu nakumaqabane. Ulungelelwaniso lokujikelezwa kumanye amasebe endawo ngaphandle kwesebe lokubeletha. Ukuzingela kolwazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngokuqhuba iinkqubo zempatho yokuhlola kunye noMthetho woQeqesho. Ukuze usombulule iingxaki uthathe izigqibo. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono amabalengatya phakathi kwabantu. Ukukhuthaza impilo nokwakha iqela.
xh.duties: Nikezela isalathiso nomphatho kumalungiselelo apho kuqwalaselwa imeko yokugqitha (ukukhathaleka okusebenzayo okanye ukhathaleko lomntu). Zonke iinkqubo, iindlela, iindidi, kunye nemibhalo yemigaqo yokuqinisekisa ukhathaleko olusemthethweni. Phatha ukhathaleko lwesigulo nakwimpilo ngokuthobela imithetho namagunya anxulumene nokukhathaleka kwesigulo nakwimpilo. -Gcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo phakathi kwamahlola nabanye abanomdla. -Sebenzisa abantu, izinto, neziseko ngokuchanekileyo ngokufanelekileyo nakwakhona.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL: Palliative Care)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Palliative Care) sought for Paarl Hospital, requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 3 year Diploma in Nursing (R171) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS A General Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse or General Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work overtime as or when required. Willingness to undergo palliative care training. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent theoretical and clinical knowledge in general nursing and experience in/ knowledgeable about palliative care. Passionate about palliative care. Flexible, responsive, critical and creative thinking, complex problem-solving skills, ability to work collaboratively within the MDT and between internal and external teams. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the provision of holistic institutional nursing care to patients in an environment which promotes core values and human dignity. Ensure that quality of nursing care is facilitated cost effectively, efficiently and equitable whilst at the same time ensuring compliance to the requirements of professional and ethical practices. Ensure realisation of strategic goals and objectives of the Palliative unit with regards to inpatient and outpatient care. Ensure supportive role from ward staff i.r.o end of life patients, receiving and referrals of patients, performing patient assessments and ensuring patients and appropriately managed and monitored by mentoring and guiding ward staff appropriately. Ensure that effective health promotion and comprehensive health care are in place for treatment of patients and ensure the effective utilisation of resources to provide quality and sustainable patient care. Coordination of relevant monthly meetings, liaising and communication with the multi-disciplinary teams, effective utilisation of training and research opportunities and effective administrative management of reporting on Palliative care.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3 (ALGEMEEN: Palliatiewe Sorg)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Palliatiewe Sorg) gesoek vir Paarl Hospital, wat 'n verpleegdiploma of -graad met SANC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 4 jaar Bachelorsgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 3 jaar Diploma in Verpleegkunde (R171) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige of Algemene Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike / erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk soos of wanneer vereis. Bereidwilligheid om palliatiewe sorg-opleiding te ondergaan. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende teoretiese en kliniese kennis in algemene verpleegkunde en ervaring in/kennis oor palliatiewe sorg. Passievol oor palliatiewe sorg. Buigsaam, reageer, kritiese en kreatiewe denke, komplekse probleemoplossingsvaardighede, vermoë om saam te werk binne die MDT en tussen interne en eksterne spanne. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die verskaffing van holistiese instituisionele verpleegsorg aan pasiënte in 'n omgewing wat kernwaardes en menswaardigheid bevorder. Verseker dat kwaliteit verpleegsorg koste-doeltreffend, doeltreffend en billik gefasiliteer word terwyl daar terselfdertyd verseker word dat daar voldoen word aan die vereistes van professionele en etiese praktyke. Verseker verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die Palliatiewe eenheid met betrekking tot inpasient- en buitepasientsorg. Verseker 'n ondersteunende rol deur saalpersoneel ten opsigte van pasiënte aan die einde van die lewe, die ontvangs en verwysings van pasiënte, die uitvoer van pasiëntevaluasies en verseker dat pasiënte behoorlik bestuur en gemonitor word deur saalpersoneel op gepaste wyse te mentor en te lei. Verseker dat doeltreffende gesondheidsbevordering en omvattende gesondheidsorg in plek is vir die behandeling van pasiënte en verseker die doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne om gehalte en volhoubare pasiëntsorg te verskaf. Koördinering van tersaaklike maandelikse vergaderings, skakeling en kommunikasie met die multidissiplinêre spanne, doeltreffende benutting van opleidings- en navorsingsgeleenthede en doeltreffende administratiewe bestuur van verslagdoening oor Palliatiewe sorg.

zu.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL: Palliative Care)
zu.summary: Kufunwa ugqwayi oyingcweti (Ukunakekela abasafela) iPaarl Hospital, okudinga idiploma noma izinga lokubhengqabungcweti ngokubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo eyingowona isisekelo: Isibonakaliso se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/izinga ezobungcweti) noma isibonakaliso esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqwayi oyingcweti. Noma Izinga le-Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) leminyaka engu-4 elivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqwayi oyingcweti. Noma Idiploma ye-Diploma in Nursing (R171) leminyaka engu-3 elivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqwayi jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kubungcweti: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqwayi oyingcweti noma njengogqwayi jikelele. Isipiliyoni: Grade 1: Akukho. Grade 2: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele / esaziwayo ezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqwayi oyingcweti kwe-General Nursing. Grade 3: Ubuncane beminyaka engu-20 yesipiliyoni esifanele / esaziwayo ezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqwayi oyingcweti kwe-General Nursing. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngehora elengeziwe noma lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuzithoba ukuba nesifundo sezokunakekela abasafela. Izindlela ezingamandla (ulwazi/amazwana): Ulwazi oluhle lobuchwepheshe nolwesibhedlela ezokwelapha jikelele kanye nesipiliyoni ekunakeni / ulwazi ngemisa yokunakekela abasafela. Inkundla enkulu ngemisa yokunakekela abasafela. Ukuba guquguquki, ukuphendula, ukucabanga ngokubaluleka, ukucabanga ngezindlela ezisha, izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi, ikhono lokusebenza ndawonye ngaphakathi kwe-MDT kanye nakumaqembu angaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Yenza kube lula ukunikezwa kwemisa yonke yezokwelapha kwesibhedlela kubafundi esimeni esikhuthaza amagugu okuyisisekelo nenhlonipho yomuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi ikhwalithi yezokwelapha inikezwa ngendlela ehamba phambili ngezindleko, ngokusebenza kahle nangokulingana, ngenkathi kunqunywa ukuthi kuhambiswa nemithetho yezokusebenza ezingowobungcweti nenyama. Qinisekisa ukufeza kwemigomo nezinhloso zokuqondisa mayelana nokunakekelwa kwabaguli baphakathi nababuya esibhedlela ngesikhungo esinakekela abasafela. Qinisekisa indima yokweseka abasebenzi begumbi lokulala mayelana nabafundi abaseduze nokuphela kwempilo, ukwamukela nokuthumela abafundi, ukwenza isilinganiso sabafundi nokubaqinisekisa ukuthi banakekelwa futhi balawulwa ngokufanele ngokuba yisibonelo nokuhola abasebenzi begumbi lokulala. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukukhuthazwa kwempilo yezempilo elula kanye nenakekelo lempilo elibanzi ekwelapheni abafundi, futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwemithombo ukuze kunikezwe inakekelo elicwengile futhi elihlala njalo labafundi. Ukuhlelela kwezinkomfa zanyanga zonke ezihlobene, ukuxhumana nokuthi ukhulume namaqembu ahlukene abasebenzi, ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwamathuba okufundisa nokwatuhlasiso, kanye nokuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezomlawulo ekubikeni ngemisa yokunakekela abasafela.

xh.title: Umhlali kahle Ngqaqambo le 1 ukuya ku-3 (JIKOLO: Ukunyamekela okuzithibela)
xh.summary: Kufuneki abe ngumhlali kahle (Ukunyamekela okuzithibela) kwiPitoli yasePaarl, afuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwezohamba nabantu kunye nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
xh.requirements: Iminyakulo yemfundo ebalulekileyo: Isigqibo se-Basic R425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/isidanga kwezohamba nabantu) okanye isigqibo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlali kahle. OKANJE Isidanga seBachelor iNyaka 4 kwezohamba nabantu (R174) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlali kahle. OKANJE Idiploma iNyaka 3 kwezohamba nabantu (R171) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) NJENGESENKUNDLA jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kwibhunga lemigangatho: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlali kahle okanye unesiNkundla jikelele. Iimfundo zokusebenza: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka elishumi ubuncinane ebalulekileyo / ekuqondwayo yemisebenzi kwezohamba nabantu emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlali kahle kwezoHamba nabantu jikelele. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka amashumi amabini ubuncinane ebalulekileyo/ekuqondwayo yemisebenzi kwezohamba nabantu emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlali kahle kwezoHamba nabantu jikelele. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukuze usebenze ngaphaya kwexesha xa kufuneka. Ukulungele ukuqeqesha ngokunyamekela okuzithibela. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaziko): Ulwazi olubalaseleyo ngokubakolunye nangokusebenza ngokubanzi ekunyamekeleni izigulane nokuba nolwazi malunga nokunyamekela okuzithibela. Inika ngokuzinikela ngokunyamekela okuzithibela. Ukuqgibelekile, ukusabela, ukucinga okucokisisa nangokudala, iikhono zokusombulula iingxaki ezibucukuphuki, ukusebenza ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwe-MDT nakumaphakathi amaphakathi angaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Qhuba ukunikwa kwekhondo elibonakalisa ukunyamekela izigulane kwindawo ethuthuzela amaxabiso anosizo nokuzinza koluntu. Qinisekisa ukuba ukunyamekela izigulane kuhlawuliswa ngesixa esilinganayo, ngokusebenza ngokusetyenziswa koluntu ngokulingana ngelixa uqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigangatho yamagatya okwenza umsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuphumelelwa kwamagqabo namaphupha eNqanaba lokunyamekela okuzithibela nangokunxulumene nokunyamekela ababambi negulane elibhediweyo. Qinisekisa inkxaso evela kubasebenzi bendawo yokulala ngenxa yamagama abafayo, ukwamkela nokuthumela izigulane, ukuqwalasela izigulane nokuqinisekisa ukuba izigulane zilawulwa kwaye zilandelwa ngokulunga ngokuyala nokukhokela abasebenzi bendawo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho inkqubela phambili yempilo enje ngokusebenza nokunyamekela okubanzi ukunyanga izigulane kuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa koluntu okusebenzayo ukunikwa ngokunyamekela izigulane ezisebenzayo. Ulawulo lokubutha iintlanganiso ezibalulekileyo nyanga zonke, ukunxulumana nothethathethwano namanqanaba angaphakathi amaninzi, ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo koluntu lokuqeqesha nokuphanda ngokusebenzayo nokulawula ngokusemthethweni iingxelo malunga nokunyamekela okuzithibela.

af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Vlak 1 tot 3) gesoek by George Regional Hospital om opleiding te fasiliteer, bevoegdhede te assesseer en verpleegpersoneel te ontwikkel.

Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om buite normale werksure te werk. Bereidwilligheid om kongresse/kursusse/werkswinkels by te woon. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en beleide van die Department of Health Western Cape. Kennis van die verpleegprosesse en prosedures soos uiteengesit in die Nursing Act en die SANC-regulasies. Vaardighede om die diens te beplan, te organiseer en te koördineer deur te analiseer, probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Leierskap gerig op die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die verpleegopleidingsdepartement.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van leergeleenthede vir alle verpleegpersoneel. Fasiliteer die in-diensopleiding/bywerking van vaardighede en bevoegdhede asook die oriëntasieprogram vir verpleegkundiges. Evalueer en assesseer die bevoegdhede en vaardighede van verpleegpersoneel en persoonlike ontwikkeling. Verseker die toepaslike plasing en begeleiding van verpleegpersoneel. Bied hulp met die effektiewe bestuur en benutting van fisiese, materiële en finansiële hulpbronne binne die verpleegopleidingsdepartement.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ohleziwe Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (UNesizakulo Jikelele: Okwesoklinikhi
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi ohleziwe (Izinga 1 kuye ku-3) e George Regional Hospital ukuze ajwayele ukufundisa, ahlule ikhono futhi ashise abasebenzi basesiNesizakulo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi komgangatho: Isifundo se-R425 esisisiseko (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri munyesizakulo) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kanye R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa e South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe. Noma Idigri yeminyaka eyi-4 eNesizakulo (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kanye R1497 noma R171 kanye R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa e South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe. Ukubhalisa eqembini labahlengikazi: Ukubhalisa e SANC njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe. Izidingo ezingokwemisebenzi ngokwalo: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphandle kwamasikhathi ajwayelekile asebenzayo. Ukuzithoba ukuya emihlanganweni/ziqeqeshweni / ezindzimeni. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe e SANC kunesizakulo jikelele. Izinga 2: Umkhathi weminyaka engu-10 wobuchule/okubonakalayo ongakolwazi basesiNesizakulo ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe e SANC kunesizakulo jikelele. Izinga 3: Umkhathi weminyaka engu-20 wobuchule/okubonakalayo ongakolwazi basesiNesizakulo ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe e SANC kunesizakulo jikelele. Amandla (ulwazi/ikhono): Ulwazi ngemithetho ezimeleyo kanye namapholisi e Department of Health Western Cape. Ulwazi lwenqubo nezinyathulo zokuhlinza njengokuchaziwe ku Nursing Act nasemthethweni i SANC. Ikhono lokuhlela, hlela futhi uhloleleni isevisi ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Ubukhosi bokufeza izinhloso ezinkulu futhi baloliqede ibungela liba yigumbi lokufundisa bahlengikazi.
zu.duties: Ukuncedisa ukwakha ithuba lokufunda bonke abasebenzi basesiNesizakulo. Ukuncedisa ukufundiswa esikhundleni/ukwazisa ngamakhono kanye namandla kanye nenqubo yokuhlakaniphisa bahlengikazi. Ukubuyekeza futhi ahlule ikhono namakhono abasebenzi basesiNesizakulo kanye nokuziphucela. Ukuthi abasebenzi basesiNesizakulo bakube ukulungiswa endaweni ekuqondile kanye nokubahamba nabo. Ukusiza ngokulawula ngempumelelo futhi basebenzise ongakha ongokwesisindo ongokwemali kanye nezinsiza ngaphakathi kwegumbi lokufundisa bahlengikazi.

xh.title: Umongikazi oqeqeshiweyo Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (I-Nursing eYakhayo: Esematsheni
xh.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi oqeqeshiweyo (Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3) eGeorge Regional Hospital ukuze aqonde uqeqesho, alinganise amakhono aphathe ubuchwepheshe bagqithiselwa kubungqina bobuchwepheshe.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingowona sifundo: Isidanga seR425 (okt idiploma/idigri kwizibonelelo ezifana neR683 negqithiswe nguR254) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oqeqeshiweyo. OKT Idigri yeminyaka emi-4 yamabanga aphakamileyo kwizibonelelo (iR174) okanye isidanga esilinganayo (iR683 negqithiswe nguR1497 okt iR171 negqithiswe nguR1497) esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi oqeqeshiweyo. Ukubhalisa kubungqina bobuchwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oqeqeshiweyo. Iimfuno ezipheleleyo zomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza ngaphandle kweyure ezithiwakeleyo zomsebenzi. Ukulungele ukuhamba umzila kwiindaba ezinkulu ziya kuba ngamakhosi / ukuzilolongela ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo. Iqondo lomsebenzi: Inqanaba 1: Akukho msebenzi upheleleyo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oqeqeshiweyo kwi-SANC kwimisebenzi egqithiswe kubuchwepheshe bokuhlinzwa. Inqanaba 2: Ukusebenza okungamashumi amabini (10) eminyaka okanye ngaphezulu kwelinye ilungu eliqeqeshiweyo kwizibonelelo ezingokomsebenzi nokugqithiswa kubungqina bobuchwepheshe emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oqeqeshiweyo kwi-SANC kwimisebenzi egqithiswe kubuchwepheshe bokuhlinzwa. Inqanaba 3: Ukusebenza okungamashumi amabini (20) eminyaka okanye ngaphezulu kwelinye ilungu eliqeqeshiweyo kwizibonelelo ezingokomsebenzi nokugqithiswa kubungqina bobuchwepheshe emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oqeqeshiweyo kwi-SANC kwimisebenzi egqithiswe kubuchwepheshe bokuhlinzwa. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngeempawu zamagunya athintela loo nto nayimigaqo yesebe lezeempilo eNtshona Koloni. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuqonda nokusebenza kwabongikazi njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiMigaqo-sesiko sabongikazi nakumagunya e-SANC. Ulwazi lokuba uyijonge, uyihlole, uyiqondanise le nkqubo ngokuhlola kunye nokulunga iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Ukulawula ukuze kugqitywe iinjongo ezibalulekileyo nezigqibo zesebe loqeqesho lwabongikazi.
xh.duties: Yenza lula ukuba khona kwezithuba zokufunda kubo bonke abasebenzi boqeqesho lokuhlola. Yenza lula uqeqesho-ngaphakathi / ukuhlaziya amakhono namakhono okwenza umsebenzi njengakwaneliso ngenkqubo yokumisela iindlela kubongikazi. Hlola uze ulinganise amakhono namakhono abasebenzi boqeqesho lokuhlola nophuhliso lwomntu. Qinisekisa ukubekwa ngokufanelekileyo nokuhamba kunye kwabasebenzi boqeqesho lokuhlola. Nceda ngokusebenzayo ekulawuleni nokusetyenziswa kwezibonelelo ezingokomzimba, ezingamasixhobo nezimali ngaphakathi kwesebe loqeqesho lwabongikazi.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3

jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 sought for Otto Du Plessis Hospital in the Cape Agulhas Sub-district, requiring SANC registration and a nursing diploma or degree.

Sebenzisa umsebenzi wezokuhlinzeka Nemikhwa yezempilo ngokuvumelana Nemithetho Nemikhwa yezezinga ephathelene Nokuhlinzeka Nemiphakathi yezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabahlinzeki nabanye abahlinzeki. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto Nemikhondo Yesikhala ngokusebenziseka Nokuphumelela.

Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om beide onafhanklik en binne 'n span te werk. Kennis van hospitaalfooibeleid en prosedures. Goëie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Clinicom & HECTIS pasiëntontvangsfunksies wat bywonings en afdoenings insluit soos per PGWC Hospital Fees-beleid en prosedures. Boek van afsprake en pasiëntvervoer op Healthnet. Behandeling van pasiëntnavrae (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Verantwoordelik vir ontvangs, hantering en veilige bewaring van staatsgeld. Verskeie ontvangsttake of pligte wat deur onmiddellike toesighouer aan u opgedra word. Instandhouding vir kollegas en verligting tussen departemente soos per operasionele behoeftes.

zu.title: Iclerki Bolawulo: Okungenayo
zu.summary: Nikela ngenkxaso yolawulo baphathi kanye nokungeniswa kwabakhwelwa esibhedlela iVictoria Hospital, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokwamukela, ukubhuka izikhathi kanye nokuphathwa kwemibuzo yabakhwelwa.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokufunda esingaphansi kwesibambi: Senior Certificate (noma esingulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele endaweni yolawulo baphathi abakhwelwa esibhedlela. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuze ukulungele ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha (amawekendi, iholide zabantu kanye nobusuku) okuhlanganisa nasezikhathini ezedlule kanye nokujikeleza njengoba kudingwa izidingo zokusebenza. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikono lokusebenza kodwa eyedwa kanye naphakathi kweqembu. Ulwazi ngemigomo kanye nendlela yokwenza ngezimali zesibhedlela. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nokuthetha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi yokwamukela abakhwelwa kwiClinicom & HECTIS okuhlanganisa ukubakhona kanye nokubakhupha njengoba kumigomo kanye nendlela yokwenza ngezimali zesibhedlela zePGWC. Ukubhuka izikhathi kanye nokuhamba kwabakhwelwa kwiHealthnet. Ukunakekela imibuzo yabakhwelwa (ngamagama nangokubhaliwe). Ukwenezele ukwamukela, ukuphatha kanye nogogodla izimali zombuso. Imisebenzi ehlukene yokwamukela noma imisebenzi enikiwe ngumlawuli wakho oseduze. Ukubeka abasebenzi naye kanye nennkxaso phakathi kweminyango njengoba kudingwa izidingo zokusebenza.

xh.title: Clerk yolawulo: Amagqabo
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo lwabaguli kunye namagqabo kwiVictoria Hospital, kuquka imisebenzi yokwamkela abantu, ukubhuka ipe ndlela nokujongana nemibuzo yabaguli.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokufunda esingaphantsi: Senior Certificate (okanye esingangayo). Isiphalangaza: Isiphalangaza esifanelekileyo kwimeko yolawulo lwabaguli esibhedlele. Imfuno engaphakathi yesimo: Ukulungele ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa (iweekends, izihlobo zombuso nobusuku) Kuquka nomsebenzi wexesha elongeziweyo nokujikelwa njengoko kufuneka ngemisebenzi. Amandla (ulwazi/akhono): Amandla okusebenza ngodwa nakwingqungquthela. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemithetho yemirhumo yesibhedlele. Amandla amahlulayo wokunxibelelwana nabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Imisebenzi yokwamkela abaguli kwiClinicom & HECTIS ebandakanya iindwendwe kunye nokuphumayo njengakwimigaqo nemithetho yemirhumo yamaPGWC Hospital Fees. Ukubhuka ipe ndlela kunye nothutho lwabaguli kwiHealthnet. Ukunxibelelana nemibuzo yabaguli (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Uxanduva lokwamkela, lokuphatha nokugcina imali karhulumente. Imisebenzi eyahlukileyo yokwamkela abantu okanye imisebenzi enikiweyo ngumphathi wakho oqhelekileyo. Ukusingatha abasebenzi nakunye nokuncediselana phakathi kwamasebe njengoko kufuneka ngemisebenzi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Finance/admin (FEES)
jobs.summary: Administration clerk handling cashier duties, BAS transactions and reconciliations at Paarl Hospital, requiring Grade 12 with Mathematics or Accountancy.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (Grade 12 or equivalent) with Mathematics and/or Accountancy as a passed subject and/or Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in a Fees- related environment dealing with Clinicom Patient Administration. Inherent requirements of the job: Rotate between departments as per operational requirements if required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy. (MS Office, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Knowledge and experience in Clinicom, Accounts Receivable (AR) system, Basic Accounting System (BAS), Uniform Patient Fees Schedule (UPFS) manual, Hospital Memorandum 18, JAC and Public Finance Management Act (PFMA).
jobs.duties: Perform cashier duties, including allocation of external funders and debtor payments as well as completion of all BAS transactions e.g., deposits, day- ends, journals and special journals. Complete the balancing and reconciliation processes between BAS and AR System. Follow-up on medical aid and non- medical aid outstanding invoices in line with Hospital Fees Manual Chapter 18 and related finance instructions, including management of foreign debtors. General fees administration and account-related duties/enquiries as per UPFS and billing requirements. Control the JAC Information and JAC Error Report. Relief colleagues and undertake various other clerical duties as and when required.
jobs.enquiries: Ms R Arendse Tel No: (021) 860-2580 or email: Raymone.Arendse@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Finansies/admin (FEES)
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat kassierpligte, BAS-transaksies en rekonsiliasies by Paarl Hospital hanteer, met 'n vereiste van Grade 12 met Wiskunde of Rekeningkunde.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (Grade 12 of ekwivalent) met Wiskunde en/of Rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n fooieverwante omgewing wat Clinicom-pasientadministrasie behels. Inherent vereistes van die werk: Roteer tussen departemente volgens operasionele vereistes indien vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid. (MS Office, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Kennis en ervaring in Clinicom, Accounts Receivable (AR)-stelsel, Basic Accounting System (BAS), Uniform Patient Fees Schedule (UPFS)-handleiding, Hospital Memorandum 18, JAC en Public Finance Management Act (PFMA).
af.duties: Voer kassierpligte uit, insluitend die toewysing van eksterne befondsers en debiteurbetalinge, asook die voltooiing van alle BAS-transaksies, bv. deposito's, dageindes, joernale en spesiale joernale. Voltooi die balanserings- en rekonsiliasieprosesse tussen BAS en die AR-stelsel. Volg uitstaande mediese hulp- en nie-mediese hulp-fakture na in ooreenstemming met Hospital Fees Manual Hoofstuk 18 en verwante finansiesinstruksies, insluitend die bestuur van buitelandse debiteure. Algemene fooie-administrasie en rekeningverwante pligte/navrae ooreenkomstig UPFS en faktureringsvereistes. Beheer die JAC-inligting en JAC-foutverslag. Verlig kollegas en onderneem verskeie ander klerklike pligte soos wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Clerk we-Administration: Finance/admin (FEES)
zu.summary: Clerk we-Administration osebenzaya imisebenzi yethelwe imali, izinkokhelo ze-BAS nokulinganiselwa kwemali e-Paarl Hospital, ofuna i-Grade 12 ene-Mathematics noma i-Accountancy.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esisezingeni elincane: Senior Certificate (Grade 12 noma okulinganayo) ene-Mathematics futhi/noma i-Accountancy njengesifundo esidlulile kanye/noma Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele endaweni ehlobene ne-Fees esiphathwa kwi-Clinicom Patient Administration. Izidingo ezimqondisi emsebenzini: Kuguqulwa phakathi kwezinye izikhundla njengoba kudingwa imisebenzi ngokufanele uma kudingeka. Ukolunye (ulwazi/ amakhono): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. (MS Office, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Ulwazi nolipiliyoni kwi-Clinicom, Accounts Receivable (AR) system, Basic Accounting System (BAS), Uniform Patient Fees Schedule (UPFS) manual, Hospital Memorandum 18, JAC kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA).
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yethelwe imali, okuhlanganisa ukwabiwa kwemali ezinhleini ezingaphandle noma ukukhokha izikweletu kanye nokuqedela yonke imisebenzi ye-BAS njengokuba kulesi sibonelo, ukufakwa kwemali, ukuphela kwamahora, amajournals namajournals aphelele. Qedela ukulinganiselwa nokulinganisa okuphakathi kwe-BAS kanye ne-AR System. Landelela osethiwe ema-invoices e-medical aid nalawo angewona e-medical aid angakhokhiwe ngokuhambisana ne-Hospital Fees Manual Chapter 18 kanye nezinye iziqondiso ze-finances, okuhlanganisa nokuqondiswa kwabafakini bakulezinye izwe. Ukulawulwa ngokuvamile kwe-finances kanye nemisebenzi/yemibuzo ehlobene nama-accounts njengoba kudingwa i-UPFS kanye nezidingo zokubhala ama-bills. Lawula ulwazi ye-JAC kanye ne-JAC Error Report. Siza abafundi abangenabo ehhovisi futhi wenze omunye umsebenzi ohlobene nokuqedela imibhalo noma okunye njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Iclerki yoLawulo: Iimali/ulawulo (i-FEES)
xh.summary: Iclerki yolawulo elawula imisebenzi yomgcinipheshe, iintshukumo ze-BAS nobudlelwane kwi-Sibhedlele iPaarl, ifuna i-Grade 12 nge-Mathematics okanye i-Accountancy.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesigaba: Isatifikethi Senqanaba lePhezulu (i-Grade 12 okanye into efanayo)ene-Mathematics nakanye i-Accountancy njengesihloko esiphumelelweyo nakanye Isatifikethi Senqanaba lePhezulu (okanye into efanayo). Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo kwimojuda efana neFees egqitha kwinkqubo yoLawulo lweGazi leClinicom Patient. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Tshintsha-phakathi kwiisebe ngokweemfuno zokusebenza ukuba kufuneka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. (i-MS Office, i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook). Ulwazi nesipili kwiClinicom, inkqubo ye-Accounts Receivable (AR), i-Basic Accounting System (BAS), i-Uniform Patient Fees Schedule (UPFS) manual, i-Hospital Memorandum 18, i-JAC kunye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA).
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yomgcinipheshe, kuquka ukwabiwa kwezimali zabanikazi bengaphandle nentlawulo yamatyala, kunye nokuphela kwezinto zonke ze-BAS njengamatyala, iintsuku ezipelileyo, iijornali nee-jornali ezizodwa. Qedela iinkqubo zokulinganisa nokuhambelanisa phakathi kwe-BAS neNkqubo ye-AR. Landela iiresiti ezingazivalwanga zemali yosizo lokweseka ezonyango naleyo engowosizo lwakwesekwa ngokweFestile Yemali yeSibhedlele Isahluko 18 nemiyalelo ephathelene nezimali, kuquka nokulawula abatyali bemali basemzini. Imisebenzi yonke yolawulo lwemali nemibuzo ephathelene ne-akhawunti njengoko kuhlawuliswa ngokwe-UPFS nokufuneka kwentlawulo. Lawula iNkcazelo yeJAC neNgxelo yePhoso yeJAC. Nika abasebenzi ababuzi ixesha lokuphumla uze wenze imisebenzi yonqamano ochongiweyo nje nako kufuneka.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Support
jobs.summary: Administration clerk providing office support, logistical coordination and supply chain assistance for provincial health and wellness campaigns in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s license. Willingness to travel throughout the Province. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and understanding of public health, project management, health promotion and cross-sectoral partnership. Good interpersonal and research skills. Computer literacy (MS suite, and digital platforms). Administrative skills. Ability to prioritise and organise work, exercise self-discipline and function under pressure, to work independently and in a team. Creativity, self-motivation, assertiveness and ability to innovate and take initiative.
jobs.duties: General Office Administration across Life Course Priority Areas. Provide logistical coordination and event management support for provincial, district, and intersectoral campaigns across the life-course portfolios. Support the financial and supply chain management (SCM) processes of the unit to ensure the timely acquisition of resources and compliance with financial guidelines. Record Keeping, Database Maintenance, and Monitoring and evaluation Support.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Ondersteuning
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat kantoorondersteuning, logistieke koördinasie en voorsieningskettingbystand verleen vir provinsiale gesondheids- en welvaartsveldtogte in die Western Cape.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring. Ingeslote vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om deur die Provinsie te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en begrip van openbare gesondheid, projekbestuur, gesondheidsbevordering en kruissektorale vennootskap. Goeie interpersoonlike en navorsingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS-suite en digitale platforms). Administratiewe vaardighede. Vermoë om werk te prioritiseer en te organiseer, selfdissipline toe te pas en onder druk te funksioneer, onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Kreatiwiteit, selfmotivering, selfhandhawing en vermoë om te innoveer en inisiatief te neem.
af.duties: Algemene kantooradministrasie oor Lewensloop-Prioriteitsareas. Verskaf logistieke koördinasie en gebeurtenisbestuurssteun vir provinsiale, distriks- en intersektorale veldtogte oor die lewensloop-portefeuljes. Ondersteun die finansiële en voorsieningskettingbestuurs- (VKB-) prosesse van die eenheid om die tydige verkryging van hulpbronne en nakoming van finansiële riglyne te verseker. Rekordhouding, databasonderhoud, en monitering en evalueringsondersteuning.

zu.title: Clerk Wezolawulo: Ukusekela
zu.summary: Iclerk yolawulo ehlinzeka ngokusekela ofisini, ukuhlola izinhlelo zokuthutha kanye nokusiza ezintweni zohlelo lokuhlinzeka kwezempilo futhi kubhaliswe izimpilo ezifundweni i-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezibalulekile: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo). Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esifanele. Izidingo ezingaphakathi kwesikhundla: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuze uhambe kulo lonke iSifunda. Izindlela ezisebenzayo (ulwazi/izikhombisi-ndlela): Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izempilo zomphakathi, ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi, ukukhuthaza izempilo nokubamba ihlangano phakathi kwezinyangazo zonke. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokucwaninga. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS suite, kanye nezinhlelo ezisezingeni elikhulu). Amakhono wokulawula ofisi. Ukukwazi ukubeka izinto ezibalulekile ohlelweni, ukuzithiba nokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinshi, ukusebenza ngokwakho nangohlelo. Ukudala ngokwakho, ukuzikhandla, ukuzimisela kakhulu kanye nokuqonda ukusungula izinto.
zu.duties: Ukulawulwa okuvamile kwezohlelo Ofisi kulo lonke izindawo ezibalulekile Ezindleleni Zobomi. Ukwenza izinhlelo zokuhlela ukuhamba kwezinhlelo kanye nokusekela ukuphathwa kwezehlayo zamaphrojekthi ezifundweni, emakhaya namaphrojekthi asemaphakathi phakathi kwemikhakiso yawo wonke umuntu ohlelwe ngohlelo lobomi. Ukusekela izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali kanye nezohlelo lokuhlinzeka (SCM) kwezinhlobo ngokwakho ngenhloso yokuthi kutholwe izinto ngokushesha kanye nokuhambisana nemigomo yezimali. Ukubhala izinto, ukugcina izinto ezibhalwe, ukuhlola isibalo, ukuhlolwa nokusekelwa.

xh.title: Iklekhi yoLawulo: Inkxaso
xh.summary: Iklekhi yolawulo ebonelela ngenkxaso yewofisi, ukuqhutywa kwezinto ezahlukeneyo, nenkxaso yohamba-hamba kwezibonelelo kumikhankatho yempilo namampilo yantlalo yabantu esiKoloniseni iNtshona Koloni.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esincinane semfundo: Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo (okwa sinye isalingana naso). Isipilo: Isipilo esifanelekileyo. Iimfuno eziphathwayo zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela ethethe ngqo. Ukulungele ukuhamba kuwo wonke ummandla. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nokuqonda ngempi lo yabantu, ulawulo lweeprojekthi, ukukhuthaza impilo yabantu kunye nobudlelwane phakathi kwezahlulo. Amakhono amabalwa obudlelwane nomntu nomntu nophando. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS suite, nezixhobo ezibonakalayo). Amakhono olawulo. Ikhaluba lokubeka izinto ezibalulekileyo nokuzihlela, ukuzithiba nokuzithamba, nokusebenza ngexesha locinzo, ukusebenza wedwa nakuluntu. Ubuchule, ukuzimisela, ukuzimela ngeenjongo, nokuba nakho ukwenza izinto ngendlela entsha nokuthatha inyathelo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula konke okusebenza kwiofisi kumacandawonke obomi obalulekileyo. Nikela ngenkxaso yokuqhutywa kwezinto ezahlukeneyo nolawulo lweziganeko ekhankanyiweyo kwikhempesha zabaphathwa, ezithili, kunye nezinkqubo ezingaphakathi kwamasebe kuwo wonke amacandawonke obomi obalulekileyo. Xhasa iinkqubo zolawulo lwezimali nezibonelelo (SCM) zale yunithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufumana ngexesha elifanelekileyo izibonelelo kwaye kuhoywe imigaqo yolawulo lwezimali. Ukugcina amarekhodi, Ukulungiselela uLwazi olusetyenziswayo, kunye nenkxaso Yokujonga nokuhlolwa.

jobs.title: Staff Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (VARIOUS Components)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R229 440 per annum Grade 2: R272 778 per annum Grade 3: R319 071 per annum
jobs.summary: Staff Nurse positions at Groote Schuur Hospital in Observatory, requiring SANC registration as an Enrolled Nurse, with salaries ranging from Grade 1 to Grade 3.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as an Enrolled Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Enrolled Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as an Enrolled Nurse. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as an Enrolled Nurse. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts and after-hours including weekends, public holidays and night duty. Willingness to rotate to other departments. Ability to lift and turn patients, stand for long hours and lift heavy equipment. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of Nursing Practices. Knowledge of Infection Prevention Control, control measures and practices. Ability to interpret basic clinical signs and symptoms. Basic computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Development and implementation of basic patient care. Provide basic clinical nursing care. Effective utilization of physical and financial resources. Maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self-development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview.” This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Personeelsverpleegkundige Vlak 1 tot 3 (VERSKILLEND Komponente)
af.summary: Personeelsverpleegkundige posisies by Groote Schuur Hospitaal in Observatory, wat SANC-registrasie as 'n Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundige vereis, met salarisse wat wissel van Vlak 1 tot Vlak 3.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die SANC as Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie met die SANC as 'n Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundige. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie met die SANC as 'n Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundige. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte en buite-ure te werk insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae en nagdiens. Bereidwilligheid om na ander departemente te roteer. Vermoë om pasiënte op te lig en om te draai, vir lang ure te staan en swaar toerusting op te lig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van Verpleegpraktyke. Kennis van Infeksievoorkomingbeheer, beheermaatreëls en praktyke. Vermoë om basiese kliniese tekens en simptome te interpreteer. Basiese rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling en implementering van basiese pasiëntsorg. Verskaf basiese kliniese verpleegsorg. Effektiewe benutting van fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne. Handhaaf professionele groei, etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ohlezi Grade 1 kuya ku-3 (IZINGXENYE EZIHLUKENE)
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabanakekelisi e-Groote Schuur Hospital e-Observatory, ezidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoguli lobuhlengikazi, kanye namaholo avela ku-Grade 1 kuya ku-Grade 3.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kancane: Isifundo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguli lobuhlengikazi.
