af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Urologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie. Inherente vereiste van die pos: 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om 'n uiters besige urologiediens op distriksvlak suksesvol te bestuur. Tersiêre kennis en vaardighede op die gebied van noodurologie asook elektiewe urologie op distriksvlak. Sterk etiese beginsels en tersaaklike kliniese en beradingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en organisatoriese vaardighede. Toepaslike ervaring in trauma- en noodurologiechirurgie as die primêre chirurg en behandelende spesialis.
af.duties: Lewering van kliniese dienslewering op spesialisvlak oor die volle spektrum van algemene Urologiese Chirurgie. Die spesialis se primêre verantwoordelikheid sal trauma- en noodurologie op distriksvlak wees. Lewering van kliniese dienslewering op spesialisvlak van elektiewe Urologiese Chirurgie (distriksvlak). Toesig oor die kliniese en operatiewe bedrywighede van urologiechirurge in opleiding. Aktiewe deelname aan die nagraadse en voorgraadse onderrigprogramme van die Afdeling Urologie. Effektiewe bestuur en administrasie van 'n wye verskeidenheid "Portefeuljes" en die ontwikkel, uitvoer en toesig hou van navorsingsprojekte. Opleiding en onderrig van mediese beamptes en urologieregistrateurs en tersaaklike siektelastenavorsing en -oudits.

zu.title: Umlingisi Wezokwelapha I-Grade 1 kuya ku-3 (UROLOGY) (SESSIONAL)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umlingisi wezokwelapha ongasese ngesikhathi kwe-Urology (I-Grade 1 kuya ku-3) e-New Somerset Hospital, e-Western Cape, okudinga ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomlingisi kwe-Urology.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane semfundo: Isiqu esifanele esimvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomlingisi wezokwelapha kwe-Urology. Ukubhalisa kubungelembi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomlingisi wezokwelapha kwe-Urology. Isipiliyoni: I-Grade 1: Akukho okubalulekile emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomlingisi wezokwelapha kwe-Urology. I-Grade 2: Okuncane kweminyaka engu-5 isipiliyoni esifanele njengomlingisi wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (noma kwi-HPCSA yamanye amazwe egunyaziwe kubasebenzi abafundile kwamanye amazwe) njengomlingisi wezokwelapha kwe-Urology. I-Grade 3: Okuncane kweminyaka engu-10 isipiliyoni esifanele njengomlingisi wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (noma kwi-HPCSA yamanye amazwe egunyaziwe kubasebenzi abafundile kwamanye amazwe) njengomlingisi wezokwelapha kwe-Urology. Isidingo esimqoka somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Ikakhulukazi ikhono lokusebenzisa kanye nokulawula inkonzo ye-Urology ebukhali kakhulu ezingeni lesifunda. Ulwazi lweziqu nemikhakha ye-Urology yesimo esiphuthumayo kanye ne-Urology yokhetho ezingeni lesifunda. Imigomo eqinile yobulungisa ngemikhono edingekayo yokwelapha nokweluleka. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izikhokelo zokuhola, zokuxhumanisa nabantu, kanye nezokuhlelela. Isipiliyoni esifanele kwe-Urology yezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nokuhlinzwa njengomhlinzi oyinhloko kanye nomlingisi wokwelapha.
zu.duties: Inkonzo yezokwelapha emkhakheni wabalulekile kuleyo nqwaba yonke ye-Urologic Surgery ezingeni labalulekile. Isebe elikhulu somsebenzi womlingisi sibe kungowe-Urology yesimo esiphuthumayo kanye nephuthumayo ezingeni lesifunda. Inkonzo yezokwelapha ezingeni labalulekile ye-Urology Surgery (izinga lesifunda). Ukugcina amandla okulawula imisebenzi yokuhlinza kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe be-Urology kubahlinzi abaqeqeshiwe. Ukubamba iqhaza elisebenzayo kumahlela okufundisa abafundi be-postgraduate nabanwebamfundo we-Urology Division. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kanye nokulawulwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zama-Portfolio kanye nokuthuthukisa, ukwenza kanye nokugcina amaphrojekthi ocwaningo. Ukufundisa nokufundisa abahlinzi be-Urology kanye nabo be-Urology futhi abaqashisiwe kwezocwaningo kanye nama-audit.

xh.title: Isikhululi seziguli sezolwezamathafa isikhululi sabaGqira iNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (UROLOGY) (SESSIONAL)
xh.summary: Kufuneki kufunwe iGqira eliNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 elibambe iSikhululi sabaGqira kwi-Urology (iSikhululi esibekelwe ixesha) kwi-New Somerset Hospital, eWestern Cape, elidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi kwi-Urology.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezidingekayo ezincinci: Isidanga esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengeGqira eliNqanaba eliPhakamileyo kwi-Urology. Ukubhaliswa kwiNkunguveli yamagqira: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengeGqira eliNqanaba eliPhakamileyo kwi-Urology. Imilingo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ntsebenziswano lwayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengeGqira eliNqanaba eliPhakamileyo kwi-Urology. Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka eli-5 elilinganiselwayo yemilingo njengeGqira eliNqanaba eliPhakamileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (okanye iNkunguveli yamagqira yamanye amazanga evunyiweyo malunga nomsebenzisi onemfundo yamanye amazanga) njengeGqira eliNqanaba eliPhakamileyo kwi-Urology. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka eli-10 elilinganiselwayo yemilingo njengeGqira eliNqanaba eliPhakamileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (okanye iNkunguveli yamagqira yamanye amazanga evunyiweyo malunga nomsebenzisi onemfundo yamanye amazanga) njengeGqira eliNqanaba eliPhakamileyo kwi-Urology. Iimfuno ezingaguqukiyo zemisebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqamba enesiqinisekiso. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokuphatha ngempumelelo inkonzo ye-Urology ebuziswa kakhulu kwinqanaba lesithili. Ulwazi namakhono asezikolweni ephakamileyo kwintsimi ye-Urology yezigulo ezikhawulezayo nakwi-Urology ekhethekileyo kwinqanaba lesithili. Amagama angqinelana nemigaqo eluhlaza kwaye afanelekileyo kwinkqubo yezigulo nakunceda ngengcobo yolwazi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okukhokela, amakhono okwahlulelana noMntu nokuqamba uluhlu lweNkqubo. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo kwi-Urology yezigulo ezize ngomzuzwana ezibangelwa ingozi kwi-Surgery njengesikhululi esingumqambi weSurgery kwaye siphatha iziguli kulo lonke ukuze kube nkqubo.
xh.duties: Inkonzo yamagqira ukukhetha iziguli ngokwemigaqo yamagqira ephakamileyo kuyo yonke indawo ye-Urologic Surgery. Imisebenzi ephambili yesikhululi kukuphatha i-Urology yezigulo ezize ngomzuzwana nakwi-Surgery kwinqanaba lesithili. Inkonzo yamagqira ngokwemigaqo ephakamileyo ye-Urology Surgery ekhethwayo (kwinqanaba lesithili). Ukulawula imisebenzi yamagqira namasebe okugqitha kwi-Surgery kubafundi bakhululekileyo kwii-Urology Surgery. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni kweenkqubo zokufundisa abafundi abangenayo nabaphuma kwikholeji kwikhaya le-Urology. Ukuphatha nokulawula iNkqubo yesiBango nokuqamba, ukuqhuba nokulawula amaprojekthi olwazi. Ukuqeqesha nokufundisa amagqira abalawuli besebe nabagqatshi bakhululekileyo bokuqeqesha abafundi kwii-Urology Surgery kwinkqubo yamagqira abalawuli besebe kwaye nabalawuli babafundi bakwazi ukwenza oluHlu lusetyenziswa ngokweNkqubo.

jobs.title: Architect (PRODUCTION Level): Education Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R791 604 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Architect needed to perform architectural activities on state-owned buildings, co-ordinate professional teams, and ensure compliance with legal, safety and health requirements.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate B degree in Architecture or relevant qualification; Three years post-qualification relevant architectural experience; Compulsory registration with SACAP (South African Council for the Architectural Profession) as a Professional Architect; A valid driving licence. Competencies: Working knowledge of the following: Technical: Programme and project management; Architectural design and analysis knowledge; Computer-aided architectural applications; Research and development; Knowledge of legal compliance; Technical report writing; Creating high performance culture; Networking; Professional judgment. Generic: Decision making; Team leadership; Analytical skills; Creativity; Self-management; Financial management; Customer focus and responsiveness; Communication; Computer literacy; Planning and organising; Conflict management; Problem solving and analysis; People management; Change management; Innovation.
jobs.duties: Perform architectural activities on state-owned or leased buildings, structures or facilities: Co-ordinate professional teams on all aspects regarding architecture; Ensure adherence and compliance to legal, safety and health requirements; Provide architectural advice and technical support in the evaluation of solutions; Ensure the adoption of technical and quality strategies; Develop architectural related policies, methods and practices; Provide solution on non-compliance and failure of designs; Review plans, drawings, specifications, and estimates prepared by building designers and/or sub- professional personnel; and ensure adherence to the requirements of professional registration; Human Capital Development: Mentor and train candidate architects and related technical and administrative personnel to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound architectural principles and code of practice; Supervise architectural work and processes; and Administer performance management and development; Office administration and budget planning: Manage resources, prepare and consolidate inputs for the facilitation of resource utilisation; Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement and SCM; Monitor and control expenditure; Report on expenditure and service delivery; Research and development: Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures; Research/literature studies on architecture to improve expertise; and Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on architectural- related matters.
jobs.enquiries: Ms C du Plooy at candice.duplooy@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Argitek (PRODUCTION-vlak): Onderwysinfrastruktuur
af.summary: Argitek benodig om argitektoniese aktiwiteite op staatsbesitte geboue uit te voer, professionele spanne te koördineer en voldoening aan regs-, veiligheids- en gesondheidsvereistes te verseker.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike B-graad in Argitektuur of relevante kwalifikasie; Drie jaar se relevante argitektoniese ervaring na kwalifikasie; Verpligte registrasie by SACAP (South African Council for the Architectural Profession) as 'n Professionele Argitek; 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Werkende kennis van die volgende: Tegnies: Program- en projekbestuur; Kennis van argitektoniese ontwerp en ontleding; Rekenaargesteunde argitektoniese toepassings; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Kennis van regsverenigbaarheid; Tegniese verslagskrywing; Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur; Netwerk bou; Professionele oordeel. Generies: Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Analitiese vaardighede; Kreatiwiteit; Selfbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Kundenadruk en reaksievermoë; Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Beplanning en organisering; Konflikbestuur; Probleemoplossing en ontleding; Mensebestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Innovasie.
af.duties: Verrig argitektoniese aktiwiteite op staatsbesitte of gehuurde geboue, strukture of fasiliteite: Koördineer professionele spanne oor alle aspekte rakende argitektuur; Verseker nakoming van en voldoenning aan regs-, veiligheids- en gesondheidsvereistes; Verskaf argitektoniese advies en tegniese ondersteuning by die evaluering van oplossings; Verseke die toepassing van tegniese en gehaltestrategieë; Ontwikkel argitektuurverwante beleid, metodes en praktyke; Verskaf oplossings vir nie-nakoming en mislukking van ontwerpe; Hersien planne, tekeninge, spesifikasies en ramings wat deur gebou-ontwerpers en/of subprofessionele personeel voorberei is; en verseker nakoming van die vereistes van professionele registrasie; Menslike kapitaalontwikkeling: Mentor en oplei kandidaat-argitekte en verwante tegniese en administratiewe personeel om oordrag van vaardighede/kennis en nakoming van deeglike argitektoniese beginsels en praktykskode te bevorder; Hou toesig oor argitektoniese werk en prosesse; en Administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling; Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning: Bestuur hulpbronne, berei en konsolideer insette vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting voor; Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging en SCM; Monitor en beheer uitgawes; Rapporteer oor uitgawes en dienslewering; Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures; Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor argitektuur om kundigheid te verbeter; en Skakel met tersaaklike liggame/rade oor argitektuurverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Architect: Education Infrastructure
zu.summary: Zenza imisebenzi yezakhiwo.
zu.requirements: I-degree elifanele kakhulu kwezobuNjiniyela beArchitecture; Isiphiwo esifanele; Ukuthi kufanele ukuthi abe no小孩; Abantu abanesithelo.
zu.duties: Zenza imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe bezakhiwo kwezinto, izakhiwo, izakhiwo noma izindawo ezingaphansi kwesifunda. Lungiselela amaqembu obuchwepheshe kuzo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwe futhi kuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho, zokuphepha kanye nezempilo. Nikeza izeluleko mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezakhiwo kanye nokuwesekela ngobuchwepheshe ekuhloleni izixazululi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokusebenza ezifanele kanye nendlela yobuchwepheshe futhi uhlinze ngekhwalithi ephilayo. Kuzakhiwo ezisetshenziswa ngaphansi kwesifunda, sunga izindawo ezinhle ezisebenzayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Hlinza ngomsebenzi wesixazululi kanye nokuphela kokusebenza. Hlolisisa izinhlelo, izithombe, izindawo ezibekiwe, neziqinisekiso ezilungiselelwe abakhi bezindlu futhi bahlolisise wonke amaphuzu; Human Capital Development: Busa futhi uqeqeshe abafundi bezakhiwo kanye nalabo abanesipho sobuchwepheshe ngokuthumela izinkomba kubantu abaholiwe; Financial management: Cacisa, hlela, futhi ulawule imali ehlelekile ebonakalisa ukusetshenziswa kwayo ekuthumeni izinkomba; Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho nangokuthola izimpahla nokusetshenziswa kwezimali; Hlola futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezimali; Conference: Nikela ngemibiko ekusetshenzisweni kwezimali nasekubhalisweni komthethosisekelo; Research and development: Qeqesha ngokobuchwepheshe ngokuthi ugcine ukuthi uyayazi imithetho yezakhiwo, ukuze ugcine ngezobuchwepheshe obusha, futhi ugcine nangokuhlela kwemithelela; Hlola imibhalo ephathelene nezakhiwo ukuze ukwazi ukwenza izakhiwo ezinhle.

xh.title: Umzobi wezakhiwo (inqanaba lokuVelisa): Education Infrastructure
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umzobi wezakhiwo ukuba enze imisebenzi yokuzoba izakhiwo kwi zakhiwo zorhwebo karhulumente, acoorodine amaqela abasebenzi abangabagunyaziswa, ajonge ukuba kusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo imigaqo yomthetho, yokhuseleko nempilo.
xh.requirements: Idegree ezimo yongamva kwi Architecture okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo; Unyaka amathathu emva kokufumana isidanga isamava ezifanelekileyo kumzobo wezakhiwo; Ukubhalwa kwi SACAP (South African Council for the Architectural Profession) njengomzobi wezakhiwo oyiNtloko kuyaphokozaleyo; Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi lokusebenza kolandelayo: ITechnical: Ulawulo lwenkqubo neprojekthi; Ulwazi lokuyila nokuhlalutywa kokuzoba izakhiwo; Iakhawuntu ezancedisayo ekuzobeni izakhiwo; Uphando nophuhliso; Ulwazi ngokusebenza ngokomthetho; Ukubhala iingxelo ezobuchwepheshe; Ukuyila inkqubo yokusebenza ngamandla aphakamileyo; Ukuxhumana; Isigqibo seziganeko ezibhekisa kubuchwepheshe. IGeneric: Ukwenza izigqibo; Ukukhokela iqela; Ikhono lokuhlalutya; Ubuchule; Ulawulo lwakho; Ulawulo lweemali; Ukujongana nabathengi nokupha iimpendulo; Unxibelelwano; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; Uplano nolungiselelo; Ulawulo loludano; Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo; Ulawulo labantu; Ulawulo lwenguquko; Izinto ezitsha.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokuzoba izakhiwo kwi zakhiwo zorhulumente okanye eziqeshiweyo, izakhiwo okwanokuthi izinto: Coorodine amaqela abasebenzi abangabagunyaziswa kuzo zonke iindaba ezijongelezayo kumzobo wezakhiwo; Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa nokuthobela imigaqo yomthetho, yokhuseleko nempilo;nika izindaba zobuchwepheshe nokuxhaswa kwiwahlalutyo; qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweekhadi zobuchwepheshe nokuza kakuhle; phuhlisa iindlela zemigaqo, iindlela neenkqubo ezinxulumene nomzobo wezakhiwo; Nika isisombulu kwiingxaki zokungathatyathelwanga nokusilela kwi sayizi; jonga iiplani, ooncwadi, iimeko, neendlela ezilungiselelwe ngabadayi bezakhiwo nakubasebenzi abangangabagunyaziswa; aze ajonge ukuthobela imigaqo yokubhalwa kolwazi; Ulawulo lweemali yabasebenzi: Qeqsha kwaye ulungise abafundi bomzobo wezakhiwo abangenamdla nakubasebenzi abanomdla wobuchwepheshe nolawulo ukuba bakhiqize ulwazi/lwazi nokuthobela imigaqo yokuzoba izakhiwo; Qhuba imisebenzi yokuzoba izakhiwo noluvo lwemisebenzi; Ulawulo lweofisi noplano lweemali: Lawula izixhobo, ulungise uze uqokelele iindlela ezikhusela ukusetyenziswa kwexhobo; qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo nendlela yokuza kwemali ekuthengeni nasekuqokeleleni iinkonzo; Qwalasela ulawulo lweemali; nike iingxelo ezinxulumene nayo nayemisebenzi; Uphando nophuhliso: Ukuphuhlisa ulwazi lwakho oluqhubekayo ukuze ughube nayo nobuchwepheshe obutsha; Uphando/izifundo ngeArchitecture ukuphucula ulwazi lwakho; uxhume nemiqathango/amabala anomdla kwimisebenzi ephathelene nomzobo.

af.title: Argitek (PRODUKSIE Vlak): Gesondheidsinfrastruktuur
af.summary: Argitek benodig om argitektoniese aktiwiteite op staatsgeboue uit te voer, professionele spanne te koördineer en te verseker dat aan gesondheids- en veiligheidsvereistes voldoen word.
af.requirements: Toepaslike B-graad in Argitektuur of tersaaklike kwalifikasie; Drie jaar na-kwalifikasie tersaaklike argitektoniese ervaring; Verpligte registrasie by SACAP (South African Council for the Architectural Profession) as 'n Professionele Argitek; 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Werkskennis van die volgende: Tegnies: Program- en projektebestuur; Kennis van argitektoniese ontwerp en ontleding; Rekenaargesteunde argitektoniese toepassings; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Kennis van regsversugting; Tegniese verslagskrywing; Skep van hoëprestasiekultuur; Netwerkwerk; Professionele oordeel. Generies: Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Analitiese vaardighede; Skeppendheid; Selfbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë; Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Beplanning en organisering; Konflikbestuur; Probleemoplossing en ontleding; Mensebestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Innovasie.
af.duties: Voer argitektoniese aktiwiteite op staatsgeboue of gehuurde geboue, strukture of faciliteite uit: Koördineer professionele spanne oor alle aspekte met betrekking tot argitektuur; Verseker nakoming van en voldoening aan reg-, veiligheids- en gesondheidsvereistes; Verskaf argitektoniese advies en tegniese ondersteuning by die evaluering van oplossings; Verseker die toepassing van tegniese en gehalte-strategieë; Ontwikkel argitektuurgerelateerde beleide, metodes en praktyke; Verskaf oplossing vir nie-nakoming en mislukking van ontwerpe; Hersien planne, tekeninge, spesifikasies en raminge wat deur gebou-ontwerpers en/of sub-professionele personeel voorberei is; en verseker nakoming van die vereistes van professionele registrasie; Menslike kapitaal-ontwikkeling: Lei en leer kandidaat-argitekte en verwante tegniese en administratiewe personeel op om oordrag van vaardighede/kennis en nakoming van gesonde argitektoniese beginsels en kode van praktyk te bevorder; Hou toesig oor argitektoniese werk en prosesse; en Administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling; Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning: Bestuur hulpbronne, berei insette voor en konsolideer dit ter fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting; Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging en SCM; Monitor en beheer uitgawes; Rapporteer oor uitgawes en dienslewering; Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures; Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor argitektuur om kundigheid te verbeter; en Skakel met tersaaklike liggame/rade oor argitektuurgerelateerde aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Umakhiwe (ISINGA ELIKHISHIWE): Isisekelo Sezempilo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umakhiwe ukuba enze imisebenzi yokwakha ezakhiweni ezinikelwe uhulumeni, ahlanganise amaqembu ochwepheshe futhi aqinisekise ukuthi kuhambiswa nemithetho ezidingweni zezempilo nokuqinisekiswa kwezokuphepha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezigqamile ze-B degree ebunjini bezakhiwo noma isiqu esihambisanayo; Unyaka abambisana nemisebenzi ehambisanano kwesikhathi esiyisikhombisa emva kokuqeda iziqu; Ukubhaliswa ngokuyikho ngaphandle kokwesabi ku-SACAP (South African Council for the Architectural Profession) njengomakhiwe ochwepheshe; Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Amakhono: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngalokhu okulandelayo: Okobuchwepheshe: Ulawulo lwehlelo nemiklamo; Ulwazi lokumila nokuhlaziya izakhiwo; Izinhlelo zekhompuyutha ezisetshenziswa ebunjini bezakhiwo; Ucwaningo nentuthuko; Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho; Ukuhlaziya amabali abuchwepheshe; Ukwakha isiko lokusebenza kahle ngamandla; Ukwakha uxhumano; Isibono sichwepheshe. Okuvamile: Ukwenza izinqumo; Ubuchwepheshe bokuqondisa iqembu; Amakhono ahlukanisa inhlaka; Ubumnandi bokudala; Ukuzilawula; Ukulawula imali; Ukuqonda izidingo zakhasimende nokuphendula; Unxibelelwano; Ulwazi lwekhompuyutha; Ukubeka izinto ukuze zihleleke; Ukupatha imikhawulo; Ukuxazulula inkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukulawula abantu; Ukulawula inguquko; Intuthuko.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokwakha ezakhiweni, izakhiwo noma izinsiza ezinikelwe uhulumeni noma eziqashiwe: Hlanganisa amaqembu ochwepheshe kuzo zonke izindikimba ezihlobene nobunjini bezakhiwo; Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana futhi kuhoniswa imithetho, izidingo zezokuphepha nezempilo; Nikeza izeluleko zobunjini bezakhiwo nokesekela ngolwazi lobuchwepheshe ekuhlaziyeni izixazululo; Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zobuchwepheshe nobungcono; Bukeka izinqubo, izindlela namasiko ahlobene nobunjini bezakhiwo; Nikeza isixazululo engasebenzini nasekuhlulekeni kwemiklamo; Hlola izinhlelo, imidwebo, izinhlinzeko, nalawo abalulekile abalungiselwe abakhi abanomklamo noma abantu abangesona ochwepheshe; futhi qinisekisa ukuthi kuhoniswa izidingo zokubhaliswa ngokuyikho ngokuchwepheshe; Intuthuko Yomuntu: Qondisa futhi uqeqeshe abakhi abangakabi ngochwepheshe kanye nabantu abahlobene nobuchwepheshe nolawulo ukukhuthaza ukudluliselwa amakhono/ulwazi nokuhambisana nemitsetso embulwane yokwakha nemitsetso yokusebenza; Qapha imisebenzi nokuqhubeka kobunjini bezakhiwo; futhi Phatha ulawulo lokusebenza kahle nentuthuko; Ukuphathwa kohhovisi nokuhlela amabhajidi: Lawula izinsiza, lungiselela futhi uhlanganise okufakwayo ukuze kusizakale ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza; Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho nangezinqubo zokuthenga nokuqashwa kwezinsiza eziyi-SCM; Qapha futhi ulawule ukusebenzisa imali; Bika ngemali echithiwe nokuhlinzwa ngezinsiza; Ucwaningo nentuthuko: Intuthuko ngokuyikho ngokuchwepheshe ukuze ughube netheknoloji namasiko amatsha; Ucwaningo/izifundo zolwazi ngobunjini bezakhiwo ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe; futhi Xhumana namaphiko/amakhansela ahlobene nendikimba zobunjini bezakhiwo.

xh.title: Umbonisiwe (iNqanaba le-PRODUCTION): IzezoMpicwe zeZempilo
xh.summary: Kufuneki ngumbonisiwe wakhiwo ukwenza imisebenzi yezakhiwo kwizakhiwo karhulumente, aqhube amaqela abasebenzi abangcali aze aque ifuneko ngokhuseleko nempilo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-B sokwenzela i-Architecture okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo; Iiminyaka emithathu yamava obugcisa obuchwepheshe emva kokufumana isidanga; Ukubhalisa ngokuyinyaniso kwi-SACAP (South African Council for the Architectural Profession) njengombonisiwe wobugcisa obuchwepheshe; Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi lokusebenza lokulandelayo: Obuchwepheshe: Ulawulo lwenkqubo noluqhubayo; Ulwazi lokuzoba nokuhlola nokulinganisa izakhiwo; Izicelo zobugcisa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha; Uphononongo nophuhliso; Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho; Ukwabhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe; Udalulwa lwekwayala yomgangatho ophezulu; Ukwakha ukuxhumana; Isigqibo sobugcisa. Ngokubanzi: Ukwenza izigqibo; Ukukhokela iqela; Amandla okuhlola; Iinkalo zobomi; Ulawulo lwakho; Ulawulo lweemali; Ukujongisisa kumthengi nokuqondisa; Unxibelelwano; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuqwalasela nokulawula; Ulawulo looyilo; Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlola; Ulawulo lwabantu; Ulawulo lokuguqula; Udaluvo.
xh.duties: Zenza imisebenzi yezakhiwo kwizakhiwo, iindonga okanye iziseko ezinikwe ilungelo kurhulumente okanye eziqeshwayo; Qeqsha amaqela abasebenzi abangcali kuzo zonke iindawo ezithintela nzakhiwo; Qinisekisa ukuthobela kwaye kuhambe kolunye lweemfuno ngokomthetho, ngokhuseleko nempilo yabantu; Nikela icebiso malunga nezakhiwo ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekulinganisweni iisilisi; Qinisekisa ukwamkelwa kwezicwangciso zobuchwepheshe nemigangatho ephezulu; Phuhliza iinkqubo, iindlela nokuzilolonga ezinxulumene nezakhiwo; Nikela iisilisi kwindinganiso engathotyelwayo nasekuhlulekeni kwezicwangciso; Phinda uyihlole iicwangciso, imizobo, iinkcazelo, namaxabiso alungiswe ngabadwebi bezakhiwo kwaye nangabasebenzi abangangcali; qinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno zobhalo lobugcisa obuchwepheshe; Ukulondolozo nophuhliso lwemitha yomntu: Qondisa kwaye uqeqeshe abadwebi abafundi kunye nabasebenzi abanobuchwepheshe abahlobene nalabo kwaye nabasebenze ngolawulo ukuze khuthazwe ukudluliswa kwezakhono/ulwazi nokuwohloka kwemigaqo eqhilile yezakhiwo nekhowudi yokuziphatha; Lawula imisebenzi nemicimbe yokwakha; Lawula ulawulo lomsebenzi nokuphuhliswa kwawo; Ulawulo lesebe kunye nokuqwalasela ibhajeti: Lawula izixhobo, lungisa kwaye uqokelele izigqibo ukuze kulungelelaniswe ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo; Qinisekisa ukuthobela iimigaqo nendlela zokuthenga nokulawula ukuqedwa kweemveliso ngenkonzo; Qwalasela kwaye ulawule ukuchithwa kwemali; Nike ingxelo ngokuchithwa kwemali nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo; Uphononongo nophuhliso: Ukuphuhliswa ngokuqhubekayo kobugcisa obuchwepheshe ukuze ugcine isiqondo namacebo amatsha nendlela zokusebenza; Uphononongo/iifundo zolwazi malunga nezakhiwo ukuze kuphuculwe ulwazi; Nxibelelane nabalinganisi/bhunga abafanelekileyo kumacandwe anxulumene nezakhiwo.

jobs.title: Professional Electrical Engineer (PRODUCTION Level)
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R914 517 - R975 582 per annum Grade B: R1 030 296 - R1 109 925 per annum Grade C: R1 172 184 - R1 376 199 per annum (Salary will be determined based on post registration experience as per OSD prescript).
jobs.summary: Professional electrical engineer needed by the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure to design and manage engineering projects, requiring ECSA registration and three years post-qualification experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Electrical Engineering Degree [B Eng/BSc (Eng)] or relevant qualification; Three years post qualification engineering experience required; Compulsory registration with ECSA as a professional engineer; A valid code B driving licence. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Programme and project management; Engineering design and analysis; Research and development; Computer-aided engineering applications; Knowledge of legal compliance and formulation of policies in a multi-disciplinary professional environment; Technical report writing; Creating high performance culture; Professional judgement; Networking. Skills in the following: Decision making; Team leadership; Analytical skills; Creativity; Self-management; Financial management; Customer focus and responsiveness; Communication; Computer literacy (MS Office); Planning and organising; Conflict management; Problem solving and analysis; People Management; Change Management; Innovation; Willingness to travel on a regular basis; Experience of contract documentation and administration, act/regulations of Occupation Health & Safety (OHS-Act), National Building Regulations and all relevant built environment legislation; knowledge of public sector procurement; Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Design new systems to solve practical engineering challenges and improve efficiency and enhance safety: Plan, design, operate and maintain engineering projects; Develop cost effective solutions according to standards; Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology; Develop tender specifications; Ensure through evaluation that planning and design by others is done according to sound engineering principles and according to norms and standards and code of practice; and Approve engineering works according to prescribed norms and standards; Human capital development: Ensure training and development of technicians, technologists and candidate engineers to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound engineering principles and code of practice; Supervise the engineering work and processes; and Administer performance management and development; Office administration and budget planning: Manage resources and prepare and consolidate inputs for the facilitation of resource utilisation; Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement and personnel administration; Monitor and control expenditure; and Report on expenditure and service delivery; Research and development: Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures; Research/literature studies on engineering technology to improve expertise; and Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on engineering-related matters.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionele Elektriese Ingenieur (PRODUKSIE Vlak)
af.summary: Die Wes-Kaapse Departement van Infrastruktuur het 'n professionele elektriese ingenieur nodig om ingenieursprojekte te ontwerp en te bestuur, wat ECSA-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring na kwalifisering vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Elektriese Ingenieursgraad [B Eng/BSc (Eng)] of relevante kwalifikasie; Drie jaar se ingenieurservaring na kwalifisering vereis; Verpligte registrasie by ECSA as 'n professionele ingenieur; 'n Geldige kode B-bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Program- en projektbestuur; Ingenieursontwerp en -analise; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Rekenaarondersteunde ingenieurstoepassings; Kennis van regsverening en die opstel van beleid in 'n multidissiplinêre professionele omgewing; Tegniese verslagskrywing; Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur; Professionele oordeel; Netwerk bou; Vaardighede in die volgende: Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Analitiese vaardighede; Skeppendheid; Selfbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë; Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office); Beplanning en organisering; Konflikbestuur; Probleemoplossing en -analise; Menslike hulpbronbestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Innovasie; Bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis; Ervaring van kontrakdokumentasie en -administrasie, wet/verordeninge van Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid (OHS-Wet), Nasionale Bouregulasies en alle relevante bou-omgewingswetgewing; kennis van openbare-sektorverkryging; Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Ontwerp nuwe stelsels om praktiese ingenieursuitdagings op te los en doeltreffendheid en veiligheid te verbeter: Beplan, ontwerp, bedryf en onderhou ingenieursprojekte; Ontwikkel kostedoeltreffende oplossings volgens standaarde; Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer; Ontwikkel tenderspesifikasies; Verseker deur evaluasie dat beplanning en ontwerp deur ander gedoen word volgens deeglike ingenieursbeginsels en volgens norms en standaarde en kode van praktyk; en Keur ingenieurswerke goed volgens voorgeskrewe norms en standaarde; Menslike kapitaalontwikkeling: Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van tegnici, tegnologe en kandidaatingenieurs om oordrag van vaardighede/kennis en nakoming van deeglike ingenieursbeginsels en kode van praktyk te bevorder; Onderhou toesig oor die ingenieurswerk en -prosesse; en Administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling; Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning: Bestuur hulpbronne en berei en konsolideer insette vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting voor; Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging en personeeladministrasie; Monitor en beheer uitgawes; en Rapporteer oor uitgawes en dienslewering; Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures; Navorsings/literatuurstudies oor ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter; en Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Professional Electrical Engineer (PRODUCTION Level)
zu.summary: Western Cape Department of Infrastructure ifuna umchwepheshe wezobuchwepheshe bezedlaka ukuze ahlele futhi aqondise imiphakathi yezobuchwepheshe, edinga ukubhaliswa ku-ECSA futhi eminyakeni emithathu yamava emva kwamakhosi.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanele se-Electrical Engineering Degree [B Eng/BSc (Eng)] noma iziqu ezihambelanayo; Zingaki amaNyaka ohlola emva kokuqeda iziqu nge technology; Ukubhaliswa okuphoqelekile ne-ECSA njengomchwepheshe oziphefumulisayo; Idrayivalesensi ye-code B esemthethweni. Izibalo: Ulwazi ngokuqondile: I-Programme ne-project management; Ukuhlela nokuxazula kobuchwepheshe; Ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa; Izinhlelo zokwenza ngomsindo wekhompyutha; Ulwazi ngokuvunelana nomthetho futhi ukwakheka kwezinqumela kwindawo ebanzi futhi kabanzi yobuchwepheshe; Ukubika ngemibhalo yezobuchwepheshe; Ukudala isiko elihle lokusebenza kahle; Isahluleko esihle somuntu; Ukuxhumana. Amakhono kokuqondile: Ukwenza izinqumo; Iqhaza ekubukeni iqembu; Amakhono okuhlaziya; Ubuciko; Ukuzibusa; Imali yobuholi; Ukuqaphela futhi ukusabela kumthengi; Ukuxhumana; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Office); Ukuhlela futhi ukuhlela; Ukulawula ukuphikiswano; Ukuxazula futhi ukuhlaziya izinkinga; Ukuphatha abantu; Ukugcina umthetho; Ubuciko bomsha; Ukuthanda ukuhamba njalo; Amava ambalwa emibhalweni yokuqasha futhi ukuphatha, umtsetho / imithetho yokuqasha kwe-Occupation Health & Safety (OHS-Act), National Building Regulations futhi yonke imithetho yendawo yakho; ulwazi ngokuqasha kwe-public sector; Ikholo lokusebenza ngomoya wobundi.
zu.duties: Hela izinhlelo ezisha ukuze uxaze izinkinga zokuhlela kwemisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe futhiuthuthukise ukusebenza kahle nekusekhusele: Cwebisa, hela, phefumula futhi gcine imiprohotho yezobuchwepheshe; Hela izisombululu ezibiza kakhulu ngokuvumelana nemigomo; Hlola imanuwali ezibonakalayo, imidwayo evamile futhi izaqubulo ukwenzela ukufakaobuchwepheshe obusha; Hela izinkomba zokuqasha; Qinisekisa ngehlolo ukuba iplani futhi ihlelo abantu abanye lwenziwe ngokuvunelana imigomo yezobuchwepheshe eluhlaza futhi ngokuvunelana imigomo futhi ikhodi yokusebenza; futhi Gunyaza imisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe ngokuvumelana imigomo futhi emazinga abekiwe; Ukuthuthukiswa kwemali yabantu: Qinisekisa ukuqashwa futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwabachwepheshe, izobuchwepheshe futhi abakhwelwa kubuchwepheshe ukukhuthazisa ukudlulisela amakhono/ulwazi futhi ukulandelwa kwemigomo yezobuchwepheshe eluhlaza futhi ikhodi yokusebenza; Qapha futhi ulawule imisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe futhi izaqubulo; futhi Lawula imisebenzi yezinhlelo futhi ukuthuthukiswa; Isiphathi seofisi futhi iplani yebhajeti: Lawula imithombo futhi ulungise futhi uhlanganise okungenayo ukuze kwensiwe ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo; Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezinqumela futhi izaqubulo zokuqasha futhi abantu bokuqasha; Qapha futhi ulawule ukukhishwa kwemali; futhi Bika ngemali ekhishiwe futhi ngenikela yesevisi; Ucwaningo futhi ukuthuthukiswa: Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okuqhubekayo ukuze ugqame nobuchwepheshe obusha futhi izaqubulo; Ucwaningo/izifundo zolwazi ngobuchwepheshe bongqondo ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe; futhi Xoxa nabahlanganyeli / amakhomidi ngemithethonqubo ezehweni kulesobuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Injineri yamandla ombane ochumileyo (INQANABA lokuVELISA)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ukhuthazwe njengenjineri yamandla ombane eqinisekisiweyo ecaleni koluntu lwe-Western Cape Department of Infrastructure ukuba akwazi ukuyila kwaye alawule iiprojekthi zenzululwazi, ekufuneka abhalwe kwi-ECSA kwaye aneminyaka emithathu yolwazi emva koko kokuba nesidanga.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo sabaNjineli bezagqithiweyo [B Eng/BSc (Eng)] okanye iziqinisekiso ezingqamisana nazo; Kufuneka kube nolwazi lokukhula jikelele kwiminyaka emithandathu njengenjineri ekungeneni kolwazi kwakho; Ukusayina okumandla njengenjineri eqinisekisiweyo ekwindlela ethile kwi-ECSA; Ilayisensi yokuzijeka okusemthethweni enesigqithisi samakhodi eB. Iimpawu ezingaphezulu: Ulwazi ngaloo nto: Ukulawulwa kolwazi kwabalinganiseli nalapho kubakho iinkqubo: Ulwazi olumandla lolwazi loluntu oluqulunqwe ngendlela echanekileyo; Ukulawula ukwenza iingxelo ezilawulwayo lulwazi; Ulwazi loluntu olukhoyo kwaye ekuqhubeni phambili kwelali; Izicelo zolwazi ezikwizikrwele ezincedisene nabantu abanokusetyenziswa kolwazi njengenjineri; Ulwazi ngemigaqo nakwindlela eyakhiwo yeendaba ezikummandla wemigaqo eneziseko ezininzi ezingazigqibekanga ngokusemthethweni; Ukwakha iingxelo zobugcisa ezingenangqondo; Ukwakha isiko elihle lokwenza izinto ngeenjongo eziphakamileyo; Isiphiso esilawulwayo ngqondweni; Ukudibanisa uluntu. Iindlela ezingaphantsi kwemiqathango: Ukwenza isigqibo sokuziphatha; Intlanganiso yobuchule ekugqibeleni kolwazi; Iindlela ezongezelelweyo kolwazi; Ukuzilawula ngokwakho; Ulawulo lwemali; Ukwazinikezela kubathengi nokuba noggumbuzela kubakhuphiweyo; Unxibelelwano; Ulwazi lweekhompyutha (MS Office); Ukucwangcisa nokuqwalasela; Ukulawula iingxumo; Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela ngazo; Ulawulo lobantu; Ulawulo lwezinto ezintsha; Ukuzimisela ukuhamba rhoqo; Ulwazi ngemibhalo yamakontrathi nolawulo, umthetho/umgaqo-nkqubo we-Occupation Health & Safety (OHS-Act), Imigaqo yezakhiwo yelizwe kunye namanye amagunya amaninzi okwakhe izinto ezikwindlela yokuhlala; ulwazi ngokuziphatha kwezicelo zoluntu; Ukuba nolwazi ngokunokusebenza kwindawo ezinesithukuthezi.
xh.duties: Yila iindlela ezintsha eziya kusombulula iingcali zenzululwazi eziphatho njengomsebenzi kunye nokuphucula ukusebenza kakuhle nokuwandisa ukhuseleko: Cwangcisa, yila, qhube kwaye ugcine iiprojekthi zenzululwazi eziphatho njengomsebenzi; Phezulu izisombululo ezizezimali ngokwemigaqo; Linganisa iimanuali ezisezantsi zangaphambili, iimidlalo yesiphithiphithi esemigqweni nemigaqo ehlala ibonakalisa ukubandakanya iindlela ezintsha zolwazi; Ukuqonda kanye nokuhlangabezela ngezinqumomthetho, izakhiwo ezingaqondisiswa kahle nangaphansi komthetho, izinkomba ngokobuchule namasu wokusebenza ohlotshaneni nemisebenzi kanye; Ukuqonda kanye nokuqonda ngohlelo olwazi oluncedisa ekuphatheni olwazi nolwazi ngohlelo lomsebenzi ohlelwe; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda izinqubo zokuthenga izimpahla nokuqamba izinkhompitha ngokuthengisa; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba, kanye nokuphathwa kokuqashwa kolunye uhlelo, ukuqapha kanye nokucubungula izinqubo; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda amasimu ephematheni kwezinkathi ephakade kwezwe nokuphatha izindlu; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda izinqubo namasu e-nsikeni kahulumene izindlu, izinkomba ngaphansi komthetho namandla ka-ukwakha kwamaphoyisa namaphoyisa. Commented [KH1]: Uyacelwa ukuba ufakisela olu lwazi oludingekayo ukuba abanikazi bale msebenzi balunakho. Ukuqonda nokuluqonda izinhlelo ezisesiMthethweni sikaZwelonke, ngokomthetho noma ngokwamasiko e-Riphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika ekuphatheni kwikomidi kahulumeni; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda izimali zikahulumene, amandla abantu kanye namasu okuphathwa ngokuxoxa kwezindaba ezihamba phambili; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda i-Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, eminye imithetho yezimali, izinkomba, iziyalo nezivumelwano ngokuhlangana; ukuqonda nokuluqonda ukusebenza komthunywa yiziphathimandla kanye namasiko okusebenza eminye imithunywa yezigaba ezingafani. Ukuqonda nokuluqonda izinkomba zikahulumeni wasikhathi sakho; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda amasu okuphathwa kokuthola imiphumela ngokuvamile; Ukuqonda nokuluqonda National and Provincial Treasury Regulations; ukuqonda nokuluqonda Division of Revenue Act (DoRA); ukuqonda nokuluqonda Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP); ukuqonda nokuluqonda Basic Accounting System (BAS) namasimu e-PERSAL; ukuqonda nokuluqonda amabhajethi kanye namasu e-MTEF.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinkonzo zokuhlelwa amabhajethi kokuqamba izinto; Nikela ngezinkonzo zokuqapha kanye nokubikwa ngemali echithwayo; Hlela futhi ulondoloze izinkomba zokuphathwa kwezimali nokuqasha izinkomba ezingakaziswa nokuphathwa kolwazi; Linganisa izinkomba zamabhajethi eHead Office, SDA’s, Chief Directorates kanye neziFakha; Siza ekwakheni i-Medium Term Expenditure: Framework (MTEF) amabhajethi; Hlela futhi uphathe ukungeniswa kwamabhajethi okulungiswa; Faka futhi ulondoloze amabhajethi avunyiwe kanye nezilungiso kwi-BAS; Hambisa amabhajethi womnyango namasu obuchule, ama-APP namasu okuqashwa kolunye; Wenze isibalo sokugcina amaphulo, amaphrojekthi kanye namasu okuhlela izinkomba; Hlaziya ukuvunyelwa ukukhokha nokutholakala kwemali.

xh.title: I-State Accountant: Management Accounting
xh.summary: I-State Accountant ebonelela ngeenkonzo zokwabalwa kwemali, ukulawula nokulawula imali kurhulumente we-Division of Revenue Act (DORA) e-Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo zemyaka e-3 (National Diploma/B-Degree okanye iphunga eliphezulu) kwimali; Okungenani unyaka wama-2 wamava kwi-Financial Management. Ikhono: Ulwazi olubonisiweyo koku kulandelayo: Public Finance Management ACT (PFMA), National Treasury Regulations (NTR), OPTI, Division of Revenue Act (DORA), imiyalelo yesebe nemit yolulawulo; Ukulungiselelwa kwezitatimende zemali, i-Financial Management Systems (FMS) ne-PERSAL; Iinkqubo ze-Cash flow (ukubika ngenyanga ngezenzo nemali echithwayo); Inqubo yebhajeti; Iikhono efunekayo: ukuhlola-nokuhlola, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukubhala iingxelo, unxibelelwano (elibhaliweyo noluthethwayo), ulwazi olubonisiweyo lwekhompyutha (i-MS Office packages), nokubala ngeemathematika. Ulwazi ngakumbi namava okusebenza ngomthetho, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo nendlela yokwenza izinto ezingcono ezinomthelela kumsebenzi wolawulo; Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zolwazi ezinceda ekulawulweni kolwazi nolwazi olumayelana nomsebenzi wolawulo; Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuthenga nokubiza izithengi; Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphuhliswa kwenkqubo, nolawulo lomsebenzi, ukulawula nokuphonononga iinkqubo; Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zanamhlanje zolawulo lolurhulumente; Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezithuli zenkonzo karhulumente. Commented [KH1]: Nceda wongeze ulwazi oluchanekileyo olufunekayo kumsebenzi othile. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngamalungiselelo oMgaqo-siseko, oMthetho nezobulungiselelo bezinstitushuni ezilawula i-Western Cape public sector; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemali karhulumente, iziseko zendalo nendlela yolawulo; Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, ezinye iinkqubo zemali, izalathiso, imiyalelo nezingqinamba ezinganyuswanga kwizithili; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngendlela esebenza ngayo iphondo nemisebenzi yeendawo ezingabakhoonyana kumasebe nendawo ezahlukeneyo zomsebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngeenkqubo zomrhulumente wango namhlanje; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngenkqubo yolawulo lolulinganiso ngokubanzi; Ulwazi nokuqonda i-National and Provincial Treasury Regulations; Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Division of Revenue Act (DoRA); Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP); Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Basic Accounting System (BAS) nezithuli ze-PERSAL; Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zebhajeti ne-MTEF.
xh.duties: Zela iinkonzo zokwabalwe kwemali nokucwangciswa; Zela iinkonzo zokulawula ibhajeti nokubika; Zisa izinqobo kwaye zigcine iinkqubo zolawulo lweemali nezinye iinkqubo; Zigcine ulwazi lweemali nolawulo lolwazi; Linganisa iingenelo zabuhlanga kwii-Head Office, SDA's, Chief Directorates nakwiindawo ezahluweneyo; Nceda ekwenzeni i-Medium Term Expenditure: Framework (MTEF) budget; Yenza kwaye ulawule okungenwayo kwe-Adjustments Budget; Faka kwaye ugcine amabhajeti avunyiweyo nokulungiswa kwi-BAS; Qondanisa amabhajeti esebe nezicwangciso eziyimigca, i-APPs nezicwangciso zomsebenzi; Yenza ixabiso leziprogram, iiprojekthi neenkqubo zezigqibo; Hlaziya ukuba kuyabiza na kwaye kukho malini na.

jobs.title: Social Worker Atlantis and Bergriver SDA
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R338 206 - R397 668 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 2: R413 004 – R478 395 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 3: R496 668 - R583 833 per annum, (OSD as prescribed) Grade 4: R608 859 – R754 785 per annum, (OSD as prescribed)
jobs.summary: Social worker position at the Department of Social Development in Atlantis, rendering social work services to vulnerable individuals, families, and communities across multiple grade levels.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in social work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a social worker: Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a social worker, Grade 1: No experience. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years' appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years' appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years of appropriate experience in social work after registration as a social worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; A valid Code B driving licence. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviour and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and knowledge management, protocol and professional ethics, Relevant legislation, policies, and prescripts (norms and standards); social dynamics, work values, and principles; developing and empowering others. Skills in the following: Challenge structural sources of poverty, inequality, oppression, discrimination, and exclusion. Written and verbal communication, report writing, self-management, motivation, Good planning and organizing, Problem- solving and analytical Computer literacy, Presentation and facilitation, Client orientation and customer focus; Ability and competence to assist, develop, advocate for, and empower individuals, families, groups, organizations, and communities to enhance their social functioning and their problem-solving capabilities; Ability to promote, restore, maintain, advocate for and enhance the functioning of individuals, families, groups and communities by enabling them to accomplish tasks, prevent and alleviate distress and use resources effectively; Understanding and ability to provide social work services towards protecting people who are vulnerable, at risk and unable to protect themselves; Ability to mentor and coach Social Workers Grade 1 Good communication skills, Report-writing skills, Self-management skills; Motivation skills; Good planning and organizing skills; Problem-solving and analytical skills; computer literacy, presentation and facilitation, and client orientation and customer focus.
jobs.duties: Render a social work service about the care, support, protection, and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families, and communities through the relevant programs (casework, group work, and community work). Attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form; Supervise and support social auxiliary workers' continuous professional development. Keep up to date with new developments in the social work and social welfare fields. Perform all the administrative functions required of the job.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Sosiale Werker Atlantis en Bergriver SDA
af.summary: Sosiale werker-posisie by die Department of Social Development in Atlantis, wat sosiale werksdienste aan kwesbare individue, gesinne en gemeenskappe oor verskeie graadvlakke lewer.
af.requirements: A relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie in sosiale werk (Bachelor of Social Work) wat professionele registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as 'n sosiale werker toelaat: Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as 'n sosiale werker, Graad 1: Geen ervaring nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in sosiale werk na registrasie as 'n sosiale werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in sosiale werk na registrasie as 'n sosiale werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in sosiale werk na registrasie as 'n sosiale werker by die South African Council for Social Service Professions; 'n Geldige Code B-bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toesighoudende raamwerk vir sosiale werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings interakteer ten einde sosiale welsyn te bevorder; Sosiale werksteorie en -ingrypings; Inligting- en kennisanalise, protokol en professionele etiek, relevante wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en -beginsels; die ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie, verslagskrywing, selfbestuur, motivering, goeie beplanning en organisering, probleemoplossing en analitiese rekenvaardigheid, aanbieding en fasilitering, kliëntgerigtheid en klantefokus; Vermoë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle op te tree en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en hul probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter; Vermoë om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, voor te pleit en te verbeter deur hul in staat te stel om take te voltooi, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoë om sosiale werksdienste te bied ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, in gevaar en nie in staat is om hulself te beskerm nie; Vermoë om sosiale werkers Graad 1 te mentoren en af te rig; Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, selfbestuursvaardighede; Motiveringsvaardighede; Goeie beplannings- en organisasievaardighede; Probleemoplossings- en analitiese vaardighede; rekenvaardigheid, aanbieding en fasilitering, en kliëntgerigtheid en klantefokus.
af.duties: Lewer 'n sosiale werksdiens ten opsigte van die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die relevante programme (gevallewerk, groepswerk en gemeenskapswerk). Behandel enige ander aangeleenthede wat tot sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei of daaruit kan voortspruit; Hou toesig oor en ondersteun die voortdurende professionele ontwikkeling van sosiale hulpwerkers. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelinge in die sosiale werk- en maatskaplike welsynsveld. Verrig al die administratiewe funksies wat die werk vereis.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wabezolo e-Atlantis nase-Bergriver SDA
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wabezolo e-Department of Social Development e-Atlantis, sinikela ngezinkonzo zomsebenzi wabezolo kubantu abasengozini, imindeni, kanye namaphakathi kumazinga ahlukene.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esifanele samabanga aphezulu kumsebenzi wabezolo (I-Bachelor of Social Work) esivumela ukubhaliswa ngobungcweti ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wabezolo: Ukubhaliswa ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wabezolo, izinga 1: Alikho isoiso. Izinga 2: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-10 yesoiso esifanele kumsebenzi wabezolo emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wabezolo ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Izinga 3: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-20 yesoiso esifanele kumsebenzi wabezolo emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wabezolo ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Izinga 4: Ubuncane beminyaka engama-30 yesoiso esifanele kumsebenzi wabezolo emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wabezolo ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Ilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela le-Code B. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Uhlaka lokuhlola abasebenzi bezomphakathi; Ukuziphatha komuntu kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi kanye nakhono okungalenga kumaphuzu lapho abantu bethintana namanduleli abo khona ukuze bakuthuthukise impilo yomphakathi; Ithiyori yomsebenzi wabezolo kanye nokungalenga ulwazi; Ukuphathwa kolwazi lwemininingwane, amaphrothokholo kanye nokuziphatha ngobungcweti, umthetho othintekayo, izinqumo, kanye namaphrophethi (amazinga kanye nemitapo yolwazi); isakhiwo somphakathi, amagugu omsebenzi, kanye nemigomo; ukuthuthukisa kanye nokukhulisa abanye. Ikhono kulokhu okulandelayo: Ukweqa imithombo yokungalunga kwesakhiwo yokuswela, ukungalingani, ukwenyuseka, ukwenza umehluko, kanye nokukhishwa eceleni. Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangokuthethwayo, ukubhala imibiko, ukuziphatha, ukukhuthaza, ukuhlela futhi uhlele kahle, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukwethula kanye nokulunga, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi; Ikhono nokuqwashiswa ukusiza, ukuthuthukisa, ukumela, kanye nokukhulusa abantu, imindeni, amaqembu, izinhlangano, kanye namaphakathi ukuze kube khona impilo yomphakathi kanye nakhono lokuxazulula izinkinga; Ikhono ukuthuthukisa, ukubuyisa, ukulondoloza, ukumela kanye nokukhulisa ukusebenza kwabantu, imindeni, amaqembu kanye namaphakathi ngokubanika amandla okuzuza imisebenzi, ukuvimbela kanye nokunciphisa inkinga futhi basebenzise imithombo ngokusebenziseka; Ukuqonda nakhono lokunikela nesevisi yomsebenzi wabezolo ngokuvikela abantu abasengozini, abasengozini futhi abangakwazi ukuzivikela; Ikhono lokuhlola futhi ukhole abasebenzi bezomphakathi abangesigaba 1 ukuxhumana okuhle, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okuziphatha; amakhono okukhuthaza; amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele kahle; amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya; ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukwethula kanye nokulunga, kanye nokugxila kumthengi.
zu.duties: Nikela nesevisi yomsebenzi wabezolo mayelana nenakekelo, ukusekela, ukuvikela, kanye nentuthuko yabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, imindeni, kanye namaphakathi kusebenziza izinhlela ezifanele (umsebenzi wezimoto, umsebenzi weqembu, kanye nomsebenzi waphakathi). Lalulela kwanoma yimiphi eminye imikhakha engadala noma engabangelwa ukungalungelelani kwezomphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo; Qaphisise futhi usekele ukuthuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo kwabasebenzi abancedisayo bezomphakathi. Gcina uthube ekuyezelweni ngezinto ezisha ezimfundweni yomsebenzi wabezolo kanye nezinkambu zenzuzo yomphakathi. Qedela yonke imisebenzi yolawulo edingekwe kule minyakazo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wezohluvo Lwezemfundo Atlantis naseBergriver SDA
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wenzabantu eDepartment of Social Development eAtlantis, kunika iinkonzo zenzabantu kumahlulo abathathwayo, iintsapho, nakumaphakathi kwamazinga amaninzi egrade.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zesikolo samabanga aphezulu ezifanelekileyo kumsebenzi wenzabantu (Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukubhalisa ngobungcali kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wenzabantu; Ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wenzabantu, Grade 1: Akukho mpilo yomsebenzi. Grade 2: Iminyaka elishumi ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wenzabantu emva kokubhalisa njengoMsebenzi Wenzabantu kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: Iminyaka elishumi elibini ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wenzabantu emva kokubhalisa njengoMsebenzi Wenzabantu kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: Iminyaka elishumi elithathu ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wenzabantu emva kokubhalisa njengomsebenzi wenzabantu kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions; Ilayisensi yokushowa ehambelana neCode B. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Isakhelo Sokulawula Abasebenzi Banzabantu; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kunye neenkqubo zentlalontle kunye nezakhono zokungena kwindawo abantu abasebenzisana kuyo nomhlaba wabo ukuze baye phambili nentlalontle; Itheori yomsebenzi wenzabantu kunye nokuvingcingwa; Ulawulwazi lolwazi nolwazi, iinkqubo nobunye belungisa, iimithetho, iinkqubo, kunye namagunya (iindlela namazinga); iintshukumo zentlalo, amaxabiso omsebenzi, kunye namagama; ukuphucula kunye nokuzuza abanye. Iakhono koku landelayo: Ukubakela bucala iimbombo ezingakhalisa ubungewala, ingalinganiso, ukucinezela, ukwahlukanisa, kunye nokushiywa ngaphandle. Unxibelelwano ngokubhalwa nangokuthethwa, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuzilawula, ukukhuthaza, iplani elungileyo nolungiselelwaniso, ukusombulula iingxaki kunye nokuqonda icomputer, ukubonisa nokuqhuba iintlanganiso, ukujolisa kumthengi; Ikhono nokukwazi ukunceda, ukuphucula, ukukhusela amalungelo, kunye nokuzuza abahlulo, iintsapho, amaqela, iindibaniselwa, nakumaphakathi ukuze kuphuculwe imisebenzi yabo yentlalo nakhono abo abusombulula iingxaki; Ikhono lokukhuthaza, kulungise, sigcine, sikhusela kwaye siphucule imisebenzi yabahlulo, iintsapho, amaqela nakumaphakathi ngokubanika ikhono lokwenza umsebenzi, ukuthintela kunye nokulawula ubuhlungu nokusetyenziswa kwemithombo ngendlela efanelekileyo; Ukuqonda nakhono lokunika iinkonzo zomsebenzi wenzabantu ngokukhusela abantu abathathwayo, basengozini futhi abazikhuseliyo; Ikhono lokukhokela kunye nokufundisa Abasebenzi Banzabantu Grade 1 Iakhono lonxibelelwano olulungileyo, iakhono zokubhala iingxelo, iakhono zokuzilawula; Iakhono zokukhuthaza; Iakhono zeplani nolungiselelwaniso olulungileyo; Iakhono zokusombulula iingxaki nokwahlula; ukusebenzisa icomputer, ukubonisa nokuqhuba iintlanganiso, kunye nokujolisa kumthengi nokuqwalasela umthengi.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yomsebenzi wenzabantu ngenkatho, inkxaso, inkhuselo, nophuhliso koluntu oluthathwayo, amaqela, iintsapho, nakumaphakathi ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo (umsebenzi wezityeya, umsebenzi wezaqele, kunye nomsebenzi womphakathi); Qwalasela naziphi na ezinye iindaba ezinokubangela, okanye ezivela kwingqikelelo ngenkathazomntu nganoma iyipina na ndlela; Lawula kwaye uxhase abasebenzi abancedisayo bahlule ngokuqhubeka koluntu abo babangowonke umntu; Hlala uyazi ngezinto ezintsha ezikhoyo kumsebenzi wenzabantu noluntu; Yenza onke amanqaku olawulo afuneka kule misede yomsebenzi.

jobs.title: Principal Provincial Inspector: LAW Enforcement
jobs.centre: Western Cape Mobility Department, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Manage and enforce road traffic and transport legislation, lead joint law enforcement activities, and oversee resources and subordinate staff within the Western Cape Mobility Department.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (equivalent or higher qualification); Must be in possession of a Basic Traffic Diploma; A minimum of 6 years experience in the field; A valid code A and EC driving licence; No Criminal record. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Operational functioning of the Directorate Traffic Law Enforcement; National Road Traffic Act, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996); Road Traffic Amendment Act, 2008 (Act 64 of 2008); Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act 60 of 2000); Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977); Firearms Control Regulations, 2004; National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000; Dimensional and Mass Limitations and the Requirements for Abnormal Load Vehicles (TRH 11); Guidelines from the Director of Public Prosecutions. Skills needed: Numeracy; Literacy; Computer Literacy; Written and verbal communication; Project Management; Accounting, Finance and Audit; Economic, Financial and Statistical Analysis; Legal Administration; Planning; Organising; Leadership; Monitoring; People Management; Investigations; Motivational; Analytical; Operational/Project Management; Negotiation; Interpretation; Legal Evidential; Ability to work under pressure; Willingness to regularly travel away from the office.
jobs.duties: Manage and enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport Legislation and other relevant legislations; Manage joint law enforcement activities and projects (co-operative governance); Manage resources and provide leadership and direction to all subordinates; Identify and manage risks; Manage the performance of all administrative activities and related duties; Supervisory functions.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POST

af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur: Regshandhawing
af.summary: Bestuur en handhaaf padverkeer- en vervoerwetgewing, lei gesamentlike regshandhawingsaktiwiteite, en hou toesig oor hulpbronne en ondergeskikte personeel binne die Western Cape Mobility Department.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie); Moet in besit wees van 'n Basiese Verkeersdiploma; 'n Minimum van 6 jaar ervaring in die veld; 'n Geldige kode A en EC bestuurslisensie; Geen strafblad. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Operasionele funksionering van die Direktoraat Verkeersregshandhawing; National Road Traffic Act, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996); Road Traffic Amendment Act, 2008 (Act 64 of 2008); Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act 60 of 2000); Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977); Firearms Control Regulations, 2004; National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000; Dimensional and Mass Limitations and the Requirements for Abnormal Load Vehicles (TRH 11); Riglyne van die Direkteur van Openbare Vervolging. Vaardighede benodig: Syferkundigheid; Geletterdheid; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Projekbestuur; Rekeningkunde, Finansies en Oudit; Ekonomiese, Finansiële en Statistiese Analise; Regsadministrasie; Beplanning; Organisasie; Leierskap; Monitering; Personeelsbestuur; Ondersoeke; Motiveringsvermoë; Analities; Operasionele/Projekbestuur; Onderhandeling; Interpretasie; Regsevidensie; Vermoë om onder druk te werk; Bereidwilligheid om gereeld weg van die kantoor te reis.
af.duties: Bestuur en handhaaf padverkeer-, openbare passasiers-, vervoerwetgewing en ander tersaaklike wetgewing; Bestuur gesamentlike regshandhawingsaktiwiteite en projekte (koöperatiewe bestuur); Bestuur hulpbronne en verskaf leierskap en rigting aan alle ondergeskiktes; Identifiseer en bestuur risiko's; Bestuur die prestasie van alle administratiewe aktiwiteite en verwante pligte; Toesighoudende funksies.

zu.title: Isiphathihlathi Esiyinhloko Sesifunda: Ukuphoqa Umthetho
zu.summary: Phatha futhi uqaphele izomthetho ngokuhamba kwezimoto kanye nethuluzi lokuhamba, hudule imisebenzi yokuphoqa umthetho ehlanganyeni, futhi lawule imithombo nobasebenze ngaphansi kwakho ku-Western Cape Mobility Department.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (izinhlaka ezingulingana noma eziphezulu kakhulu); Kufanele ube ne-Basic Traffic Diploma; Okungenani 6 iminyaka yohlu lwemisebenzi enkundleni; Isitifiketi se-code A kanye ne-EC lesokugibela; Akukho rekodi yezono ezenzelwe ubugxila. Izidingo ezibalulekile: Ulwazi ngalokhu: Ukusebenza komsebenzi we-Directorate Traffic Law Enforcement; National Road Traffic Act, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996); Road Traffic Amendment Act, 2008 (Act 64 of 2008); Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act 60 of 2000); Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977); Firearms Control Regulations, 2004; National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000; Dimensional and Mass Limitations and the Requirements for Abnormal Load Vehicles (TRH 11); Izinqondiso ezivela kumqondisi wamacala omphakathi. Izindlela eziyidingekayo: Ubuchule bokubala; Ubuchule bokusukela nokubhala; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa isicomputha; Ukuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma; Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Izimali, ukuphathwa kwemali kanye nokuhlolwa; Ukuhlola ukuziphendulela komnotho, izimali kanye nezibalo; Ukuphathwa kwomthetho; Ukulungelelisa; Ukuhlela; Ubukhosi; Ukulandela; Ukuphathwa kwabantu; Ukuphenya; Ukukhuthaza; Ukuhlola ubuqotho; Ukusebenza komsebenzi noma ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Ukuxoxisana; Ukutolika; Umbhalo wesiko; Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenhlamvana; Ukuzithoba ukuhamba ngezikhathi kude nendawo yokusebenza.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uqaphele umthetho wezokuhamba kwezimoto, wezokuhamba kwabagibeli bomphakathi, nezomthetho zokuthutha kanye nomthetho omunye ohlobene; Phatha imisebenzi yokuphoqa umthetho ehlanganyeni kanye nemiqulu (ukuphathwa ngokubambisana); Phatha imithombo buthathe isikhundla ngokuhola oboke abasebenze ngaphansi kwakho; Baza uphata ulutho; Phatha ukusebenza ngezinkomba eziphelele zokuphathwa kwemibhalo nezinye imisebenzi kufunyanwe kuyo; Imisebenzi yokulandela.

xh.title: Isiphongo seNgcendelela eSiphakamilesi: Ukwatshulwa koMthetho
xh.summary: Lawula kwaze kwagqitywa ukusetshenziswa kolwalamulo lwethrafikhi yendlela noluhambiso, bokhokho bathethe imisebenzi yokwatyhola ulwalamulo ngokubambisana, baze balawule amacebo abalawulwa imisebenzi nabanzi abangaphantsi kwabo kwiSebe leMobility lese Western Cape.
xh.requirements: IGraji ye-12 (okanye izidanga ngaphezulu); kufuneka abe neDiploma yeTraffic eYisiseko; Ubuncwane beminye engaphezulu kwe-6 yeminyaka yolwazi kule ndawo; Ilayisenisi yekhodi A ne-EC esemthethweni yokushayela; Akukho bungozi obukhankanyiweyo kwigunya lezigwebo. Izakhono: Ulwazi ngezinto zilandelayo: Ukuqhuba ngokusebenzayo iDirektore yokuWatshula koMthetho weTraffic; uMthetho weSizwe weTrafikhi yoMzila, 1996 (uMthetho 93 ka-1996); uMthetho oChongiweyo weTrafikhi yoMzila, 2008 (uMthetho 64 ka-2008); uMthetho wokuLawula iZikhali ezithi zivuthwaza, 2000 (uMthetho 60 ka-2000); uMthetho weNqumgamano eziZekwe eNyangweni, 1977 (uMthetho 51 ka-1977); iZimiso zokuLawulwa kweZikhali ezithi zivuthwaza, 2004; iZimiso zeSizwe zeTrafikhi yoMzila, 2000; iMida zeDimensi noBunzima kunye neeFundo zeFutha ezizeNgaphakathi kweLayisi eNgoswini (TRH 11); iNdibaniselwano esuka kwiNkanka yoMthetho eBekiweyo oSebenzela eRiphabhlikhi. Iakhono efunekayo: ukubala; ukufunda nokubhala; ukuqonda nekhompyutha; unxibelelwano ngokubhala nangokuthetha; ulawulo lweprojekthi; ukwazi ama-Akhawunti, iiMali nokuphangwa; uhlalutyo lwezoQoqosho, lweMali nolweziBalo; ulawulo lomthetho; ulungiselelo; ukuqamba izinto ngokulungelelanisa; inkokhelo; ukulandela; ulawulo labantu; ukuphanda ububi; ukhuthazo; uhlalutyo; ulawulo lokuQhuba/leprojekthi; iNtetho yakuThintana; ukuChaza; ubungqina bomthetho; ukukwazi ukusebenza ngengxindlindala; ukuzimisela ukuhamba ixesha elithile usuke ofisini ngokuhlala.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaze kwagqitywa ukusetshenziswa kolwalamulo lweTrafikhi yoMzila, lokuHamba kwabantu ngowiso-ngenisa, koluHambiso nakwelunye ulwalamulo oluhambelana nalo; Lawula imisebenzi yokwatyhula ulwalamulo ngokubambisana kunye neeprojekthi (ulawulo ngokubambisana); Lawula amacebo unike inkokhelo nolwazi onikeze bonke abangaphantsi kwakho; Qaphela ulawule iingozi ezinokubakho; Lawula ukusebenza ngokupheleleyo kwayo yonke imisebenzi engobuqhawe kunye nendima efanayo; Imisebenzi yolawulo.
